M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:52: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Him: everlasting obedience is His right. Will you heed anyone other than God?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:53: Whatever good things you possess come from God, and when hardship afflicts you, it is to Him alone you cry out for help,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:54: yet when He has relieved you of your hardship- lo and behold!- some of you attribute partners to your Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:55: Let them show ingratitude for the favours We have shown them; ‘Enjoy your brief time- soon you will know.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:56: They set aside part of the sustenance We give them, for [idols] about which they have no true knowledge. By God! You will be questioned about your false inventions.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:57: They assign daughters to God––may He be exalted!––and the [sons] they desire to themselves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:58: When one of them is given news of the birth of a baby girl, his face darkens and he is filled with gloom.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:59: In his shame he hides himself away from his people because of the bad news he has been given. Should he keep her and suffer contempt or bury her in the dust? How ill they judge!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:60: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter should have the contemptible image, and God should have the highest one: He is the Mighty, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:61: If God took people to task for the evil they do, He would not leave one living creature on earth, but He reprieves them until an appointed time: when their time comes they cannot delay it for a moment nor can they bring it forward.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:62: They attribute to God what they themselves dislike while their own tongues utter the lie that the best belongs to them. Without doubt it is the Fire that belongs to them: they will be given priority there!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:63: By God, We have sent messengers before you [Muhammad] to other communities, but Satan made their foul deeds seem alluring to them. He is the patron of these present disbelievers too, and a painful punishment awaits them all.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:64: We have sent down the Scripture to you only to make clear to them what they differ about, and as guidance and mercy to those who believe.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:65: It is God who sends water down from the sky and with it revives the earth when it is dead. There truly is a sign in this for people who listen.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:66: In livestock, too, you have a lesson- We give you a drink from the contents of their bellies, between waste matter and blood, pure milk, sweet to the drinker.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:67: From the fruits of date palms and grapes you take sweet juice and wholesome provisions. There truly is a sign in this for people who use their reason.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:68: And your Lord inspired the bee, saying, ‘Build yourselves houses in the mountains and trees and what people construct.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:69: Then feed on all kinds of fruit and follow the ways made easy for you by your Lord.’ From their bellies comes a drink of different colours in which there is healing for people. There truly is a sign in this for those who think.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:70: It is God who has created you and in time will cause you to die. Some of you will be reduced, in old age, to a most abject state, so that, after having knowledge, they will know nothing at all: God is truly all knowing and all powerful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:71: God has given some of you more provision than others. Those who have been given more are unwilling to pass their provision on to the slaves they possess so that they become their equals. How can they refuse to acknowledge God’s blessings?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:72: And it is God who has given you spouses from amongst yourselves and through them He has given you children and grandchildren and provided you with good things. How can they believe in falsehood and deny God’s blessings?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:73: Those they worship beside God have no power to provide anything for them from the heavens or the earth: they can do nothing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:74: So do not make up images about God: God knows and you do not.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:75: God presents this illustration: a slave controlled by his master, with no power over anything, and another man We have supplied with good provision, from which he gives alms privately and openly. Can they be considered equal? All praise belongs to God, but most of them do not recognize this.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:76: God presents another illustration: two men, one of them dumb, unable to do anything, a burden to his carer- whatever task he directs him to, he achieves nothing good- can he be considered equal to one who commands justice and is on the straight path?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:77: All that is hidden from view in the heavens and earth belongs to God. The coming of the Hour of Judgement is like the blink of an eye, or even quicker: God has power over everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:78: It is God who brought you out of your mothers’ wombs knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and minds, so that you might be thankful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:79: Do they not see the birds made to fly through the air in the sky? Nothing holds them up except God. There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:80: It is God who has given you a place of rest in your homes and from the skins of animals made you homes that you find light [to handle] when you travel and when you set up camp; furnishings and comfort for a while from their wool, fur, and hair.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:81: It is God who has given you shade from what He has created, and places of shelter in the mountains; garments to protect you from the heat, and garments to protect you in your wars. In this way He perfects His blessings on you, so that you may devote yourselves to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:82: But if they turn away [Prophet], your only duty is to deliver the message clearly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:83: They know God’s blessings, but refuse to recognize them: most of them are ungrateful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:84: The day will come when We raise up a witness from every community, when the disbelievers will not be allowed to make excuses or amends.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:85: When the evildoers face punishment it will not be lightened for them nor will they be given any respite.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:86: When the idolaters see the partners they joined with God they will say, ‘Our Lord, these are the partners we used to invoke beside You,’ but the partners will retort, ‘You are liars,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:87: and on that Day they will offer total submission to God: their false deities will desert them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:88: Because of the corruption they spread, We shall add torment upon torment for those who disbelieved and barred others from the path of God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:89: The day will come when We raise up in each community a witness against them, and We shall bring you [Prophet] as a witness against these people, for We have sent the Scripture down to you explaining everything, and as guidance and mercy and good news to those who devote themselves to God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:90: God commands justice, doing good, and generosity towards relatives and He forbids what is shameful, blameworthy, and oppressive. He teaches you, so that you may take heed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:91: Fulfil any pledge you make in God’s name and do not break oaths after you have sworn them, for you have made God your surety: God knows everything you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:92: Do not use your oaths to deceive each other- like a woman who unravels the thread she has firmly spun- just because one party may be more numerous than another. God tests you with this, and on the Day of the Resurrection He will make clear to you those things you differed about.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:93: If God so willed, He would have made you all one people, but He leaves to stray whoever He will and guides whoever He will. You will be questioned about your deeds.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:94: Do not use your oaths to deceive each other lest any foot should slip after being firmly placed and lest you should taste the penalty for having hindered others from the path of God, and suffer terrible torment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:95: Do not sell for a small price any pledge made in God’s name: what God has [to give] is better for you, if you only knew.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:96: What you have runs out but what God has endures, and We shall certainly reward those who remain steadfast according to the best of their actions.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:97: To whoever, male or female, does good deeds and has faith, We shall give a good life and reward them according to the best of their actions.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:98: [Prophet], when you recite the Quran, seek God’s protection from the outcast, Satan.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:99: He has no power over those who believe and trust in their Lord;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:100: his power is only over those who ally themselves with him and those who, because of him, join partners with God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:101: When We substitute one revelation for another- and God knows best what He reveals- they say, ‘You are just making it up,’ but most of them have no knowledge.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:102: Say that the Holy Spirit has brought the Revelation with the Truth step by step from your Lord, to strengthen the believers and as guidance and good news to the devout.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:103: We know very well that they say, ‘It is a man who teaches him,’ but the language of the person they allude to is foreign, while this revelation is in clear Arabic.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:104: If people do not believe in God’s revelation, God does not guide them, and a painful punishment awaits them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:105: Falsehood is fabricated only by those who do not believe in God’s revelation: they are the liars.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:106: With the exception of those who are forced to say they do not believe, although their hearts remain firm in faith, those who reject God after believing in Him and open their hearts to disbelief will have the wrath of God upon them and a grievous punishment awaiting them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:107: This is because they love the life of this world more than the one to come, and God does not guide those who reject Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:108: These are people whose hearts, hearing, and sight have been closed off by God: they are heedless,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:109: and there is no doubt that they will be the losers in the Hereafter.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:110: But your Lord will be most forgiving and most merciful to those who leave their homes after persecution, then strive and remain steadfast.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:111: On the Day when every soul will come pleading for itself, every soul will be paid in full for all its actions- they will not be wronged.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:112: God presents the example of a town that was secure and at ease, with provisions coming to it abundantly from all places. Then it became ungrateful for God’s blessings, so God afflicted it with the garment of famine and fear, for what its people had done.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:113: A messenger who was one of them came to them, but they called him a liar. So punishment overwhelmed them in the midst of their evildoing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:114: So eat of the good and lawful things God has provided for you and be thankful for His blessings, if it is Him that you worship.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:115: He has forbidden you only these things: carrion, blood, pig’s meat, and animals over which any name other than God’s has been invoked. But if anyone is forced by hunger, not desiring it nor exceeding their immediate need, God is forgiving and merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:116: Do not say falsely, ‘This is lawful and that is forbidden,’ inventing a lie about God: those who invent lies about God will not prosper-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:117: they may have a little enjoyment, but painful punishment awaits them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:118: [Prophet], We forbade the Jews what We told you about. We did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:119: But towards those who do wrong out of ignorance, and afterwards repent and make amends, your Lord is most forgiving and merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:120: Abraham was truly an example: devoutly obedient to God and true in faith. He was not an idolater;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:121: he was thankful for the blessings of God who chose him and guided him to a straight path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:122: We gave him blessings in this world, and he is among the right-eous in the Hereafter.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:123: Then We revealed to you [Muhammad], ‘Follow the creed of Abraham, a man of pure faith who was not an idolater.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:124: The Sabbath was made obligatory only for those who differed about it. On the Day of Resurrection your Lord will judge between them as to their differences.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:125: [Prophet], call [people] to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good teaching. Argue with them in the most courteous way, for your Lord knows best who has strayed from His way and who is rightly guided.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:126: If you [believers] have to respond to an attack, make your response proportionate, but it is best to stand fast.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:127: So [Prophet] be steadfast: your steadfastness comes only from God. Do not grieve over them; do not be distressed by their scheming,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.16:128: for God is with those who are mindful of Him and who do good.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:1: Glory to Him who made His servant travel by night from the sacred place of worship to the furthest place of worship, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him some of Our signs: He alone is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:2: We also gave Moses the Scripture, and made it a guide for the Children of Israel. ‘Entrust yourselves to no one but Me,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:3: you descendants of those We carried with Noah: he was truly a thankful servant.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:4: We declared to the Children of Israel in the Scripture, ‘Twice you will spread corruption in the land and become highly arrogant.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:5: When the first of these warnings was fulfilled, We sent against you servants of Ours with great force, and they ravaged your homes. That warning was fulfilled,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:6: but then We allowed you to prevail against your enemy. We increased your wealth and offspring and made you more numerous––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:7: whether you do good or evil it is to your own souls––and when the second warning was fulfilled [We sent them] to shame your faces and enter the place of worship as they did the first time, and utterly destroy whatever fell into their power.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:8: Your Lord may yet have mercy on you, but if you do the same again, so shall We: We have made Hell a prison for those who defy [Our warning].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:9: This Quran does indeed show the straightest way. It gives the faithful who do right the good news that they will have a great reward and
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:10: warns that We have prepared an agonizing punishment for those who do not believe in the world to come.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:11: Yet man prays for harm, just as he prays for good: man is ever hasty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:12: We made the night and the day as two signs, then darkened the night and made the daylight for seeing, for you to seek your Lord’s bounty and to know how to count the years and calculate. We have explained everything in detail.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:13: We have bound each human being’s destiny to his neck. On the Day of Resurrection, We shall bring out a record for each of them, which they will find spread wide open,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:14: ‘Read your record. Today your own soul is enough to calculate your account.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:15: Whoever accepts guidance does so for his own good; whoever strays does so at his own peril. No soul will bear another’s burden, nor do We punish until We have sent a messenger.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:16: When We decide to destroy a town, We command those corrupted by wealth [to reform], but they [persist in their] disobedience; Our sentence is passed, and We destroy them utterly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:17: How many generations We have destroyed since Noah! Your Lord knows and observes the sins of His servants well enough.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:18: If anyone desires [only] the fleeting life, We speed up whatever We will in it, for whoever We wish; in the end We have prepared Hell for him in which to burn, disgraced and rejected.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:19: But if anyone desires the life to come and strives after it as he should, as a true believer, his striving will be thanked.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:20: To both the latter and the former, We give some of your Lord’s bounty. [Prophet], your Lord’s bounty is not restricted-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:21: see how We have given some more than others- but the Hereafter holds greater ranks and greater favours.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:22: Set up no other god beside God, or you will end up disgraced and forsaken.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:23: Your Lord has commanded that you should worship none but Him, and that you be kind to your parents. If either or both of them reach old age with you, say no word that shows impatience with them, and do not be harsh with them, but speak to them respectfully
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:24: and lower your wing in humility towards them in kindness and say, ‘Lord, have mercy on them, just as they cared for me when I was little.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:25: Your Lord knows best what is in your heart. If you are good, He is most forgiving to those who return to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:26: Give relatives their due, and the needy, and travellers- do not squander your wealth wastefully:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:27: those who squander are the brothers of Satan, and Satan is most ungrateful to his Lord-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:28: but if, while seeking some bounty that you expect from your Lord, you turn them down, then at least speak some word of comfort to them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:29: Do not be tight-fisted, nor so open-handed that you end up blamed and overwhelmed with regret.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:30: Your Lord gives abundantly to whoever He will, and sparingly to whoever He will: He knows and observes His servants thoroughly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:31: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty––We shall provide for them and for you––killing them is a great sin.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:32: And do not go anywhere near adultery: it is an outrage, and an evil path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:33: Do not take life, which God has made sacred, except by right: if anyone is killed wrongfully, We have given authority to the defender of his rights, but he should not be excessive in taking life, for he is already aided [by God].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:34: Do not go near the orphan’s property, except with the best [intentions], until he reaches the age of maturity. Honour your pledges: you will be questioned about your pledges.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:35: Give full measure when you measure, and weigh with accurate scales: that is better and fairer in the end.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:36: Do not follow blindly what you do not know to be true: ears, eyes, and heart, you will be questioned about all these.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:37: Do not strut arrogantly about the earth: you cannot break it open, nor match the mountains in height.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:38: The evil of all these actions is hateful to your Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:39: [Prophet], this is some of the wisdom your Lord has revealed to you: do not set up another god beside God, or you will be thrown into Hell, blamed and rejected.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:40: What? Has your Lord favoured you people with sons and taken daughters for Himself from the angels?What a monstrous thing for you to say!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:41: We have explained things in various ways in this Quran, so that such people might take notice, but it has only turned them further away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:42: Say, ‘If there were other gods along with Him, as they say there are, then they would have tried to find a way to the Lord of the Throne.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:43: Glory to Him! He is far above what they say!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:44: The seven heavens and the earth and everyone in them glorify Him. There is not a single thing that does not celebrate His praise, though you do not understand their praise: He is most forbearing, most forgiving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:45: [Prophet], when you recite the Quran, We put an invisible barrier between you and those who do not believe in the life to come.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:46: We have put covers on their hearts that prevent them from understanding it, and heaviness in their ears. When you mention your Lord in the Quran, and Him alone, they turn their backs and run away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:47: We know best the way they listen, when they listen to you and when they confer in secret, and these wrongdoers say, ‘You are only following a man who is bewitched.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:48: See what they think you are like! But they are lost and cannot find the right way.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:49: They also say, ‘What? When we are turned to bones and dust, shall we really be raised up in a new act of creation?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:50: Say, ‘[Yes] even if you were [as hard as] stone, or iron,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:51: or any other substance you think hard to bring to life.’ Then they will say, ‘Who will bring us back?’ Say, ‘The One who created you the first time.’ Then they will shake their heads at you and say, ‘When will that be?’ Say, ‘It may well be very soon:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:52: it will be the Day when He calls you, and you answer by praising Him, and you think you have stayed [on earth] only a little while.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:53: [Prophet], tell My servants to say what is best. Satan sows discord among them: Satan is a sworn enemy of man.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:54: Your Lord has the most knowledge about all of you: if He pleases He will have mercy on you, and if He pleases He will punish you. [Prophet], We did not send you to take charge of them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:55: Your Lord knows best about everyone in the heavens and the earth. We gave some prophets more than others: We gave David a book [of Psalms].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:56: Say, ‘Call upon those you claim to be deities beside God: they have no power to remove or avert any harm from you.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:57: Those [angels] they pray to are themselves seeking a way to their Lord, even those who are closest to Him. They hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. The punishment of your Lord is much to be feared:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:58: there is no community We shall not destroy, or punish severely, before the Day of Resurrection- this is written in the Book.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:59: Nothing prevents Us from sending miraculous signs, except the fact that previous peoples denied them. We gave the people of Thamud the she-camel as a clear sign, yet they maltreated it. We send signs only to give warning.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:60: [Prophet], We have told you that your Lord knows all about human beings. The vision We showed you was only a test for people, as was the cursed tree [mentioned] in the Quran. We warn them, but this only increases their insolence.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:61: When We said to the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ they all bowed down, but not Iblis. He retorted, ‘Why should I bow down to someone You have created out of clay?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:62: and [then] said, ‘You see this being You have honoured above me? If You reprieve me until the Day of Resurrection, I will lead all but a few of his descendants by the nose.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:63: God said, ‘Go away! Hell will be your reward, and the reward of any of them who follow you- an ample reward.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:64: Rouse whichever of them you can with your voice, muster your cavalry and infantry against them, share their wealth and their children with them, and make promises to them- Satan promises them nothing but delusion-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:65: but you will have no authority over My [true] servants: Your Lord can take care of them well enough.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:66: [People], it is your Lord who makes ships go smoothly for you on the sea so that you can seek His bounty: He is most merciful towards you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:67: When you get into distress at sea, those you pray to besides Him desert you, but when He brings you back safe to land you turn away: man is ever ungrateful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:68: Can you be sure that God will not have you swallowed up into the earth when you are back on land, or that He will not send a sandstorm against you? Then you will find no one to protect you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:69: Or can you be sure that He will not send you back out to sea, and send a violent storm against you to drown you for being so ungrateful? You will find no helper against Us there.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:70: We have honoured the children of Adam and carried them by land and sea; We have provided good sustenance for them and favoured them specially above many of those We have created.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:71: On the Day when We summon each community, along with its leader, those who are given their record in their right hand will read it [with pleasure]. But no one will be wronged in the least:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:72: those who were blind in this life will be blind in the Hereafter, and even further off the path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:73: [Prophet], the disbelievers tried to tempt you away from what We revealed to you, so that you would invent some other revelation and attribute it to Us and then they would have taken you as a friend.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:74: If We had not made you stand firm, you would almost have inclined a little towards them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:75: In that case, We would have made you taste a double punishment in this life, and a double punishment after death and then you would have found no one to help you against Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:76: They planned to scare you off the land, but they would not have lasted for more than a little while after you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:77: Such was Our way with the messengers We sent before you, and you will find no change in Our ways.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:78: So perform the regular prayers in the period from the time the sun is past its zenith till the darkness of the night, and [recite] the Quran at dawn- dawn recitation is always witnessed––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:79: and dur-ing the night wake up and pray, as an extra offering of your own, so that your Lord may raise you to a [highly] praised status.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:80: Say, ‘My Lord, make me go in truthfully, and come out truthfully, and grant me supporting authority from You.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:81: And say, ‘The truth has come, and falsehood has passed away: falsehood is bound to pass away.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:82: We send down the Quran as healing and mercy to those who believe; as for those who disbelieve, it only increases their loss.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:83: When We favour man he turns arrogantly to one side, but when harm touches him, he falls into despair.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:84: Say, ‘Everyone does things their own way, but your Lord is fully aware of who follows the best-guided path.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:85: [Prophet], they ask you about the Spirit. Say, ‘The Spirit is part of my Lord’s domain. You have only been given a little knowledge.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:86: If We pleased, We could take away what We have revealed to you- then you would find no one to plead for you against Us-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:87: if it were not for your Lord’s mercy: His favour to you has been truly great.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:88: Say, ‘Even if all mankind and jinn came together to produce something like this Quran, they could not produce anything like it, however much they helped each other.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:89: In this Quran, We have set out all kinds of examples for people, yet most of them persist in disbelieving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:90: They say, ‘We will not believe for you [Muhammad] until you make a spring gush out of the ground for us;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:91: or until you have a garden of date palms and vines, and make rivers pour through them;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:92: or make the sky fall on us in pieces, as you claimed will happen; or bring God and the angels before us face to face;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:93: or have a house made of gold; or ascend into the sky- even then, we will not believe in your ascension until you send a real book down for us to read.’ Say, ‘Glory be to my Lord! Am I anything but a mortal, a messenger?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:94: The only thing that kept these people from believing, when guidance came to them, was that they said, ‘How could God have sent a human being as a messenger?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:95: Say, ‘If there were angels walking about on earth, feeling at home, We would have sent them an angel from Heaven as a messenger.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:96: Say, ‘God is witness enough between me and you. He knows and observes His servants well.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:97: [Prophet], anyone God guides is truly guided, and you will find no protector other than Him for anyone He leaves astray. On the Day of Resurrection We shall gather them, lying on their faces, blind, dumb, and deaf. Hell will be their Home. Whenever the Fire goes down, We shall make it blaze more fiercely for them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:98: This is what they will get for rejecting Our signs and saying, ‘What? When we are turned to bones and dust, how can we be raised in a new act of creation?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:99: Do they not see that God, who created the heavens and earth, can create the likes of them [anew]? He has ordained a time for them- there is no doubt about that- but the evildoers refuse everything except disbelief.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:100: Say, ‘If you possessed the very stores of my Lord’s bounty, you would hold them back in your fear of spending: man is ever grudging.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:101: In the past, We gave Moses nine clear signs- ask the Children of Israel. When Moses came to [the Egyptians], Pharaoh said to him, ‘Moses, I think you are bewitched.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:102: He said, ‘You know very well that only the Lord of the heavens and earth could have sent these signs as clear proof. I think that you, Pharaoh, are doomed.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:103: So he wanted to wipe them off the [face of the] earth, but We drowned him and those with him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:104: After his death, We told the Children of Israel, ‘Live in the land, and when the promise of the Hereafter is fulfilled, We shall bring you to the assembly of all people.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:105: We sent down the Quran with the truth, and with the truth it has come down- [Prophet], We sent you only to give good news and warning-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:106: it is a recitation that We have revealed in parts, so that you can recite it to people at intervals; We have sent it down little by little.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:107: Say, ‘Whether you believe it or not, those who were given knowledge earlier fall down on their faces when it is recited to them,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:108: and say, “Glory to our Lord! Our Lord’s promise has been fulfilled.”
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:109: They fall down on their faces, weeping, and [the Quran] increases their humility.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:110: Say [to them], ‘Call on God, or on the Lord of Mercy- whatever names you call Him, the best names belong to Him.’ [Prophet], do not be too loud in your prayer, or too quiet, but seek a middle way
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.17:111: and say, ‘Praise belongs to God, who has no child nor partner in His rule. He is not so weak as to need a protector. Proclaim His limitless greatness!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:1: Praise be to God, who sent down the Scripture to His servant and made it unerringly straight,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:2: warning of severe punishment from Him, and [giving] glad news to the believers who do good deeds––an excellent reward
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:4: It warns those people who assert, ‘God has offspring.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:5: They have no knowledge about this, nor did their forefathers––it is a monstrous assertion that comes out of their mouths: what they say is nothing but lies.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:6: But [Prophet] are you going to worry yourself to death over them if they do not believe in this message?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:7: We have adorned the earth with attractive things so that We may test people to find out which of them do best,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:8: but We shall reduce all this to barren dust.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:9: [Prophet], do you find the Companions in the Cave and al-Raqim so wondrous, among all Our other signs?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:10: When the young men sought refuge in the cave and said, ‘Our Lord, grant us Your mercy, and find us a good way out of our ordeal,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:11: We sealed their ears [with sleep] in the cave for years.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:12: Then We woke them so that We could make clear which of the two parties was better able to work out how long they had been there.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:13: [Prophet], We shall tell you their story as it really was. They were young men who believed in their Lord, and We gave them more and more guidance.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:14: We gave strength to their hearts when they stood up and said, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth. We shall never call upon any god other than Him, for that would be an outrageous thing to do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:15: These people of ours have taken gods other than Him. Why do they not produce clear evidence about them? Who could be more unjust than someone who makes up lies about God?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:16: Now that you have left such people, and what they worshipped instead of God, take refuge in the cave. God will shower His mercy on you and make you an easy way out of your ordeal.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:17: You could have seen the [light of the] sun as it rose, moving away to the right of their cave, and when it set, moving away to the left of them, while they lay in the wide space inside the cave. (This is one of God’s signs: those people God guides are rightly guided, but you will find no protector to lead to the right path those He leaves to stray.)
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:18: You would have thought they were awake, though they lay asleep. We turned them over, to the right and the left, with their dog stretching out its forelegs at the entrance. If you had seen them, you would have turned and run away, filled with fear of them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:19: In time We woke them, and they began to question one another. One of them asked, ‘How long have you been here?’ and [some] answered, ‘A day or part of a day,’ but then [others] said, ‘Your Lord knows best how long you have been here. One of you go to the city with your silver coins, find out where the best food is there, and bring some back. But be careful not to let anyone know about you:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:20: if they found you out, they would stone you or force you to return to their religion, where you would never come to any good.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:21: In this way We brought them to people’s attention so that they might know that God’s promise [of resurrection] is true and that there is no doubt about the Last Hour, [though] people argue among themselves. [Some] said, ‘Construct a building over them: their Lord knows best about them.’ Those who prevailed said, ‘We shall build a place of worship over them.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:22: [Some] say, ‘The sleepers were three, and their dog made four,’ others say, ‘They were five, and the dog made six’- guessing in the dark- and some say, ‘They were seven, and their dog made eight.’ Say [Prophet], ‘My Lord knows best how many they were.’ Only a few have real knowledge about them, so do not argue, but stick to what is clear, and do not ask any of these people about them;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:23: do not say of anything, ‘I will do that tomorrow,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:24: without adding, ‘God willing,’ and, whenever you forget, remember your Lord and say, ‘May my Lord guide me closer to what is right.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:25: [Some say], ‘The sleepers stayed in their cave for three hundred years,’ some added nine more.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:26: Say [Prophet], ‘God knows best how long they stayed.’ His is the knowledge of all that is hidden in the heavens and earth- How well He sees! How well He hears!- and they have no one to protect them other than Him; He does not allow anyone to share His rule.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:27: [Prophet], follow what has been revealed to you of your Lord’s Scripture: there is no changing His words, nor can you find any refuge except with Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:28: Content yourself with those who pray to their Lord morning and evening, seeking His approval, and do not let your eyes turn away from them out of desire for the attractions of this worldly life: do not yield to those whose hearts We have made heedless of Our Quran, those who follow their own low desires, those whose ways are unbridled.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:29: Say, ‘Now the truth has come from your Lord: let those who wish to believe in it do so, and let those who wish to reject it do so.’ We have prepared a Fire for the wrongdoers that will envelop them from all sides. If they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like molten metal, scalding their faces. What a terrible drink! What a painful resting place!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:30: As for those who believe and do good deeds- We do not let the reward of anyone who does a good deed go to waste-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:31: they will have Gardens of lasting bliss graced with flowing streams. There they will be adorned with bracelets of gold. There they will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade. There they will be comfortably seated on soft chairs. What a blessed reward! What a pleasant resting place!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:32: Tell them the parable of two men: for one of them We made two gardens of grape vines, surrounded them with date palms, and put corn fields in between;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:33: both gardens yielded fruit and did not fail in any way; We made a stream flow through them,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:34: and so he had abundant fruit. One day, while talking to his friend, he said, ‘I have more wealth and a larger following than you.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:35: He went into his garden and wronged himself by saying, ‘I do not think this will ever perish,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:36: or that the Last Hour will ever come- even if I were to be taken back to my Lord, I would certainly find something even better there.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:37: His companion retorted, ‘Have you no faith in Him who created you from dust, from a small drop of fluid, then shaped you into a man?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:38: But, for me, He is God, my Lord, and I will never set up any partner with Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:39: If only, when you entered your garden, you had said, “This is God’s will. There is no power not [given] by God.” Although you see I have less wealth and offspring than you,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:40: my Lord may well give me something better than your garden, and send thunderbolts on your garden from the sky, so that it becomes a heap of barren dust;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:41: or its water may sink so deep into the ground that you will never be able to reach it again.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:42: And so it was: his fruit was completely destroyed, and there he was, wringing his hands over what he had invested in it, as it drooped on its trellises, and saying, ‘I wish I had not set up any partner to my Lord.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:43: He had no forces to help him other than God- he could not even help himself.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:44: In that situation, the only protection is that of God, the True God: He gives the best rewards and the best outcome.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:45: Tell them, too, what the life of this world is like: We send water down from the skies and the earth’s vegetation absorbs it, but soon the plants turn to dry stubble scattered about by the wind: God has power over everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:46: Wealth and children are the attractions of this worldly life, but lasting good works have a better reward with your Lord and give better grounds for hope.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:47: One day We shall make the mountains move, and you will see the earth as an open plain. We shall gather all people together, leaving no one.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:48: They will be lined up before your Lord: ‘Now you have come to Us as We first created you, although you claimed We had not made any such appointment for you.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:49: The record of their deeds will be laid open and you will see the guilty, dismayed at what they contain, saying, ‘Woe to us! What a record this is! It does not leave any deed, small or large, unaccounted for!’ They will find everything they ever did laid in front of them: your Lord will not be unjust to anyone.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:50: We said to the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ and they all bowed down, but not Iblis: he was one of the jinn and he disobeyed his Lord’s command. Are you [people] going to take him and his offspring as your masters instead of Me, even though they are your enemies? What a bad bargain for the evildoers!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:51: I did not make them witnesses to the creation of the heavens and earth, nor to their own creation; I do not take as My supporters those who lead others astray.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:52: On the Day God will say, ‘Call on those you claimed were My partners,’ they will call them but they will not answer; We shall set a deadly gulf between them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:53: The evildoers will see the Fire and they will realize that they are about to fall into it: they will find no escape from it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:54: In this Quran We have presented every kind of description for people but man is more contentious than any other creature.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:55: Now that guidance has come to them, what stops these people believing and asking forgiveness from their Lord before the fate of earlier peoples annihilates them or their torment confronts them?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:56: We only send messengers to bring good news and to deliver warning, yet the disbelievers seek to refute the truth with false arguments and make fun of My messages and warnings.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:57: Who could be more wrong than the person who is reminded of his Lord’s messages and turns his back on them, ignoring what his hands are storing up for him [in the Hereafter]? We have put covers over their hearts, so they cannot understand the Quran, and We put heaviness in their ears: although you call them to guidance [Prophet] they will never accept it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:58: Your Lord is the Most Forgiving, and full of mercy: if He took them to task for the wrongs they have done, He would hasten their punishment on. They have an appointed time from which they will have no escape,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:59: [just like] the former communities We destroyed for doing wrong: We set an appointed time for their destruction.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:60: Moses said to his servant, ‘I will not rest until I reach the place where the two seas meet, even if it takes me years!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:61: but when they reached the place where the two seas meet, they had forgotten all about their fish, which made its way into the sea and swam away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:62: They journeyed on, and then Moses said to his servant, ‘Give us our lunch! This journey of ours is very tiring,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:63: and [the servant] said, ‘Remember when we were resting by the rock? I forgot the fish- Satan made me forget to pay attention to it- and it [must have] made its way into the sea.’ ‘How strange!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:64: Moses said, ‘Then that was the place we were looking for.’ So the two turned back, retraced their footsteps,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:65: and found one of Our servants- a man to whom We had granted Our mercy and whom We had given knowledge of Our own.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:66: Moses said to him, ‘May I follow you so that you can teach me some of the right guidance you have been taught?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:67: The man said, ‘You will not be able to bear with me patiently.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:68: How could you be patient in matters beyond your knowledge?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:69: Moses said, ‘God willing, you will find me patient. I will not disobey you in any way.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:70: The man said, ‘If you follow me then, do not query anything I do before I mention it to you myself.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:71: They travelled on. Later, when they got into a boat, and the man made a hole in it, Moses said, ‘How could you make a hole in it? Do you want to drown its passengers? What a strange thing to do!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:72: He replied, ‘Did I not tell you that you would never be able to bear with me patiently?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:73: Moses said, ‘Forgive me for forgetting. Do not make it too hard for me to follow you.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:74: And so they travelled on. Then, when they met a young boy and the man killed him, Moses said, ‘How could you kill an innocent person? He has not killed anyone! What a terrible thing to do!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:75: He replied, ‘Did I not tell you that you would never be able to bear with me patiently?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:76: Moses said, ‘From now on, if I query anything you do, banish me from your company- you have put up with enough from me.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:77: And so they travelled on. Then, when they came to a town and asked the inhabitants for food but were refused hospitality, they saw a wall there that was on the point of falling down and the man repaired it. Moses said, ‘But if you had wished you could have taken payment for doing that.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:78: He said, ‘This is where you and I part company. I will tell you the meaning of the things you could not bear with patiently:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:79: the boat belonged to some needy people who made their living from the sea and I damaged it because I knew that coming after them was a king who was seizing every [serviceable] boat by force.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:80: The young boy had parents who were people of faith, and so, fearing he would trouble them through wickedness and disbelief,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:81: we wished that their Lord should give them another child- purer and more compassionate- in his place.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:82: The wall belonged to two young orphans in the town and there was buried treasure beneath it belonging to them. Their father had been a righteous man, so your Lord intended them to reach maturity and then dig up their treasure as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do [these things] of my own accord: these are the explanations for those things you could not bear with patience.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:83: [Prophet], they ask you about Dhu ’l-Qarnayn. Say, ‘I will tell you something about him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:84: We established his power in the land, and gave him the means to achieve everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:85: He travelled on a certain road;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:86: then, when he came to the setting of the sun, he found it [seemed to be] setting into a muddy spring. Nearby he found some people and We said, ‘Dhu ’l-Qarnayn, you may choose [which of them] to punish or show kindness to.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:87: He answered, ‘We shall punish those who have done evil, and when they are returned to their Lord He will punish them [even more] severely,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:88: while those who believed and did good deeds will have the best of rewards: we shall command them to do what is easy for them.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:90: then, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no shelter from it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:91: And so it was: We knew all about him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:93: then, when he reached a place between two mountain barriers, he found beside them a people who could barely understand him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:94: They said, ‘Dhu ’l-Qarnayn, Gog and Magog are ruining this land. Will you build a barrier between them and us if we pay you a tribute?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:95: He answered, ‘The power my Lord has given me is better than any tribute, but if you lend me your strength, I will put up a fortification between you and them:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:96: bring me lumps of iron!’ and then, when he had filled the gap between the two mountainsides [he said], ‘Work your bellows!’ and then, when he had made it glow like fire, he said, ‘Bring me molten metal to pour over it!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:97: Their enemies could not scale the barrier, nor could they pierce it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:98: and he said, ‘This is a mercy from my Lord. But when my Lord’s promise is fulfilled, He will raze this barrier to the ground: my Lord’s promise always comes true.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:99: On that Day, We shall let them surge against each other like waves and then the Trumpet will be blown and We shall gather them all together.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:100: We shall show Hell to the disbelievers,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:101: those whose eyes were blind to My signs, those who were unable to hear.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:102: Did they think that they could take My servants as masters instead of Me? We have prepared Hell as the disbelievers’ resting place.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:103: Say [Prophet], ‘Shall we tell you who has the most to lose by their actions,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:104: whose efforts in this world are misguided, even when they think they are doing good work?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:105: It is those who disbelieve in their Lord’s messages and deny that they will meet Him.’ Their deeds come to nothing: on the Day of Resurrection We shall give them no weight.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:106: Their recompense for having disbelieved and made fun of My messages and My messengers will be Hell.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:107: But those who believe and do good deeds will be given the Gardens of Paradise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:108: There they will remain, never wishing to leave.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:109: Say [Prophet], ‘If the whole ocean were ink for writing the words of my Lord, it would run dry before those words were exhausted’- even if We were to add another ocean to it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.18:110: Say, ‘I am only a human being, like you, to whom it has been revealed that your God is One. Anyone who fears to meet his Lord should do good deeds and give no one a share in the worship due to his Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:2: This is an account of your Lord’s grace towards His servant, Zachariah,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:3: when he called to his Lord secretly, saying,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:4: ‘Lord, my bones have weakened and my hair is ashen grey, but never, Lord, have I ever prayed to You in vain:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:5: I fear [what] my kinsmen [will do] when I am gone, for my wife is barren, so grant me a successor––a gift from You––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:6: to be my heir and the heir of the family of Jacob. Lord, make him well pleasing [to You].’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:7: ‘Zachariah, We bring you good news of a son whose name will be John––We have chosen this name for no one before him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:8: He said, ‘Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I am old and frail?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:9: He said, ‘This is what your Lord has said: “It is easy for Me: I created you, though you were nothing before.” ’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:10: He said, ‘Give me a sign, Lord.’ He said, ‘Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to anyone for three full [days and] nights.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:11: He went out of the sanctuary to his people and signalled to them to praise God morning and evening.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:12: [We said], ‘John, hold on to the Scripture firmly.’ While he was still a boy, We granted him wisdom,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:13: tenderness from Us, and purity. He was devout,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:14: kind to his parents, not domineering or rebellious.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:15: Peace was on him the day he was born, the day he died, and it will be on him the day he is raised to life again.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:16: Mention in the Quran the story of Mary. She withdrew from her family to a place to the east
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:17: and secluded herself away; We sent Our Spirit to appear before her in the form of a perfected man.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:18: She said, ‘I seek the Lord of Mercy’s protection against you: if you have any fear of Him [do not approach]!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:19: but he said, ‘I am but a Mes-senger from your Lord, [come] to announce to you the gift of a pure son.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:20: She said, ‘How can I have a son when no man has touched me? I have not been unchaste,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:21: and he said, ‘This is what your Lord said: “It is easy for Me- We shall make him a sign to all people, a blessing from Us.”’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:22: And so it was ordained: she conceived him. She withdrew to a distant place
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:23: and, when the pains of childbirth drove her to [cling to] the trunk of a palm tree, she exclaimed, ‘I wish I had been dead and forgotten long before all this!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:24: but a voice cried to her from below, ‘Do not worry: your Lord has provided a stream at your feet
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:25: and, if you shake the trunk of the palm tree towards you, it will deliver fresh ripe dates for you,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:26: so eat, drink, be glad, and say to anyone you may see: “I have vowed to the Lord of Mercy to abstain from conversation, and I will not talk to anyone today.”’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:27: She went back to her people carrying the child, and they said, ‘Mary! You have done something terrible!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:28: Sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man; your mother was not unchaste!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:29: She pointed at him. They said, ‘How can we converse with an infant?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:30: [But] he said: ‘I am a servant of God. He has granted me the Scripture; made me a prophet;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:31: made me blessed wherever I may be. He commanded me to pray, to give alms as long as I live,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:32: to cherish my mother. He did not make me domineering or graceless.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:33: Peace was on me the day I was born, and will be on me the day I die and the day I am raised to life again.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:34: Such was Jesus, son of Mary. [This is] a statement of the Truth about which they are in doubt:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:35: it would not befit God to have a child. He is far above that: when He decrees something, He says only, ‘Be,’ and it is.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:36: ‘God is my Lord and your Lord, so serve Him: that is a straight path.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:37: But factions have differed among themselves. What suffering will come to those who obscure the truth when a dreadful Day arrives!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:38: How sharp of hearing, how sharp of sight they will be when they come to Us, although now they are clearly off course! Warn them [Muhammad] of the Day of Remorse when the matter will be decided,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:39: for they are heedless and do not believe.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:40: It is We who will inherit the earth and all who are on it: they will all be returned to Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:41: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Abraham. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:42: He said to his father, ‘Father, why do you worship something that can neither hear nor see nor benefit you in any way?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:43: Father, knowledge that has not reached you has come to me, so follow me: I will guide you to an even path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:44: Father, do not worship Satan- Satan has rebelled against the Lord of Mercy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:45: Father, I fear that a punishment from the Lord of Mercy may afflict you and that you may become Satan’s companion [in Hell].’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:46: His father answered, ‘Abraham, do you reject my gods? I will stone you if you do not stop this. Keep out of my way!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:47: Abraham said, ‘Peace be with you: I will beg my Lord to forgive you- He is always gracious to me-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:48: but for now I will leave you, and the idols you all pray to, and I will pray to my Lord and trust that my prayer will not be in vain.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:49: When he left his people and those they served beside God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made them both prophets:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:50: We granted Our grace to all of them, and gave them a noble reputation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:51: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Moses. He was specially chosen, a messenger and a prophet:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:52: We called to him from the right-hand side of the mountain and brought him close to Us in secret communion;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:53: out of Our grace We granted him his brother Aaron as a prophet.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:54: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Ishmael. He was true to his promise, a messenger and a prophet.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:55: He commanded his household to pray and give alms, and his Lord was well pleased with him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:56: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Idris. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:57: We raised him to a high position.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:58: These were the prophets God blessed- from the seed of Adam, of those We carried in the Ark with Noah, from the seed of Abraham and Israel- and those We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Lord of Mercy were recited to them, they fell to their knees and wept,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:59: but there came after them generations who neglected prayer and were driven by their own desires. These will come face to face with their evil,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:60: but those who repent, who believe, who do righteous deeds, will enter Paradise. They will not be wronged in the least:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:61: they will enter the Gardens of Lasting Bliss, promised by the Lord of Mercy to His servants- it is not yet seen but truly His promise will be fulfilled.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:62: There they will hear only peaceful talk, nothing bad; there they will be given provision morning and evening.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:63: That is the Garden We shall give as their own to those of Our servants who were devout.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:64: [Gabriel said],‘We only descend [with revelation] at your Lord’s command––everything before us, everything behind us, everything in between, all belongs to Him––your Lord is never forgetful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:65: He is Lord of the heavens and earth and everything in between so worship Him: be steadfast in worshipping Him. Do you know of anyone equal to Him?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:66: Man says, ‘What? Once I am dead, will I be brought back to life?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:67: but does man not remember that We created him when he was nothing before?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:68: By your Lord [Prophet] We shall gather them and the devils together and set them on their knees around Hell;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:69: We shall seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:70: We know best who most deserves to burn in Hell-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:71: but every single one of you will approach it, a decree from your Lord which must be fulfilled.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:72: We shall save the devout and leave the evildoers there on their knees.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:73: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, [all that] the disbelievers say to the believers [is], ‘Which side is better situated? Which side has the better following?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:74: We have destroyed many a generation before them who surpassed them in riches and outward glitter!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:75: Say [Prophet], ‘The Lord of Mercy lengthens [the lives] of the misguided, until, when they are confronted with what they have been warned about- either the punishment [in this life] or the Hour [of Judgement]- they realize who is worse situated and who has the weakest forces.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:76: But God gives more guidance to those who are guided, and good deeds of lasting merit are best and most rewarding in your Lord’s sight.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:77: Have you considered the man who rejects Our revelation, who says, ‘I will certainly be given wealth and children’?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:78: Has he penetrated the unknown or received a pledge to that effect from the Lord of Mercy?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:79: No! We shall certainly record what he says and prolong his punishment:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:80: We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of and he will come to Us all alone.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:81: They have taken other gods beside God to give them strength,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:82: but these gods will reject their worship and will even turn against them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:83: Have you [Prophet] not seen how We send devils to incite the disbelievers to sin?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:84: There is no need for you to be impatient concerning them: We are counting down their [allotted] time.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:85: On the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:86: and drive the sinful like a thirsty herd into Hell,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:87: no one will have power to intercede except for those who have permission from the Lord of Mercy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:88: The disbelievers say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has offspring.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:89: How terrible is this thing you assert:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:90: it almost causes the heavens to be torn apart, the earth to split asunder, the mountains to crumble to pieces,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:91: that they attribute offspring to the Lord of Mercy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:92: It does not befit the Lord of Mercy [to have offspring]:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:93: there is no one in the heavens or earth who will not come to the Lord of Mercy as a servant-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:94: He has counted them all: He has numbered them exactly-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:95: and they will each return to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:96: But the Lord of Mercy will give love to those who believe and do righteous deeds:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:97: We have made it easy, in your own language [Prophet], so that you may bring glad news to the righteous and warnings to a stubborn people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.19:98: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:2: It was not to distress you [Prophet] that We sent down the Quran to you,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:3: but as a reminder for those who hold God in awe,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:4: a revelation from the One who created the earth and the high heaven,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:5: the Lord of Mercy, established on the throne.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:6: Everything in the heavens and on earth, everything between them, everything beneath the soil, belongs to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:7: Whatever you may say aloud, He knows what you keep secret and what is even more hidden.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:8: God––there is no god but Him––the most excellent names belong to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:9: Has the story of Moses come to you [Prophet]?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:10: He saw a fire and said to his people, ‘Stay here––I can see a fire. Maybe I can bring you a flaming brand from it or find some guidance there.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:11: When he came to the fire, he was summoned, ‘Moses!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:12: I am your Lord. Take off your shoes: you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:13: I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:14: I am God; there is no god but Me. So worship Me and keep up the prayer so that you remember Me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:15: The Hour is coming––though I choose to keep it hidden––for each soul to be rewarded for its labour.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:16: Do not let anyone who does not believe in it and follows his own desires distract you from it, and so bring you to ruin.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:17: ‘Moses, what is that in your right hand?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:18: ‘It is my staff,’ he said, ‘I lean on it; restrain my sheep with it; I also have other uses for it.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:20: He threw it down and- lo and behold!- it became a fast-moving snake.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:21: He said, ‘Pick it up without fear: We shall turn it back into its former state.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:22: Now place your hand under your armpit and it will come out white, though unharmed: that is another sign.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:23: We do this to show you some of Our greatest signs.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:24: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly become a tyrant.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:25: Moses said, ‘Lord, lift up my heart
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:26: and ease my task for me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:28: so that they may understand my words,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:29: and give me a helper from my family,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:33: so that we can glorify You much
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:35: You are always watching over us.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:36: God said, ‘Moses, your request is granted.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:37: Indeed We showed you favour before.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:39: “Put your child into the chest, then place him in the river. Let the river wash him on to its bank, and he will be taken in by an enemy of Mine and his.” I showered you with My love and planned that you should be reared under My watchful eye.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:40: Your sister went out, saying, “I will tell you someone who will nurse him,” then We returned you to your mother so that she could rejoice and not grieve. Later you killed a man, but We saved you from distress and tried you with other tests. You stayed among the people of Midian for years, then you came here as I ordained.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:41: I have chosen you for Myself.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:42: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and make sure that you remember Me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:43: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:44: Speak to him gently so that he may take heed, or show respect.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:45: They said, ‘Lord, we fear he will do us great harm or exceed all bounds.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:46: He said, ‘Do not be afraid, I am with you both, hearing and seeing everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:47: Go and tell him, “We are your Lord’s mes-sengers, so send the Children of Israel with us and do not oppress them. We have brought you a sign from your Lord. Peace be upon whoever follows the right guidance;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:48: it has been revealed to us that punishment falls on whoever rejects the truth and turns his back on it.”’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:49: [Pharaoh] said, ‘Moses, who is this Lord of yours?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:50: Moses said, ‘Our Lord is He who gave everything its form, then gave it guidance.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:52: Moses said, ‘My Lord alone has knowledge of them, all in a record; my Lord does not err or forget.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:53: It was He who spread out the earth for you and traced routes in it. He sent down water from the sky. With that water We bring forth every kind of plant,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:54: so eat, and graze your cattle. There are truly signs in all this for people of understand-ing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:55: From the earth We created you, into it We shall return you, and from it We shall raise you a second time.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:56: We showed Pharaoh all Our signs, but he denied them and refused [to change].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:57: He said, ‘Have you come to drive us from our land with your sorcery, Moses?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:58: We will confront you with sorcery to match your own: make an appointment between us which neither of us will fail to keep, in a mutually agreeable place.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:59: He said, ‘Your meeting will be on the day of the feast, so let the people be assembled when the sun has risen high.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:60: Pharaoh withdrew and gathered his resources, then he returned.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:61: Moses said to them, ‘Beware, do not invent lies against God or He will destroy you with His punishment. Whoever invents lies will fail.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:62: So they discussed their plan among themselves, talking secretly,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:63: saying, ‘These two men are sorcerers. Their purpose is to drive you out of your land with their sorcery and put an end to your time-honoured way of life.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:64: So gather your resources and line up for the contest. Whoever wins today is sure to prosper.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:65: They said, ‘Moses, will you throw first or shall we?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:66: ‘You throw,’ said Moses, and––lo and behold!––through their sorcery, their ropes and staffs seemed to him to be moving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:68: but We said, ‘Do not be afraid, you have the upper hand.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:69: Throw down what is in your right hand: it will swallow up what they have produced. They have only produced the tricks of a sorcerer, and a sorcerer will not prosper, wherever he goes.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:70: [So it was, and] the sorcerers threw themselves down in submission. ‘We believe,’ they said, ‘in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:71: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? This must be your master, the man who taught you witchcraft. I shall certainly cut off your alternate hands and feet, then crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will know for certain which of us has the fiercer and more lasting punishment.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:72: They said, ‘We shall never prefer you to the clear sign that has come to us, nor to Him who created us. So decide whatever you will: you can only decide matters of this present life-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:73: we believe in our Lord, [hoping] He may forgive us our sins and the sorcery that you forced us to practise- God is better and more lasting.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:74: Hell will be the reward of those who return to their Lord as evildoers: there they will stay, neither living nor dying.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:75: But those who return to their Lord as believers with righteous deeds will be rewarded with the highest of ranks,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:76: Gardens of lasting bliss graced with flowing streams, and there they will stay. Such is the reward of those who purify themselves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:77: We revealed to Moses, ‘Go out at night with My servants and strike a dry path for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken and do not be dismayed.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:78: Pharaoh pursued them with his armies and was overwhelmed by the sea.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:79: Pharaoh truly led his people astray; he did not guide them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:80: Children of Israel, We rescued you from your enemies. We made a pledge with you on the right-hand side of the mountain. We sent down manna and quails for you,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:81: ‘Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not overstep the bounds, or My wrath will descend on you. Anyone on whom My wrath descends has truly fallen.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:82: Yet I am most forgiving towards those who repent, believe, do righteous deeds, and stay on the right path.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:83: [God said], ‘Moses, what has made you come ahead of your people in such haste?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:84: and he said, ‘They are following in my footsteps. I rushed to You, Lord, to please You,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:85: but God said, ‘We have tested your people in your absence: the Samiri has led them astray.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:86: Moses returned to his people, angry and aggrieved. He said, ‘My people, did your Lord not make you a gracious promise? Was my absence too long for you? Did you want anger to fall on you from your Lord and so broke your word to me?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:87: They said, ‘We did not break our word to you deliberately. We were burdened with the weight of people’s jewellery, so we threw it [into the fire], and the Samiri did the same,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:88: but he [used the molten jewellery to] produce an image of a calf which made a lowing sound, and they said, ‘This is your god and Moses’ god, but he has forgotten.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:89: Did they not see that [the calf] gave them no answer, that it had no power to harm or benefit them?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:90: Aaron did say to them, ‘My people, this calf is a test for you. Your true Lord is the Lord of Mercy, so follow me and obey my orders,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:91: but they replied, ‘We shall not give up our devotion to it until Moses returns to us.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:92: Moses said, ‘When you realized they had gone astray, what prevented you, Aaron,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:93: from coming after me? How could you disobey my orders?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:94: He said, ‘Son of my mother- let go of my beard and my hair!- I was afraid you would say, “You have caused division among the children of Israel and have not heeded what I said.”’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:95: Moses said, ‘And what was the matter with you, Samiri?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:96: He replied, ‘I saw something they did not; I took in some of the teachings of the Messenger but tossed them aside: my soul prompted me to do what I did.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:97: Moses said, ‘Get away from here! Your lot in this life is to say, “Do not touch me,” but you have an appointment from which there is no escape. Look at your god which you have kept on worshipping- we shall grind it down and scatter it into the sea.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:98: [People], your true god is the One God- there is no god but Him- whose knowledge embraces everything.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:99: In this way We relate to you [Prophet] stories of what happened before. We have given you a Quran from Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:100: Whoever turns away from it will bear on the Day of Resurrection a heavy burden
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:101: and will remain under it. What a terrible burden to carry on that Day!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:102: When the trumpet is sounded and We gather the sinful, sightless,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:103: they will murmur to one another, ‘You stayed only ten days [on earth]’-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:104: We know best what they say- but the more perceptive of them will say, ‘Your stay [on earth] was only a single day.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:105: They ask you [Prophet] about the mountains: say, ‘[On that Day] my Lord will blast them into dust
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:107: with no peak or trough to be seen.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:108: On that Day, people will follow the summoner from whom there is no escape; every voice will be hushed for the Lord of Mercy; only whispers will be heard.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:109: On that Day, intercession will be useless except from those to whom the Lord of Mercy has granted permission and whose words He approves-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:110: He knows what is before and behind them, though they do not comprehend Him-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:111: and [all] faces will be humbled before the Living, Ever Watchful One. Those burdened with evil deeds will despair,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:112: but whoever has done righteous deeds and believed need have no fear of injustice or deprivation.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:113: We have sent the Quran down in the Arabic tongue and given all kinds of warnings in it, so that they may beware or take heed-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:114: exalted be God, the one who is truly in control. [Prophet], do not rush to recite before the revelation is fully complete but say, ‘Lord, increase me in knowledge!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:115: We also commanded Adam before you, but he forgot and We found him lacking in constancy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:116: When We said to the angels, ‘Bow down before Adam,’ they did. But Iblis refused,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:117: so We said, ‘Adam, this is your enemy, yours and your wife’s: do not let him drive you out of the garden and make you miserable.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:118: In the garden you will never go hungry, feel naked,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:119: be thirsty, or suffer the heat of the sun.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:120: But Satan whispered to Adam, saying, ‘Adam, shall I show you the tree of immortality and power that never decays?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:121: and they both ate from it. They became conscious of their nakedness and began to cover themselves with leaves from the garden. Adam disobeyed his Lord and was led astray-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:122: later his Lord brought him close, accepted his repentance, and guided him-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:123: God said, ‘Get out of the garden as each other’s enemy.’ Whoever follows My guidance, when it comes to you [people], will not go astray nor fall into misery,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:124: but whoever turns away from it will have a life of great hardship. We shall bring him blind to the Assembly on the Day of Resurrection
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:125: and he will say, ‘Lord, why did You bring me here blind? I was sighted before!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:126: God will say, ‘This is how it is: You ignored Our revelations when they came to you, so today you will be ignored.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:127: This is how We reward those who go too far, and who do not believe in their Lord’s revelations. The greatest and most enduring punishment is in the Hereafter.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:128: Do they not draw a lesson from the many generations We destroyed before them, through whose dwelling places they now walk? There truly are signs in this for anyone with understanding!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:129: If it were not for a preordained Word from your Lord [Prophet], they would already have been destroyed. Their time has been set,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:130: so [Prophet] be patient with what they say- celebrate the praise of your Lord, before the rising and setting of the sun, celebrate His praise during the night, and at the beginning and end of the day, so that you may find contentment-
