M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:131: and do not gaze longingly at what We have given some of them to enjoy, the finery of this present life: We test them through this, but the provision of your Lord is better and more lasting.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:132: Order your people to pray, and pray steadfastly yourself. We are not asking you to give Us provision;We provide for you, and the rewards of the Hereafter belong to the devout.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:133: The disbelievers say, ‘Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?’ Have they not been given clear proof confirming what was in the earlier scriptures?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:134: If We had destroyed them through punishment before this Messenger came, they would have said, ‘Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we could have followed Your revelations before we suffered humiliation and disgrace!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.20:135: [Prophet], say, ‘We are all waiting, so you carry on waiting: you will come to learn who has followed the even path, and been rightly guided.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:1: Ever closer to people draws their reckoning, while they turn away, heedless.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:2: Whenever any fresh revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it playfully
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:3: with frivolous hearts. The evildoers conferred in secret: ‘Is this man anything but a mortal like yourselves? Are you going to fall under his spell with your eyes wide open?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:4: He said, ‘My Lord knows everything that is said in the heavens and the earth: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:5: Some say, ‘Muddled dreams’; others, ‘He made it up’; yet others, ‘He is just a poet, let him show us a sign as previous messengers did.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:6: But of the communities We destroyed before them not a single one believed. Will these now believe?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:7: And even before your time [Prophet], all the messengers We sent were only men We inspired–– if you [disbelievers] do not know, ask people who know the Scripture––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:8: We did not give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:9: We fulfilled Our promise to them in the end: We saved them and those We wished to save, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:10: And now We have sent down to you [people] a Scripture to remind you. Will you not use your reason?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:11: How many communities of evildoers We have destroyed! How many others We have raised up in their places!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:12: When they felt Our might coming upon them, see how they tried to escape it!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:13: ‘Do not try to escape. Go back to your homes and the pleasure you revelled in: you may be questioned.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:14: They said, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:15: and that cry of theirs did not cease until We made them burnt-offstubble.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:16: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them playfully.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:17: If We had wished for a pastime, We could have found it within Us- if We had wished for any such thing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:18: No! We hurl the truth against falsehood, and truth obliterates it- see how falsehood vanishes away! Woe to you [people] for the way you describe God!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:19: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and those that are with Him are never too proud to worship Him, nor do they grow weary;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:20: they glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:21: Have they chosen any gods from the earth who can give life to the dead?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:22: If there had been in the heavens or earth any gods but Him, both heavens and earth would be in ruins: God, Lord of the Throne, is far above the things they say:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:23: He cannot be called to account for anything He does, whereas they will be called to account.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:24: Have they chosen to worship other gods instead of Him? Say, ‘Bring your proof. This is the Scripture for those who are with me and the Scripture for those who went before me.’ But most of them do not recognize the truth, so they pay no heed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:25: We never sent any messenger before you [Muhammad] without revealing to him: ‘There is no god but Me, so serve Me.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:26: And they say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has taken offspring for Himself.’ May He be exalted! No! They are only His honoured servants:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:27: they do not speak before He speaks and they act by His command.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:28: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede without His permission––indeed they themselves stand in awe of Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:29: If any of them were to claim, ‘I am a god beside Him,’ We would reward them with Hell: this is how We reward evildoers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:30: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and the earth used to be joined together and that We ripped them apart, that We made every living thing from water? Will they not believe?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:31: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it should sway under them, and set broad paths on it, so that they might follow the right direction,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:32: and We made the sky a well-secured canopy- yet from its wonders they turn away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:33: It is He who created night and day, the sun and the moon, each floating in its orbit.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:34: We have not granted everlasting life to any other human being before you either [Muhammad]- if you die, will [the disbelievers] live for ever?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:35: Every soul is certain to taste death: We test you all through the bad and the good, and to Us you will all return.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:36: When the disbelievers see you, they laugh at you: ‘Is this the one who talks about your gods?’ They reject any talk of the Lord of Mercy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:37: Man was created hasty: I will show you My signs soon, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:38: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:39: If the disbelievers only knew, the time will arrive when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces or their backs, and they will get no help.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:40: It will come upon them suddenly and stupefy them; they will be powerless to push it away; they will not be reprieved.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:41: Messengers before you [Muhammad] were also ridiculed, but those who mocked them were overwhelmed in the end by the very thing they had mocked.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:42: Say, ‘Who could protect you night and day from the Lord of Mercy?’ Yet they turn away when their Lord is mentioned.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:43: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? Their gods have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:44: We have allowed these sinners and their forefathers to enjoy life for a long time. But do they not see how We are shrinking their borders? Is it they who will prevail?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:45: Say, ‘I warn you only through the Revelation.’ The deaf will not hear the warning call,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:46: yet if a mere breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they will be sure to cry, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:47: We will set up scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that no one can be wronged in the least, and if there should be even the weight of a mustard seed, We shall bring it out- We take excellent account.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:48: We gave Moses and Aaron [the Scripture] that distinguishes right from wrong, a light and a reminder for those who are mindful of God,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:49: those who stand in awe of their Lord, though He is unseen, and who fear the Hour.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:50: This [Quran] too is a blessed message We have sent down- are you [people] going to deny it?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:51: Long ago We bestowed right judgement on Abraham and We knew him well.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:52: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images to which you are so devoted?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:53: They replied, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:54: He said, ‘You and your fathers have clearly gone astray.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:55: They asked, ‘Have you brought us the truth or are you just playing about?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:56: He said, ‘Listen! Your true Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He who created them, and I am a witness to this.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:57: By God I shall certainly plot against your idols as soon as you have turned your backs!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:58: He broke them all into pieces, but left the biggest one for them to return to.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:59: They said, ‘Who has done this to our gods? How wicked he must be!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:60: Some said, ‘We heard a youth called Abraham talking about them.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:61: They said, ‘Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial].’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:62: They asked, ‘Was it you, Abraham, who did this to our gods?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:63: He said, ‘No, it was done by the biggest of them- this one. Ask them, if they can talk.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:64: They turned to one another, saying, ‘It is you who are in the wrong,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:65: but then they lapsed again and said, ‘You know very well these gods cannot speak.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:66: Abraham said, ‘How can you worship what can neither benefit nor harm you, instead of God?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:67: Shame on you and on the things you worship instead of God. Have you no sense?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:68: They said, ‘Burn him and avenge your gods, if you are going to do the right thing.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:69: But We said, ‘Fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:70: They planned to harm him, but We made them suffer the greatest loss.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:71: We saved him and Lot [and sent them] to the land We blessed for all people,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:72: and We gave him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and made each of them righteous.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:73: We made all of them leaders, guiding others by Our command, and We inspired them to do good works, to keep up the prayer, and to give alms: they were Our true worshippers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:74: We gave Lot sound judgement and knowledge and saved him from the community who practised obscenities- they were shameless people who broke God’s law!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:75: We admitted him to Our mercy; he was a righteous man.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:76: Long before that, We answered Noah when he cried out to Us: We saved him and his family from the great calamity
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:77: and We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs- they were evil people, so We drowned them all.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:78: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgement regarding the field into which sheep strayed by night and grazed. We witnessed their judgement
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:79: and made Solomon understand the case [better], though We gave sound judgement and knowledge to both of them. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate Our praises with David- We did all these things-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:80: We taught him how to make coats of mail for the benefit of you [people], to protect you in your wars, but are you grateful for this?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:81: We harnessed the stormy wind for Solomon, so that it sped by his command to the land We had blessed- We have knowledge of all things-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:82: and We made some of the jinn subservient to him, to dive for him and do other works besides. We were watching over them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:83: Remember Job, when he cried to his Lord, ‘Suffering has truly afflicted me, but you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:84: We answered him, removed his suffering, and restored his family to him, along with more like them, as an act of grace from Us and a reminder for all who serve Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:85: And remember Ishmael, Idris, and Dhu’l-Kifl: they were all steadfast.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:86: We admitted them to Our mercy; they were truly righteous.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:87: And remember the man with the whale,when he went off angrily, thinking We could not restrict him, but then he cried out in the deep darkness, ‘There is no God but You, glory be to You, I was wrong.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:88: We answered him and saved him from distress: this is how We save the faithful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:89: Remember Zachariah, when he cried to his Lord, ‘My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of heirs.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:90: We answered him––We gave him John, and cured his wife of barrenness- they were always keen to do good deeds. They called upon Us out of longing and awe, and humbled themselves before Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:91: Remember the one who guarded her chastity. We breathed into her from Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign for all people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:92: [Messengers], this community of yours is one single community and I am your Lord, so serve Me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:93: They have torn their unity apart, but they will all return to Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:94: If anyone does good deeds and is a believer, his efforts will not be ignored: We record them for him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:95: No community destroyed by Us can escape its return,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:96: and when the peoples of Gog and Magog are let loose and swarm swiftly from every highland,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:97: when the True Promise draws near, the disbelievers’ eyes will stare in terror, and they will say, ‘Woe to us! We were not aware of this at all. We were wrong.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:98: You [disbelievers] and what you worship instead of God will be fuel for Hell: that is where you will go-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:99: if these [idols] had been real gods they would not have gone there- you will all stay there.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:100: There the disbelievers will be groaning piteously, but the [idols] will hear nothing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:101: But those for whom We have decreed Paradise will be kept far from Hell-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:102: they will not hear a murmur from it- and endlessly they will enjoy everything their souls desire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:103: They will have no fear of the great Terror: the angels will receive them with the words, ‘This is the Day you were promised!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:104: On that Day, We shall roll up the skies as a writer rolls up [his] scrolls. We shall reproduce creation just as We produced it the first time: this is Our binding promise. We shall certainly do all these things.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:105: We wrote in the Psalms, as We did in [earlier] Scripture: ‘My righteous servants will inherit the earth.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:106: There truly is a message in this for the servants of God!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:107: It was only as a mercy that We sent you [Prophet] to all people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:108: Say, ‘What is revealed to me is that your God is one God- will you submit to Him?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:109: But if they turn away, say, ‘I have proclaimed the message fairly to you all. I do not know whether the judgement you are promised is near or far,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:110: but He knows what you reveal and conceal.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:111: I do not know: this [time] may well be a test for you, and enjoyment for a while.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.21:112: He said,‘My Lord, pass the true judgement.’ And, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of Mercy. We seek His assistance against what you [disbelievers] say.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:1: People, be mindful of your Lord, for the earthquake of the Last Hour will be a mighty thing:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:2: on the Day you see it, every nursing mother will think no more of her baby, every pregnant female will miscarry, you will think people are drunk when they are not, so severe will be God’s torment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:3: Yet still there are some who, with no knowledge, argue about God, who follow every devilish rebel
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:4: fated to lead astray those who take his side, and guide them to the suffering of the blazing flame.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:5: People, [remember,] if you doubt the Resurrection, that We created you from dust, then a drop of fluid, then a clinging form, then a lump of flesh, both shaped and unshaped: We mean to make Our power clear to you. Whatever We choose We cause to remain in the womb for an appointed time, then We bring you forth as infants and then you grow and reach maturity. Some die young and some are left to live on to such an age that they forget all they once knew. You sometimes see the earth lifeless, yet when We send down water it stirs and swells and produces every kind of joyous growth:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:6: this is because God is the Truth; He brings the dead back to life; He has power over everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:7: There is no doubt that the Last Hour is bound to come, nor that God will raise the dead from their graves,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:8: yet still there are some who, with no knowledge or guidance or any book of enlightenment, argue about God,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:9: turning scornfully aside to lead others away from God’s path. Disgrace in this world awaits such a person and, on the Day of Resurrection, We shall make him taste the suffering of the Fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:10: [It will be said], ‘This is for what you have stored up with your own hands: God is never unjust to His creatures.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:11: There are also some who serve God with unsteady faith: if something good comes their way, they are satisfied, but if they are tested, they revert to their old ways, losing both this world and the next- that is the clearest loss.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:12: Instead of God, they call upon what can neither harm nor help them- that is straying far away-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:13: or invoke one whose harm is closer than his help: an evil master and an evil companion.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:14: But God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams. God does whatever He wishes.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:15: Anyone who thinks that God will not support him in this world and the next should stretch a rope up to the sky, climb all the way up it, and see whether this strategy removes the cause of his anger.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:16: In this way, We send the Quran down as clear messages, and God guides whoever He will.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:17: As for the believers, those who follow the Jewish faith, the Sabians, the Christians, the Magians, and the idolaters, God will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection; God witnesses all things.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:18: Do you not realize [Prophet] that everything in the heavens and earth submits to God: the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, and the animals? So do many human beings, though for many others punishment is well deserved. Anyone disgraced by God will have no one to honour him: God does whatever He will.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:19: These two kinds of people disagree about their Lord. Garments of fire will be tailored for those who disbelieve; scalding water will be poured over their heads,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:20: melting their insides as well as their skins;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:21: there will be iron crooks to restrain them;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:22: whenever, in their anguish, they try to escape, they will be pushed back in and told, ‘Taste the suffering of the Fire.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:23: But God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams; there they will be adorned with golden bracelets and pearls; there they will have silken garments.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:24: They were guided to good speech and to the path of the One Worthy of all Praise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:25: As for the disbelievers, who bar others from God’s path and from the Sacred Mosque- which We made for all people, residents and visitors alike- and who try to violate it with wrongdoing, We shall make them taste a painful punishment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:26: We showed Abraham the site of the House, saying, ‘Do not assign partners to Me. Purify My House for those who circle around it, those who stand to pray, and those who bow and prostrate themselves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:27: Proclaim the Pilgrimage to all people. They will come to you on foot and on every kind of swift mount, emerging from every deep mountain pass
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:28: to attain benefits and celebrate God’s name, on specified days, over the livestock He has provided for them- feed yourselves and the poor and unfortunate-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:29: so let the pilgrims perform their acts of cleansing, fulfil their vows, and circle around the Ancient House.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:30: All this [is ordained by God]: anyone who honours the sacred ordinances of God will have good rewards from his Lord. Livestock have been made lawful to you, except for what has been explicitly forbidden. Shun the filth of idolatrous beliefs and practices and shun false utterances.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:31: Devote yourselves to God and assign Him no partners, for the person who does so is like someone who has been hurled down from the skies and snatched up by the birds or flung to a distant place by the wind.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:32: All this [is ordained by God]: those who honour God’s rites show the piety of their hearts.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:33: Live-stock are useful to you until the set time. Then their place of sacrifice is near the Ancient House:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:34: We appointed acts of devotion for every community, for them to celebrate God’s name over the livestock He provided for them: your God is One, so devote yourselves to Him. [Prophet], give good news to the humble
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:35: whose hearts fill with awe whenever God is mentioned, who endure whatever happens to them with patience, who keep up the prayer, who give to others out of Our provision to them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:36: We have made camels part of God’s sacred rites for you. There is much good in them for you, so invoke God’s name over them as they are lined up for sacrifice, then, when they have fallen down dead, feed yourselves and those who do not ask, as well as those who do. We have subjected them to you in this way so that you may be thankful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:37: It is neither their meat nor their blood that reaches God but your piety. He has subjected them to you in this way so that you may glorify God for having guided you. Give good news to those who do good:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:38: God will defend the believers; God does not love the unfaithful or the ungrateful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:39: Those who have been attacked are permitted to take up arms because they have been wronged- God has the power to help them-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:40: those who have been driven unjustly from their homes only for saying, ‘Our Lord is God.’ If God did not repel some people by means of others, many monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques, where God’s name is much invoked, would have been destroyed. God is sure to help those who help His cause- God is strong and mighty-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:41: those who, when We establish them in the land, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, command what is right, and forbid what is wrong: God controls the outcome of all events.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:42: If they reject you [Prophet], so did the people of Noah before them, and those of Ad, Thamud,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:44: Midian. Moses too was called a liar. I gave the disbelievers time, but in the end I punished them. How I condemned them!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:45: How many towns steeped in wrongdoing We have destroyed and left in total ruin; how many deserted wells; how many lofty palaces!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:46: Have these people [of Mecca] not travelled through the land with hearts to understand and ears to hear? It is not people’s eyes that are blind, but their hearts within their breasts.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:47: They will challenge you [Prophet] to hasten the punishment. God will not fail in His promise- a Day with your Lord is like a thousand years by your reckoning.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:48: To many a town steeped in wrongdoing I gave more time and then struck them down: they all return to Me in the end.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:49: Say [Prophet], ‘People, I am sent only to give you clear warning.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:50: Those who believe and do good deeds will be forgiven and have a generous reward,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:51: but those who strive to oppose Our messages and try in vain to defeat Us are destined for the Blaze.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:52: We have never sent any messenger or prophet before you [Muhammad] into whose wishes Satan did not insinuate something, but God removes what Satan insinuates and then God affirms His message. God is all knowing and wise:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:53: He makes Satan’s insinuations a temptation only for the sick at heart and those whose hearts are hardened- the evildoers are profoundly opposed [to the Truth]-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:54: and He causes those given knowledge to realize that this Revelation is your Lord’s Truth, so that they may believe in it and humble their hearts to Him: God guides the faithful to the straight path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:55: The disbelievers will remain in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly overpowers them or until torment descends on them on a Day devoid of all hope.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:56: On that Day control will belong to God: He will judge between them. Those who believe and do good deeds will be admitted to Gardens of Delight,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:57: while those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations will receive a humiliating torment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:58: He will give a generous provision to those who migrated in God’s way and were killed or died. He is the Best Provider.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:59: He will admit them to a place that will please them: God is all knowing and most forbearing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:60: So it will be. God will help those who retaliate against an aggressive act merely with its like and are then wronged again: God is pardoning and most forgiving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:61: So it will be, because God makes night pass into day, and day into night, and He is all hearing and all seeing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:62: So it will be, because it is God alone who is the Truth, and whatever else they invoke is sheer falsehood: it is God who is the Most High, the Most Great.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:63: Have you [Prophet] not considered how God sends water down from the sky and the next morning the earth becomes green? God is truly most subtle, all aware;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:64: everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Him; God alone is self-sufficient, worthy of all praise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:65: Have you not considered how God has made everything on the earth of service to you? That ships sail the sea at His command? That He keeps the heavens from falling down on the earth without His permission? God is most compassionate and most merciful to mankind-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:66: it is He who gave you [people] life, will cause you to die, then will give you life again- but man is ungrateful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:67: We have appointed acts of devotion for every community to observe, so do not let them argue with you [Prophet] about this matter. Call them to your Lord- you are on the right path-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:68: and if they argue with you, say, ‘God is well aware of what you are doing.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:69: On the Day of Resurrection, God will judge between you regarding your differences.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:70: Are you [Prophet] not aware that God knows all that is in the heavens and earth? All this is written in a Record; this is easy for God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:71: Yet beside God they serve that for which He has sent no authority and of which they have no knowledge: the evildoers will have no one to help them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:72: [Prophet], you can see the hostility on the faces of the disbelievers when Our messages are recited clearly to them: it is almost as if they are going to attack those who recite Our messages to them. Say, ‘Shall I tell you what is far worse than what you feel now? The Fire that God has promised the disbelievers! What a dismal end!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:73: People, here is an illustration, so listen carefully: those you call on beside God could not, even if they combined all their forces, create a fly, and if a fly took something away from them, they would not be able to retrieve it. How feeble are the petitioners and how feeble are those they petition!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:74: They have no grasp of God’s true measure: God is truly most strong and mighty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:75: God chooses messengers from among the angels and from among men. God is all hearing, all seeing:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:76: He knows what lies before and behind them. All matters return to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:77: Believers, bow down, prostrate yourselves, worship your Lord, and do good so that you may succeed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.22:78: Strive hard for God as is His due: He has chosen you and placed no hardship in your religion, the faith of your forefather Abraham. God has called you Muslims––both in the past and in this [message]––so that the Messenger can bear witness about you and so that you can bear witness about other people. So keep up the prayer, give the prescribed alms, and seek refuge in God: He is your protector––an excellent protector and an excellent helper.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:6: except with their spouses or their slaves––with these they are not to blame,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:7: but anyone who seeks more than this is exceeding the limits––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:8: who are faithful to their trusts and pledges
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:9: and who keep up their prayers,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:11: Paradise as their own, there to remain.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:12: We created man from an essence of clay,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:13: then We placed him as a drop of fluid in a safe place,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:14: then We made that drop into a clinging form, and We made that form into a lump of flesh, and We made that lump into bones, and We clothed those bones with flesh, and later We made him into other forms––glory be to God, the best of creators!––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:16: and then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be raised up again.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:17: We created seven levels above you: We are never unmindful of Our creation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:18: We sent water down from the sky in due measure and lodged it in the earth––We have the power to take it all away if We so wish––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:19: with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines, with many fruits there for you to eat,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:20: and a tree, growing out of Mount Sinai, that produces oil and seasoning for your food.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:21: There is a lesson for you in livestock: We produce milk for you to drink from their bellies. And they have many other benefits: you eat them
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:22: and you ride on them, as you do in ships.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:23: We sent Noah to his people. He said, ‘My people, serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:24: But the leading disbelievers among his people said, ‘He is merely a mortal like you, trying to gain some superiority over you. God would have sent down angels if He had wished; besides, we never heard of anything like this from our forefathers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:25: He is just a madman, so let’s wait and see what happens to him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:26: Noah said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:27: and so We revealed to him: ‘Build the Ark under Our watchful eye and according to Our revelation. When Our command comes and water gushes up out of the earth,take pairs of every species on board, and your family, except for those on whom the sentence has already been passed- do not plead with me for the evildoers: they will be drowned-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:28: and when you and your companions are settled on the Ark, say, “Praise be to God, who delivered us from the wicked people,”
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:29: and say, “My Lord, let me land with Your blessing: it is You who provide the best landings”.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:30: There are signs in all this: We have always put [people] to the test.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:31: Then We raised another generation after them,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:32: and sent one of their own as a messenger: ‘Serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:33: But the leading disbelievers among his people, who denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, to whom We had granted ease and plenty in this life, said, ‘He is just a mortal like you- he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:34: and you will really be losers if you obey a mortal like yourselves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:35: How can he promise you that after you die and become dust and bones you will be brought out alive?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:36: What you are promised is very farfetched.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:37: There is only the life of this world: we die, we live, but we will never be resurrected.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:38: He is just a man making lies up about God. We will never believe in him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:39: The prophet said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:40: and so God said, ‘Soon they will be filled with regret.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:41: The blast justly struck them and We swept them away like scum. Away with the evildoers!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:42: We raised other generations after them-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:43: no community can advance or delay its time-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:44: and We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to a community they invariably called him a liar, so We destroyed them one after the other and made them into cautionary tales. Away with the disbelievers!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:45: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our signs and clear authority,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:46: to Pharaoh and his prominent leaders, but they responded with arrogance: they were a haughty people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:47: They said, ‘Are we to believe in two mortals like us? And their people are our servants?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:48: and so they called them both liars: they became another ruined people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:49: We gave Moses the Scripture, so that they might be rightly guided.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:50: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign; We gave them shelter on a peaceful hillside with flowing water.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:51: Messengers, eat good things and do good deeds: I am well aware of what you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:52: This community of yours is one- and I am your Lord: be mindful of Me-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:53: but they have split their community into sects, each rejoicing in their own.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:54: So [Muhammad] leave them for a while steeped [in their ignorance].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:55: Do they reckon that, by giving them wealth and sons,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:56: We race to give them good things? They really have no idea!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:57: Those who stand in awe of their Lord,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:59: who do not ascribe partners to Him,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:60: who always give with hearts that tremble at the thought that they must return to Him,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:61: are the ones who race toward good things, and they will be the first to get them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:62: We do not burden any soul with more than it can bear- We have a Record that tells the truth- they will not be wronged.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:63: But the disbelievers’ hearts are steeped [in ignorance of ] all this; and there are other things besides this that they do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:64: When We bring Our punishment on those corrupted with wealth, they will cry for help:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:65: ‘Do not cry out today: you will get no help from Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:66: Time and time again My messages were recited to you, but you turned arrogantly on your heels,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:67: and spent the evening making fun of [the Quran].’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:68: Have they not contemplated the Word of God? Has something come to them that did not come to their forefathers?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:69: Do they not recognize their Messenger? So why do they reject him?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:70: Why do they say he is possessed? He has brought them the truth and most of them hate it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:71: but if the truth were in accordance with their desires, the heavens, the earth, and everyone in them would disintegrate. We have brought them their Reminder and they turn away from it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:72: Do you [Prophet] ask them for any payment? Your Lord’s is the best payment: He is the Best of Providers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:73: You call them to a straight path
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:74: and those who do not believe in the Hereafter turn away from that path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:75: Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve them of distress, they would blindly persist in their transgression.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:76: We have already afflicted them, yet they did not submit to their Lord: they will not humble themselves
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:77: until We open a gate to severe torment for them- then they will be plunged into utter despair.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:78: It is God who endowed you with hearing, sight, and hearts- how seldom you are grateful!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:79: It is He who made you multiply on earth. It is to Him that you will be gathered:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:80: it is He who gives life and death; the alternation of night and day depends on Him; will you not use your minds?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:82: they say, ‘What? When we die and turn to dust and bones, shall we really be resurrected?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:83: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:84: Say [Prophet], ‘Who owns the earth and all who live in it, if you know [so much]?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:85: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not take heed?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:86: Say, ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens? Who is the Lord of the Mighty Throne?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:87: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not be mindful?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:88: Say, ‘Who holds control of everything in His hand? Who protects, while there is no protection against Him, if you know [so much]?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:89: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Then how can you be so deluded?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:90: The fact is, We brought them the truth and they are lying.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:91: God has never had a child. Nor is there any god beside Him- if there were, each god would have taken his creation aside and tried to overcome the others. May God be exalted above what they describe!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:92: He knows what is not seen as well as what is seen; He is far above any partner they claim for Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:93: Say, ‘Lord, if You are going to show me the punishment You have promised them,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:94: then Lord, do not include me among the evildoers!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:95: We certainly are able to show you the punishment We have promised them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:96: Repel evil with good- We are well aware of what they attribute to Us-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:97: and say, ‘Lord, I take refuge with You from the goadings of the evil ones;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:98: I seek refuge with you, Lord, so that they may not come near me.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:99: When death comes to one of them, he cries, ‘My Lord, let me return
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:100: so as to make amends for the things I neglected.’ Never! This will not go beyond his words: a barrier stands behind such people until the very Day they are resurrected.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:101: On that Day when the Trumpet is blown, the ties between them will be as nothing and they will not ask about each other:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:102: those whose good deeds weigh heavy will be successful,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:103: but those whose balance is light will have lost their souls for ever and will stay in Hell-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:104: the Fire will scorch their faces and their lips will be twisted in pain.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:105: ‘Were My messages not recited over and over to you and still you rejected them?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:106: They will say, ‘Lord, our waywardness overcame us and we went astray.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:107: Lord, take us away from this and if we go back to our old ways, then we shall really be evildoers.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:108: He will say, ‘Away with you! In you go! Do not speak to Me!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:109: Among My servants there were those who said, “Lord, We believe. Forgive us and have mercy on us: You are the most merciful of all.”
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:110: But you kept on laughing at them: so intent were you on laughing at them that it made you forget My warning.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:111: Today I have rewarded them for their patience: it is they who will succeed.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:112: He will say, ‘How many years were you on earth?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:113: and they will reply, ‘We stayed a day or a part of a day, but ask those who keep count.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:114: He will say, ‘You stayed but a little, if you had only known.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:115: Did you think We had created you in vain, and that you would not be brought back to Us?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:116: Exalted be God, the true King, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the Glorious Throne!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:117: Whoever prays to another god alongside Him- a god for whose existence he has no evidence- will face his reckoning with his Lord. Those who reject the truth will not prosper.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.23:118: Say [Prophet], ‘Lord, forgive and have mercy: You are the most merciful of all.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:1: This is a sura We have sent down and made obligatory: We have sent down clear revelations in it, so that you may take heed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:2: Strike the adulteress and the adulterer one hundred times. Do not let compassion for them keep you from carrying out God’s law––if you believe in God and the Last Day––and ensure that a group of believers witnesses the punishment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:3: The adulterer is only [fit] to marry an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress is only [fit] to marry an adulterer or an idolater: such behaviour is forbidden to believers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:4: As for those who accuse chaste women of fornication, and then fail to provide four witnesses, strike them eighty times, and reject their testimony ever afterwards: they are the lawbreakers,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:5: except for those who repent later and make amends––God is most forgiving and merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:6: As for those who accuse their own wives of adultery, but have no other witnesses, let each one four times call God to witness that he is telling the truth,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:7: and, the fifth time, call God to reject him if he is lying;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:8: punishment shall be averted from his wife if she in turn four times calls God to witness that her husband is lying
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:9: and, the fifth time, calls God to reject her if he is telling the truth.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:10: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you, if it were not that God accepts repentance and is wise . . .!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:11: It was a group from among you that concocted the lie––do not consider it a bad thing for you [people]; it was a good thing––and every one of them will be charged with the sin he has earned. He who took the greatest part in it will have a painful punishment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:12: When you heard the lie, why did believing men and women not think well of their own people and declare, ‘This is obviously a lie’?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:13: And why did the accusers not bring four witnesses to it? If they cannot produce such witnesses, they are the liars in God’s eyes.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:14: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you in this world and the next, you would already have been afflicted by terrible suffering for indulging in such talk.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:15: When you took it up with your tongues, and spoke with your mouths things you did not know [to be true], you thought it was trivial but to God it was very serious.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:16: When you heard the lie, why did you not say, ‘We should not repeat this- God forbid!- It is a monstrous slander’?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:17: God warns you never to do anything like this again, if you are true believers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:18: God makes His messages clear to you: God is all knowing, all wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:19: A painful punishment waits in this world and the next for those who like indecency to spread among the believers: God knows and you do not.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:20: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy and the fact that He is compassionate and merciful . . .!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:21: Believers, do not follow in Satan’s footsteps- if you do so, he will urge you to indecency and evil. If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you, not one of you would ever have attained purity. God purifies whoever He will: God is all hearing, all seeing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:22: Those who have been graced with bounty and plenty should not swear that they will [no longer] give to kinsmen, the poor, those who emigrated in God’s way: let them pardon and forgive. Do you not wish that God should forgive you? God is most forgiving and merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:23: Those who accuse honourable but unwary believing women are rejected by God, in this life and the next. A painful punishment awaits them
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:24: on the Day when their own tongues, hands, and feet will testify against them about what they have done-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:25: on that Day, God will pay them their just due in full- and they will realize that God is the Truth that makes everything clear.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:26: Corrupt women are for corrupt men, and corrupt men are for corrupt women; good women are for good men and good men are for good women. The good are innocent of what has been said against them; they will have forgiveness and a generous provision.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:27: Believers, do not enter other people’s houses until you have asked permission to do so and greeted those inside- that is best for you: perhaps you will bear this in mind.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:28: If you find no one in, do not enter unless you have been given permission to do so. If you are told, ‘Go away’, then do so- that is more proper for you. God knows well what you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:29: You will not be blamed for entering houses where no one lives, and which could provide you with some useful service. God knows everything you do openly and everything you conceal.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:30: [Prophet], tell believing men to lower their glances and guard their private parts: that is purer for them. God is well aware of everything they do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:31: And tell believing women that they should lower their glances, guard their private parts, and not display their charms beyond what [it is acceptable] to reveal; they should let their headscarves fall to cover their necklines and not reveal their charms except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands’ fathers, their sons, their husbands’ sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their womenfolk, their slaves, such men as attend them who have no sexual desire, or children who are not yet aware of women’s nakedness; they should not stamp their feet so as to draw attention to any hidden charms. Believers, all of you, turn to God so that you may prosper.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:32: Marry off the single among you and those of your male and female slaves who are fit [for marriage]. If they are poor, God will provide for them from His bounty: God’s bounty is infinite and He is all knowing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:33: Those who are unable to marry should keep chaste until God gives them enough out of His bounty. If any of your slaves wish to pay for their freedom, make a contract with them accordingly, if you know they have good in them, and give them some of the wealth God has given you. Do not force your slave-girls into prostitution, when they themselves wish to remain honourable, in your quest for the short-term gains of this world, although, if they are forced, God will be forgiving and merciful to them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:34: We have sent verses down to you [people] clarifying the right path, examples of those who passed away before you, and advice for those who are mindful of God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:35: God is the Light of the heavens and earth. His Light is like this: there is a niche, and in it a lamp, the lamp inside a glass, a glass like a glittering star, fuelled from a blessed olive tree from neither east nor west, whose oil almost gives light even when no fire touches it- light upon light- God guides whoever He will to his Light; God draws such comparisons for people; God has full knowledge of everything-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:36: shining out in houses of worship. God has ordained that they be raised high and that His name be remembered in them, with men in them celebrating His glory morning and evening:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:37: men who are not distracted, either by commerce or profit, from remembering God, keeping up the prayer, and paying the prescribed alms, fearing a day when hearts and eyes will turn over.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:38: God will reward such people according to the best of their actions, and He will give them more of His bounty: God provides limitlessly for anyone He will.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:39: But the deeds of those who disbelieve are like a mirage in a desert: the thirsty person thinks there will be water but, when he gets there, he finds only God, who pays him his account in full- God is swift in reckoning.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:40: Or like shadows in a deep sea covered by wave upon wave, with clouds above- layer upon layer of darkness- if he holds out his hand, he is scarcely able to see it. The one to whom God gives no light has no light at all.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:41: [Prophet], do you not see that all those who are in the heavens and earth praise God, as do the birds with wings outstretched? Each knows its [own way] of prayer and glorification: God has full knowledge of what they do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:42: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to God: and to God is the final return.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:43: Do you not see that God drives the clouds, then gathers them together and piles them up until you see rain pour from their midst? He sends hail down from [such] mountains in the sky, pouring it on whoever He wishes and diverting it from whoever He wishes- the flash of its lightning almost snatches sight away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:44: God alternates night and day- there truly is a lesson in [all] this for those who have eyes to see-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:45: and God created each animal out of [its own] fluid: some of them crawl on their bellies, some walk on two legs, and some on four. God creates whatever He will; God has power over everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:46: We have sent verses that clarify the right path: God guides whoever He will to a straight path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:47: They say, ‘We believe in God and the Messenger; we obey,’ but then some of them turn away: these people are not true believers
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:48: and when they are summoned to God and His Messenger in order for him to judge between them, some of them turn away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:49: If they were claiming their right, they would come willingly [to the Prophet].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:50: Do they have sickness in their hearts? Are they full of doubts? Do they fear that God and His Messenger might deal with them unjustly? No, it is they who are the unjust ones.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:51: When the true believers are summoned to God and His Messenger in order for him to judge between them, they say, ‘We hear and we obey.’ These are the ones who will prosper:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:52: whoever obeys God and His Messenger, stands in awe of God, and keeps his duty to Him will be triumphant.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:53: [The others] solemnly swear by God that if you [Prophet] commanded them, they would march out. Tell them, ‘Do not swear: it is reasonable obedience that is required, and God is aware of everything you do.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:54: Say, ‘Obey God; obey the Messenger. If you turn away, [know that] he is responsible for the duty placed upon him, and you are responsible for the duty placed upon you. If you obey him, you will be rightly guided, but the Messenger’s duty is only to deliver the message clearly.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:55: God has made a promise to those among you who believe and do good deeds: He will make them successors to the land, as He did those who came before them; He will empower the religion He has chosen for them; He will grant them security to replace their fear. ‘They will worship Me and not join anything with Me.’ Those who are defiant after that will be the rebels.-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:56: [People], keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and obey the Messenger, so that you may be given mercy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:57: Do not think [Prophet] that the disbelievers can escape God on earth; the Fire will be their final home, an evil end.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:58: Believers, your slaves and any who have not yet reached puberty should ask your permission to come in at three times of day: before the dawn prayer; when you lay your garments aside in the midday heat; and after the evening prayer. These are your three times for privacy; at other times, there is no blame on you or them if you move around each other freely. In this way God makes messages clear: God is all knowing, all wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:59: When your children reach puberty, they should [always] ask your permission to enter, like their elders do. This is how God makes His messages clear to you: God is all knowing, all wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:60: No blame will be attached to elderly women who are not hoping for sex, if they take off their outer garments without flaunting their charms, but it is preferable for them not to do this: God is all hearing, all seeing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:61: No blame will be attached to the blind, the lame, the sick.Whether you eat in your own houses, or those of your fathers, your mothers, your brothers, your sisters, your paternal uncles, your paternal aunts, your maternal uncles, your maternal aunts, houses you have the keys for, or any of your friends’ houses, you will not be blamed: you will not be blamed whether you eat in company or separately. When you enter any house, greet one another with a greeting of blessing and goodness as enjoined by God. This is how God makes His messages clear to you so that you may understand.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:62: The true believers are those who believe in God and His Mes-senger, who, when they are gathered with him on a communal matter, do not depart until they have asked his permission- those who ask your permission [Prophet] are the ones who truly believe in God and His Messenger. When they ask your permission to attend to their private affairs, allow whoever you see fit and ask God to forgive them. God is most forgiving and merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:63: [People], do not regard the Messenger’s summons to you like one of you summoning another- God is well aware of those of you who steal away surreptitiously- and those who go against his order should beware lest a trial afflict them or they receive a painful punishment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.24:64: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God: He knows what state you are in- on the Day when all are returned to Him, He will tell them everything they have done- God has full knowledge of everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:1: Exalted is He who has sent the Differentiator down to His servant so that it may be a warning to all people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:2: It is He who has control over the heavens and earth and has no offspring––no one shares control with Him––and who created all things and made them to an exact measure.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:3: Yet the disbelievers take as their gods things beneath Him that create nothing, and are themselves created, that can neither harm nor help themselves, and have no control over death, life, or resurrection.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:4: The disbelievers say, ‘This can only be a lie he has forged with the help of others’––they themselves have done great wrong and told lies––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:5: and they say, ‘It is just ancient fables, which he has had written down: they are dictated to him morning and evening.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:6: Say, ‘It was sent down by Him who knows the secrets of the heavens and earth. He is all forgiving, all merciful.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:7: They also say, ‘What sort of messenger is this? He eats food and walks about in the marketplaces! Why has no angel been sent down to help him with his warnings?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:8: Why has he not been given treasure or a garden to supply his food?’ and the evildoers say, ‘The man you follow is simply under a spell.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:9: See what they think you are like! They have gone astray and cannot find the right way.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:10: Exalted is He who can, if He wishes, give you better things than these: Gardens graced with flowing streams, and palaces too.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:11: It is actually the coming of the Hour that they reject: We have prepared a blazing fire for those who reject the Hour.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:12: When it sees them from a distance, they will hear it raging and roaring,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:13: and when they are hurled into a narrow part of it, chained together, they will cry out for death.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:14: ‘Do not cry out this day for one death, but for many.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:15: Say, ‘Which is better, this or the lasting Garden that those who are mindful of God have been promised as their reward and journey’s end?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:16: There they will find everything they wish for, and there they will stay. [Prophet], this is a binding promise from your Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:17: On the Day He gathers them all together with those they worship beside Him, He will say, ‘Was it you [false gods] who led these creatures of Mine astray, or did they stray from the path by themselves?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:18: They will say, ‘May You be exalted! We ourselves would never take masters other than You! But You granted them and their forefathers pleasures in this life, until they forgot Your Reminder and were ruined.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:19: [God will say], ‘Now your gods have denounced what you say as lies: you cannot avoid the punishment; you will not get any help.’ If any of you commits such evil, We shall make him taste agonizing torment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:20: No messenger have We sent before you [Muhammad] who did not eat food and walk about in the marketplace. But We have made some of you a means of testing others- will you stand fast? Your Lord is always watching.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:21: Those who do not fear to meet Us say, ‘Why are the angels not sent down to us?’ or ‘Why can we not see our Lord?’ They are too proud of themselves and too insolent.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:22: There will be no good news for the guilty on the Day they see the angels. The angels will say, ‘You cannot cross the forbidden barrier,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:23: and We shall turn to the deeds they have done and scatter them like dust.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:24: But the companions in the Garden will have a better home on that Day, and a fairer place to rest.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:25: On the Day when the sky and its clouds are split apart and the angels sent down in streams,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:26: on that Day, true authority belongs to the Lord of Mercy. It will be a grievous Day for the disbelievers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:27: On that Day the evildoer will bite his own hand and say, ‘If only I had taken the same path as the Messenger.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:28: Woe is me! If only I had not taken so and so as a friend-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:29: he led me away from the Revelation after it reached me. Satan has always betrayed mankind.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:30: The Messenger has said, ‘Lord, my people treat this Quran as something to be shunned,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:31: but We have always appointed adversaries from the wicked, for every prophet: Your Lord is sufficient guide and helper.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:32: The disbelievers also say, ‘Why was the Quran not sent down to him all at once?’ We sent it in this way to strengthen your heart [Prophet]; We gave it to you in gradual revelation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:33: They cannot put any argument to you without Our bringing you the truth and the best explanation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:34: It is those driven [falling], on their faces,to Hell who will be in the worst place- they are the furthest from the right path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:35: We gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron to help him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:36: We said, ‘Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs.’ Later We destroyed those people utterly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:37: The people of Noah, too: when they rejected their messengers, We drowned them and made them an example to all people. We have prepared a painful torment for the evildoers,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:38: as We did for the people of Ad, Thamud, and al-Rass, and many generations in between.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:39: To each of them We gave warnings, and each of them We destroyed completely.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:40: These disbelievers must have passed by the town that was destroyed by the terrible rain––did they not see it? Yet they do not expect to be raised from the dead.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:41: Whenever they see you [Prophet] they ridicule you: ‘Is this the one God has sent as a messenger?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:42: He might almost have led us astray from our gods if we had not stood so firmly by them.’ When they see the punishment, they will know who is furthest from the path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:43: Think [Prophet] of the man who has taken his own passion as a god: are you to be his guardian?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:44: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle- no, they are further from the path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:45: Do you not see how your Lord lengthens the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it stand still- We made the sun its indicator-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:46: but We gradually draw it towards Us, little by little.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:47: It is He who made the night a garment for you, and sleep a rest, and made the day like a resurrection.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:48: It is He who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His Mercy. We send down pure water from the sky,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:49: so that We can revive a dead land with it, and We give it as a drink to many animals and people We have created.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:50: Many times We have repeated this to people so that they might take heed, but most persist in their ingratitude.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:51: If it had been Our will, We would have sent a warner to every town,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:52: so do not give in to the disbelievers: strive hard against them with this Quran.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:53: It is He who released the two bodies of flowing water, one sweet and fresh and the other salty and bitter, and put an insurmountable barrier between them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:54: It is He who creates human beings from fluid, then makes them kin by blood and marriage: your Lord is all powerful!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:55: Yet instead of God they worship things that can neither benefit nor harm them: the disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:56: We sent you only to give good news and warning.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:57: Say, ‘I am not asking for any reward for it, but anyone who wishes should take a path to his Lord.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:58: Put your trust in the Living [God] who never dies, and celebrate His praise. He knows the sins of His servants well enough:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:59: it is He who created the heavens and earth and what is between them in six Days, and then established Himself on the throne- He is the Lord of Mercy; He is the Best Informed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:60: Yet when they are told, ‘Bow down before the Lord of Mercy,’ they say, ‘What is the Lord of Mercy? Should we bow down before anything you command?’ and they turn even further away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:61: Exalted is He who put constellations in the heavens, a radiant light, and an illuminating moon-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:62: it is He who made the night and day follow each other- so anyone who wishes may be mindful or show gratitude.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:63: The servants of the Lord of Mercy are those who walk humbly on the earth, and who, when the foolish address them, reply, ‘Peace’;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:64: those who spend the night bowed down or standing, worshipping their Lord,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:65: who plead, ‘Our Lord, turn away from us the suffering of Hell, for it is a dreadful torment to suffer!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:66: It is an evil home, a foul resting place!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:67: They are those who are neither wasteful nor niggardly when they spend, but keep to a just balance;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:68: those who never invoke any other deity beside God, nor take a life, which God has made sacred, except in the pursuit of justice, nor commit adultery. (Whoever does these things will face the penalties:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:69: their torment will be doubled on the Day of Resurrection, and they will remain in torment, disgraced,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:70: except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds: God will change the evil deeds of such people into good ones. He is most forgiving, most merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:71: People who repent and do good deeds truly return to God.)
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:72: [The servants of the Lord of Mercy are] those who do not give false testimony, and who, when they see some frivolity, pass by with dignity;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:73: who, when reminded of their Lord’s signs, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:74: those who pray, ‘Our Lord, give us joy in our spouses and offspring. Make us good examples to those who are aware of You’.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:75: These servants will be rewarded with the highest place in Paradise for their steadfastness. There they will be met with greetings and peace.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:76: There they will stay- a happy home and resting place!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.25:77: [Prophet, tell the disbelievers], ‘What are you to my Lord without your supplication? But since you have written offthe truth as lies, the inevitable will happen.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:2: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:3: [Prophet], are you going to worry yourself to death because they will not believe?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:4: If We had wished, We could have sent them down a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in utter humility.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:5: Whenever they are brought a new revelation from the Lord of Mercy, they turn away:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:6: they deny it, but the truth of what they scorned will soon hit them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:7: Do they not see the earth, and what noble kinds of thing We grow in it?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:8: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:9: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:10: Your Lord called to Moses: ‘Go to those wrongdoers,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:11: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not take heed?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:12: Moses said, ‘My Lord, I fear they will call me a liar,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:13: and I will feel stressed and tongue-tied, so send Aaron too;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:14: besides, they have a chargeagainst me, and I fear they may kill me.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:15: God said, ‘No [they will not]. Go, both of you, with Our signs––We shall be with you, listen-ing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:16: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, “We bring a message from the Lord of the Worlds:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:17: let the Children of Israel leave with us.” ’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:18: Pharaoh said, ‘Did we not bring you up as a child among us? Did you not stay with us for many years?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:19: And then you committed that crime of yours: you were so ungrateful.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:20: Moses replied, ‘I was misguided when I did it
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:21: and I fled from you in fear; later my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of His messengers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:22: And is this- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel- the favour with which you reproach me?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:23: Pharaoh asked, ‘What is this “Lord of the Worlds”?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:24: Moses replied, ‘He is the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them. If you would only have faith!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:25: Pharaoh said to those present, ‘Do you hear what he says?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:26: Moses said, ‘He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:27: Pharaoh said, ‘This messenger who has been sent to you is truly possessed.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:28: Moses continued, ‘Lord of the East and West and everything between them. If you would only use your reason!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:29: But Pharaoh said [to him], ‘If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:30: and Moses asked, ‘Even if I show you something convincing?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:31: ‘Show it then,’ said Pharaoh, ‘if you are telling the truth.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:32: So Moses threw down his staff and- lo and behold!- it became a snake for everyone to see.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:33: Then he drew out his hand and- lo and behold!- it was white for the onlookers to see.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:34: Pharaoh said to the counsellors around him, ‘This man is a learned sorcerer!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:35: He means to use his sorcery to drive you out of your land! What do you suggest?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:36: They answered, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:37: to bring every accomplished sorcerer to you.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:38: The sorcerers were [to be] assembled at the appointed time on a certain day
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:39: and the people were asked, "Are you all coming?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:40: We may follow the sorcerers if they win!"
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:41: When the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:42: and he said, ‘Yes, and you will join my inner court.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:43: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you will.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:44: They threw their ropes and staffs, saying, ‘By Pharaoh’s might, we shall be victorious.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:45: But Moses threw his staff and- lo and behold!- it swallowed up their trickery
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:46: and the sorcerers fell down on their knees,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:47: exclaiming, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:48: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:49: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be the master who taught you sorcery! Soon you will see: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify the lot of you!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:50: ‘That will do us no harm,’ they said, ‘for we are sure to return to our Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:51: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we were the first to believe.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:52: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, ‘Leave with My servants by night, for you will be pursued!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:53: Pharaoh sent messengers into the cities, proclaiming,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:56: and we are a large army, on the alert.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:57: So it was that We made them leave their gardens and their springs,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:58: their treasures and their noble dwellings-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:59: We gave [such] things [later]to the Children of Israel.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:60: Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:61: and as soon as the two sides came within sight of one another, Moses’ followers said, ‘We shall definitely be caught.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:62: Moses said, ‘No, my Lord is with me: He will guide me,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:63: and We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ It parted- each side like a mighty mountain-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:64: and We brought the others to that place:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:65: We saved Moses and all his companions,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:67: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:68: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:69: Tell them the story of Abraham,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:70: when he asked his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:71: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constantly in attendance on them.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:72: He asked, ‘Do they hear you when you call?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:73: Do they help or harm you?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:74: They replied, ‘No, but this is what we saw our fathers doing.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:75: Abraham said, ‘Those idols you have worshipped,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:77: are my enemies; not so the Lord of the Worlds,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:78: who created me. It is He who guides me;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:79: He who gives me food and drink;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:80: He who cures me when I am ill;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:81: He who will make me die and then give me life again;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:82: and He who will, I hope, forgive my faults on the Day of Judgement.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:83: My Lord, grant me wisdom; join me with the righteous;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:84: give me a good name among later generations;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:85: make me one of those given the Garden of Bliss-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:86: forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:87: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:88: the Day when neither wealth nor children can help,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:89: when the only one who will be saved is the one who comes before God with a heart devoted to Him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:90: When the Garden is brought near to the righteous
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:91: and the Fire is placed in full view of the misguided,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:92: it will be said to them, ‘Where are those you worshipped
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:93: beside God? Can they help you now, or even help themselves?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:94: and then they will all be hurled into Hell, together with those that misled them,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:96: There they will say to their gods, as they bicker among themselves,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:98: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:99: It was the evildoers who led us astray,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:100: and now we have no intercessor
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:102: If only we could live our lives again, we would be true believers!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:103: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:104: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:105: The people of Noah, too, called the messengers liars.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:106: Their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:107: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:108: be mindful of God and obey me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:109: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:110: be mindful of God and obey me.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:111: They answered, ‘Why should we believe you when the worst sort of people follow you?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:112: He said, ‘What knowledge do I have of what they used to do?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:113: It is for my Lord alone to bring them to account- if only you could see-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:114: I will not drive believers away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:115: I am here only to give people a clear warning.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:116: So they said, ‘Noah, if you do not stop this, you will be stoned.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:117: He said, ‘My Lord, my people have rejected me,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:118: so make a firm judgement between me and them, and save me and my believing followers.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:119: So We saved him and his followers in the fully laden ship,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:121: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:122: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:123: The people of Ad, too, called the messengers liars.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:124: Their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:125: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:126: be mindful of God and obey me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:127: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:128: How can you be so vain that you set up monuments on every high place?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:129: Do you build fortresses because you hope to be immortal?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:130: Why do you act like tyrants whenever you attack someone?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:131: Be mindful of God and obey me;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.26:132: be mindful of Him who has provided you with everything you know-
