Abdel Haleem.33:50: Prophet, We have made lawful for you the wives whose bride gift you have paid, and any slaves God has assigned to you through war, and the daughters of your uncles and aunts on your father’s and mother’s sides, who migrated with you. Also any believing woman who has offered herself to the Prophet and whom the Prophet wishes to wed- this is only for you [Prophet] and not the rest of the believers: We know exactly what We have made obligatory for them concerning their wives and slave-girls- so you should not be blamed: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:51: You may make any of [your women] wait and receive any of them as you wish, but you will not be at fault if you invite one whose turn you have previously set aside: this way it is more likely that they will be satisfied and will not be distressed and will all be content with what you have given them. God knows what is in your hearts: God is all knowing, forbearing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:52: You [Prophet] are not permitted to take any further wives, nor to exchange the wives you have for others, even if these attract you with their beauty. But this does not apply to your slave-girls: God is watchful over all.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:53: Believers, do not enter the Prophet’s apartments for a meal unless you are given permission to do so; do not linger until [a meal] is ready. When you are invited, go in; then, when you have taken your meal, leave. Do not stay on and talk, for that would offend the Prophet, though he would shrink from asking you to leave. God does not shrink from the truth. When you ask his wives for something, do so from behind a screen: this is purer both for your hearts and for theirs. It is not right for you to offend God’s Messenger, just as you should never marry his wives after him: that would be grievous in God’s eyes.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:54: God has full knowledge of all things, whether you reveal them or not.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:55: The Prophet’s wives are not to blame [if they are seen by] their fathers, their sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their women, or their slaves. [Wives of the Prophet], be mindful of God. God observes everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:56: God and His angels bless the Prophet- so, you who believe, bless him too and give him greetings of peace.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:57: Those who insult God and His Messenger will be rejected by God in this world and the next- He has prepared a humiliating torment for them-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:58: and those who undeservedly insult believing men and women will bear the guilt of slander and flagrant sin.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:59: Prophet, tell your wives, your daughters, and women believers to make their outer garments hang low over them so as to be recog-nized and not insulted: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:60: If the hypocrites, the sick at heart, and those who spread lies in the city do not desist, We shall rouse you [Prophet] against them, and then they will only be your neighbours in this city for a short while.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:61: They will be rejected. Wherever they are found, they will be arrested and put to death.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:62: This has been God’s practice with those who went before. You will find no change in God’s practices.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:63: People ask you about the Hour. Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of it.’ How could you [Prophet] know? The Hour may well be near.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:64: God has rejected the disbelievers and prepared a blazing fire for them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:65: There they will stay permanently, with no one to befriend or support them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:66: On the Day when their faces are being turned about in the Fire, they will say, ‘If only we had obeyed God and the Messenger,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:67: and ‘Lord! We obeyed our masters and our chiefs, and they led us astray.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:68: Lord! Give them a double punishment and reject them completely.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:69: Believers, do not be like those who insulted Moses- God cleared him of their allegations and he was highly honoured in God’s eyes.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:70: Believers, be mindful of God, speak in a direct fashion and to good purpose,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:71: and He will put your deeds right for you and forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys God and His Messenger will truly achieve a great triumph.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:72: We offered the Trust to the heavens, the earth, and the mountains, yet they refused to undertake it and were afraid of it; mankind undertook it- they have always been inept and foolish.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.33:73: God will punish the hypocrites and the idolaters, both men and women, and turn with mercy to the believers, both men and women: God is most forgiving, most merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:1: Praise be to God, to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and earth, and praise be to Him in the life to come. He is the All Wise, the All Aware.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:2: He knows all that goes into the earth and all that comes out of it; He knows all that comes down from the heavens and all that goes up to them. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:3: Still, the disbelievers say, ‘The Last Hour will never come upon us.’ Say, ‘Yes, by my Lord, [it will], by Him who knows the unseen! Not even the weight of a speck of dust in the heavens or earth escapes His knowledge, nor anything smaller or greater. It is all recorded in a clear Record
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:4: so that He can reward those who believe and do good deeds: they will have forgiveness and generous provision.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:5: But as for those who work against Our Revelations, seeking to undermine them, there will be a torment of painful suffering.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:6: [Prophet], those who have been given knowledge can see that what has been sent to you from your Lord is the truth, and that it leads to the path of the Almighty, worthy of all praise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:7: But the disbelievers say, ‘Shall we show you a man who claims that, when you have been utterly torn to pieces, you will be raised in a new creation?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:8: Has he invented a lie about God? Is he mad?’ No! It is those who do not believe in the life to come who will suffer torment, for they are in gross error.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:9: Do they not think about what is in front of them and behind them in the heavens and earth? If We wished, We could make the earth swallow them, or make fragments from the heavens fall down upon them. There truly is a sign in this for every servant who turns back to God in repentance.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:10: We graced David with Our favour. We said, ‘You mountains, echo God’s praises together with him, and you birds, too.’ We softened iron for him,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:11: saying, ‘Make coats of chain mail and measure the links well.’ ‘Do good, all of you, for I see everything you do.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:12: And [We subjected] the wind for Solomon. Its outward journey took a month, and its return journey likewise. We made a fountain of molten brass flow for him, and some of the jinn worked under his control with his Lord’s permission. If one of them deviated from Our command, We let him taste the suffering of the blazing flame.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:13: They made him whatever he wanted- palaces, statues, basins as large as water troughs, fixed cauldrons. We said, ‘Work thankfully, family of David, for few of my servants are truly thankful.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:14: Then, when We decreed Solomon’s death, nothing showed the jinn he was dead, but a creature of the earth eating at his stick: when he fell down they realized- if they had known what was hidden they would not have continued their demeaning labour.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:15: There was a sign for the people of Sheba, too, in their dwelling place: two gardens, one on the right, one on the left: ‘Eat from what your Lord has provided for you and give Him thanks, for your land is good, and your Lord most forgiving.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:16: But they paid no heed, so We let loose on them a flood from the dam and replaced their two gardens with others that yielded bitter fruit, tamarisk bushes, and a few lote trees.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:17: In this way We punished them for their ingratitude- would We punish anyone but the ungrateful?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:18: Also, We had placed, between them and the towns We had blessed, other towns within sight of one another to which they could travel easily- ‘ Travel safely in this land by night and by day’-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:19: but [still] they complained, ‘Our Lord has made the distance between our staging posts so long!’They wronged themselves and, in the end, We made their fate a byword, and scattered them in countless fragments. There truly are signs in this for every patient, thankful person.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:20: Satan was proved right in his opinion of them, for they all followed him- except for a group of believers-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:21: even though he had no authority over them. But [We aim] to distinguish those who believe in the life to come from those who doubt it: [Prophet], your Lord observes everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:22: Say, ‘Pray to your so-called gods besides God: they do not control even the weight of a speck of dust in heaven or earth, nor do they have any share in them, nor are any of them any help to God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:23: Intercession will not work with Him, except by those to whom He gives permission.’ They will be asked, after the terror is lifted from their hearts [on the Day of Judgement], ‘What did your Lord speak?’ and they will answer, ‘The Truth. He is the Most High, the Most Great.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:24: Say [Prophet], ‘Who gives you sustenance from the heavens and earth?’ Say, ‘God does,’ and ‘[One party of us] must be rightly guided and the other clearly astray.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:25: Say, ‘You will not be ques-tioned about our sins, nor will we be questioned about what you do.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:26: Say, ‘Our Lord will gather us together, then He will judge justly between us; He alone is the All Knowing Judge.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:27: Say, ‘Show me those you joined to Him as partners. No indeed! He alone is God, the Almighty, the All Wise.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:28: We have sent you [Prophet] only to bring good news and warning to all people, but most of them do not understand.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:29: And they say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:30: Say, ‘You have an appointment for a Day which you cannot put off nor bring forward, even by a single moment.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:31: The disbelievers say, ‘We will believe neither this Qur an nor the Scriptures that came before it.’ If only you could see [Prophet] how the wrongdoers will be made to stand before their Lord, hurling reproaches at one another. Those who were oppressed will say to the oppressors, ‘If it were not for you, we would have been believers.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:32: The oppressors will say to them, ‘Was it we who prevented you from following right guidance after it had reached you? No! You yourselves were sinners.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:33: The oppressed will say to them, ‘No, it was your scheming, night and day, ordering us to disbelieve in God and set up rivals to Him.’ When they see the punishment, they will fall silent with regret, and We shall put iron collars on the disbelievers’ necks. Why should they be rewarded for anything other than what they have done?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:34: Never have We sent a warner to a community without those among them who were corrupted by wealth saying, ‘We do not believe in the message you have been sent with.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:35: They would say, ‘We have greater wealth and more children than you, and we shall not be punished.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:36: Say [Prophet], ‘My Lord gives in abundance to whoever He will and sparingly to whoever He will, though most people do not understand.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:37: Neither wealth nor children will bring you nearer to Us, but those who believe and do good deeds will have multiple rewards for what they have done, and will live safely in the lofty dwellings of Paradise,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:38: whereas those who work against Our messages, seeking to undermine them, will be summoned to punishment.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:39: Say, ‘My Lord gives in abundance to whichever of His servants He will, and sparingly to whichever He will; He will replace whatever you give in alms; He is the best of providers.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:40: On the Day He gathers them all together, He will say to the angels, ‘Was it you these people worshipped?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:41: They will reply, ‘May You be exalted! You are our supporter against them! Really, they worshipped the jinn- most of them believed in them.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:42: ‘So today neither of you has any power to benefit or harm the other,’ We shall tell the evildoers, ‘Taste the torment of the fire which you called a lie.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:43: When Our messages are recited to them, clear as they are, they say, ‘This is only a man who wants to turn you away from what your forefathers worshipped,’ and, ‘This [Quran] is nothing but lies he has made up.’ When the Truth comes to the disbelievers, they say, ‘This is just plain sorcery,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:44: though We have not given them any books to study nor sent any warner before you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:45: Those who lived before them also denied the truth- these people have not attained even a tenth of what We gave their predecessors- they, too, rejected My messengers, and how terrible My condemnation was!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:46: Say [Prophet], ‘I advise you to do one thing only: stand before God, in pairs or singly, and think: there is no sign of madness in your companion [the Prophet]- he is only warning you before severe suffering arrives.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:47: Say, ‘If I have asked you for any reward, you can keep it. It is God alone who will reward me: He is witness to everything.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:48: Say, ‘My Lord hurls the Truth down [before you]. He has full knowledge of all that is unseen.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:49: Say, ‘The Truth has come; falsehood is powerless.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:50: Say, ‘If I go astray, that is my loss, and if I am rightly guided, it is through what my Lord has revealed to me. He is all hearing, and ever near.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:51: [Prophet], if you could only see their terror! There will be no escape when they are seized from a nearby place;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:52: they will say, ‘Now we believe in it,’ but how can they reach it from such a distant place-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:53: they denied it all in the past, and threw conjecture from a faroff place-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.34:54: when a barrier has been placed between them and what they desire, just as was done with their kind before? They were deep in doubt and suspicion.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:1: Praise be to God, Creator of the heavens and earth, who made angels messengers with two, three, four [pairs of] wings. He adds to creation as He will: God has power over everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:2: No one can withhold the blessing God opens up for people, nor can anyone but Him release whatever He withholds: He is the Almighty, the All Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:3: People, remember God’s grace towards you. Is there any creator other than God to give you sustenance from the heavens and earth? There is no god but Him. How can you be so deluded?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:4: If they call you a liar [Prophet], many messengers before you were also called liars: it is to God that all things will be returned.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:5: People! God’s promise is true, so do not let the present life deceive you. Do not let the Deceiver deceive you about God:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:6: Satan is your enemy––so treat him as an enemy––and invites his followers only to enter the blazing fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:7: Those who disbelieve will be punished severely; those who believe and do good deeds will be forgiven, and richly rewarded.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:8: What about those whose evil deeds are made alluring to them so that they think they are good? God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will. [Prophet], do not waste your soul away with regret for them: God knows exactly what they do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:9: It is God who sends forth the winds; they raise up the clouds; We drive them to a dead land and with them revive the earth after its death: such will be the Resurrection.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:10: If anyone desires power, all power belongs to God; good words rise up to Him and He lifts up the righteous deed, but a severe torment awaits those who plot evil and their plotting will come to nothing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:11: It is God who created you from dust and later from a drop of fluid; then He made you into two sexes; no female conceives or gives birth without His knowledge; no person grows old or has his life cut short, except in accordance with a Record: all this is easy for God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:12: The two bodies of water are not alike- one is palatable, sweet, and pleasant to drink, the other salty and bitter- yet from each you eat fresh fish and extract ornaments to wear, and in each you see the ships ploughing their course so that you may seek God’s bounty and be grateful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:13: He makes the night merge into the day and the day into the night; He has subjected the sun and the moon- each runs for an appointed term. Such is God your Lord: all control belongs to Him. Those you invoke beside Him do not even control the skin of a date stone;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:14: if you call them they cannot hear you; if they could hear, they could not answer you; on the Day of Resurrection they will disown your idolatry. None can inform you [Prophet] like the One who is all aware.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:15: People, it is you who stand in need of God- God needs nothing and is worthy of all praise-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:16: if He wills, He can do away with you and bring in a new creation,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:17: that is not difficult for God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:18: No burdened soul will bear the burden of another: even if a heavily laden soul should cry for help, none of its load will be carried, not even by a close relative. But you [Prophet] can only warn those who fear their Lord, though they cannot see Him, and keep up the prayer- whoever purifies himself does so for his own benefit–– everything returns to God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:19: The blind and the seeing are not alike,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:21: shade and heat are not alike,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:22: nor are the living and the dead. God makes anyone He wills hear [His message]: you cannot make those in their graves hear.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:23: You are only here to warn them-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:24: We have sent you with the Truth as a bearer of good news and warning- every community has been sent a warner.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:25: If they call you a liar, their predecessors did the same: messengers came to them with clear signs, scriptures, and enlightening revelation
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:26: and afterwards I seized the disbelievers- how terrible My punishment was!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:27: Have you [Prophet] not considered how God sends water down from the sky and that We produce with it fruits of varied colours; that there are in the mountains layers of white and red of various hues, and jet black;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:28: that there are various colours among human beings, wild animals, and livestock too? It is those of His servants who have knowledge who stand in true awe of God. God is almighty, most forgiving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:29: Those who recite God’s scripture, keep up the prayer, give secretly and openly from what We have provided for them, may hope for a trade that will never decline:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:30: He will repay them in full, and give them extra from His bounty. He is most forgiving, most appreciative.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:31: The Scripture We have revealed to you [Prophet] is the Truth and confirms the scriptures that preceded it. God is well informed about His servants, He sees everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:32: We gave the Scripture as a heritage to Our chosen servants: some of them wronged their own souls, some stayed between [right and wrong], and some, by God’s leave, were foremost in good deeds. That is the greatest favour:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:33: they will enter lasting Gardens where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, where they will wear silk garments.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:34: They will say, ‘Praise be to God, who has separated us from all sorrow! Our Lord is truly most forgiving, most appreciative:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:35: He has, in His bounty, settled us in the everlasting Home where no toil or fatigue will touch us.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:36: But those who reject the truth will stay in Hellfire, where they will neither be finished off by death, nor be relieved from Hell’s torment: this is how We reward hardened disbelievers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:37: They will cry out loud in Hell, ‘Lord, let us out, and we will do righteous deeds, not what we did before!’- ‘ Did We not give you a life long enough to take warning if you were going to? The warner came to you, now taste the punishment.’ The evildoers will have nobody to help them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:38: God knows all that is hidden in the heavens and earth; He knows the thoughts contained in the heart;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:39: it is He who made you [people] successors to the land. Those who deny the truth will bear the consequences: their denial will only make them more odious to their Lord, and add only to their loss.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:40: Say, ‘Consider those “partners” of yours that you call upon beside God. Show me! What part of the earth did they create? What share of the heavens do they possess?’ Have We given them a book that contains clear evidence? No indeed! The idolaters promise each other only delusion.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:41: God keeps the heavens and earth from vanishing; if they did vanish, no one else could stop them. God is most forbearing, most forgiving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:42: [The idolaters] swore their most solemn oath that, if someone came to warn them, they would be more rightly guided than any [other] community, but when someone did come they turned yet further away,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:43: became more arrogant in the land, and intensified their plotting of evil- the plotting of evil only rebounds on those who plot. Do they expect anything but what happened to earlier people? You will never find any change in God’s practice; you will never find any deviation there.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:44: Have they not travelled in the land and seen how those before them met their end, although they were superior to them in strength? God is not to be frustrated by anything in the heavens or on the earth: He is all knowing, all powerful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.35:45: If God were to punish people [at once] for the wrong they have done, there would not be a single creature left on the surface of the earth. He gives them respite for a stated time and, whenever their time comes, God has been watching His servants.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:3: you [Muhammad] are truly one of the mes-sengers sent
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:5: with a revelation from the Almighty, the Lord of Mercy,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:6: to warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so they are unaware.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:7: The verdict has been passed against most of them, for they refuse to believe.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:8: [It is as if] We had placed [iron] collars around their necks, right up to their chins so that their heads are forced up
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:9: and set barriers before and behind them, blocking their vision: they cannot see.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:10: It is all the same to them whether you warn them or not: they will not believe.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:11: You can warn only those who will follow the Quran and hold the Merciful One in awe, though they cannot see Him: give such people the glad news of forgiveness and a noble reward.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:12: We shall certainly bring the dead back to life, and We record what they send ahead of them as well as what they leave behind: We keep an account of everything in a clear Record.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:13: Give them the example of the people to whose town messengers came.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:14: We sent two messengers but they rejected both. Then We reinforced them with a third. They said, ‘Truly, we are messengers to you,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:15: but they answered, ‘You are only men like ourselves. The Lord of Mercy has sent nothing; you are just lying.'
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:16: They said, ‘Our Lord knows that we have been sent to you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:17: Our duty is only to deliver the message to you,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:18: but they answered, ‘We think you are an evil omen. If you do not stop, we shall stone you, and inflict a painful torment on you.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:19: The messengers said, ‘The evil omen is within yourselves. Why do you take it as an evil omen when you are reminded of the Truth? You are going too far!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:20: Then, from the furthest part of the city, a man came running. He said, ‘My people, follow the messengers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:21: Follow them: they are not asking you to reward them and they are rightly guided.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:22: Why should I not worship the One who created me? It is to Him that you will be returned.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:23: How could I take besides Him any other gods, whose intercession will not help me and who would not be able to save me if the Lord of Mercy wished to harm me?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:24: Then I would clearly be in the wrong.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:25: I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:26: He was told, ‘Enter the Garden,’ so he said, ‘If only my people knew
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:27: how my Lord has forgiven me and set me among the highly honoured.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:28: After him We did not send any army from heaven against his people, nor were We about to:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:29: there was just one blast, and they fell down lifeless.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:30: Alas for human beings! Whenever a messenger comes to them they ridicule him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:31: Do they not see how many generations We have destroyed before them, none of whom will ever come back to them?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:32: [Yet] all of them will be brought before Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:33: There is a sign for them in the lifeless earth: We give it life and We produce grain from it for them to eat;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:34: We have put gardens of date palms and grapes in the earth, and We have made springs of water gush out of it
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:35: so that they could eat its fruit. It was not their own hands that made all this. How can they not give thanks?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:36: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs of things that the earth produces, as well as themselves and other things they do not know about.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:37: The night is also a sign for them: We strip the daylight from it, and- lo and behold!- they are in darkness.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:38: The sun, too, runs its determined course laid down for it by the Almighty, the All Knowing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:39: We have determined phases for the moon until finally it becomes like an old date-stalk.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:40: The sun cannot overtake the moon, nor can the night outrun the day: each floats in [its own] orbit.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:41: Another sign for them is that We carried their seed in the laden Ark,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:42: and We have made similar things for them to ride in.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:43: If We wished, We could drown them, and there would be no one to help them: they could not be saved.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:44: Only by Our mercy could they be reprieved to enjoy life for a while.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:45: Yet when they are told, ‘Beware of what lies before and behind you, so that you may be given mercy,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:46: they ignore every single sign that comes to them from their Lord,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:47: and when they are told, ‘Give to others out of what God has provided for you,’ the disbelievers say to the believers, ‘Why should we feed those that God could feed if He wanted? You must be deeply misguided.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:48: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:49: But all they are waiting for is a single blast that will overtake them while they are still arguing with each other.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:50: They will have no time to make bequests, nor will they have the chance to return to their own people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:51: The Trumpet will be sounded and- lo and behold!- they will rush out to their Lord from their graves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:52: They will say, ‘Alas for us! Who has resurrected us from our resting places?’ [They will be told], ‘This is what the Lord of Mercy promised, and the messengers told the truth.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:53: It was just one single blast and then- lo and behold!- they were all brought before Us.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:54: ‘Today, no soul will be wronged in the least: you will only be repaid for your deeds.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:55: The people of Paradise today are happily occupied-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:56: they and their spouses- seated on couches in the shade.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:57: There they have fruit and whatever they ask for.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:58: “Peace,” a word from the Lord of Mercy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:59: But step aside today, you guilty ones.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:60: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan, for he was your sworn enemy,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:61: but to serve Me? This is the straight path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:62: He has led great numbers of you astray. Did you not use your reason?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:63: So this is the Fire that you were warned against.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:64: Enter it today, because you went on ignoring [my commands].’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:65: On that Day We shall seal up their mouths, but their hands will speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to everything they have done.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:66: If it had been Our will, We could have taken away their sight. They would have struggled to find the way, but how could they have seen it?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:67: If it had been Our will, We could have paralysed them where they stood, so that they could not move forward or backward.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:68: If We extend anyone’s life, We reverse his development. Do they not use their reason?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:69: We have not taught the Prophet poetry, nor could he everhave been a poet.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:70: This is a revelation, an illuminating Quran to warn anyone who is truly alive, so that God’s verdict may be passed against the disbelievers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:71: Can they not see how, among the things made by Our hands, We have created livestock they control,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:72: and made them obedient, so that some can be used for riding, some for food,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:73: some for other benefits, and some for drink? Will they not give thanks?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:74: Yet they have taken other gods besides God to help them,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:75: though these could not do so even if they called a whole army of them together!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:76: So [Prophet] do not be distressed at what they say: We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:77: Can man not see that We created him from a drop of fluid? Yet- lo and behold!- he disputes openly,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:78: producing arguments against Us, forgetting his own creation. He says, ‘Who can give life back to bones after they have decayed?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:79: Say, ‘He who created them in the first place will give them life again: He has full knowledge of every act of creation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:80: It is He who produces fire for you out of the green tree- lo and behold!- and from this you kindle fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:81: Is He who created the heavens and earth not able to create the likes of these people? Of course He is! He is the All Knowing Creator:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:82: when He wills something to be, His way is to say, “Be”- and it is!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.36:83: So glory be to Him in whose Hand lies control over all things. It is to Him that you will all be brought back.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:5: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:6: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:7: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:8: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:9: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:10: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:11: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:13: take no heed when they are warned,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:14: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:15: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:16: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:18: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:19: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:20: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:21: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:22: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:23: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:25: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:26: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:27: and they will turn on one another accusingly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:28: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:29: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:30: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:31: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:32: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:33: On that Day they will all share the torment:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:34: this is how We deal with the guilty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:35: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:36: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:37: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:38: you will taste the painful torment,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:39: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:44: seated on couches, facing one another.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:45: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:46: white, delicious to those who taste it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:48: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:50: They will turn to one another with questions:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:51: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:52: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:53: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:54: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:55: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:56: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:57: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:58: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:60: This truly is the supreme triumph!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:61: Everyone should strive to attain this.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:62: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:63: which we have made a test for the evildoers?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:64: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:65: and its fruits are like devils’ heads.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:66: They will fill their bellies eating from it;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:67: then drink scalding water on top of it;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:68: then return to the blazing Fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:70: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca],
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:71: most men in the past went astray,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:72: even though We sent messengers to warn them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:73: See how those who were warned met their end!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:74: Not so the true servants of God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:75: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:76: We saved him and his people from great distress,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:77: We let his offspring remain on the earth,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:78: We let him be praised by later generations:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:79: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:80: This is how We reward those who do good:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:81: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:83: Abraham was of the same faith:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:84: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:85: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:86: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:87: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:88: then he looked up to the stars.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:90: so [his people] turned away from him and left.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:91: He turned to their gods and said, ‘Do you not eat?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:93: then he turned and struck them with his right arm.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:95: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:96: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:97: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:98: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:99: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:100: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:101: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:102: When the boy was old enough to work with his father, Abraham said, ‘My son, I have seen myself sacrificing you in a dream. What do you think?’ He said, ‘Father, do as you are commanded and, God willing, you will find me steadfast.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:103: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on the side of his face,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:105: you have fulfilled the dream.’ This is how We reward those who do good-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:106: it was a test to prove [their true characters]-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:107: We ransomed his son with a momentous sacrifice,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:108: and We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:110: This is how We reward those who do good:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:111: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:112: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac- a prophet and a righteous man-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:113: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly wronged themselves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:114: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:115: We saved them and their people from great distress;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:116: We helped them, so they were the ones to succeed;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:117: We gave them the Scripture that makes things clear;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:118: We guided them to the right path;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:119: We let them be praised by succeeding generations:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:121: This is how We reward those who do good:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:122: truly they were among Our faithful servants.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:123: Elijah too was one of the messengers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:124: He said to his people, ‘Have you no fear of God?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:125: How can you invoke Baal and forsake the Most Gracious Creator,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:126: God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:127: but they rejected him. They will be brought to punishment as a consequence;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:128: not so the true servants of God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:129: We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:131: This is how We reward those who do good:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:132: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:133: Lot was also one of the messengers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:134: We saved him and all his family-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:135: except for an old woman who stayed behind-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:137: You [people] pass by their ruins morning
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:138: and night: will you not take heed?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:139: Jonah too was one of the messengers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:140: He fled to the overloaded ship.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:141: They cast lots, he suffered defeat,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:142: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:143: If he had not been one of those who glorified God,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:144: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:145: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:146: and made a gourd tree grow above him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:147: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:148: They believed, so We let them live out their lives.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:149: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:150: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:151: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:153: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:154: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:156: Do you perhaps have clear authority?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:157: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:158: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:159: God is far above what they attribute to Him-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:160: the true servants of God do not do such things-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:161: and neither you nor what you worship
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:162: can lure away from God any
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:163: except those who will burn in Hell.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:164: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:168: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:169: we would be true servants of God,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:170: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:171: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:172: it is they who will be helped,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:173: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:174: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:175: Watch them: they will soon see.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:176: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:177: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:178: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:179: Watch them: they will soon see.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:180: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.37:182: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:1: Sad By the Quran with its reminding . . .!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:2: Yet the disbelievers are steeped in arrogance and hostility.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:3: How many generations We have destroyed before them! They all cried out, once it was too late, for escape.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:4: The disbelievers think it strange that a prophet of their own people has come to warn them: they say, ‘He is just a lying sorcerer.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:5: How can he claim that all the gods are but one God? What an astonishing thing [to claim]!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:6: Their leaders depart, saying, ‘Walk away! Stay faithful to your gods! That is what you must do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:7: We did not hear any such claim in the last religion: it is all an invention.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:8: Was the message sent only to him out of all of us?’ In fact they doubt My warning; in fact they have not tasted My punishment yet.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:9: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord’s bounty, the Mighty, the All Giving?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:10: Do they control the heavens and earth and everything between? Let them climb their ropes:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:11: their armed alliance is weak and will be crushed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:12: The people of Noah, Ad, and firmly-supported Pharaoh rejected their prophets before them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:13: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the Forest-Dwellers each formed opposition [against theirs].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:14: They all rejected the mes-sengers and they were deservedly struck by My punishment:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:15: all the disbelievers here are waiting for is a single blast that cannot be postponed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:16: They say, ‘Our Lord! Advance us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:17: Bear their words patiently [Prophet]. Remember Our servant David, a man of strength who always turned to Us:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:18: We made the mountains join him in glorifying Us at sunset and sunrise;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:19: and the birds, too, in flocks, all echoed his praise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:20: We strengthened his kingdom; We gave him wisdom and a decisive way of speaking.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:21: Have you heard the story of the two litigants who climbed into his private quarters?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:22: When they reached David, he took fright, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid. We are two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other: judge between us fairly- do not be unjust- and guide us to the right path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:23: This is my brother. He had ninety-nine ewes and I just the one, and he said, “Let me take charge of her,” and overpowered me with his words.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:24: David said, ‘He has done you wrong by demanding to add your ewe to his flock. Many partners treat each other unfairly. Those who sincerely believe and do good deeds do not do this, but these are very few.’ [Then] David realized that We had been testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness, fell down on his knees, and repented:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:25: We forgave him [his misdeed]. His reward will be nearness to Us, a good place to return to.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:26: ‘David, We have given you mastery over the land. Judge fairly between people. Do not follow your desires, lest they divert you from God’s path: those who wander from His path will have a painful torment because they ignore the Day of Reckoning.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:27: It was not without purpose that We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between. That may be what the disbelievers assume- how they will suffer from the Fire!-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:28: but would We treat those who believe and do good deeds and those who spread corruption on earth as equal? Would We treat those who are aware of God and those who recklessly break all bounds in the same way?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:29: This is a blessed Scripture which We sent down to you [Muhammad], for people to think about its messages, and for those with understanding to take heed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:30: We gave David Solomon. He was an excellent servant who always turned to God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:31: When well-bred light-footed horses were paraded before him near the close of day,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:32: he kept saying, ‘My love of fine things is part of my remembering my Lord!’ until [the horses] disappeared from sight-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:33: ‘Bring them back!’ [he said] and started to stroke their legs and necks.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:34: We certainly tested Solomon, reducing him to a mere skeleton on his throne.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:35: He turned to Us and prayed: ‘Lord forgive me! Grant me such power as no one after me will have- You are the Most Generous Provider.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:36: So We gave him power over the wind, which at his request ran gently wherever he willed,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:37: and the jinn––every kind of builder and diver
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:39: ‘This is Our gift, so give or withhold as you wish without account.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:40: His reward will be nearness to Us, and a good place to return to.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:41: Bring to mind Our servant Job who cried to his Lord, ‘Satan has afflicted me with weariness and suffering.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:42: ‘Stamp your foot! Here is cool water for you to wash in and drink,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:43: and We restored his family to him, with many more like them: a sign of Our mercy and a lesson to all who understand.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:44: ‘Take a small bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [her] with that so as not to break your oath.’ We found him patient in adversity; an excellent servant! He, too, always turned to God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:45: Remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, all men of strength and vision.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:46: We caused them to be devoted to Us through their sincere remembrance of the Final Home:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:47: with Us they will be among the elect, the truly good.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:48: And remember Our servants Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu ’l-Kifl, each of them truly good.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:49: This is a lesson. The devout will have a good place to return to:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:50: Gardens of lasting bliss with gates wide open.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:51: They will be comfortably seated; they will call for abundant fruit and drink;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:52: they will have well-matched [wives] with modest gaze.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:53: ‘This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:54: Our provision for you will never end.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:55: But the evildoers will have the worst place to return to:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:56: Hell to burn in, an evil place to stay-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:57: all this will be theirs: let them taste it- a scalding, dark, foul fluid,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:59: [It will be said], ‘Here is another crowd of people rushing headlong to join you.’ [The response will be], ‘They are not welcome! They will burn in the Fire.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:60: They will say to them, ‘You are not welcome! It was you who brought this on us, an evil place to stay,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:61: adding, ‘Our Lord, give double punishment to those who brought this upon us.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:62: They will say, ‘Why do we not see those we thought were bad
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:63: and took as a laughing-stock? Have our eyes missed them?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:64: This is how it will really be: the inhabitants of the Fire will blame one another in this way.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:65: [Prophet] say, ‘I am only here to give warning. There is no god but God the One, the All Powerful,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:66: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Almighty, the Most Forgiving.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:67: Say, ‘This message is a mighty one,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:69: I have no knowledge of what those on high discuss:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:70: it is only revealed to me that I am here to give clear warning.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:71: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a man from clay.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:72: When I have shaped him and breathed from My Spirit into him, bow down before him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:73: The angels all bowed down together,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:74: but not Iblis, who was too proud. He became a rebel.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:75: God said, ‘Iblis, what prevents you from bowing down to the man I have made with My own hands? Are you too high and mighty?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:76: Iblis said, ‘I am better than him: You made me from fire, and him from clay.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:77: ‘Get out of here! You are rejected:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:78: My rejection will follow you till the Day of Judgement!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:79: but Iblis said, ‘My Lord, grant me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:82: Iblis said, ‘I swear by Your might! I will tempt all
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:84: God said, ‘This is the truth- I speak only the truth-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:85: I will fill Hell with you and all those that follow you.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:86: [Prophet], say, ‘I ask no reward from you for this, nor do I claim to be what I am not:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:87: this is only a warning for all people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.38:88: In time you will certainly come to know its truth.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:1: This Scripture is sent down from God the Mighty, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:2: It is We who sent down the Scripture to you [Prophet] with the Truth, so worship God with your total devotion:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:3: true devotion is due to God alone. [As for] those who choose other protectors beside Him, saying, ‘We only worship them because they bring us nearer to God,’ God Himself will judge between them regarding their differences. God does not guide any ungrateful liar.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:4: God could have chosen any of His creation He willed for offspring, but He is far above this! He is the One, the Almighty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:5: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose; He wraps the night around the day and the day around the night; He has subjected the sun and moon to run their courses for an appointed time; He is truly the Mighty, the Forgiving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:6: He created you all from a single being, from which He made its mate; He gave you four kinds of livestock in pairs; He creates you in your mothers’ wombs, in one stage after another, in threefold depths of darkness. Such is God, your Lord; He holds control, there is no god but Him. How can you turn away?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:7: If you are ungrateful, remember God has no need of you, yet He is not pleased by ingrati-tude in His servants; if you are grateful, He is pleased [to see] it in you. No soul will bear another’s burden. You will return to your Lord in the end and He will inform you of what you have done: He knows well what is in the depths of [your] hearts.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:8: When man suffers some affliction, he prays to his Lord and turns to Him, but once he has been granted a favour from God, he forgets the One he had been praying to and sets up rivals to God, to make others stray from His path. Say, ‘Enjoy your ingratitude for a little while: you will be one of the inhabitants of the Fire.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:9: What about someone who worships devoutly during the night, bowing down, standing in prayer, ever mindful of the life to come, hoping for his Lord’s mercy? Say, ‘How can those who know be equal to those who do not know?’ Only those who have understanding will take heed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:10: Say, ‘[God says], believing servants, be mindful of your Lord! Those who do good in this world will have a good reward- God’s earth is wide––and those who persevere patiently will be given a full and unstinting reward.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:11: Say, ‘I have been commanded to serve God, dedicating my worship entirely to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:12: I have been commanded to be the first to submit.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:13: Say, ‘I fear the torment of a terrible Day if I disobey my Lord.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:14: Say, ‘It is God I serve, dedicating my worship entirely to Him-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:15: you may serve whatever you please beside Him.’ Say, ‘The true losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their people on the Day of Resurrection: that is the most obvious loss.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:16: They will have layers of Fire above them and below.’ This is how God puts fear into His servants: My servants, beware of Me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:17: There is good news for those who shun the worship of false gods and turn to God, so [Prophet] give good news to My servants
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:18: who listen to what is said and follow what is best. These are the ones God has guided; these are the people of understanding.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:19: What about the one who has been sentenced to punishment? Can you [Prophet] rescue those already in the Fire?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:20: But those who are mindful of their Lord will have lofty dwellings built for them, one above the other, graced with flowing streams. This is a promise from God: God does not break His promise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:21: Have you not considered that God sends water down from the sky, guides it along to form springs in the earth, and then, with it, brings forth vegetation of various colours, which later withers, turns yellow before your eyes, and is crumbled to dust at His command? There is truly a reminder in this for those who have understanding.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:22: What about the one whose heart God has opened in devotion to Him, so that he walks in light from his Lord? Alas for those whose hearts harden at the mention of God! They have clearly lost their way.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:23: God has sent down the most beautiful of all teachings: a Scripture that is consistent and draws comparisons; that causes the skins of those in awe of their Lord to shiver. Then their skins and their hearts soften at the mention of God: such is God’s guidance. He guides with it whoever He will; no one can guide those God leaves to stray.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:24: What about the one who will only have his bare face to protect him from his terrible suffering on the Day of Resurrection? It will be said to the evildoers, ‘Taste what you have earned.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:25: Others before them also disbelieved, and the punishment fell on them unawares:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:26: God gave them the punishment of disgrace in this world to taste; the punishment will be even harder in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:27: In this Quran, We have put forward all kinds of illustration for people, so that they may take heed-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:28: an Arabic Quran, free from any distortion- so that people may be mindful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:29: God puts forward this illustration: can a man who has for his masters several partners at odds with each other be considered equal to a man devoted wholly to one master? All praise belongs to God, though most of them do not know.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:30: You [Prophet] will certainly die, and so will they,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:31: and, on the Day of Resurrection, you will dispute with one another in the presence of your Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:32: So who could be more wrong than the person who invents a lie about God and rejects the truth when it comes to him? Is there not ample punishment for the disbelievers in Hell?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:33: It is the one who brings the truth and the one who accepts it as true who are mindful of God:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:34: they will have everything they wish for with their Lord. Such is the reward of those who do good:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:35: God will absolve them even of their worst deeds and will reward them according to their best.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:36: Is God not enough for His servant? Yet they threaten you [Prophet] with those they worship other than Him. If God allows someone to stray he has no one to guide him;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:37: if God guides someone no one can lead him astray. Is God not mighty and capable of retribution?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:38: If you [Prophet] ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and earth?’ they are sure to answer, ‘God,’ so say, ‘Consider those you invoke beside Him: if God wished to harm me, could they undo that harm? If God wished to show me mercy, could they withhold that mercy?’ Say, ‘God is enough for me: all those who trust should put their trust in Him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:39: Say, ‘My people, do whatever is in your power- and so will I. You will find out
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:40: who will suffer humiliation, and on whom a lasting torment will descend.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:41: We have sent the Scripture down to you [Prophet] with the Truth for people. Whoever follows the guidance does so for his own benefit, whoever strays away from it does so at his own peril: you are not in charge of them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:42: God takes the souls of the dead and the souls of the living while they sleep- He keeps hold of those whose death He has ordained and sends the others back until their appointed time- there truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:43: Yet they take intercessors besides God! Say, ‘Even though these have no power or understanding?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:44: Say, ‘All intercession belongs to God alone; He holds control of the heavens and the earth; in the end you will all return to Him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:45: Whenever God is mentioned on His own, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but they rejoice when gods other than Him are mentioned.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:46: Say, ‘God! Creator of the heavens and earth! Knower of all that is hidden and all that is open, You will judge between Your servants regarding their differences.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:47: If the evildoers possessed the earth’s assets twice over they would offer them to ransom themselves from the terrible suffering on the Day of Resurrection: God will show them something they had not reckoned with,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:48: the evil of their deeds will become plain to them, and they will be overwhelmed by that at which they used to laugh.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:49: When man suffers some affliction, he cries out to Us, but when We favour him with Our blessing, he says, ‘All this has been given to me because of my knowledge’- it is only a test, though most of them do not know it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:50: Those who lived before them said the same. What they did was of no use to them;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:51: they suffered its evil effects. Today’s wrongdoers will also suffer the evil effects of their deeds: they will not escape.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:52: Do they not know that God provides abun-dantly for anyone He will and gives sparingly to anyone He will? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:53: Say, ‘[God says], My servants who have harmed yourselves by your own excess, do not despair of God’s mercy. God forgives all sins: He is truly the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:54: Turn to your Lord. Submit to Him before the punishment overtakes you and you can no longer be helped.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:55: Follow the best teaching sent down to you from your Lord, before the punishment suddenly takes you, unawares,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:56: and your soul says, “Woe is me for having neglected what is due to God, and having been one of those who scoffed!”
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:57: Or it says, “If God had guided me, I would have joined the righteous!”
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:58: Or, faced by punishment, it says, “If only I could have another chance, I would join those who do good!”
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:59: No indeed! My messages came to you and you rejected them: you were arrogant and rejected the truth.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:60: On the Day of Resurrection, you [Prophet] will see those who told lies against God, their faces darkened. Is there not ample punishment for the arrogant in Hell?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:61: But God will deliver those who took heed of Him to their place of safety: no harm will touch them, nor will they grieve.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:62: God is the Creator of all things; He has charge of everything;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:63: the keys of the heavens and earth are His. Those who have rejected the revelations of God will be the losers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:64: Say, ‘Do you order me to worship someone other than God, you foolish people?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:65: It has already been revealed to you [Prophet] and to those before you: ‘If you ascribe any partner to God, all your work will come to nothing: you will be one if the losers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:66: No! Worship God alone and be one of those who are grateful to Him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:67: These people have no grasp of God’s true measure. On the Day of Resurrection, the whole earth will be in His grip. The heavens will be rolled up in His right hand- Glory be to Him! He is far above the partners they ascribe to Him!-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:68: the Trumpet will be sounded, and everyone in the heavens and earth will fall down senseless except those God spares. It will be sounded once again and they will be on their feet, looking on.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:69: The earth will shine with the light of its Lord; the Record of Deeds will be laid open; the prophets and witnesses will be brought in. Fair judgement will be given between them: they will not be wronged
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:70: and every soul will be repaid in full for what it has done. He knows best what they do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:71: Those who rejected the Truth will be led to Hell in their throngs. When they arrive, its gates will open and its keepers will say to them, ‘Were you not sent your own messengers to recite the revelations of your Lord to you and warn you that you would meet this Day?’ and they will say, ‘Yes indeed we were.’ But the sentence of punishment will have been passed against those who rejected the truth.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:72: It will be said, ‘Enter the gates of Hell: there you will remain. How evil is the abode of the arrogant!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:73: Those who were mindful of their Lord will be led in throngs to the Garden. When they arrive, they will find its gates wide open, and its keepers will say to them, ‘Peace be upon you. You have been good. Come in: you are here to stay,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:74: and they will say, ‘Praise be to God who has kept His promise to us and given us this land as our own. Now we may live wherever we please in the Garden.’ How excellent is the reward of those who labour!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.39:75: You [Prophet] will see the angels surrounding the Throne, glorifying their Lord with praise. True judgement will have been passed between them, and it will be said, ‘Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:2: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Almighty, the All Knowing,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:3: Forgiver of sins and Accepter of repentance, severe in punishment, infinite in bounty. There is no god but Him; to Him is the ultimate return.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:4: It is only the disbelievers who dispute God’s revelations. [Prophet], do not be dazzled by their movements back and forth across the land.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:5: Before them the people of Noah rejected the truth and so did those who formed opposition after them: every community schemed to destroy its messenger and strove to refute truth with falsehood; but it was I who destroyed them. How terrible My punishment was!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:6: In this way your Lord’s sentence was passed against the disbelievers that they would be the inhabitants of the Fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:7: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those who surround it celebrate the praise of their Lord and have faith in Him. They beg forgiveness for the believers: ‘Our Lord, You embrace all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who turn to You and follow Your path. Save them from the pains of Hell
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:8: and admit them, Lord, to the lasting Gardens You have promised to them, together with their righteous ancestors, spouses, and offspring: You alone are the Almighty, the All Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:9: Protect them from all evil deeds: those You protect on that Day from [the punishment for] evil deeds will receive Your mercy- that is the supreme triumph.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:10: But those who disbelieved will be told, ‘When you were called to the faith and rejected it, God’s disgust with you was even greater then than the self-disgust you feel [today].’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:11: They will say, ‘Our Lord, twice You have caused us to be lifeless and twice You have brought us to life. Now we recognize our sins. Is there any way out?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:12: [They will be told], ‘This is all because when God alone was invoked you rejected this, yet when others were associated with Him you believed [in them].’ Judgement belongs to God the Most High, the Most Great.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:13: It is He who shows you [people] His signs and sends water down from the sky to sustain you, though only those who turn to God will take heed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:14: So call upon God and dedicate your religion to Him alone, however hateful this may be to the disbelievers:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:15: He is exalted in rank, the Lord of the Throne. He sends revelations with His teachings to whichever of His servants He will, in order to warn of the Day of Meeting,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:16: the Day when they will come out and nothing about them will be concealed from God. ‘Who has control today?’ ‘God, the One, the All Powerful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:17: Today each soul will be rewarded for whatever it has done; today no injustice will be done. God is swift in reckoning.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:18: Warn them [Prophet] of the ever-approaching Day, when hearts are at throats, choking them. The evildoer will have no friends, nor any intercessor to be heeded.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:19: God is aware of the most furtive of glances, and of all that hearts conceal:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:20: God will judge with truth, while those they invoke besides Him will not judge at all. God is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:21: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how those who lived before them met their end? They were stronger than them and made a more impressive mark on the land, yet God destroyed them for their sins- they had no one to defend them against Him-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:22: because messengers repeatedly came to them with clear signs and still they rejected them. God destroyed them: He is truly full of strength, severe in punishment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:23: We sent Moses with Our signs and clear authority
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:24: to Pharaoh, Haman, and Korah and they said, ‘Sorcerer! Liar!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:25: When he brought the truth to them from Us, they said, ‘Kill the sons of those who believe with him; spare only their women’- the scheming of those who reject the truth can only go wrong-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:26: and Pharaoh said, ‘Leave me to kill Moses- let him call upon his Lord!- for I fear he may cause you to change your religion, or spread disorder in the land.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:27: Moses said, ‘I seek refuge with my Lord and yours from every tyrant who refuses to believe in the Day of Reckoning.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:28: A secret believer from Pharaoh’s family said, ‘How can you kill a man just for saying, “My Lord is God”? He has brought you clear signs from your Lord- if he is a liar, on his own head be it- and if he is truthful, then at least some of what he has threatened will happen to you. God does not guide any rebellious, outrageous liar.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:29: My people, as masters in the land you have the power today, but who will help us against God’s might if it comes upon us?’ But Pharaoh said, ‘I have told you what I think; I am guiding you along the right path.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:30: The believer said, ‘My people, I fear your fate will be the fate of those others who opposed [their prophets]:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:31: the fate of the people of Noah, Ad, Thamud, and those who came after them- God never wills injustice on His creatures.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:32: My people, I fear for you on the Day you will cry out to one another,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:33: the Day you will turn tail and flee with no one to defend you from God! Whoever God leaves to stray will have no one to guide him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:34: Joseph came to you before with clear signs, but you never ceased to doubt the message he brought you. When he died, you said, “God will not send another messenger.”’ In this way God leaves the doubting rebels to stray-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:35: those who dispute God’s messages, with no authority given to them, are doing something that is loathed by God and by those who believe. In this way God seals up the heart of every arrogant tyrant.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:36: Pharaoh said, ‘Haman, build me a tall tower so that I may reach the ropes that lead
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:37: to the heavens to look for this God of Moses. I am convinced that he is lying.’ In this way the evil of Pharaoh’s deed was made alluring to him and he was barred from the right path- his scheming led only to ruin.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:38: The believer said, ‘My people, follow me! I will guide you to the right path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:39: My people, the life of this world is only a brief enjoyment; it is the Hereafter that is the lasting home.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:40: Whoever does evil will be repaid with its like; whoever does good and believes, be it a man or a woman, will enter Paradise and be provided for without measure.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:41: My people, why do I call you to salvation when you call me to the Fire?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:42: You call me to disbelieve in God and to associate with Him things of which I have no knowledge; I call you to the Mighty, the Forgiving One.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:43: There is no doubt that what you call me to serve is not fit to be invoked either in this world or the Hereafter: our return is to God alone, and it will be the rebels who will inhabit the Fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:44: [One Day] you will remember what I am saying to you now, so I commit my case to God: God is well aware of His servants.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:45: So God saved him from the harm they planned. A terrible punishment engulfed Pharaoh’s people;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:46: they will be brought before the Fire morning and evening. On the Day the Hour comes, it will be said, ‘Throw Pharaoh’s people into the worst torment.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:47: In the Fire they will quarrel with one another: the weak will say to the haughty, ‘We were your followers, so can you now relieve us from some share of the Fire?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:48: but they will say, ‘We are all in this together. God has judged between His creatures.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:49: Those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, ‘Ask your Lord to lessen our suffering for one day,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:50: but they will say, ‘Did your messengers not come to you with clear evidence of the truth?’ They will say, ‘Yes they did,’ and the keeper will say, ‘You can plead, then, but the pleas of disbelievers will always be in vain.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:51: We support Our messengers and the believers, in the present life and on the Day when witnesses arise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:52: On the Day when excuses will not profit the evildoers, their fate will be rejection and they will have the worst of homes.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:53: We gave Moses guidance and passed down the Scripture to the Children of Israel,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:54: as a guide and a reminder to people of understanding.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:55: So be patient, Prophet, for what God has promised is sure to come. Ask forgiveness for your sins; praise your Lord morning and evening.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:56: As for those who, with no authority to do so, dispute God’s messages, there is nothing in their hearts but a thirst for a greatness they will never attain. Seek refuge in God, for He is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:57: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater by far than the creation of mankind, though most people do not know it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:58: The blind and the sighted are not equal, just as those who believe and do good works and those who do evil are not equal: how seldom you reflect!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:59: The Final Hour is sure to come, without doubt, but most people do not believe.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:60: Your Lord says, ‘Call on Me and I will answer you; those who are too proud to serve Me will enter Hell humiliated.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:61: It is God who has given you the night in which to rest and the day in which to see. God is truly bountiful to people, but most people do not give thanks.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:62: Such is God your Lord, the Creator of all things: there is no god but Him. How can you be so deluded?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:63: This is how deluded those who deny God’s messages are.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:64: It is God who has given you the earth for a dwelling place and the heavens for a canopy. He shaped you, formed you well, and provided you with good things. Such is God your Lord, so glory be to Him, the Lord of the Worlds.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.40:65: He is the Living One and there is no god but Him, so call on Him, and dedicate your religion entirely to Him. Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
