M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:22: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:23: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:24: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:25: They turn to one another and say,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:26: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:27: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:28: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:29: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:30: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:31: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:32: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:33: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:34: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:35: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:36: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:37: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:38: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:39: Does God have daughters while you have sons?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:40: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:41: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:42: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:43: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:44: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:45: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:46: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:47: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:48: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.52:49: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:1: By the star when it sets!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:2: Your companion has not strayed; he is not deluded;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:3: he does not speak from his own desire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:4: The Quran is nothing less than a revelation that is sent to him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:5: It was taught to him by [an angel] with mighty powers
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:9: until he was two bow-lengths away or even closer––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:10: and revealed to God’s servant what He revealed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:11: [The Prophet’s] own heart did not distort what he saw.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:12: Are you going to dispute with him what he saw with his own eyes?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:13: A second time he saw him:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:14: by the lote tree beyond which none may pass
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:16: when the tree was covered in nameless [splendour].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:17: His sight never wavered, nor was it too bold,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:18: and he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:21: are you to have the male and He the female?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:22: That would be a most unjust distribution!––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:23: these are nothing but names you have invented yourselves, you and your forefathers. God has sent no authority for them. These people merely follow guesswork and the whims of their souls, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:24: Is man to have everything he wishes for,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:25: when the present life and the life to come belong only to God?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:26: There are many angels in heaven whose intercession will be of no use until God gives permission to those He will, whose words He will accept.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:27: Those who deny the life to come give the angels female names.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:28: They have no knowledge to base this on: they merely follow guesswork. Guesswork is of no value against the Truth.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:29: So [Prophet] ignore those who turn away from Our revelation, who want only the life of this world.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:30: Their knowledge does not go beyond that. Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who follows guidance.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:31: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and reward, with what is best, those who do good.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:32: As for those who avoid grave sins and foul acts, though they may commit small sins, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He has been aware of you from the time He produced you from the earth and from your hiding places in your mothers’ wombs, so do not assert your own goodness:He knows best who is mindful of Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:33: [Prophet], consider that man who turned away:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:34: he only gave a little and then he stopped.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:35: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen? Can he see [the Hereafter]?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:36: Has he not been told what was written in the Scriptures of Moses
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:37: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:38: that no soul shall bear the burden of another;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:39: that man will only have what he has worked towards;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:40: that his labour will be seen
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:41: and that in the end he will be repaid in full for it;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:42: that the final goal is your Lord;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:43: that it is He who makes people laugh and weep;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:44: that it is He who gives death and life;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:45: that He Himself created the two sexes, male and female,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:46: from an ejected drop of sperm;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:47: that He will undertake the second Creation;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:48: that it is He who gives wealth and possessions;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:49: that He is the Lord of Sirius;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:50: that it was He who destroyed, in their entirety, ancient 'Ad
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:52: and before them the people of Noah who were even more unjust and insolent;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:53: that it was He who brought down the ruined cities
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:54: and enveloped them in the punishment He ordained for them?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:55: Which then of your Lord’s blessings do you deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:56: This is a warning just like the warnings sent in former times.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:58: and only God can disclose it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:60: Why do you laugh instead of weeping?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:61: Why do you pay no heed?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.53:62: Bow down before God and worship.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:1: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:2: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:3: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:4: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:5: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:6: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:7: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:8: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:9: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:10: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:11: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:12: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:13: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:14: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:15: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:16: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:17: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:18: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:19: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:20: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:21: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:22: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:23: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:24: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:25: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:26: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:27: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:28: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:29: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:30: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:31: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:32: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:33: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:34: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:35: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:36: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:37: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:38: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:39: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:40: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:41: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:42: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:43: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:44: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:45: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:46: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:47: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:48: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:49: We have created all things in due measure;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:50: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:51: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:52: Everything they do is noted in their records:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:53: every action, great or small, is recorded.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:54: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.54:55: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:1: It is the Lord of Mercy
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:5: The sun and the moon follow their calculated courses;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:6: the plants and the trees submit to His designs;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:7: He has raised up the sky. He has set the balance
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:8: so that you may not exceed in the balance:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:9: weigh with justice and do not fall short in the balance.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:10: He set down the Earth for His creatures,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:11: with its fruits, its palm trees with sheathed clusters,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:12: its husked grain, its fragrant plants.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:13: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:14: He created mankind out of dried clay, like pottery,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:15: the jinn out of smokeless fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:16: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:17: He is Lord of the two risings and Lord of the two settings.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:18: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:19: He released the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water. They meet,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:20: yet there is a barrier between them they do not cross.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:21: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:22: Pearls come forth from them: large ones, and small, brilliant ones.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:23: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:24: His are the moving ships that float, high as mountains, on the sea.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:25: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:27: all that remains is the Face of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:28: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:29: Everyone in heaven and earth entreats Him; every day He is at work.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:30: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:31: We shall attend to you two huge armies [of jinn and mankind].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:32: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:33: Jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of heaven and earth, then do so: you will not pass without Our authority.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:34: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:35: A flash of fire and smoke will be released upon you and no one will come to your aid.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:36: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:37: When the sky is torn apart and turns crimson, like red hide.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:38: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:39: On that Day neither mankind nor jinn will be asked about their sins.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:40: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:41: The guilty will be known by their mark and will be seized by their foreheads and their feet.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:42: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:43: This is the Hell the guilty deny,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:44: but they will go round between its flames and scalding water.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:45: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:46: For those who fear [the time when they will] stand before their Lord there are two gardens.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:47: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:49: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:50: With a pair of flowing springs.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:51: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:52: With every kind of fruit in pairs.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:53: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:54: They will sit on couches upholstered with brocade, the fruit of both gardens within easy reach.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:55: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:56: There will be maidens restraining their glances, untouched beforehand by man or jinn.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:57: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:59: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:60: Shall the reward of good be anything but good?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:61: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:62: There are two other gardens below these two.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:63: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:65: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:66: With a pair of gushing springs.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:67: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:68: With fruits- date palms and pomegranate trees.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:69: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:71: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:73: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:74: Untouched beforehand by man or jinn.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:75: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:76: They will all sit on green cushions and fine carpets.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:77: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.55:78: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:1: When that which is coming arrives,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:2: no one will be able to deny it has come,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:4: When the earth is shaken violently
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:5: and the mountains are ground to powder
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:7: then you will be sorted into three classes.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:8: Those on the Right––what people they are!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:9: Those on the Left––what people they are!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:11: For these will be the ones brought nearest to God
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:14: and a few from later generations.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:16: they will sit facing each other;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:17: everlasting youths will go round among them
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:18: with glasses, flagons, and cups of a pure drink
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:19: that causes no headache or intoxication;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:20: [there will be] any fruit they choose;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:21: the meat of any bird they like;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:24: a reward for what they used to do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:25: They will hear no idle or sinful talk there,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:27: Those on the Right, what people they are!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:28: They will dwell amid thornless lote trees
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:41: But those on the Left, what people they are!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:42: They will dwell amid scorching wind and scalding water
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:43: in the shadow of black smoke,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:47: always saying, ‘What? When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:50: will all be gathered on a predetermined Day
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:51: and you who have gone astray and denied the truth
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:52: will eat from the bitter tree of Zaqqum,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:56: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgement.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:57: It was We who created you: will you not believe?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:59: do you create it yourselves or are We the Creator?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:60: We ordained death to be among you. Nothing could stop Us
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:61: if We intended to change you and recreate you in a way unknown to you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:62: You have learned how you were first created: will you not reflect?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:63: Consider the seeds you sow in the ground-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:64: is it you who make them grow or We?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:65: If We wished, We could turn your harvest into chaff and leave you to wail,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:69: was it you who brought it down from the rain-cloud or We?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:70: If We wanted, We could make it bitter: will you not be thankful?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:72: is it you who make the wood for it grow or We?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:73: We made it a reminder, and useful to those who kindle it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:74: so [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:75: I swear by the positions of the stars-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:76: a mighty oath, if you only knew-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:77: that this is truly a noble Quran,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:79: that only the purified can touch,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:80: sent down from the Lord of all being.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:81: How can you scorn this statement?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:82: And how, in return for the livelihood you are given, can you deny it?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:83: When the soul of a dying man comes up to his throat
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:85: We are nearer to him than you, though you do not see Us-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:86: why, if you are not to be judged,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:87: do you not restore his soul to him, if what you say is true?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:88: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to God,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:89: he will have rest, ease, and a Garden of Bliss;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:90: if he is one of those on the Right,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:91: [he will hear], ‘Peace be on you,’ from his companions on the Right;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:92: but if he is one of those who denied the truth and went astray,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:93: he will be welcomed with scalding water.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.56:96: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Supreme.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:1: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:2: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him; He gives life and death; He has power over all things.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:3: He is the First and the Last; the Outer and the Inner; He has knowledge of all things.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:4: It was He who created the heavens and earth in six Days and then established Himself on the throne. He knows what enters the earth and what comes out of it; what descends from the sky and what ascends to it. He is with you wherever you are; He sees all that you do;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:5: control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him. Everything is brought back to God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:6: He makes night merge into day and day into night. He knows what is in every heart.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:7: Believe in God and His Messenger, and give out of what He has made pass down to you: those of you who believe and give will have a great reward.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:8: Why should you not believe in God when the Mes-senger calls you to believe in your Lord, and He has already made a pledge with you, if you have faith?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:9: It is He who has sent down clear revelations to His Servant, so that He may bring you from the depths of darkness into light; God is truly kind and merciful to you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:10: Why should you not give for God’s cause when God alone will inherit what is in the heavens and earth? Those who gave and fought before the triumph are not like others: they are greater in rank than those who gave and fought afterwards. But God has promised a good reward to all of them: God is fully aware of all that you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:11: Who will make God a good loan? He will double it for him and reward him generously.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:12: On the Day when you [Prophet] see the believers, both men and women, with their light streaming out ahead of them and to their right, [they will be told], ‘The good news for you today is that there are Gardens graced with flowing streams where you will stay: that is truly the supreme triumph!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:13: On the same Day, the hypocrites, both men and women, will say to the believers, ‘Wait for us! Let us have some of your light!’ They will be told, ‘Go back and look for a light.’ A wall with a door will be erected between them: inside it lies mercy, outside lies torment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:14: The hypocrites will call out to the believers, ‘Were we not with you?’ They will reply, ‘Yes. But you allowed yourselves to be tempted, you were hesitant, doubtful, deceived by false hopes until God’s command came- the Deceiver tricked you about God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:15: Today no ransom will be accepted from you or from the disbelievers: your home is the Fire- that is where you belong––a miserable destination!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:16: Is it not time for believers to humble their hearts to the remembrance of God and the Truth that has been revealed, and not to be like those who received the Scripture before them, whose time was extended but whose hearts hardened and many of whom were lawbreakers?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:17: Remember that God revives the earth after it dies; We have made Our revelation clear to you so that you may use your reason.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:18: Charitable men and women who make a good loan to God will have it doubled and have a generous reward.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:19: Those who believe in God and His messengers are the truthful ones who will bear witness before their Lord: they will have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations are the inhabitants of Hell.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:20: Bear in mind that the present life is just a game, a diversion, an attraction, a cause of boasting among you, of rivalry in wealth and children. It is like plants that spring up after the rain: their growth at first delights the sowers, but then you see them wither away, turn yellow, and become stubble. There is terrible punishment in the next life as well as forgiveness and approval from God; the life of this world is only an illusory pleasure.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:21: So race for your Lord’s forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers: that is God’s bounty, which He bestows on whoever He pleases. God’s bounty is infinite.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:22: No misfortune can happen, either in the earth or in yourselves, that was not set down in writing before We brought it into being- that is easy for God-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:23: so you need not grieve for what you miss or gloat over what you gain. God does not love the conceited, the boastful,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:24: those who are miserly, and who tell other people to be miserly. If anyone turns away, remember that God is self-sufficient and worthy of praise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:25: We sent Our messengers with clear signs, the Scripture and the Balance, so that people could uphold justice: We also sent iron, with its mighty strength and many uses for mankind, so that God could mark out those who would help Him and His messengers though they cannot see Him. Truly God is powerful, almighty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:26: We sent Noah and Abraham, and gave prophethood and scripture to their offspring: among them there were some who were rightly guided, but many were lawbreakers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:27: We sent other messengers to follow in their footsteps. After those We sent Jesus, son of Mary: We gave him the Gospel and put compassion and mercy into the hearts of his followers. But monasticism was something they invented- We did not ordain it for them- only to seek God’s pleasure, and even so, they did not observe it properly. So We gave a reward to those of them who believed, but many of them were lawbreakers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:28: Believers, be mindful of God and have faith in His Messenger: He will give you a double share of His mercy; He will provide a light to help you walk; He will forgive you- God is most forgiving, most merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.57:29: The People of the Book should know that they have no power over any of God’s grace and that grace is in the hand of God alone: He gives it to whoever He will. God’s grace is truly immense.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:1: God has heard the words of the woman who disputed with you [Prophet] about her husband and complained to God: God has heard what you both had to say. He is all hearing, all seeing.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:2: Even if any of you say to their wives, ‘You are to me like my mother’s back,’they are not their mothers; their only mothers are those who gave birth to them. What they say is certainly blameworthy and false, but God is pardoning and forgiving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:3: Those of you who say such a thing to their wives, then go back on what they have said, must free a slave before the couple may touch one another again––this is what you are commanded to do, and God is fully aware of what you do––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:4: but anyone who does not have the means should fast continuously for two months before they touch each other, and anyone unable to do this should feed sixty needy people. This is so that you may [truly] have faith in God and His Messenger. These are the bounds set by God: grievous torment awaits those who ignore them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:5: Those who oppose God and His Messenger will be brought low, like those before them: We have revealed clear messages, and humiliating torment awaits those who ignore them,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:6: on the Day when God will raise everyone and make them aware of what they have done. God has taken account of it all, though they may have forgotten: He witnesses everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:7: Do you not see [Prophet] that God knows everything in the heavens and earth? There is no secret conversation between three people where He is not the fourth, nor between five where He is not the sixth, nor between less or more than that without Him being with them, wherever they may be. On the Day of Resurrection, He will show them what they have done: God truly has full knowledge of everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:8: Have you not seen how those who have been forbidden to hold secret conversations go back afterwards and hold them, and conspire with one another in what is sinful, hostile, and disobedient to the Messenger? When they come to you they greet you with words God has never used to greet you, and say inwardly, ‘Why does God not punish us for what we say?’ Hell will be punishment enough for them: they will burn there- an evil destination.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:9: You who believe, when you converse in secret, do not do so in a way that is sinful, hostile, and disobedient to the Messenger, but in a way that is good and mindful [of God]. Be mindful of God, to whom you will all be gathered.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:10: [Any other kind of] secret conversation is the work of Satan, designed to cause trouble to the believers, though it cannot harm them in the least unless God permits it. Let the believers put their trust in God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:11: You who believe, if you are told to make room for one another in your assemblies, then do so, and God will make room for you, and if you are told to rise up, do so: God will raise up, by many degrees, those of you who believe and those who have been given knowledge: He is fully aware of what you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:12: You who believe, when you come to speak privately with the Messenger, offer something in charity before your conversation: that is better for you and purer. If you do not have the means, God is most forgiving and merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:13: Were you afraid to give charity before consulting the Prophet? Since you did not give charity, and God has relented towards you, you should [at least] observe your prayers, pay the prescribed alms, and obey God and His Messenger: God is well aware of your actions.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:14: Have you not seen [Prophet] those who give their loyalty to people with whom God is angry? They are neither with you nor with them, and knowingly swear to lies.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:15: God has prepared a severe torment for them: what they do is truly evil.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:16: They have used their oaths to cover up [their false deeds], and barred others from the path of God. A humiliating torment awaits them-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:17: neither their wealth nor their children will be of any use to them against God- they will be the inhabitants of Hell, where they will remain.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:18: On the Day God raises them all from the dead, they will swear before Him as they swear before you now, thinking that it will help them. What liars they are!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:19: Satan has gained control over them and made them forget God. They are on Satan’s side, and Satan’s side will be the losers:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:20: those who oppose God and His Messenger will be among the most humiliated.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:21: God has written, ‘I shall most certainly win, I and My messengers.’ God is powerful and almighty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.58:22: [Prophet], you will not find people who truly believe in God and the Last Day giving their loyalty to those who oppose God and His Messenger, even though they may be their fathers, sons, brothers, or other relations: these are the people in whose hearts God has inscribed faith, and whom He has strengthened with His spirit. He will let them enter Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay: God is well pleased with them, and they with Him. They are on God’s side, and God’s side will be the one to prosper.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:1: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God; He is the Almighty, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:2: It was He who drove those of the People of the Book who broke faith out from their homes at the first gathering of forces––you [believers] never thought they would go, and they themselves thought their fortifications would protect them against God. God came up on them from where they least expected and put panic into their hearts: their homes were destroyed by their own hands, and the hands of the believers. Learn from this, all of you with insight!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:3: If God had not decreed exile for them, He would have tormented them [even more severely] in this world. In the Hereafter they will have the torment of the Fire
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:4: because they set themselves against God and His Messenger: God is stern in punishment towards anyone who sets himself against Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:5: Whatever you [believers] may have done to [their] palm trees–– cutting them down or leaving them standing on their roots––was done by God’s leave, so that He might disgrace those who defied Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:6: You [believers] did not have to spur on your horses or your camels for whatever gains God turned over to His Messenger from them. God gives authority to His messengers over whoever He will: God has power over all things.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:7: Whatever gains God has turned over to His Messenger from the inhabitants of the villages belong to God, the Messenger, kinsfolk, orphans, the needy, the traveller in need- this is so that they do not just circulate among those of you who are rich––so accept whatever the Messenger gives you, and abstain from whatever he forbids you. Be mindful of God: God is severe in punishment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:8: The poor emigrants who were driven from their homes and possessions, who seek God’s favour and approval, those who help God and His Messenger- these are the ones who are true- [shall have a share].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:9: Those who were already firmly established in their homes [in Medina], and firmly rooted in faith, show love for those who migrated to them for refuge and harbour no desire in their hearts for what has been given to them. They give them preference over themselves, even if they too are poor: those who are saved from their own souls’ greed are truly successful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:10: Those who came after them say, ‘Lord, forgive us our sins and the sins of our brothers who believed before us, and leave no malice in our hearts towards those who believe. Lord, You are truly compassionate and merciful.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:11: Have you [Prophet] considered the hypocrites who say to their fellows, the faithless among the People of the Book, ‘If you are driven out, we shall go with you- we would never listen to anyone who sought to harm you- and if you are attacked, we shall certainly come to your aid’? God bears witness that they are in fact liars:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:12: if they are driven out, they will never leave with them; if they are attacked, they will never help them. Even if they did come to their aid, they would soon turn tail and flee- in the end they would have no help.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:13: Fear of you [believers] is more intense in their hearts than fear of God because they are people devoid of understanding.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:14: Even united they would never fight you, except from within fortified strongholds or behind high walls. There is much hostility between them: you think they are united but their hearts are divided because they are people devoid of reason.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:15: Like those who went just before them, they have tasted the result of their conduct and a painful punishment awaits them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:16: Like Satan, who says to man, ‘Do not believe!’ but when man disbelieves, says, ‘I disown you; I fear God, the Lord of the Worlds,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:17: both will end up in the Fire, there to remain. That is the reward of evildoers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:18: You who believe! Be mindful of God, and let every soul consider carefully what it sends ahead for tomorrow; be mindful of God, for God is well aware of everything you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:19: Do not be like those who forget God, so God causes them to forget their own souls: they are the rebellious ones-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:20: there is no comparison between the inhabitants of the Fire and the inhabitants of Paradise- and the inhabitants of Paradise are the successful ones.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:21: If We had sent this Quran down to a mountain, you [Prophet] would have seen it humbled and split apart in its awe of God: We offer people such illustrations so that they may reflect.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:22: He is God: there is no god other than Him. It is He who knows what is hidden as well as what is in the open, He is the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:23: He is God: there is no god other than Him, the Controller, the Holy One, Source of Peace, Granter of Security, Guardian over all, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Truly Great; God is far above anything they consider to be His partner.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.59:24: He is God: the Creator, the Originator, the Shaper. The best names belong to Him. Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies Him: He is the Almighty, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:1: You who believe, do not take My enemies and yours as your allies, showing them friendship when they have rejected the truth you have received, and have driven you and the Messenger out simply because you believe in God, your Lord––not if you truly emigrated in order to strive for My cause and seek My good pleasure. You secretly show them friendship––I know all you conceal and all you reveal–– but any of you who do this are straying from the right path.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:2: If they gain the upper hand over you, they will revert to being your enemies and stretch out their hands and tongues to harm you; it is their dearest wish that you may renounce your faith.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:3: Neither your kinsfolk nor your children will be any use to you on the Day of Resurrection: He will separate you out. God sees everything you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:4: You have a good example in Abraham and his companions, when they said to their people, ‘We disown you and what you worship besides God! We renounce you! Until you believe in God alone, the enmity and hatred that has arisen between us will endure!’––except when Abraham said to his father, ‘I will pray for forgiveness for you though I cannot protect you from God’––[they prayed] ‘Lord, we have put our trust in You; we turn to You; You are our final destination.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:5: Lord, do not expose us to mistreatment [at the hands of] the disbelievers. Forgive us, Lord, for You are the Almighty, the All Wise.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:6: Truly, they are a good example for you [believers] to follow, a good example for those who fear God and the Last Day. If anyone turns away, [remember] God is self-sufficing and worthy of all praise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:7: God may still bring about affection between you and your present enemies- God is all powerful, God is most forgiving and merciful-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:8: and He does not forbid you to deal kindly and justly with anyone who has not fought you for your faith or driven you out of your homes: God loves the just.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:9: But God forbids you to take as allies those who have fought against you for your faith, driven you out of your homes, and helped others to drive you out: any of you who take them as allies will truly be wrongdoers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:10: You who believe, test the believing women when they come to you as emigrants- God knows best about their faith- and if you are sure of their belief, do not send them back to the disbelievers: they are not lawful wives for them, nor are the disbelievers their lawful husbands. Give the disbelievers whatever bride-gifts they have paid- if you choose to marry them, there is no blame on you once you have paid their bride-gifts- and do not yourselves hold on to marriage ties with disbelieving women. Ask for repayment of the bride-gifts you have paid, and let the disbelievers do the same. This is God’s judgement: He judges between you, God is all knowing and wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:11: If any of you have wives who leave you for the disbelievers, and if your community subsequently acquires [gains] from them, then pay those whose wives have deserted them the equivalent of whatever bride-gift they paid. Be mindful of God, in whom you believe.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:12: Prophet, when believing women come and pledge to you that they will not ascribe any partner to God, nor steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor lie about who has fathered their children, nor disobey you in any righteous thing, then you should accept their pledge of allegiance and pray to God to forgive them: God is most forgiving and merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.60:13: You who believe, do not take as allies those with whom God is angry: they despair of the life to come as the disbelievers despair of those buried in their graves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:1: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:2: You who believe, why do you say things and then do not do them?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:3: It is most hateful to God that you say things and then do not do them;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:4: God truly loves those who fight in solid lines for His cause, like a well-compacted wall.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:5: Moses said to his people, ‘My people, why do you hurt me when you know that I am sent to you by God?’ When they went astray, God left their hearts to stray: God does not guide rebellious people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:6: Jesus, son of Mary, said, ‘Children of Israel, I am sent to you by God, confirming the Torah that came before me and bringing good news of a messenger to follow me whose name will be Ahmad.’ Yet when he came to them with clear signs, they said, ‘This is obviously sorcery.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:7: Who could be more wrong than someone who invents lies against God when called to submit to Him? God does not guide the wrongdoers:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:8: they wish to put His light out with their mouths. But He will perfect His light, even though the disbelievers hate it;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:9: it is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to show that it is above all [other] religions, even though the idolaters hate it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:10: You who believe, shall I show you a bargain that will save you from painful torment?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:11: Have faith in God and His Messenger and struggle for His cause with your possessions and your persons––that is better for you, if only you knew-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:12: and He will forgive your sins, admit you into Gardens graced with flowing streams, into pleasant dwellings in the Gardens of Eternity. That is the supreme triumph.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:13: And He will give you something else that will really please you: His help and an imminent breakthrough. [Prophet], give the faithful the good news.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.61:14: You who believe, be God’s helpers. As Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples, ‘Who will come with me to help God?’ The disciples said, ‘We shall be God’s helpers.’ Some of the Children of Israel believed and some disbelieved: We supported the believers against their enemy and they were the ones who came out on top.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:1: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God, the Controller, the Holy One, the Almighty, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:2: It is He who raised a mes-senger, among the people who had no Scripture, to recite His revelations to them, to make them grow spiritually and teach them the Scripture and wisdom––before that they were clearly astray––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:3: to them and others yet to join them. He is the Almighty, the Wise:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:4: such is God’s favour that He grants it to whoever He will; God’s favour is immense.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:5: Those who have been charged to obey the Torah, but do not do so, are like asses carrying books: how base such people are who disobey God’s revelations! God does not guide people who do wrong.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:6: Say [Prophet], ‘You who follow the Jewish faith, if you truly claim that out of all people you alone are friends of God, then you should be hoping for death.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:7: But because of what they have stored up for themselves with their own hands they would never hope for death––God knows the wrongdoers very well––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:8: so say, ‘The death you run away from will come to meet you and you will be returned to the One who knows the unseen as well as the seen: He will tell you everything you have done.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:9: Believers! When the call to prayer is made on the day of congregation, hurry towards the reminder of God and leave off your trading––that is better for you, if only you knew––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:10: then when the prayer has ended, disperse in the land and seek out God’s bounty. Remember God often so that you may prosper.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.62:11: Yet they scatter towards trade or entertainment whenever they observe it, and leave you [Prophet] standing there. Say, ‘God’s gift is better than any entertainment or trade: God is the best provider.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:1: When the hypocrites come to you [Prophet], they say, ‘We bear witness that you are the Messenger of God.’ God knows that you truly are His Messenger and He bears witness that the hypocrites are liars––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:2: they use their oaths as a cover and so bar others from God’s way: what they have been doing is truly evil––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:3: because they professed faith and then rejected it, so their hearts have been sealed and they do not understand.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:4: When you see them [Prophet], their outward appearance pleases you; when they speak, you listen to what they say. But they are like propped-up tim-bers––they think every cry they hear is against them––and they are the enemy. Beware of them. May God confound them! How devious they are!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:5: They turn their heads away in disdain when they are told, ‘Come, so that the Messenger of God may ask forgiveness for you,’ and you see them walking away arrogantly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:6: It makes no difference whether you ask forgiveness for them or not, God will not forgive them: God does not guide such treacherous people.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:7: They are the ones who say, ‘Give nothing to those who follow God’s Messenger, until they abandon him’, but to God belong the treasures of the heavens and earth, though the hypocrites do not understand this.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:8: They say, ‘Once we return to Medina the powerful will drive out the weak,’ but power belongs to God, to His Messenger, and to the believers, though the hypocrites do not know this.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:9: Believers, do not let your wealth and your children distract you from remembering God: those who do so will be the ones who lose.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:10: Give out of what We have provided for you, before death comes to one of you and he says, ‘My Lord, if You would only reprieve me for a little while, I would give in charity and become one of the righteous.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.63:11: God does not reprieve a soul when its turn comes: God is fully aware of what you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:1: Everything that is in the heavens and earth glorifies God; all control and all praise belong to Him; He has power over everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:2: It is He who created you, yet some of you disbelieve and some believe: God sees everything you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:3: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose; He formed you and made your forms good: you will all return to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:4: He knows what is in the heavens and earth; He knows what you conceal and what you reveal; God knows very well the secrets of every heart.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:5: [Disbelievers], have you not heard about those who disbelieved before you? They tasted the evil consequences of their conduct, and a painful torment awaits them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:6: That is because their messengers came to them with clear signs, yet they said, ‘Should we take guidance from mere mortals?’, rejected the message, and turned away. But God had no need for them: He is all sufficient, worthy of all praise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:7: The disbelievers claim they will not be raised from the dead. Say [Prophet], ‘Yes indeed! I swear by my Lord! You will be raised and then you will be informed about everything you have done: an easy matter for God.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:8: So believe in God, in His Messenger, and in the light We have sent down: God is fully aware of what you do.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:9: When He gathers you for the Day of Gathering, the Day of mutual neglect, He will cancel the sins of those who believed in Him and acted righteously: He will admit them into Gardens graced with flowing streams, there to remain for ever- the supreme triumph.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:10: But those who disbelieved and rejected Our signs will be the inhabitants of the Fire, there to remain- a miserable destination.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:11: Misfortunes can only happen with God’s permission––He will guide the heart of anyone who believes in Him: God knows all things––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:12: so obey God and the Messenger. If you turn away, remember that Our Messenger’s duty is only to make plain his message.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:13: God! There is no god but Him, so let the faithful put their trust in Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:14: Believers, even among your spouses and your children you have some enemies- beware of them- but if you overlook their offences, forgive them, pardon them, then God is all forgiving, all merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:15: Your wealth and your children are only a test for you. There is great reward with God:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:16: be mindful of God as much as you can; hear and obey; be charitable- it is for your own good. Those who are saved from their own meanness will be the prosperous ones:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:17: if you make a generous loan to God He will multiply it for you and forgive you. God is ever thankful and forbearing;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.64:18: He knows the unseen, as well as the seen; He is the Almighty, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:1: Prophet, when any of you intend to divorce women, do so at a time when their prescribed waiting period can properly start, and calculate the period carefully: be mindful of God, your Lord. Do not drive them out of their homes––nor should they themselves leave––unless they commit a flagrant indecency. These are the limits set by God–– whoever oversteps God’s limits wrongs his own soul––for you cannot know what new situation God may perhaps bring about.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:2: When they have completed their appointed term, either keep them honourably, or part with them honourably. Call two just witnesses from your people and establish witness for the sake of God. Anyone who believes in God and the Last Day should heed this: God will find a way out for those who are mindful of Him,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:3: and will provide for them from an unexpected source; God will be enough for those who put their trust in Him. God achieves His purpose; God has set a due measure for everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:4: If you are in doubt, the period of waiting will be three months for those women who have ceased menstruating and for those who have not [yet] menstruated; the waiting period of those who are pregnant will be until they deliver their burden: God makes things easy for those who are mindful of Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:5: This is God’s command, which He has sent down to you. God will wipe out the sinful deeds and increase the rewards of anyone who is mindful of Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:6: House the wives you are divorcing according to your means, wherever you house yourselves, and do not harass them so as to make their lives difficult. If they are pregnant, maintain them until they are delivered of their burdens; if they suckle your infants, pay them for it. Consult together in a good way- if you make difficulties for one another, another woman may suckle the child for the father––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:7: and let the wealthy man spend according to his wealth. But let him whose provision is restricted spend according to what God has given him: God does not burden any soul with more than He has given it- after hardship, God will bring ease.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:8: Many a town that insolently opposed the command of its Lord and His messengers We have brought sternly to account: We punished them severely
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:9: to make them taste the ill effect of their conduct- the result of their conduct was ruin.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:10: God has prepared a severe torment for them. So, you who have understanding, you who believe, beware of God. He has sent you the Quran
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:11: and a messenger- reciting to you God’s revelations that make things clear- to bring those who believe and do righteous deeds from darkness into light. God will admit those who believe in Him and do righteous deeds into Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will remain for ever––He has made good provision for them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.65:12: It is God who created seven heavens and a similar [number] of earths. His command descends throughout them. So you should realize that He has power over all things and that His knowledge encompasses everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:1: Prophet, why do you prohibit what God has made lawful to you in your desire to please your wives? Yet God is forgiving and merciful:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:2: He has ordained a way for you [believers] to release you from [such] oaths––God is your helper: He is the All Knowing, the Wise.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:3: The Prophet told something in confidence to one of his wives. When she disclosed it [to another wife] and God made this known to him, he confirmed part of it, keeping the rest to himself. When he confronted her with what she had done, she asked, ‘Who told you about this?’ and he replied, ‘The All Knowing, the All Aware told me.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:4: If both of you [wives] repent to God––for your hearts have deviated––[all will be well]; if you collaborate against him, [be warned that] God will aid him, as will Gabriel and all righteous believers, and the angels too will back him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:5: His Lord may well replace you with better wives if the Prophet decides to divorce any of you: wives who are devoted to God, true believers, devout, who turn to Him in repentance and worship Him, given to fasting, whether previously married or virgins.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:6: Believers, guard yourselves and your families against a Fire fuelled by people and stones, over which stand angels, stern and strong; angels who never disobey God’s commands to them, but do as they are ordered:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:7: ‘You who disbelieve, make no excuses today: you are only being repaid for what you used to do.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:8: Believers, turn to God in sincere repentance. Your Lord may well cancel your bad deeds for you and admit you into Gardens graced with flowing streams, on a Day when God will not disgrace the Prophet or those who have believed with him. With their lights streaming out ahead of them and to their right, they will say, ‘Lord, perfect our lights for us and forgive us: You have power over everything.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:9: Prophet, strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Deal with them sternly. Hell will be their home, an evil destination!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:10: God has given examples of disbelievers: the wives of Noah and Lot who married two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them. Their husbands could not help them against God: it was said, ‘Both of you enter the Fire with the others.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:11: God has also given examples of believers: Pharaoh’s wife, who said, ‘Lord, build me a house near You in the Garden. Save me from Pharaoh and his actions; save me from the evildoers,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.66:12: and Mary, daughter of Imran. She guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her from Our spirit. She accepted the truth of her Lord’s words and Scriptures: she was truly devout.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:1: Exalted is He who holds all control in His hands; who has power over all things;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:2: who created death and life to test you [people] and reveal which of you does best––He is the Mighty, the Forgiving;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:3: who created the seven heavens, one above the other. You will not see any flaw in what the Lord of Mercy creates. Look again! Can you see any flaw?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:4: Look again! And again! Your sight will turn back to you, weak and defeated.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:5: We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and made them [missiles] for stoning devils for whom We have also prepared the torment of a blazing fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:6: For those who defy their Lord We have prepared the torment of Hell: an evil destination.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:7: They will hear it drawing in its breath when they are thrown in. It blazes forth,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:8: almost bursting with rage. Its keepers will ask every group that is thrown in, ‘Did no one come to warn you?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:9: They will reply, ‘Yes, a warner did come to us, but we did not believe him. We said, “God has revealed nothing: you are greatly misguided”.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:10: They will say, ‘If only we had listened, or reasoned, we would not be with the inhabitants of the blazing fire,’ and
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:11: they will confess their sins. Away with the inhabitants of the blazing fire!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:12: But there is forgiveness and a great reward for those who fear their Lord though they cannot see Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:13: Whether you keep your words secret or state them openly, He knows the contents of every heart.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:14: How could He who created not know His own creation, when He is the Most Subtle, the All Aware?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:15: It is He who has made the earth manageable for you––travel its regions; eat His provision- and to Him you will be resurrected.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:16: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not make the earth swallow you up with a violent shudder?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:17: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not send a whirlwind to pelt you with stones? You will come to know what My warning means.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:18: Those who went before them also disbelieved- how terrible was My condemnation!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:19: Do they not see the birds above them spreading and closing their wings? It is only the Lord of Mercy who holds them up: He watches over everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:20: What force can help you if the Lord of Mercy does not? The disbelievers are truly deluded.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:21: Who can provide for you if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in their insolence and their avoidance of the Truth.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:22: Who is better guided: someone who falls on his face, or someone who walks steadily on a straight path?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:23: Say [Prophet], ‘It is He who brought you into being, He who endowed you with hearing, sight, and understanding- what small thanks you give!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:24: Say, ‘It is He who scattered you throughout the earth, He to whom you will be gathered.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:25: They say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:26: Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of this: my only duty is to give clear warning.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:27: When they see it close at hand, the disbelievers’ faces will be gloomy, and it will be said, ‘This is what you were calling for.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:28: Say, ‘Just think- regardless of whether God destroys me and my followers or has mercy on us- who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:29: Say, ‘He is the Lord of Mercy; we believe in Him; we put our trust in Him. You will come to know in time who is in obvious error.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.67:30: Say, ‘Just think: if all your water were to sink deep into the earth who could give you flowing water in its place?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:1: Nun By the pen! By all they write!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:2: Your Lord’s grace does not make you [Prophet] a madman:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:3: you will have a never-ending reward––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:4: truly you have a strong character––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:5: and soon you will see, as will they,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:6: which of you is afflicted with madness.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:7: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:8: So do not yield to those who deny the truth––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:9: they want you to compromise with them and then they will compromise with you––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:10: do not yield to any contemptible swearer,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:12: or hinderer of good, to anyone who is sinful, aggressive,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:13: coarse, and on top of all that, an imposter.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:14: Just because he has wealth and sons,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:15: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘These are just ancient fables.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:16: We shall brand him on the snout!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:17: We have tried them as We tried the owners of a certain garden, who swore that they would harvest its fruits in the morning
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:18: and made no allowance [for the Will of God]:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:19: a disaster from your Lord struck the garden as they slept
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:20: and by morning it was stripped bare, a desolate land.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:21: Still they called each other at daybreak,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:22: ‘Go early to your field if you wish to gather all its fruits,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:24: ‘Make sure no poor person enters the garden today!’––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:25: they left early, bent on their purpose-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:26: but when they saw the garden, they said, ‘We must have lost our way!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:28: The wisest of them said, ‘Did I not say to you, “Will you not glorify God?”’-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:29: they said, ‘Glory be to God, Our Lord! Truly, we were doing wrong!’-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:30: and then they turned to each other in mutual reproach.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:31: They said, ‘Alas for us! We have done terrible wrong,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:32: but maybe our Lord will give us something better in its place: we truly turn to Him in hope.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:33: Such is the punishment [in this life], but greater still is the punishment in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:34: There will be Gardens of bliss for those who are mindful of God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:35: Should We treat those who submit to Us as We treat those who do evil?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:36: What is the matter with you? On what basis do you judge?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:37: Do you have a Scripture that tells you
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:38: that you will be granted whatever you choose?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:39: Have you received from Us solemn oaths, binding to the Day of Resurrection, that you will get whatever you yourselves decide?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:40: Ask them [Prophet] which of them will guarantee this.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:41: Do they have ‘partners’ [besides God]? Let them produce their ‘partners’, if what they say is true.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:42: On the Day when matters become dire, they will be invited to prostrate themselves but will be prevented from doing so,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:43: and their eyes will be downcast and they will be overwhelmed with shame: they were invited to prostrate themselves when they were safe [but refused].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:44: So [Prophet] leave those who reject this revelation to Me: We shall lead them on, step by step, in ways beyond their knowledge;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:45: I will allow them more time, for My plan is powerful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:46: Do you demand some reward from them that would burden them with debt?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:47: Do they have knowledge of the unseen that enables them to write it down?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:48: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: do not be like the man in the whale who called out in distress:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:49: if his Lord’s grace had not reached him, he would have been left, abandoned and blameworthy, on the barren shore,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:50: but his Lord chose him and made him one of the Righteous.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:51: The disbelievers almost strike you down with their looks when they hear the Quran. They say, ‘He must be mad!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.68:52: but truly it is nothing other than a Reminder for all peoples.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:3: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:4: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blowwould come:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:5: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:6: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:7: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:8: Can you see any trace of them now?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:9: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:10: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:11: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:12: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:13: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:14: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:15: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:16: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:17: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:18: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:19: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:20: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:21: and so he will have a pleasant life
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:23: with clustered fruit within his reach.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:24: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:25: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:26: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:27: How I wish death had been the end of me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:28: My wealth has been no use to me,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:30: ‘Take him, put a collar on him,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:31: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:32: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:33: he would not believe in Almighty God,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:34: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:35: so today he has no real friend here,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:36: and the only food he has is the filth
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:38: So I swear by what you can see
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:39: and by what you cannot see:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:40: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:41: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:42: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:43: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:44: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:45: We would certainly have seized his right hand
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:47: and none of you could have defended him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:48: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:49: We know that some of you consider it to be lies-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:50: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:51: but it is in fact the certain Truth.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.69:52: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:2: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:3: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:4: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:5: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:6: The disbelievers think it is distant,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:7: but We know it to be close.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:8: On a Day when the heavens will be like molten brass
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:9: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:10: when no friend will ask about his friend,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:11: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:13: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:14: and everyone on earth, if it could save him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:15: But no! There is a raging flame
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:17: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:20: he is fretful when misfortune touches him,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:21: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:23: and are constant in their prayers;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:24: who give a due share of their wealth
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:26: who believe in the Day of Judgement
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:27: and fear the punishment of their Lord––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:28: none may feel wholly secure from it––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:30: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:31: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:32: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:34: and are steadfast in their prayers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:35: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:36: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet],
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:37: from right and left, in crowds?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:38: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:39: No! We created them from the substance they know,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:40: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:41: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:42: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:43: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.70:44: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:1: We sent Noah to his people: ‘Warn your people, before a painful punishment comes to them.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:2: And so he said, ‘My people, I am here to warn you plainly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:3: Serve God, be mindful of Him and obey me.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:4: He will forgive you your sins and spare you until your appointed time––when God’s appointed time arrives it cannot be postponed. If only you understood!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:5: He said, ‘My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:6: but the more I call them, the further they run away:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:7: every time I call them, so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, cover their heads with their garments, persist in their rejection, and grow more insolent and arrogant.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:8: I have tried calling them openly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:9: I have tried preaching to them in public and speaking to them in private.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:10: I said, “Ask forgiveness of your Lord: He is ever forgiving.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:11: He will send down abundant rain from the sky for you;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:12: He will give you wealth and sons; He will provide you with gardens and rivers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:13: What is the matter with you? Why will you not fear God’s majesty,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:14: when He has created you stage by stage?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:15: Have you ever wondered how God created seven heavens, one above the other,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:16: placed the moon as a light in them and the sun as a lamp,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:17: how God made you spring forth from the earth like a plant,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:18: how He will return you into it and then bring you out again,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:19: and how He has spread the Earth out for you
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:20: to walk along its spacious paths?” ’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:21: Noah said, ‘My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose riches and children only increase their ruin;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:22: who have made a grand plan,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:23: saying, “Do not renounce your gods! Do not renounce Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, or Nasr!”
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:24: They have led many astray. Lord, bring nothing but destruction down on the evildoers!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:25: They were drowned and sent to Hell for their evildoings: they found no one to help them against God.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:26: And Noah said, ‘Lord, do not leave any of the disbelievers on the earth-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:27: if you leave them they will lead Your servants astray and beget only sinners and disbelievers-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.71:28: Lord, forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer. Forgive believing men and women but bring nothing but ruin down on the evildoers!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:1: Say [Prophet], ‘It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn once listened in and said, “We have heard a wondrous Quran,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:2: that gives guidance to the right path, and we have come to believe it––We shall never set up partners with our Lord––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:3: and that He––exalted be the glory of our Lord!––has neither spouse nor child.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:4: Outrageous things have been said about God by the foolish among us,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:5: although we had thought that no man or jinn would [dare to] tell a lie about Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:6: Men have sought refuge with the jinn in the past, but they only misguided them further.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:7: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise anyone from the dead.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:8: We tried to reach heaven, but discovered it to be full of stern guards and shooting stars––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:9: we used to sit in places there, listening, but anyone trying to listen now will find a shooting star lying in wait for him––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:10: [so now] we do not know whether those who live on earth are due for misfortune, or whether their Lord intends to guide them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:11: Some of us are righteous and others less so: we follow different paths.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:12: We know we can never frustrate God on earth; we can never escape Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:13: When we heard the guidance we came to believe: whoever believes in his Lord need fear no loss nor injustice.
