M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:14: Some of us submit to Him and others go the wrong way: those who submit to God have found wise guidance,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:15: but those who go wrong will be fuel for Hellfire.” ’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:16: If they had taken to the right way, We would have given them abundant water to drink-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:17: a test for them––but anyone who turns away from his Lord’s Revelation will be sent by Him to spiralling torment.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:18: Places of worship are for God alone- so do not pray to anyone other than God-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:19: yet when God’s Servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed in on him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:20: Say, ‘I pray to my Lord alone; I set up no partner with Him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:21: Say, ‘I have no control over any harm or good that may befall you.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:22: Say, ‘No one can protect me from God: I have no refuge except in Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:23: I only deliver [what I receive] from God- only His messages.’ Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will have Hell’s Fire as his permanent home:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:24: when they are confronted by what they have been warned about, they will realize who has the weaker protector and the smaller number.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:25: Say, ‘I do not know whether what you have been warned about is near, or whether a distant time has been appointed for it by my Lord.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:26: He is the One who knows what is hidden.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:27: He does not disclose it except to a messenger of His choosing. He sends watchers to go in front and behind
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.72:28: to ensure that each of His messengers delivers his Lord’s message: He knows all about them, and He takes account of everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:2: Stay up throughout the night, all but a small part of it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:4: or a little more; recite the Quran slowly and distinctly:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:5: We shall send a momentous message down to you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:6: Night prayer makes a deeper impression and sharpens words––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:7: you are kept busy for long periods of the day––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:8: so celebrate the name of your Lord and devote yourself wholeheart-edly to Him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:9: He is Lord of the east and west, there is no god but Him, so take Him as your Protector,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:10: patiently endure what they say, ignore them politely,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:11: and leave to Me those who deny the truth and live in luxury. Bear with them for a little while;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:12: We have fetters, a blazing fire,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:13: food that chokes, and agonizing torment in store for them
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:14: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will shake. The mountains will become a heap of loose sand.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:15: We have sent a messenger to you [people] to be your witness, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:16: but Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger and so We inflicted a heavy punishment on him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:17: So if you disbelieve, how can you guard yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair grey,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:18: a Day when the sky will be torn apart? God’s promise will certainly be fulfilled.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:19: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes take the way to his Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.73:20: [Prophet], your Lord is well aware that you sometimes spend nearly two-thirds of the night at prayer––sometimes half, sometimes a third––as do some of your followers. God determines the division of night and day. He knows that you will not be able to keep a measure of it and He has relented towards all of you, so recite as much of the Quran as is easy for you. He knows that some of you will be sick, some of you travelling through the land seeking God’s bounty, some of you fighting in God’s way: recite as much as is easy for you, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and make God a good loan. Whatever good you store up for yourselves will be improved and increased for you. Ask God for His forgiveness, He is most forgiving, most merciful.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:3: Proclaim the greatness of your Lord;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:6: do not be overwhelmed and weaken;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:7: be steadfast in your Lord’s cause.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:9: that will be a Day of anguish for the disbelievers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:11: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:15: yet he still hopes I will give him more.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:16: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:17: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:23: and turned away and behaved arrogantly
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:24: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:25: just the talk of a mortal!’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:26: I will throw him into the scorching Fire.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:27: What will explain to you what the scorching Fire is?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:28: It spares nothing and leaves nothing;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:29: it scorches the flesh of humans;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:30: there are nineteen in charge of it––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:31: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:35: It is one of the mightiest things,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:37: to those of you who choose to go ahead and those who lag behind.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:38: Every soul is held in pledge for its deeds,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:39: but the Companions of the Right will stay
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:42: ‘What drove you to the Scorching Fire?’ [they will ask]
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:43: and they will answer, ‘We did not pray;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:44: we did not feed the poor;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:45: we indulged with others [in mocking the believers];
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:46: we denied the Day of Judgement
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:47: until the Certain End came upon us.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:48: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:49: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:52: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:53: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:54: but truly this is a reminder.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:55: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.74:56: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:3: Does man think We shall not put his bones back together?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:4: In fact, We can reshape his very fingertips.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:5: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:6: he says, ‘So, when will this Day of Resurrection be?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:9: when the sun and the moon are brought together,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:10: on that Day man will say, ‘Where can I escape?’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:12: they will all return to your Lord on that Day.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:13: On that Day, man will be told what he put first and what he put last.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:14: Truly, man is a clear witness against himself,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:15: despite all the excuses he may put forward.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:16: [Prophet], do not rush your tongue in an attempt to hasten [your memorization of] the Revelation:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:17: We shall make sure of its safe collection and recitation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:18: When We have recited it, repeat the recitation
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:19: and We shall make it clear.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:20: Truly you [people] love this fleeting world
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:21: and neglect the life to come.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:22: On that Day there will be radiant faces,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:24: and on that Day there will be the sad and despairing faces
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:25: of those who realize that a great calamity is about to befall them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:26: Truly, when the soul reaches the collarbone;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:27: when it is said, ‘Could any charm-healer save him now?’;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:28: when he knows it is the final parting;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:29: when his legs are brought together:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:30: on that day he will be driven towards your Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:32: but denied the truth and turned away,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:33: walking back to his people with a conceited swagger.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:34: Closer and closer it comes to you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:36: Does man think he will be left alone?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:37: Was he not just a drop of spilt-out sperm,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:38: which became a clinging form, which God shaped in due proportion,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:39: fashioning from it the two sexes, male and female?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.75:40: Does He who can do this not have the power to bring the dead back to life?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:1: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing to speak of ?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:2: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to put him to the test; We gave him hearing and sight;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:3: We guided him to the right path, whether he was grateful or not.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:4: We have prepared chains, iron collars, and blazing Fire for the disbelievers, but
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:5: the righteous will have a drink mixed with kafur,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:6: a spring for God’s servants, which flows abundantly at their wish.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:7: They fulfil their vows; they fear a day of widespread woes;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:8: they give food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive, though they love it themselves,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:9: saying, ‘We feed you for the sake of God alone: We seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:10: We fear the Day of our Lord––a woefully grim Day.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:11: So God will save them from the woes of that Day, give them radiance and gladness,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:12: and reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and silken robes.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:13: They will sit on couches, feeling neither scorching heat nor biting cold,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:14: with shady [branches] spread above them and clusters of fruit hanging close at hand.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:15: They will be served with silver plates
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:16: and gleaming silver goblets according to their fancy,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:17: and they will be given a drink infused with ginger
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:19: Everlasting youths will attend them––if you could see them, you would think they were scattered pearls––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:20: and if you were to look around, you would see bliss and great wealth:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:21: they will wear garments of green silk and brocade; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will give them a pure drink.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:22: [It will be said], ‘This is your reward. Your endeavours are appreciated.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:23: We Ourself have sent down this Quran to you [Prophet] in gradual revelation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:24: Await your Lord’s Judgement with patience; do not yield to any of these sinners or disbelievers;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:25: remember the name of your Lord at dawn and in the evening;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:26: bow down before Him, and glorify Him at length by night.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:27: These people love the fleeting life. They put aside [all thoughts of] a Heavy Day.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:28: Yet We created them; We strengthened their constitution; if We please, We can replace such people completely.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:29: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the way to his Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:30: But you will only wish to do so if God wills- God is all knowing, all wise-
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.76:31: He admits whoever He will into His Mercy and has prepared a painful torment for the disbelievers.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:1: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:6: as a proof or a warning:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:7: what you are promised will come to pass.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:9: and the sky is torn apart,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:10: when the mountains are turned to dust
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:11: and the messengers given their appointed time––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:12: for what Day has all this been set?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:14: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:15: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:16: Did We not destroy the first [of them]?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:17: We shall make the last follow them:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:18: this is how We deal with the guilty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:19: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:20: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:21: which We housed in a safe lodging
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:23: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:24: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:25: Did We not make the earth a home
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:26: for the living and the dead?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:27: Did We not place firm, lofty mountains on it and provide you with sweet water?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:28: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:29: They will be told, ‘Go to that which you used to deny!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:30: Go to a shadow of smoke!’ It rises in three columns;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:31: no shade does it give, nor relief from the flame;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:32: it shoots out sparks as large as treetrunks
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:34: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.77:35: On that Day they will be speechless,

M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:1: By the sun in its morning brightness
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:2: and by the moon as it follows it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:3: by the day as it displays the sun’s glory
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:4: and by the night as it conceals it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:5: by the sky and how He built it
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:6: and by the earth and how He spread it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:7: by the soul and how He formed it
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:8: and inspired it [to know] its own rebellion and piety!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:9: The one who purifies his soul succeeds
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:10: and the one who corrupts it fails.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:11: In their arrogant cruelty, the people of Thamud called [their messenger] a liar,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:12: when the most wicked man among them rose [against him].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:13: The messenger of God said to them, ‘[Leave] God’s camel to drink,’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:14: but they called him a liar and hamstrung her. Their Lord destroyed them for their crime and levelled them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.91:15: He did not hesitate to punish them.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:3: by His creation of male and female!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:4: The ways you take differ greatly.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:5: There is the one who gives, who is mindful of God,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:7: We shall smooth his way towards ease.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:8: There is the one who is miserly, who is self-satisfied,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:10: We shall smooth his way towards hardship
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:11: and his wealth will not help him as he falls.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:12: Our part is to provide guidance––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:13: this world and the next belong to Us––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:14: so I warn you about the raging Fire,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:15: in which none but the most wicked one will burn,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:16: who denied [the truth], and turned away.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:17: The most pious one will be spared this––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:18: who gives his wealth away as self-purification,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:19: not to return a favour to anyone
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:20: but for the sake of his Lord the Most High––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.92:21: and he will be well pleased.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:2: and by the night when it grows still,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:3: your Lord has not forsaken you [Prophet], nor does He hate you,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:4: and the future will be better for you than the past;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:5: your Lord is sure to give you so much that you will be well satisfied.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:6: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:7: Did He not find you lost and guide you?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:8: Did He not find you in need and make you self-sufficient?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:9: So do not be harsh with the orphan
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:10: and do not chide the one who asks for help;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.93:11: talk about the blessings of your Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.94:1: Did We not relieve your heart for you [Prophet],
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.94:3: that weighed so heavily on your back,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.94:5: So truly where there is hardship there is also ease;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.94:6: truly where there is hardship there is also ease.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.94:7: The moment you are freed [of one task] work on,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.94:8: and turn to your Lord for everything.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.95:1: By the fig, by the olive,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.95:4: We create man in the finest state
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.95:5: then reduce him to the lowest of the low,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.95:6: except those who believe and do good deeds–– they will have an unfailing reward.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.95:7: After this, what makes you [man] deny the Judgement?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.95:8: Is God not the most decisive of judges?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:1: Read! In the name of your Lord who created:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:2: He created manfrom a clinging form.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:3: Read! Your Lord is the Most Bountiful One
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:4: who taught by [means of] the pen,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:5: who taught man what he did not know.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:7: when he thinks he is self-sufficient:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:8: [Prophet], all will return to your Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:9: Have you seen the man who forbids
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:11: Have you seen whether he is rightly guided,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:13: Have you seen whether he denies the truth and turns away from it?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:14: Does he not realize that God sees all?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:15: No! If he does not stop, We shall drag him by his forehead––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:18: We shall summon the guards of Hell.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.96:19: No! Do not obey him [Prophet]: bow down in worship and draw close.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.97:1: We sent it down on the Night of Glory.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.97:2: What will explain to you what that Night of Glory is?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.97:3: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.97:4: on that night the angels and the Spirit descend again and again with their Lord’s permission on every task;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.97:5: [there is] peace that night until the break of dawn.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.98:1: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters were not about to change their ways until they were sent clear evidence,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.98:2: a messenger from God, reading out pages [blessed with] purity,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.98:4: [Yet] those who were given the Scripture became divided only after they were sent [such] clear evi-dence
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.98:5: though all they are ordered to do is worship God alone, sincerely devoting their religion to Him as people of true faith, keep up the prayer, and pay the prescribed alms, for that is the true religion.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.98:6: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters will have the Fire of Hell, there to remain. They are the worst of creation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.98:7: Those who believe and do good deeds are the best of creation.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.98:8: Their reward with their Lord is everlasting Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay forever. God is well pleased with them and they with Him. All this is for those who stand in awe of their Lord.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.99:1: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.99:2: when the earth throws out its burdens,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.99:3: when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.99:4: on that Day, it will tell all
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.99:5: because your Lord will inspire it [to do so].
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.99:6: On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.99:7: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.99:8: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:1: By the charging steeds that pant
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:2: and strike sparks with their hooves,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:5: and plunging into the midst of the enemy,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:6: man is ungrateful to his Lord––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:7: and He is witness to this––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:8: he is truly excessive in his love of wealth.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:9: Does he not know that when the contents of graves burst forth,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:10: when the secrets of hearts are uncovered, on that Day,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.100:11: their Lord will be fully aware of them all?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.101:3: What will explain to you what the Crashing Blow is?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.101:4: On a Day when people will be like scattered moths
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.101:5: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.101:6: the one whose good deeds are heavy on the scales
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.101:8: but the one whose good deeds are light
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.101:9: will have the Bottomless Pit for his home––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.101:10: what will explain to you what that is?––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.102:2: until you go into your graves.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.102:3: No indeed! You will come to know.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.102:4: No indeed! In the end you will come to know.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.102:5: No indeed! If only you knew for certain.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.102:6: You will most definitely see Hellfire,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.102:7: you will see it with the eye of certainty.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.102:8: On that Day, you will be asked about your pleasures.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.103:3: except for those who believe, do good deeds, urge one another to the truth, and urge one another to steadfastness.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.104:2: who amasses riches, counting them over,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.104:3: thinking they will make him live for ever.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.104:4: No indeed! He will be thrust into the Crusher!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.104:5: What will explain to you what the Crusher is?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.104:6: It is God’s Fire, made to blaze,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.105:1: Do you [Prophet] not see how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephant?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.105:2: Did He not utterly confound their plans?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.105:3: He sent ranks of birds against them,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.105:4: pelting them with pellets of hard-baked clay:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.106:1: [He did this] to make the Quraysh feel secure,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.106:2: secure in their winter and summer journeys.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.106:3: So let them worship the Lord of this House:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.106:4: who provides them with food to ward off hunger, safety to ward off fear.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.107:1: [Prophet], have you considered the person who denies the Judgement?
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.107:2: It is he who pushes aside the orphan
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.107:3: and does not urge others to feed the needy.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.107:4: So woe to those who pray
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.107:5: but are heedless of their prayer;
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.108:1: We have truly given abundance to you [Prophet]––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.108:2: so pray to your Lord and make your sacrifice to Him alone––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.108:3: it is the one who hates you who has been cut off.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.109:2: I do not worship what you worship,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.109:3: you do not worship what I worship,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.109:4: I will never worship what you worship,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.109:5: you will never worship what I worship:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.109:6: you have your religion and I have mine.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.110:1: When God’s help comes and He opens up your way [Prophet],
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.110:2: when you see people embracing God’s faith in crowds,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.110:3: celebrate the praise of your Lord and ask His forgiveness: He is always ready to accept repentance.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.111:1: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined! May he be ruined too!
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.111:2: Neither his wealth nor his gains will help him:
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.111:3: he will burn in the Flaming Fire––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.111:4: and so will his wife, the firewood-carrier,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.111:5: with a palm-fibre rope around her neck.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.112:3: He begot no one nor was He begotten.
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.112:4: No one is comparable to Him.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.113:1: Say [Prophet], ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.113:2: against the harm in what He has created,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.113:3: the harm in the night when darkness gathers,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.113:4: the harm in witches when they blow on knots,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.113:5: the harm in the envier when he envies.’
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.114:1: Say, ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of people,
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.114:4: against the harm of the slinking whisperer––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.114:5: who whispers into the hearts of people––
M.A.S. Abdel Haleem.114:6: whether they be jinn or people.’

Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.1:1: In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Bestower of mercy
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.1:2: All praise be to Allah, Lord of all realms,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.1:3: the All-Merciful, the Bestower of mercy,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.1:5: It is You we worship, and it is You we call for help.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.1:6: Guide us to the straight path:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.1:7: the path of those You have blessed, not those who have incurred(Your) wrath, nor those who have gone astray.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:2: That is the Scripture; there is no doubt about it—a guidance for the mindful(of God) ,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:3: who believe in the(existence of) hidden realms and establish the prayers and spend out of what We have provided them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:4: and those who believe in what has been sent down to youand what has been sent down before you, and regarding the Hereafter they are certain.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:5: Those are upon guidance from their Lord, and those are the successful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:6: Indeed, it is the same for those who have denied: whether youhave warned them or have not warned them, they do not believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:7: Allah has set a seal on their hearts and on their hearing, and over their sight(s )is a veil; for for them is a great punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:8: And of mankind are those who say, “We have attained faith in Allah and in the Last Day,” but they are not believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:9: They try to deceive Allah and those who have attained faith, yet they deceive none but themselves, but they are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:10: In their hearts is sickness, so Allah increased their sickness, and for them is a painful punishment on account of how they used to lie .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:11: And when it is said to them, “Do not spread corruption in the land,” they say, “Indeed, we are only reformers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:12: Undoubtedly, it is they who are indeed the corrupters, but they are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:13: And when it is said to them, “Believe as the people have believed,” they say, “Shall we believe as the fools have believed?” Undoubtedly, it is they who are indeed the fools, but they do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:14: And when they encounter those who have attained faith, they say, “We have attained faith.” But when they arealone with their Satans, they say, “We are indeed with you; we are only ridiculing.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:15: Allah ridicules them and gives them free rein to exceed all limits, wandering blindly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:16: Those are the ones who have purchased utter misguidance in exchange for guidance, so in no way has their bargain made any profit, and in no way have they been rightly guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:17: Their likeness is that of a person who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated all around him, Allah took away theirlight and left them in darkness(es) , unable to see.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:18: Deaf, mute, blind, so they are not returning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:19: Or like a cloudburst from the sky in which are darkness(es) and thunder and lightning. They put their fingers into their ears against the thunderbolts, in fear of death. Yet Allah is All-Encompassing of the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:20: The lightning almost snatches their sight(s) away; whenever it illuminates for them, they walk in it. But when it darkens over them, they stand(still) . And had Allah willed, He could have done away with their hearing and their sight(s ). Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:21: O mankind, worship your Lord Who created you and those before you, that you may become mindful(of Him) :
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:22: the One Who has made the land a habitat for you and the sky a structure, and has sent water down from the sky and has brought out products thereby as provision for you. So do not assign rivals to Allah while you know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:23: And if youare in doubt about what We have bestowed upon Our servant from on high, then bring a single surahof its like, and call your witnesses apart from Allah if you are truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:24: But if youdo not—and you will not—then be mindful of the Firewhose fuel is people and stones; it has been prepared for the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:25: And giveglad tidings to those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds: that for them are Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with any produce therefrom as provision, they say, “This is what we were provided with before,” and they are brought(them) in(perfect) resemblance. And for them are cleansed spouses therein, and therein they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:26: Indeed, Allah does not shy away from setting forth any parable, even of a gnat or anything above it. So as for those who have attained faith—they know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who have denied—they say, “What did Allah want(to say) by this parable?” He misguides many thereby and He guides many thereby, but He does not misguide thereby except the defiantly disobedient
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:27: who violate Allah’s covenant after it has been pledged and sever what Allah has commanded to be joined and spread corruption in the earth—those are the losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:28: How can youdeny Allah when you were lifeless and He gave you life, then He puts you to death, then He brings you to life, then to Him you are returned ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:29: It is He Who created for youwhat is on earth, all together, then turned to the heaven and formed theminto seven heavens. And He is All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:30: And recall when yourLord said to the angels, “I am appointing a viceroy in the earth.” They said, “Will You appoint in it someone who causes corruption in it and sheds blood, while we highly exalt You with praise and proclaim Your holiness?” He said, “Indeed, I know what you do not know.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:31: And He taught Adam the names, all of them; then He presented them to the angels and said, “Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:32: They said, “Highly Exalted be You! We have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You Who are the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:33: He said, “O Adam, inform them of their names.” So when he informed them of their names, He said, “Did I not tell youthat I know(all about) the hidden realm of the heavens and the earth, and that I know what you disclose and what you have been concealing?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:34: And recall when We said to the angels, “Prostrate yourselves to Adam”, so they prostrated themselves—but not Iblis. He refused and acted arrogantly and became of the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:35: Thereafter, We said, “O Adam, settle in the Garden, you and your spouse, and eatfrom it freely as you both will; but do not approachthis tree, lest youbecome of the unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:36: Yet Satan made them slip therefrom, so he brought them out of what they were in. Then We said, “Descend, as enemies to one another, for in the earth youhave a place of settlement and enjoyment for a while.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:37: Thereupon Adam received words from his Lord. Thus, He granted him repentance and accepted it from him. Indeed, it is He Who is the Superb Granter and Accepter of repentance, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:38: We said, “Descend from it, all together. Then whenever any guidance comes to you from Me, then whoever follows My guidance—then no fear shall beupon themnor shall they grieve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:39: But those who have denied and disbelieved in Our signs—those are the fellows of the Fire; therein they abide.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:40: O Children of Israel, “Remember My blessing which I blessed you with and fulfill your(part of the) covenant so that I fulfill My(part of the) covenant, and fear Me alone.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:41: And believein what I have sent down, confirming what is with you. And do not be the first denierof it, and do not purchase, inexchange for My revelations, a small price, and be mindful of Me alone.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:42: And do not mix truth with falsehood, and do not conceal the truth while youknow.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:43: And establish the prayer, and bringthe purifying charity, and bow down with the ones bowing down.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:44: Do youcommand mankind to virtue and forget yourselves, even though you read the Scripture? Do you not reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:45: And seekhelp through patience and prayer, and it is indeed a great burden except for the reverent
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:46: who are certain that they shall meet their Lord and that to Him they will return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:47: O Children of Israel, remember My blessing with which I blessed you, and that I favored you over all communities.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:48: And be mindful of a daywhen no self avails another in anything, nor is any intercession accepted on its behalf, nor is any ransom taken from it, nor are they supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:49: And recall how We delivered youfrom Pharaoh’s folk—(those) inflictingupon you an evil punishment, slaying your sons and keeping your women alive(in bondage) . For therein is a great test from your Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:50: And recall how We parted the sea for youand(thus) We saved you, and We drowned Pharaoh’s folk while you were beholding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:51: And recall when We appointed with Moses forty nights. Then youtook the calf(for worship) after him, while you were unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:52: Then We pardoned you after that, that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:53: And recall when We gave Moses the Scripture and the Criterion, that youmay be guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:54: And recall when Moses said to his people, “O my people, you have done injustice to yourselves by taking the calf(for worship) . So repent to your Maker and kill yourselves. That would be better for you with your Maker.” So He granted you repentance and accepted it from you; indeed it is He who is the Superb Granter and Accepter of repentance, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:55: And recall when yousaid, “O Moses, we will not believe in you unless we see Allah plainly.” Thereupon the thunderbolt struck you while you were beholding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:56: Then We revived youafter your death, that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:57: And We shaded youwith mists, and We sent down manna and quails upon you: “Eat of the good things We have provided for you.” And in no way did they do injustice to Us, but they used to do injustice to themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:58: And recall when We said, “Enter this town and eat from it freely wherever youwill, but enter the gate bowing down and say, ‘disburden(us) ’. We(will)forgive you your offenses , and We will give more to those who excel in doing good.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:59: Then the ones who did injustice exchanged(it for) a saying other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon the ones who did injustice a torment from heaven on account of how they used to defiantly disobey.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:60: And recall how Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, “Strike the rock with yourstaff.” Thereupon twelve springs gushed out from it; each group of people certainly knew its drinking-place. “Eatand drink from Allah’s provision, and do not go wickedly about the land, corrupting(it) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:61: And recall when yousaid, “O Moses, we shall not endure one kind of food, so call upon your Lord to bring out for us of what the earth germinates: of its herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions.” He said, “Would youexchange what is better for what is less? Go down to Egypt where you will have what you asked for.” And theywere struck with humiliation and destituteness, and they incurred wrath from Allah. That was because they used to deny Allah’s signsand unjustifiably kill the prophets. That was because they disobeyed and used to transgress.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:62: Indeed, those who have attained faith and those who have Judaized and the Christians and the Sabians—whoever has attained faith in Allah and the Last Day and has acted righteously—then theirreward is with their Lord, and no fear shall beupon them nor shall they grieve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:63: And recall when We took a pledge from youand raised Mount Tûr above you: “Take what We have given you firmly and remember what is in it, that you may become mindful(of God) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:64: But after that youturned away. So were it not for Allah’s grace and mercy towards you, you would have been of the losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:65: And you surely knew those of you who transgressed the Sabbath, so We said to them, “Be despicable apes!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:66: Thus We made it a deterrent for their generation and for subsequent generations, and a lesson for the mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:67: And recall when Moses said to his people, “Indeed, Allah commands you to slaughter a cow.” They said, “Do you make a mockery of us?” He said, “I seek refuge with Allah from being one of the ignorant.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:68: They said, “Call upon your Lord to make evident to us what(sort of cow) it is.” He said, “He says it is a cow neither too old nor too young—of median age between that, so do what you are commanded.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:69: They said, “Call upon your Lord to make evident to us what its color is.” He said, “Indeed, He says that it is surely a yellow cow, bright in color, pleasing to the beholders.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:70: They said, “Call upon your Lord to make evident to us what(sort of cow) it is; surely all cows look alike to us and—if Allah wills— we shall most surely be guided.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:71: He said, “He says it is a cow neither yoked to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, sound without blemish.” They said, “Now you have come with the truth.” So they slaughtered it, though they almost did not.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:72: And recall when youkilled a self then shifted responsibility for it onto each other, but Allah was to bring out(to the open) what you were concealing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:73: So We said, “Strike him with part of it.” Thus Allah brings the dead to life, and He shows youHis signs, that you may reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:74: Then after that your hearts hardened, so that they were as rocks or even harder. For surely from some rocks rivers gush out, and surely some others splinter so that water comes out from them, and surely some others sink in awe of Allah. And Allah is never oblivious of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:75: Do youardently hope that they will believe you, when a group of them used to hear the Speech of Allah and then distort it after they had reasoned, knowingly?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:76: And when they encounter those who have attained faith, they say, “We have attained faith.” But when they come together privately, they say, “Do youinform them of what Allah has disclosed to you so that they might debate you concerning it before your Lord?” Do you not reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:77: Do they not know that Allah knows whatever they keep secret and whatever they make public?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:78: And among themare illiterates who do not know the Scripture, other than fancies, and they only speculate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:79: So woe to those who scribe the Scripture with their own hands and then say, “This is from Allah,” that they may purchase, in exchange for it, a small price. Woe to them on account of what their hands have written, and woe to them on account of what they earn.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:80: And they said, “The Fire will not touch us except for a few days.” Say, “Have youtaken a covenant from Allah—so Allah will never break His covenant—or are you saying about Allah what you do not know?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:81: Yes indeed, whoever has earned an evil deed and whose offense has surrounded him—then those are the fellows of the Fire; therein they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:82: But those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—those are the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) ; therein they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:83: And recall when We took a pledge from the Children of Israel: “You shall worshipnone but Allah, and excel in showing kindness to the parents and the relative and orphans and the destitute, and say kind words to mankind and establish the prayers and bringthe purifying charity.” Then youturned away in disregard, except for a few of you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:84: And recall when We took a pledge from you: “You shall not shed your blood nor evict yourselves from your homes.” Then you consented while you were witnessing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:85: Then here you are, killing yourselves and evicting a group of your own from their homes—backing each other against them in sin and hostility. And if they come to you as captives, you do ransom them, while their eviction is forbidden to you. Is it that you believe in part of the Scripture and deny part? So what is the repayment for those of you who do that but disgrace in the Earlier Life, and(that) on the Day of Resurrection they are turned back to the most severe punishment? For Allah is never oblivious of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:86: Those are the ones who purchased the Earlier Life in exchange for the Hereafter, so the punishment is not lightened for them nor are they to be supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:87: And most surely, We brought Moses the Scripture and sent a succession of messengers after him. And We brought Jesus, son of Mary, the evident proofs, and We aided him with the Holy Spirit. Is it that every time a messenger came to you with anything your(inner) selves do not desire, you acted arrogantly, so one group you disbelieved, and another group you kill?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:88: And they said, “Our hearts are enfolded.” Rather, Allah has cursed them for their denial, so little do they believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:89: For when a scripture came to them from Allah, confirming what they had—although previously they were seeking a conquest against those who denied—but when there came to them what they recognized, they denied it. So may Allah’s curse be upon the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:90: Miserable is what they have purchased in exchange for their(very) selves—that they deny what Allah has bestowed from on high , out of resentment that Allah would send down His grace upon whomever He wills of His servants. Thus they incurred wrath upon wrath, for for the deniers is a demeaning punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:91: And when it is said to them, “Believe in what Allah has sent down,” they say, “We believe in what was sent down to us,” and they deny anything beyond that, although it is the truth which confirms what they have. Say, “Why(then) do you killAllah’s prophets—earlier—if you are believers?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:92: And very truly Moses came to youwith the evident proofs, then you took the calf(for worship) after him while you were unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:93: And recall when We took a pledge from youand raised Mount Tûr above you: “Take what We have given you firmlyand hear.” They said, “We have heard and disobeyed.” And, on account of their denial, in their hearts they were soaked in(the worship of) the calf. Say, “How miserable is that which yourfaith commands you to do, if you are believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:94: Say, “If the Home of the Hereafter with Allah is for youalone apart from all mankind, then wish for death if you are truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:95: But they will never wish for it, on account of what their hands have put forth. For Allah is All-Knowing of the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:96: And youwill most surely find them the most adhering of mankind to life, and more so than those who associated(others with God) . Every one of them would love to have his life extended a thousand years, but being granted a long life does not nudge him from the punishment, for Allah is All-Seeing of what they do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:97: Say, “Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel…—for indeed, it is he who has bestowed it upon yourheart from on high by Allah’s leave, confirming what preceded it, and guidance and glad tidings for the believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:98: Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael—then surely Allah is an enemy to the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:99: And We have indeed sent down to youevident signs, and none denies them except the defiantly disobedient.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:100: Is it not that whenever they make a covenant, a group of them throws it away? In fact, most of them do not believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:101: For when a messenger from Allah came to them confirming what they had, a group of those who were given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they did not know,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:102: and they followed what the devils readduring the reign of Solomon. But never did Solomon deny; rather it was the Satans who denied, teaching people sorcery and what was sent down in Babylon to the two angels Harut and Marut. And they do not teach anybody until they say, “We are but a means of trial, so do not deny(faith) .” Even so, they learn from them the means to cause separation between a man and his spouse—but never could they harm anyone except by Allah’s leave. And they learn what would harm them and not benefit them. Yet they did know that whoever purchased itwould have no share in the Hereafter. So indeed, how miserable is what they sold themselves for, if they only knew!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:103: And had they attained faith and been mindful(of God) , then surely a requital from Allah would have been better, if they only knew.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:104: O you who have attained faith, do not say ‘Raʻina,’but say, ‘Unthurna,’and listen, for for the deniers is a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:105: Neither the deniers from among the People of the Scripture nor the polytheists would love that any good be sent down upon you fromyourLord. Yet Allah specifies for His mercy whomever He wills, for Allah is the Possessor of great grace.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:106: Never do We abrogate any signnor cause it to be forgotten unless We bring one better than it or similar to it. Have younot come to know that Allah is All-Powerful over everything?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:107: Have younot come to know that to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth? For apart from Allah youhave neither ally nor supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:108: Or do youwant to question your Messenger as Moses was questioned earlier? For whoever substitutes denial for faith, then he has certainly strayed from the right way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:109: Many of the People of the Scripture would love to turn youback into deniers after you have attained faith, out of envy in their(inner) selves, after the truth has become evident to them. So pardon and overlook until Allah brings about His command. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:110: And establish the prayer and bringthe purifying charity, for whatever good you forward for yourselves, you will find it with Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:111: And they said, “None will enter the Garden(of Paradise) unless he has been a Jew or a Christian.” These are their fancies. Say, “Produce your proof, if you are truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:112: Yes indeed, whoever submits his face(in worship) to Allah while excelling in doing good, then he has his reward with his Lord, and no fear shall beupon themnor shall they grieve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:113: Nevertheless, the Jews said, “Christians have no ground whatsoever to stand on,” while the Christians said, “Jews have no ground whatsoever to stand on.” Yet they read the Scripture. Similarly, the ones who do not know said the like of their saying. Thus Allah judges between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding whatever they differed over.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:114: And who is more unjust than one who prevented(praying in) the mosques of Allah so that His Name be not mentioned in them, and pursued their ruin? Those—never was it for them to enter them except in fear. For them is disgrace in the Earlier(Life) , and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:115: And to Allah belong the East and the West, so wherever youturn, then that is where Allah’s Countenance is. Indeed, Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:116: And they said, “Allah has taken(for Himself) offspring.” Highly Exalted is He. Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth; all are devout towards Him—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:117: the Innovator of the heavens and the earth, and whenever He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and so it is .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:118: And those who do not know said, “If only Allah would speak to us, or a sign would come to us.” Thus said those who were before them—just what they said. Their hearts are alike. We have certainly made the signs evident for people who are certain.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:119: We have indeed sent you with the truth as a herald of glad tidings and as a warner, for you will not be asked about the fellows of purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:120: And never will the Jews or the Christians be pleased with youuntil you follow their creed. Say, “Surely, Allah’s guidance is the Guidance.” And should youfollow their whims after the knowledge that has come to you, you would have against Allah neither ally nor supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:121: Those to whom We have brought the Scripture read it as it ought to be read; those ones believe in it. But  whoever denies it—then thoseare the losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:122: O Children of Israel, remember My blessing with which I have blessed you and that I have favored you over all communities.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:123: And bemindful of a daywhen no self avails any other self in anything, nor is any ransom accepted from it, nor does any intercession benefit it, nor are they supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:124: And recall when Abraham was tried by his Lord with certain words and he fulfilled them. He said, “I am appointing you as a leader for mankind.” He said, “And of my offspring?” He said, “My covenant does not include the unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:125: And recall when We made the House a resort for mankind, and a sanctuary.And takefrom Abraham’sstanding place a place of prayer. And We covenanted with Abraham and Ishmael, “Cleanse My House for circumambulators and consecrators and those bowing down and prostrating themselves.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:126: And recall when Abraham said, “Lord! Make this a secure land and provide its people with products—whoever of them has attained faith in Allah and the Last Day.” He said, “And whoever denies—I will give him a little enjoyment, then compel him to the punishment of the Fire, and what a miserable destiny!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:127: And recall Abrahamraising the foundations of the House together with Ishmael, “Our Lord, accept(it) from us; indeed, it is You, You(alone) , who are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:128: Our Lord, and make us both Muslimto You, and from our offspring a Muslim community(submitting) to You. And show us our rites, and grant us repentance and accept it from us; indeed, it is You, You(alone) who are the Superb Granter and Accepter of repentance, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:129: Our Lord, and send forth among them a messenger from themselves to read to them Your signsand teach them the Scripture and the wisdom and purify them. Indeed, it is you, You(alone) , who are the Almighty, the All-Wise.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:130: And who would forsake the creed of Abraham except he who fools himself? And We have indeed chosen him in the Earlier(Life) , and in the Hereafter he is most surely one of the righteous.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:131: Recall when his Lord said to him, “Submit!” He said, “I have submitted to the Lord of all realms.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:132: And with this Abrahamfrequentlyenjoined his children, and(so did) Jacob, “O my children, Allah has indeed chosen the religion for you, so do not die except as Muslims.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:133: Or were you witnesses when death approached Jacob, and he said to his children, “What will you worship after me?” They said, “We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham, Ishmael and Isaac: One God, and to Him we are Muslims.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:134: That is a nation that has passed. For them is what they have earned, and for you is what youhave earned, and you will not be questioned about what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:135: And they said, “Be Jews or Christians and you will be guided.” Say, “Rather, the creed of Abraham who turned away from all that is false, for never was he of the polytheists.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:136: Say, “We have attained faith in Allah and in what was sent down to us, and in what was sent down to Abrahamand Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Grandsons, and in what was brought to Moses and Jesus, and in what was brought to the prophets by their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, for to Him we are Muslims.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:137: So if they believe in the same as youhave believed in, then they have been guided. But if they turn away, then they are in discord. And Allah will protect you against them, for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:138: (It is) Allah’s hue. And who gives a better hue than Allah? “And of Him we are worshipers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:139: Say, “Do you debate with us about Allah, when He is our Lord and your Lord, and when for us are our deeds and for you are your deeds, and to Him we are sincere?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:140: Or do you saythat Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Grandsonswere Jews or Christians? Say, “Do you know better or Allah?” And who is more unjust than one who conceals a testimony he has from Allah? For Allahis not oblivious of what youdo.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:141: That is a community that has passed away. For them is what they have earned and for youis what you have earned, for you will not be questioned about what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:142: The fools among mankind will say, “What has turned them away from the direction of prayer that they used to follow?” Say, “To Allah belong the East and the West. He guides whom He wills to a straight path.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:143: And thus have We made you a middle community, that you may be witnesses over humanity and that the Messenger may be a witness over you. Thus We only assigned the direction of prayer, which you formerly followed, that We may distinguish the one who follows the Messenger from the one who turns on his heels. And it was indeed difficult, except for those whom Allah has guided. But never would Allah let your faithgo to waste; indeed, towards mankind, Allah has always been truly Compassionate, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:144: We have surely seen the turning about of yourface towards the heaven. So We will turn you towards a direction that pleases you. So turn your face towards the Inviolable Mosque. And wherever youmay be, turn your facestowards it. Indeed, those who were brought the Scripture know that it is the truth from their Lord. And Allah is not oblivious of what they do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:145: And indeed, even if youwere to come with every sign to those whom the Scripture was brought to, they would not follow your direction of prayer, nor are you to follow their direction of prayer, nor do they follow the direction of prayer of one another. For if you were to follow their whims after the knowledge that has come to you, you would most surely be, in that case, one of the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:146: Those whom We have brought the Scripture recognize himas they recognize their own children. But indeed a group of them do conceal the truth while they know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:147: The truth is from yourLord, so never be of the skeptics.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:148: Thus for each is a direction towards which he turns , so racetowards good works. Wherever you may be, Allah will bring you all together. Allah is indeed Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:149: And from wherever youset out, turn your face towards the Inviolable Mosque, for this is indeed the truth from your Lord. And Allah is not oblivious of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:150: And from wherever youset out, turn your face towards the Inviolable Mosque. And wherever youmay be, turn your faces towards it so that people may not have any argument against you—except those of them who have been unjust. So do not fear them, but fear Me—and so that I may perfect My blessing upon you, and that you may be guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:151: Just as We sent among you a messenger from yourselves, reading Our signsto you, and purifying you, and teaching you the Scripture and wisdom, and teaching you what you did not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:152: So remember Me(and) I will remember you. And thank Me, and do not deny Me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:153: O you who have attained faith, seek help through patience and prayers. Indeed, Allah is with the patient ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:154: And do not sayof anyone who is killed in the way of Allah, “(They are) dead.” Rather,(they are) alive, but you are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:155: And We will certainly test youwith some fear and hunger and shortage of wealths and lives and products. Thus giveglad tidings to the patient ones:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:156: those who, when a calamity afflicts them, say, “To Allah we belong, and indeed to Him we are returning.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:157: Upon those are pardons and mercy from their Lord, and those are the rightly guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:158: Indeed, Al-Safa and Al-Marwa are among the rites of Allah, so whoever performs Pilgrimageto the House or performs Minor Pilgrimage, then no sin is committed by him if he circumambulates them. And whoever volunteers a good act—then Allah is indeed Thankful, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:159: Indeed, those who conceal what We have sent down of evident proofs and guidance after We had made it evident for mankind in the Scripture—those—Allah curses them and the cursers curse them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:160: except those who have repented and reformed and made(the truth) evident. For those—I grant them repentance and accept it from them, for I am the Superb Granter and Accepter of repentance, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:161: Indeed, those who have denied and have died as deniers—those—upon themis the curse of Allah and of the angels and of all mankind,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:162: abiding therein; never is the punishment lightened for them, nor are they given respite.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:163: For yourGod is One God. There is no God but He, the All-Merciful, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:164: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of the night and the day, and the ships that sail the sea with what benefits mankind, and the water that Allah sent down from the sky— with which He revived the earth after it had died and scattered in it all kinds of treading creatures, and the shifting of the winds , and the clouds disposed between the sky and the earth are surely signs for people who reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:165: Yet of mankind is one who takes(others) apart from Allah as rivals to Him. Theylove them with a love like that due to Allah, yet those who have attained faith are stronger in love for Allah. And if only those who have done injustice could see , when they see the punishment, that all power belongs to Allah and thatAllah is severe in punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:166: Recall when those who were followed disownedthose who had followed(them) , and they saw the punishment and ties between them were severed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:167: And those who followed said, “If only we could have another chance so we could disown them as they disowned us.” Thus Allah showsthem their deeds as regrets to them, and never will they come out of the Fire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:168: O mankind, eat of what is lawful and good on earth, and do not follow the footsteps of Satan; indeed, he is to you an evident enemy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:169: He only commands youto evil and obscenity, and to say about Allah what you do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:170: And when it is said to them, “Follow what Allah has sent down,” they say, “Rather, we follow what we found our forefathers following. What if their forefathers used not to reason anything nor to seek guidance?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:171: The parable of those who have denied is that of onewho hollers out to things that hear nothing but mere calls and cries. Deaf, dumb,(and) blind, so they do not reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:172: O you who have attained faith, eat of the good things We have provided you, and give thanks to Allahif it is He that you worship.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:173: He has only forbidden youcarrion and blood and the flesh of swine and what was dedicated to other than Allah. But if anyone is compelled without seeking(it) or exceeding(the limits) , he commits no sin. Indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:174: Indeed, those who conceal what Allah has sent down of the Scripture and purchase, in exchange for it, a small price—those devour nothing into their bellies but fire. And Allah does not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor does He purify them, for for them is a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:175: Those are the ones who have purchased utter misguidance in exchange for guidance, and punishment in exchange for forgiveness. So how patient are they in the face of the Fire!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:176: That is because Allah has bestowed the Scripture from on high with the truth. And most surely, those who differed over the Scripture are in profound discord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:177: Virtue is not(attained) by turning yourfaces towards the East and the West. Rather, virtue is(exemplified) in one who has attained faith in Allah and the Last Day and the angels and the Scripture and the prophets, and has brought money—despite his love of it—to relatives and orphans and the destituteand the traveler in need and the askers and for(the freeing of) slaves, and has established the prayer and broughtthe purifying charity; and(it is exemplified) in thosewho fulfill their covenant when they have covenanted, and those who are patient in(the face of) misery and adversity and at the time of battle. Those are the ones who were truthful, and it is those who are the mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:178: O you who have attained faith, fair retribution for the murderedhas been prescribed upon you: the free for the free, and the bondman for the bondman, and the female for the female. Yet whoever is somewhat pardoned by his brother(in faith) , then this shall be adhered to in accordance with what is fair, and the payment back to him should be in a good way. That is lightening from your Lord and mercy. But whoever transgresses after that—then for him is a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:179: Thus there is life for you in fair retribution, O people of understanding, that you may be mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:180: It has been prescribed upon you: when death comes to one of you, if he is leaving wealth,(to bequeath) a bequest in favor of the parents and close relatives in accordance with what is fair—a duty upon the mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:181: But whoever changes itafter he has heard it, then surely its sin is upon those who change it. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:182: Yet whoever fears unfairness or sin from a bequether, so he reconciles between them, then he commits no sin. Indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:183: O you who have attained faith, fasting has been prescribed upon you as it was prescribed upon those before you, that you may become mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:184: (This fasting is for) a limited number of days. But should any one of you be sick or on a journey, then(he should fast) a period of other days. Yet for those who can fast with difficulty, a compensation(is allowed instead)—food for a destitute person . But whoever volunteers a good act, it is better for him. Yet to fast is better for you, if you only knew.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:185: (It was) the month of Ramadan in which the Recitalwas sent down as guidance for mankind, and as evident explanations of the guidance and the criterion. So whoever of you witnesses the month, then he shall fast it. But whoever is sick or on a journey, then(he must fast) a period of other days. Allah wants ease for you and does not want hardship for you, and that you should complete the period, and that you should glorify Allah for having guided you, and so that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:186: And when My servants ask youabout Me—indeed, I am near; I respond to the call of the caller when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me and let them have faith in Me, that they may become prudent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:187: Permitted for youis intercourse with your women on the night of the fast; they are a garment for you and you are a garment for them. Allah has known that you used to betray yourselves, but He granted you repentance and accepted it from you and pardoned you. So approach them now and seek what Allah has prescribed for you, and eat and drink until the white thread becomes evident to you from the black thread at dawn, then complete the fast to the night. But do not approach them while you are consecrating yourselves in the mosques. These are the limits of Allah, so do not come near them. Allah thus clarifies His signs to mankind, that they may become mindful(of Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:188: And do not devour your wealths among yourselves by false means, nor throw it(as bribes) to the judges in order to devour partof other people’s wealth illicitly, while you know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:189: They ask youabout the crescents. Say, “They are time-marks for mankind and for the Pilgrimage.” And virtue is not(attained) by approaching houses from their backs; rather, virtue is(exemplified in) one who has been mindful(of God) . So approach houses from their doorsand be mindful of Allah, that youmay succeed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:190: And combat in the way of Allah those who combat you, but do not start hostilities; indeed, Allah does not love the hostile ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:191: And kill them wherever youencounter them, and evict them from where they have evicted you, for religious persecution is more severe than killing. But do not combat them at the Inviolable Mosque unless they combatyou about it. So if they combatyou, then kill them. Such is the repayment of the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:192: But if they cease, then Allah is indeed Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:193: And combatthem until there is no more religious persecution and religion becomes for Allah. But if they cease, then let there be no hostility except against the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:194: An inviolable month for an inviolable month, and inviolable rites call for fair retribution. So whoever starts hostilities against you, be hostile to him in the same measure as he has been hostile to you. And be mindful of Allah, and know that Allah is with the mindful(of Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:195: And spend in the way of Allah and do not cast yourown hands into annihilation, and excel in doing good. Indeed, Allah loves those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:196: And complete the Pilgrimageand the Minor Pilgrimagefor Allah. But if youare detained, then(offer) whatever is feasible of offerings. And do not shave your heads until the offering has reached its destination. But whoever of you is sick or has some affliction of his head, then the due redemption is fasting or a donation or a sacrifice. Then when you are secure: whoever enjoys a break between the Minor Pilgrimage and the Pilgrimage, then(he must offer) whatever is feasible of offering. But whoever cannot find the means, then fasting for three days during the Pilgrimage, and seven when youhavereturned; that is ten in total. That is for the one whose family is not present at the Inviolable Mosque. And bemindful of Allah, and know that Allah is stern in retribution.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:197: Pilgrimage is during specific months. So whoever decides to perform Pilgrimage, then there shall never be intercourse nor ungodliness nor disputation during the Pilgrimage. And whatever good youdo, Allah knows it. And take provisions, but the best provision is indeed mindfulness(of God) . And be mindful of Me, O people of understanding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:198: Youcommit no sin by seeking grace from your Lord. So when youpour forth from Arafat, remember Allah at the Sacred Landmark. And remember Him as He has guided you, although before that, you were indeed of those astray.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:199: Then pourforth from where the people have poured forth and ask Allah for forgiveness. Indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:200: Then when youhave completed your rites, remember Allah as you remember your forefathers or with even greater remembrance. And of mankind is one who says, “Our Lord, bring to us in the Earlier(Life) ,” yet he has no share in the Hereafter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:201: And of them is one who says, “Our Lord, bring to us goodness in the Earlier(Life) and goodness in the Hereafter and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:202: Those shall have a share of what they have earned, for Allah is Swift in reckoning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:203: And rememberAllahduring a limited number of days. But whoever hurries on(to leave Mena) after two days commits no sin, and whoever stays on commits no sin—provided he maintains mindfulness(of God) . And bemindful of Allah, and know that to Him you will be herded.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:204: And of mankind is one whose speech about the Earlier Life impresses you, and he calls upon Allah to bear witness as to what is in his heart, while he is the most hostile of adversaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:205: For when he turns away(from you) , he rushes about in the land in order to spread corruption on earth and destroy both field and progeny. But Allah does not love corruption.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:206: And when he is told, “Be mindful of Allah,” the might of the sin takes over him. So Hell is sufficient for him, and indeed, what a miserable resting place!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:207: And of mankind is one who sells his(inner) self, seeking Allah’s pleasure. And Allah is Compassionate towards the servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:208: O you who have attained faith, enter into peacefulness and submission collectively, and do not follow the footsteps of Satan; indeed, to you he is an evident enemy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:209: So if youslip after the evident proofs have come to you, then know that Allah is Almighty, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:210: Are they waiting for anything except for(the command of) Allah to come to them in shades of mists, and the angels(too)? And(thus) the matter wassettled, for to Allah all things are returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:211: Ask the Children of Israel how many an evident sign We brought them. Yet whoever changes the blessing of Allah after it has come to him, then Allah is indeed stern in retribution.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:212: The Earlier Life has been adorned for those who have denied, and they ridicule those who have attained faith. But those who are mindful(of God) are above them on the Day of Resurrection, for Allah provides to whomever He wills without measure.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:213: Mankind used to be one community, then Allah sent the prophets as bearers of glad tidings and as forewarners. And He sent down with them the Scripture with the truth to judge between mankind regarding whatever they differed over. But none differed over itexcept those who were given it—after evident proofs had come to them—out of mutual envy between them. Then Allah guided those who attained faith to the truth they had disputed, by His knowledge. For Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.2:214: Or did youexpect to enter the Garden(of Paradise) before the like of(the trials that befell) those who passed on before you had befallen you? Misery and adversity afflicted them, and they were shaken as with an earthquake, until the Messenger and those who believed with him would say, “When is Allah’s support(coming) ?” Undoubtedly, Allah’s support is indeed near.
