Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:30: And if only youcould see when they weremade to stand before their Lord. He said, “Is this not the truth?” They said, “Yes indeed, by our Lord.” He said, “Then taste the punishment on account of what you used to deny.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:31: Lost indeed are those who disbelieved in the meeting with Allah until, when the Hour comes upon them suddenly, they will say, “Alas for us for whatever we have neglected in it,” while carrying their burdens on their backs. Undoubtedly, evil is what they bear.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:32: And the Earlier Life is nothing but a game and a distraction, but the Home of the Hereafter is definitely better for those who are mindful(of God) . Do younot reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:33: Indeed, We know that very truly what they say grieves you, but it is not really you whom they disbelieve; rather, it is the signs of Allah that the unjust repudiate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:34: And very truly, other messengers before you were disbelieved, but they patiently endured being disbelieved and hurt until Our support came to them, for none can change His words. And indeed there has already come to yousome of the emissaries’ stories.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:35: And if you find their disregard hard to bear, then if you can, seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the heaven so as to bring them a sign. And had Allah willed, He could have united them on guidance. So do not beof the ignorant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:36: Indeed, those who respond are those who hear. But the dead—Allah resurrects them, then to Him they are returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:37: And they said, “If only a sign had been bestowed upon him from on highby his Lord.” Say, “Indeed, Allah is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:38: And there is no treading creature on land, nor a bird flying with its wings, but are communities like you. We have neglected nothing in the Scripture. Then to their Lord they are herded.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:39: Those who disbelieved in Our signs are deaf and dumb, in darkness(es) . Whomever Allah wills, He misguides. And whomever He wills, He sets on a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:40: Say, “Have you seen yourselves? If Allah’s punishment came upon you or the Hour came upon you, would you call upon any other than Allah, if you are sincere?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:41: Rather, it is only Him that you would call upon, then He removes whatever made you call on Him if He so wills, and you would forget what you associated(with Him) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:42: And most surely We sent to communities before you, and We seized them with misery and adversity, that they may supplicate(Us) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:43: If only when Our affliction came upon them they had supplicated(Us) . But their hearts hardened, and Satan adorned for them whatever they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:44: Then, when they forgotwhat they had been reminded of, We opened for them the gates of everything until, when they delighted in what they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were instantly in despair.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:45: Thus the last remnant of those who were unjust was cut off. And praise be to Allah, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:46: Say, “Have youseen? If Allah took away your hearing and your sight(s) and set a seal on your hearts, which god other than Allah would restore them to you?” Look how Wediversify the signs, yet they keep turning away.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:47: Say, “Have you seen yourselves? If Allah’s punishment came upon you suddenly or openly, would any be annihilated except the unjust people?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:48: And We do not send the emissaries except as bearers of glad tidings and as forewarners, so whoever has attained faith and reformed—no fear shall be upon them, nor shall they grieve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:49: But those who disbelieved in Our signs—punishment will touch them on account of their defiant disobedience.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:50: Say, “I do not say to youthe treasuries of Allah are with me, nor do I know what is hidden, nor do I say to you I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me.” Say, “Are the blind and the seeing equal? Do younot reflect?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:51: And warn with it those who fear to be herded to their Lord—they do not have, apart from Him, any guardian or intercessor—that they may become mindful(of Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:52: And donot expel those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His Countenance; you are not responsible for their reckoning in any way, nor are they responsible for your reckoning in any way. So were you to expel them, you would be of the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:53: And thus We have tried some of them by means of others, that they may say, “Are these the ones whom Allah has favored from among us?” Does not Allah know better of those who are thankful?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:54: And when those who believe in Our signs come to you, say, “Peace be upon you; your Lord has prescribed for Himself mercifulness: that whoever among you does evil out of ignorance then repents afterwards and reforms—thatHe is then Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:55: And thus We detail the signs, and so that the way of the criminals can become evident .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:56: Say, “I have been forbidden from worshiping those you call upon apart from Allah.” Say, “I do not follow your whims, for then I would have surely gone astray and would not be of those guided.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:57: Say, “I rely on evident proof from my Lord, while you have disbelieved in Him. I do not possess what you ask to be hastened; judgment belongs to none but Allah; Hestates the truth and He is the Best of judges.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:58: Say, “If what you ask to be hastened was with me, the matter between me and you would have been settled, for Allah knows better of the unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:59: And with Him are the keys of the hidden realm; none knows them except He. And He knows whatever is on land and sea, and not a leaf falls but He knows it, nor a single grain in the darkness(es) of earth, nor is there anything wet or dry but is in an evident record.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:60: And it is He Who takes youby night and He knows what you have committed by day, then He raises you up in it, that a stated term may be fulfilled; then to Him is your return, then He will inform you of what you used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:61: And He is the Subjugator over His servants, and He sends preservers over youuntil, when death has come to one of you, Our messengers take him away, and they never neglect(their tasks) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:62: Then they are returned to Allah, their True Patron. Undoubtedly, His is the judgment, and He is the Swiftest of reckoners.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:63: Say, “Who delivers you from the darkness(es) of land and sea?” Youcall upon Him in supplication and in secret. “If He saves usfrom this, We will surely be of the thankful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:64: Say, “It is Allah Who delivers youfrom it and from every calamity, yet you associate others with Him.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:65: Say, “He is the One Able to send upon you a punishment from above you or from under your feet, or He can confound you into sects and make you taste one another’s violence. Look how We diversify the signs, that they may comprehend.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:66: But your people considered it to be a lie, though it is the truth. Say, “I am not a trustee over you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:67: For every tiding is a time of settlement, and youwill come to know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:68: And when yousee those who engage in blaspheming Our signs, then disregard them until they engage in another discourse. But should Satan make you forget, then do not sit after the Reminding with the unjust people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:69: And in no way are the mindful(of God) responsible for their reckoning, but only(for) reminding—that they may become mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:70: So leavealone those who take their religion for a game and a distraction, and whom the Earlier Life has deceived. But remind with it, lest a single self become wrecked on account of what it has earned. Apart from Allah it has neither guardian nor intercessor, and if it offers every conceivable compensation, it will not be accepted from it. Those are the ones who were wrecked on account of what they had earned; for them is a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment on account of how they used to deny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:71: Say, “Are we to call, apart from Allah, upon what can neither benefit us nor harm us and be turned back on our heels after Allah has guided us, like someone who is lured by the Satans on earth and is confused? He has fellows calling him to guidance: ‘Come to us’.” Say, “The guidance of Allah is indeed the Guidance, and we have been commanded to surrender to the Lord of all realms,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:72: and(we were told:) ‘perform the prayers and be mindful of Him, for it is to Him that you will be herded.’
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:73: And it is He Who created the heavens and the earth in truth. And on the day when He says: ‘Be,’ and so it is: His saying is the truth; and to Him belongs the dominion on the day when the Trumpet is blown. The Knower of the hidden realm and the manifest, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Aware.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:74: And recall when Abraham said to his father Azar , “Doyou take human-shaped idols for gods? I see that you and your people are indeed in evident misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:75: And thus We showAbraham the empire of the heavens and the earth, and so that he would be of the ones who believe with certitude.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:76: So when the night covered him, he saw a planet; he said, “This is my lord.” But when it set, he said, “I do not love those that set.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:77: So when he saw the moon rising, he said, “This is my lord.” But when it set, he said, “If my Lord does not guide me, I will most surely be one of the people who have gone astray.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:78: So when he saw the sun rising, he said, “This is my lord; this is bigger.” But when it set, he said, “O my people, I am innocent of whatever you associate(with Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:79: I have directed my face towards the One Who originated the heavens and the earth—turning away from all that is false—and in no way am I one of the polytheists.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:80: And his people debated with him. He said, “Do you debate with me about Allah when He has guided me? I do not fear what you associate with Him unless my Lord were to will something. My Lord has embraced everything in knowledge. Will you not remind yourselves?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:81: And how is it that I should fear that which you associate with Him, while you do not fear associating with Allah that of which He has bestowed upon you no authority from on high? So which of the two groups is more entitled to security, if you(really) know?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:82: Those who have attained faith and have not confounded their faith with injustice—for those is security, and they are guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:83: And that was Our argument which We brought to Abraham against his people; We elevate by degrees whomever We will. Indeed, yourLord is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:84: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob; each of them We guided. And We guided Noah previously, and from his offspring David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. And thus We repay those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:85: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias—every one of them is of the righteous.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:86: And Ishmael and Elijah and Jonah and Lot—and every one of them We favored over all communities.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:87: And of their forefathers and their offspring(s) and their brethren—and We chose them and guided them to a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:88: Such is Allah’s guidance; He guides with it whomever He wills of His servants. But had they associated(others with God) —whatever they used to do would have been nullified.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:89: Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and wise judgment and prophethood. So even if these people now disbelieve in them, we have surely entrusted them to others who do not reject them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:90: Those are the ones whom Allah has guided, so follow after their guidance. Say, “I ask of you no reward for it; it is just a reminder for all mankind.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:91: And they did not value Allah as He should be valued when they said, “In no way has Allah sent down anything on any human being.” Say, “Who sent down the Scripture which Moses came with—a light and guidance for mankind? Youmake of it parchments, disclosing them and hiding much. And youwere taught what you did not know—neither you, nor your forefathers.” Say, “Allah(revealed it) .” Then leave them in their indulgence in vain talk, playing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:92: And this is a Scripture that We sent down, blessed, confirming what preceded it, and that you may warnthe Mother of Townsand those around it. Thus those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they preserve their prayers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:93: For who is more unjust than someone who fabricated lies against Allah or said, “It was revealed to me,” when nothing had been revealed to him, and someone who said, “I will send down the like of what Allah has sent down”? And if only youcould see the unjust ones in the perplexities of death as the angels stretch their hands: “Get yourselves out; today you are being repaid with the punishment of shame on account of what you used to say about Allah other than the truth, and for acting arrogantly towards His signs.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:94: “And most surely youhave come to Us individually, just as We created you the first time, and you have left behind your backs whatever We granted you. Yet We do not see with you your intercessors—those you claimed were associates in you. Most surely, the link between you was severed, and what you had claimed has strayed from you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:95: Indeed, Allah is the Splitter of the grain and the fruit stone. He brings out the living from the dead, and(He is) the Bringer Out of the dead from the living. Such is Allah, so how can yoube averted(from the truth) ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:96: (He is) the Splitter of the daybreak, and He has made the night for rest and the sun and the moon for calculation; such is the determining of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:97: And it is He Who made for you the stars, that you may be guided by them in the darkness(es) of land and sea. Surely, Wehave detailed the signs for people who know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:98: And it is He Who initiated you from a single self, then a place of settlement and a storage. Surely, Wehave detailed the signs for people who comprehend.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:99: And it is He who sent down water from the sky, and with it Webrought out the germination of everything, then We brought out from it greenery from which We bring outlayered grain. And out of the palm-trees—from their spathes— clusters of dates, hanging low, and gardens of grapevines, and the olives, and the pomegranates—similaryet dissimilar. Look at its produce when it has yielded its produce and(look at) its ripening. Most surely in that are signs for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:100: Yet they made for Allah associates—the unseen beings—although He created them, and they invented for Him sons and daughters, without(any) knowledge. Highly Exalted is He and Most High, far above what they describe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:101: Originator of the heavens and the earth—how can He have offspring when He never had a consort? And He created everything, and He is All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:102: Such is Allah, yourLord; there is no God but He, the Creator of everything, so worship Him, for He is the Ultimate Trustee over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:103: Sight(s) cannot grasp Him, while He grasps all sight(s) , and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:104: “Insights have indeed come to youfrom your Lord, so whoever sees does so to his own benefit, while whoever remains blind does so to his own detriment. And I am not a constant preserver over you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:105: And thus We diversify the signs, and so that they say, “Youhavestudied ,” and so that We make it evident for people who have knowledge.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:106: Follow what was revealed to you from your Lord—there is no god but He—and disregard the polytheists.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:107: And had Allah willed, they would not have associated(others with Him) . And We did not make you as a constant preserver over them, and in no way are you a trustee over them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:108: Yet do not insult those they call upon apart from Allah lest they insult Allah out of hostility, without knowledge. Thus Wehave adorned for every community their work, then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:109: And they swore by Allah their most solemn oaths that if a sign were to come to them, they would believe in it. Say, “Signs are only with Allah,” but how do you know that even if it did come, they would still not believe?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:110: And We turn away their burning hearts and their sight(s) as they did not believe in it the first time, and We leave them to wander aimlessly while exceeding all limits.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:111: And even if We bestowed the angels upon them from on high and the dead spoke to them and We herded everything before them, they would still not believe unless Allah wills, but most of them are ignorant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:112: And thus We made for every prophet an enemy—Satans from among humans and unseen beings—revealing to one another fancy words in order to deceive. But had yourLordwilled, they would not have done it, so leave them to their fabrications.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:113: And so that the burning hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter may incline to it, and that they may be well pleased with it, and that they may perpetrate whatever they perpetrate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:114: “Shall I seek a judge other than Allah when He is the One Who sent down to you the Scripture, explained in detail?” And those to whom We gave the Scripture know that it is the truth, bestowed from on high by your Lord, so never beof those who doubt.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:115: Thus the Word of yourLord hasbeencompleted, in truth and justice. None can change His words, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:116: But if youwere to obey most of those on earth, they would make you stray from the way of Allah. They follow nothing but assumptions, and they do nothing but guess.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:117: Indeed, your Lord is the One Who knows better about who strays from His way, and it is He who knows better about who the guided are.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:118: So eatof that over which the Name of Allah has been mentioned, if you indeed believe in His signs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:119: And why should you not eat of that over which the Name of Allah has been mentionedwhen He has detailed for you what He has prohibited for you, except that to which you are compelled? And many do indeed lead(others) astraywith their whims without(any) knowledge. Indeed, yourLord knows better who the transgressors are.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:120: So leaveaside apparent sin as well as what is concealed thereof. Indeed, those who earn sin will definitely be repaid on account of what they used to perpetrate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:121: And do not eat from that over which the Name of Allah was not mentioned, for it is grave disobedience. And the Satans do indeed reveal to their allies to argue with you; but if you obey them, you would surely be polytheists.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:122: Is he who was lifeless, then We revived him and made for him a light by which he walks among mankind, as one whose likeness is in darkness(es) , never emerging from them? Thus whatever the deniers have been doing was adorned for them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:123: And thus We set up in every town its leading criminals to scheme in it, but they scheme only against themselves, though they are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:124: And when a sign comes to them, they say, “We will not believe unless we are brought the like of what was brought to Allah’s messengers.” Allah knows better where to set His message . Abasement(decreed) by Allah will afflict those who committed crimes, and severe punishment(too) , on account of what they used to scheme.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:125: Whomever Allah wants to guide, He expands his chest to(accept) Islam; and whomever He wants to lead astray, He makes his chest tight, constricted , as though he were gradually ascending in the sky. Allah thus lays abomination upon those who do not believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:126: And this is your Lord’s path, straight. Wehave surely detailed the signs for people who constantly remember.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:127: For them is the Home of Peace with their Lord, and He is their Ultimate Guardian on account of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:128: Thus on the day He herds themall together: “O assembly of unseen beings, you have surely done so much against humans.” But their allies among humans said, “Our Lord, we enjoyed one another, and we have reached the term that you have assigned for us.” He said, “The Fire is your dwelling, wherein you abide, except as Allah wills. Indeed, your Lord is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:129: And thus We make the unjust allies of one another on account of what they used to earn.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:130: “O assembly of unseen beingsand humans, did there not come to you messengers from among you, relating to you My signs and warning you of the meeting of this day of yours?” They said, “We have(now) testified against ourselves.” And the Earlier Life deceived them, and they testified against themselves that they were deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:131: That is because yourLord would never destroy towns unjustly while their inhabitants are oblivious.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:132: And for all there are degrees(of rank) according to how they acted, and yourLord is not oblivious of how they act.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:133: Thus yourLord is the Self-Sufficient, the Possessor of mercy. If He wills, He can do away with youand give succession after you to whomever He wills, just as He initiated you from the offspring of other people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:134: Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and in no way can you thwart(God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:135: Say, “O my people, act according to your position , surely, I am also acting(according to mine) ; then you will come to know who will have the future outcome of the(final) Home. Indeed, the unjust never succeed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:136: And they set aside for Allah a share of the(yield of the) fields and the livestock He created, and they said, “This is for Allah,” according to their claim, “and this is for our associates.” But whatever was(deemed) for their associates does not reach Allah, yet whatever was(deemed) for Allah reaches their associates. Evil is their judgment!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:137: Likewise, their associates have adorned for many polytheists the killing of their children in order to topple them and confound for them their religion. And had Allah willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and what they fabricate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:138: And they said, “Such livestock and fields are restricted; none may eat of them except whom we will,” by their claims, and livestock whose backs were forbidden, and livestock over which they do not mentionthe name of Allah—fabricating lies against Him. He will repay them on account of what they used to fabricate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:139: And they said, “What lies in the bellies of such livestock is exclusively for our males and prohibited to our spouses.” But if it is stillborn, they can share in it. He will repay them for their description. Indeed, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:140: Lost indeed are those who killed their children foolishly with no basis in knowledge, and forbade what Allah had provided for them by fabricating(lies) against Allah. Surely, they went astray and never were they guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:141: And it is He Who initiated gardens, both cultivated and wild, and date-palms and vegetation of diverse crops and olives and pomegranates, similar yet dissimilar. Eatof its produce when it has yielded its produce and bring its due on the day of its harvest, and do not be extravagant; surely He does not love the extravagant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:142: And of the livestock are load carriers and those too small. Eat of what Allah has provided you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan; indeed, he is to you an evident enemy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:143: (Suppose there are) eight pairs: of sheep there are two(pairs) and of goats there are two. Say, “Did He forbid the two males or the two females or what the wombs of the two females contain? Informme with knowledge, if you are truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:144: And of camels there are two, and of cattle there are two. Say, “Did He forbid the two males or the two females or what the wombs of the two females contain? Or were you witnesses when Allah admonished you with this?” So who is more unjust than one who fabricated lies against Allah in order to lead mankind astray without knowledge? Indeed, Allah does not guide unjust people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:145: Say, “In what was revealed to me, I find nothing forbidden to any eater who would eat it, except carrion or flowing blood or the flesh of swine—because it is an abomination—or an ungodly offering dedicated to other than Allah. But if anyone is compelled by necessity without being deliberate or transgressing, then indeed, yourLord is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:146: And for the ones who have Judaized We have forbidden everything with claws, and of cattle and sheep We have forbidden them their fat—except what is carried on theirbacks or the entrails or what is mixed with bone. This is how We repaid them for their oppression, and very truly, We are truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:147: So if they disbelieve you, then say, “Your Lord is Possessor of all-embracing mercy, but His chastisement is never turned back from the criminal people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:148: Those who associated(others with God) will say, “Had Allah willed, we would not have associated(others with Him) , nor would have our forefathers, nor would we have prohibited anything.” Likewise, those before them disbelieved until they tasted Our chastisement. Say, “Do you have any knowledge that you can bring forth for us? You follow nothing but assumptions, and you do nothing but guess.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:149: Say, “Yet to Allah belongs the conclusive argument, so had He willed, He would have guided you all.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:150: Say, “Bring your witnesses who would testify that Allah has prohibited this.” So if they testify, do not testify with them. And do not follow the whims of those who disbelieved in Our signs and those who do not believe in the Hereafter and who equate others with their Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:151: Say, “Come, let me tell youwhat your Lord has forbidden: that you shall not associate anything with Him, and towards your parents you shall show kindness, and you shall not kill your children because of poverty—We provide for you and for them, and you shall not come near obscenities—what is apparent of it and what is concealed, and you shall not kill the self which Allah has made inviolable—except in the course of justice. All this He has enjoined upon you, that you may reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:152: And you shall not come near the wealth of the orphan except with the best(intentions) until he reaches his full strength. And you shall give full weight and full measure with justice—We never task any self beyond its capacity. And when youspeak, you shall be fair, even if it concerns a relative. And you shall fulfil your covenant with Allah. All this He has enjoined upon you, that you may remember .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:153: And (know that) this is My path, straight, so followit. And do not follow the(other) ways, lest they divert you from His way. All this He has enjoined upon you, that you may be mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:154: Then We brought Moses the Scripture, perfect for the one who excelled in doing good, and detailing everything, and guidance and mercy, that they may believe in the meeting with their Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:155: And this(too) is a blessed Scripture that We sent down, so followit and be righteous, that you may receive mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:156: Lest yousay, “The Scripture was sent down to two factions before us, and we were indeed oblivious of their teachings.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:157: Or lest you say, “Had the Scripture been sent down to us, we would have been better guided than them.” Most surely, an evident explanation has come to you from your Lord, and guidance and mercy. Who then does greater injustice than one who considered Allah’s signs to be a lie and kept turning away from them? Wewill repay those who keep turning away from Our signs with the worst kind of punishment on account of how they used to constantly turn away.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:158: Are they waiting for anything but for the angels to come to them or for your Lord to come or for some of your Lord’s signs to come? On the day when some of your Lord’s signs come, no self will benefit from attaining faith unless it had attained faith previously or had earned goodness through its faith. Say, “Wait; indeed, we too are waiting.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:159: Indeed, the ones who have caused disunity in their religion and became sects—youhave nothing to do with them. Rather, their case rests with Allah, then He informs them of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:160: Whoever has come up with a good deed—for him there is ten times its like , and whoever has come up with an evil deed will be repaid only with its equivalent, and they will not be dealt with unjustly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:161: Say, “Surely(as for) myself, my Lord has guided me to a straight path—an upright religion —the creed of Abraham who turned away from all that is false, and never was he one of the polytheists.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:162: Say, “Indeed, my prayer and my rites and my way of living and my way of dying are for Allah, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:163: No associate is there for Him, and to this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:164: Say, “Am I to seek a Lord other than Allah when He is the Lord of everything?” And not a single self earns except what it is due, and no bearer of burden bears the burden of another. Then to yourLord is your return, then He will inform you regarding whatever you used to differ over.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.6:165: And it is He Who made you successors on the earth and elevated some of you by degrees over others in order to test you through what He has brought you. Indeed, yourLord is Swift in punishment, and He is most surely Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:2: A Scripture which was sent down to you, so let there be no discomfort in your chest because of it, that you may warn with it, and a reminding for the believers:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:3: “Followwhat was sent down to you from your Lord, and do not follow other guardians apart from Him. Little do you remind yourselves .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:4: And how many a town have We annihilated, such that Our chastisement came upon them while sleeping at night or while they were napping at noon.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:5: But their only cry when Our chastisement came upon them was, “We were indeed unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:6: We will most surely ask those to whom messages were sent, and We will most surely ask the emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:7: Then We will most surely relate to them with knowledge, for We were never absent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:8: And the scale on that day is the truth. So those whose scales weigh heavy—those are the successful,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:9: while those whose scales weigh light—those are the ones who have lost themselves on account of the injustice they used to do regarding our signs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:10: And very truly We have established youin the earth and made for you in it livelihood. Rarely do you give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:11: And very truly We created you, then We designed you, then We said to the angels, “Prostrate to Adam.” So they prostrated—but not Iblis; he was not of those who prostrated themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:12: He said, “What prevented you from prostrating yourself when I commanded you?” He said, “I am better than him; You created me from fire and created him from clay.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:13: He said, “So get down from it, for it is not for you to behave arrogantly in it. So get out! You are indeed one of the belittled!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:14: He said, “Reprieve me until the day they are resurrected.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:15: He said, “You are indeed of those reprieved.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:16: He said, “So because You have deluded me, I will most surely waylay them on Your straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:17: Then I will most surely come at them from before them and from behind them and from their right and from their left, and you will not find most of them appreciative.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:18: He said, “Get out of it, despised, vanquished; whoever of them follows you—I will most surely fill up Hell with you all.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:19: And O Adam, settle in the Garden, you and your spouse, and eat of whatever youwish. But neither one of you shall approach this tree lest youbecome of the unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:20: But Satan whispered to themto reveal to them what had been covered from them of their private parts. And he said, “YourLord has only forbidden youthis tree lest youbecome angels or become of the immortals.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:21: And he swore to them, “I am most surely a sincere advisor to you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:22: So he lured themwith deceit. So when theytasted the tree, their private parts became visible to them and they began covering themselves with the leaves of the Garden, and their Lord called out to them, “Did I not forbid you both from this tree and tell youthat Satan is an evident enemy to you?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:23: Theysaid, “Our Lord, we have been unjust to ourselves. And unless You forgive us and have mercy on us, we will certainly be of the losers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:24: He said, “Descendas enemies to one another, and in the earth you will have a place of settlement and enjoyment for a while.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:25: He said, “In it youlive, and in it you die, and from it you are brought out .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:26: O Children of Adam, We have sent down upon you garments to cover your private parts and for luxury. Butthe garment of mindfulness(of God) —that is better. That is of Allah’s signs, that theymay constantly remember.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:27: O Children of Adam, never let Satan lure you like he brought your parents out of the Garden, stripping them of their garments to show them their private parts. He surely sees you, He and his clan, from where you cannot see them. Indeed, We have made the Satans allies of those who do not believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:28: And when they commit an obscenity, they say, “We found our fathers doing this, and Allah has commanded us to do it.” Say, “Indeed, Allah does not command to obscenities. Are yousaying about Allah what you know not?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:29: Say, “My Lord has commanded justice. And set your faces upright at every mosqueand call upon Him, devoting religion to Him. Just as He originated you, so you will return.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:30: A group He has guided and another group has deserved misguidance. They have taken the Satans as guardians apart from Allah and they assume that they are guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:31: O Children of Adam, take your adornment at every mosque, and eat and drink, but do not be extravagant; surely He does not love the extravagant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:32: Say, “Who has forbidden Allah’s adornment which He has brought out for His servants and the good things among(His) provision?” Say, “They are for those who attained faith in the Earlier Life,exclusively theirs on the Day of Resurrection.” Thus We detail the signsfor people who know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:33: Say, “Indeed, My Lord has only forbidden obscenities—both manifest and secret—and sin and unjustified aggression, and that you associate with Allah that for which He has never bestowedany authority from on high , and that you say about Allah what you know not.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:34: And for every community there is an appointed term. So when their term has arrived, they cannot then delay by one hour nor can they advance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:35: O Children of Adam, whenever messengers from among you come to you, relating to you My signs, then whoever becomes mindful(of God) and reforms—no fear shall beupon themnor shall they grieve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:36: But those who disbelieved in Our signs and were too arrogant to accept them—those are the fellows of the Fire; therein they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:37: So who is more unjust than someone who has fabricated lies against Allah or has considered His signs to be a lie? Those—their share of the decree will reach them. Until, when Our messengers have come to them to take their souls(at death) , they say, “Where is whatever you used to call upon apart from Allah?” They say, “They have strayed from us,” and they testify against themselves that they were deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:38: He said, “Enter with the communities of unseen beingsand humans who have gone into the Fire before you.” Every time a community entered, it cursed its sister-community till, when they were all in it, the last of them said about the first of them, “Our Lord, these are the ones who led us astray, so bring upon them double punishment in the Fire.” He said, “Each will have double, but you knownot.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:39: And the first of them said to the last of them, “Thus you had no advantage over us, so taste the punishment on account of what you used to earn.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:40: Indeed, those who disbelieved in Our signs and were too arrogant to accept them—the gates of the heavenwill not be widely opened for them, nor will they enter the Garden(of Paradise) until the camelpasses through the eye of the needle. And thus We repay the criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:41: For them is Hell as a resting place, and above them are sheets of fire. And thus We repay the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:42: But those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—We never task any self beyond its capacity—those are the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) ; therein they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:43: And We removedwhatever malice was within their chests; rivers flow beneath them. And they said, “Praise be to Allah who has guided us to this, for never would we have been guided had Allah not guided us; most surely, the messengers of our Lord did come with the truth.” And it was called out to them, “This is the Garden(of Paradise) you are made to inherit on account of what you used to do.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:44: And the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) called out to the fellows of the Fire, “We certainly found what our Lord had promised us to be true, so did you find what your Lord had promised you to be true?” They said, “Yes.” Thereupon an announcer called out in their midst, “Let the curse of Allah be upon the unjust,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:45: who bar(people) from the way of Allah and seek to make it crooked, while regarding the Hereafter they are deniers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:46: And between them isa partition, and on the elevations are men who recognize everyone by their features. And they calledto the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) , “Peace be upon you.” They have not entered it, but they are ardently hoping.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:47: And when their sight(s) are directed towards the fellows of the Fire, they say, “Our Lord, do not place us with the unjust people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:48: Then the fellows of the elevations calledout to men whom they recognize by their features. They said, “In no way did your multitude avail you, nor did your arrogance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:49: “Are these the ones youswore Allah would not touch with mercy? Enter the Garden(of Paradise) ; no fear is upon you, nor shall you grieve.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:50: And the fellows of the Fire called out to the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) , “Pour some water over us or some of what Allah has provided for you.” They said, “Allah has indeed forbidden them for the deniers
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:51: who took their religion as a distraction and a game, and whom the Earlier Life deceived.” So today We forget them like they forgot the meeting on this day of theirs and for how they used to repudiate Our signs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:52: And most surely, We have given them a Scripture which We have detailed with knowledge—guidance and mercy for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:53: Are they waiting for anything but its fulfillment? The day its fulfillment comes true, those who forgot it earlier will say, “The messengers of our Lord did come with the truth, so do we have any intercessors to intercede for us? Or could we be returned back to behave differently from the way we behaved before?” They have certainly lost themselves, and whatever they used to fabricate strayed away from them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:54: Indeed, yourLord is Allah, the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six daysthen settled over the Throne. He causes the night to overwhelm the day, pursuing it persistently, for the sun and the moon and the stars are subjected by His command. Truly, His is the creation and the command. Supremely Blessed be Allah, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:55: Call upon your Lord in supplication and in secret. Indeed, He does not love the transgressors.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:56: And do not corrupt the earth after its reformation, and call upon Him with fear and ardent hope. Indeed, Allah’s mercy is close to those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:57: And it is He Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings ahead of His mercy until, when they carry up heavy clouds, Wedrive them to a lifeless land where We send down water, and with it We bring out all kinds of products. Thus We bring out the dead, that you may remind yourselves .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:58: And the good land—its plants come out by the leave of its Lord, whereas that which has become nasty does not come out unless useless. Thus Wediversify the signs for people who give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:59: Very truly, We sent Noah to his people. So he said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great day.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:60: The chiefs of his people said, “We surely see that you are in evident misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:61: He said, “O my people, there is no misguidance in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:62: I proclaim to you the messages of my Lord and I advise you, and I know from Allah what you do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:63: Are you amazed that a reminder has come to you from your Lord upon a man from among you, to warn you and that you might be mindful(of God) and that you may receive mercy?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:64: But they disbelieved him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and We drowned those who disbelieved in Our signs. Indeed, they were a blind people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:65: And to ʻĀd, their brother Hud. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not be mindful(of Him) ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:66: The chiefs of his people, who denied, said, “We surely see that you are in foolishness and we surely think that you are one of the liars.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:67: He said, “O my people, there is no foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:68: I proclaim to you the messages of my Lord, and I am a trustworthy adviser to you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:69: Are you amazed that a reminder has come to you from your Lord upon a man from among you, to warn you? And call to mind when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you greatly in stature, and remember Allah’s blessings, that you may succeed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:70: They said, “Have you come to us in order for us to worship Allah alone and leave what our forefathers used to worship? So bring us what you threaten us with, if you are one of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:71: He said, “Abomination and wrath have surely befallen you from your Lord. Are you arguing with me over names which you and your forefathers invented, for which Allah sent down no authority? So wait; I am indeed with you among those waiting.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:72: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us, and We cut off the roots of those who disbelieved in Our signs and never attained faith.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:73: And to Thamûd, their brother Saleh. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him; an evident proof has certainly come to you from your Lord: this she-camel of Allah is a sign for you, so let her eat in Allah’s land and do not touch her with any harm lest a painful punishment seize you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:74: “And call to mind when He made you successors after ʻĀd and settled you in the land, taking for yourselves palaces on its plains and carving out houses of the mountains. So remember Allah’s marvels and do not go wickedly about the land, corrupting it.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:75: The chiefs of his people, who acted arrogantly, said to those who had been deemed weak and oppressed—those who had attained faith from among them, “Do you know that Saleh is an emissary from his Lord?” They said, “We are indeed believers in what he has been sent with.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:76: Those who acted arrogantly said, “Indeed, we deny what you believe in.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:77: So they hamstrung the she-camel and defied the command of their Lord and said, “O Saleh, bring upon us what you threaten us with, if you are one of the emissaries.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:78: Thereupon the Tremor overtook them, and they became lifeless bodies in their home.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:79: Then he turned away from them and said, “O my people, I have proclaimed to you the message of my Lord and I have advised you, but you do not like those who give advice.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:80: And Lot, when he said to his people, “Do you commit such obscenity with which no one in all communities has preceded you?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:81: “You do approach men with desire instead of women. Rather, you are an extremist people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:82: And his people’s only response was to say, “Evict them from your town; indeed, they are a group of people who always keep themselves clean.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:83: So We saved him and his family, except for his woman; she was of those who lingered behind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:84: And We rained down on them a rain! So look what the outcome was for the criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:85: And to Midian, their brother Shuaib. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him; an evident proof has come to you from your Lord, so give full measure and balance, and do not defraud people of their belongings, and do not corrupt the land once it has been reformed. That is better for you, if you are believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:86: And do not sit on every path, making threats and barring from the way of Allah those who have attained faith in Him, seeking to make it crooked. And call to mind when you were few, then He made you numerous. So look what the outcome was for the corrupters.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:87: And since a faction of you have come to believe in what I was sent with and a faction have not come to believe, then be patient until Allah judges between us, for He is the Best of judges.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:88: The chiefs of his people, who acted arrogantly, said “O Shuaib, We will surely evict you from our town, along with those who have attained faith with you, unless you do indeed return to our creed.” He said, “Even if we are reluctant?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:89: We would definitely be fabricating lies against Allah if we were to return to your creed after Allah has delivered us from it. And it is not for us to return to it unless Allah, our Lord, wills. Our Lord has encompassed everything in knowledge. In Allah we have placed our trust. Our Lord, legislatejustly between us and our people, for You are the Best of legislators.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:90: And the chiefs of his people, who denied, said, “If you follow Shuaib, you will definitely be losers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:91: Thereupon, the Tremor overtook them, and they became lifeless bodies in their home.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:92: Those who disbelieved Shuaib—(it was) as if they never prospered therein. Those who disbelieved Shuaib—it was they who were the losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:93: So he turned away from them and said, “O my people, I have proclaimed to you the messages of my Lord and I have advised you, so how should I grieve over a denying people?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:94: And never did We send any prophet to any town but We afflicted its people with misery andadversity, that they may earnestly supplicate(Us) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:95: Then We substituted good in place of evil until they thrived and said, “Adversity and prosperity have touched our forefathers.” Then We seized them suddenly while they were unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:96: Yet had the people of the towns attained faith and become mindful(of God) , We would surely have opened for them blessings from the heaven and the earth. But they disbelieved, so We seized them for what they used to earn.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:97: Do the fellows of the towns feel secure that Our chastisement will not come upon them by night while they are sleeping?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:98: And do the fellows of the towns really feel secure that Our chastisement will not come upon them by day while they are playing?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:99: Do they feel safe from Allah’s scheme? None feel safe from Allah’s scheme except people who are losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:100: Is it not guidance for those who inherit the land after its fellows that if We willed, We could strike them for their misdeeds, and seal up their hearts so that they would not hear?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:101: These towns—We relate to you some of their stories. For very truly their messengers came to them with evident proofs, but they would not believe in what they had disbelieved earlier. Thus Allah seals the hearts of the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:102: And We did not find most of them true to their covenants; rather, We did find most of them defiantly disobedient.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:103: Then, after them, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they did injustice to them. So look what the outcome was for the corrupters.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:104: And Moses said, “O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of all realms,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:105: committed to saying nothing about Allah but the truth. I have surely come to youwith an evident proof from your Lord, so sendwith me the Children of Israel.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:106: He said, “If you have come with a sign, then present it, if you are of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:107: So he cast his staff and, lo and behold, it was an evident serpent!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:108: And He pulled out his hand and, lo and behold, it was white for the viewers!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:109: The chiefs among Pharaoh’s people said, “This is most surely a knowledgeable sorcerer
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:110: who wants to evict you from your land, so what is it that you command?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:111: They said, “Put him off, and his brother, and send summoners to the cities
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:112: to bring you every knowledgeable sorcerer .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:113: Thus the sorcerers came to Pharaoh. They said, “Surely there is a reward for us if we are the overcomers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:114: He said, “Yes, and you will most surely become of those brought near(to me) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:115: They said, “O Moses! Either you cast, or we will be the ones to cast.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:116: He said, “You cast!” So when they cast, they affected the eyes of the people with sorcery and intimidated them and came up with great sorcery.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:117: And We revealed to Moses: “Throw your staff,” and, lo and behold, it swallowed what they were faking!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:118: Thus the truth came to pass, and what they were doing went to waste.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:119: So there and then they were overcome and they returned, utterly belittled.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:121: They said, “We have attained faith in the Lord of all realms,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:122: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:123: Pharaoh said, “How dare you believe in Him before I have given you permission? This is surely a scheme you schemed in the city in order to evict its people from it, but you will come to know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:124: I will most surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, then I will most surely crucify you all.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:125: They said, “Indeed, it is to our Lord that we will return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:126: You only resent us because we have believed in the signs of our Lord when they have come to us. Our Lord, pour out patience upon us and take us at death as Muslims.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:127: And the chiefs of Pharaoh’s people said, “Will you leave Moses and his people to corrupt in the land and leave you and your gods?” He said, “We will relentlesslykill their sons and keep their women alive(in bondage) , and indeed, we are subjugators over them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:128: Moses said to his people, “Beseech Allah for help and be patient; indeed, the earth belongs to Allah: He gives it in inheritance to whomever He wills of His servants, and the future outcome belongs to the mindful(of God) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:129: They said, “We were hurt before you came to us and after you came to us.” He said, “Hopefully your Lord will destroy your enemy and make you successors in the land, then He will look at how you act.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:130: And We afflicted Pharaoh’s folk with years(of drought) and with shortage of products, that they may constantly remember.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:131: Yet when good came to them, they said, “This is ours,” and whenever something bad would afflict them, they would ascribe the evil omen to Moses and those with him. Undoubtedly, their omen is indeed solely with Allah, but most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:132: And they said, “No matter what sign you bring us to bewitch us with, never shall we believe in you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:133: So We sent upon them the flood and the locusts and the lice and the frogs and blood—all explicit signs—but they acted arrogantly, and they were a criminal people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:134: And when the torment befell them, they said, “O Moses, pray to your Lord for us according to the covenant He made with you; if you lift the torment from us, we will most surely believe in you, and we will most surely send the Children of Israel with you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:135: But when We lifted the torment from them for a term they were to fulfill, they promptly broke their promise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:136: So We took retribution on them and drowned them in the waters because they rejected Our signs and were oblivious of them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:137: And We made those who had been deemed weak and oppressed inherit the eastern and western territories of the land which We had blessed. Thus the fair word of your Lord to the Children of Israel was fulfilled because of their endurance, and We destroyed what Pharaoh and his people had done and what they were building.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:138: And We made the Children of Israel pass over the sea, then they came upon a people who were devoted to some human-shaped idols of theirs. They said, “O Moses, make for us a god as they have gods.” He said, “You are truly speaking ignorantly.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:139: “What these people are concerned with is surely doomed to perdition, and whatever they used to do is false.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:140: He said, “Shall I seek for you a god other than Allah when He has favored you over all communities?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:141: And recall how We savedyou from Pharaoh’s folk who inflicted upon you an evil punishment, relentlessly killing your sons and keeping your women alive(in bondage) . And in that was a great test from your Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:142: And We appointed forMoses thirty nights, and completed them with ten. And thus the time appointed by his Lordwas forty nights. And Moses said to his brother Aaron: “Take my place among my people, and be upright, and do not follow the way of the corrupters.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:143: And when Moses came for Our appointment and his Lordspoke to him, he said, “My Lord, let me see—to look upon You.” He said, “You will not see Me, but look at the mountain—if it(still) resides in its place, you will see Me.” But when his Lord manifested Himself to the mountain, He turned it into rubble , and Moses fell down unconscious. Then when he recovered, he said, “Highly Exalted are You; I have indeed repented to you, and I am the first of the believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:144: He said, “O Moses, I have indeed chosen you above mankind for My messages and for My Words, so take what I have given you and be one of the thankful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:145: And We inscribed for him in the Tablets all kinds of admonition and a detailed explanation of everything. “So holdfast to them and command your people to adopt the best of them. I will show youthe(final) Home of the defiantly disobedient.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:146: I will turn away from My signs those who behave arrogantly on earth without justification. And even if they see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of prudence, they will not adopt it for a way; while if they see the way of delusion, they will adopt it for a way. That is because they disbelieved in Oursigns and were oblivious of them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:147: And those who disbelieved in Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter—their deeds were nullified. Will they be repaid except for what they used to do?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:148: And in his absence the people of Moses took a calf made from their ornaments—a body which lowed. Did they not see that it could not speak to them or guide them to any way? They took it(for worship) , and thus they became unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:149: Then when they felt incapacitatedand they realized that they had gone astray, they said, “Unless our Lord extends His mercy to us and forgives us , we will be of the losers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:150: And when Moses returned to his people, wrathful(and) sorrowful, he said, “What a miserable thing you have done in my absence! Were you impatient over the command of your Lord?” And he threw down the Tablets and he took hold of his brother’s head, pulling him towards himself. He said, “Son of my mother, the people deemed me weak and were about to kill me, so do not allow the enemies to gloat over me and do not count me among the unjust people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:151: He said, “My Lord, forgive me and my brother and enter us into Your mercy, for You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:152: Indeed, those who took the calf will be afflicted by wrath from their Lord and humiliation in the Earlier Life. And thus do We repay the fabricators of falsehood.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:153: Yet those who have done evil deeds and then repented and attained faith—your Lord, thereafter, is surely Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:154: And when the wrath abated in Moses, he took up the Tablets. And in their transcript is guidance and mercy for those in awe of their Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:155: And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment, then when the Tremor overtook them, he said, “My Lord, had You willed, You could have annihilated them before, and me too. Will You annihilate us for what the fools among us have done? This is but Your test—with it You lead astray whomever You will and guide whomever You will; You are our Ultimate Guardian, so forgive us and have mercy on us, and You are the best of forgivers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:156: And inscribe for us goodness in this Earlier(Life) and in the Hereafter. We have Judaizedto You.” He said, “My punishment—I inflict it upon whomever I will, but My mercy has encompassed everything, so I will inscribe it for those who are mindful(of God) and bringthe purifying charity, and those who believe in Our signs—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:157: those who follow the Messenger, the gentileProphet whom they find written in the Torah and the Gospel—in their possession—commanding them to what is fair and forbidding them what is deplorable, and allowing for them all good things and prohibiting for them nasty things, and unloading their heavy load and the shackles that were upon them. So those who have attained faith in him and have respected him and have supported him and have followed the light that came down with him—those are the successful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:158: Say, “O mankind, I am indeed the Messenger of Allah to you all—He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; there is no god but He. He gives life and causes death, so believe in Allah and HisMessenger, the gentileProphet who believes in Allah and His words, and follow him, that you may be guided.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:159: And of the people of Moses is a community that guides by truth and thereby acts with justice.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:160: And We divided them into twelve tribal communities. And We revealed to Moses when his people asked him for something to drink: “Strike the rock with your staff,” whereupon twelve springs gushed from it; each group of people certainly recognized its drinking-place. And We shaded them with clouds and We sent down upon them manna and quails: “Eat of the good things We have provided for you.” And they were not unjust to Us, but to themselves they used to do injustice.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:161: And recall when it was said to them, “Settle in this town and eat therein whatever you wish and speak modestly and enter the gate in humility—We will forgive you your offenses , and will give more to those who excel in doing good.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:162: Then the ones who did injustice among them substituted another word for the word said to them, so We sent down upon them a torment from heaven on account of how they used to do injustice.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:163: And ask them about the town by the sea when they violated the Sabbath. When they observed the Sabbath, their fish would come to them abundantly. But when they violated the Sabbath, their fish would not come to them. Thus We tried them on account of how they used to be defiantly disobedient.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:164: And recall when a group of them said, “Why do you admonish a people whom Allah will annihilate or punish with a severe punishment?” They said, “As an excuse to your Lord, and so that they may become mindful(of God) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:165: Then when they forgotwhat they were reminded of, We saved those who forbidevil, and We seized those who did injustice with a terrible punishment on account of how they used to be defiantly disobedient.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:166: Then when they rebelled against what they had been forbidden to do, We said to them, “Be despicable apes.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:167: And recall when your Lord announced that He would most surely send against them someone who would inflict terrible punishment upon them until the Day of Resurrection. Your Lord is most surely swift in punishment, and He is most surely Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:168: And We scattered them into communities on earth—some of them righteous and some of them short of that—and We tested them with good and evil, that they may return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:169: Thus they were succeeded by generations who inherited the Scripture while seizing the materials of this lower(world) , and saying, “We will be forgiven.” And should similar materials come their way, they would again seize them. Was not the pledge of the Scripture taken by them, to say nothing about Allah but the truth? Did they not study its contents? But the Home of the Hereafter is better for the mindful(of God) . Will you not reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:170: And those who adhere strictly to the Scripture and have establishedthe prayer—indeed, We do not waste the reward of the reformers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:171: And recall when We suspended the mountain over them as if it was a dark cloud, and they thought it would fall on them: “Holdfast to what We have given you and remember what it contains, that you may remain mindful(of God) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:172: And recall when Your Lord summoned the offspring of the children of Adam from their loins and made them testify about themselves, “Am I not your Lord?” They said, “Yes, we do testify.” Thus you cannot sayon the Day of Resurrection, “We were oblivious of this.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:173: Nor can you say, “Our forefathers practiced polytheism before, and we were their offspring who came after them. Will you annihilate us for what the advocates of falsehood did?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:174: And thus We detail the signs, and that they may return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:175: And relate to them the story of the one to whom We brought Our signs, but he detached himself from them, so Satan went after him and he became of the deluded.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:176: And had We willed, We could have elevated him through them, but he clung to the ground and followed his whim. Thus his example is like that of a dog: if you chase it, it pants; and if you leave it alone, it pants. Such is the likeness of the people who disbelieved in Our signs. So narrate the narratives, that they may reflect.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:177: Evil is the parable of the people who disbelieved in Our signs and to themselves they used to do injustice.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:178: Whomever Allah guides is the guided one, and whomever He misguides—thoseare the losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:179: We have destined for Hell multitudes of unseen beingsand humans; they have hearts with which they do not comprehend, and have eyes with which they do not see, and have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like cattle; in fact, they are further astray. Those are the oblivious.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:180: And to Allah belong the most beautiful names, so use them to call upon Him, and leave aside those who blaspheme His names. They will be repaid for what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:181: And of those We created is a community that guides by truth and does justice thereby.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:182: But those who disbelieved in Our signs—We will draw them forth gradually(to punishment) from where they do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:183: And Iwill give them respite. Indeed, My plot is firm.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:184: Have they not reflected? There is no madness in their fellow; he is but an evident warner.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:185: Have they not looked into the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all the things that Allah created and that perhaps their time may have drawn near? In what discourse beyond this will they believe?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:186: Whomever Allah leads astray has no guide, and He leaves them to wander aimlessly while exceeding all limits.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:187: They ask you about the Hour, “When will it take place?” Say, “Knowledge of it rests with my Lord; none can reveal its coming except He. Heavy has its weight become throughout the heavens and the earth. It comes not upon you except suddenly.” They ask you as if you are responsible for it. Say, “Surely, knowledge of it but rests with Allah,” though most of mankind do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:188: Say, “I have no power to benefit or harm(even) myself, except as Allah wills. And had I known the hidden realm, I would have acquired much good, and no harm would have touched me. I am only a warner and a herald of glad tidings to people who believe.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:189: It is He Who created you from a single self and made from it its spouse, that he may find rest with her; then when he coveredher, she carried a light(load of) pregnancy, then she passed by with it. But when she grew heavy, theycalled upon Allah, their Lord, “If You give us a righteous one, we will most surely be of the thankful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:190: But when He gave them a righteous one, they set associates with Him in what He has given them. Rather, Most High is Allah above what they associate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:191: Do they associate(with God) what creates nothing and are themselvescreated?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:192: And can neither support them nor support themselves?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:193: And if youcall them to guidance, they do not follow you. It is the same for you whether you call them or remain silent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:194: Indeed, those you call upon apart from Allah are servants like you, so call upon them and let them respond to you if you are truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:195: Do they have feet with which they walk, or do they have hands with which they strike, or do they have eyes with which they see, or do they have ears with which they hear? Say, “Callupon your associates, then plot against me and give me no respite.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:196: Indeed, my Ultimate Guardian is Allah, Who bestowed the Scripture from on high, and He guards the righteous,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:197: while those you call upon apart from Him cannot support you nor can they support themselves.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:198: And if you call them to guidance, they do not hear. And you see them looking at you, yet they do not see.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:199: Take the course of pardoning, and command to benevolence, and disregard ignorant harassers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:200: And if youare ever spurred by a spurring from Satan, then seek refuge with Allah; indeed, He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:201: Indeed, those who are mindful(of God) —when an impulse from Satan touches them, they remind themselves and immediately see(the truth) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:202: But their brethren lead them relentlessly into delusion, and they never stop short.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:203: If you do not bring them a sign, they say, “Why don’t you improvise one.” Say, “I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord.” This(Scripture) is insights from your Lord, and guidance and mercy for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:204: Thus when the Recitalis recited, then listento it and pay attention, that you may receive mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:205: And remember yourLord within yourself in supplication and in fear, and without being loud of voice, in the mornings and before sunset; and do not be of the oblivious.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.7:206: Indeed, those who are in the presence of your Lord are not too arrogant to worship Him, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:1: They ask youabout the spoils(of war) . Say, “The spoils are for Allah and the Messenger, so bemindful of Allah and reconcile between yourselves and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you are believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:2: Surely, the believers are but those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned, and when His signsare read to them they increase them in faith, and in their Lord they place their trust—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:3: the ones who establish the prayer and from what We have provided them they spend.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:4: Those are truly the believers; for them are degrees(of rank) with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:5: Just as when yourLord brought you out of your house with the truth, while a group of believers were definitely reluctant,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:6: arguing with you about the truth after it became evident, as if they were being driven to death while they looked on.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:7: And recall: Allah promising youone of the two factions—that it would be yours, and you wishing that the unarmed group be yours. Yet Allah wants to uphold the truth with His words and to uproot the deniers
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:8: in order to uphold the truth and nullify falsehood, even if the criminals dislike it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.8:9: Recall: youcrying for help from your Lord, so He responded to you, “I am surely reinforcing you with one thousand angels in succession .”
