Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:40: Until, when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, “Carry in it, ofeach kind, a male and female couple , and your family—except those against whom the sentence has already been passed—and those who have attained faith.” But none attained faith with him except a few.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:41: And he said, “Embark in it. In the name of Allah shall be its sailing and its anchorage. My Lord is most surely Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:42: And so it sailswith them amidst waves like mountains. And Noah called to his son who had kept away, “O my child! Embark with us and do not be with the deniers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:43: He said, “I will take shelter on a mountain which can safeguard me from the water.” He said, “There is no safeguard from Allah’s command today, except for the one on whom He has bestowed mercy.” And the waves surged between them, and he became of the drowned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:44: And it was said, “O land, swallow your waters,” and “O sky, clear up.” And the waters receded, and the matter was concluded, and it settled on(mount) Judei, and it was said: “Away with the unjust people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:45: And Noah called to his Lord and said, “O My Lord, my son is indeed of my family, and Your promise is indeed the truth, and You are the Wisest of all judges.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:46: He said, “O Noah, he is not of your family; surely, it is an unrighteous deed , so do not ask Me about something you know nothing about; I surely admonish you lest you be one of the ignorant.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:47: He said, “O My Lord, I do seek refuge with You from asking You about what I have no knowledge of, and unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I will be one of the losers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:48: It was said, “O Noah, disembark with peace from Us, and with blessings upon you and upon communities that will spring from those with you. And to(other) communities We shall grant enjoyment, then a painful punishment from Us will touch them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:49: That is of the stories of the hidden realm which we reveal to you; never were you nor your people to know them before this, so be patient; the future outcome surely belongs to the people who are mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:50: And to ʻĀd, their brother Hud. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no other god but Him; you are nothing but fabricators.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:51: O my people, I ask you no reward for it; my reward is only from the One Who originated me. Do you not reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:52: And, O my people, ask forgiveness from your Lord then repent to Him. He will send down abundant rain from the sky for you and will add strength to your strength. But do not turn away as criminals.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:53: They said, “O Hud, you did not come to us with any evident proof, and we shall not abandon our gods for your words, and we shall not believe in you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:54: We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil.” He said, “I call Allah to witness, and you to witness, that I am innocent of what you associate
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:55: apart from Him. So plot against me, all together, then do not reprieve me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:56: I have indeed placed my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is not a treading creature but He holds it by its forelock; indeed, my Lord is on a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:57: But if they turn away, then I have conveyed to you what I was sent to you with. And my Lord will make other people succeed you, and you will not harm Him at all. My Lord is indeed a Constant Preserver over everything.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:58: Thus when Our command came, We delivered Hud and those who had attained faith with him, by mercy from Us, and We delivered them from a harsh punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:59: And that was ʻĀd: they repudiated the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the command of every stubborn tyrant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:60: And they were pursued by a curse in this Earlier(Life) and on the Day of Resurrection. Undoubtedly, ʻĀd did deny their Lord. Undoubtedly, away with ʻĀd, the people of Hud.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:61: And to Thamûd, their brother Saleh. He said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him; He initiated you from the earth and assigned you to develop it, so seek His forgiveness and then repent to Him. My Lord is indeed Near, Responsive.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:62: They said, “O Saleh, we had hopes in you before this. Are you forbidding us from worshiping what our parents worship? And most surely, we are in serious doubt regarding what you are calling us to.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:63: He said, “O my people, have you seen: if I rely on evident proof from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Him? Who then would support me against Allah if I disobeyed Him? For you add nothing to me except causing losses.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:64: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah—a sign for you—so let her graze in Allah’s land and do not touch her with any harm lest an imminent punishment overtake you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:65: But they hamstrung her, so he said, “Enjoy yourselves in your home for three days; that is a promise not to be belied.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:66: Then when Our command came, We delivered Saleh and those who had attained faith with him, by mercy from Us, and from the disgrace of that day. Indeed, your Lordis the All-Powerful, the Almighty.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:67: And those who had done injustices were taken away by the Shout and became motionless bodies in their homes,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:68: as if they had never prospered therein. Undoubtedly, Thamûd did deny their Lord. Undoubtedly, away with Thamûd.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:69: And very truly, Our messengers came to Abraham with glad tidings. They said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace,” and soon after he came with a roasted calf.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:70: But when he saw their hands not reaching towards it, he distrusted them and conceived a fear of them. They said, “Do not fear; we have indeed been sent to the people of Lot.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:71: And his wife was standing by, so she laughed. And We gave her glad tidings of Isaac, and after Isaac, Jacob.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:72: She said, “Woe to me. Shall I give birth when I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? This is truly an amazing thing!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:73: They said, “Are you amazed at the command of Allah? The mercy and blessings of Allah are upon you, O people of the house. He is indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:74: And when Abraham’s fear had subsided and the glad tidings had reached him—he argueswith Us concerning the people of Lot.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:75: Most surely, Abraham is forbearing, imploring, penitent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:76: “O Abraham, disregard this; surely your Lord’s command has come, and an irreversible punishment shall surely be brought upon them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:77: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was troubled over them and concerned for them, and he said, “This is a dreadful day.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:78: And his people came rushing towards him, while earlier they were in the habit of doing evil deeds. He said, “O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you, so be mindful of Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not one prudent man among you?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:79: They said, “You have(long) known that we have no right to your daughters, and surely you know well what we want.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:80: He said, “If only I had strength against you or could rely on some intense support.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:81: They said, “O Lot, we are the messengers of your Lord; they will not reach you, so take your family on a journey while yet a part of the night remains, and let none of you look back. But not your wife —she will be afflicted by that which afflicts them. Indeed, their appointed time is the morning. Is not the morning near?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:82: And when Our command came, We turned it upside down, and We rained down on it stones of baked clay,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:83: marked from yourLord, and never far from the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:84: And to Midian, their brother Shuaib. He said, “O my people, worship Allah—you have no god other than Him—and do not give short measure or short weight. I see you are prospering, but I fear for you the punishment of an encompassing day.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:85: “O my people, give full measure and full weight with justice, and do not defraud people of their belongings, and do not go wickedly about the land, corrupting it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:86: A remnant which is granted by Allah is better for you, if you are believers. And I am not a constant preserver over you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:87: They said, “O Shuaib, does your prayer command you that we abandon what our fathers worship or that we should not do with our wealth whatever we will? Very truly, you are the forbearing, prudent one!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:88: He said, “O my people, can you see? What if I rely on evident proof from my Lord and He has provided me with good provision from Himself? And I have no desire to do what I forbid you from doing. I desire nothing but reform as far as I can. And in no way is my success with anyone except with Allah.In Him I have placed my trust, and to Him I turn penitently.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:89: And O my people, let not your hostility towards me cause you to suffer what was suffered by the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Saleh; and the people of Lot are not far off from you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:90: And ask your Lord for forgiveness and then repent to Him; my Lord is indeed Bestowing of mercy, Most Loving.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:91: They said, “O Shuaib, we do not comprehend much of what you say, and we see that you are weak among us; and were it not for your clan, we would have stoned you, for you have no might against us.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:92: He said, “O my people, is my clan mightier to you than Allah? And you have turned your backs on Him? Indeed, my Lord is All-Encompassing of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:93: And O my people, act according to your position ; surely, I am also acting(according to mine) ; you will know to whom will come a punishment that disgraces him and who it is that is a liar. So wait and watch; surely I too am watching out with you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:94: And when Our command came, We delivered Shuaib and those who had attained faith with him, by mercy from Us. And the Shout took away those who had done injustices, so they became motionless bodies in their homes
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:95: as if they had never prospered therein. Undoubtedly, away with Midian as was done away with Thamûd.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:96: And very surely, We sent Moses with Our signs and an evident manifestation
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:97: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and never was the command of Pharaoh prudent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:98: He precedes his people on the Day of Resurrection, and he ledthem into the Fire, and what a miserable drinking place to be led to!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:99: And they were followed by a curse in this(life) and on the Day of Resurrection; what a miserable gift to be gifted!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:100: That is of the stories of the towns—We relate them to you; some are still standing and some have withered away.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:101: And in no way did We do them any injustice, but to themselves they did injustice, so their gods whom they called upon apart from Allah availed them nothing when the command of your Lord arrived, and they did not increase them in anything but ruin.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:102: And such is the seizing of your Lord when He seizes the towns while they are unjust. His seizing is indeed most painful, most severe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:103: Indeed, in that is a sign for whoever fears the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a day for which mankind will be gathered together, and that is a day to be witnessed,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:104: and we only postpone it until a predetermined term.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:105: On the day when it arrives, not a single self can speak without His leave, so some will be wretched and some will be happy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:106: So as for the wretched ones, they are in the Fire—they have therein sighing and gasping,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:107: abiding therein for as long as the heavens and the earth remain, except as your Lord has willed. Indeed, yourLord is Doer of whatever He wants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:108: And as for the ones who have been granted happiness , they are in the Garden(of Paradise) , abiding therein for as long as the heavens and the earth remain, except as your Lord has willed—an uninterrupted grant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:109: So do not regard what these people worship with skepticism. They do not worship except as their fathers used to worship before, and most surely We will pay them their due in full, undiminished.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:110: And indeed We already brought Moses the Scripture, but it was differed upon. And were it not for a word that had preceded from your Lord, judgment would have been decreed between them, and they are most surely in perplexing doubt concerning it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:111: Yet indeed , to every one of them your Lord will certainly render in full(the reward) for their deeds; indeed, He is All-Aware of what they do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:112: So beupright as you have been commanded, along with whoever has repented with you, and donot exceed all limits; indeed, He is All-Seeing of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:113: And do not rely on those who have done injustices or the Fire will touch you, and you will have no guardians apart from Allah, and you will not be supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:114: And establishthe prayer at both extremities of the day and in the early hours of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with evil deeds. That is a reminding for those who remember.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:115: And bepatient, for surely Allah does not waste the reward of those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:116: So if only there were, among the generations before you, people with a remnant(of wisdom) forbidding corruption in the land, other than the few of them whom We saved. But the unjust ones pursued the luxuries they were indulged in, and thus became criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:117: And in no way would your Lord destroy towns unjustly while their inhabitants are reformers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:118: And had yourLord willed, He could have made mankind one community, but they continue to differ,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:119: except those upon whom your Lord has bestowed mercy—and for that reason He created them. And the Word of your Lord has been fulfilled: “I will most surely fill Hell with(the race of) unseen beingsand human beings, both together.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:120: And all what We relate to you of the stories of the messengers is to strengthen your heart therewith. And the truth has come to you in this, and an admonition and a reminder for the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:121: And say to those who do not believe, “Act according to your position ; surely, we are also acting(according to ours) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:122: And wait; indeed, we too are waiting.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.11:123: And to Allah belongs the hidden realm of the heavens and the earth, and to Him every matter is returned . So worshipHim and place your trust in Him, for your Lord is not oblivious of what youdo .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:1: Alif Lām Ra. Those are the signsof the Evident Scripture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:2: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Recital, that youmay reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:3: We relate to youthe most beautiful of stories by revealing to you this Recital, although prior to it you were indeed one of the oblivious.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:4: Recall when Joseph said to his father, “O my father, I saw eleven planets and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:5: He said, “O my child, do not relate your vision to your brothers, lest they plot a plot against you; indeed, Satan is an evident enemy to man.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:6: And thus your Lord will choose you and teach you of the interpretation of dreams and perfect His blessing upon you and upon Jacob’s folk, as He perfected it before upon both of your forefathers Abraham and Isaac; indeed, your Lord is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:7: Very truly, there have been signs in Joseph and his brothers for the askers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:8: Recall when they said, “Joseph and his brother are certainly dearer to our father than we are, although we are a(whole) band. Most surely, our father is in evident misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:9: “Kill Joseph or throw him somewhere in the land, and your father‘s attention will be yours, then afterwards you become righteous people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:10: Oneof them said, “Do not kill Joseph, but cast him into the invisible cavity of the unlined well—some travelers may pick him up—if you must do something.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:11: They said, “O our father, why do you not trust us with Joseph, when we are most surely his advisors?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:12: Send him with us tomorrow, that he may eat welland play, and we are most surely his preservers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:13: He said, “It surely grieves me that you should go away with him, and I fear the wolf may eat him while you are oblivious of(what happens to) him.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:14: They said, “If the wolf should eat him while we are a(whole) band, then most surely, we would be losers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:15: So when they went away with him and agreed to put him into the invisible cavityof the unlined well, and We revealed to him, “You will surely inform them of this affair of theirs while they are unaware.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:16: And they came to their father in the evening, weeping.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:17: They said, “O our father, we went off racing one another and left Joseph by our belongings, so the wolf ate him. But in no way would you believe us, even if we were truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:18: And they came with falseblood on his shirt. He said, “Rather, your(inner) selves prompted you(to do) something, so beautiful patience(is most fitting for me) , and Allah alone is besought for help against what you describe.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:19: And there came some travelers, so they sent their water-carrier, then he let down his bucket. He said, “What gladtidings ! Here is a boy!” And they hid him as merchandise. Yet Allah is All-Knowing of what they do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:20: And they sold him for a cheap price—a few coins, and they were of those undervaluing him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:21: Yet the man from Egypt who purchased him said to his wife, “Tend graciously to his dwelling; hopefully he may be useful to us, or we may take him as a son.” And thus We established Joseph in the land, and so that we might teach him of the interpretation of dreams. And Allah always prevailsin His affairs, yet the majority of mankind does not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:22: And when he had attained full strength, We brought him wise judgment and knowledge, for thus do We repay those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:23: Then she in whose house he was living sought to seduce him, and she shut the doors and said, “(Everything is) ready for you.” He said, “God is my refuge! He is my lord, who has given me a good dwelling; indeed, the unjust ones never succeed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:24: And surely, she advanced towards him, and he would have advanced towards her had he not seen the proof of his Lord. Thus it was, so that We would divert evil and obscenity away from him; indeed, he is one of Our sincere chosen servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:25: And they raced towards the door, and she tore his shirt from behind, and at the door they ran into her master. She said, “What is the penalty for someone who wanted evil towards your family except imprisonment or a painful punishment?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:26: He said, “It was she who sought to seduce me.” And a witness from her own family testified: “If his shirt has been torn from the front, then she has told the truth and he is of the liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:27: But if his shirt has been torn from the back, then she has lied and he is of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:28: Then when he saw that his shirt had been torn from the back, he said, “This is indeed of yourplotting; indeed, your plotting is great!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:29: “Joseph, disregard this. And you(woman) , ask forgiveness for your misdeed; indeed, you have been one of the wrongdoers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:30: And some ladies in the city said, “The mighty governor’s wife seeks to seduce her young assistant; he has certainly impassioned her with love! Indeed, we do see her in evident misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:31: So when she heard of their gossip, she sent for them and prepared for them reclining cushions and brought each one of them a knife, and she said, “Come out before them.” So when they saw him, they marveled at him and cut their hands and said, “God forbid! In no way is this a human being; this is but a noble angel!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:32: She said, “Here he is—the one you blamed me for, and most surely I did seek to seduce him, but he safeguarded(his chastity) . Yet if he does not do what I command him, he will most surely be imprisoned, and he will most surely become one of the dishonored.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:33: He said, “My Lord, prison is dearer to me than what they call me to, and unless You turn their plotting away from me, I might yield to them and become one of the ignorant.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:34: Thereupon his Lord responded to him and diverted their plotting away from him; indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:35: Then it occurred to them, after they had seen the signs, to imprison him for a while.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:36: And two young men entered prison with him. One of them said, “I see myself pressing wine.” And the other said, “I see myself carrying on my head bread from which the birds are eating. Tell us their interpretation; we see that you are of those who excel in doing good.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:37: He said, “No food will be provided for you but I will have informed you about their interpretation before it comes to you. That is some of what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have forsaken the creed of people who do not believe in Allah, and regarding the Hereafter they are deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:38: And I have followed the creed of my forefathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob. Never was it for us to associate anything with Allah. That is of Allah’s grace upon us and upon mankind, but the majority of mankind does not give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:39: O my fellow inmates, are diverse lords better or Allah, the One, the Subduer?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:40: You do not worship apart from Him except(mere) names you have named, you and your forefathers, for which Allah has sent down no manifestation. Judgment belongs to none but Allah. He has commanded that you worship none but Him; that is the upright religion, but the majority of mankind does not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:41: O my fellow inmates, as for one of you, he will give his lord wine to drink. And as for the other, he will be crucified and the birds will eat from his head. The matter you seek to be elucidated has been settled.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:42: And he said to the one he thought would be released, “Remember me to your lord.” But Satan caused him to forget the remembrance tohis lord, so he remained in prison for several years.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:43: Then the king said, “I see seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones, and seven green ears of corn and others dried up. O chiefs, elucidate for me my vision, if you can explicate visions.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:44: They said, “Jumbles of dreams, and we know nothing of the interpretation of dreams.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:45: And he of the two who had been released and had recollected after a long time said, “I will inform youof its interpretation, so send me out.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:46: “Joseph, O you unwavering believer, elucidate for us: seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones, and seven green ears of corn and others dried up—so that I may return to the people, that they may know.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:47: He said, “Youshall plant for seven consecutive years; but whatever you harvest, leave it in its ear, except for a little from which you eat.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:48: Then after that will come seven hard ones consuming what you have forwarded to them, except for a little of what you have stored.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:49: Then after that comes a year during which people are relieved and during which they press.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:50: So the king said, “Bring him to me.” But when the messenger came to him, he said, “Go back to your lord and ask him, ‘What about the women who cut their hands?’ Surely, my Lord is All-Knowing of their plotting.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:51: He said, “What happened with youwhen you sought to seduce Joseph?” They said, “God forbid! We knew of no evil committed by him.” The mighty governor’s wife said, “Now the truth has come to light. It was I who sought to seduce him, and he is most surely one of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:52: “That is so he may know that I did not betray him in his absence, for surely Allah does not guide the plotting of the betrayers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:53: Yet I do not consider my(inner) self blameless. Most surely, the self commands to evil, except those upon whom my Lord has bestowed mercy; indeed, my Lord is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:54: So the king said, “Bring him to me so that I can reserve him for myself.” And when he spoke to him, he said, “Surely, today you are—with us—established, trustworthy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:55: He said, “Put me in charge of the storehouses of the land; I am indeed a knowledgeable constant preserver.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:56: And thus We established Joseph in the land to live therein wherever he sowilled. We reachwith Our mercy whomever We will, and We never waste the reward of those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:57: But the reward of the Hereafter is better for those who attained faith and used to be mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:58: And Joseph’s brothers came and presented themselves before him, so he recognized them, but they did not recognize him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:59: Then when he had supplied them with their supplies, he said, “Bring me a brother of yours from your father. Do you not see that I fill up the measure, and I am the best of hosts?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:60: But if you do not bring him to me, you will have no(more) measure with me, and you will not come near me(again) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:61: They said, “We will solicit his father for him, and we are sure to do so.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:62: So he said to his young assistants , “Put their goods in their saddlebags; perhaps they will recognize them when they return to their families so that they may come back.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:63: So when they returned to their father, they said, “O our father, we were denied measure, so send our brother with us so that we can obtain measure, and we are most surely his preservers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:64: He said, “Am I to entrust him to you as I entrusted his brother to you before? Allah is a Better Preserver , and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful ones.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:65: And when they opened their baggage they found that their goods had been returned to them. They said, “O father, what more could we want? Here are our goods, returned to us; we will provide for our family and preserve our brother and have an additional camel-load; that is an easy measure(to obtain) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:66: He said, “I will not send him with you unless you give me a binding pledge before Allah that you will most surely bring him back to me, unless you get trapped.” So when they gave him their binding pledge, he said, “Allah is the Ultimate Trustee over what we say.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:67: And he said, “O my children, do not enter through one gate, but enter through different gates, though I cannot avail you anything against Allah; judgment belongs to none but Allah; in Him I have placed my trust, and in Him let those who seek to trust place their trust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:68: And when they entered as their father had commanded them, it did not avail them anything against Allah; it was just a need in Jacob’s(inner) self, which he fulfilled. And he is most surely a person of knowledge inasmuch as We have taught him, but the majority of mankind does not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:69: And when they presented themselves before Joseph, he drew his brother close to him. He said, “Indeed it is I—I am your brother, so do not be saddened by what they used to do.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:70: Then, when he had supplied them with their supplies, he placed the drinking-cup in his brother’s saddlebag. Then an announcer called out, “O caravan, most surely you are thieves.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:71: They said as they came towards them, “What are you missing?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:72: They said, “We are missing the king’s goblet. And whoever comes up with it will have a camel-load, and Iguarantee it.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:73: They said, “(We swear) by Allah, youhave most surely known that we did not come to spread corruption in the land, and never have we been thieves.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:74: They said, “What shall be his repayment, if youare lying?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:75: They said, “The repayment should be that he in whose saddlebag it is found, he himself is the repayment. Thus we repay the unjust ones.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:76: So he began with their bags before his brother’s bag, then he extracted it from his brother’s bag. Thus We plotted for Joseph; he could not have seized his brother according to the king’s religionunless Allah wills. We elevate by degrees whomever We so will. For above everyone who has knowledge, there is One who is All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:77: They said, “If he steals, well, actually a brother of his has stolen before.” But Joseph kept it secret within himself and did not reveal it to them. He said(to himself) , “Youare in a worse situation, and Allah knows better of what you describe.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:78: They said, “O mighty governor, he has a father(who is) a very old man, so take one of us in his place; we see that you are of those who excel in doing good.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:79: He said, “God is my refuge! Were we to take anyone except him in whose possession we found our property, we would then most surely be unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:80: So when they completely despaired of him, they conferred privately. Their eldest said, “Do younot know that your father took a binding pledge from you before Allah, and in the past you failed with regard to Joseph? Therefore, I will not leave this land until my father permits me or Allah judges for me, for He is the Best of judges.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:81: Go back to yourfather and say, ‘Our father, your son has indeed stolen. And we did not testify(about the punishment of stealing) except according to what we have learned, and we could not have preserved(him) against what is hidden.’
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:82: And ask the town where we were and the caravan in which we came, for indeed, we are truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:83: He said, “Rather, your(inner) selves prompted you(to do) something, so beautiful patience(is most fitting for me) ; hopefully Allah will bring them all back to me. Indeed, He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:84: And he turned away from them and said, “Alas for Joseph!” And his eyes turned white from grief and he suppressed his anguish.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:85: They said, “(We swear) by Allah, you will continue remembering Joseph until you become totally drained or become of those annihilated.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:86: He said, “Indeed, I only complain of my anguish and grief to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:87: “O my children, go and ask around about Joseph and his brother and do not despair of Allah’s leniency, for certainly none despair of Allah’s leniency except the denying people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:88: Then when they presented themselves before him, they said, “O mighty governor, harm has touched us and our family and we have brought scant merchandise, but give us full measure and be charitable towards us; indeed, Allah rewards the charitable ones.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:89: He said, “Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:90: They said, “Can it be that you really are Joseph? ” He said, “I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allah has certainly been gracious to us; indeed, whoever is mindful(of God) and endures patiently—indeed, Allah never wastes the reward of those who excel in doing good.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:91: They said, “(We swear) by Allah, Allah has certainly preferred you over us, and we were definitely wrongdoers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:92: He said, “There is no blame on youtoday; may Allah forgive you, for He is the Most Merciful of the merciful ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:93: Take this shirt of mine and cast it over my father’s face(and) he will recover his sight. And bring your whole family to me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:94: And as soon as the caravan departed, their father said, “I sense the scent of Joseph, though you may deem me senile.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:95: They said, “(We swear) by Allah, youare surely in your old misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:96: So when the herald of glad tidings arrived, he cast it over his face and he regained his sight. He said, “Did I not say to you, ‘Indeed, I know from Allah what you know not.’”?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:97: They said, “O father, pray for the forgiveness of our misdeeds; we were indeed wrongdoers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:98: He said, “I will ask my Lord to forgive you; indeed, He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Bestower of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:99: So when they presented themselves before Joseph, he drew his parents close to him and said, “Enter Egypt all of you, Allah willing, feeling secure.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:100: And he raised his parents on the throne, and they(all) fell prostrate before him, and he said, “O father, this is the interpretation of my vision of long ago. My Lord has certainly made it come true, and He was certainly charitable to me when He brought me out of prison and brought youfrom the nomadic life after Satan had sown discord between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in fulfilling whatever He wills; indeed, He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:101: “My Lord, You have surely brought me of kingshipand have taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Initiator of the heavens and the earth—You are my Ultimate Guardian in the Earlier(Life) and the Hereafter; take me back at death as a Muslim and join me with the righteous.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:102: That is of the stories of the hidden realm which We reveal to you, for you were not with them when they agreed together upon their affair as they were scheming.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:103: And most mankind will not believe, no matter how keen youare,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:104: though you ask them no reward for it. It is only a reminder for all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:105: And how many a sign in the heavens and the earth do they pass by while they disregard them?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:106: And most of them do not believe in Allah unless they associate(others with Allah) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:107: Do they feel secure that an overwhelming event of Allah’s punishment will not come upon them, or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they are unaware?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:108: Say, “This is my way; I call to Allah with insight—I and whoever has followed me. And Highly Exalted be Allah, and I am not of those who associate(others with Allah) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:109: And in no way did We send(any messengers) before youexcept men to whom We reveal , from among the people of the towns. Have they not journeyed through the earth and looked at what the outcome was for those before them? The Home of the Hereafter is surely better for those who have been mindful(of God) . Do younot reason ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:110: Until, when the messengers had completely despaired and thought that they had been lied to (by their own selves) , Our support came to them. Then whomever We willed was delivered , and Our chastisement is never turned back from the criminal people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.12:111: Most surely, in their narrative there has been a lesson for people of understanding. This was not a fabricated tale, but a confirmation of what came before it and a detailed explanation of everything and guidance and mercy for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:1: Alif Lām Mīm Ra. Those are the signs of the Scripture. And what has been sent down to youfrom your Lord is the truth, but most of mankind do not believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:2: Allah is the One Who raised up the heavens without pillars that you see, then He settled over the Throne, and He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term. He governs matters; He details signs, that youmay be certain of the meeting with your Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:3: And He is the One Who spread the land and made in it firm mountains and rivers, and of all products he made therein two pairs; He causes the night to overwhelm the day; indeed, in that are signs for people who reflect.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:4: And in the land are neighboring plots and gardens of vines, and vegetation, and date-palms —from the same root or from distinct roots—irrigated with the same water, yet We make the produce of some taste better than others; most surely, in that are signs for people who reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:5: And if youare amazed, then more amazing is their saying: “Can it be thatwhen we have become dust—can it be that we will really be(resurrected) in a new creation?” Those are the ones who have denied their Lord, and those are the ones with yokes around their necks, for those are the fellows of the Fire; therein they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:6: And they urge youto hasten evil before good, though exemplary punishments have occurred before them. And most surely your Lord is the Possessor of forgiveness to mankind despite their injustice, but most surely your Lord is stern in retribution.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:7: And those who have denied say, “If only a signwould be sent down to him from his Lord?” Indeed, you are only a forewarner, as for every people there is a guide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:8: Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose(prematurely) or exceed, and everything with Him is in due measure—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:9: the Knower of the hidden realm and the manifest; the Supreme, the Highly Exalted.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:10: It is the same: whether one of you speaks secretly or aloud, whether he goes into hiding by night or goes out by day.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:11: For each one there is a succession(of angels) before him and behind him, preserving him from Allah’s command. Indeed, Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is within themselves. And if Allah wants an evil for a people, there is no turning it back, and apart from Him they have no guardian.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:12: It is He who shows youthe lightening,(causing) fear and ardent hope, and He produces the heavy clouds.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:13: And the thunder exalts Him with praise, and so do the angels out of fear of Him. And He sends the thunderbolts, striking with them whomever He wills. Yet they argue about Allah, while He is stern in His plan.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:14: To Him belongs the call of truth, while those they call upon apart from Him do not respond to them with anything, except as someone who stretches his hands towards water so that it may reach his mouth, but never will it reach it. Thus the call of the deniers can only go astray.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:15: And to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or reluctantly, as do their shadows in the mornings and before sunset.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:16: Say, “Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?” Say, “Allah.” Say, “Have you taken apart from Him protectors who have no power to benefit or harm(even) themselves?” Say, “Are the blind and the seeing equal? Or are darkness and light equal? Or have they set up to Allah associates who created the like of His creation, so that their creation is indistinguishable to them from His? Say, “Allah is the Creator of everything, and He is the One, the Subduer.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:17: He sent down water from the sky, so valleys flowed—each according to its capacity—and the current carried swelling froth. And from what they burnin fire, seeking to make ornaments or utensils, comes a similar froth. Thus Allah exemplifies truth and falsehood: so as for the froth—it fades away, and as for what benefits mankind—it remains in the earth; thus Allah sets forth parables.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:18: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best(reward) , but those who have not responded to Him—if they possessed whatever is in the earth, all together and twice as much, they would indeed offer to ransom themselves with it. For those is an evil reckoning, for their shelter is Hell, and what a miserable resting place!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:19: Is someone who knows that what was sent down to you from your Lord is the truth like someone who is blind? Indeed, only those endowed with understanding remind themselves—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:20: those who fulfill Allah’s covenant and do not violate the pledge;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:21: and those who join what Allah has commanded to be joined and are in awe of their Lord and fear evil reckoning;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:22: and those who endured patiently, seeking their Lord’s countenance, and established the prayers and spent of what We provided them, secretly and publicly, and who repelan evil deed with a good deed; for those is the Ultimate Dwelling:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:23: everlasting Gardens which they enter, along with whoever was righteous of their forefathers and their spouses and their offspring(s) , while the angels enter upon them from every gate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:24: “Peace be upon youfor all you have endured patiently, so how excellent is the Ultimate Dwelling!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:25: And those who violate the covenant of Allah after pledging it, and sever what Allah has commanded to be joined and spread corruption in the land—those, for them there is the curse, and for them there is the Very Evil Home.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:26: Allah extends provision for whomever He wills and He restrains(it) . And they rejoiced with the Earlier Life, yet the Earlier Life, compared to the Hereafter, is nothing but(a brief) enjoyment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:27: And those who have denied say, “If only a signwould be sent down to him from his Lord?” Say, “Indeed, Allah leads astray whomever He wills, and He guides to Himself whoever has turned penitent:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:28: those who have attained faith and whose hearts becomeserene with the remembranceof Allah. Undoubtedly, it is indeed in the remembrance of Allah that hearts find comfort.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:29: Those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—for them is blessedness and a beautiful place to return to.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:30: Thus We have sent youamong a community before which other communities have passed away, that you may read to them what We have revealed to you, while they deny the All-Merciful. Say, “He is my Lord; there is no god but He; in Him I have placed my trust and to Him is my repentance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:31: And even if there had been a Recitalby which mountains were made to move or by which the land was cut up or by which the dead were spoken to…. Rather, to Allah belongs all command. Have those who have attained faith not yet given up and realized that if Allah wills, He can guide all mankind? And shocking events continue to afflict those who have denied—on account of what they have done—or fall near their home, until Allah’s promise comes true; indeed, Allah never breaks a promise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:32: And very truly messengers before you were ridiculed, so I reprieved the deniers then I seized them, so how was My punishment?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:33: Is the One Who is watchful over what every single self has earned…? Yet they set up associates to Allah. Say, “Namethem! Or are you to inform Him as to what He knows not in the earth? Or is it a show of words?” Rather, the scheming of those who have denied has been adorned for them, and they were barred from the way. And whomever Allah leads astray, no guide shall there ever be for him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:34: For them is a punishment in the Earlier Life, but the punishment of the Hereafter is harsher, for they have no shield from Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:35: The likeness of the Garden promised to those mindful(of God) : rivers flow beneath it; its crops are perpetual, and so is its shade. Such is the ultimate outcome for those who were mindful, while the ultimate outcome for the deniers is the Fire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:36: And those whom We have brought the Scripture rejoice at what was sent down to you, while of the parties are those who reject parts of it. Say, “Indeed, I have only been commanded to worship Allah and to never associate(anything) with Him; to Him I call and to Him is my return.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:37: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic code of law. Thus, were youto follow their whims after the knowledge that has come to you, you would have against Allahneither guardian nor shield.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:38: And most surely, We have sent messengers before you and We assigned for them spouses and offspring, and never was it for a messenger to come with a sign except by Allah’sleave. For every term there is a decreed term.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:39: Allah erases whatever He decides and He keeps (whatever He decides) , and with Him is the sourceof the Scripture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:40: Whether We show you some of what We have promised them or take you at death, your duty is indeed mere proclamation, while Ours is the reckoning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:41: Do they not see how We approach the land, diminishing it from its edges? Thus Allahjudges; nothing can hold back His judgment, and He is Swift in reckoning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:42: And the ones who came before them had schemed(as well) , yet to Allah belongs all scheming; He knows what every single self earns. And the deniers will know to whom belongs the Ultimate Dwelling.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.13:43: And those who have denied say, “Youare not an emissary.” Say, “Sufficient is Allah as a witness between me and you, and so is whoever has the knowledge of the Scripture.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:1: Alif Lām Ra. A Scripture that We sent down to you, that you may bring mankind out from darkness(es) into light—by the leave of their Lord—to the path of the Almighty, the Praiseworthy:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:2: Allah —the One to Whom belongs whatever isin the heavens and whatever is in the earth. And woe to the deniers from a severe punishment!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:3: Those who seek the love of the Earlier Life more than the Hereafter, and bar(people) from the way of Allah and seek to make it crooked—those are in extreme misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:4: And never did We send any messenger but(he spoke) in the tongue of his people, that he may clarify for them. Then Allah leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills, for He is the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:5: And very truly We sent Moses with Our signs: “Bring yourpeople out of darkness(es) into light and remind them of the Days of Allah.” Indeed, in that are signs for everyone who is most patient, constantly thankful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:6: And recall when Moses said to his people, “Remember Allah’s blessing upon you when He saved you from Pharaoh’s folk: inflicting on you an evil punishment and slaying your sons and keeping your women alive(in bondage) . And in that was a great test from your Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:7: And recall when yourLord proclaimed, ‘If you give thanks, I will indeed increase you; but if you deny, then indeed My punishment is severe.’”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:8: Thus Moses said, “If youdeny, together with everyone on earth—then Allah is most surely Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:9: Has not the tiding of those before youcome to you—the people of Noah and ʻĀd and Thamûd and those(who came) after them? None know them except Allah. Their messengers came to them with evident proofs, yet they turned back their hands to their mouthsand said, “We surely deny what you have been sent with, and we are indeed in doubt about whatever suspicious(matter) you are calling us to.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:10: Their messengers said, “Is there any doubt about Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth? He calls youto forgive you your misdeeds and to defer you until(you fulfill) a stated term.” They said, “You are only human beings like us; you want to turn us away from what our forefathers used to worship, so bring us an evident manifestation.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:11: Their messengers said to them, “We are only human beings like you,but Allah does a favor to whomever He wills of His servants, and in no way could we come up to you with any manifestation except by Allah’s leave. And in Allah let the believers place their trust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:12: And how can we not place our trust in Allah when He has guided us in our ways? And we will most surely endure patiently whichever way you hurt us. And let anyone who trusts, place his trust in Allah.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:13: Yet those who denied said to their messengers, “We will most surely evict you from our land unless you return to our creed.” So their Lord revealed to them: “We will most surely annihilate the unjust ones,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:14: and We will most surely settle you in the land after them. That is for whoever stood in fear of My position and in fear of My threat.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:15: Thus they sought a legislation, then every stubborn tyrant failed;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:16: beyond him lies Hell, and he is given, for drink, purulent water
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:17: which he sips, though he can barely swallow. And death comes at him from everywhere but he is not to die, and beyond him is a harsh punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:18: The parable of those who denied their Lord: their deeds are like ashes on which the wind blew severely upon a stormy day; they have no control over anything they have earned. That is the extreme misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:19: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth with the truth? If He wills, He can do away with youand bring a new creation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:20: And that is not too mighty for Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:21: And they emergedbefore Allah all together. And the weak said to the arrogant leaders, “We were your followers, so can you avail us in any way against Allah’s punishment?” They said, “Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you. It is the same for us: whether we mourn or are patient, there is no escape for us.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:22: Thus Satan said, when the matter had been concluded, “Indeed, Allah promised youthe promise of truth, and I promised you but I failed you. And never did I have any authority over you except that I called you and you responded to me. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves; I cannot come to your aid nor can you come to my aid;(now) I have indeed denied your earlier association of me(with Allah) . Indeed, for the unjust is a painful punishment.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:23: But those who had attained faith and had done righteous deeds were entered into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein by their Lord’s leave; their greeting therein is: “Peace.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:24: Have younot seen how Allah has set forth a parable? A good word is like a good tree—its root is firm and its branches are in heaven,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:25: yielding its crop every season by its Lord’s leave. And Allah sets forth parables for mankind, that they may remind themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:26: And the parable of a nasty word is that of a nasty tree that has been uprooted: it has no stability.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:27: Allah gives firmness to those who have attained faith with the firm statement in the Earlier Life and in the Hereafter, and Allah leads the unjustastray. And Allah does whatever He wills.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:28: Have younot seen those who exchanged the blessing of Allah for denial and landed their people into the home of perdition?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:29: Hell, wherein they roast, and what a miserable settlement!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:30: And they set up rivals to Allah in order to make(others) stray from His way. Say, “Enjoy yourselves, for surely your destiny is to the Fire.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:31: Tell My servants who have attained faith to establish the prayers and to spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a day comes in which there is neither trade nor close friendship.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:32: Allah is the One Who created the heavens and the earth and sent down water from the sky, then brought out with it, of the products, provision for you; and He has subjected to you the ships to run in the sea by His command, and He has subjected to you the rivers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:33: And He has subjected to you the sun and the moon, both moving constantly, and He has subjected to you the night and the day.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:34: And He has brought youof all what you asked Him, and if you were to count Allah’s blessings, you would not be able to enumerate them. Surely, man is constantly unjust, a relentless denier.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:35: And recall when Abraham said, “O my Lord, make this land safe and keep me and my sons away from worshiping human-shaped idols.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:36: “My Lord, they have indeed led many people astray. So whoever follows me, then surely he is of me; and whoever disobeys me, then You are Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:37: Our Lord, I have indeed settled of my offspring in a valley devoid of vegetation at Your House which has been made Inviolable, Our Lord, that they may establish the prayers. So make some people’s burning hearts incline towards them, and provide them with products, that they may give thanks.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:38: “Our Lord, You surely know whatever we hide and whatever we make public. For nothing is hidden from Allah, whether in the earth or in the heaven.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:39: “Praise be to Allah Who has given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac; my Lord is indeed All-Hearing of supplication.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:40: “My Lord, make me one who establishes the prayer, and(also) of my offspring. OurLord, and accept my supplication.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:41: “Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the day when the reckoning takes place.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:42: Donot ever think that Allah is oblivious of what the unjustare doing. He only defers them to a day when sight(s) glaze over,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:43: as they rush forward with their necks outstretched, their heads upraised, their eyes unblinking and their hearts void.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:44: And warnmankind of the day when punishment comes upon them, and the unjustsay, “Our Lord, defer us for a little while and we will respond to Your call and follow the messengers.” Did younot swear earlier that in no way would you face extinction?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:45: And you settled in the residences of those who were unjust to themselves and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We set forth for you the parables.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:46: And very truly they had schemed their scheming, yet their scheming is known to Allah, even though their scheming was enough to remove mountains.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:47: So never thinkthat Allah will break His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Almighty, Capable of vengeance
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:48: on the day when the earth is changed into another earth, as well as the heavens, and they emergedbefore Allah, the One, the Subduer.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:49: And yousee the criminals on that day bound together in fetters,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:50: their attires made of tar, and the Fire covering their faces.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:51: That Allah may repay every single self according to what it has earned. Indeed, Allah is Swift in reckoning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.14:52: Thisis a proclamation for mankind, and that they may be warned by it, and that they may know that He is one God, and that people of understanding may constantly remember.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:1: Alif Lām Ra. Those are the signsof the Scripture and an evident Recital.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:2: Perhaps those who have denied will wish they had been Muslims.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:3: Letthem eat and enjoy and be distracted by(false) hope, for they willcome to know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:4: For in no way did We annihilate any town except that it had a known written decree.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:5: No community can advance its time, nor can they delay it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:6: And they said, “O you upon whom the Reminder has been bestowed from on high, very truly you are insane.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:7: If only you would bring us the angels, if you are one of the truthful!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:8: We bestow not the angelsfrom on high except with the truth, and in no way would theythen be respited.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:9: Indeed, We—We alone—have bestowed the Reminder from on high, and We will most surely preserve it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:10: And most surely We sent(messengers) before youto the sects of the ancients,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:11: but no messenger comesto them but they used to ridicule him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:12: Thus We insert itinto the hearts of the criminals—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:13: they do not believe in it, though the rule of(God regarding) the ancients has surely passed before.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:14: And if We were to open for them a gateway into the sky so that they were to continue ascending through it,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:15: they would surely say, “Indeed, our sight(s) have been stupefied ; rather, we are a people bewitched.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:16: And most surely, We have made constellations in the sky and adorned it to the beholders;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:17: and We have preserved it from every outcast devil,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:18: except the one who eavesdrops and is followed by an evident meteor.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:19: And the land—We spread it and cast firm mountains in it, and We germinated therein of everything in proper measure.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:20: And We made livelihoods for youin it, as well as for those for whom you are not the providers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:21: For there is not a thing but with Us are its treasuries, yet in no way do We bestow it from on high except in a known measure.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:22: And We sent the winds , fertilizing, then sent down water from the sky and gave it to youto drink, and in no way are you its keepers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:23: And indeed, We—surely, We—give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:24: And most surely We have known those of you who passed away, and most surely We have known those who come afterwards;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:25: and indeed, it is yourLord Who herds themtogether; indeed, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:26: And most surely We created man from potter’s clay, of fermented mud,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:27: while We created the unseen beingbefore from the fire of the searing wind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:28: And recall when yourLord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from potter’s clay, of fermented mud.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:29: So when I have formed him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down to him, prostrating.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:30: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:31: but not Iblis. He refused to be with those who prostrated themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:32: He said, “O Iblis, what keeps you from being with those who prostrate themselves?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:33: He said, “Never would I prostrate myself to a human being whom You created from potter’s clay, of fermented mud.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:34: He said, “Then get out of it, for indeed you are an outcast,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:35: and indeed the curse is upon you until the Day of Recompense.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:36: He said, “My Lord, then reprieve me until the day they are resurrected.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:37: He said, “Then, you are indeed of the ones reprieved
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:38: until the Day of the Time Appointed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:39: He said, “My Lord, since You have deluded me, I will most surely adorn for them(evil deeds) on earth, and I will most surely delude them all,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:40: except for Your sincere chosen servants among them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:41: He said, “This is a straight path which is binding on Me :
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:42: over My servants youhave no authority indeed, except for those who follow you of the deluded ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:43: And indeed, Hell is the meeting place for them all.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:44: It has seven gates; for each gate is an assigned class.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:45: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are amid Gardens and springs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:47: And We removedwhatever malice was within their chests—as brethren, on couches facing each other.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:48: No fatigue touchesthem therein, nor from it will they ever be brought out.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:49: InformMy servants that I—only I—am the Oft-Forgiving, the Bestower of mercy,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:50: and that My punishment is the painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:51: And inform them of the guests of Abraham,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:52: when they entered upon him and said, “Peace.” He said, “We are truly scared of you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:53: They said, “Do not be scared; we bring youglad tidings of a knowledgeable boy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:54: He said, “Have you brought me glad tidings when old age has touched me? So what glad tidings could you give ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:55: They said, “We brought you true glad tidings, so be not of the despairing ones.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:56: He said, “And who despairs of his Lord’s mercy except for thoseastray?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:57: He said, “So what is your business, O emissaries?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:58: They said, “We have been sent to a people of criminals,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:59: except for Lot’s folk; we will most surely deliver them all,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:60: except for his wife.” We have determined that she will most surely be of those who linger behind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:61: So when the emissaries came to Lot’s folk,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:62: he said, “You are an unknown people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:63: They said, “Rather, we have come to youwith that about which they were skeptical,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:64: and we have brought you the truth, and very truly we are truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:65: So journey with your family at the latter part of the night and follow at their rear, and let none of you turn around, and proceedwherever youare commanded.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:66: And We decreed to him that matter: that the last trace of these would be uprooted by the morning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:67: And the people of the town came anticipating glad tidings.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:68: He said, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:69: and be mindful of Allah and do not disgrace me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:70: They said, “Did we not forbid youfrom(receiving) any people?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:71: He said, “These are my daughters, if you must.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:72: By yourlife, in their drunkenness they certainly do blunder!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:73: So the Shout took them away at sunrise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:74: And We turned it upside down and rained down upon them stones of hard clay.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:75: Indeed, in that are certainly signs for those who contemplate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:76: And indeed, itis certainly on an existing way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:77: Indeed, in that is certainly a sign for the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:78: And indeed, the fellows of the Thicket were certainly unjust,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:79: so We took retribution on them, and indeed, both are certainly in an evident archive.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:80: And most surely, the fellows of Al-Hijrdisbelievedthe emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:81: So We brought them Our signs, but they used to disregard them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:82: And of the mountains they used to carve homes, feeling safe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:83: But the Shout took them away by the morning,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:84: so all what they used to earn was of no avail to them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:85: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them except with the truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming, so pardon(with) gracious pardoning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:86: Indeed, yourLord is the One Who is the All-Creating, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:87: And most surely, We have brought youseven of the oft-repeatedand the great Recital.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:88: Donot look longingly at the good things We have given some classes of them to enjoy, and do not grieve over them, and lower your wingtowards the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:89: And say, “Indeed, it is I—I who am the evident warner.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:90: So too did We send down to those who divide among themselves—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:91: those who have made the Recitalinto fragments.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:92: So by yourLord, We will surely ask them all
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:93: about what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:94: So proclaimopenly what you are commanded and disregard the polytheists.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:95: Indeed, We have sufficed youagainst the mockers:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:96: those who set up another god with Allah. So they will come to know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:97: And most surely We are aware that yourchest tightens with what they say.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:98: So exalt your Lord with praise and be of those who prostrate,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.15:99: and worship your Lord until Certitudecomes to you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:1: Allah’s command has come, so donot rush it. Highly Exalted is He, and Most High above what they associate(with Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:2: Hebestows the angels from on highwith the Spirit by His command upon whom He wills of His servants: “Givewarning that there is no god but Me, so be mindful of Me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:3: He created the heavens and the earth with truth. Most High is He above what they associate(with Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:4: He created man from a sperm-drop, yet he becomes an evident adversary!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:5: And livestock—He created them for you. In them are warmth and benefits for you, and of them you eat.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:6: And there is beauty in them for you when you drive them home and when you drive them to pasture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:7: And they carry your heavy burdens to a land you could not have reached without great hardship to yourselves; indeed, your Lord is truly Compassionate, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:8: And horses and mules and donkeys—that you may ride them, and as an adornment; and He creates what you do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:9: And it is upon Allah to point out the way, but some of themare crooked. And had He willed, He would surely have guided you all.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:10: It is He Who sent down to you from the sky water from which is a drink for you and from which are trees where you pasture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:11: With it Hegerminates for you vegetation and olives and date-palms and grapevines and of all products. Indeed, in that is a sign for people who reflect.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:12: And He has subjected to you the night and the day and the sun and the moon. And the starsare subjected by His command. Indeed, in that are signs for people who reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:13: And(He has subjected) whatever He has scattered for you in the earth of varying colors. Indeed, in that is a sign for people who constantly remember.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:14: And He is the One Who subjected the sea, that you may eat from it tender meat and extract from it ornaments that you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and(all this) so that you may seek of His bounties, and that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:15: And He cast firm mountains into the earth lest it sway with you, and rivers and ways, that you may be guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:16: And landmarks, and by the star they are guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:17: Is One Who creates like one who does not create? Will you never remind yourselves ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:18: And if youwere to count the blessings of Allah, you would not be able to enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is certainly Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:19: And Allah knows whatever you keep secret and whatever you make public.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:20: Yet those they call uponapart from Allah create nothing, while they(themselves) are created.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:21: (They are, in fact) dead, not alive, and they are unaware of when they will be resurrected.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:22: YourGod is one God. Therefore, those who do not believe in the Hereafter—their hearts are in denial and they act arrogantly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:23: Without doubt, Allah knows whatever they keep secret and whatever they make public; indeed, He does not like those who act arrogantly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:24: And when it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “Legends of the ancients.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:25: Let them carry their burdens, complete, on the Day of Resurrection, and some of the burdens of those they lead astray without knowledge. Undoubtedly, evil is what they bear.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:26: Those before them did scheme, but Allah struck at the very foundations of their building, so the roof collapsed upon them from above them, and the punishment came upon them from where they were unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:27: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He disgraces them and says, “Where are My associates for whose sake you used to oppose (the believers) ? Those who were given knowledge said, “Today disgrace and misery are indeed upon the deniers
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:28: whom the angels take at death while they are unjust to themselves.” Then they offered submission: “We were doing no evil.” Yes! Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of what youused to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:29: Thus enter the gates of Hell, abiding therein.” And how miserable is the dwelling of the arrogant!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.16:30: And it was said to those who were mindful(of God) , “What did your Lord send down?” They said, “(All that is) good.” To those who have excelled in doing good in this Earlier(Life) is goodness, and the Home of the Hereafter is even better. And indeed, how excellent is the home of the people who are mindful(of God) :
