Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:22: And press your hand to your side; it will come out white without any bad affliction—another sign,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:23: that We may show you of Our greatest signs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:24: Go to Pharaoh; indeed, he has exceeded all limits.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:25: He said, “My Lord, expand my chest for me,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:26: and ease my mission for me,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:27: and untie the knot from my tongue
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:28: so that they can comprehend my speech,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:29: and appoint for me an assistant from my family:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:32: and associatehim with me in my mission,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:33: that we may exalt You much
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:35: Indeed, You have always been All-Seeing of us.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:36: He said, “Youhave been granted your request, O Moses.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:37: And most surely, We have conferred favor upon you on another occasion,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:38: when We revealed to your mother what was revealed:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:39: ‘Throw him in the coffer then throw it into the waters, so that the waters will cast it onto the bank where an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his will pick him up.’ For I bestowed upon you love from Me and so that you may be modeled before My eye.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:40: Recall your sister walking along and saying, ‘Shall I tell you about someone who can foster him?’ So We returned you to your mother, that her eye may be comforted and(that she may) not grieve. And you killed a person, but We delivered you from stress and We tested you thoroughly. Then you stayed for years among the people of Midian. Then you came as ordained, O Moses.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:41: And I modeled you for Myself.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:42: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and donot slacken in remembering Me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:43: Goto Pharaoh—he has indeed exceeded all limits—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:44: but saya lenient word to him, that he may remind himself or be fearful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:45: They said, “Our Lord, we fear he may persecute us or exceed all limits.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:46: He said, “Be not afraid; I am indeed with you, hearing and seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:47: So approachhim and say, `Weare the messengers of your Lord, so send the Children of Israel with us and do not punish them; we have surely brought you a sign from your Lord, for peace is upon whoever has followed the guidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:48: It has indeed been revealed to us that punishment falls upon whoever has disbelieved andturned away.’”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:49: He said, “So who is yourLord, O Moses?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:50: He said, “Our Lord is the One Who gave everything its creation then guided(it) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:51: He said, “So what about the former generations?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:52: He said, “Knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record; my Lord never goes astray nor does He forget.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:53: (He is) the One Who has made the earth a cradle for youand traced in it ways for you, and sent down from the sky water with which Webrought out pairs of diverse plants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:54: Eatand pasture your livestock. Most surely, in that are signs for ones endowed with intelligence.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:55: From it We created you, and into it We return you, and from it We bring you out once again.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:56: And very truly We showed him all of Our signs, but he disbelieved and refused.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:57: He said, “Have you come to us to evict us from our land with your sorcery, O Moses?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:58: We will most surely bring you sorcery like it; so make between us and you an appointment which we will not break—neither us nor you—in a suitable place.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:59: He said, “Yourappointment is the day of the festival, so let the people be herded together at forenoon.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:60: Then Pharaoh turned away and put together his plot, and then he came.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:61: Moses said to them, “Woe to you. Do not fabricate lies against Allah or He will destroy youwith a punishment, and surely, the one who fabricates lies is bound to fail.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:62: Then they disagreed with each other about their matter and conversed secretly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:63: They said, “These two are nothing but sorcerers who want to evict you from your land with their sorcery and abolish your exemplary way of life.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:64: So decide yourplot, then come, lined up(in ranks) ; and the one who gains the upper hand is surely bound to succeed today.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:65: They said, “O Moses, either you cast or we will be the first to cast.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:66: He said, “Rather, youcast.” And suddenly, their ropes and staffs were made to appear to him, because of their sorcery, to be slithering.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:67: So Moses felt apprehensive within himself.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:68: We said, “Be not afraid; youare the highest.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:69: And cast what is in your right hand—it will swallow what they have crafted; what they have crafted is only a sorcerer’s trickery, for the sorcerer will not succeed wherever he may go.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:70: So the sorcerers fell down prostrate. They said, “We have attained faith in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:71: He said, “Have youattained faith in him before I have given you permission? He must be your chief who has taught you sorcery. So I will most surely cut off your hands and your feet on alternate sides, and I will most surely crucify you on the trunks of the palm-trees. Then you will most surely know which of us is more severe in punishment and more lasting.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:72: They said, “We will not prefer you over what has come to us of evident proofs nor(over) the One Who originated us, so decree whatever you decree; you can only decree for this Earlier Life.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:73: We have indeed attained faith in our Lord so that He may forgive us our offenses and what you have compelled us to practice of sorcery, for Allah is better and more lasting.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:74: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal, then surely for him is Hell, where he neither dies nor lives.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:75: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, having done righteous deeds, then for thoseare the highest degrees(of rank) :
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:76: Gardens of Perpetuity beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein, for that is the repayment of the one who purifies himself.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:77: And very truly, We revealed to Moses: “Journey by night with My servants and strike for them a dry road across the sea. You will not be afraidof being overtaken nor apprehensive.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:78: So Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, but there overwhelmed them of the waters that which overwhelmed them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:79: Thus Pharaoh led his people astray and never did he guide(them) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:80: O Children of Israel, We have surely saved youfrom your enemy, and have made an appointment with you by the right side of Mount Tûr, and sent down to you manna and quails.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:81: Eat of the good things We have provided for you, but do not exceed the limits in it lest you deserveMy wrath upon you, for the one upon whom My wrath is deserved has surely fallen.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:82: And very truly I am Forgiving towards the one who repented and attained faith and acted righteously and then remained guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:83: “And what made you rush ahead of your people, O Moses?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:84: He said, “They are following in my footsteps. And I hurried on to You, my Lord, that You may be well pleased.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:85: He said, “Yet, We have surely tested your people in your absence, and the Samiri led them astray.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:86: So Moses returned to his people, wrathful(and) sorrowful. He said, “O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Was the(time of the) covenant too long for you? Or did you want wrath from your Lord to descend upon you, so you broke your promise to me?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:87: They said, “We did not break our promise to you by our choice, but we were made to carry burdens of the people’s ornaments, so we cast them and so did the Samiri cast.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:88: So he brought out for them a calf—a mere body with a lowing sound. And theysaid, “This is your god and the god of Moses, but he has forgotten.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:89: Do they not see that it cannot return a word to them, nor does it possess for them harm or benefit?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:90: And Aaron had most surely said to them before, “O my people, you are indeed being tested by this, and indeed your Lord is the All-Merciful, so follow me and obey my command.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:91: They said, “We will not give up consecrating it until Moses returns to us.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:92: He said, “O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:93: from following me? Have you disobeyed my command?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:94: He said, “O son of my mother, do not seize me by my beard nor by my head; I feared you would say, ‘You have caused division among the Children of Israel and have not regarded my word.’”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:95: He said, “What do you have to say, O Samiri?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:96: He said, “I perceived what they did not perceive, so I grasped a handful from the messenger’s traces and I flung it away, and thus my soul prompted me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:97: He said, “Be gone! For indeed your lot in this life is to say, ‘No touching’, and indeed you have an appointment that you will not be allowed to break . And look at your god that you kept consecrating—we will certainly burn it up then blow it away completely into the waters.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:98: Surely yourgod is none but Allah, the One besides Whom there is no other god; He has embraced everything in knowledge.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:99: Thus We narrate to youof the stories that have passed before, for We have brought you a Reminder from Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:100: Whoever has disregarded it will indeed carry on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:101: abidingin it, and how bad their load becameon the Day of Resurrection—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:102: the day when the Trumpet is blown ! And We herd the criminals on that day, blue,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:103: murmuring among themselves: “Youhave stayed only for ten.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:104: We know better what they say, when the most exemplary of them in conduct says, “Youhave stayed for no more than a day.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:105: And they ask you about the mountains. So say, “My Lord will blow them away
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:106: and leave them as desolate waste.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:107: You will see in them neither crookedness nor deviation.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:108: On that day, they follow the caller without any crookedness, and voices were(hushed) in reverence to the All-Merciful, so that youhear nothing but a murmur.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:109: On that day, intercession does not avail except for the one permitted by the All-Merciful, and He was pleased for him to speak.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:110: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot encompass Him with knowledge.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:111: And faces were humbledto the Living One, the All-Sustaining, and surely whoever carried injustice is bound to fail.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:112: But whoever does righteous deeds while being a believer, then he neither fears injustice nor curtailment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:113: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Recital, and We have diversified the warnings in it, that perhaps they would become mindful(of God) or it would bring about in them a remembrance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:114: Most high above all is Allah, the True King. Donot be hasty with the Recitalbefore its revelation to you is concluded , and say, “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:115: And most surely We covenanted with Adam before, but he forgot, and We found in him no resolve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:116: And recall when We said to the angels, “Prostrate yourselves to Adam.” So they prostrated themselves— but not Iblis; he refused.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:117: So We said, “O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your spouse. So do not let him get youout of the Garden, for then youwillsuffer.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:118: In it, indeed, youwill never go hungry nor be naked.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:119: Nor will you be thirsty in it nor will you swelter.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:120: But Satan whispered to him. He said, “O Adam, shall I show you the Tree of Immortality and a kingdom that never decays?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:121: So theyate from it, whereupon their private parts became exposed to them, and they started covering themselves with the leaves of the Garden. Thus Adam disobeyed his Lord and was deluded.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:122: Then his Lord recalled him and granted him repentance and accepted it from him and guided(him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:123: He said, “Descend from it, all together, some of you as enemies of some others. But whenever guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray nor suffer.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:124: But whoever has disregarded My Reminder—for him is a miserable life, and Wewill herd him on the Day of Resurrection blind.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:125: He said, “My Lord, why did You herd me blind though I used to see?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:126: He said, “Just as Our signs came to youand you forgot them, today you will be forgotten.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:127: And thus We repay the one who was an extremist and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And surely the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more lasting.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:128: Did it give them no guidance(to learn) how many generations before them We annihilated, amidst whose residences they walk? Indeed, in that are signs for the ones endowed with intelligence.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:129: And were it not for a word that had preceded from yourLord, the inevitable would have happened, but(there is) a stated term.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:130: So bear patiently what they say and exalt yourLord with praise before the rising of the sun and before its setting, and during the hours of the night exalt Him, and at the(two) ends of the day, that you may be well pleased .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:131: And never extend your eyes towards what We have given some classes of them to enjoy—the splendorof the Earlier Life—that We may test them thereby, for your Lord’sprovision is better and more lasting.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:132: And command your people to prayer, and patiently adhere to it; We ask of youno provision; it is We who provide for you. For the future outcome is for mindfulness(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:133: And they said, “If only he were to bring us a sign from his Lord!” Were they not given evidence of whatever is in the former scrolls?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:134: Had We annihilated them with a punishment before him, they would have said, “Our Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger so that we would have followed Your signs before we were humiliated and disgraced.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.20:135: Say, “Everybody is waiting, so wait, for you will know who the people of the even path are and who was rightly-guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:1: Mankind’s reckoning has drawn near, while they are in oblivion, disregarding(it) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:2: No fresh reminder comes to them from their Lord but they listen to it playfully,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:3: their hearts distracted. And secretly did the unjust converse, “Is this anything but a human being like you? Will you go along with sorcery while you see?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:4: He said , “My Lord knows what is said in the heaven and the earth, for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:5: But they said, “A jumble of dreams; rather, he fabricated it; rather, he is a poet, so let him bring us a sign like those sent to the ancients.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:6: None of the towns We annihilated before them had believed. Will they, then, believe?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:7: And never did We send before youbut men to whom We reveal , so ask the people of the Reminder if youdo not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:8: And never did We make them a mere body,(ones) who eatno food, for never were they immortal.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:9: Then We fulfilled the promise to them, so We saved them together with whomever We will, and We annihilated the extremists.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:10: Most surely, We have sent down to youa Scripture containing your reminder. Do you not reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:11: And how many an unjust town have We crushed and established thereafter another people?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:12: Thus when they sensed Our force, they immediately ran away from it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:13: Do not run, but come back to the luxuries youwere immersed in, and your residences, that you may be questioned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:14: They said, “Woe to us; indeed, we have been unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:15: Thus this continued to be their cry until We made them extinguished ashes.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:16: And in no way did We create the sky and the earth and what is between them playfully.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:17: If We wanted amusement, We could have obtained it from very close to Us, were We to do so.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:18: Rather, We hurl the truth against falsehood so that it crushes it, and thus it vanishes. And woe unto youfor what you describe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:19: For to Him belongs whomever is in the heavens and the earth. And those in His presence are not too arrogant to worship Him, nor do they grow weary.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:20: They give due exaltation(to Him) night and day, never tiring.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:21: Or have they taken to themselves gods from the earth who(can) resurrect?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:22: If there were in them gods other than Allah, they would have surely become corrupted. So Highly Exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, far above what they describe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:23: He is not asked about what He does, but they shall be asked.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:24: Or have they taken apart from Him other gods? Say, “Bring yourproof; thisis the reminder of those with me and the reminder of those before me.” Rather, most of them do not know the truth, so they disregard(it) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:25: And never did We send any messenger before youbut We revealto him that: “There is no god but I, so worshipMe.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:26: Yet they said, “The All-Merciful has taken to himself offspring.” Highly Exalted is He; rather, they are honored servants
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:27: who never speak before Him, and they only act on His command.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:28: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not intercede except for those whom He approves, and they tremble in awe of Him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:29: And whoever of them says, “I am a god apart from Him,” We will repay him with Hell; thus We repay the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:30: Do the deniers not see that the heavens and the earth were one mass, and then We tore them apart? And We made from water every living thing; will they not believe?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:31: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it sway with them; and We set broad pathways on it, that they might be guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:32: And We made the sky a preserved ceiling, yet they disregard its signs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:33: And it is He Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each floating in an orbit.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:34: And never did We grant immortality to any human being before you. Should you die, are they then the immortal?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:35: Every single self is bound to taste death, for We test youwith evil and good as a means of trial, and to Us you are returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:36: And when those who have denied see you, they treat you only with ridicule: “Is this the one who mentions your gods?” For of the reminder of the All-Merciful they themselves are deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:37: Man was created of haste. I will show youMy signs, so do not ask Me to hasten.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:38: And they say, “When will this promise come true, if you are truthful?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:39: If those who have denied only knew the time when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces nor off their backs, nor will they be supported!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:40: Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and bewilder them, so they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be given respite.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:41: And most surely(other) messengers before youwere ridiculed, but those who mocked were surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:42: Say, “Who guards you by night and day from the All-Merciful?” But they disregard the reminder of their Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:43: Or do they have gods that can defend them against Us? They cannot support themselves, nor will they find anyone to side with them against Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:44: Rather, We gave these people and their forefathers enjoyments until time grew long upon them. Do they not see how We gradually reduce the land from its extremities? Are they then the overcomers?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:45: Say, “Indeed, I am only warning youthrough revelation.” But the deafcannot hear the call when they are being warned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:46: And if a whiff of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they say, “Woe to us, We have truly been unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:47: And We set up the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that not a single self suffers the least injustice, and even if it be the weight of a mustard seed, We bring it forth. For sufficient are We as reckoners.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:48: And very truly, We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion and illumination and a reminder for the ones who were mindful(of God) :
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:49: those who fear their Lord, though Unseen, and are apprehensive of theHour.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:50: And this(too) is a blessed Reminder that We have sent down. Are yougoing to reject it?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:51: And most surely, We brought Abraham his prudence before, and We well knew of him
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:52: when he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are devoted?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:53: They said, “We found our forefathers worshiping them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:54: He said, “Youand your forefathers have been in evident misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:55: They said, “Have you come to us with the truth, or are you one of the jesters?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:56: He said, “Rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the One who originated them, and to that, I am one of those who bear witness.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:57: And by Allah, I shall certainly plot against your human-shaped idols after you have turned away, fleeing.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:58: So he reduced them into pieces, except for their biggest, that they may return to it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:59: They said, “Who did this to our gods? Indeed, he is certainly one of the unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:60: They said, “We heard a young man mentioning them; he is called Abraham.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:61: They said, “So bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may witness.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:62: They said, “Are you the one who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:63: He said, “Rather, it was this biggest of them that did it, so ask them, if they can talk.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:64: So they turned to one another and said, “Indeed, you yourselves are the unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:65: But they reverted to their old ideas: “Youcertainly know well that these do not talk.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:66: He said, “Do you worship, apart from Allah, what can neither benefit you in anything nor harm you?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:67: Fie on you and on what you worship apart from Allah. Do you not reason?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:68: They said, “Burn him and support your gods, if you are going to act.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:69: We said, “O fire, be cool and peaceful upon Abraham.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:70: For they wanted to plot against him, so We made them the biggest losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:71: And We delivered him and Lot to the land that We blessed for all(people of all) realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:72: And We granted him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and each We made righteous.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:73: And We made them leaders, guiding by Our command, and We revealed to them(the command of) performing good works and establishing the prayer and bringingthe purifying charity, for of Us they were worshipers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:74: And Lot—We gave him wise judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the town that used to practice nasty things. They were indeed a wicked, defiantly disobedient people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:75: And We entered him into Our mercy; He isindeed one of the righteous.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:76: And Noah, when he called before, so We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great calamity.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:77: And We supported him against the people who disbelieved Our signs; indeed, they were a wicked people, so We drowned them all.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:78: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the case of the field, when some people’s sheep wandered therein by night. And to their judgment We were witnesses.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:79: Yet We made Solomon understand it, and to each We gave wise judgment and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to give(God) due exaltation along with David, and the birds as well—surely We did.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:80: And We taught him the making of shields for you, so that they may secure youfrom your violence, so are you then appreciative?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:81: And to Solomon the stormy wind , blowing at his command towards the land that We had blessed. And We well knew of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:82: And of the devils were some that would dive for him and perform other, lesser tasks, but We were preserving of them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:83: And Job, when he called upon his Lord: “Great harm has touched me, yet You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:84: So We responded to him and lifted the harm which had afflicted him, and We brought him his family and their like with them—a mercy from Us, and a reminding for the worshipers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:85: And Ishmael and Enoch and Ezekiel; each isone of the steadfast.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:86: And We entered them into Our mercy; indeed, they areof the righteous.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:87: And Jonah, when he went off angrily and he thought that We would not restrain him . But then He cried out in the darkness(es) , “There is no god but You! Highly Exalted are You! Indeed, I have been one of the unjust!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:88: So We responded to him and delivered him from stress, for thus We save the believers .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:89: And Zechariah, when he called out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me solitary, while You are the best of inheritors.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:90: So We responded to him and granted him John, and We rehabilitated his spouse for him. Indeed, they used to hasten towards good works and call upon Us wishfully and in awe, for they used to be reverent towards Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:91: And she who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign to(all people of) all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:92: Indeed, this community of yoursis one community and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:93: But they tore themselves into sects; they are all returning to Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:94: So whoever does righteous deeds and is a believer—his endeavor will never be denied. And indeed, We are writing it down for him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:95: And there is a ban on any town that We have annihilated—that they do not return,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:96: until, when Gog and Magog are opened , and they swarm down from every mound,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:97: and the true promise has drawn near— then, the sight(s) of those who denied glaze over: “Woe to us. We have been oblivious to this. Rather, we were unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:98: Youand what you worship apart from Allah are indeed fuel for Hell. You are bound to approach it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:99: Had these been gods, they would not have approached it. And all will abide in it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:100: In it they wail, and in it they do not hear.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:101: Indeed, those who deserved goodness from Us—those are kept away from it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:102: They do not hear its hissing, and in what their hearts have desired they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:103: The most supreme fear does not worry them, for the angels receive them: “This is yourday which you were promised.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:104: On the day when We fold the heaven as the scribe rolls up scriptures . Just as We began the first creation, We restore it—a promise from Us. We will indeed act.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:105: And most surely We have written in the Book, after the Reminder, that the land will be inherited by My righteous servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:106: Indeed, in this is a proclamation for people who are worshipers(of Allah) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:107: For We have not sent you but as a mercy to all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:108: Say, “It is revealed to me that yourGod is but One God, so are you going to submit?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:109: But if they turn away, say, “I have informed you sufficiently, although I do not know whether what youare promised is near or far.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:110: Indeed, He knows whatever is said aloud of speech, and He knows whatever youconceal.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:111: And I do not know whether it is perhaps a means of trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.21:112: He said , “My Lord, judge with justice.” “For our Lord is the All-Merciful, Whose help is sought against what you allege.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:1: O mankind, be mindful of your Lord. Indeed, the quaking of the Hour is something great.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:2: On the day when yousee it: every nursing female discards whatever she has nursed, and every pregnant female aborts her pregnancy, and yousee mankind drunk, even though they are not drunk—but the punishment of Allah is severe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:3: And of mankind is one who argues about Allah without knowledge and follows every defiant Satan.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:4: It was destined for him that whoever takes him as a guardian—he surely leads him astray and leads him to the punishment of the Blaze.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:5: O mankind, if you are in doubt about the Resurrection—We have indeed created you from dust, then from a drop of semen, then from a clinging form, then from a lump of flesh,(partly) differentiated and(partly) undifferentiated, in order to clarify things for you. And We settle in the wombs whatever We will for a stated term, and then We bring youout as infants until you attain your full strength. And of you is one who is taken(at death) , and of you is one who is returned to the most abject age, so that he may not know anything after having known. And yousee the land still, but when We send down water on it, it shakes and swells and germinates all kinds of lovely plant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:6: That is because indeed Allah is the Truth, and because indeed He gives life to the dead, and because indeed He is Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:7: And because the Hour is indeed coming—there is no doubt about it—and because indeed Allah resurrects those in the graves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:8: And of mankind is one who argues about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an illuminating scripture,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:9: turning aside in contempt, to make(others) stray from the way of Allah; for him in the Earlier(Life) is disgrace, and on the Day of Resurrection We make him taste the punishment of burning:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:10: “That is for what yourhandshave put forth, and because Allah is not a tyrant unto the servants.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:11: And of mankind is one who worships Allah on edge, so that if something good befalls him, he is reassured by it; but if a trial befalls him, he turns about-face, losing the Earlier(Life) and the hereafter; that is the evident loss.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:12: Apart from Allah, he calls upon what can neither harm him nor benefit him; that is the extreme misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:13: He calls upon one whose harm is closer than his benefit; truly, what a miserable patron, and truly, what a miserable consort.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:14: Indeed, Allah enters those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow; indeed, Allah does whatever He wants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:15: Whoever has been thinking that Allah will not support himin the Earlier(Life) and the Hereafter—let him extend a meansto the sky, then cut(it) off, and see whether his plotting eliminates what enrages(him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:16: And thus We sent it down as evident signs, for Allah guides whomever He wants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:17: Indeed, those who have attained faith and those who have Judaized, and the Sabiansand the Christians and the Zoroastriansand the Polytheists—indeed, Allah judges between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, Allah is witness to everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:18: Have younot seen that to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is in the earth, and the sun and the moon and the stars and the mountains and the trees and the treading creatures and many of mankind? But many others deserved the punishment. And whomever Allah shames, there is none to honor him. Indeed, Allah does whatever He wills.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:19: Here are two adversaries who have disputed regarding their Lord, so those who denied—garments of fire were tailoredfor them, with scalding water pouring over their heads,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:20: melting their insides and the skins.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:21: And for them there are maces of iron;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:22: whenever they try to depart it out of anguish, they are driven back into it and(told) , “Tastethe punishment of burning.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:23: Indeed, Allah enters those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they are decorated with bracelets of goldand (with)pearls, and their garments therein are of silk.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:24: And they were guided to the best of words, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:25: Indeed, those who have denied and bar(others) from the way of Allah and from the Inviolable Mosque, which We have designated for all mankind equally ,(including) the one who consecrates himself therein and the visitor. And whoever wants any blasphemy unjustly therein—We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:26: And recall when We located the House for Abraham: “Do not associate anything with Me, and cleanse My House for the circumambulators and those who stand to pray and those who kneel and prostrate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:27: And announce the pilgrimage to mankind—they will come to youon foot and on every lean mount; they will come from every distant pathway,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:28: that they may witness benefits for themselves and rememberthe name of Allah during the known daysfor providing them with livestock animals. So eatof it and feed the unfortunate poor.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:29: Then let them end their untidiness and let them fulfill their vows and let them circumambulate the Ancient House.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:30: All that. And whoever venerates Allah’s inviolable rites, then it is good for him with his Lord. And livestock have been made lawful to you, except what is recited to you. So avoid the abomination of idols and avoid saying falsehood,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:31: turning to Allah, away from all that is false, without associating anything with Him. And whoever associates anything with Allah—it is as though he has fallen from the sky so that the birds snatch him or the wind sweeps down with him to a far-off place.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:32: All that. And whoever venerates the rituals of Allah—it is indeed out of the hearts’ mindfulness(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:33: In them are benefits for youfor a stated term, then their place(of sacrifice) is towards the Ancient House.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:34: And for every community We have appointed a rite, that they may commemorate Allah’s name over the livestock animals which He has provided for them. Thus yourGod is One God, so to Him submit. And give glad tidings to the humble:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:35: those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned, and those who endure patiently what has befallen them, and those who establish the prayer and spend from what We have provided for them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:36: And We have made for youthe(offering of) fleshy cattle among Allah’s rituals. In them is much good for you, so mentionAllah’s name upon them as they line up. Then when they have fallen to their sides, eat of them and feed the contented and the beggar. Thus We have subjected them to you, that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:37: Never shall their flesh nor their blood reach Allah. Rather, what reaches Him from you is mindfulness(of Him) . Thus He has subjected them to you, that you may glorify Allah for guiding you. And give glad tidings to those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:38: Indeed, Allah defends those who have attained faith. Indeed, Allah does not love every treacherous staunch denier.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:39: Permission has been granted to those who are combated , because they have been dealt with unjustly—and most surely Allah is Able to give them support:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:40: those who have been unjustifiably evicted from their homes merely for saying, “Our Lord is Allah.” And were it not that Allah repels people by means of others, monasteries and churches and synagogues and mosques—where the name of Allah is mentioned frequently—would have been utterly demolished . And most surely, Allah will support whoever supports Him. Indeed, Allah is certainly All-Powerful, Almighty.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:41: Those who, when We give them authority in the land, establish the prayer and bringthe purifying charityand command to what is fair and forbid what is deplorable. And with Allah rests the outcome of all events.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:42: And if they disbelieve you—so before them the people of Noah andʻĀdand Thamud(also) disbelieved,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:43: and the people of Abraham and the people of Lot,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:44: and the inhabitants of Midian(as w ell). And Moses was disbelieved. So I reprieved the deniers then I seized them, so how terrible was My condemnation?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:45: So how many a town have We annihilatedwhile it was unjust, so that it lies devastated upon its trellises, with an abandoned well and a lofty mansion?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:46: Have they not journeyed in the land and had hearts to reason with or ears to listen with? Therefore, it is not the sight(s) that go blind, but it is the hearts within the chests that go blind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:47: And they urge youto hasten the punishment. But Allah will not break His promise. And indeed, a single day with your Lord is like a thousand years of what youcount .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:48: And how many a town did I respite while it was unjust? Then I seized it, for to Me is the destiny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:49: Say, “O mankind, indeed, I am only an evident warner to you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:50: Therefore, those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:51: But those who strove against Our signsattempting to challenge (the believers) —those are the fellows of purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:52: And never did We send any messenger before you nor a prophet but when he wished(to guide people) Satan cast(obstacles) to his wish. Yet Allah nullifies what Satan casts, then Allah affirms His signs. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:53: Thus He makes whatever Satan casts a means of trial for those whose hearts harbor disease and those who are hard-hearted. For the unjust are indeed in profound discord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:54: And let those endowed with knowledge know that it is the truth from your Lord, and believe in it so that their hearts soften to it. And indeed, Allah will guide those who have attained faith to a straight path,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:55: while those who have denied continue to be in skepticism about it until the Hour comes upon them suddenly or there comes to them the punishment of a desolate day.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:56: Dominion on that day belongs to Allah; He judges between them. Thus those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds are in Gardens of Bliss,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:57: while those who have denied and disbelieved Our signs—for those there is a demeaning punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:58: And those who emigrated in Allah’s way then were killed or died—Allah will most surely provide them with good provision. And indeed, it is Allah who is certainly the Best of providers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:59: He will most surely enter them an entrance that well pleases them. For indeed, Allah is certainly All-Knowing, Clement.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:60: All that. And whoever punishes with the like of the punishment he was made to suffer and then he is oppressed(again) , Allah will most surely support him. Indeed, Allah is certainly Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:61: That is because Allah causes the night to penetrate the day and He causes the day to penetrate the night, and because Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:62: That is because Allah is the Truth, and because whatever they call uponapart from Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the All-High, the Supreme.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:63: Have younot seen that Allah has sent down water from the sky, then the land becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Subtle, All-Aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:64: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. For indeed it is Allah who is certainly the Self-sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:65: Have younot seen that Allah has subjected to youwhatever is in the earth and the ships that sail at sea by His command, and that He holds up(whatever is in) the heaven lest it fall on earth, except by His permission? Allah is indeed truly Compassionate towards mankind, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:66: And it is He who gave youlife, then makes you die, then revives you. Indeed, man is surely a staunch denier.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:67: For every community We have appointed a rite which they observe, so do not let them dispute with youin this matter. And do call to your Lord; you are most surely rightly guided upon the straight way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:68: But if they argue with you, say, “Allah knows better what youdo.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:69: Allah judges between you on the Day of Resurrection regarding whatever you used to differ over.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:70: Have younot come to know that Allah knows whatever is in the heaven and the earth? Indeed, that is in a record; indeed, that is easy for Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:71: Yet they worship, apart from Allah, things for which He sent down no authority and what they have no knowledge of. And for the unjustthere is no supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:72: And when Our signsare read to them, evident, yourecognize deploring(looks) on the faces of those who have denied; they nearly assault those who read to them Our signs. Say “Shall I inform you of something worse than that? The Fire! Allah has promised it to those who have denied—and what a miserable destiny!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:73: O mankind, a parable has been set forth, so listen to it: indeed, those whom you call uponapart from Allah shall never create a fly, even if they were to band together for that purpose; and if a fly snatches anything from them, they cannot recover it from it. Weak are the pursuer and the pursued.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:74: They have not respected Allah with the respect due to Him. Indeed, Allah is certainly All-Powerful, Almighty.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:75: Allah elects messengers from among the angels and from among mankind; indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:76: He knows what is before them and what is behind them. For to Allah all matters are returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:77: O you who have attained faith, kneel and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good(deeds), that you may succeed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.22:78: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not imposed upon you any discomfort in religion—the creed of your father Abraham. It is He Who named you Muslims before and in this(Scripture) , so that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over mankind. So establish the prayer and bringthe purifying charityand hold fast to Allah. He is your Patron, so what an excellent Patron and what an excellent Supporter!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:1: Surely the believers have attained success:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:2: those who are reverent in their prayers;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:3: and those who disregard idle talk;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:4: and those who are observant of the purifying charity;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:5: and those who preserve their private parts,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:6: except from their spouses or those whom they rightfully possess—for then they are free from blame.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:7: But whoever seeks anything beyond that—those are the transgressors.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:8: And those who to their trusts and their covenant are faithful,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:9: and those who preserve their prayers —
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:10: those are the ones who are the(true) inheritors
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:11: who inherit Paradise; therein they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:12: And most surely, We created man from an extract of clay;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:13: then We made him a sperm-drop, lodged in a secure place;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:14: then We developed the sperm-drop into a clinging form, and We developed the clinging form into a morsel-like lump, and We developed the morsel-like lump into bones , and We clothed the boneswith flesh, then We produced him into another creation. So supremely blessed be Allah, the Best of creators.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:15: Then after that youare surely bound to die.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:16: Then on the Day of Resurrection youare bound to be raised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:17: And surely We created above youseven(heavenly) roads, and never have We been oblivious of the creation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:18: And We sent down water from the sky in due measure and settled it in the earth, and We are certainly able to take it away.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:19: And with it We produced for yougardens of palms and grapevines; in them you have abundant fruits, and of them you eat.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:20: And a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, germinating oil and seasoning for the eaters.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:21: And there is indeed a lesson for youin livestock: We give you to drinkfrom what is in their bellies, and you have many benefits in them, and from them you eat,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:22: and on them and on ships you are carried.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:23: And most surely We sent Noah to his people, so he said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not be mindful(of God) ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:24: So the chiefs of his people, who denied, said, “This is nothing but a human being like you, who wants to gain superiority over you. And had Allah willed, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of this among our forefathers of old;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:25: he is nothing but a man in whom is madness, so wait for a while and see what happens to him.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:26: He said, “My Lord, support me with what they have disbelieved me about.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:27: So We revealed to him: “Build the ship under Our eyes and according to Our revelation. And when Our command comes and the oven overflows, carry in it ofeach kind, a(male and female) couple, and your family except those of them against whom the word has already been pronounced. And do not speak to me concerning those who have done injustice; they will surely be drowned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:28: Then, when you and those with you are settled on the ship, say, ‘Praise be to Allah who has delivered us from the unjust people.’
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:29: And say, ‘My Lord, land me at a blessed landing-place, for You are the best of those who bring(people) to land.’”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:30: Indeed, in that are surely signs, and surely We have always been testing(mankind) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:31: Then after them We brought forth another generation,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:32: and We sent among them a messenger from themselves: “Worship Allah; youhave no god other than Him; will you not be mindful(of God) ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:33: And said the chiefs of his people who denied and disbelieved in the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had indulged in the Earlier Life, “This is nothing but a human being like you, who eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:34: And if you obey a human being like yourselves, then you are bound to lose.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:35: Does he promise youthat when you have died and have become dust and bones you will be brought out?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:36: Farfetched, farfetched is what you are promised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:37: There is nothing but our Earlier Life—we die and we live, and we will never be raised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:38: He is nothing but a man who has fabricated lies against Allah, and never will we believe him.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:39: He said, “My Lord, support me with what they have disbelieved me about.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:40: He said, “Soon they will definitely become remorseful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:41: So the Shout took them away, according to the true(promise) , and We turned them into scum. So away with the unjust people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:42: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:43: No community can advance its time, nor can they delay it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:44: Then We sent Our messengers in succession; every time a messenger came to his community, they disbelieved him. So We made them follow one anotherand made them history. So away with a people who do not believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:45: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and an evident manifestation
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:46: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they acted arrogantly and they were a haughty people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:47: So they said, “Are we to believe in two human beings like us while their people are servants to us?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:48: So they disbelieved them both, and thus they became of those who were annihilated.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:49: And indeed We gave Moses the Scripture, that they may be guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:50: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and We sheltered them in a secure place on a hilltop with a spring.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:51: “O messengers, eat of the good foods and do righteousness; indeed, I am All-Knowing of what you do .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:52: For indeed, this community of yours is one community and I am your Lord, so be mindful of Me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:53: But they tore themselves into sects, each party rejoicing in what they had.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:54: So leavethem in their perplexity for a while.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:55: Do they assume that, in supplying them with wealth and children,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:56: We hasten to give them the good things? In fact, they are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:57: Indeed, those who, out of awe for their Lord, are fearful,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:58: and those who believe in their Lord’s signs,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:59: and those who associate none with their Lord,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:60: and those who bring whatever they bring while their hearts tremble, knowing that to their Lord they are returning—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:61: those are the ones who hasten towards good works, and it is they who will reach it first.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:62: And We never task any self beyond its capacity, and with Us is a recordthat tells the truth, and they will not be dealt with unjustly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:63: But their hearts are in perplexity as to this, and they have deeds other than that which they are doing,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:64: until when We seize the affluent ones among them with punishment, they promptly begin to groan.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:65: “Do not groan today; indeed, youwill not be supported by Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:66: Surely, My signsused to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:67: in arrogance regarding it, conversing by night(about it) ,(yet) deserting it .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:68: Have they not pondered the Word? Or has there come to them what came not to their forefathers of old?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:69: Or is it that they did not recognize their messenger so they disacknowledge him?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:70: Or do they say, “He is possessed?” Rather, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are hateful of the truth.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:71: Yet were the Truth to follow their whims, the heavens and the earth and everyone in them would have become corrupted. Rather, We have come up to them with their Reminder, but they keep disregarding their Reminder.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:72: Or are youasking them for a payment? Rather, your Lord’s payment is better, for He is the best of providers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:73: And indeed, youare surely calling them to a straight path,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:74: for those who do not believe in the Hereafter are most surely swerving from the path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:75: And were We to have mercy upon them and remove whatever harm is upon them, surely they would continue to wander aimlessly while exceeding all limits.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:76: And most surely We gripped them with punishment, but they did not surrender to their Lord, nor do they supplicate(Him)
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:77: until, when We have opened before them a gate of intense punishment, they suddenly despair.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:78: And it is He Who initiated for youthe hearing and the sight(s) and the burning hearts; scarcely do you give thanks!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:79: And it is He Who scattered youon earth, and to Him you will be herded.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:80: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and to Him is the alternation of night and day. Do younot reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:81: Rather, they said the like of what the ancients had said.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:82: They said, “Can it be thatwhen we have died and become dust and bones, can it be that we will really be resurrected?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:83: Most surely, we were promised this before, we and our forefathers—these are nothing but legends of the ancients.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:84: Say, “To whom does the earth and everyone in it belong, if youhappen to know?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:85: They will say, “To Allah.” Say, “Will you never remember ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:86: Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:87: They will say, “To Allah.” Say, “Will you never be mindful(of God) ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:88: Say, “In whose hand is the dominance of everything, and He grants refuge but cannot be granted refuge, if you happen to know?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:89: They will say, “ToAllah.” Say, “Then are you bewitched?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:90: Rather, We have come up to them with the truth, yet they are surely liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:91: Never has Allah taken any offspring nor has there ever been any god with Him, for then each god would have taken away what he had created, and some of them would have gained supremacy over others. Highly Exalted is Allah, far above what they describe:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:92: the Knower of the hidden realm and the manifest. So Most High is He, far above what they associate(as gods with Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:93: Say, “My Lord, if You would show me what they are promised,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:94: my Lord, do not make me among the unjust people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:95: And We are surely able to show youwhat We promise them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:96: Repelwhat is bad by what is better. We know better what they describe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:97: And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the urgings of the devils,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:98: and I seek refuge with You, my Lord, lest they become present with me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:99: Until, when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:100: that I may act righteously in that which I have left(behind) .” But no! It is just a word that he says, and behind them is a barrier until the day they are resurrected.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:101: So when the Horn is blown, no ties of kinship between them exist on that day, nor do they ask one another.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:102: So the one whose scales weigh heavy—those are the successful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:103: And the one whose scales weigh light—those are the ones who have lost themselves; in Hell they abide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:104: The Fire lashes their faces, and therein they grimace.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:105: “Were not My signsrecited to you, but you used to disbelieve them?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:106: They said, “Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:107: Our Lord, bring us out of this, and if we ever return, we would truly be unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:108: He said, “Be despisedtherein and do not speak to Me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:109: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to say, ‘Our Lord, we have attained faith, so forgive us and have mercy on us, and You are the best of the merciful.’
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:110: But youmade them a target of ridicule until they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:111: Today I have indeed rewarded them for what they endured patiently, foritis they who are the triumphant ones.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:112: He said , “How long did you remain on earth in terms of number of years?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:113: They said, “We remained a day or part of a day, so ask those who keep count.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:114: He said , “Youremained but for a little while, if you only knew.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:115: Did youthink that We had created you in vain, and that to Us you would not be returned ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:116: Rather, Most High is Allah, the True King; there is no god but He, the Lord of the Noble Throne.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:117: And whoever calls upon another god with Allah—he has no proof thereof—his reckoning rests with his Lord; indeed, the deniers never succeed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.23:118: And say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of the merciful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:1: A surahthat We have sent down and ordained and sent down in it evident signs, that you may remind yourselves .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:2: The fornicating woman and the fornicating man—whip each one of them a hundred lashes and let no compassion towards them keep youfrom carrying out Allah’s religion, if you(truly) believe in Allah and the Last Day, and let their punishment be witnessed by a groupof believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:3: The fornicating man marries none but a fornicating woman or an idolatress, and the fornicating woman marries none but a fornicating man or an idolater, and that has been prohibited for the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:4: And those who accuse chaste women then cannot bring four witnesses—whipthem eighty lashes and do not ever accept their testimony, for those are the defiantly disobedient—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:5: except for those who have repented afterwards and reformed, for indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:6: And those who accuse their own spouses but have no witnesses except themselves, then let the testimony of one of them be four oaths by Allah that he is surely of the truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:7: And the fifth is: may Allah’s curse indeedbeupon him if he is of the liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:8: But what averts punishment from her is that she testifies under oath four times by Allah that he is surely of the liars,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:9: while the fifth is: may Allah’s wrath indeed beupon her if he is of the truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:10: And were it not for Allah’s grace upon you, and His mercy, and that Allah is the Granter and Accepter of repentance, All-Wise. . .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:11: Indeed, those who produced the fabrication are a band of you. Do not consider it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For each person of them is whatever sin he has earned, yet the one who played the major role—for him is a great punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:12: If only when youheard it, the believing men and the believing women had thought well of themselvesand said, “This is an evident fabrication!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:13: If only they had produced four witnesses against it. Yet since they did not come up with the witnesses, then before Allah they are the liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:14: And were it not for Allah’s grace upon you, and His mercy in the Earlier(Life) and the Hereafter, you would have been touched by a great punishment for what you have ventured into.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:15: Recall receiving it with your tongues and saying with your mouths what you had no knowledge of, and considering it trivial while with Allah it is greatly serious.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:16: And if only when youheard it you had said, “It is not lawful for us to speak about this. Highly Exalted are You; this is a great slander.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:17: Allah admonishes you never to return to the like of it if you are believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:18: And Allah clarifies the signs to you, for Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:19: Indeed, those who love that obscenity should spread among the believers—for them is a painful punishment in the Earlier(Life) and the Hereafter, for Allah knows while you know not.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:20: And were it not for Allah’s grace upon you, and His mercy, and that Allah is Compassionate, Bestowing of mercy. . .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:21: O you who have attained faith, do not follow Satan’s footsteps, for whoever follows Satan’s footsteps(should know that) indeed he commands to obscenity and what is deplorable. And were it not for Allah’s grace towards you, and His mercy, not one of you would ever have been purified, ever, but Allah purifies whomever He wills. For Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:22: And let not the ones endowed with grace and affluence swear not to give to the near relatives and the destituteand the emigrants in the way of Allah, and let them pardon and let them overlook. Do younot love that Allah should forgive you? For Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:23: Those who accuse chaste, unwary, believing women are indeed cursed in the Earlier(Life) and the Hereafter, and for them is a great punishment
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:24: on the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them regarding what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:25: On that day, Allah pays them their true recompense in full, and they learn that it is Allah who is the Evident Truth.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:26: Nastyones are for nasty men, and nasty men are for nasty ones, and good ones are for good men, and good men are for good ones. Those are acquitted of what they say; for them is forgiveness and a noble provision.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:27: O you who have attained faith, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you announce your presence and greet their inhabitants with the greeting of peace. That is better for you, that you may remind yourselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:28: But if youfind no one in them, then do not enter them until you are given permission. And if it is said to you, “Turn back,” then turn back; it is purer for you, for Allah is All-Knowing of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:29: Youcommit no sin by entering uninhabited houses in which there is convenience for you, for Allah knows whatever you disclose and whatever you conceal.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:30: Tellthe believing men to restrain their sight(s) and to preserve their private parts; that is purer for them. Indeed, Allah is All-Aware of what they do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:31: And tellthe believing women to restrain their sight(s) and to preserve their private parts, and not display their adornment except what is apparent thereof, and to draw their head coverings over their bosoms and not display their adornment except to their husbands, or their fathers, or their husbands’ fathers, or their sons, or their husbands’ sons, or their brothers, or their brothers’ sons, or their sisters’ sons, or their womenfolk, or those whom they rightfully possess, or their male attendants who have no(sexual) urge, or children who are not yet aware of women’s privacies, and they should not strike their feet to draw attention to their hidden adornment. Thus repent to Allah, all of you, O believers, that you may succeed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:32: And marry the singles among you and those who are fit among your bondmen and bondwomen. If they are poor, Allah will enrich them from His grace. For Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:33: And let those who do not find the means to marry remain chaste until Allah enriches them from His grace. And if any of those whom yourightfully possess desire an(emancipation) agreement, write an agreement with them if you recognize some good in them, and give them of Allah’s wealth which He has given you. And do not compel your maids to prostitution, seeking the materials of the Earlier(Life) , if they want to remain chaste. But should anyone compel them—then after their compulsion, Allah is indeed Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:34: And We have most surely sent down to youclarifying signs and a parable from those who passed on before you, and an admonition for the ones who were mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:35: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The parable of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp; the lamp is in a glass; the glass is like a glittering planet, kindled from a blessed tree—an olive tree—neither eastern nor western. Its oil would almost illuminate even if no fire were to touch it. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whomever He wills. Thus Allah sets forth parables for mankind. For Allah is All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:36: (Such light shines) in houses which Allah has permitted to be raised up and in which His name is remembered. Highly exalting Him therein, mornings and before sunset,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:37: are menwhom neither bargain nor sale distracts from Allah’s remembrance or from establishing the prayers or from bringingthe purifying charity, fearing a day when hearts and sight(s) are overturned,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:38: (in the hope) that Allah may repay them according to the best of what they have done and increase them from His grace. For Allah provides for whomever He wills without measure.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:39: But those who have denied—their deeds are like a mirage in a desert: the thirsty one thinks it is water until when he has reached it he finds it to be nothing, but there he finds Allah, Who settles his account in full. For Allah is Swift in reckoning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:40: Or(they are) like darkness(es) in an abysmal sea, covered by waves, above which are waves, above which are clouds—darkness(es) , one upon the other. If one holds out his hand, he can hardly see it. For whomever Allah has not granted a light has no light.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:41: Have younot seen how Allah is highly exalted by whoever is in the heavens and the earth and by the birds outstretching their wings, each having come to know its(way of) prayer and exaltation? And Allah is All-Knowing of what they do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:42: For to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the destiny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:43: Have you not seen how Allah propels clouds, then brings them together, then piles them up in heaps so you see rainfall coming out of its midst? And He sends down from the sky—from mountains in it— some hail, striking with it whomever He wills and diverting it from whomever He wills? The flash of its lightening almost does away with the sight(s) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:44: Allah alternates night and day. Indeed, in that is a lesson for those endowed with sight(s) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:45: And Allah created every treading creature from water, so of them is one(kind) that treads upon its belly, and one(kind) that treads upon two legs, and one(kind) that treads upon four; Allah creates whatever He wills; Allah is indeed Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:46: Most surely, We have sent down clarifying signs, and Allah guides whomever He wills to a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:47: And they say, “We have attained faith in Allah and in the Messenger, and we have obeyed.” Then a group of them turn away afterwards, for in no way are those ever believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:48: And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger in order to judge between them, a group of them promptly disregards(it) ;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:49: but if the truth is in their favor, they come to Him in obedience.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:50: Is there sickness in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allah may oppress them, or(that) His Messenger(may do so) ? In fact, they themselves are the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:51: However, the response of the believers when they are called to Allah and His Messenger in order to judgebetween them has always been to say, “We have heard and obeyed”, for those are the successful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:52: And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger and fears Allah and is mindful of Him—then it is those who are the triumphant ones.
