Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:53: And they swore by Allah their most solemn oaths that if youcommanded them, they would set out. Say, “Donot swear;(your) obedience is well-known. Allah is indeed All-Aware of what you do.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:54: Say, “ObeyAllah and obey the Messenger.” But if youturn away, then heis only responsible for what(duty) he is made to carry, and youare responsible for whatever(duty) you are made to carry. For if you obey him, you will be guided, while the only responsibility of the Messenger is evident proclamation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:55: Allah has promised those of you who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds that He will most surely make them successors in the land as He made those before them successors (of others) , and that He will most surely establish for them their religion which He has approved for them, and that He will most surely substitute security in place of their fear—as they worship Me, never associating anything with Me. But whoever denies after that—those are the defiantly disobedient.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:56: And establishthe prayer and bringthe purifying charityand obey the Messenger, that you may be granted mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:57: Never thinkthat those who have deniedcan thwart(God) on earth. For their shelter is the Fire, and indeed, what a miserable destiny!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:58: O you who have attained faith, let those whom you rightfully possess and those of you who have not reached puberty seek your permission (befor e entering) onthree occasions: before the dawn prayer and at noon when you lay aside your clothes and after the evening prayer—three occasions of privacy for you. At other times, neither you nor they commit sin by intermingling with one another; Allah thus clarifies the signs for you. For Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:59: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them seek permission as those before them have sought permission; Allah thus clarifies His signs for you. For Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:60: And elderly women who do not expect(to be desired in) marriage—they commit no sin by taking off their outer clothing without flaunting their adornment, but to maintain modesty is better for them. For Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:61: There is no blame on the blind, nor any blame on the lame, nor any blame on the sick, nor on yourselves for eating at your houses , or your fathers’ houses, or your mothers’ houses, or your brothers’ houses, or your sisters’ houses, or the houses of your paternal uncles, or the houses of your paternal aunts, or the houses of your maternal uncles, or the houses of your maternal aunts, or those whose keys you own, or that of a friend of yours. You commit no sin by eating together or separately. But when you enter such houses, greet yourselves with a greeting from Allah, blessed(and) good; Allah thus explains the signs for you, that you may reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:62: Indeed, the believers are but those who have attained faith in Allah and His Messenger and, when they are with him for a matter of common interest, they do not leave until they have sought his permission. Indeed, those who seek yourpermission—those are the ones who believe in Allah and His Messenger. So if they seek your permission to attend to some affair of theirs, give permission to any of them you wish and seek Allah’s forgiveness for them; indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:63: Do not make the calling of the Messenger among yourselves like your calling of one another. Allah certainly knows thoseamong you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those who oppose his command beware, lest a trial afflict them or a painful punishment afflict them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.24:64: Undoubtedly, to Allah does belong whatever is in the heavens and the earth; surely, He knows yourcondition. And on the day they are returned to Him, He informs them of what they did. For Allah is All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:1: Supremely Blessed be the One Who bestowed the Criterion from on high upon His servant, to be a warnerto all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:2: The One to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Who has not taken for Himself any offspring nor has He any associate in the dominion, and He has created everything and determined its measure.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:3: And they have taken apart from Him gods who do not create anything, but are themselves created, and who possess for themselves neither harm nor benefit, and have no power over life or death or resurrection.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:4: Moreover, those who have denied said, “This is nothing but a fabrication that he has forged, while other people have helped him with it.” They have certainly come forth with injustice and falsehood.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:5: And they said, “Legends of the ancients that he has sought to be written down; thus they are dictated to him morning and evening.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:6: Say, “It was sent down by the One Who knows the Secret in the heavens and the earth; indeed, He has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:7: And they said, “What sort of messenger is this who eats food and walks in marketplaces? If only an angel had been sent down to him to be a warner alongside him,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:8: or if a treasure were to be cast to him, or if he had a garden from which he eats .” And the unjust ones said, “Youare only following a bewitched man.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:9: Lookhow they have set forth parables for you and gone astray, so they cannot find a way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:10: Supremely Blessed be the One Who, if He so willed, would provide youwith better than that—Gardens beneath which rivers flow—and make for you palaces.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:11: Rather, they have considered the Hour to be a lie, and We have prepared a blaze for those who have disbelieved in the Hour.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:12: When it sees them from a distant place, they hear its raging and roaring.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:13: And when they are cast, shackled, into a tight place therein, there they plead for demise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:14: “Do not callfor one demise today, but call for many demises.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:15: Say, “Is that better or the Garden of Eternity promised to the ones who were mindful(of God) ? For them it has always been a repayment anda destiny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:16: They have therein whatever they desire, as they abide. That has always been yourLord’s promise,(worthy) to be requested.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:17: And on the day when He herdsthemand what they worship apart from Allah, then Hesays , “Was it youwho misguided these servants of Mine, or was it they who strayed from the way?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:18: They said, “Highly Exalted are You. We should not have taken any masters apart from You. But you allowed them to enjoy, as well as their fathers, until they forgot the Reminder and became a ruined people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:19: Thus theyhave certainly disbelieved youregarding what you say, so you can neither avoid(punishment) nor get any support. And whoever of you commits injustice, We will make him taste a supreme punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:20: And never did We send any emissaries before youbut they used to eat food and walk in the marketplaces. And We made some of you a means of trial for others—will you be patient? And your Lord has always been All-Seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:21: And those who do not expect to meet Us said, “If only the angels were sent down to us or we could see our Lord.” They have acted arrogantly regarding themselves and have become excessively defiant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:22: On the day when they see the angels—no glad tidings for the criminals on that day, and theysay, “an insurmountable separator.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:23: And We proceededto the work they had done and turned them into scattered dust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:24: The fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) on that day have a better residence and are more fairly accommodated.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:25: And it is the day when the sky is cleft with clouds and the angels weresent down in streams.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:26: Dominion on that day belongs to the All-Merciful, and it has been a difficult day for the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:27: And it is the day when the unjust bites his hands, saying, “If only I had followed the way with the Messenger.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:28: Woe to me! I wish I had not taken so-and-so for a close friend;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:29: he definitely made me stray away from the Reminder after it had come to me.” And Satan has always been a betrayer of man.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:30: And the Messenger said, “O My Lord, my people have dealt with this Recitalby deserting it.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:31: Likewise, to every prophet We assigned enemies from among the criminals. But sufficient is yourLord as a Guide and Supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:32: And those who denied said, “If only the Recitalhad been sent down upon him as one complete whole!” Yet(it is sent in this way) in order to strengthen your heart thereby, and We(revealed it to be) chanted slowly and distinctly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:33: And whatever similitude they come to youwith, We provide you with the truth and a better exposition.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:34: Those who are herded to Hell on their faces—those are in a worse position and further astray from the way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:35: And surely We gave Moses the Scripture and appointed his brother Aaron as an assistant,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:36: then We said, “Goto the people who have disbelieved Our signs,” then We destroyed them completely.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:37: And when the people of Noah disbelieved the messengers, We drowned them and made them a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful punishment for the unjust,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:38: and(for) ʻĀdand Thamûdand the fellows of Al-Russand many generations in between.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:39: Thus to each We set forth parables, and each We devastated utterly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:40: And indeed they have already come across the cityupon which was rained the woeful rain. Have they not seen it then? Rather, they did not expect any resurrection.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:41: And when they see you, they take you not except in ridicule: “Is this the one Allah has sent as a messenger?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:42: He was about to make us stray away from our gods, had we not patiently adhered to them.” And they will eventually know, when they witness the punishment, who is further astray from the way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:43: Have youseen the one who took his own whim as his god? Would you be a trustee for him?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:44: Or do youassume that most of them hear or reason? They are but like livestock; rather, they are even further astray from the way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:45: Have younot seen how your Lord extended the shade? And had He willed, He could have made it still. Then We made the sun a guide to it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:46: Then We drew it to Us easily.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:47: And it is He Who made the night for youas a garment and sleep for repose, and made the day a(time of) resurrection.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:48: And it is He Who sent the winds as heralds of glad tidings ahead of His mercy. And Wesent down from the sky pure water
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:49: to revive a lifeless land thereby, and to provide drink for a multitude of animals and humans We have created.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:50: And most surely We have circulated it among them, that they may constantly remember , yet most of mankind refused anything but constant denial.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:51: And had We willed, We could have sent to every town a warner.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:52: So do not obeythe deniers, but strive against them with ita supreme striving.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:53: And it is He Who merged the two seas, this one fresh and sweet and this one salty and bitter, and He made between them a barrier and an insurmountable separator.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:54: And it is He Who created of water a human being, then made him related by lineage and marriage. And yourLord has always been All-Able.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:55: Yet they worship, apart from Allah, what neither benefits them nor harms them. And the denier has always been a backup against his Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:56: And We have not sent you but as a bearer of glad tidings and as a warner.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:57: Say, “I ask of you no reward for this—only that whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:58: And place yourtrust in the Ever-Living One Who never dies, and exalt Him with praise. And sufficient is He as the All-Aware of the misdeeds of His servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:59: The One Who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six daysthen settled on the Throne. The All-Merciful. So ask about Him one(who is) well aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:60: And when it is said to them, “Prostrate yourselves to the All-Merciful,” they say, “And what is the All-Merciful? Shall we prostrate ourselves to what you command us?” And it increases their aversion.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:61: Supremely Blessed be the One Who placed constellations in the sky and placed in it a lamp and an illuminating moon.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:62: And it is He Who made the night and the day alternate—for whoever wants to constantly remember or wants to give constant thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:63: And the servants of the All-Merciful are those who walk the earth gently, and when the ignorant harassers address them, they say, “Peace.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:64: And they are those who spend the night prostrating themselves to their Lord and standing(in prayer) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:65: And they are those who say, ‘‘Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell; indeed, its suffering has been ever adhering;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:66: it is indeed bad as a residence and dwelling place.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:67: And they are those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor stingy, for the upright method has always been between both.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:68: And they are those who do not call upon any other god with Allah and do not kill the self which Allah has made inviolable—except in the pursuit of justice—and do not fornicate. And whoever does that encounters penalties.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:69: The punishment is doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he abides therein humiliated—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:70: except for whoever has repented and has attained faith and has done righteous work, for those—Allah replaces their evil deeds with good deeds. And Allah has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:71: And whoever has repented and has acted righteously, then surely he repents to Allah a true repentance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:72: And they are those who do not bear false witness, and when they come across idle talk, they pass by with dignity.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:73: And they are those who, when reminded of the signsof their Lord, do not fall before them deaf and blind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:74: And they are those who say, “Our Lord, grant us in our spouses and our offspring(s) a comfort to the eyes, and make us a good example of the ones who were mindful(of God) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:75: Those are awarded the Chamber(in Heaven) for their patience, and are received therein with greetings and peace,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:76: abiding therein—an excellent residence and dwelling place.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.25:77: Say, “What are youto my Lord without your calling upon Him? But you have certainly disbelieved, so the inevitable is bound to come.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:2: Those are the signs of the Evident Scripture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:3: Perhaps youare going to destroy yourself with sorrow because they do not believe?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:4: If We will, We can bestow upon them a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bent in humility.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:5: But no fresh reminder comes to them from the All-Merciful but they disregard it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:6: Thus they have certainly disbelieved, but soon will come to them the tidings of what they used to ridicule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:7: Have they not seen the land— how many noble kinds of plants We have germinated therein?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:8: Indeed, in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:9: And indeed, it is yourLord who is surely the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:10: And recall when Your Lord called to Moses, “Go to the unjust people—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:11: the people of Pharaoh. Will they never be mindful?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:12: He said, “My Lord, I fear that they will disbelieve me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:13: And my chest tightens and my tongue is not fluent, so send for Aaron(too) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:14: And they hold(a charge of) a misdeed against me, so I fear they will kill me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:15: He said, “By no means! So go, with Our signs; We are with you, listening.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:16: So goto Pharaoh and say, ‘We are indeed the Messenger of the Lord of all realms:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:17: send the Children of Israel with us.’”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:18: He said, “Did we not raise youamong us as a child, and you stayed among us for many years of your life?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:19: And youcommitted that base deed of yours that you committed while you were one of the deniers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:20: He said, “I did it then while I was one of those astray.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:21: And I fled from youwhen I feared you, then my Lord gave me wise judgment and made me one of the emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:22: And is that a favor youremind me of: that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:23: Pharaoh said, “And what is the Lord of all realms?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:24: He said, “The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, if you(can ever) believe with certitude.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:25: He said to those around him, “Are you listening?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:26: He said, “YourLord and the Lord of your ancient fathers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:27: He said, “This messenger of yours who has been sent to you is certainly a madman.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:28: He said, “The Lord of the east and the west and whatever is between them, if youcan(ever) reason.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:29: He said, “If youaccept any god other than me, I will surely make you of the imprisoned.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:30: He said, “What if I bring yousomething evident?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:31: He said, “Bring it, if youare of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:32: So he cast his staff and thereupon it was an evident serpent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:33: And he pulled his hand and thereupon it was white for the beholders.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:34: He said to the chiefs around him, “This is indeed a knowledgeable sorcerer
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:35: who wants to evict you from your land with his sorcery, so what do you command?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:36: They said, “Put him off, and his brother, and send summoners to the cities
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:37: to bring youevery knowledgeable magician.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:38: So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointment on a specified day.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:39: And people were told, “Are you going to assemble,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:40: that we may follow the sorcerers if they are the overcomers?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:41: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh, “Is there a reward for us if we are the overcomers?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:42: He said, “Yes, and you will then most surely become of those brought near(to me) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:43: Moses said to them, “Cast whatever you intend to cast.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:44: So they cast their ropes and their staffs and said, “By Pharaoh’s might, we are most surely the overcomers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:45: Then Moses threw his staff, and thereupon it swallowed what they had fabricated.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:46: So the sorcerers fell down prostrating.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:47: They said, “We have attained faith in the Lord of all realms,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:48: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:49: He said, “Have youbelieved in him before I have given you permission? He must be your leader who taught you sorcery. Well, you will certainly know soon; I will most surely cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will most surely crucify you all.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:50: They said, “No problem; indeed, to our Lord we are returning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:51: We ardently hope our Lord will forgive us our offenses, as we were the first of the believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:52: And We revealed to Moses: “Journey withMy servants by night; youwill indeed be followed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:53: So Pharaoh sent summoners to the cities.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:54: “Indeed, these are just a small gang,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:55: and they certainly do enrage us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:57: So We got them out from gardens and springs
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:58: and treasures and a noble domicile.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:59: So it was. And We made the Children of Israel inherit them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:60: And they pursued them at sunrise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:61: And when the two groups sighted each other, the followers of Moses said, “We are indeed overtaken!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:62: He said, “By no means! My Lord is indeed with me; He will guide me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:63: So We revealed to Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff,” whereupon it split, so that each part was like a great hill.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:64: And thereupon, we brought the others near.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:65: Then We saved Moses and those with him, all of them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:67: Most surely in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:68: And most surely, yourLord is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:69: And relate to them the tiding of Abraham,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:70: when he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:71: They said, “We worship human-shaped idols and we remain consecrating ourselves to them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:72: He said, “Can they hear youwhen you call?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:73: Or can they benefit you, or can they do harm?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:74: They said, “Rather, we found our forefathers doing so.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:75: He said, “Have you seen what you have been worshiping,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:77: They are enemies to me, except for the Lord of all realms,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:78: Who created me and therefore He guides me;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:79: and Who feeds me and gives me to drink;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:80: and when I get sick, He heals me;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:81: and Who makes me die and then revives me;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:82: and Whom I ardently hope will forgive me my offense on the Day of Recompense.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:83: “My Lord, grant me wise judgment and include me with the righteous,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:84: and make me a reputation of truth among later generations,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:85: and make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:86: and forgive my father—he was indeed one of those astray,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:87: and do not disgrace me on the day they are resurrected:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:88: the day when neither wealth nor children are of help—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:89: except for one who has cometo Allah witha sound heart.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:90: And the Garden(of Paradise) was brought near for those who had been mindful,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:91: while purgatory was displayed to the deluded ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:92: And they were told, “Where is what you used to worship
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:93: apart from Allah? Can they support you or get support for themselves?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:94: Then they were toppled into it, together with the deluded ones
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:95: and the troops of Iblis, all of them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:96: They said, as they disputed about it,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:97: “(We swear) by Allah, we were surely in evident misguidance
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:98: for equating youwith the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:99: But no one misguided us except the criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:100: And now we neither have intercessors
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:102: So if only we could have another chance, we would be of the believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:103: Most surely in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:104: And most surely, yourLord is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:105: The people of Noah disbelieved the emissaries
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:106: when their brother Noah said to them, “Will you never be mindful?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:107: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:108: So be mindful of Allah and obey me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:109: And I ask of you no reward for this, for my reward is only from the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:110: So be mindful of Allah and obey me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:111: They said, “Shall we believe in you, when(only) the lowliest have followed you ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:112: He said, “What do I know about what they used to do?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:113: Their reckoning rests only with my Lord, if only you were aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:114: And in no way would I expel the believers;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:115: I am only an evident warner.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:116: They said, “If you do not refrain, O Noah, you will most surely be of those stoned.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:117: He said, “My Lord, my people have disbelieved me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:118: So legislate between me and them decisively, and deliver me and those who are with me of the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:119: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:121: Most surely in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:122: And most surely, yourLord is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:124: when their brother Hûd said to them, “Will you never be mindful?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:125: Indeed, I am to youa trustworthy messenger.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:126: So be mindful of Allah and obey me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:127: And I ask of you no reward for this, for my reward is only from the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:128: Do you build a sign on every height for vanity’s sake?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:129: And you set up fortresses, hoping to live eternally?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:130: And when youstrike, you strike mercilessly?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:131: So be mindful of Allah and obey me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:132: And be mindful of the One Who supplied you with whatever you know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:133: He supplied you with livestock and children
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:135: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great day.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:136: They said, “It is equal to us, whether you admonish or be not of those who admonish.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:137: This is nothing but the character of the ancients,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:138: and we will never be punished.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:139: So they disbelieved him; thus We annihilated them. Most surely in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:140: And most surely, YourLord is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:142: when their brother Salih said to them, “Will you never be mindful?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:143: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:144: So be mindful of Allah and obey me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:145: And I ask of you no reward for this, for my reward is only from the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:146: Will you(always) be left secure in whatever is here?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:148: and vegetation(s) , and palm-trees with tender yield?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:149: And you carve houses in the mountains, with skill ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:150: So be mindful of Allah and obey me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:151: And do not obey the command of the extremists:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:152: those who spread corruption in the land and do not reform.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:153: They said, “You are surely one of the bewitched;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:154: you are nothing but a human being like us, so bring us a sign if you are of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:155: He said, “This is a she-camel; she has her turn to drink, and you have your turn to drink on a well-known day.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:156: And do not touch her with any harm, lest the punishment of a great day seize you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:157: But they hamstrung her, then became remorseful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:158: So the punishment seized them. Most surely in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:159: And most surely, yourLord is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:160: The people of Lot disbelieved the emissaries
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:161: when their brother Lot said to them, “Will you never be mindful?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:162: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:163: So be mindful of Allah and obey me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:164: And I ask of you no reward for this, for my reward is only from the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:165: Of all the creatures in all realms, do youapproach males?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:166: And you leave what your Lord has created for you of spouses? Rather, you are a people who have transgressed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:167: They said, “Unless you refrain, O Lot, you will most surely be of those evicted.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:168: He said, “I am certainly one of those who abhor your practice.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:169: “My Lord, deliver me and my family from what they practice.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:170: So We delivered him and his family, all of them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:171: except for an old woman among those who lingered behind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:173: And We rained down upon them a rain, so how bad was the rain of those forewarned!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:174: Most surely in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:175: And most surely, yourLord is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:176: The Fellows of the Thicket disbelieved the emissaries
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:177: when Shu’aib said to them, “Will you never be mindful?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:178: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:179: So be mindful of Allah and obey me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:180: And I ask of you no reward for this, for my reward is only from the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:181: Give full measure and do not be of the cheaters,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:183: and do not defraud people of their belongings, and do not go wickedly about the land, corrupting it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:184: And be mindful of the One Who created youand the masses of old.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:185: They said, “You are surely one of the bewitched.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:186: And you are nothing but a human being like us, and we think that you are surely of the liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:187: So make pieces from heaven fall on us, if you are of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:188: He said, “My Lord knows better what you do.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:189: But they disbelieved him, so the punishment of the Day of Gloom seized them; it was indeed the punishment of a great day.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:190: Most surely in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:191: And most surely, yourLord is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:192: And most surely, it is a bestowal from on high from the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:193: The Trustworthy Spiritcame down with it
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:194: upon yourheart, that you may be of the forewarners,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:196: And it is in the books of the ancients.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:197: Is it not a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel recognized it?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:198: And had We bestowed it from on high upon some non-Arabs
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:199: and he had recited it to them, they would still not have believed in it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:200: Thus We inserted it into the hearts of the criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:201: They will not believe in it until they witness the painful punishment
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:202: which will come to them suddenly while they are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:203: Then they will say, “Will we be reprieved?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:204: So do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:205: So have youseen if We let them enjoy(life) for(many) years,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:206: then there comes to them what they were promised,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:207: of what avail to them will their past enjoyments be?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:208: And never did We destroy a town but it had forewarners—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:209: a reminding, and in no way have We been unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:210: And in no way have the devils been descending with it,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:211: for it neither suits them nor is it in their power.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:212: They are indeed barred from hearing(it) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:213: So do not call upon any other god with Allah, lest yoube of those punished.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:215: and lower your wingfor those of the believers who have followed you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:216: But if they disobey you, say, “I am indeed innocent of what you do.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:217: And place your trust in the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:218: Who sees you when you rise,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:219: as well as your movement among those who prostrate;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:220: indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:221: Shall I inform youupon whom the devils keep descending?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:222: They keep descending upon every sinful fabricator.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:223: They give ear, and most of them are liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:224: And as for the poets—the deluded ones follow them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:225: Have younot seen that they aimlessly roam in every valley?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:226: And that they say what they do not do?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.26:227: Except for those who attained faith and did righteous deeds and remembered Allah frequently and defended themselves after they had been dealt with unjustly. And those who have been unjust will know the place of return to which they are bound to return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:1: Tâ Sîn. Those are the signsof the Recitaland an Evident Scripture—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:2: guidance and glad tidings for the believers
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:3: who establish the prayer and bringthe purifying charityand, of the Hereafter, they are certain.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:4: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter—We have adorned their deeds for them, so they wander aimlessly;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:5: those are the ones for whom is the worst punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the biggest losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:6: And indeed, youare surely receiving the Recitalfrom One who is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:7: Recall when Moses said to his family, “I have surely glimpsed a fire. I will bring you some news from it, or bring you a firebrand, a borrowed flame , that you may warm yourselves.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:8: Then when he reached it, he was called: “Blessed is whoever is in the fire and whoever is around it, and Highly Exalted is Allah, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:9: O Moses, it is indeed I, Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:10: Now, cast your staff.” So when he saw it shaking as though it were a snake, he turned away, fleeing, and did not look back. “O Moses, fear not! Truly, in My presence emissaries have nothing to fear,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:11: except for one who did an injustice then substituted kindness for evil—then I am surely Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:12: And put your hand inside the opening of your garment(and) it will come out white, without any evil affliction—among nine signs to Pharaoh and his people; they have indeed been a defiantly disobedient people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:13: So when Our signs came to them as an eye-opener, they said, “This is evident sorcery.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:14: And they repudiated them, though their(inner) selves were certain of them—out of injustice and haughtiness; so lookwhat the outcome was for the corrupters.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:15: And indeed, We brought David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, “Praise be to Allah, Who has favored us over many of His believing servants.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:16: And Solomon succeeded David, and he said, “O mankind, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given of everything; this is most surely the evident grace.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:17: And to the service of Solomon were herded his troops of unseen beingsand men and birds, all held in strict order,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:18: until, when they came upon the valley of ants, an ant said, “O you ants! Enter into your homes, lest Solomon and his troops crush you while they are unaware.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:19: So he smiled, laughing at her speech, and said, “My Lord, direct me to be thankful for Your blessings which you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteousness that well pleases You. And include me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:20: Then he inspected the birds and said, “What is it with me? Can I not see the hoopoe, or is he among the absentees?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:21: Most surely, I will either punish him severely or slay him, unless he brings me an evident excuse.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:22: But he did not stay away for long and he said, “I have encompassed that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with sure tidings.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:23: I found a woman reigning over them, and she has been given of everything, and she has a great throne.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:24: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun apart from Allah, for Satan has adorned their deeds for them and has thus barred them from the way, so that they are not guided—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:25: that they do not prostrate themselvesto Allah, Who brings out what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows whatever you hide and whatever youmake public.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:26: Allah—there is no god but He, Lord of the Great Throne.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:27: He said, “We will see whether you have spoken the truth or have been one of the liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:28: Go with this letter of mine and cast it to them, then turn away from them and wait to see what they say to each other.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:29: She said, “O chiefs, a noble letter has indeed been cast down to me;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:30: it is indeed from Solomon, and it is indeed, ‘In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Bestower of mercy:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:31: You must not exalt yourselves above me and must come to me as Muslims.’”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:32: She said, “O chiefs, give me your opinion in this matter of mine. I never take a decision on any matter except in your presence.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:33: They said, “We are a people of power and of intense force, and you are in command, so see what you wish to command.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:34: She said, “Indeed, when kings enter a town, they corrupt it and humiliate its dignified people, and this is what they(always) do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:35: Thus I am sending them a gift and will see what the emissaries return with.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:36: So when he came to Solomon, he said, “Are yousupplying me with wealth? What Allah has brought me is better than what He has brought you. Rather, it is you who rejoice when given gifts.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:37: Returnback to them. Indeed, we will come upon them with troops they cannot resist, and indeed, we will evict them from it, humiliated and dishonored.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:38: He said, “O chiefs, which one of you can bring me her throne before they come to me as Muslims?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:39: A powerful one of the unseen beingssaid, “I will bring it to youbefore you rise from your seat, and indeed, I am certainly strong and trustworthy enough to do it.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:40: The one who had knowledge of the Scripture said, “I will bring it to you before you blink your eye.” So when he saw it settled before him, he said, “This is of my Lord’s grace, to test me: whether I will thank or will deny. For whoever is thankful is only thankful to his own benefit, and whoever has denied—my Lord is, indeed, Self-Sufficient, Noble.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:41: He said, “Disguise her throne for her, and we shall see whether she will be guided or be one of those who are never guided.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:42: So when she arrived, it was said, “Is your throne like this?” She said, “As if this is it.”(Solomon said,) “And We were given knowledge before her and we have always been Muslims.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:43: But she was barred by whatever she used to worship apart from Allah; indeed, she was of a denying people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:44: She was told, “Enter the tower.” And when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pond and she bared her legs. He said, “It is a tower paved with glass.” She said, “My Lord, I have indeed been unjust to myself, and I have submitted with Solomon to Allah, Lord of all realms.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:45: And indeed, We sent to Thamûd their brother Saleh(saying) , “Worship Allah.” But they promptly became two disputing groups.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:46: He said, “O my people, why do you ask that the bad be hastened before the good? If only you would ask Allah’s forgiveness so that you may be shown mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:47: They said, “We consider youa bad omen, and those with you(too) .” He said, “Your omen is with Allah. In fact, you are a people being tried.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:48: And there were nine persons in the city who were spreading corruption in the land and would not reform.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:49: They said, “Swear by Allah to one another that we will surely attack himand his family at night, and then wewill emphatically tellhis kinsman seeking retribution, ‘We did not witness the murder of his family, and we are indeed truthful.’”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:50: And they schemed a scheme, and We schemed a scheme while they were unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:51: So lookat how the outcome of their scheming was that We did destroy them and their people, all of them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:52: So here are their houses, vacant, on account of their injustice. Indeed, in this is surely a sign for people who know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:53: And We saved those who believed and were mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:54: And Lot(too) , when he said to his people, “Do you commit obscenity while you can see(its shamefulness) ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:55: Do you approach men with lust instead of women? Rather you are an ignorant people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:56: But the only response of his people was to say, “Evict Lot’s folk from your town; indeed, they are a few people who always keep themselves clean.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:57: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife, whom We destined to be of those who lingered behind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:58: And We rained upon them a rain, and so evil was the rain of the forewarned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:59: Say, “Praise be to Allah and peace be upon His servants whom He has elected. Is Allah better or what they associate?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:60: Or who(else then) is the one who created the heavens and the earth, and sent down to youfrom the sky water with which Wegerminated gardens full of beauty, whose trees you could not have germinated? Is there any other god with Allah? Rather, they are a people who equate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:61: Or who(else then) is the one who made the earth habitable and made rivers flow through it and set firm mountains for it and placed a partition between the two seas? Is there any other god with Allah? Rather, most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:62: Or who(else then) is the one who responds to someone in need when he calls upon Him and relieves evil and makes you successors on earth? Is there any other god with Allah? Little do you remind yourselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:63: Or who(else then) is the one who guides youthrough the darkness(es) of the land and the sea, and who sends the winds as heraldsof glad tidings before His mercy? Is there any other god with Allah? Most High is Allah above what they associate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:64: Or who(else then) is the one who originates creation and then restores it, and Who provides for youfrom the sky and the land? Is there any other god with Allah? Say, “Produce yourproof, if you are truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:65: Say, “No one in the heavens or the earth knows what is hidden except Allah.” For they are unaware of when they will be resurrected;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:66: rather, their knowledge has been reached in the Hereafter; rather, they are in doubt about it; rather, they are completely blind to it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:67: And those who denied said, “Can it be that when we have become dust, and our forefathers—can it be thatwe will really be brought out?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:68: Most surely, we were promised this before, we and our forefathers; this is nothing but the legends of the ancients.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:69: Say, “Journey through the earth and look what the outcome was for the criminals.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:70: But donot grieve over them and do not be troubled by what they scheme.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:71: And they say, “When is this promise, if you are truthful?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:72: Say, “Perhaps some of what you are asking to be hastened has drawn near.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:73: And indeed, yourLord is surely the Possessor of grace towards mankind, but most of them are not thankful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:74: And indeed, yourLord knows whatever their chests harbor and whatever they make public.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:75: And never is there anything hidden in the heaven or the earth but it is in an evident record.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:76: This Recitalindeed narrates to the Children of Israel most of what they differ over,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:77: and most surely it is a guidance and a mercy to the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:78: Indeed, yourLord decrees between them by His wise judgment, and He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:79: So place yourtrust in Allah; you are indeed upon the evident truth.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:80: Indeed, youcannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hearthe call if they withdraw and turn their backs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:81: Nor can youguide the blind out of their utter misguidance; you can make no one hear except those who believe in Our signs, and are(thus) Muslims.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:82: And when the decree is fulfilled against them, We will bring out for them—from the earth—a treading creature that will tell them that mankindused to have no certitude in Our signs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:83: On the day when We herd from every community a crowd of those who disbelieve our signs, so that they are held in strict order.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:84: Until, when they come(before their Lord) , He will say, “Did you deny My signs and did you not encompass them in knowledge, or what were you doing?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:85: And the decree shall be fulfilled against them for the injustices they did, and they shall be speechless.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:86: Have they not seen that We have made the night for them to rest therein and the day allowing sight? Indeed, in that are signs for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:87: And on the day when the Trumpet is blown, and everyone in the heavens and the earth washorrified, except whomever Allah willed, and everyone came before Him in humility.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:88: And yousee the mountains, thinking them fixed, yet they pass as the passing of the clouds—the making of Allah Who has perfected everything; He is indeed All-Aware of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:89: Whoever comes with a good deed—for him is one better than it and they are safe from horror onthat day,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:90: while whoever comes with an evil deed—their faces are tumbled into the Fire. “Are youbeing repaid except for what you used to do?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:91: (Say ) “Indeed, I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this township, Who has made it inviolable and to Whom everything belongs, and I have been commanded to be of the Muslims
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:92: and to read the Recital; so whoever is guided, then he is surely guided to his own benefit. And whoever goes astray, then say, “Indeed, I am only one of the forewarners.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.27:93: And say, “Praise be to Allah; He will show youHis signs and you will recognize them. For in no way is yourLord oblivious of what youdo .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:2: Those are the signsof the Evident Scripture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:3: We read to youfrom the tiding of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:4: Indeed, Pharaoh became exalted in the land and divided its people into sects, deeming a faction of them weak and oppressed: slaughtering their sons while keeping their women alive(in bondage) . Indeed, he was one of the corrupters.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:5: Thus We are willing to favor those who were deemed weak and oppressed in the land and to make them leaders and to make them the inheritors
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:6: and to establish them in the land and to show Pharaoh and Hamān and their troops from them the very thing they used to fear .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:7: And We revealed to Moses’ mother, “Nurse him, then when you fear for him, cast him into the waters and do not fear and do not grieve; We are surely returning him to you and making him one of the emissaries.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:8: Then Pharaoh’s folk picked him up(only) to be an enemy and a(source of) grief for them. Indeed, Pharaoh and Hamān and their troops were wrongdoers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:9: So Pharaoh’s wife said, “A comfort to the eye for me and for you. Donot kill him; hopefully he may be useful to us, or we may take him as a son.” And they were unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:10: And Moses’ mother felt a void in her burning heart so that she almost declared him, had We not steadied her heart, that she may remain of the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:11: Thus she said to his sister, “Trail him.” So she watched him from afar while they were unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:12: And We had forbidden all wet nurses for him, so she said, “Shall I tell youabout a household that can raise him for you and look after him?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:13: Thus We returned him to his mother, that her eye might be comforted and that she may not grieve, and so that she would know that Allah’s promise is true; yet most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:14: And when he had attained his full strength and had matured, We gave him wise judgment and knowledge, for thus do We repay thosewho excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:15: And(one day) he entered the city unnoticed by its people and found in it two men fighting—one of his own sect and one from his enemies, so the one of his sect solicited his assistance against the one from his enemies, so Moses struck him and put an end to him. He said, “This is of Satan’s work; he is indeed an evidently misguiding enemy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:16: He said, “My Lord, I have indeed been unjust to myself, so forgive me.” So He forgave him; indeed, He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:17: He said, “My Lord, because of the blessings You have bestowed upon me, I shall not be a backup for criminals.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:18: So the next morning he was walking about the city, fearful(and) vigilant, when suddenly the man who had sought his support the day before cried out to him. Moses said to him, “You are an evident deluder.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:19: And as he was about to strike the one who was their enemy, he said, “O Moses, do you want to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land and do not want to be of the reformers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:20: And a man came running from the farthest part of the city; he said, “O Moses, the chiefs are conspiring to kill you, so get out; I am indeed one of those who seek to advise you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:21: So he went out of it, fearful(and) vigilant; he said, “My Lord, deliver me from the unjust people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:22: And as he headed towards Midian, he said, “Hopefully, my Lord will guide me to the right way.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:23: And when he arrived at the waters of Midian he found there a crowd of people drawing water, and he found two women holding their flocks on the side. He said, “What is the matter with you?” They said, “We cannot draw water until the shepherds depart, and our father is a very old man.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:24: So he drew water for them and then turned away to the shade and said, “My Lord, I am in dire need of whatever good you have sent down for me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:25: Then one of them came to him, walking bashfully. She said, “My father is calling you to repay you, as a reward for drawing water for us.” So when he came to him and narrated to him the narratives, he said, “Do not fear; you are(now) safe from the unjust people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:26: One of them said, “Father, hire him; indeed, the best one you can hire is one who is strong (and)trustworthy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:27: He said, “I surely wish to marry you to one of these two daughters of mine, provided you work for me for the term of eight pilgrimages; but if you complete ten, that is up to you, for I do not desire to impose any hardship on you. You will find me, Allah willing, one of the righteous.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:28: He said, “Let this be(an agreement) between you and me; whichever of the two terms I fulfill, I will not have transgressed, and Allah is a trustee over what we say.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:29: So when Moses had completed the term and journeyed with his family, he noticed a fire by the side of Mount Tûr. He said to his family, “Stay here; I have surely glimpsed a fire. Perhaps I can bring yousome information from there, or an ember from the fire, that you may warm yourselves.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:30: So when he reached it, he was called from the right side of the valley at the blessed spot, from the tree: “O Moses, indeed I—I alone—am Allah, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:31: So throw down yourstaff.” And when he saw it shaking as if it were a snake, he turned away, fleeing, and did not look back. “O Moses, come forward and do not fear; you are indeed of the secure ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:32: Put yourhand inside your garment; it will come out white, without any bad affliction. And clasp to you your arm, that you should not be overawed, for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his chiefs; indeed, they have been a defiantly disobedient people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:33: He said, “My Lord, I have in fact killed one of them, and I fear lest they kill me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:34: And my brother Aaron—he is more eloquent than me, so send him with me as an assistant to confirm me; I do fear that they will disbelieve me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:35: He said, “We will strengthen yourshoulder with your brother and give youauthority so they will not be able to reach you. With Our signs, youand those who follow you will be the overcomers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:36: So when Moses came to them with Our signs, evident, they said, “This is nothing but fabricated sorcery, and We never heard of this among our ancient forefathers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:37: ThusMoses said, “My Lord knows better of the one who brings guidance from Him and who will have the future outcome of the Home; indeed, the unjust never succeed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:38: And Pharaoh said, “O chiefs, I have never known of any god for you other than me. So fire-up clay-bricks for me, O Haman, and build me a tower, that perhaps I may view the God of Moses, though I definitely think he is of the liars.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:39: Thus he and his troops went arrogantly about the land without any right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:40: So We took him and his troops and We threw them into the waters, so look what the outcome was for the unjust ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:41: And We made them leaders calling to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they are not supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:42: And We caused a curse to follow them in this Earlier(Life) , and on the Day of Resurrection they are of the despised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:43: And We certainly brought Moses the Scripture after We had annihilated the earliest generations, as insights for mankind, and guidance and mercy, that perhaps they would remind themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:44: And youwere not on the western side(of the Mount) when We decreed the command to Moses, nor were youof the witnesses.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:45: Yet We established many generations, then the ages became seemingly long. Nor were you among the people of Midian, reading Our signsto them; but We have been sending emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:46: Nor were you by the side of Mount Tûr when We called out. Rather, it was a mercy from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner had come before you, that perhaps they would remind themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:47: And(We have sent you as a messenger) lest a calamity befall them as a result of what their hands have put forth, and they say, “Our Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your signs and been among the believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:48: But when the truth came to them from Our Providence, they said, “If only he was given the like of what was given to Moses.” Did they not deny what was given to Moses in the past? They said, “Two works of sorcery , backing one another.” And they said, “We deny both.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:49: Say, “Then bring a scripture from Allah more conducive to guidance than both of them and I will follow it, if youare truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:50: But if they do not respond to you, know that they only follow their whims. And who is more misguided than one who follows his own whim without guidance from Allah? Indeed, Allah does not guide the unjust people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:51: And surely We have conveyed the Word to them, that they may remind themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:52: Those to whom We brought the Scripture before it believe in it,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:53: and when it is recited to them, they say, “We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord; indeed, we were Muslimsprior to it.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:54: Those are brought their reward twice on account of how they persevered patiently. And they counter evil with good and they spend from what We have provided them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:55: And when they hear idle talk they disregard it and say, “We have our deeds and youhave your deeds; peace be upon you; we do not seek(the company of) ignorant people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:56: Indeed, youcannot guide whom you love, but Allah guides whom He wills, and He knows better of those who are guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:57: And they said, “If we follow the guidance with you, we will be snatched from our land.” Did We not establish for them a safe sanctuary to which all kinds of products are brought as provision from Ourself? But most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:58: And how many a town did We annihilate for becoming unappreciative of its livelihood? So here are their residences, uninhabited after them but little, and We have always been the inheritors.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:59: And in no way would yourLord annihilate towns until He had sent to their mother-town a messenger reading to them Oursigns. And in no way would We annihilate towns except if their people are unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:60: And whatever youhave been brought is(merely) the enjoyment of the Earlier Life and its adornment, but what is with Allah is better and longer lasting. Do you not reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:61: Can someone to whom We have made a fine promise—which he is bound to encounter—be equal to someone whom We have allowed to enjoy the enjoyment of the Earlier Life, then on the Day of Resurrection will be one of the arraigned?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:62: On the day when He calls to them and says, “Where are My associates whom you used to claim?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:63: Those against whom the sentence was justified said, “Our Lord, these are the ones whom we deluded. We deluded them as we ourselves were deluded. We declare our innocence before You; it was not us that they used to worship.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:64: And it was said, “Call on yourassociates.” So they called them, but they did not respond to them, and they saw the punishment. If only they had sought guidance!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:65: And on the day when He callsto them and says, “What did you respond to the emissaries?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:66: Then all tidings were obscuredfor them on that day so they are unable to ask each other.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:67: But as for one who has repented and has attained faith and has acted righteously—hopefully, he will become of the successful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:68: And yourLord creates whatever He wills and He chooses. Never could the choice be theirs. Highly Exalted is Allah, and Most High is He above the associations they make.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:69: And yourLord knows whatever their chests harbor and whatever they make public.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:70: And He is Allah; there is no god but He. To Him belongs all praise in the First(life) and in the Hereafter, and to Him youare returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:71: Say, “Have youseen if Allah were to make the night perpetual over you until the Day of Resurrection, which god other than Allah would bring you illumination? Do you not hear?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:72: Say, “Have youseen if Allah were to make the day perpetual over you until the Day of Resurrection, which god other than Allah would bring you night to rest in? Do you not observe?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:73: But out of His mercy, He has made for younight and day so that you may rest in it and seek of His grace, and that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:74: And on the day when He calls to them and says, “Where are My associates whom you used to claim?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:75: And We drewout from every community a witness, then said, “Produce your proof,” so they realized that the truth belongs to Allah, and whatever they used to fabricate strayed away from them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:76: Indeed, Qarun was of the people of Moses, but he oppressed them. And We had given him treasures, the keys of which would weigh down a band of strong men. Recall when his people said to him, “Do not exult; surely, Allah does not love the exultant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:77: And seek in whatever Allah has brought youthe Home of the Hereafter, and do not forget your share of the Earlier(Life) , and do good as Allah has done good to you, and do not seek corruption in the land; indeed, Allah does not like the corrupters.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:78: He said, “Indeed, it was only brought to me on account of knowledge I possess.” Did he not know that before him Allah had annihilated many generations who were stronger than he and hadcollected greater riches? And the criminals will not be asked about their misdeeds.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:79: And he came out before his people in his splendor; those who wanted the Earlier Life said, “If only we possessed the likes of what Qarun was given. He is indeed very fortunate.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:80: But those who were given knowledge said, “Woe to you! The recompense of Allah is better for those who have attained faith and have acted righteously.” Yet none is granted it except the patient ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:81: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home, then he had no battalion to support him apart from Allah, and he was not of those who could help themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:82: And by morning the ones who only yesterday had wished they were in his position were saying, “Indeed, it is Allah who extends His provision for whomever He wills of His servants, and He restrains(it) . Had Allah not been gracious to us, He would have caused it to swallow us . No wonder the deniers never succeed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:83: That is the Home of the Hereafter—We assign it for those who want no exaltation in the land nor corruption. And the future outcome is for those who are mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:84: Whoever has come with a good deed—for him there is better than it, but whoever has come with an evil deed—those who have done evil deeds will only be rewarded for what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:85: Indeed, He Who ordained the Recitalupon youwill surely return you to a great place of return. Say, “My Lord knows better who brings guidance and who is the one in evident misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:86: And you did not(even) expect the Scripture would be cast to you, yet(it was revealed to you) as a mercy from your Lord, so never be a backup for the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:87: And do not let them bar youfrom Allah’s signsafter they have been sent down to you. And call to your Lord, and never be of those who associate(others with God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.28:88: And do not callupon any other god with Allah; there is no god but He. All things perish except His Countenance. Judgment belongs(only) to Him, and to Him youare returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:2: Do people think that they will be left to say, “We believe” without being tested?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:3: Yet certainly We have tested those before them; thus Allah will surely know the truthful and He will surely know the liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:4: Or do those who do evil deeds think that they can outstrip Us? Terrible is their judgment!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:5: Whoever expects the meeting with Allah—the appointed time of Allah is sure to come, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:6: Thus whoever strives—he only strives to his own benefit; most surely, Allah is Self-Sufficient(without need for any of the creatures) of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:7: And as for those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—We will certainly remit their evil deeds and We will certainly repay them according to the best of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:8: And We have enjoined upon man kindness towards his parents. But if they urge youto associate with Me something youhave no knowledge of, do not obey them. To Me is yourreturn, and I will inform you of what you used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:9: Those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—We will surely enter them among the righteous.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:10: And among mankind is one who says, “We have attained faith in Allah.” Yet when he is hurt on Allah’s account, he equates the people’s persecution with Allah’s punishment. And if help comes from yourLord, he will definitely say, “We were actually with you.” Does not Allah know better whatever is within the chests of(all creatures of) all realms?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:11: And Allah will surely know those who have attained faith, and He will surely know the hypocrites.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:12: And those who denied said to those who had attained faith, “Follow our way and we will carry your offenses.” But never will they(willingly) carry any of their offenses; they are indeed liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:13: Yet, they will surely carry their own heavy burdens and other heavy burdens with their own heavy burdens, and they will surely be asked on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to fabricate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:14: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and He stayed among them for a thousand years, less fifty seasons. Then the Flood took them, for they were unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:15: But We saved him together with the fellows of the Ark, and We made it a sign for(all people of) all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:16: And Abraham—recall when he said to his people, “Worship Allah and be mindful of Him; that is better for you if you only knew.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:17: Indeed, whatever youworship apart from Allah are nothing but idols, and you create fabrications. Those you worship apart from Allah possess no provision for you, so seek your provision with Allah and worship Him and thank Him; to Him you are returned .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:18: And if youdisbelieve, other communities before you have also disbelieved. And there is no responsibility upon the messenger except evident proclamation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:19: Have they not seenhow Allah starts creation and then restores it? This is indeed easy for Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:20: Say, “Journey throughout the earth and look how He started creation.” Then Allah will bring about the next existence; Allah is indeed All-Powerful over everything.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:21: He punishes whomever He wills and He grants mercy to whomever He wills, and to Him youare turned back.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:22: And youcan neither thwart(God) on earth nor in heaven, and apart from Allah you have neither ally nor supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:23: And those who denied Allah’s signs and the meeting with Him—those have despaired of Mymercy, and for those is a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:24: But there was no response from his people except that they said, “Kill him or burn him.” But Allah saved him from the fire; indeed, in that are signs for people who believe.
