Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:25: And he said, “Youhave chosen idols apart from Allah, as a bond of love for one another in the Earlier Life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your shelter is the Fire, and you will have no helpers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:26: Then Lot believed in him and said, “I am emigrating to my Lord; He is indeed the Almighty, the All-Wise.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:27: And We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and conferred upon his offspring the prophethood and the scripture, and brought him his reward in the Earlier(Life) . And indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:28: And Lot—recall when he said to his people, “Indeed, you do approach obscenity such as nobody in all communities has ever committed before you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:29: Can it be that you do approach men and cut off the wayand commit what is deplorable in your gatherings?” But there was no response from his people except that they said, “Bring upon us Allah’s punishment if youare of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:30: He said, “My Lord, help me against the corruptive people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:31: And when Our messengers came to Abraham with the glad tidings, they said, “We are going to destroy the people of this town; indeed, its people have been unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:32: He said, “Yet Lot is in it.” They said, “We know better of who is in it; we will most surelydeliver himand his family, except for his wife; she has become one of those who linger behind.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:33: Then, when Our messengers came to Lot, he was troubled and distressed on their account. But they said, “Do not fear nor grieve; we will deliver youand your family, except for your wife; she has become one of those who linger behind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:34: Indeed, We will send downupon the people of this town a torment from heaven on account of having been defiantly disobedient.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:35: And We left behind something of it as an evident sign for people who reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:36: And to Midian(We sent) their brother Shuʻaib. So he said, “O my people, worship Allah and expect the Last Day, and do not go wickedly about the land, corrupting it.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:37: But they disbelieved him, so the Tremor overtook them and they became lifeless bodies in their home.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:38: And ʻĀdand Thamûdas well, as it has become evident for youfrom their(ruined) residences. And Satan adorned their deeds for them, barring them from the way, even though they could see.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:39: And Qarun and Pharaoh and Hamān—Moses certainly went to them with clear proofs, but they went about arrogantly in the land, and in no way were they forerunners.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:40: Each We seized by his misdeed: so of them are those upon whom We sent a sandstorm, and of them are those who were taken away by the Shout, and of them are those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and of them are those whom We drowned. For never would Allah do them any injustice, but to themselves they used to do injustice.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:41: The likeness of those who take for themselves guardians apart from Allah is as the likeness of the spider that takes for itself a house, and surely the feeblest of houses is indeed the house of the spider, if they only knew.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:42: Indeed, Allah knows whatever thing they call uponapart from Him, and He is the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:43: And such parables We set forth for mankind, but none grasps them except the learned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:44: Allah created the heavens and the earth with truth; indeed, in that is a sign for the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:45: Recite what is revealed to youof the Scripture and establish the prayer; indeed the prayer forbids obscenity and what is deplorable. And surely the remembrance of Allah is greater. And Allah knows what youdo.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:46: And do not argue with the People of the Scripture except in the best manner, unless it be those of them who have done injustice, and say, “We believe in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to you, and our God and your God is One, and to Him we are Muslims.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:47: Likewise, We sent down to youthe Scripture. So those to whom We gave the Scripture believe in it, and some of these ones believe in it, but none repudiate Our signs except the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:48: And younever used to read any Scripture before it, and you never used to write it down with your right hand; otherwise the advocates of falsehood would have doubted.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:49: In fact, it is evident signs in the chests of those given knowledge, and none repudiate Our signs except the unjust ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:50: And they said, “Why are no signs sent down to him from his Lord?” Say, “Surely the signs are only in the Providence of Allah, and surely I am only an evident warner.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:51: Does it not suffice them that We revealed to youthe Scripture which is recited to them? Indeed, in that is mercy and a reminding for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:52: Say, “Allah suffices as witness between you and me; He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who believed in falsehood and denied Allah—it is those who are the losers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:53: And they urge youto hasten the punishment. And were it not for a stated term, the punishment would have come to them. But it will come upon them suddenly while they are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:54: They urge you to hasten the punishment, and indeed, Hell is surely encompassing of the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:55: On the day when the punishment envelops them from above them and from beneath their feet, and He says , “Taste what you used to do!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:56: O My servants who have attained faith: My earth is vast, so worship Me alone.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:57: Every single self is sure to taste death, then to Us youare returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:58: And those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—We will settle them in the Garden(of Paradise) in Chambers under which rivers flow, abiding therein; how good is the reward of the workers
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:59: who endured patiently and in their Lord they place their trust!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:60: How many a treading creature is there that does not carry its provision? Allah provides for it and for you, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:61: And surely, if you were to ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon?” They would say, “Allah.” So how can they be averted(from the truth) ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:62: Allah expands provision for whomever He wills of His servants and He restrains for him; indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:63: And surely, if youwere to ask them, “Who sent down from the sky water with which He revived the earth after it had died?” They would say, “Allah.” Say, “Praise be to Allah.” Rather, most of them do not reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:64: This Earlier Life is nothing but a distraction and a game, and indeed the Home of the Hereafter is truly the perennial life, if they only knew.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:65: So when they embark on ships they call upon Allah, devoting religion to Him. But once He has delivered them safely to land, they promptly associate others(with Him) ,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:66: so that they deny whatever We have brought them and so that they enjoy , for they will eventually know!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:67: Have they not seen that We have established a safe sanctuary, while all around them people are being snatched away? Do they believe in falsehood and deny the blessings of Allah?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:68: And who is more unjust than one who has fabricated lies and attributed them to Allah or disbelieved the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a dwelling for the deniers?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.29:69: And those who strove for Us—We will surely guide them in Our ways, for Allahis most surely with those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:3: in the nearestland. But after having been overcome, they will overcome(their enemy)
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:4: in a fewyears. The command belongs to Allah, in the past and in the future. And on that day, the believers will exult
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:5: in Allah’s support. He supports whomever He wills, and He is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:6: The promise of Allah—Allah never breaks His promise, but most of mankind knows not.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:7: They know an outer aspect of the Earlier Life, but they are oblivious of the Hereafter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:8: Have they not reflected within themselves? Allah did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them except with the truth and for a stated term. But many among mankind do deny the meeting with their Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:9: Have they not journeyed through the earth and looked at what the outcome was for those before them? They were more powerful than them, and they cultivated the land and developed it more than they developed it, and their messengers came to them with evident proofs. For never would Allah do them any injustice, but to themselves they used to do injustice.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:10: Then absolute evil was the consequence for those who committed evil ; that is because they rejected Allah’s signs and used to ridicule them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:11: Allah originates creation and then restores it, then to Him youare returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:12: And on the day when the Hour takes place, the criminals despair.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:13: And they hadno intercessors from among their associate-gods, and they became deniers of their associate-gods.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:14: And on the day when the Hour takes place—on that day they separate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:15: So, as for those who had attained faith and had done righteous deeds—they are in a meadow, delighted.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:16: But as for those who had denied and had rejected Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter—those are arraigned in the punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:17: So Highly Exalted is Allah when youreach nightfall and when you reach morning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:18: And to him is all praise in the heavens and the earth, and in the evening, and when youreach midday.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:19: He brings out the living from the dead and He brings out the dead from the living, and He revives the land after it has died, and likewise youare brought out .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:20: And of His signs is that He created youfrom dust, and there you are, human beings spreading about.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:21: And of His signs is that He created for you spouses from among yourselves so that you may find rest with them, and He has set between you love and mercy; indeed, in that are signs for people who reflect.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:22: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the diversity of yourtonguesand colors; indeed, in that are signs for those who know .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:23: And of His signs is yoursleep by night and day, and your pursuit of His grace; indeed, in that are signs for people who listen.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:24: And of His signs is that He shows youlightning, causing fear and ardent hope. And He bestows water from the sky, and with it He revives the earth after its death; indeed, in that are signs for people who reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:25: And of His signs is that the heaven and the earth remain(firm) by His command, then when He calls youout of the earth, you promptly come out.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:26: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth; all surrender to Him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:27: It is He who originates creation and then restores it, and that is even easier for Him. And His is the Most Exalted example in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:28: He has set forth for youa parable from yourselves: do you make those whom you rightfully possess full partners in the wealth We have given you, so that you are equal in regard to it, fearing them as you have fear of each other? We thus detail the signs for people who reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:29: Yet those who did injustice followed their whims without knowledge. But who can guide those whom Allah has misguided? And they will have no helpers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:30: So set yourface upright towards the religion, turning away from all that is false;(this religion is) the original disposition from Allah upon which He originated mankind. There cannot be any change in Allah’s creation; this is the upright religion, but most of mankind does not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:31: (Keep) turningto Him in penitence, and be mindful of Him and establish the prayer, and do not be of those who associate others(with Him) —
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:32: of the ones who have caused disunity in their religion and become sects, each party exulting in whatever they have.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:33: And when harm touches people they call upon their Lord, turning to Him in penitence. Thereafter, when He makes them taste mercy from Him, a group of them associate others with their Lord
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:34: so as to deny what We have brought them. So take yourenjoyment, then you will come to know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:35: Or have We sent down to them any authority which speaks in support of what they have been associating with Him?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:36: And when We make people taste a mercy, they rejoice in it; but when adversity befalls them because of what their hands have put forth, they promptly become despondent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:37: Have they not seen that Allah extends provision for whomever He wills and He restrains(it) ? Surely in that are signs for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:38: So bringto the relative his rights, and the destituteand the traveler in need; that is best for those who seek Allah’s Countenance, and those are the successful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:39: And whatever youhave brought in usury so that it increases through people’s money is not(considered) an increase with Allah, but whatever you have broughtas purifying charity, seeking Allah’s Countenance—thoseare the multipliers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:40: Allah is the One Who created you, then provided for you, then makes you die, then brings you back to life. Can any of your associate-gods do any of that? Highly Exalted is He, and Most High above what theyassociate (with Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:41: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea because of what people’s hands have earned, so that He may make them tastesome of what they have done, that they may return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:42: Say, “Journeythrough the earth and look what the outcome was for those who came before; most of them were polytheists”.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:43: So set yourface upright towards the upright religion before there comes from Allah a day that cannot be turned back; on that day they will be divided:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:44: whoever has denied—upon him falls his denial, and whoever has acted righteously—theysmooth a way for themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:45: So that He may repay those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds out of His grace. Indeed, He does not love the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:46: And of His signs is that He sends the winds bearing glad tidings, and that He may let youtaste of His mercy, and so that ships may sail by His command, and so that you may seek of His grace, and so that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:47: And indeed, before youWe sent messengers to their people, and they came to them with evident proofs. So We took retribution from those who had committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:48: Allah is the One Who sends the winds so they stirup clouds, then He spreads them in the sky as He wills and makes them into pieces , then you see rain drops coming out from their midst; then when He makes it fall upon whom He wills of His servants, there they are, anticipating glad tidings
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:49: although before it was bestowed upon them from on highthey were indeed in despair.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:50: So lookat the effects of Allah’s mercy—how He revives the earth after its death; indeed, He is the Reviver of the dead, and He is All-Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:51: But if We sent a wind and they saw it turning things yellow, they would continue thereafter to deny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:52: So surely youcannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn away, fleeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:53: Nor will youguide the blind out of their misguidance; you can make hear only those who believe in Our signs and are thus Muslims.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:54: Allah is the One Who created youout of weakness, then after weakness gave(you) strength, then after strength gave(you) weakness and gray hair. He creates whatever He wills, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:55: And on the day when the Hour takes place, the criminals swear they had not stayed but for an hour; thus they used to be averted(from the truth) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:56: But(on Judgment Day) those endowed with knowledge and faith said, “Surely, youhave remained(in existence from the time of your creation) until the Day of Resurrection(in accordance with the decree) in Allah’s Scripture; so this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not know.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:57: On that day the excuses of those who were unjust do not benefit them, nor are they allowed to make amends.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:58: And We have certainly set forth in this Recitalfor mankind every sort of parable. But even if youbring them a(miraculous) sign, those who have denied will surely say, “You are nothing but fakers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:59: Allah thus seals the hearts of those who do not know,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.30:60: so bepatient. The promise of Allah is true, so do not let those who lack certitude belittle you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:2: These are the signs of the Wise Scripture,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:3: a guidance and a mercy for those who excel in doing good:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:4: those who establish the prayer and bringthe purifying charityand of the Hereafter they are certain.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:5: Those are rightly guided by their Lord, and those are the successful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:6: And among mankind is one who trades in distracting tales to make(people) stray from the way of Allah without knowledge, and to take it for a mockery; for those is a demeaning punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:7: And when Our signsare recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as though he did not hear them, as though there is deafness in his ears. So givehim glad tidingsof a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:8: Indeed, those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—for them are the Gardens of Bliss,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:9: abiding therein, a true promise of Allah. And He is the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:10: He created the heavens without any pillars that youcan see, and cast firm mountains into the earth lest it sway with you, and scattered throughout it all kinds of treading creatures. And from the sky We sent down water, and We germinated therein many noble kinds of plants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:11: Such is Allah’s creation, so showme what those apart from Him have created; rather, the unjust are in evident misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:12: And truly, We endowed Luqman with wisdom: “Givethanks to Allah.” For whoever is thankful is only thankful to his own benefit, and whoever has denied, then Allah is indeed Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:13: And recall when Luqman said to his son, as he was admonishing him, “O my child, do not associate(anything) with Allah; indeed, associating(others with Allah) is surely a great injustice.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:14: And We have enjoined upon man the care of his parents. His mother carried him with hardship upon hardship, besides weaning him in two years. So givethanks to Me and to your parents; to Me is the destiny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:15: But if theystrive to have youassociate with Me whatever you have no knowledge of, do not obey them. Yet accompany them in the Earlier(Life) kindly, and follow the way of the one who has turned to Me in penitence. Then to Me is yourreturn, and I will inform you of what you used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:16: “O my child, if it be the weight of a mustard-seed, and be itin a rock or in the heavens or in the earth, Allah brings it forth; indeed, Allah is Subtle, All-Aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:17: O my child, establish the prayer and command to what is fair and forbid what is deplorable, and be patient over what has befallen you; indeed, that is of the matters requiring determination.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:18: And do not turn your cheek away from people(in pride) , nor walk about the earth merrily; indeed, Allah does not love every self-admiring boaster.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:19: And moderate your stride and lower your voice; indeed, the most deplorable of all voices is surely the donkey’s voice.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:20: Have younot seen that Allah has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and showered you with His blessings , both manifest and hidden? Yet among mankind is one who argues about Allah without any knowledge nor any guidance norany illuminating Scripture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:21: And when it is said to them, “Follow what Allah has sent down,” they say, “Rather, we follow what we found our forefathers doing.” Even if Satan has been calling them to the punishment of the Blaze?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:22: And whoever surrenders his face to Allah while excelling in doing good, then he has truly grasped the firmest handhold. And with Allah rests the outcome of all events.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:23: And whoever denies—let not his denial sadden you; to Us is theirreturn, then We will inform them of what they did; indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of what lies within the chests.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:24: We give them a little enjoyment, then We compel them to a harsh punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:25: And if youask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They will surely say, “Allah.” Say, “Praise be to Allah.” Rather, most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:26: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Indeed, Allah is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:27: And were all the trees on earth pens, with the sea replenishedby seven seas following it, never would the Words of Allah run out. Indeed, Allah is Almighty, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:28: Neither yourcreation nor your resurrection are but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:29: Have younot seen that Allah causes the night to penetrate the day, and causes the day to penetrate the night? And that He subjected the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term? And that Allah is All-Aware of whatever youdo?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:30: That is because Allah is the Truth, and because what they call uponapart from Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the All-High, the Supreme.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:31: Have younot seen that the ships sail through the sea by the blessing of Allah, to show you of His signs? Indeed, in that are signs for everyone who is most patient, constantly thankful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:32: And when waves like canopies cover them, they call upon Allah, devoting religion to Him. But when He has delivered them ashore, some of them waver. But no one repudiates Our signs except every perfidious staunch denier.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:33: O mankind, be mindful of your Lord, and fear a day when no parent can repay anything on behalf of his child, nor can a child repay anything on behalf of his parent. The promise of Allah is indeed true, so let not the Earlier Life deceive you, and let not the Deceiver deceive you regarding Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.31:34: Indeed, with Allah rests the knowledge of the Hour. And He bestows the rain from on highand He knows what the wombs contain. But in no way does any soul know what it will earn tomorrow, and in no way does any soul know in what land it will die; indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:2: The bestowal of the Scripture from on high is—no doubt about it—by the Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:3: Yet they say, “He has fabricated it.” Rather, it is the truth from yourLord, so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you, that they may be guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:4: Allah is the One Who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days, and then settled over the Throne; apart from Him, youhave neither ally nor intercessor. Will you not remind yourselves?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:5: He governs every matter from the heavens to the earth, then it ascends to Him on a day the length of which is a thousand years by yourcount.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:6: That is the Knower of the hidden realm and the manifest, the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:7: Who has made excellent everything He created , and He originated the creation of man from clay,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:8: then made his progeny from an extract of a despicable fluid,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:9: then He proportioned him and breathed into him of His Spirit, and He gave youhearing and sight(s) and burning hearts; little do you give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:10: And they said, “Can it be thatwhen we have becomelost into the earth—can it be thatwe willreallybe brought to a new creation?” Rather, they do deny the meeting with their Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:11: Say, “The angel of death put in charge of youtakes you, then to your Lord you are returned .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:12: And if only youcould see the criminals bowing their heads before their Lord: “Our Lord, we have seen and we have heard, so send us back, that we may act righteously; we are(now) certain.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:13: And had We willed, We could have brought every soul its guidance, but the declaration from Me will come true: “I will most surely fill Hell with(the race of) unseen beingsand human beings, both together.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:14: So taste, on account of how youforgot the meeting of this day of yours; indeed, We have forgotten you, so taste the eternal punishment on account of what you used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:15: The only people who(truly) believe in Our signs are those who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrating and highly exalt their Lord with praise, and they are not arrogant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:16: Their sides shun the beds as they pray to their Lord out of fear and ardent hope, and from Our provisions to them they spend.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:17: No soul knows what has been hidden for themof comfort to the eyes—a repayment on account of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:18: So, is the one who has been a believer like the one who has been defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:19: As for those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds, for them are the Gardens of Shelter—hospitality on account of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:20: But as for those who have defiantly disobeyed, their shelter is the Fire; every time they want to depart it, they are brought back into it, and it is said to them, “Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:21: And We will certainly make them taste the lesser punishment(in this life) prior to the greater punishment, that they may return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:22: And who is more unjust than one who was reminded of his Lord’s signs, then disregarded them? We will certainly wreak vengeance upon the criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:23: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so donot regard his meeting with scepticism. And We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:24: And of them We appointed leaders guiding by Our command, when they persevered patiently and were certain of Our signs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:25: Indeed, yourLord is the One Who judges between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding whatever they used to differ over.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:26: Is it not a guidance for them: how many generations We caused to perish before them, amidst whose residences they(now) walk? Surely in that are signs. Do they not hear?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:27: Have they not seen that We conduct the water to a dry land, and with it We bring out vegetation from which their livestock eat, and they themselves? Do they not see?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:28: And they say, “When is this conquest, if youare truthful?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:29: Say, “On the Day of Conquest the belief of the ones who had denied will not benefit them, and they will not be given respite.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.32:30: So disregardthem and wait. Indeed, they(too) are waiting.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:1: O Prophet, be mindful of Allah and do not obey the deniers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah has always been All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:2: And follow what is revealed to youfrom your Lord; indeed, Allah has always been All-Aware of what youdo .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:3: And place yourtrust in Allah, for Allah is sufficient as a Trustee.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:4: Never did Allah make two hearts inside any man’s body, nor did He ever make yourspouses whom you reject and compare to your mothers’ backs into your actual mothers. Nor did He make your adopted sons your actual sons. That is your saying coming out of your mouths, and Allah speaks the truth and He guides to the way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:5: Call them after their fathers; that is more equitable with Allah. But if youdo not know their fathers, then your brethren in faith and your protégés. And you commit no sin if you err therein, except for what your hearts premeditate. And Allah has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:6: The Prophet is worthier as a guardian of the believers than they are of themselves, and his spouses are(as) mothers to them. And blood relatives are worthier than the(other) believers or the immigrantsas heirs of one another according to Allah’s Scripture—except that youmay do an upright act to your allies; that has been inscribed in the Scripture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:7: And recall that We took from the prophets their pledge, and from youand from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, son of Mary, and We took from them a solid pledge,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:8: that Hemay ask the truthfulabout their truthfulness. Yet He has prepared for the deniers a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:9: O you who have attained faith, remember Allah’s blessings upon you when troops advanced towards you, and Wesent against them a wind and troops that you did not see. And Allah has always been All-Seeing of what you do .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:10: When they came upon youfrom above you and from beneath you, and when sight(s) swerved and hearts reached the larynges, and you assumeabout Allah various assumptions.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:11: There and then the believers were tested and were made to quake with a severe earthquake,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:12: as the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is sickness say, “Allah and His Messenger promised us nothing but a deception.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:13: Recall, too, when a faction of them said, “O people of Yathrib, there is no staying for you here, so retreat.” And a group of them askthe Prophet to excuse them, saying, “Indeed, our houses are exposed,” although they are not exposed, but they want nothing but to flee.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:14: And had itbeen invaded from all its sides, then they were asked tribulation, they would have brought it and tarried not but a little.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:15: And certainly, they had previously covenanted with Allah that they would not turn their backs. And Allah’s covenant must be answered for.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:16: Say, “Flight will not benefit youif you flee from death or killing; even then you will be given no enjoyment but a little.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:17: Say, “Who is it who can safeguard youfrom Allah if He desires adversity for you or desires mercy for you?” Apart from Allah, they can find for themselves neither guardian nor supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:18: Allah already knows the hinderers among you and those who say to their brethren, “Come along to us,” whereas they do not mobilize for battle but a little,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:19: begrudging support to you. And when fear approaches, yousee them looking at you, their eyes rolling—like someone fainting at death; then, when panic is over, they scald youwith sharp tongues, begrudging you any good. Those have not believed, so Allah has nullified their deeds, and this matter has always been easy for Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:20: They assume that the parties have not gone away. But were the parties to come(again) , they would wish they were in the desert with the nomadic Arabs, asking about yournews. And if they were among you, they would not combat but a little.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:21: Most surely, there has always been an excellent role model for youin the Messenger of Allah(and) for anyone who has been putting hope in Allah and expecting the Last Day, and has remembered Allah frequently.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:22: And when the believers saw the parties, they said, “This is what Allah and His messenger have promised us, and Allah and His messenger have told the truth.” And it only increased them in faith and submission.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:23: Of the believers are men who have been true to what they have covenanted with Allah: so of them is one who fulfilled his obligation, and of them is one who still waits, and they have not changed in the least.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:24: That Allah may repay the truthful for their truthfulness and punish the hypocrites, if He wills, or grant them repentance and accept it from them. Indeed, Allah has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:25: And Allah repelled those who denied in their rage—they gained no advantage. And Allah thus spared the believers combat, and Allah has always been All-Powerful, Almighty.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:26: And He brought down those of the People of the Scripture who backed them from their strongholds, and threw terror into their hearts,(while) youkillone group, and another group you capture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:27: And He made youinherit their land and their homes and their possessions and a land you had never trodden. And Allah has always been Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:28: O Prophet, say to your spouses, “If you want the Earlier Life and its adornment, then come, let me compensate you and release you kindly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:29: But if you want Allah and His Messenger and the Home of the Hereafter, then indeed, Allah has prepared a great reward for those of you who excel in doing good.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:30: O wives of the Prophet, if any one of you were ever to commit an evident obscenity , the punishment for her would be doubled twofold. And that has always been easy for Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:31: But whoever of you is devout towards Allah and His Messenger and acts righteously—We will bring her her reward twice over, and We have prepared for her a noble provision.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:32: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like any of the other women. If you are truly mindful(of God) , then do not speak too softly, lest the sick at heart lust after you, but speak forthright words.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:33: And settle in your houses and do not display yourselves as in the former days of pagan ignorance, and establish the prayer and bringthe purifying charityand obey Allah and His Messenger; indeed, Allah only wants to keep abomination away from you, O people of the(Prophet’s) household, and to cleanse you thoroughly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:34: And remember what is recited in yourhouses of Allah’s signs, and wisdom; indeed, Allah has always been Subtle, All-Aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:35: Indeed, Muslim men and Muslim women, and believing men and believing women, and devout men and devout women, and truthful men and truthful women, and patient men and patient women, and reverent men and reverent women, and charitable men and charitable women, and fasting men and fasting women, and men who preserve their private partsand women who(likewise) preserve, and men who remember Allah frequently and women who(likewise) remember—Allah has prepared for them forgiveness and a great reward.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:36: It is not for any believing man or believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decreed a command, to have a choice in their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, then he has strayed into evident misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:37: And recall as you say to the one upon whom Allah had bestowed His grace, and upon whom youhad(also) bestowed your grace, “Hold on to your spouse and be mindful of Allah,” while hiding within yourself what Allah was to reveal, and fearing mankind, whereas Allah is more worthy of your fear. Then when Zaid ended his relationship with her, We married her to you, that there may be no blame on the believers regarding the spouses of their adopted sons when their relationship has ended, for the command of Allah has always been fulfilled.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:38: Never has there been any blame on the Prophet regarding what Allah has ordained for him; such is Allah’s rule among those(prophets) who passed on before, and the command of Allah has always been a determined determination.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:39: Those who proclaim the messages of Allah and fear Him and fear no one except Allah. And Allah is sufficient as a Reckoner.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:40: Never has Muhammad been the father of any of yourmen, but a Messenger of Allah and the seal of the prophets. And Allah has always been All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:41: O you who have attained faith, remember Allah with frequent remembrance,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:42: and highly exalt Him morning and evening.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:43: It is He Who blesses you, as do His angels, to get you out of darkness(es) into light, and He has always been Merciful to the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:44: Their greeting on the day they meet Him is, “Peace.” And He has prepared for them a noble reward.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:45: O Prophet, We have sent you as a witness and a bearer of glad tidings and a warner,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:46: and a caller to Allah by His leave and an illuminating beacon.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:47: And givethe believers glad tidings that for them is a supreme grace from Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:48: And donot obey the deniers and the hypocrites, and ignore their hurtfulness, and place your trust in Allah, for Allah is sufficient as a Trustee.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:49: O you who have attained faith, if you marry believing women but then divorce them before havingtouched them , you have no right to expect a waiting period on their part. But compensate them and release them in a graceful manner.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:50: O Prophet, We have permitted to you your spouses to whom you have given their dowries, and those whom you rightfully possess from what Allah has granted you, and the daughters of your paternal uncle, and the daughters of your paternal aunts, and the daughters of your maternal uncle, and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you, and a believing woman—if she grants herself to the Prophet, if the Prophet wishes to marry her;(this is) exclusively for you, and not for the believers. We already know what We have ordained for them regarding their spouses and those whom they rightfully possess; this is to spare you any discomfort. And Allah has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:51: You may defer any of them you wish and receive any of them you wish, and should you desire any of those you had set aside, then no sin is committed by you. This is more proper, so that they are comforted and are not grieved, and are content with what you have brought them—all of them. And Allah knows what is within your hearts, for Allah has always been All-Knowing, Forbearing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:52: Youare not allowed(to marry) any further women, nor to exchange the spouses you have for others, even if you are impressed by their beauty, except for those whom you rightfully possess. And Allah has always been Watchful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:53: O you who have attained faith, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless you are given permission to come for a meal. And do not wait for its preparation, but when you are invited, then go in. And when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for a talk. This used to hurt the Prophet, but he shied away from telling you, but Allah does not shy away from the truth. And when youask themfor something, ask them from behind a screen; that is cleaner for your hearts and their hearts. For it is not for you to hurt the Messenger of Allah, nor must you ever marry his spouses after him; that would indeed be(a) great(offense) with Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:54: Whether youdisclose anything or hide it, indeed, Allah has always been All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:55: No sin is committed by themregarding their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers’ sons or their sisters’ sons or their women or those whom they rightfully possess. Yet be mindfulof Allah; indeed, Allah has always been a Witness over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:56: Indeed, Allah and His angels give blessingsto the Prophet. O you who have attained faith, pray for blessings upon him and greet him with a prayer of peace.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:57: Indeed, those who hurt Allah and His Messenger— Allah has cursed them in the Earlier(Life) and the Hereafter, and has prepared for them a demeaning punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:58: And those who hurt believing men and believing women for acts they did not earn have surely burdened themselves with perjury and evident sin.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:59: O Prophet, tell your spouses and your daughters and the women of the believers to make their outer garments hang low over them; that is more likely that they will be recognized and not hurt. And Allah has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:60: If the hypocrites do not desist, as well as those with sickness in their hearts and the rumormongers in the City(of Madinah) , We will surely incite youagainst them; then they will not neighbor you in it except for a short while.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:61: Accursed; wherever they are found, they should be captured and relentlessly killed outright.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:62: Such has been Allah’s rule with those who passed on before, and youwill never find any change in Allah’s rule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:63: People ask you about the Hour. Say, “Indeed, knowledge thereof rests only with Allah. But what could make yourealize? Perhaps the Hour could be near.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:64: Indeed, Allah has cursed the deniers and has prepared for them a blaze,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:65: abiding therein forever, finding neither ally nor supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:66: On the day when their faces are flipped in the Fire, they say, “If only we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:67: And they said, “Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries, but they led us away from the way.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:68: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a supreme curse.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:69: O you who have attained faith, do not be like those who hurt Moses, though Allah cleared him of what they had said. And he has been well-esteemed with Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:70: O you who have attained faith, be mindful of Allah and speak for justice;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:71: He will set aright your deeds for you and will forgive you your misdeeds. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger—thenhe has surely triumphed a great triumph.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:72: Indeed, We offered the trustto the skies and the land and the mountains, but they refused to carry it and were apprehensive of it, but man carried it; he has always been constantly unjust, constantly ignorant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.33:73: That Allah may punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the polytheists, men and women. And(that) Allah may grant repentance to the believers and accept it from them, men and women, for Allah has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:1: All praise be to Allah to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and all praise be to Him in the Hereafter, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:2: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky and what ascends to it, and He is the Bestower of mercy, the Oft-Forgiving.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:3: Yet those who have denied have said, “The Hour is not coming upon us.” Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, the Knower of the hidden realm, it will come upon you.” Not an atom’s weight in the heavens or in the earth escapes His knowledge, nor anything smaller or larger, except that it is in an evident record—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:4: that He may repay those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds; for those is forgiveness and noble provision.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:5: Those who strove against Our signs, attempting to challenge (God) — those ones, for them is a painful punishment of torment .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:6: And those who have received knowledge see that what was sent down to youfrom your Lord is the truth and guides to the path of the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:7: And those who have denied said, “Shall we point out to youa man who tells you that, once you are torn into shreds, you will surely be in a new creation?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:8: Did he invent a lie about Allah or is there madnessin him? Rather, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are in punishment and extreme misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:9: Have they not seen what lies before them and behind them of the heaven and the earth? If We will , We canmake the earth cave in beneath them, or let fall down on them pieces from the sky; indeed, in that is a sign for every penitent servant.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:10: And surely, We bestowed upon David grace from Us: “O mountains, echo with him(My praises) , and you birds(too) .” And We softened iron for him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:11: “Makecoats of armor and measure the links well, and dorighteousness; indeed I am All-Seeing of what youdo.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:12: And for Solomon(I subjected) the wind —its morning course(reaching a distance otherwise attained in) one month, and its evening course(reaching a distance otherwise attained in) one month. And We made a spring of molten brass flow for him, and there would be unseen beingsworking under him by the leave of his Lord. But whoever of them would swerve from Our command, We would make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:13: They would make for him whatever he wished of sanctuaries, and statues, and bowls like pools, and heavy cauldrons. “O David’s folk, work in thankfulness.” But few of My servants are constantly thankful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:14: Then, when We decreed death for him, nothing indicated his death to them except the woodworm eating his staff. Then, when he fell down, it became clear to the unseen beings that, had theyknown what was hidden, they would not have remained in the demeaning punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:15: Surely, there used to be a sign for(the people of) Sheba in their residence : two gardens, on the right and on the left. “Eatof your Lord’s provision and give thanks to Him.” A good land and an Oft-Forgiving Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:16: But they disregarded(God) , so We sent against them the torrent of the Arim(Dam) , and We substituted for them their two gardens with two gardens of bitter crops and thorny shrubs and something of sparse lote-trees.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:17: Thus We repaid them on account of how they denied, and do We(thus) repay anyoneexcept the staunch denier?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:18: And We made between themand the towns We had blessedvisible towns, and We well determined the journey between. “Journeybetween them safely by night and day.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:19: But they said, “Our Lord,lengthen the distances of our journeys.” Thus they were unjust to themselves, so We made them history and We scattered them in every direction; indeed, in this are signs for everyone who is most patient, constantly thankful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:20: And surely, Iblis confirmed his assumption about them. So they followed him, except for a group of believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:21: And never did he have any authority over them, except that We may know the one who believes in the Hereafter from the one who is doubtful about it. And yourLord is a Constant Preserver over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:22: Say, “Call upon those whom you claimed(to be gods) apart from Allah; they do not possess an atom’s weight in the heavens nor in the earth, and they do not have therein any association(with God) , and He does not have any assistant from among them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:23: And intercession cannot be of benefit before Him, except for oneto whom He has given permission . Until, when fear has been dispelled from their hearts, they say, “What did yourLord say?” They say, “The truth; and He is the All-High, the Supreme.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:24: Say, “Who provides for youfrom the heavens and the earth?” Say, “Allah—and indeed, either you or we are rightly guided or in evident misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:25: Say, “Youwill not be asked about the crimes we committed, nor will we be asked about what you do.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:26: Say, “Our Lord will bring us together, then He will legislatejustly for us with the truth, for He is the Legislator, the All-Knowing.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:27: Say, “Show me those you have attached to Him as associates. But no! Rather, He is Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:28: And We have not sent you but to the whole of mankind, as a herald of glad tidings and a warner, but the majority of mankind does not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:29: Thus they say, “When is this promise due, if youare truthful?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:30: Say, “Youare promised a day which you can neither postpone for a while nor bring forward.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:31: Those who denied said, “We will never believe in this Recitalnor in what came before it.” And if only youcould see the unjust as they are brought to stand before their Lord, throwing back allegations at one another: those who had been deemed weak and oppressed say to the arrogant leaders, “Were it not for you, we would have been believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:32: The arrogant leaders saidto those who had been deemed weak and oppressed, “Did we bar you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you yourselves were criminals.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:33: And those who had been deemed weak and oppressed said to the arrogant leaders, “Rather, it was your scheming by night and day as you used to command us to deny Allah and to set up rivals to Him.” Thus they hid their remorse when they saw the punishment. And We put the yokes around the necks of those who had denied. Are they being repaid except for what they used to do?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:34: And never have We sent a warner to any town except that its affluent said, “Indeed, we deny what youhave been sent with.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:35: And they said, “We have more wealth and more children(than the believers) , and never shall we be punished.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:36: Say, “Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whomever He wills and He restrains(it) , but the majority of mankind does not know.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:37: And it is neither yourwealth nor your children that bring you closer in position to Us—except whoever has attained faith and has acted righteously, for for those is a repayment of double(measure) for what they did, and in the Chambers (of Paradise) they remain safe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:38: But those who strove against Our signsattempting to challenge (God) —those are arraigned in the punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:39: Say, “Indeed, My Lord extends provision for whomever He wills of His servants and He restrains(it) . And anything youspend(in His cause) He replaces it, and He is the Best of providers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:40: And on the day when He herds themall together, then says to the angels, “Is it you that these used to worship?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:41: They said, “Highly Exalted are You; You are our Ultimate Guardian, not them. Rather, they used to worship the unseen beings; most of them are believers in them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:42: “So today youpossess for one another neither benefit nor harm.” And We will say to those who did injustices, “Taste the punishment of the Fire in which you used to disbelieve.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:43: And when Our signsare read to them, evident, they say, “This is nothing but a man who wants to bar youfrom what your forefathers used to worship.” And they say, “This is nothing but a fabricated lie.” And the deniers said of the truth when it came to them, “This is nothing but evident sorcery.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:44: Yet never before had We given them any books to study, nor had We sent them any warner before you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:45: And those before them also disbelieved, and never did they attain even a tenth of what We gave them. And they disbelieved My messengers, so how terrible was My condemnation!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:46: Say, “Indeed, I admonish youwith one thing: that you rise up for Allah in pairs or individually, then reflect. There is no madness in your fellow. He is just a warner to you before the advent of a severe punishment.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:47: Say, “Whatever reward I have asked of you, it is yours; my reward comes only from Allah, and He is Witness over everything.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:48: Say, “Indeed, My Lord projects the truth. He is the Superb Knower of the hidden realms.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:49: Say, “The truth has come, while falsehood can neither originate nor restore.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:50: Say, “If I go astray, I go astray only to my own loss; but if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me; He is indeed All-Hearing, Near.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:51: And if youcould only see when they wereterrified and there was no escape, and they were seized from a nearby place.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:52: And they said, “We have believed in it.” But how can they attain it from such a distant place
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:53: when they had denied it before? And they throw about conjectures regarding the hidden realm from such a distant place.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.34:54: And a barrier was placed between them and what they desire, as was done formerly with their likes. Indeed, they were in disturbing doubt.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:1: All praise be to Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Maker of the angels as messengers with two and three and four wings. He adds to creation as He wills; indeed, Allah is Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:2: Whatever mercy Allah unfolds for mankind, none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds, none can release it thereafter. And He is indeed the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:3: O mankind, remember Allah’s blessing upon you. Is there a creator other than Allah who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no god but He, so how can you be averted(from the truth) ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:4: And if they disbelieve you, surely messengers before you were also disbelieved. And to Allah all matters are returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:5: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is true, so let not the Earlier Life deceive you, and let not the Deceiver deceive you regarding Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:6: Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you, so take him as an enemy; indeed, he only invites his party to be among the fellows of the Blaze.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:7: For those who have denied is a severe punishment, while for those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds is forgiveness and a supreme reward.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:8: What about the one whose evil deed was adorned for him and so he came to regard it as good? Allah misguides whomever He wills and He guides whomever He wills, so let not your self be wasted sorrowing over them; indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of what they do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:9: And Allah is the One Who sent the winds , stirring up clouds, then Wedrove them to a lifeless land whereby We revived the earth after it had died; likewise is Resurrection.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:10: Whoever wants might—to Allah belongs all might. To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work lifts it up. But as for those who scheme evil, there is a severe punishment, and the scheming of those is bound to fail.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:11: And Allah created youfrom dust, then from a sperm drop, then He made you pairs. And no female carries or delivers except with His knowledge. And no person is given a long life or has his life cut short except that it is in a record; indeed, that is easy for Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:12: And the two waters are not equal: this one is fresh, sweet, good to drink, while this is salty, bitter. Yet from each youeat tender meat and extract jewelry which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through them, that you may seek of His grace, and that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:13: He causes the night to penetrate the day and He causes the day to penetrate the night, and He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term. Such is Allah, yourLord; to Him belongs the dominion. But those you call upon apart from Him do not own so much as the mere skin of a date stone.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:14: If youcall upon them, they do not hear your call; and even if they heard, never would they respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection, they will reject your polytheism. And none informs youlike One Who is all-aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:15: O mankind, it is you who stand in need of Allah, while Allah is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:16: If He wills, He can do away with youand bring about a new creation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:17: And that would not be too mighty for Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:18: And no bearer of burden bears the burden of another. And even if a heavily laden one calls for help with its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if the one called be a relative. You are only to warn those who fear their Lord, though unseen, and have established the prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself to his own benefit. And to Allah is the destiny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:19: Not equal are the blind one and the one who can see,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:20: nor are the darkness(es) and the light,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:21: nor are the shade and the torrid heat,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:22: nor equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allah causes whomever He wills to hear, but youcannot make those in the graves hear.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:24: Indeed, We have sent youwith the truth, as a herald of glad tidings and a warner. And there is no community but a warner has passed through it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:25: And if they disbelieve you, those before them also disbelieved. Their messengers came to them with evident proofs and with the Books and with the illuminating Scripture.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:26: Then I seized those who denied—so how terrible was My condemnation?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:27: Have younot seen that Allah has sent down water from the sky, and with it Wehave brought out products of various colors? And in the mountains are streaks of white and red, varying in their hue, and pitch-black.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:28: Likewise, human beings and animals and livestock come in various colors. Indeed, from among His servants, only the learned fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Almighty, Oft-Forgiving.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:29: Indeed, those who read the Scripture of Allah and have established the prayer and have spent of what We have provided for them, secretly and publicly, expect a bargain that will not fail.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:30: That He may render to them their rewards in full and increase them of His grace; He is indeed Oft-Forgiving, Ever Thankful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:31: And what We have revealed to youof the Scripture is the truth, confirming what preceded it. Allah is most surely All-Aware, All-Seeing of His servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:32: Then We gave the Scripture as a heritage to those of Our servants whom We selected: so of them is one who is unjust to himself, and one who follows a middle course, and one who is a forerunner in good deeds—by Allah’s leave. That is what the great grace is.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:33: Gardens of Eden which they enter ; they are adorned therein with gold bracelets and pearls , and their garments therein are of silk.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:34: And they said, “All praise be to Allah Who has lifted all sorrow from us; our Lord is most surely Oft-Forgiving, Ever Thankful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:35: He Who settled us in the Home of Everlasting Stay, by His grace, where neither toil touches us nor fatigue afflicts us.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:36: And those who have denied—for them is the fire of Hell wherein they are never finished off and thus die, nor is its punishment lightened for them. Thus We repay every staunch denier .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:37: And they scream aloud therein, “Our Lord, get us out, that we may act righteously, unlike the way we used to act.” “Did We not give youa lifelong enough to take warning if you were going to? And the warner did come to you, so taste, for there is no supporter for the unjust.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:38: Indeed, Allah is the Knower of the hidden realm of the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is All-Knowing of what lies within the chests.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:39: It is He who made yousuccessors on earth. So whoever denies—his denial is upon him, and the denial of the deniers adds only to their Lord’s loathing of them, and the denial of the deniers adds only to their perdition.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:40: Say, “Have you regarded those associates of yours that you worship apart from Allah? Show me what they have created on earth.” Or do they have any share in the heavens? Or have We given them a scripture such that they rely on an evident proof from it? Rather, the unjust promise one another nothing but a deception.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:41: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. And were they to vanish, there is none to hold them both except He; indeed, He has always been Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:42: And they swore by Allah their most solemn oaths: that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any of the other communities. Yet when a warner came to them, it only increased them in aversion—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:43: behaving arrogantly in the land and scheming evil. But evil scheming surrounds none but its people. So do they expect anything but the precedent of the ancients? For youwill never find any change in Allah’s rule, and you will never find any deviation in Allah’s rule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:44: And have they not journeyed through the earth and observed the consequences for those before them, though they were superior to them in strength? But in no way could Allah be thwarted by anything in the heavens or in the earth. Indeed, He has always been All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.35:45: And if Allah were to hold mankind accountable for what they have earned, He would not leave a single treading creature on its surface. But He defers them for a stated term, and then when their term is due—indeed, Allah has always been All-Seeing of His servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:3: Youare indeed of the emissaries
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:5: (God bestowed it as) a bestowal from on high by the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:6: to warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are oblivious.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:7: Certainly, most of them deserved the decree on them, for they refuse to believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:8: Indeed, We placed shackles around their necks up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:9: And We placed a barrier in front of them and a barrier behind them, and thus We blocked their vision so they cannot see.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:10: And it is the same for them whether youwarn them or do not warn them—they believe not.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:11: Indeed, youcan only warn one who has followed the Reminder and has feared the All-Merciful though unseen—so give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a noble reward.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:12: Indeed, We—We alone—revive the dead and write down what they have put forth and their traces. And everything have We tallied in an evident archive.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:13: And setforth for them the parable of the fellows of the town when the Emissaries came to it—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:14: when We sent them two persons but they disbelieved them, so We reinforced (them) with a third. Then they said, “Truly, We are emissaries sent to you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:15: They said, “You are nothing but human beings like us, and the All-Merciful did not send down anything; you are only lying.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:16: They said, “Our Lord knows that we are indeed emissaries sent to you,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:17: and our only duty is evident proclamation.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:18: They said, “We see an evil omen in you; if you do not give up, we will most surely stone you, and a painful punishment from us will most surely afflict you.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:19: They said, “Your evil omen is within yourselves. Can it be that it is becauseyou were reminded ? Rather, you are an extremist people!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:20: And there came a man rushing from the farthest end of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:21: Follow those who do not ask youany reward, and are themselves guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:22: And why should I not worship the One Who originated me, and to Whom youare returned ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:23: Shall I take other gods apart from Him? If the All-Merciful wants harm for me, their intercession does not avail me at all, nor can they rescue me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:24: In that case, I should indeed be in evident misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:25: Indeed, I have attained faith in yourLord, so listen to me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:26: It was said, “Enter the Garden(of Paradise) .” He said, “Oh if only my people could know
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:27: how my Lord has forgiven me and made me one of the honored!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:28: And after him, We sent down no soldiers from heaven to his people, nor would We ever send any down.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:29: It was just a single Shout, and suddenly they were extinct.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:30: Alas for the servants! No messenger comes to them but they ridicule him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:31: Have they not seen how many generations We annihilated before them—that they will not return to them?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:32: And none of them but will be arraigned before Us, all together.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:33: And there is a sign for them in the lifeless land: We have revived it and have brought out from it grains, so from it they eat.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:34: And We have made in it gardens of palm-trees and grapevines, and have caused springs to burst forth in it,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:35: that they may eat from its produce and(from) whattheir hands have made . So will they not give thanks?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:36: Highly Exalted is He Who created all pairs—of what the earth germinates and of their own selvesand of what they do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:37: And a sign for them is the night: We strip the day out of it—and they are suddenly in darkness.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:38: And the sun runs towards its destination; such is the determining of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:39: And We have determined the moon in phases until it returned like an old palm-branch.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:40: The sun is not to overtake the moon, nor is the night to outpace the day, and each floats in an orbit.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:41: And a sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden ship,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:42: and We created for them the like of it in which they ride.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:43: And if We will, We can drown them—with no screaming to be heard from them, nor will they be rescued,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:44: except by a mercy from Us and enjoyment for a while.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:45: And when it is said to them, “Be mindful of what lies before you and what lies behind you, that you may receive mercy” . . .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:46: Yet never does a sign of their Lord’s signs come to them, but they disregard it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:47: And when it is said to them, “Spend of what Allah has provided for you,” those who deny say to those who have attained faith, “Shall we feed someone whom Allah could feed, if He so wills? You are but in evident misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:48: And they say, “When will this promise be, if youare truthful?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:49: All they can expect is a single Shout, which will take them away while they feud,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:50: so that they will neither be able to make a will nor return to their own people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:51: And the trumpet was blown, whereupon they walked quickly out from the tombs to their Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:52: They said, “Woe to us! Who has resurrected us from our resting place?” This is what the All-Merciful has promised, and the emissaries have spoken the truth.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:53: It was just a single Shout, and suddenly they were all arraigned before Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:54: So today no soul is dealt with unjustly in the least, and youare not repaid except for what you used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:55: Indeed, today the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) are happily busy,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:56: they and their spouses, in shades , reclining on couches.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:57: For them are fruits therein, and for them is whatever they call for.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:58: “Peace”—a word from a Lord Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:59: But step aside today, you criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:60: Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not worship the devil—indeed, for you he is an evident enemy—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:61: and that you shall worship Me? This is a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:62: Yet he has certainly led a great multitude of you astray. Did you not use reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:63: This is Hell which youwere promised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:64: Roast in it today on account of how you used to deny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:65: Today, We put a seal upon their mouths, and their hands speak to Us, and their feet testify to whatever they used to earn.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:66: And if We will, We can obliterate their eyes, then they race with each other to(find) the Path—but how will they see?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:67: And if We will, We can disfigure them right in their place , so that they can neither move forward nor go back.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:68: And to whomever We give long life, We reverse his development—so will they not reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:69: And never did We teach himpoetry, nor is it proper for him; it is but a Reminder and an Evident Recital—
