Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:70: so that it may forewarn whoever is alive, and so that God’s decree may be deserved by the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:71: Have they not seen that We have created for them, of Our Handiwork, livestock, so that they are their owners?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:72: And We made them manageable by them, so some they ride and some they eat.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:73: And they have in them other benefits and drinks, so will they not give thanks?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:74: Yet they have taken to themselves gods other than Allah, that perhaps they may be supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:75: They cannot support them, even if they are arraigned for them as an army.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:76: So let not their words sadden you. Indeed, We know whatever they keep secret and whatever they make public.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:77: Has man not regarded that We created him from a sperm-drop? Yet he became an evident adversary,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:78: and he set forth a parable for Us and forgot his own creation. He said, “Who can revive the bones when they have decayed?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:79: Say, “He who initiated them the first time revives them, for He is All-Knowing of every creation.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:80: He who made fire for youout of green trees, so that with them you kindle.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:81: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth capable of creatingthe like of them? Yes indeed, and He is the All-Creating, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:82: Indeed, His only command once He has desired anything is to say to it, “Be,” and so it is .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.36:83: So Highly Exalted is the One in Whose hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him youare returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:1: By those aligned, lined up in ranks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:2: Then by the propellers propelling firmly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:3: Then by the readers of a Reminder—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:4: indeed, yourGod is surely One,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:5: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and Lord of the Easts.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:6: Indeed, We have adorned the lowestheaven withan adornment, the planets ,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:7: and as a protection against every defiant devil.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:8: They cannot eavesdrop onthe Higher Assembly, for they get bombarded from every side—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:9: repelled, and they will have an unremitting punishment,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:10: except for one who snatched a fragment and was then pursued by a piercing meteor.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:11: So inquireof them, “Are they more difficult to create, or the others We created?” Indeed, We created them from sticky clay.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:12: Rather, youwere amazed asthey ridicule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:13: And when reminded, they remember not.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:14: And when they see a sign, they exaggerate in ridiculing
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:15: and say, “This is nothing but evident sorcery.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:16: Can it be thatwhen we have died and become dust and bones, can it be that we will really be resurrected?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:18: Say, “Yes indeed, and you will be totally subdued.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:19: It is but a single nudge, and there they are looking on(in bewilderment) !
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:20: And they said, “Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:21: “This is the Day of Decision which youused to deny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:22: Herdthose who were unjust and their spouses, and what they used to worship
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:23: apart from Allah, and guide them to the path to purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:24: And stop them—indeed, they are to be questioned.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:25: “What is the matter with youthat you do not help one another?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:26: Rather, on this day, they are submissive.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:27: And they cameto one another, asking one another.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:28: Theysaid, “Indeed, youused to come at us from the right”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:29: Theysaid, “Rather, youyourselves were not believers,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:30: and we had no authority over you; rather, you yourselves were a people who exceeded all limits.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:31: And therefore we deserved our Lord’s decree on us. Most surely we will all get a taste,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:32: for we deluded you; indeed, we were deluded.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:33: So on that day, they are indeed partners in the punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:34: This is what We do with the criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:35: Indeed, when it was said to them, “There is no god except Allah,” they would act arrogantly
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:36: and say, “Are we really to abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:37: In fact, he came with the truth, and he confirmed the emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:38: Most surely, youwill taste the painful punishment,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:39: and in no way will you be repaid except for what you used to do,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:41: For those, there is a known provision:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:45: A drink is passed round among them from a flowing spring:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:46: white, a delight to those who drink,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:47: no headiness in it, nor by it are they drained.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:48: And with them are bashful maidens with lovely eyes,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:49: as if they were closely guarded eggs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:50: So they cameto one another, asking one another.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:51: One of them said, “Indeed, I did have a comrade
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:52: who would say, ‘Can it be that youare really of those who believe?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:53: Can it be thatwhen we have died and become dust and bones, can it be that we will really be called to account?’”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:54: He said(to his companions in Paradise) , “Can youview(him) ?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:55: Then he viewed(him) and saw him in the midst of purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:56: He said,“(I swear) by Allah, youalmost ruined me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:57: And were it not for the blessing of my Lord, I would have been of the arraigned.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:59: except for our first death? And are we never to be punished?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:60: It is most surely this which is the great triumph.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:61: For the like of this let the workers work.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:62: Is this a better hospitality or the Tree of Zaqqum?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:63: Indeed, We have made it a means of trial for the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:64: Indeed, it is a tree that comes out from the very origin of purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:65: Its yield is as if it were devils’ heads.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:66: So they are sure to eat from it and fill their bellies with it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:67: Then, on top of it, they will have a brew of scalding water.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:68: Then their return is sure to be to purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:69: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:70: so they rush along in their footsteps.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:71: And certainly, most of the ancients before them went astray.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:72: And certainly, We sent among them forewarners.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:73: So lookat what the outcome was for those who were warned,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:75: And certainly, Noah called out to Us, so the very excellent of responders are We!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:76: Thus We delivered him and his family from the great calamity,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:77: and We made his offspring the sole survivors,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:78: and We left him thus to be remembered among later generations.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:79: Peace be upon Noah among(all creatures of) all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:80: Indeed, thus do We repay those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:81: Indeed, he is one of Our believing servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:83: And, indeed, of his kind is Abraham.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:84: Recall when he came to his Lord with a sound heart.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:85: He said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:86: Is it false gods, instead of Allah, that youwant?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:87: So what is youropinion about the Lord of all realms?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:88: Then he took one look at the stars
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:90: So they turned away from him, fleeing,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:91: whereupon he turned to their gods and said, “Will younot eat?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:92: What is it with you? Do you not speak?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:93: Then he turned on them, striking with his right hand.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:94: So they came towards him, dashing .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:95: He said, “Do you worship what you carve,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:96: when Allah has created youand all that you do?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:97: They said, “Build a structure for him and throw him into purgatory.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:98: So they desired to plot against him, but We made them the lowest.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:99: And then he said, “I am going to my Lord—He will guide me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:100: “My Lord, give me one of the righteous.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:101: So We gave him glad tidings of a forbearing boy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:102: Then, when he was old enough to accompany him, he said, “O my child, I see in a dream that I am sacrificing you, so look—what do you see ?” He said, “O my father, do as you are commanded; you will find me, Allah willing, of the patient ones.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:103: Then, when theyhad submitted and he laid him down on his forehead,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:104: We then called out to him, “O Abraham!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:105: Youhave truly fulfilled the vision.” Thus indeed do We repay those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:106: Indeed, this was certainly the evident test.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:107: And We redeemed him with a great sacrifice,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:108: and We left him thus to be remembered among later generations:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:110: Thus We repay those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:111: Indeed, he is one of Our believing servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:112: And We gave him glad tidings of Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:113: And We blessed him and Isaac. But of their offspring is one who excels in doing good and one who is evidently unjust to himself.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:114: And We certainly conferred Our favor upon Moses and Aaron,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:115: and We delivered themand their people from the great calamity.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:116: And We supported them, so they were the overcomers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:117: And We gave themthe evidential Scripture,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:118: and We guided themupon the straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:119: And We left themthus to be remembered among later generations:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:121: Thus do We repay those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:122: Indeed, they are of Our believing servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:123: And Elijah is indeed one of the emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:124: Recall when he said to his people, “Will you not be mindful(of God) ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:125: Do youcall upon Baʻland leave the best of creators—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:126: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your ancient fathers?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:127: But they disbelieved him, and thus they will certainly be arraigned,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:129: And We left him thus to be remembered among later generations:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:131: Thus do We repay those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:132: Indeed, he is one of Our believing servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:133: And Lot is indeed one of the emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:134: Recall when We delivered him and all of his family,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:135: except for an old womanwho lingered behind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:137: And most surely youpass by them in the morning
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:138: and at night. Do you not reason?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:139: And Jonah is indeed one of the emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:140: Recall when he fled to the overloaded ship,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:141: and he drew lots and was of those who lost.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:142: Then the whale took him into its mouth, and he was to blame.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:143: And had he not been one of those who highly exalt God,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:144: he would have stayed in its belly until the day they are resurrected.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:145: Then We threw him into the wilderness while he was sick,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:146: and We germinated a gourd tree over him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:147: Then We sent him to a hundred thousand or more.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:148: And they attained faith, so We gave them enjoyment for some time.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:149: So inquireof them, “Are the daughters for yourLord while for them are the sons?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:150: Or did We create the angels as females while they witnessed?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:151: Undoubtedly, it is out of their utter falsehood that they do indeed say,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:152: “Allah has begotten.” But they are most surely liars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:153: Has He selected daughters over sons?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:154: What is it with you? How do you judge?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:156: Or do youhave an evident manifestation?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:157: Then bring yourscripture, if you have been truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:158: And they invented a relationship between Him and(the race of) unseen beings. And certainly,(the race of) unseen beings knew that they(who made the claims) would surely be arraigned—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:159: Highly Exalted is Allah far above what they describe—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:161: Thus surely, youand what you worship
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:162: can never seduce(anyone) away from Him,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:163: except for one who is to roast in purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:164: “And there is not one of usbut has an assigned position.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:165: And we are indeed the aligned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:166: And we are indeed those who exalt God.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:168: “Had we received a Reminder from the ancients,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:169: we would have been Allah’s sincere chosen servants.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:170: But they denied it, so they will find out.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:171: And most surely Our Word has already gone out to our servant emissaries:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:172: indeed, it is they who shall surely be supported,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:173: and indeed it is Our soldiers who shall surely be the overcomers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:174: So turnaway from them for some time,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:175: and watch them—for they will soon see.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:176: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:177: Yet, when it descends into their courtyard, miserable shall be the morning of those forewarned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:178: And turnaway from them for a while,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:180: Highly Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of Might, far above what they describe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:181: And peace be upon the emissaries.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.37:182: And all praise be to Allah, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:1: Sād. By the Recitalcontaining the Reminder.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:2: Yet those who denied are in a state of mightand opposition.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:3: How many generations have We caused to perish before them, so they called out when it was too late to escape!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:4: And they marveled that a forewarner had come to them from among them, and the deniers said, “This is a sorcerer, a sheer liar.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:5: Did he make all the gods into one God? Surely this is indeed something strange.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:6: And the chiefs among them proceeded,(saying) , “Walk away(from the Prophet) and hold fast to yourgods; indeed this is certainly something planned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:7: Never have we heard of this in the former creed. This is nothing but an invention.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:8: Was the Reminder sent down to him out of all of us?” Rather, they are doubtful about My Reminder; rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:9: Or do they possess the treasuries of yourLord’s mercy, the Almighty, the Giver?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:10: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend by any means.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:11: An army of confederates will be defeated there.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:12: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved, as did ʻĀd, and Pharaoh of the stakes,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:13: and Thamûdand the people of Lot and the fellows of the thicket. Those were the parties.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:14: None of them but disbelieved the messengers, so My punishment was deserved.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:15: For these await nothing but a single shout, from which there is no recovery.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:16: Yet they said, “Our Lord, hasten for us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:17: Endurepatiently what they say and remember Our servant David who was endowed with strong faith; indeed, he often turnsto Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:18: Indeed, We subjected the mountains to give due exaltations(to God) with him in the evening and at daybreak,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:19: with the birds made to flock, each often turning to Him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:20: Thus We strengthened his dominion and brought him wisdom and decisive speech.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:21: And has the tiding of the disputants reached you, as they climbed the sanctuary—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:22: as they entered upon David, and he was startled by them? They said, “Do not fear; two disputants, one of whom has oppressed the other. So judge between us with the truth and do not be untrue, and guide us to the right path.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:23: “Indeed, this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have just one ewe, and he said, ‘Entrust it to me,’ and he pressured me with words.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:24: He said, “He has done youwrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes, and indeed many partners do oppress one another— except those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds, but these are so few.” And David realized that We were testing him, so he sought forgiveness from his Lord and fell down to his knees and turned penitent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:25: So We forgave him that, and indeed there is most surely for him nearness to Us and a beautiful place to return to.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:26: “O David, We have appointed you as a viceroy in the land, so judge between mankind with the truth and do not follow the whim, lest it misguide you from the way of Allah. Indeed, for those who stray from the way of Allah there is a severe punishment for their having forgotten the Day of Reckoning.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:27: And in no way have We created the heaven and the earth and whatever is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who have denied. So woe to those who have denied from the Fire!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:28: Or are We to make those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds equal to those who spread corruption in the earth? Or are We to make the people who are mindful(of God) equal to the wicked?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:29: A Scripture that We sent down to you, blessed, that they may ponderits signsand that those endowed with understanding may remind themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:30: And to David We gave Solomon, an excellent servant; indeed, he often turnsto Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:31: Recall when the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:32: so he said, “Indeed, I have loved the good things with a love more than the remembrance of my Lord, until itdisappeared behind the veil(of night) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:33: Bringthem back to me.” And he started to stroke their legs and necks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:34: And surely, We tested Solomon and cast a body on his throne, then he turned penitent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:35: He said, “My Lord, forgive me and grant me a dominion never to be attained by anyone after me; indeed, You— only You—are the Giver.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:36: So We subjected to him the wind , flowing gently by his command wherever he directed;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:37: and the demons—every builder and diver;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:38: and others bound together in fetters.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:39: “This is Our gift, so givegenerously or withhold, without measure.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:40: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a beautiful place to return to.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:41: And recall Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, “Satan has touched me with toil and suffering.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:42: “Stamp your foot—this is a cool washing-place and drinking-place.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:43: And We gave him back his family and doubled them—a mercy from Us and a reminding for those endowed with understanding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:44: “And take with yourhand a bundle of grass, and strike with it so as not to breach(your oath) .” Indeed, We found him patient. What an excellent servant; indeed, he often turnsunto Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:45: And recallOurservants Abraham and Isaac and Jacob—those endowed with strong faith and with sight(s) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:46: Surely We distinguished them with a distinct quality —the remembranceof the(final) Home.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:47: And indeed, to Us they are of the elect, the outstanding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:48: And recallIshmael and Elisha and Ezekiel—and all are of the outstanding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:49: This is a Reminder. For indeed, for the mindful(of God) is a beautiful place to return to:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:50: the Gardens of Eden, with their doors wide-open for them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:51: relaxing therein and calling for abundant fruit and beverage.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:52: And with them are bashful maidens of equal age.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:53: This is what you are promisedfor the Day of Reckoning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:54: Indeed, such is Our provision, inexhaustible.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:55: All this. But indeed, for those who exceed all limits is a miserable place to return to:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:56: Hell, in which they roast—so what a miserable resting place!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:57: All this, so let them taste it—scalding water and purulence.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:58: And another (torment) similar to it, of diverse kinds.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:59: “This is a crowd rushing headlong with you.” They are not welcome; indeed, they are to be roasted in the Fire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:60: They said, “But it is youwho are not welcome! It is you who brought it upon us! So what a miserable end!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:61: They said, “Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, give him double punishment in the Fire.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:62: And they said, “What is it with us that we do not see men whom we used to count among the villains?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:63: Did we take them with mockery , or have our sight(s) swerved from them?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:64: Indeed, that is certainly true: the disputing among the inhabitants of the Fire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:65: Say, “Indeed, I am only a forewarner, for there is no god except Allah—the One, the Subduer,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:66: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Almighty, the Forgiver.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:67: Say, “It is a great tiding
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:69: I have had no knowledge of the Highest Assembly as they disputed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:70: It is only revealed to methat I am an evident warner.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:71: Recall when YourLord said to the angels, “Indeed, I am creating a human being from clay.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:72: So when I have formed him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall prostrate before him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:73: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them, entirely—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:74: but not Iblis; he acted arrogantly and became one of the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:75: He said, “O Iblis, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My Own hands? Have you acted arrogantly, or have you become one of the exalted?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:76: He said, “I am better than him; You created me from fire and created him from clay.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:77: He said, “Then get out of it, for you are indeed an outcast!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:78: And indeed, My curse is upon you until the Day of Recompense.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:79: He said, “My Lord, then reprieve me until the day they are resurrected.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:80: He said, “Then indeed, you are of those reprieved
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:81: until the Day of the Time Appointed.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:82: He said, “Then, by Your majesty, I will most surely delude them all,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:83: except for your sincere chosen servants among them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:84: He said, “So the truth is—and only the truth I say—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:85: I will surely fill Hell with youand with whoever of them who follows you, all together.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:86: Say, “I ask of you no reward for this, and I am not a pretender.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:87: It is but a Reminder to(all creatures of) all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.38:88: And youwill certainly know its tiding after a while.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:1: The bestowal of the Scripture from on high is by Allah the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:2: Indeed, We have sent down to youthe Scripture with the truth, so worship Allah, devoting religion to Him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:3: Undoubtedly, faithful religion is due to Allah! And those who take guardians apart from Him—(they say,) “We only worship them so that they may bring us closer to Allah.” Indeed, Allah will judge between them regarding whatever they used to differ over. Indeed, Allah does not guide one who is a liar, a relentless denier.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:4: Had Allah desired to have a child, He would have selected whatever He so willed from whatever He created. Highly Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Subduer.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:5: He created the heavens and the earth with truth; He rolls the night around the day, and He rolls the day around the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running for a stated term. Undoubtedly, He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:6: He created youfrom a single self, then made from it its spouse, and sent down to you of livestock eight kinds in pairs. He creates you in your mothers’ bellies, one act of creation after another, in threefold darkness(es) . That is Allah, yourLord; to Him belongs the dominion; there is no god but Him, so how then are you turned away?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:7: If youdeny, then indeed Allah is Self-sufficient without(any need of) you, yet He does not approve denial on the part of His servants, and if you are thankful He approves it for you. And no bearer of burden bears the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, whereupon He informs you of what you used to do; indeed, He is All-Knowing of what lies within the chests.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:8: And when some harm touches man, he calls upon his Lord, in penitence to Him. But then, when He confers on him a blessing of His, he forgets what he was previously calling upon for, and he sets up rivals to Allah in order to make(people) stray from His way. Say, “Enjoyyourdenial for a little while; you are one of the fellows of the Fire.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:9: Or what about one who worships devoutly during the watches of the night, prostrating himself and standing up, wary of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord? Say, “Are those who know and those who do not know equal?” Indeed, only those endowed with understanding remind themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:10: Say(on My behalf) , “O My servants who have attained faith, be mindful of yourLord. For those who do good in this Earlier(Life) is goodness, and Allah’s land is vast. Indeed, the patient ones will be rendered their reward in full without measure.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:11: Say, “Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, devoting religion to Him,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:12: and I was commanded to become the first of the Muslims.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:13: Say, “I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the punishment of a great day.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:14: Say, “It is Allah I worship, devoting my religion to Him.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:15: “So worshipwhatever you wish apart from Him.” Say, “Indeed, the losers are those who lost themselves and their people on the Day of Resurrection.” Undoubtedly, that is the evident loss.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:16: They have layers of fire above them, and layers beneath them. That is how Allah puts fear into His servants. “O My servants, therefore, be mindful of Me!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:17: And those who avoided false masters—that they should worship them, and turned to Allah in penitence—for them are glad tidings. So giveglad tidings to My servants
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:18: who listen to what is said and follow the best of it; those are the ones whom Allah has guided, and those are the people of understanding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:19: What about the one who has deserved the decree of punishment? Is it youwho(can) rescue those in the Fire?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:20: But those who were mindful of their Lord—for them are compartments above which are compartments built high, with rivers flowing beneath them: the promise of Allah; Allah never breaks a promise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:21: Have younot seen that Allah has sent down water from the sky, then He made it flow into springs in the earth, then He brings out with it vegetation of various colors, then they wither and you see them yellowing, then He turns them into debris? Indeed, in this is a reminding for the people of understanding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:22: What about someone whose chest Allah has expanded to(accept) Islam, so that he follows a light from His Lord? So woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah; those are in evident misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:23: Allah has bestowed the most beautiful of all teachings from on high: a Scripture consistent and paired. The skins of those who fear their Lord shiver from it, then their skins and their hearts soften up to the remembrance of Allah. Such is Allah’s guidance; He guides with it whomever He wills. But whomever Allah misguides, no guide shall there ever be for him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:24: What about someone who covers his face against the terrible punishment of the Day of Resurrection? And it was saidto the unjust, “Taste what youused to earn.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:25: Those before them disbelieved, so the punishment came up to them from where they were unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:26: So Allah made them taste disgrace in the Earlier Life, and surely the punishment of the Hereafter is more grievous, if they only knew.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:27: And surely, We have put forth in this Recitalfor mankind all kinds of parables, that they may remind themselves:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:28: an Arabic Recital, free from any distortion, that they may become mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:29: Allah set forth the parable of a man owned by quarreling associates, and a man belonging exclusively to one man. Are they equal in status? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:30: Youwill certainly die, and they will certainly die.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:31: Then certainly on the Day of Resurrection you will dispute with one another in the presence of your Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:32: So who is more unjust than one who lied about Allah and disbelieved the truth when it came to him? Is there not in Hell a dwelling for the deniers?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:33: But the one who came with the sincere belief and sincerely believed in it—thoseare the mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:34: For them, with their Lord, is whatever they will; such is the repayment for those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:35: So that Allah may remit the worst of what they have done and repay them their reward in accordance with the best of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:36: Is not Allah enough for His servant ? And they(seek to) frighten youwith those apart from Him. Thus whomever Allah misguides, no guide shall there ever be for him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:37: And whomever Allah guides, for him there is no misleader. Is Allah not Almighty, Capable of vengeance?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:38: And if youasked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they would say, “Allah.” Say, “Have youseen those whom you call upon apart from Allah? If Allah desired any harm for me, would they be capable of preventing His harm? And if He desired a blessing for me, would they be capable of preventing His mercy?” Say, “Allah suffices for me; those who trust, place their trust in Him.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:39: Say, ‘My people, act according to your position ; surely, I am also acting(according to mine) . Then you shall come to know
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:40: who will receive a punishment that disgraces him, and upon whom a perpetual punishment shall fall.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:41: Indeed, We have sent down the Scripture upon youfor mankind with the truth. So whoever seeks guidance does so to his own benefit, while whoever goes astray—he only does so to his own detriment, and you are not a trustee over them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:42: Allah takes up the selves at the time of their death, and those that have not died(He takes up) during their sleep. Then He retains those for which He has decreed deathand releases the others to(fulfill) a stated term. Most surely, in that are signs for people who reflect.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:43: Or have they chosen intercessors other than Allah? Say, “Even though they have no power over anything, nor do they reason?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:44: Say, “All intercession is up to Allah; to Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, then to Him youare returned .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:45: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are disgusted. But when those apart from Him are mentioned, they promptly start anticipating glad tidings.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:46: Say, “Our God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the hidden realm and the manifest, You judge between Your servants regarding whatever they used to differ over.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:47: If those who were unjust owned whatever is in the earth, all together, and the like of it with it, they would(seek to) redeem themselves with it from the terrible punishment on the Day of Resurrection. But there appearedto them from Allah what they never anticipated.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:48: And there appeared to them the evil deeds of whatever they had earned, and so they became surrounded by what they usedto ridicule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:49: And when harm touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We grant him a blessing from Us, he says, “I have been brought it solely because of(my) knowledge.” Rather, it is a means of trial, but most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:50: Those before them previously said that, but what they used to earn did not avail them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:51: so they were afflicted by the evil deeds of whatever they had earned. And the unjust among these will also be afflicted by the evil deeds of whatever they have earned, and in no way can they thwart(God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:52: Have they not come to know that Allah extends provision for whomever He wills, and He restrains(it) ? In that are signs for people who believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:53: Say, “O My servants who have gone to extremes against themselves: despair not of Allah’s mercy, for indeed Allah forgives all misdeeds; indeed, He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Bestower of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:54: And turn penitent to yourLord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you and you are not supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:55: And follow the best of what was sent down to youfrom your Lord before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:56: So that no soul may say, “Alas, for having neglected my duty towards Allah and for having been of the mockers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:57: Or it may say, “Had Allah guided me, I would have been of the mindful(of God) .”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:58: Or it may say, when it sees the punishment, “If only I had another chance, I would be of those who excel in doing good.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:59: Yes indeed! My signs did come to you, but you disbelieved in them and acted arrogantly and were of the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:60: And on the Day of Resurrection yousee those who told lies about Allah with their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a dwelling for the arrogant?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:61: And Allah delivers those who were mindful(of Him) to their place of triumph; no harm touches them, nor do they grieve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:62: Allah is the Creator of everything, and He is the Ultimate Trustee over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:63: To Him belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth. But those who have denied the signs of Allah—it is they who are the losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:64: Say, “Is it other than Allah, then, that you command me to worship, you ignorant ones?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:65: And it was revealed to youand to those before you that if youassociate(others with God) , your work will certainly be nullified, and you will certainly be of the losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:66: Rather, worship Allah and be of the appreciative.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:67: Yet they did not render to Allah the respect that He deserves, for the entire earth is in His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens are folded in His right. Highly Exalted is He and Most High beyond the associations they make.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:68: And the Trumpet was blown, so all who were in the heavens and the earth were stunned, except whomever Allah willed. Then it was blown another time, whereupon they all stood looking on.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:69: And the earth shone with the Light of its Lord, and the recordwas placed, and the prophets and the witnesseswere brought in, and it was judged between them in truth, and they were not dealt with unjustly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:70: And every soul was fully compensated for what it had done, for He knows better what they do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:71: And those who denied were driven to Hell in throngs, until, when they had reached it, its gates were opened and its keepers said to them, “Did not messengers from among you come to you, reading to you the signsof your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this day of yours?” They said, “Yes, indeed!” But the word of punishment proved true against the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:72: It was said, “Enter the gates of Hell, abiding therein.” So how miserable is the dwelling of the arrogant!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:73: And those who were mindful of their Lord were driven to the Garden(of Paradise) in throngs, until, when they had reached it and its gates were opened and its keepers said to them, “Peace be upon you, you have been good, so enter it, to abide.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:74: And they said, “All praise be to Allah Who has fulfilled His promise to us and made us inherit the land, enjoying the Garden(of Paradise) as we please.” So how excellent is the reward of the workers!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.39:75: And youseethe angels hovering around the Throne, exalting their Lord with praise. And it was judged between them equitably, and it was said, “Praise be to Allah, Lord of all realms.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:2: The bestowal of the Scripture from on high is by Allah the Almighty, the All-Knowing,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:3: the Forgiver of(every) misdeed and the Granter and Accepter of repentance, the Severe in punishment, the Bountiful in bounty; there is no god but He; to Him is the ultimate return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:4: None argues against Allah’s signs except those who have denied, so donot be deceived by their movement in the land.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:5: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved, as did the parties after them. And every community sought after theirmessenger in order to capture him, and they argued using falsehood to defeat with it the truth. But I seized them, so how was My punishment!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:6: Thus yourLord’s Word came true against those who denied: that they are the fellows of the Fire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:7: Those who carry the Throne and those around it exalt their Lord with praise and believe in Him and ask for forgiveness for those who have attained faith: “Our Lord, You have encompassed everything in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way, and protect them from the punishment of purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:8: Our Lord, and enter them into the Gardens of Eden which You have promised them—and the righteous among their forefathers and their spouses and their offspring(s) ; indeed, it is You, You(alone), who are the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:9: And shield them from evil deeds, for whomever You shield from evil deeds on that day, You have had mercy on him. And that is the great triumph.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:10: Indeed, those who denied will be addressed, “The loathing of Allah is greater than your loathing of yourselves—for you were invited to the faith, but you refused.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:11: They said, “Our Lord, you caused us to die twice, and you gave us life twice. Now we have acknowledged our misdeeds, so is there any way out?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:12: That is because whenever Allah alone was called upon, youdenied. But if others are associated with Him, you believe. But judgment rests with Allah the All-High, the Supreme.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:13: It is He who shows youHis signs and bestows —from on high—provision from heaven for you. But none reminds himself except whoever is penitent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:14: So callupon Allah, devoting religion to Him, even if the deniers hate it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:15: Exalted in degrees(of rank) , Owner of the Throne—He casts the spirit(of inspiration) by His command upon whomever He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Encounter:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:16: the day when they emerge; nothing about them is hidden from Allah. “To whom does the dominion belong today?” “To Allah, the One, the Subduer.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:17: Today, every soul is repaid for what it has earned. There is no injustice today; indeed, Allah is Swift in reckoning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:18: And warnthem of the Day of the Inevitable Event, when hearts are at throats, while they block them. The evildoers will have neither intimate(friend) nor intercessor to be obeyed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:19: He knows the treacherous look of the eyes and whatever the chests hide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:20: And Allah decrees with the truth, while those whom they call uponapart from Him do not decree at all. Indeed, it is Allah who is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:21: Have they not journeyed through the earth and looked at how the outcome was for those before them? They were superior to them in strength and in the traces which they left in the land, but Allah seized them for their misdeeds, for they had no shield from Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:22: That is because their messengers used to come to them with evident proofs, but they denied, so Allah seized them. He is All-Powerful, Stern in retribution.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:23: And We sent Moses with Our signs and an evident manifestation
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:24: to Pharaoh and Hamān and Qarun, but they said, “A sorcerer, a sheer liar.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:25: Then when he came to them with the truth from Us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who have attained faith with him and keep their women alive(in bondage) .” But the plotting of the deniers can only go astray.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:26: And Pharaoh said, “Let me kill Moses, and let him call upon his Lord; indeed, I am afraid that he may exchange yourreligion or that he may cause corruption to appear in the land.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:27: And Moses said, “I have sought refuge with my Lord and yourLord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:28: And a believing man from Pharaoh’s folk who had concealed his faith said, “Do youkill a man for saying, ‘My Lord is Allah,’ and he has come to you with evident proofs from your Lord? If he is a liar, then his lying is upon him. But if he is truthful, then some of what he promises you will befall you; indeed, Allah does not guide anyone who is an extremist, a sheer liar.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:29: O my people, yours is thedominion today, prevailing in the land. But who will help us against Allah’s chastisement, should it fall upon us?” Pharaoh said, “I do not show youexcept what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of prudence.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:30: But the one who had attained faith said, “O my people, I fear for you the like of the Day of the Parties—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:31: like the custom of the people of Noah and ʻĀdand Thamûdand those after them. For Allah wants no injustice for the servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:32: O my people, I fear for you the Day of Calling Out—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:33: the day when you turn away, fleeing, with no safeguard from Allah. And whomever Allah misguides, no guide shall there ever be for him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:34: And surely Joseph did come to youwith the evident proofs, but you continued to doubt what he came to you with, until when he perished, you said, “Allah will never send a messenger after him.” Thus Allah misguides whoever is an extremist, constantly doubting.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:35: Those who argue against Allah’s signs without any manifestation having come to them—this is most loathsome to Allah and to those who have attained faith; thus Allah seals the heart of every arrogant compeller.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:36: And Pharaoh said, “O Hamān, build me a tower, that I may reach the means—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:37: the means of the heavens, so that I may view the God of Moses, though I surely think he is a liar.” And thus Pharaoh’s evil deeds were adorned for him and he was barred from the way, for Pharaoh’s plotting is in nothing but ruin.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:38: And the one who had attained faith said, “O my people, follow me and I will guide you to the way of prudence.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:39: O my people, this Earlier Life is nothing but(fleeting) enjoyment, while the Hereafter is indeed the Home of Permanence.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:40: Whoever has committed an evil deed will not be repaid except with its like, but whoever has acted righteously, whether male or female, while a believer—then those shall enter the Garden(of Paradise) where they shall be provided for without measure.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:41: And O my people, how is it that I call you to salvation and you call me to the Fire?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:42: Youcall me to deny Allah and associate with Him what I have no knowledge of, while I call you to the Almighty, the Forgiver.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:43: Without doubt, what youcall me to has no say in the Earlier(Life) or in the Hereafter, and that our turning back is to Allah, and that it is the extremists who are the fellows of the Fire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:44: Youwill remember what I am telling you. So I entrust my affairs to Allah; indeed, Allah is All-Seeing of the servants.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:45: So Allah shielded him from the evils of their scheming, while an awful punishment surrounded Pharaoh’s folk:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:46: the Fire—they are exposed to it in the early morning and at nightfall, and on the day the Hour takes place(it is said) : “EnterPharaoh’s folk into the most intense punishment.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:47: And as they debate in the Fire, the weak say to the arrogant leaders, “Indeed, we were followers of yours, so will you now spare us a portion of the Fire?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:48: The arrogant leaders said, “We are all in it; indeed, Allah has judged between the servants.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:49: And those in the Fire said to the keepers of Hell, “Call upon your Lord to lighten one day of the punishment for us.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:50: They said, “Did not your messengers come to you with evident proofs?” They said, “Yes.” They said, “Then call.” But the calling of the deniers is but in vain.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:51: Most surely, We support Our messengers and those who have attained faith in the Earlier Life and on the day when all sorts of witnesses arise—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:52: the day when the excuses of the unjust do them no benefit, and for them is the curse, and for them is the worst(final) Home.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:53: And certainly We gave Moses the guidance and made the children of Israel inherit the Scripture,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:54: as guidance and a reminding for those endowed with understanding.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:55: So be patient; indeed the promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness for yourmisdeed and exalt your Lord with praise evening and morning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:56: Indeed, those who argue against Allah’s signs without any manifestation having come to them—there is nothing in their chests but a feeling of greatness which they will never attain. So seekrefuge in Allah; indeed, it is He who is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:57: The creation of the heavens and the earth is certainly greater than the creation of humanity, but the majority of mankind does not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:58: And in no way are the blind and the seeing equal, nor are those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds(equal) to the evildoer. How little you remind yourselves!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:59: Indeed, the Hour is coming—no doubt about it—but the majority of mankind does not believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:60: Yet your Lord has said, “Call upon Me(and) I will respond to you. Indeed, those who are too arrogant to serve Me will enter Hell in humiliation.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:61: It is Allah Who made the night for you, that you may rest therein, and the day allowing sight; indeed, Allah is certainly Gracious towards mankind, but the majority of mankind does not give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:62: Such is Allah, yourLord, Creator of everything; there is no god except Him, so how can you be averted(from the truth) ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:63: Thus are averted those who used to repudiate the signs of Allah.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:64: It is Allah who made the earth a habitat for you, and the sky a structure, and He designed you and perfected your designs, and He provided you with the good things. Such is Allah, your Lord, so supremely blessed be Allah, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:65: He is the Living One; there is no god except He, so callupon Him, devoting religion to Him. All praise be to Allah, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:66: Say, “Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those whom youcall upon apart from Allah, now that the evident proofs have come to me from my Lord. And I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of all realms.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:67: It is He Who created youfrom dust, then from a drop of semen, then from a clinging form, then He brings you out as infants, then He lets you attain your full strength, then you become elderly—although some of you are taken(at death) sooner—and that you may reach a predetermined age, and so that you may reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:68: It is He who gives life and death, so whenever He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and so it is .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:69: Have younot seen those who argue regarding Allah’s signs? How are they turned away?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:70: Those who disbelieved the Scripture and what We sent Our messengers with, for they will come to know
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:71: when the yokes are around their necks, as well as the chains, as they are dragged
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:72: into the scalding water, then in the Fire they are seethed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:73: Then it was saidto them, “Where are those you used to associate
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:74: apart from Allah?” They said, “They have strayed from us. In fact, we were calling upon nothing before.” Thus Allah misguides the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:75: “That is on account of how youused to rejoice on earth in untruth and on account of how you used to behave with vanity.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:76: Enterthe gates of Hell, abiding therein. So how miserable is the dwelling of the arrogant!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:77: So be patient; indeed, the promise of Allah is true. So whether We show you some of what We have promised them or take you up to Us, to Us they are returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:78: And surely We sent messengers before you, some of whose stories We related to you, and some We did not. And it was never for any messenger to bring about a sign except by Allah’s leave. So when the command of Allah comes, matters are decreed between them with fairness, and there and then the advocates of falsehood will lose.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:79: It is Allah who made livestock for you, that you may ride some of them and of some you eat.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:80: And in them you have benefits, and through them you satisfy a need within your chests, and on them and on ships you are carried.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:81: And He shows youHis signs, so which of Allah’s signs do you deny?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:82: Have they not journeyed through the earth and looked at how the outcome was for those before them? They were superior to them in strength and in the traces which they left in the land, but what they had achieved availed them nothing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:83: When their messengers came to them with evident proofs they rejoiced in the knowledge they had, so they became surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:84: Then when they witnessed Our chastisement they said, “We believe in Allah alone and we deny what we used to associate with Him.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.40:85: But their faith could not help them once they witnessed Our chastisement; such has been Allah’s rule in(dealing with) His servants, and there and then did the deniers lose.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:2: A bestowal from on high by the All-Merciful, the Bestower of mercy—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:3: a Scripture whose signswere detailed as an Arabic Recitalfor people who know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:4: A herald of glad tidings and a warner, but most of them disregard(it), so they do not hear.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:5: And they said, “Our hearts are screened from what youcall us to, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a barrier. So do what you want, and so will we.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:6: Say, “I am only a human being like you. To me it is revealed that your god is One God. So be upright towards Him and seek forgiveness from Him.” And woe to the polytheists—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:7: those who do not bring about the purifying act, and regarding the Hereafter they are deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:8: Indeed, those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—for them is an unfailing reward.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:9: Say, “Can it be that youreally deny the One Who created the earth in two(heavenly) days and attribute rivals to Him? That is the Lord of all realms.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:10: And He made therein firm mountains on top of it, and He blessed it and determined its sustenance in four days, equal, for those who ask.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:11: Then He settledto the heaven while it was smoke, and said to it and to the earth, “Come, willingly or reluctantly.” They said, “We have come willingly.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:12: So He decreed them as seven heavens in two days, and He revealed within each heaven its command. And We adorned the lowestheaven with lamps, and for preservation; that is the determining of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:13: But if they disregard(you) , then say, “I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt of ʻĀdand Thamûd.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:14: Recall when their messengers came to them from before them and from behind them, saying, “Do not worship anyone but Allah.” They said, “Had our Lord willed, He would have sent down angels; therefore, of what you are sent with, we are deniers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:15: So, as for ʻĀd, they turned unjustifiably arrogant in the land andsaid, “Who is more powerful than us?” Had they not seen that Allah, who created them, is more powerful than them? And they used to repudiate Our signs,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:16: so We sent upon them a screaming wind for a few days of unrelenting misfortune, to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the Earlier Life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is surely more disgraceful, and they will not be supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:17: But as for Thamûd, We had guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance. So the thunderbolt of the degrading punishment seized them on account of what they used to earn.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:18: Meanwhile, We delivered those who had attained faith and had been mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:19: And the day when Allah’s enemies are herded into the Fire in an organized manner—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:20: until, when they reach it, their hearing and their sight(s) and their skins testify against them regarding what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:21: And they say to their skins, “Why did you testify against us?” They say, “Allah, Who made everything speak, made us speak.” It is He Who created youthe first time, and to Him you are returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:22: And youwere unable to hide yourselves in a way that neither your hearing nor your sight(s) nor your skins were prevented from testifying against you, and you thought that Allah does not know much of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:23: And it is that thought of yours about yourLord that led you to ruin—so you became of the losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:24: So even if they endure patiently, the Fire is(still) a dwelling for them; and if they ask to make amends, they will not be allowed to amend.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:25: And We assigned for them comrades who then adorned for them what was before them and what was behind them, and the Word came to pass against them among communities of unseen beingsand humans that passed away before them; indeed, they were losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:26: Those who denied said, “Do not listen to this recitationand speak noisily during it so that youmay overcome.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:27: We will certainly make those who have denied taste a severe punishment, and We will certainly repay them for the worst of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:28: Such is the repayment of Allah’s enemies—the Fire; therein for them is the Home of Eternity, a repayment on account of how theyused to repudiate Our signs.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:29: And those who denied said, “Our Lord, show us those two(groups) which misguided us—among unseen beingsand humankind—so that we can trample them both under our feet so they become of the lowest.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:30: Indeed, those who said: “Our Lord is Allah,” and then led a righteous life—the angels descend upon them: “Do not fear and do not grieve, but have glad tidings of the Garden(of Paradise) which you were promised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:31: We are your allies in the Earlier Life and in the Hereafter, and you have therein whatever your(inner) selves desire, and for you therein is whatever you claim,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:32: as hospitality from One Who is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:33: And who is better in speech than one who called to Allah and did righteousness and said, “I am of the Muslims”?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:34: For good and evil are never equal. Repel(evil) with that which is better, and thereupon the one between whom and youis enmity becomes like an intimate ally.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:35: But none receives it except those who were patient, and none receives it except the very fortunate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:36: And if youare ever spurred by a spurring from Satan, take refuge with Allah; indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:37: And of His signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves to the sun nor to the moon, but prostrate yourselves to Allah Who created them, if it is Him that you worship.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:38: But if they act arrogantly, then those in the presence of yourLord highly exalt Him with praise night and day, and never do they tire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:39: And of His signs is that yousee the land still, but when We send down water upon it, it shakes and swells . Indeed, He Who revived it will certainly revive the dead; indeed, He is All-Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:40: Indeed, those who blaspheme Our signs are not hidden from Us. Is one who is cast into the Fire better, or one who comes safely on the Day of Resurrection? Do as you wish; He is All-Seeing of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:41: Indeed, those who denied the Reminder when it came to them . . .—whereas it is indeed a mighty Scripture
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:42: which falsehood cannot approach from before it or behind it—a bestowal from on high by One Who is Wise, Praiseworthy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:43: Nothing is said to youbut was said to the messengers before you. Indeed, yourLord is certainly Possessor of forgiveness and Possessor of painful retribution.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:44: Had We made it a Recitalin a foreign language, they would have said, “If only its signswere detailed.” A foreign language while(the messenger is) an Arab? Say, “For those who have attained faith, it is guidance and healing. But as for those who do not believe—there is deafness in their ears, and it is blindness upon them. Those are being called out from a distant place.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:45: And surely, We brought Moses the Scripture, but it was differed upon. And were it not for a word that had preceded from yourLord, judgment would have been decreed between them. But indeed, they are surely in perplexing doubt concerning it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:46: Whoever acts righteously does so to his own benefit, while whoever commits evil does so to his own detriment. And yourLord is never a tyrant unto the servants.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:47: To Him is referred(all) knowledge of the Hour. And no products come out of their sheathsnor does any female carry or deliverbut with His knowledge. And on the day when He calls out to them, “Where are My associates?” They said, “We declare to You, none of us is a witness.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:48: And whatever they used to call upon earlier strayed away from them, and they realized that there was no escape for them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:49: Man never tires of supplication for good things, but if evil touches him, he becomes despairing, despondent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:50: And if We do let him taste a mercy from Us after an adversity that has touched him, he will surely say, “This is mine, and I do not think that the Hour is coming. And even if I am returned to my Lord, I will have the very best with Him.” We will inform those who denied of what they did, and We will make them taste a harsh punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:51: And when We bestow Our blessings upon Man, he disregards(Us) and distances himself. But when evil touches him, he has lengthy supplication.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:52: Say, “Have youseen? If it is from Allah and then you deny it—who is more misguided than he who is in profound discord?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:53: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and in themselves until it becomes evident to them that Heis the Truth. Is it not sufficient that yourLord is witness over everything?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.41:54: Undoubtedly, they do regard the meeting with their Lord with skepticism. Undoubtedly, He is indeed All-Encompassing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:3: Thus reveals —to youand to those before you—Allah the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:4: ToHim belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the All-High, the Great.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:5: The heavens almost splinter from above them, while the angels exalt their Lord with praise and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Undoubtedly, Allah is indeed the Oft-Forgiving, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:6: And those who take guardians apart from Him—Allah is a Constant Preserver over them, for youare not a trustee over them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:7: And thus We revealed to youan Arabic Recital, that you may warn the Mother of Townsand those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, of which there is no doubt: a group in the Garden(of Paradise) and a group in the Blaze.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:8: And had Allah willed, He could have made them one community, but He enters into His mercy whomever He wills, while the unjust have neither ally nor supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:9: Or have they taken others as guardians apart from Him? Yet Allah is the Ultimate Guardian, and He gives life to the dead, and He is All-Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:10: And whatever matter youdiffer over— its judgment rests with Allah. “Such is Allah, my Lord; in Him I have placed my trust and to Him I turn penitently.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:11: The Originator of the heavens and the earth; He has made for you spouses from among yourselves, and of the animals mates, by means of which He multiplies you. The like of Him has nothing like him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:12: To Him belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whomever He wills and He restrains(it) ; indeed He is All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:13: He legislated for youthe same religion He enjoined upon Noah, and what We revealed to you, and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus: “You shall establish the religion and not be disunited therein.” To the polytheists, outrageous is what you call them to. Allah chooses to Himself whomever He wills, and He guides to Himself whoever is penitent.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:14: And they did not become disunited except after knowledge had come to them, thereby oppressing one another. And were it not for a word that had preceded from yourLord(to defer judgment) to a stated term, judgment would have been decreed between them. And indeed, those who were made to inherit the Scripture after them are in grave doubt about it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:15: So, because of that, goon calling, and be upright as you have been commanded, and do not follow their whims, and say, “I have attained faith in what Allah has sent down in every Scripture, and I have been commanded to judge between you equitably. Allah is our Lord and your Lord; we have our deeds and youhave your deeds; there is no debate between us and you; Allah will bring us together, for to Him is the destiny.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:16: And those who continue to debate about Allah after He has been responded to—their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them falls wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:17: It is Allah who sent down the Scripture with the truth, and the Balance. But what could make yourealize that perhaps the Hour is near?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:18: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten it, but those who have attained faith are apprehensive of it and know it to be the truth. Undoubtedly, those who cast doubts about the Hour are most surely far astray.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:19: Allah is Subtle towards His servants; He provides for whomever He wills, and He is the All-Powerful, the Almighty.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:20: Whoever wants the harvest of the Hereafter—We increase for him his harvest, and whoever wants the harvest of the Earlier(Life) —We give him thereof, yet he has no share of the Hereafter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:21: Or is it that they have associates who have legislated for them as religion that which Allah has not given permission? And were it not for the conclusive decision, it would have been settled between them. For indeed, there is a painful punishment for the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:22: Yousee the unjust apprehensive of what they have earned, and it is sure to befall them. But those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds are in the meadows of the Gardens(of Paradise) . For them is whatever they will in the presence of their Lord; that is what the supreme grace is.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:23: Those are the glad tidings Allah gives to His servants who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds. Say, “I ask of you no reward for it except the genuine love offered among those of kinship.” And whoever scores a good deed, We will increase its goodness for him; indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Ever Thankful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:24: Or do they say, “He has fabricated lies about Allah.” Yet if Allah so willed, He could seal yourheart. But Allah erases falsehood and upholds the truth by His Words; indeed, He is All-Knowing of what lies within the chests.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:25: And it is He who accepts the repentance of His servants, and pardons evil deeds, and knows what youdo ;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:26: and He responds(to) those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds, and He increases them of His grace. But for the deniers is a severe punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:27: And if Allah were to extend provision for His servants, they would oppress(others) on earth. Rather, He bestows from on highin precise measure whatever He wills; indeed, regarding His servants, He is All-Aware, All-Seeing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:28: And it is He who bestows rain from on high,after they have despaired, and unfolds His mercy, and it is He Who is the Ultimate Guardian, the Praiseworthy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:29: And of His signs are the creation of the heavens and the earth and the treading creatures He has spread throughout them, for He is All-Able to gather them at will.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:30: And whatever disaster befalls you—it is because of what your hands have earned, yet He pardons much.
