Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:31: And youcannot thwart(God) on earth, and apart from Allah you have neither ally nor supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:32: And of His signs are the ships sailing the sea like flags.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:33: If He wills, He can still the wind , leaving them motionless on its surface; indeed, in that are signs for everyone who is most patient, constantly thankful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:34: Or He can wreck them on account of what they have earned, yet He pardons much—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:35: so that those who dispute Our signs may know that there is no escape for them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:36: So whatever you are given of anything is only an enjoyment of the Earlier Life, but what Allah has is better and more lasting for those who have attained faith and in their Lord they have placed their trust;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:37: and those who avoid the gravest of sinsand obscenities, and if they feel wrathful, they(then) forgive;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:38: and those who responded to their Lord and established the prayer, and whose affairs are conducted by mutual consultation, and of what Wehave provided them they spend;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:39: and those who, when oppression befalls them, defend themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:40: And the repayment of an evil deed is an evil deed equivalent to it. But whoever has pardoned and made reconciliation—his reward lies with Allah; indeed, He does not love the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:41: And for one who has defended himself after being dealt with unjustly—on thosethere is no blame.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:42: Rather, blame lies on those who do injustice to mankind and commit unjustified aggression in the land; for those is a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:43: But whoever has endured patiently and has forgiven—that is certainly a sign of real resolve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:44: And whoever Allah misguides has no guardian apart from Him. And yousee the unjust when they have seen the punishment, saying, “Is there a way of going back?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:45: And yousee them exposed to it, reverent with humility, looking with a stealthy glance. And those who had attained faith said, “Indeed, the losers are those who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection.” Undoubtedly, the unjust are indeed in a lasting punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:46: And they had no allies to support them against Allah. And whomever Allah misguides has no way out.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:47: Respond to yourLord before there comes from Allah a day that cannot be turned back. You will have neither refuge on that day, nor possibility of denial.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:48: But if they disregard(you) —We have not sent youas a constant preserver over them; your only duty is proclamation. And indeed, whenever We let man taste a mercy from Us, he rejoices in it. But when something evil befalls them as a consequence of what their hands have put forth, then man is indeed a staunch denier.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:49: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates whatever He wills. He grants females to whomever He wills, and He grants males to whomever He wills.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:50: Or He pairs them, males and females, and He makes whomever He wills barren; indeed, He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:51: And it is not for any human that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a veil or by sending a messenger to reveal by His permission whatever He wills; indeed, He is All-High, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:52: And thus have We revealed a spirit to youby Our command. Youdid not know what the Scripture was nor what faith was, but We made it a light with which We guide whomever We will of Our servants. And most surely, you guide to a straight path—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.42:53: the path of Allah to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. Undoubtedly, to Allah are destined all commands.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:3: indeed, We made it an Arabic Recital, that youmay reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:4: And indeed, it is with Us in the Source of Scriptures, all-high, all-wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:5: So shall We ignore reminding you, for having been an extremist people?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:6: And how many a prophet did We send to the ancients!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:7: Yet not a prophet came to them but that they used to ridicule him.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:8: Thus We annihilated people more powerful than them, and so the example of the ancients has passed away.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:9: And were youto ask them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They would say, “The Almighty, the All-Knowing created them.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:10: He Who made the earth a cradle for youand traced in it ways for you, that you may be guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:11: And He Who sent down water from the sky in due proportion, whereby We revived a lifeless land; thus youare brought out .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:12: And He Who created all pairs and provided youwith ships and livestock on which you ride,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:13: that youmay mount their backs then remember the blessing of your Lord as you settle upon them and say, “Highly Exalted is the One Who has subjected this to us, and in no way could we have done it by ourselves,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:14: and indeed to our Lord we are certainly returning.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:15: Yet they ascribed to Him a portion of His servants. Surely, man is indeed an evidently staunch denier.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:16: Or has He chosen for Himself daughters from what He creates, and favored youwith sons?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:17: Yet when one of them is given glad tidingsof what he ascribed to the All-Merciful, his face becomes dark as he suppresses his anguish,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:18: (thinking) “What! Someone brought up amid adornments and, in conflict, cannot be evident?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:19: And they considered the angels, who are servants ofthe All-Merciful, to be females. Did they witness their creation? Their claim will be recorded and they will be asked.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:20: And they said, “Had the All-Merciful willed, we would not have worshiped them.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are merely conjecturing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:21: Or have We brought them a scripture prior to this one, so that they are adhering to it?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:22: Rather, they said, “Indeed, we found our forefathers on a course, and indeed we are being guided in their footsteps.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:23: Likewise, We sentno warner before youto any town but its affluent ones said, “Indeed, we found our forefathers on a course, and indeed we are following in their footsteps.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:24: He would say , “Even if I have come to youwith better guidance than what you found your forefathers following?” They would say, “Indeed, we deny what youare sent with.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:25: Thus We took retribution on them, so lookat what the outcome was for the disbelievers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:26: And recall when Abraham said to his father and his people, “I am innocent of what you worship
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:27: except for the One Who originated me, for He will guide me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:28: And he made it an enduring word in his posterity, so that they may return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:29: Yet I let these and their forefathers enjoy(life) until the truth and an evident messenger came to them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:30: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is sorcery, and indeed we are deniers of it.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:31: They also said, “If only this Recitalhad been sent down to any great man from the two towns.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:32: Is it they who allocate the mercy of yourLord? It is We who have allocated their livelihood in the Earlier Life. And We elevated some of them by degrees above others, that some of them may employ one another in service. But your Lord’s mercy is better than what they hoard.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:33: Were it not that humanity would become a single(ungodly) community, We would have provided those who deny the All-Merciful with roofs of silver to their houses, and stairways(of silver) by which they ascend,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:34: and doors(of silver) to their houses, and furnishings on which they recline,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:35: and(golden) decorations. Yet all that is nothing butthe enjoyment of the Earlier Life, whereas the Hereafter with yourLord is for the ones who are mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:36: And whoever shuns the remembrance of the All-Merciful, We assign for him a Satan who then becomes his comrade.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:37: And indeed, they certainly bar them from the way, though they think they are guided.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:38: Until, when he comes to Us, he says, “If only there were between me and youthe distance of the two easts.” What a miserable comrade!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:39: Yet never will it benefit youon that day, since you have committed injustices, that you are partners in the punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:40: Can youmake the deaf hear, or guide the blind and one who has been in evident misguidance?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:41: So We will either take youaway, then surely wreak vengeance upon them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:42: or We will surely show you what We have promised them, for indeed We have absolute power over them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:43: So adhereto what has been revealed to you; indeed you are upon a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:44: And indeed it is surely a message for youand for your people, and youwill be asked.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:45: And ask those of Our messengers We sent before you: “Did We appoint gods apart from the All-Merciful to be worshiped?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:46: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, so He said, “Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of all realms.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:47: Yet, as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they promptly started laughing at them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:48: even though each sign We showed them was more supreme than its counterpart, and We took hold of them with the punishment, that possibly they would return.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:49: And they said(to Moses) , “O sorcerer, pray to your Lord for us according to His covenant with you, and then we will surely be guided.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:50: But when We lifted the punishment from them, they promptly broke their promise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:51: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, “O my people, do I not have the dominion over Egypt, and are these rivers not flowing beneath me? Do you not see?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:52: Or am I not better than this one who is despicable and can barely express himself?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:53: So, if only some bracelets of gold had been cast on him, or if angels had come with him in comradeship!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:54: Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him; indeed they were a defiantly disobedient people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:55: So when they displeased Us, We took vengeance on them and We drowned them all.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:56: So We made them aprecedent and an example for later people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:57: And when the son of Mary was set forth as an example, yourpeople promptly clapped him
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:58: and said, “Are our gods better, or he?” They cited him only for argument; in fact, they are a quarrelsome people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:59: He is but a servant whom We blessed, and We made him an example for the children of Israel.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:60: And had We willed, We would have made from among youangels to be successors on earth.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:61: And indeed heis a portent of the Hour, so never beskeptical about it and follow Me; this is a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:62: And let not Satan bar you; indeed, he is an evident enemy to you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:63: And when Jesus came with the evident proofs, he said, “I have come to youwith wisdom, and to clarify for you some of what you differ over, so be mindful of Allah and obey me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:64: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him; this is a straight path.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:65: But the parties differed among themselves, so woe to those who committed injustices from the punishment of a painful day.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:66: Are they only waiting for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:67: On that day, close friends will be enemies to one another, except for the ones who were mindful(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:68: O My servants, no fear shall be upon you today, nor shall you grieve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:69: Those who believed in Our signsand were Muslims:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:70: enter the Garden(of Paradise) , you and your spouses, filled up with joy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:71: They are served around with trays of gold and cups, and therein is whatever is desired by the selvesand delights the eyes, and therein youabide.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:72: And that is the Garden(of Paradise) youwere madeto inherit on account of what you used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:73: For youtherein is abundant fruit from which you eat.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:74: Indeed, the criminals abide in the punishment of Hell
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:75: which is never palliated for them, and in it they are devastated.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:76: Yet in no way did We do them injustice, but it was they who were the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:77: And they cried, “O Malek, let your Lord finish us off.” He said, “You are staying.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:78: We certainly came to you with the truth, but most of youare hateful of the truth.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:79: Or have they contrived to do something? So indeed, We too are contriving.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:80: Or do they think that We cannot hear their secret and their private conversations? Yes indeed, Our messengers are by them, writing down.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:81: Say, “If the All-Merciful had a child , I would be the first of(his) worshipers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:82: Highly Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, beyond what they describe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:83: So leavethem to blunder and play until they meet their day which they are promised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:84: And it is He who in the heaven is God, and in the earth is God, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:85: And supremely blessed be the One to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and Who alone has knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom youare returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:86: And those they call upon apart from Him are incapable of intercession, except those who testify to the truth knowingly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:87: And surely if you asked them, “Who created them?” they would certainly say, “Allah.” So how can they be averted(from the truth) ?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:88: And(God hears) hisstatement: “My Lord, indeed, these are people who do not believe.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.43:89: Then grantthem amnesty and say, “Peace.” For they shall come to know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:3: We have indeed sent it down on a blessed night. Indeed, We have always been warning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:4: Onit, every wise command is distinguished—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:5: a command from Us; indeed, We have always been sending
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:6: mercy from yourLord—indeed, it is He who is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:7: (from the) Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, if you(can ever) believe with certitude.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:8: There is no god but He; He gives life and causes death—yourLord and the Lord of your ancient fathers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:9: Yet they play around in doubt.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:10: So waitand watch out for the day when the sky produces evident smoke
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:11: that overwhelms mankind; this is a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:12: “Our Lord, lift the punishment from us; we are truly believers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:13: But how can the reminding benefit them when an evident messenger had already come to them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:14: then they turned away from him and said, “(He is) taught(by others) , a madman!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:15: Indeed, if We lift off the punishment a little, youwill revert.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:16: On the day when We assault with the biggest onslaught, We will indeed wreak vengeance upon them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:17: And surely before them We tested the people of Pharaoh when a noble messengercame to them,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:18: saying, “Hand over Allah’s servants to me; indeed, I am to youa trustworthy messenger.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:19: And do not consider yourselves to be above Allah; indeed, I come to you with an evident manifestation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:20: And I have indeed sought refuge with my Lord and yourLord lest you stone me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:21: Thus if youdo not believe in me, just keep away from me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:22: Then he called upon his Lord—that these people are criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:23: (Then His Lord commanded,) “Journey with My servants by night; indeed, youwill be followed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:24: And leavethe sea parted(behind you) ; indeed, they are an army to be drowned.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:25: How many gardens and springs did they leave behind,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:26: as well as vegetation(s) and a noble domicile
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:27: and a blessing they used to enjoy?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:28: So it was. And We made another people inherit it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:29: So neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor were they reprieved.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:30: And surely, We delivered the Children of Israel from the demeaning punishment—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:31: from Pharaoh; indeed, he was of the extremists.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:32: And We chose them knowingly over all communities,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:33: and gave them of the signs that which was an evident test.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:35: “There is nothing but our first death, for we will not be resurrected.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:36: So bringback our forefathers, if you are truthful!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:37: Are they better, or the people of Tubbaʻand those before them? We annihilated them; indeed, they were criminals.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:38: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them to play.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:39: We did not create them except with truth, but most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:40: Indeed, the Day of Decision is the appointed time for them all—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:41: a day when no patron will avail a protégé in any way, and they cannot be supported,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:42: except for one upon whom Allah has hadmercy; indeed, He is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:44: is the food of the sinful one,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:45: like molten brass boiling in the bellies
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:46: like the boiling of scalding water.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:47: “Takehim and drag him into the midst of Hell,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:48: then pour over his head some of the punishment of scalding water!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:49: “Taste! You —indeed you—are the mighty, the noble.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:50: Indeed, this is what youwereskeptical about.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:51: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are in a safe domicile,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:53: dressed in silk and brocade, facing one another.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:54: So it is. And We marriedthem to spouses with lovely wide eyes.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:55: They call therein for every kind of fruit, feeling safe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:56: Therein they do not taste death beyond the first death, and Heshielded them from the punishment of Hell—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:57: a grace from yourLord; that is the great triumph.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:58: Thus have We made iteasy through yourtongue, that they may remind themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.44:59: So wait and watch. Indeed, they too are waiting and watching.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:2: The bestowal of the Scripture from on high is by Allah the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:3: Indeed, in the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:4: And in yourown creation, and in the treading creatures He scatters, are signs for people who believe with certitude.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:5: And the alternation of night and day, and the provision Allah has sent down from the sky, with which He has revived the earth after its death, and the shifting of the winds are signs for people who reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:6: Those are Allah’s signswhich We read to youin truth. So in which discourse, after Allah and His signs, will they believe?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:8: who hears Allah’s signsbeing read to him, yet he persists arrogantly, as though he did not hear them. So givehim glad tidingsof a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:9: And when he learns something of Our signs, he takes them in mockery; for thoseis a demeaning punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:10: Beyond them lies Hell, and what they have earned will not benefit them at all, nor will those whom they took as guardians apart from Allah, and for them is a great punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:11: This is guidance, but those who have denied their Lord’s signs—for them is a painful punishment of torment .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:12: Allah is the One Who has subjected to youthe sea, that ships may run in it by His Command, and that you may seek of His grace, and that you may give thanks.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:13: And He has subjected to youwhatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth—all is from Him. Indeed, in that are signs for people who reflect.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:14: Tellthose who have attained faith to forgive those who do not expect the Days of Allah, that He may repay peoplefor what they used to earn.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:15: Whoever acts righteously does so to his own benefit, while whoever commits evil does so to his own detriment, then to yourLord you are returned .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:16: And surely We had given the Children of Israel the Scripture and wise judgment and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and favored them above all communities
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:17: and gave them evident explanations regarding matters. Thus they differed not except after knowledge had come to them, thereby oppressing one another. Indeed, yourLord judges between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding whatever they used to differ over.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:18: Then We set youupon a(path of) legislation regarding matters, so follow it and do not follow the whims of those who do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:19: Indeed, they will never avail youagainst Allah in any way, for indeed, the unjust are guardians of one another, while Allah is the Ultimate Guardian of the ones mindful(of Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:20: This provides insights for mankind, and guidance and mercy for people who believe with certitude.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:21: Or do those who have perpetrated evil deeds assume that We will make them asequal to those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds, whether in their life or their death? Miserableis their judgment!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:22: And Allah created the heavens and the earth with truth, and so that every soul will be repaid for what it has earned, for they will not be dealt with unjustly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:23: Have youseen the one who has taken his own whim as his god, and Allah has misguided him despite his knowledge, and has sealed his hearing and his heart, and has placed a veil over his sight? Who will guide him after Allah? Will you not remind yourselves?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:24: And they said, “There is nothing but our Earlier Life; we die and we live, for nothing annihilates us except time.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are only guessing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:25: And when Our signsare recited to them, evident, their only argument is to say, “Bring back our forefathers, if youare truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:26: Say, “Allah gives you life, then He makes you die, then He gathers you for the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt; but most of mankind does not know.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:27: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Thus on the day when the Hour takes place—on that day the advocates of falsehood lose.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:28: And yousee every community kneeling; every community iscalled to its Scripture: “Today youare being repaid for what you used to do:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:29: here is Our Scripture speaking about youin truth. Surely, We have been transcribing what youhave been doing.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:30: As for those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—their Lord enters them into His mercy; that is the evident triumph.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:31: But as for those who have denied(it will be said to them) : “Were My signs not read to you, yet you acted arrogantly and were a criminal people?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:32: And when it is said, “Indeed, the promise of Allah is true”—while of the Hour there is no doubt—yousay, “We do not know what the Hour is; we are only making a guess; we are not certain.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:33: And the evils of what they had done became evident to them, and they became surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:34: And it was said, “Today We forget youas you forgot the meeting of this day of yours. Thus your shelter is the Fire, and there are no helpers for you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:35: That is because youdealt with Allah’s signswith ridicule, and the Earlier Life deceived you.” So today they are not brought outof it, and they are not allowed to make amends.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:36: So praise be to Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all realms.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.45:37: And to Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth, for He is the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:2: The bestowal of the Scripture from on high is by Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:3: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what lies between them except in accordance with truth and for a stated term. But the deniers continue to disregard the warnings which they have received.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:4: Say, “Have youseen what you call upon apart from Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth, or do they own a share of the heavens? Bring me a scripture prior to this one, or some trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:5: And who is more misguided than one who calls upon, apart from Allah, those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection and who are oblivious to their invocation?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:6: And when mankind is herded, those(false gods) become enemies to them and deny their worship of them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:7: And when Our signsare read to them, evident, those who deny say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is evident sorcery.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:8: Or do they say, “He has fabricated it!” Say, “If I have fabricated it myself, there is nothing youcan do to protect me from Allah. He knows better what you are engaged in; sufficient is He as a witness between me and you, and He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Bestower of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:9: Say, “I am not different from the other messengers, and I do not know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow what is revealed to me, and I am only an evident warner.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:10: Say, “Have youseen: if it is truly from Allah and you deny it? And a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to its like and has attained faith, while you have acted arrogantly. Indeed, Allah does not guide the unjust people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:11: Those who denied said of those who had attained faith, “If it were anything good, they would not have preceded us to it.” And since they were not guided by it, they will say, “This is an ancient lie.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:12: And before it was the Scripture of Moses, a guide and a mercy. And this is a confirming Scripture in the Arabic tongue, that it may warn those who have done injustice, and as glad tidings for those who excel in doing good.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:13: Indeed, those who said, “Our Lord is Allah,” then led a righteous life—no fear shall be upon them, nor shall they grieve;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:14: those are the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) , abiding therein—a repayment on account of what they used to do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:15: And We have enjoined upon man excelling in showing kindness to his parents; his mother carried him with difficulty and delivered him with difficulty; his carriage and weaning are thirty months. Until, when he has attained his full strength and has reached forty years, he says, “Lord, enable me to appreciate the blessings with which You have blessed me and my parents, and to do righteousness that well pleases You, and grant me righteousness in my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed I am of the Muslims.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:16: Those are the ones from whom We accept the best of what they have done and whose misdeeds We overlook ;(they are) among the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) —the promise of truth which they had been promised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:17: As for the one who said to his parents, “Fie on both of you! Are you promising me that I will be brought out when generations have passed away before me?” Meanwhile, they both cry for Allah’s help, “Woe to you, believe! The promise of Allah is true!” But he says, “These are nothing but legends of the ancients.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:18: Those are the ones upon whom the sentence is justified, among the communities that have passed away before them of unseen beingsand humans; they were indeed losers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:19: And for all, there are degrees according to what they have done, and that He may render to them in full(the reward) for their deeds, and they will not be dealt with unjustly.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:20: And on the day when those who denied the truth are paraded before the Fire: “Youhave squandered your good things in your Earlier Life and you enjoyed them. So today you are being repaid with the punishment of shame on account of your unjustifiable arrogance on earth, and on account of how you used to defiantly disobey.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:21: And recall the brother of ʻĀdwhen he warned his people at the dunes—and warnings had passed away before him and after him: “Worship none but Allah; I fear for youthe punishment of a great day.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:22: They said, “Have youcome to us to divert us from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you are of the truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:23: He said, “Indeed, all knowledge is only with Allah, and I proclaim to youwhat I have been sent with, but I see you are an ignorant people.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:24: Then, when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, “This is a cloud that will bring us rain.” “Rather, it is what yousought to hasten: a wind in which is painful punishment,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:25: destroying everything by the command of its Lord.” And when the morning came upon them, nothing could be seen except their residences. Thus We repay the criminal people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:26: And surely We had empowered them in the same way as We empowered youand We gave them hearing, and sight(s) , and burning hearts. But neither their hearing, nor their sight(s) , nor their burning hearts availed them in any way. That is because they used to repudiate the signsof Allah, and so they became surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:27: And most surely We have annihilated many towns around youand diversified the signs, that they may return(to the truth) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:28: Why then did those whom they worshiped as means of nearness to Allah not support them? Rather, they abandonedthem. It was their lie, a fabrication of their own making.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:29: And recall when We dispatched towards youseveral unseen beingsto listen to the Recital. When they came in its presence, they said, “Listenquietly!” Then, when it was concluded, they turned to their people, forewarning them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:30: They said, “O our people, we have heard a Scripture, sent down after Moses, confirming what came before it. It guides to the truth and to a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:31: O our people, respond to the caller to Allah and believe in Him, and He will forgive you your misdeeds and grant you protection from a painful punishment.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:32: And he who does not respond to the caller to Allah cannot incapacitate(God) on earth and has no protectors apart from Him; those are in evident misguidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:33: Have they not seen that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and was never tired by creating them, is capable ofreviving the dead? Yes indeed; He is indeed powerful over all things.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:34: And on the day when those who denied are presented to the Fire: “Is this not real?” They said, “Yes, indeed, by our Lord.” He said, “Then taste the punishment on account of how youused to deny.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.46:35: So bepatient, as the messengers with resolve were patient, and do not be hasty regarding them. On the day when they witness what they are promised, it will seem as if they had lasted for only an hour of a day. A proclamation: will any be annihilated except the defiantly disobedient people?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:1: Those who denied and barred(others) from the way of Allah—He made their deeds go to waste.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:2: And those who attained faith and did righteous deeds, and attained faith in what was sent down to Muhammad—and it is the truth from their Lord—He remitted their evil deeds and set aright their state of mind.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:3: That is because those who denied followed falsehood, while those who attained faith followed the truth from their Lord. Allah thus sets forth for mankind their examples.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:4: Thus, when youencounter those who have denied, strike at their necks. Then when you have subjugated them, bind them firmly. Then either release them by grace or by ransom until war lays down its burdens. Had Allah willed, He could have defeated them Himself, but He thus tests some of you by means of others. As for those who were killed in the way of Allah, He will not let their deeds go to waste.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:5: He will guide them and set aright their state of mind
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:6: and will enter them into the Garden(of Paradise) —He has identified it for them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:7: O you who have attained faith, if you support Allah, He will support you and strengthen your foothold.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:8: But as for those who denied, for them is perdition, and He made their deeds go to waste.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:9: That is because they hated what Allah had sent down, so He nullified their deeds.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:10: Have they not journeyed through the earth and looked at what the outcome was for those before them? Allah poured destruction upon them. For for the deniers there is something comparable.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:11: That is because Allah is the Patron of those who have attained faith, while the deniers have no Patron.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:12: Indeed, Allah enters those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow. And those who have denied enjoy themselves and eat as cattle eat, but the Fire is a dwelling for them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:13: And how many a town was more powerful than your townwhich evicted you? We annihilated them, and there was no helper for them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:14: Is someone who relies on evident proof from his Lord like someone the evil of whose work was adorned for him? And theyfollowed their own whims.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:15: The likeness of the Garden(of Paradise) that the mindful(of God) have been promised: rivers of water, notstaling; and rivers of milk whose taste has not changed; and rivers of wine, a delight for those who drink; and rivers of honey, clarified and pure. And they have therein of all products and forgiveness from their Lord.(How can this be) compared to the fate of those abiding in the Fire and were given, for drink, scalding water, so that it tore their bowels?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:16: And among them is one who listens to you, but when theydepart from your presence, they say to those given knowledge, “What did he say just now?” Those are the ones whose hearts Allah has sealed, and they followed their own whims.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:17: But as for those who wanted guidance, He has increased them in guidance and has brought them their mindfulness(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:18: So are they but waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? In fact, its tokens have already come. But how will they be reminded when it has come to them?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:19: So knowthat there is no god but Allah, and ask forgiveness for your misdeed, and for believing men and believing women. For Allah knows your moving about and your dwelling.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:20: And those who have attained faith say, “If only a surahwas sent down.” Yet when a decisive surah is sent down and combat is mentioned in it, yousee those in whose hearts is sickness looking at you with the look of someone fainting at death. Yet worthier of them would be
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:21: obedience and upright speech. Then, when the matter is settled, had they been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:22: Would youthen, in case you became in charge , spread corruption in the earth and sever your family ties?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:23: Those are the ones whom Allah has cursed, so He made them deaf and blinded their sight(s) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:24: Will they not ponder the Recital, or are there locks upon their hearts?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:25: Indeed, those who turned on their heels after guidance became evident to them—Satan has enticed themand has filled themwith false hopes.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:26: That is because they said to those who hated what Allah had bestowed from on high, “We will obey you in certain matters.” But Allah knows their secret exchanges .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:27: How will it be when the angels take them at death, beating their faces and their backs?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:28: That is because they followed what angered Allah, and they disliked His good pleasure, so He nullified their deeds.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:29: Or did those in whose hearts is sickness think that Allah would not bring out(to the open) their malice?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:30: Had We willed, We could have shown them to you, and you would have recognized them by their marks. Yet you will recognize them by their tone of speech, and Allah knows all yourdeeds.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:31: And We will certainly test youuntil We knowthose of you who strive and those who are steadfastly patient, and(until We) test your reactions.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:32: Indeed, those who denied and barred(others) from the way of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them—they will not harm Allah at all, but He will nullify their deeds.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:33: O you who have attained faith, obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not let your deeds go to waste.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:34: Indeed, those who denied and barred(others) from the way of Allah and then died as deniers—Allah will not forgive them.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:35: So do not waver and call for peace while youhave the upper hand; Allah is with you and He will not divest you of your deeds.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:36: Indeed, the Earlier Life is nothing but a game and a distraction. But if youattain faith and are mindful(of God) , He will grant you your rewards, and He will not ask you for your possessions.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:37: Were He to ask youfor it and press you, you would become miserly, and He would bring out(to the open) your malice.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.47:38: Here youare, being called to spend in the way of Allah. Among you are those who become miserly, but whoever becomes miserly, becomes miserly only against himself. And Allah is the Self-Sufficient, while you are the needy. And if you turn away(from Him) , He will replace you with another people, then they will not be like you.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:1: Indeed, We haveunlocked for youan evident conquest,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:2: that Allah may forgive you what has passed of your misdeeds and what is yet to come, and complete His blessing upon you and guide you to a straight path
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:3: and support you with mighty support.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:4: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers, to add faith to their faith, for to Allah belong the troops of the heavens and the earth, and Allah has always been All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:5: So asto enter believing men and believing women into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein, and to remit their evil deeds. And that, with Allah, has always been a great triumph.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:6: And to punish hypocritical men and hypocritical women and idolatrous men and idolatrous women—those who harbor evil thoughts about Allah; they are encircled by evil, and Allah’s wrath is upon them and has cursed them and has prepared for them Hell, and what an evil destiny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:7: For to Allah belong the troops of the heavens and the earth, and Allah has always been Almighty, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:8: Indeed, We have sent youas a witness and a bearer of glad tidings and a warner,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:9: that youmay believe in Allah and His Messenger, and rally to Him and honor Him and highly exalt Him morning and evening.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:10: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to youare actually pledging allegiance to Allah: the hand of Allah is over their hands. So whoever reneges in fact reneges to his own detriment. And whoever fulfills what he has covenanted with Allah, then He will grant hima great reward.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:11: The nomadic Arabs who lagged behind will say to you, “Our belongings and our families have preoccupied us, so ask forgiveness for us.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, “Who can avail you anything against Allah if He desires harm for you or desires benefit for you?” In fact, Allah has always been All-Aware of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:12: But youthought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, and that was adorned in your hearts. And you harbored evil thoughts, for you have always been a worthless people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:13: And whoever has not believed in Allah and His Messenger— We have prepared for the deniers a Blaze.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:14: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He forgives whomever He wills, and He punishes whomever He wills, for Allah has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:15: Those who lagged behind will say when youdepart to collect the gains, “Let us follow you.” They want to change the Speech of Allah. Say, “You will not follow us; Allah has said so before.” Then they will say, “Rather, youenvy us.” In fact, they have not comprehended except a little.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:16: Sayto the nomadic Arabs who lagged behind, “You will be called against a people of intense force to combat them, unless they surrender. So if you obey, Allah will give you an excellent reward. But if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:17: There is no blame on the blind, nor any blame on the lame, nor any blame on the sick. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger—He will enter himinto Gardens beneath which rivers flow. But whoever turns away—Hewill punish himwith a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:18: Surely, Allah was well pleased with the believers as they pledged allegiance to youunder the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:19: and a multitude of gainsfor them to capture. For Allah has always been Almighty, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:20: Allah has promised youa multitude of gainsto capture, so He has expedited this for you and has restrained people’s hands from you, that it may be a sign to the believers, and to guide you to a straight path.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:21: And other(war booty) of which youwere incapable(of capturing) , but Allah has encompassed it, and Allah has always been Powerful over everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:22: And if those who have denied had combated you, they would have turned their backs, then they would find neither ally nor supporter.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:23: Such has been Allah’s rule that has passed on before, for youwill never find any change in Allah’s rule.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:24: And it is He who withheld their hands from youand your hands from them in the valley of Makkah after giving you advantage over them, for Allah has always been All-Seeing of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:25: It is they who have denied, and barred youfrom the Inviolable Mosque, and prevented the offering from reaching its destination. And were it not for(the presence among them of) some faithful men and some faithful women whom you did not know of and whom you would have hurt, thus incurring dishonor unknowingly on their account . . .—that Allah may enter into His mercy whomever He wills. If they had been apart, We would have punished those of them who denied with a painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:26: Those who denied filled their hearts with chauvinism—the chauvinism of paganignorance. But Allah sent His tranquility down upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of mindfulness(of God) of which they were most worthy and deserving, for Allah has always been All-Knowing of everything.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:27: Surely, Allah has fulfilled His Messenger’s vision in truth: “Youwill surely enter the Inviolable Mosque by the will of Allah in security, heads shaven or hair cut short, not fearing anything. Yet He knew what you did not know and so set up for you, apart from that, a near conquest.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:28: It is He who sent His Messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth to make it prevail over all religions, for Allah suffices as Witness.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.48:29: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and those with him are stern against the deniers, merciful to one another; yousee them kneeling, prostrating, seeking grace from Allah and(His) good pleasure; their marks are on their faces from the effect of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah and their description in the Gospel: like vegetation that sprouted, then became strong, then grew thick, then rested on its stem, impressing the farmers. Through them He enrages the deniers. Allah has promised those of them who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds forgiveness and a great reward.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:1: O you who have attained faith, do not proceed ahead of Allah and His Messenger, and be mindful of Allah; indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:2: O you who have attained faith, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and do not speak loudly to him as you speak loudly to one another, lest your deeds be nullified while you are unaware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:3: Indeed, those who lower their voices before Allah’s Messenger—those are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for mindfulness(of Him) ; for them is forgiveness and a great reward.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:4: Indeed, those who call youfrom behind the chambers—most of them do not reason.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:5: Had they remained patient until youcame out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:6: O you who have attained faith, if an ungodly person brings you any news, investigate (the matter) , lest you harm a people out of ignorance and thus become regretful for what you have done.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:7: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah; if he were to obey you in many matters, you would suffer hardship. But Allah has endeared faith to you and adorned it in your hearts and made denial and ungodliness and rebellion hateful to you; those are the prudent ones.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:8: A grace from Allah and a blessing, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:9: And if two factions of believers fall to fighting each other, reconcilebetween them. But if one group oppresses the other, then combat the one which oppresses until it complies with the command of Allah. But once it has complied, reconcile between them with justice and be equitable; indeed, Allah loves the equitable.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:10: Indeed, all the believers are but brothers, so reconcile between yourtwo brothers and be mindful of Allah, that you may receive mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:11: O you who have attained faith, no people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than them. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than them. Nor shall you defame yourselves, nor shall you insult one another by nicknames. What a miserable label ungodliness is after attaining faith! And whoever has not repented—then thoseare the unjust.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:12: O you who have attained faith, avoid making too many assumptions—indeed, some assumptions are sinful. And do not spy on one another nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would detest it. So be mindful of Allah; indeed, Allah is Granting and Accepting of repentance, Bestowing of mercy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:13: O mankind, We have created you from a male and a female and made you into races and tribes, that you may know one another; indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah are the most mindful(of Him) among you; indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:14: The nomadic Arabs said, “We have attained faith.” Say, “You have not attained faith; rather say, ‘We have become Muslims,’ for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not diminish any of your deeds; indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:15: The believers are those who have attained faith in Allah and His Messenger, and then have not doubted and have striven with their wealth and their lives in the way of Allah; those are the truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:16: Say, “Are yougoing to teach Allah about your religion, when Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, for Allah is All-Knowing of everything?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:17: They keep reminding youof the favor they did you by becoming Muslims. Say, “Do not consider your submission(to Allah) a favor to me; it is Allah who does you a favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are truthful.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.49:18: Allah knows the hidden realm of the heavens and the earth, for Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:2: But they marveled that a forewarner had come to them from among them, so the deniers said, “How strange!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:3: Can it be that when we have died and become dust . . .? This is a far-fetched return.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:4: We have already known what the earth consumes of them, and with Us is a constantly preserving record.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:5: But they rejected the truth when it came to them, so they are in a state of confusion.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:6: Have they not looked at the sky above them—how We constructed it and decoratedit and how it has no fractures?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:7: And the earth—how We spread it out and set on it firm mountains and germinated therein all kinds of lovely plants,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:8: an eye-opener and a reminder for every penitent servant?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:9: And We brought down from the sky blessed water and germinated with it gardens and grain to harvest,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:10: and the soaring palm trees with clustered dates—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:11: provision for the servants. And We revived thereby a lifeless land; likewise is the emergence.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:12: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved, and(so did) the fellows of Al-Russ and Thamûd
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:13: and ʻĀd and Pharaoh and the brethren of Lot
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:14: and the fellows of the Thicket and the people of Tubbaʻ; they all disbelieved the messengers, so My threat came true.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:15: Were We fatigued by the first creation? Rather, they are in doubt of a new creation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:16: And surely We created man and know what his(inner) self whispers to him, for We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:17: As the two receptorsreceive(him) , one on the right and one on the left, constantly seated.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:18: Not a word does he utter, but close to him is a watcher, constantly ready.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:19: Then came the daze of death with the truth: “That is what youwere trying to avoid.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:20: And the Trumpet was blown: “That is the Day of the Threat.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:21: And every soul came forward, accompanied by a driver and a witness.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:22: “Indeed, youwere oblivious to this, so We removed your veil and your sight today is(as sharp as) iron.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:23: And His comradesaid, “This is what I have ready with me.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:24: “Castinto Hell, every stubborn relentless denier,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:26: who has set up another deity with Allah. So casthim into the severe punishment.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:27: His comrade said, “Our Lord, I did not make him exceed all limits, but he was in extreme misguidance.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:28: He said, “Do not dispute in My presence, for I have warned youin advance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:29: The decree from Me cannot be changed, and I am not a tyrant unto the servants.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:30: On the day when We say to Hell, “Are you full?” And it says, “Are there any more?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:31: And the Garden(of Paradise) was brought closer to those mindful(of God) , not far away.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:32: This is what youare promised —for every constant preserver who often turns to God,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:33: the one who inwardly feared the All-Merciful and came with a penitent heart.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:34: “Enterit in peace; that is the Day of Eternity.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:35: Therein they have whatever they desire, and We have even more.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:36: And how many generations before them who were more powerful than they did We destroy! And they explored the lands—was there any escape?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:37: Indeed, in that is a reminder for whoever possesses a heart or cares to listen and witness.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:38: And surely We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and never were We touched by any fatigue.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:39: So endurewhat they say, and highly exalt your Lord with praise before the rising of the sun and before sunset.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:40: And highly exaltHim with praise in the night and after prostrations.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:41: And listenon the day when the caller calls from a nearby place.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:42: The day when they hear the Shout in all truth; that is the Day of Emergence.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:43: Indeed, We—We alone—give life and cause death, and to Us is the destiny.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:44: The day the earth ruptures open from above them, letting them rush out; that is an easy exodus for Us.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.50:45: We know better what they say, and youare not a compeller over them, so remind by the Recitalwhoever fears My warning.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:2: and by those bearers of loads,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:4: and by those distributing as commanded—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:5: what youare promised is true.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:6: And, indeed, the Recompense is sure to come.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:7: By the heaven comprising interwoven tracks,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:8: indeed, youare of different opinions.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:9: Averted from it is he who is averted.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:11: Those who are unmindful and in perplexity,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:12: asking, “When is the Day of Recompense?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:13: The day they are heated on the Fire:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:14: “Taste your trial; this is what you,(challengingly) have been asking to be hastened.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:15: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are amidst Gardens(of Paradise) and springs,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:16: taking what their Lord has given them. Indeed, before that, they used to excel in doing good:
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:17: they used to lie down but little of the night,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:18: and at dawn they would seek forgiveness,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:19: and in their wealth was a share for the asker and the deprived.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:20: And on earth are signs for those who believe with certitude,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:21: and within yourselves; do you not see?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:22: And in the heaven is your provision and what you are promised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:23: So by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, indeed, it is as true as the fact that you(can) pronounce.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:24: Has the story of Abraham’s honored guests reached you?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:25: When they entered upon him they said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace, strangers.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:26: And he slipped away to his family and brought a fatted calf
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:27: and set it before them. He said, “Will you not eat?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:28: And he was filled with apprehension towards them. They said, “Do not be afraid,” and they announced to him the glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:29: So his wife came forward with a shriek, then clasped her face and said, “A barren old woman!”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:30: They said, “Thus your Lord has said; He is the All-Wise, the All- Knowing.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:31: He said, “So what is your business, O emissaries?”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:32: They said, “We have been sent to a criminal people,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:33: to unleash upon them rocks of clay,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:34: marked by yourLord for the extremists.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:35: Then We brought out all the believers who were in it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:36: Yet We found in it only one household of Muslims,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:37: and We left in it a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:38: And in Moses(there is also a sign) —when We sent him to Pharaoh with an evident manifestation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:39: But he turned away with his warlords and said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:40: So We seized him and his troops and flung them into the waters, and he was to blame.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:41: And(likewise) in(the people of) ʻĀd—We sent against them the Barren Wind,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:42: sparing nothing it came upon without rendering it like decayed ruins.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:43: And(likewise) in(the people of) Thamûd—they were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:44: But they defied the command of their Lord, so the Lightningstruckthem as they looked on,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:45: and they could not rise up, nor could they help themselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:46: And(recall) before that, the people of Noah—indeed, they were a defiantly disobedient people.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:47: And the universe—We constructed it with power, and We are surely expanding it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:48: And the earth—We spread it out. So how excellent are We who prepared it!
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:49: And We created all things in pairs, that you may remind yourselves.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:50: “So flee to Allah; I am to youfrom Him an evident warner.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:51: And do not set up any other god with Allah; I am to you from Him an evident warner.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:52: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them but they said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:53: Did they recommend it to one another? In fact, they are a people who exceed all limits.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:54: So turn away from them, for youare not to blame.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:55: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:56: And I did not create the unseen beingsand humans but to worship Me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:57: I need no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:58: Allah is the All-Providing, the Possessor of power, the All-Firm.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:59: So, indeed, those who do injustice will have their lot like the lot of their fellows, so let them not hasten Me.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.51:60: So woe to those who have denied from that day of theirs which they are promised.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:4: By the frequented House(of God) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:6: By the sea flared up with fire—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:7: the punishment of yourLord is sure to come;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:8: there is nothing to avert it
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:9: on the day when the sky sways in agitation
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:10: and the mountains go into motion.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:11: So woe on that day to the disbelievers
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:12: who are indulged in vain talk, playing.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:13: The day when they are shoved into the Fire of Hell forcefully.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:14: “This is the Fire in which youused to disbelieve.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:15: Is this magic, or do younot see?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:16: Roast in it, and be patient or be impatient—it is the same for you; indeed, you are only being repaid for what you used to do.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:17: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are in Gardens and bliss,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:18: enjoying what their Lord has brought them, and their Lord has shielded them from the punishment of purgatory.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:19: “Eat and drink pleasantly on account of what youused to do.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:20: Relaxing on luxurious furnishings, and We coupled them with spouses with lovely wide eyes.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:21: And those who attained faith and whose offspring followed themin faith—We have unitedthem with theiroffspring , and We have not deprived them of anything of their work; every person is in pledge for what(deeds) he has earned.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:22: And We have supplied them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:23: They exchange therein a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or recrimination.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:24: And serving them are youths like nestled pearls.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:25: And they approached one another, inquiring.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:26: They said, “When we were still with our familieswe used to live in fear,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:27: so Allah has conferred favor upon us and has shielded us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:28: Indeed, before this we used to pray to Him; indeed , He is the Fulfiller of promises, the Bestower of mercy.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:29: So remind, for youare neither a soothsayer nor a madman.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:30: Or do they say, “A poetfor whom we await a calamity of time”?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:31: Say, “Go on awaiting, for I am with youamong those awaiting.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:32: Or is it that their discerning minds command them to this? Or are they a people who exceed all limits?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:33: Or do they say, “He made it up”? In fact, they do not believe.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:34: So let them produce a discourse like it if they are truthful.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:35: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:36: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:37: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:38: Or do they have a stairway(to heaven) by means of which they listen? Then let their listener bring an evident manifestation.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:39: Or is He to have the daughters and youthe sons?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:40: Or do youask them for a reward so that they are weighed down by debt?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:41: Or do they have(knowledge of) the hidden realm and they are writing it down?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:42: Or do they want a plot? Rather, the plot will only befall the deniers.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:43: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Highly Exalted is Allah above what they associate.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:44: And if they were to see lumps of sky falling, they would say, “A mass of clouds.”
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:45: So leavethem until they meet their day in which they are stunned—
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:46: the day when their plots avail them nothing, nor are they supported.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:47: And indeed, for those who did injustice there is a punishment apart from that, but most of them do not know.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:48: So wait patiently for the decree of yourLord, for you are before Our Eyes. And highly exalt your Lord with praise when you arise,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.52:49: and highly exalt Him during the night and at the receding of the stars.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:1: By the star as it goes down,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:2: yourfellow has not gone astray, nor has he been deluded,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:3: nor does he speak out of whim.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:4: It is but a revelation being revealed,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:5: taught to him by the extremely powerful,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:6: the one of vigor. He settled
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:7: while he was at the highest horizon,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:8: then he came near and descended
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:9: so that he was within two bows’ length or closer.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:10: Then He revealed to His servant that which He revealed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:11: The burning heart did not lie aboutwhat it saw.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:12: Will youenter into controversies with himdespitewhat he sees?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:13: And he saw him on another descent,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:14: at the Lote-tree of the Extremity,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:15: near which is the Garden of Shelter,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:16: when there covered the Lote-tree what covered it.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:17: The sight(of the Prophet) did not swerve, nor did it exceed.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:18: He certainly saw some of the great signs of his Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:19: Have youseen Al-Lāt and Al-ʻUzza?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:20: And Manāt, the third one, the other?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:21: Are youto have the males and He the females?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:23: These are nothing but names which youhave named, you and your forefathers, for which Allah sent down no manifestation. They follow nothing but assumptions and what the(inner) selves desire, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:24: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:25: To Allah belong the Hereafter and the first(life) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:26: And how many an angel is there in the heavens whose intercession avails nothing except after Allah gives permission to whomever He wills and is well pleased with.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:27: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels with female names,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:28: though they have no knowledge of that. They only follow assumptions, yet surely assumptions do not substitute for the truth.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:29: So disregardthe one who has turned away from Our Reminder and has wanted nothing but the Earlier Life.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:30: That is the extent of their knowledge. Indeed, yourLord is the One Who knows better who has strayed from His way and He is the One Who knows better who has accepted guidance.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:31: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may repay those who have done evil according to what they have done and repay those who have excelled in doing good with the best.
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:32: Those who avoid the gravest of sinsand obscenities—except for minor lapses—yourLord is of vast forgiveness. He knows better about you, ever since He initiated you from the earth, and ever since you were fetuses in your mothers’ bellies. So do not acclaim your own purity—He knows better who is mindful(of Him) .
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:33: Have youseen the one who turned away
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:34: and gave a little, then held back?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:35: Does he possess knowledge of the hidden realm and can therefore foresee?
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:36: Or was he not informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:37: and of Abraham who fulfilled(conveying the commandments) :
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:38: that no bearer of burden bears the burden of another;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:39: and that man attains only what he has striven for;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:40: and that surely his pursuit will eventually be seen,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:41: then he is repaid for it with the fullest repayment;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:42: and that to yourLord is the finality;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:43: and that it is He Who caused laughter and weeping;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:44: and that it is He Who caused death and gave life;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:45: and that He created the two spouses—the male and the female,
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:46: from a sperm drop when emitted;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:47: and that upon Him is the next creation;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:48: and that it is He Who enriched and impoverished;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:49: and that it is He Who is the Lord of Sirius;
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:50: and that He annihilated ancient ʻĀd
Fadel Soliman, Bridges’ translation.53:52: and the people of Noah before that; indeed, they were more unjust and more exceeding of all limits.
