T. Usmani.23:85: They will say, “Allah’s.” Say, “Would you still pay no heed?
T. Usmani.23:86: Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Great Throne?”
T. Usmani.23:87: They will say, “(All this belongs) to Allah”. Say, “Would you still not fear Allah?”
T. Usmani.23:88: Say, “Who is the One in whose hand lies the kingdom of every thing and who gives protection, and no protection can be given against him, if you have knowledge?”
T. Usmani.23:89: They will say, “(All this belongs) to Allah.” Say, “Then by which magic are you drawn crazy?”
T. Usmani.23:90: The fact is that We have brought to them The Truth, and they are absolute liars.
T. Usmani.23:91: Allah has not taken a son to Himself, nor was there any god with Him. Had there been so, every god would have taken away what he created, and each one of them would have been aggressive against the other. Pure is Allah from what they describe.
T. Usmani.23:92: He is the Knower of the hidden and the manifest. So, He is far higher than their ascribing of partners to Him.
T. Usmani.23:93: (O prophet) say (in prayer), “O my Lord, if You are to show me (in my life) that (punishment) which they (the infidels) are threatened with,
T. Usmani.23:94: then, my Lord, do not place me among the wrongdoing people.”
T. Usmani.23:95: And of course, We do have the power to show you that with which We have threatened them.
T. Usmani.23:96: Repel evil with that which is best. We are well aware of what they describe.
T. Usmani.23:97: And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the strokes of the satans (devils),
T. Usmani.23:98: and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, even from their coming near me.”
T. Usmani.23:99: (The infidels go on doing their misdeeds) until when death comes to one of them, he will say, “My Lord send me back,
T. Usmani.23:100: so that I may act righteously in that (world) which I have left behind.” Never! It is simply a word he utters, and in front of such people there is a barrier till the day when they will be resurrected.
T. Usmani.23:101: Thereafter, when the Sūr (the trumpet) is blown, no ties of kinship will remain between them any more, nor will they inquire about one another.
T. Usmani.23:102: So, the one whose scales (of good deeds) turn out to be heavy, then such people are the successful ones,
T. Usmani.23:103: and the one whose scales turn out to be light, then such people are the ones who harmed their own selves; in Jahannam (Hell) they are to remain for ever.
T. Usmani.23:104: Fire will scorch their faces, and they will be disfigured therein.
T. Usmani.23:105: (It will be said to such people), “Were My verses not used to be recited to you and you used to reject them?”
T. Usmani.23:106: They will say, “Our Lord, our wretchedness prevailed over us, and we were a people wandering astray.
T. Usmani.23:107: Our Lord, get us out from here; if we do this again, then of course, we will be transgressors.”
T. Usmani.23:108: He (Allah) will say, “Stay in it, humiliated, and do not speak to Me.
T. Usmani.23:109: There was indeed a group of My servants who used to say, ‘Our Lord, we adhere to the (true) faith, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and you are the best of all the merciful.’
T. Usmani.23:110: But you made fun of them, so much so that they caused you to forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
T. Usmani.23:111: Today I have so recompensed them for their observing patience that they are the triumphant.”
T. Usmani.23:112: He (Allah) will say (to unbelievers), “How long did you stay on the earth by number of years?”
T. Usmani.23:113: They will say, “We stayed for a day or for a part of a day. So, ask those (angels) who have (exact) calculation.”
T. Usmani.23:114: He will say, “You did not stay but for a little. Would that you had understood (this at that time)!
T. Usmani.23:115: So did you think that We created you for nothing, and that you will not be brought back to Us?”
T. Usmani.23:116: So, High above all is Allah, the King, the True. There is no god but He, the Lord of the Noble Throne.
T. Usmani.23:117: And whoever invokes another god with Allah, while he has no proof for it, his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely, the infidels will not achieve success.
T. Usmani.23:118: And say (O prophet) “My Lord, grant pardon and have mercy, for you are the best of all the merciful.”
T. Usmani.24:1: This is a Sūrah We have sent down and enjoined, and sent down in it clear signs, so that you may receive the advice.
T. Usmani.24:2: The fornicating woman and the fornicating man, flog each one of them with one hundred stripes. No pity for them should prevail upon you in the matter of Allah’s religion, if you really believe in Allah and the Last Day; and a group of believers must witness their punishment.
T. Usmani.24:3: A man who is fornicator does not (like to) marry but a woman who is a fornicator or a polytheist; and a woman who is a fornicator does not (like to) marry but a man who is a fornicator or a polytheist. And this (i.e. preferring to marry such spouses) has been prohibited for the believers.
T. Usmani.24:4: Those who accuse the chaste women (of fornication), but they do not produce four witnesses, flog them with eighty stripes and do not accept their any evidence any more. They are the sinners,
T. Usmani.24:5: except those who repent afterwards and mend their ways; then, Allah is All-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.24:6: Those who accuse their wives (of adultery) while they have no witnesses except their own selves, then the evidence of one of them would be to swear four oaths by Allah that he is truthful,
T. Usmani.24:7: and the fifth (oath) that Allah’s curse be on him if he is one of the liars.
T. Usmani.24:8: And it will remove the punishment from the woman if she swears four oaths by Allah that he (the accuser husband) is certainly one of the liars,
T. Usmani.24:9: and the fifth (oath) that Allah’s wrath be on her if he is one of the truthful.
T. Usmani.24:10: Had it not been for the grace of Allah upon you, and His mercy, and (had it not been) that Allah is Most-Relenting, All-Wise, (you would have faced severe hardships).
T. Usmani.24:11: Those who have come up with the false imputation are a gang among you. Do not think it is bad for you; rather, it is good for you. Every one of them is liable for what he earned of the sin. And the one who played the major role in it, for him there is a mighty punishment.
T. Usmani.24:12: Why - when you (O believers) heard of it - did the believing men and the believing women not think well about their own selves, and (why did they not) say, “This is a manifest lie”.
T. Usmani.24:13: Why did they (the accusers) not bring four witnesses to prove this? So, as they did not bring the witnesses, they are the liars in the sight of Allah.
T. Usmani.24:14: Had it not been for the grace of Allah upon you, and His mercy in this world and in the Hereafter, a severe punishment would have reached you for what you indulged in -
T. Usmani.24:15: when you were welcoming it with your tongues, and were saying with your mouths something of which you had no knowledge, and were taking it as a trivial matter, while in the sight of Allah it was grave.
T. Usmani.24:16: And why, when you heard of it, did you not say, “It is not for us to speak about this. Pure are You (O Allah). This is a terrible calumny.”
T. Usmani.24:17: Allah admonishes you never to repeat something like this, if you are believers.
T. Usmani.24:18: Allah makes the signs clear to you, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
T. Usmani.24:19: Surely, those who like that lewdness spreads among the believers, for them there is painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. Allah knows, and you do not know.
T. Usmani.24:20: Had it not been for the grace of Allah upon you, and His mercy, and that Allah is Very-Kind, Very-Merciful (you would have been destroyed).
T. Usmani.24:21: O you who believe, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Whoever follows the footsteps of Satan, (should know that) he orders (one to commit) shameful acts and evil deeds. Had it not been for the grace of Allah upon you, and His mercy, not a single person from you would have ever attained purity. But Allah purifies whomsoever He wills. Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.24:22: The men of grace and wealth among you should not swear against giving (their charitable gifts) to the kinsmen and the poor and to those who have migrated in the way of Allah, and they should forgive and forego. Do you not like that Allah forgives you? Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.24:23: Surely, those who level a false charge against the chaste, natve and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there is a mighty punishment
T. Usmani.24:24: on the Day when their tongues, their hands and their legs will testify against themselves of what they used to do.
T. Usmani.24:25: On that day Allah will give them their rightful recompense in full, and they will know that Allah is the Very Truth who makes all things manifest.
T. Usmani.24:26: Vile women are for vile men, and vile men are for vile women; and good women are for good men, and good men are for good women. Those are free from what they (the accusers) say. For them there is forgiveness, and a graceful provision.
T. Usmani.24:27: O you who believe, do not enter any houses, other than your own houses unless you seek permission and greet their inmates with Salām . That is good for you, so that you may be heedful.
T. Usmani.24:28: Even if you do not find anyone in them, do not enter therein until permission is given to you. And if it is said to you, ‘Go back’, just go back; it is more decent for you. Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.24:29: There is no sin on you if you enter uninhabited houses in which you have rightful benefit. Allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
T. Usmani.24:30: Tell the believing men that they must lower their gazes and guard their private parts; it is more decent for them. Surely Allah is All-Aware of what they do.
T. Usmani.24:31: And tell the believing women that they must lower their gazes and guard their private parts, and must not expose their adornment, except that which appears thereof, and must wrap their bosoms with their shawls, and must not expose their adornment, except to their husbands or their fathers or the fathers of their husbands, or to their sons or the sons of their husbands, or to their brothers or the sons of their brothers or the sons of their sisters, or to their women, or to those owned by their right hands, or male attendants having no (sexual) urge, or to the children who are not yet conscious of the shames of women. And let them not stamp their feet in a way that the adornment they conceal is known. And repent to Allah O believers, all of you, so that you may achieve success.
T. Usmani.24:32: Arrange the marriage of the spouseless among you, and the capable from among your bondmen and bondwomen. If they are poor, Allah will enrich them out of His grace. Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.24:33: And those who cannot afford marriage should keep themselves chaste until Allah enriches them out of His grace. And those of your slaves who wish to enter the contract of Kitābah (emancipation by paying money), contract Kitābah with them, if you recognize some good in them. And give them out of the wealth of Allah that He has given to you. And do not compel your maids to prostitution - if they wish to observe chastity - in order that you may seek the temporary benefit of the worldly life. If one compels them, then after their being compelled, Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.24:34: Indeed We have sent down to you enlightening verses, and an exemplary description of those who passed away before you, and a good counsel for the God-fearing.
T. Usmani.24:35: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is that of a niche, in which there is a lamp; the lamp is in a glass - the glass looks like a brilliant star - it is lit by (the oil of) a blessed tree, the olive, which is neither eastern, nor western. Its oil is about to emit light even though the fire has not touched it - (it is) light upon light. Allah guides to His light whomsoever He wills; Allah describes examples for the people, and Allah knows everything well.
T. Usmani.24:36: (The guided people worship Allah) in the houses that Allah has permitted to be raised, and where His name is recounted and His purity is pronounced, in the morning and in the evening,
T. Usmani.24:37: by the men whom no trade or sale makes neglectful of the remembrance of Allah, nor from establishing Salāh and paying Zakāh ; they are fearful of a day in which the hearts and the eyes will be over-turned.
T. Usmani.24:38: The fate (of such people) is that Allah will reward them for the best deeds they did, and will give them more out of His grace. Allah gives whom He wills without counting.
T. Usmani.24:39: As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are like a mirage in a desert plain, which a thirsty person deems to be water, until when he comes to it, he finds it nothing, and finds (the decree of) Allah with him, so He pays him his account in full. Allah is swift at reckoning.
T. Usmani.24:40: Or (their deeds) are like layers of darkness in a vast deep sea overwhelmed by a wave, above which there is another wave, above which there are clouds - layers of darkness, one above the other. When one puts forth his hand, he can hardly see it; and the one to whom Allah does not give light can have no light at all.
T. Usmani.24:41: Did you not realize that purity of Allah is proclaimed by all those in the heavens and the earth, and by the birds with their wings spread out? Everyone knows one’s own (way of) praying (to Allah) and one’s own (way of) proclaiming Allah’s purity. And Allah knows well what they do.
T. Usmani.24:42: To Allah belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and towards Allah is the final return.
T. Usmani.24:43: Do you not realize that Allah drives the clouds, then joins them together, then turns them into a heap? Then you see the rain coming out from their midst. He sends down from the sky mountains (of clouds) having hail in them, then He afflicts with it whomsoever He wills and turns it away from whomsoever He wills. The flash of its lightning seems to snatch away the eyes.
T. Usmani.24:44: Allah alternates the night and the day. Surely, in that there is a lesson for those who have eyes to see.
T. Usmani.24:45: Allah has created every moving creature from water. So, some of them move on their bellies; and some of them move on two legs, and some of them move on four. Allah creates what He wills. Surely, Allah is powerful over everything.
T. Usmani.24:46: We have surely sent down enlightening verses, and Allah guides whom He wills to the straight path.
T. Usmani.24:47: They say, “We have believed in Allah and in the messenger, and have adopted obedience”, then a group from them goes back after all this. Those are no believers.
T. Usmani.24:48: When they are summoned to Allah and His messenger that he (the messenger) may judge between them, in no time a group of them turns averse.
T. Usmani.24:49: And if the right is theirs, they would come to him as (if they are) submissive ones.
T. Usmani.24:50: Is there a malady in their hearts or do they have doubt or do they fear that Allah and His messenger will do injustice to them? Rather they themselves are the unjust.
T. Usmani.24:51: The only reply of the (true) believers, when they are summoned to Allah and His messenger that he (the messenger) may judge between them, is that they say, “We listen and obey.” Such people are the successful.
T. Usmani.24:52: Whoever obeys Allah and His messenger and has awe of Him and observes Taqwā for His sake, then such people are the victorious.
T. Usmani.24:53: And they (the hypocrites) swear by Allah on forceful oaths that if you (O prophet) order them, they will certainly leave (their homes for Jihād ). Say, “do not swear, (the reality of your) obedience is known. Indeed Allah is fully aware of what you do.”
T. Usmani.24:54: Say, “Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if you turn away, then on him (the messenger) lies (the responsibility of) what he is burdened with, and on you lies (the responsibility of) what you are burdened with. And if you obey him, you will get the right path. The duty of the Messenger is no more than to convey the message clearly.”
T. Usmani.24:55: Allah has promised those of you who believe and do good deeds that He will certainly make them (His) vicegerents in the land, as He made those before them, and will certainly establish for them their religion which He has chosen for them, and will certainly give them peace in place of fear in which they were before; (provided that) they worship Me, ascribing no partner to Me. And those who turn infidel after that are the transgressors.
T. Usmani.24:56: Establish Salāh and pay Zakāh and obey the messenger, so that you may be favored with mercy.
T. Usmani.24:57: Never think that the disbelievers are (able) to frustrate (Allah’s plan) on the earth. Their abode is the Fire. Indeed it is an evil terminus.
T. Usmani.24:58: O you who believe, the slaves owned by you, and those of you who have not reached puberty, must seek your permission (to see you) at three times: before the prayer of Fajr, and when you take off your clothes at noon, and after the prayer of ‘Ishā’. These are three times of privacy for you. There is no harm, neither to you nor to them, after these (three times). They are your frequent visitors, as some of you are (frequent visitors) of the others. This is how Allah explains the verses to you. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
T. Usmani.24:59: When the children from among you reach puberty, they must seek permission, as the permission is sought by those before them. This is how Allah explains His verses to you. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
T. Usmani.24:60: And those old women who have no hope for marriage, there is no sin on them, if they take off their (extra) clothes while they do not display their adornment. Still, that they refrain (even from this) is better for them. Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.24:61: There is no blame on a blind person, nor is there any blame on any lame one, nor is there any blame on a sick person, nor on yourselves in that you eat (something) from your own homes or from the homes of your fathers or the homes of your mothers or the homes of your brothers or the homes of your sisters or the homes of your paternal uncles, or the homes of your paternal aunts or the homes of your maternal uncles or the homes of your maternal aunts or from the places the keys of which you have under your control, or from (the home of) your friend.There is no sin on you if you eat together or separately. So when you enter homes, greet one another with Salām , a greeting prescribed by Allah, which is blessed, pleasant. This is how Allah explains the verses to you, so that you may understand.
T. Usmani.24:62: The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His messenger and who, when they are with him for a collective matter, do not leave unless they seek his permission. Surely, those who seek your permission are the ones who believe in Allah and His messenger. So, if they seek permission from you for some business of theirs, give permission to whom you wish from among them, and pray to Allah for their forgiveness. Surely, Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.24:63: Do not take the call of the messenger among you as a call of one of you to another. Allah definitely knows those of you who sneak out hiding themselves under the cover of others. So, those who violate his (messenger’s) order must beware, lest they are visited by a trial or they are visited by a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.24:64: Remember! To Allah belongs all that is there in the heavens and the earth. He knows the condition in which you are at present; and the Day on which they will be returned to Him, He will tell them what they did. Allah is fully aware of everything.
T. Usmani.25:1: Glorious is the One who has revealed the Criterion to His servant, so that he may be a warner to all the worlds,
T. Usmani.25:2: the One to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and who did neither have a son, nor is there any partner to him in the Kingdom, and who has created everything and designed it in a perfect measure.
T. Usmani.25:3: Yet they have adopted other gods, beside Him, who do not create any thing, as they themselves are created, and they possess no power to cause harm or benefit even to themselves, nor do they have any control over death or life or resurrection.
T. Usmani.25:4: The disbelievers said, “This is nothing but a lie he (the messenger) has fabricated and some other people have helped him in it.” Thus they came up with sheer injustice and falsehood.
T. Usmani.25:5: And they said, “(These are) the tales of the ancients he (the messenger) has caused to be written, and they are read out to him at morn and eve.”
T. Usmani.25:6: Say, “It is sent down by the One who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth. Indeed He is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.25:7: They said, “What sort of messenger is this who eats food and walks in the markets? Why is it that an angel has not been sent down to him who would have been a warner along with him.
T. Usmani.25:8: Or a treasure should have been thrown down to him, or he should have a garden to eat from it?” And the transgressors said (to the believers,) “You are following none but a bewitched man.”
T. Usmani.25:9: See how they coined similes for you, so they have gone astray and cannot find a way.
T. Usmani.25:10: Glorious is the One who, if He so wills, would give you better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow, and would give you palaces.
T. Usmani.25:11: But they have disbelieved the Hour (the Day of Judgment) and for those who disbelieve the Hour, We have prepared a flaming fire.
T. Usmani.25:12: When it will see them from a distant place, they will hear (the sounds of) its raging and breathing,
T. Usmani.25:13: and when they will be thrown into a narrow place therein, while they will be chained together, they will call for death.
T. Usmani.25:14: (Then it will be said to them,) “Do not call for one death today, but call for many a death.”
T. Usmani.25:15: Say, “Is that better or the eternal paradise the God-fearing are promised?” It will be a reward for them and a final abode.
T. Usmani.25:16: For them there will be whatever they wish, while they will be eternal. This is a promise undertaken by your Lord, (the fulfillment of) which is worth praying for.
T. Usmani.25:17: (Remember) the Day when He will gather them and what they used to worship beside Allah and will say (to the latter ones), “Did you mislead these My servants, or did they themselves lose the way?”
T. Usmani.25:18: They will say, “Pure are You. It was not for us to adopt other guardians than You. Instead, You gave them and their fathers (worldly) benefits till they forgot the advice, and became a ruined people.”
T. Usmani.25:19: Thus they will refute you in what you say, and you will not be able to repulse (the punishment,) or to receive help. Whoever commits injustice from among you, We will make him taste a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.25:20: We did not send any messengers before you (O prophet,) but all of them used to eat food and walk in the markets. And We have made some of you a test for some others. Would you observe patience? And your Lord is Ever-seeing.
T. Usmani.25:21: Said those who do not even expect to meet Us, “Why the angels are not sent down to us or why do we not see our Lord?” Indeed they think too highly of themselves, and have gone too far in rebellion.
T. Usmani.25:22: The Day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the sinners that day, and they will say, “(We need) a shelter, fully protected!”
T. Usmani.25:23: And We will proceed to whatever deeds they did, and will turn them into scattered dust.
T. Usmani.25:24: The people of Paradise, on that day, will be the best in (terms of their) abode and best in (terms of their) resting-place.
T. Usmani.25:25: The Day the sky will break open with a cloud, and the angels will be sent down in a majestic descent,
T. Usmani.25:26: the Kingdom on that day will be for the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah), and it will be a difficult day for the disbelievers.
T. Usmani.25:27: And (Be mindful of) the Day the wrongdoer will bite his hands saying, “Would that I had taken a path along with the messenger!
T. Usmani.25:28: Woe to me! Would that I had not taken so-and-so for my friend!
T. Usmani.25:29: Indeed he led me astray from the advice after it had come to me.” And the Satan is man’s betrayer.
T. Usmani.25:30: And the messenger will say, “O my Lord, my people had taken this Qur’ān as deserted.”
T. Usmani.25:31: In a similar way We made for every prophet an enemy from among the sinners, but your Lord suffices as a guide and as a supporter.
T. Usmani.25:32: Said those who disbelieved, “Why has the Qur’ān not been revealed to him all at once?” (It has been sent down) in this way (i.e. in parts) so that We make your heart firm, and We revealed it little by little.
T. Usmani.25:33: They bring to you no hypothesis, but We bring to you the correct position and (an answer) better explained.
T. Usmani.25:34: Those who will be driven on their faces to Hell - they are the worst in situation and far more astray from the path.
T. Usmani.25:35: Surely We gave Mūsā the Book, and appointed his brother Hārūn as a minister with him.
T. Usmani.25:36: So we said, “Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs” Then We annihilated them totally.
T. Usmani.25:37: As for the people of NūH, when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them and made them an example for mankind, and We have prepared a painful punishment for the transgressors.
T. Usmani.25:38: And (We annihilated also the peoples of) ‘Ād and Thamūd and the people of Rass, and many generations in between them.
T. Usmani.25:39: To each (of them) We cited examples, and each of them We brought to utter ruin.
T. Usmani.25:40: Indeed they (the pagans of Makkah) have passed by the town that was afflicted by an evil rain sent down to it. So, have they not been seeing it? Rather, they do not believe in Resurrection.
T. Usmani.25:41: When they see you, they take you only as a laughing stock, (saying) “Is this the man whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
T. Usmani.25:42: He would have almost led us astray from our gods, had we not been so firm towards them.” They will know when they will see the punishment, who is farther astray in his way.
T. Usmani.25:43: Tell me about the one who has taken his desire as his god, would you then, become a guardian for him?
T. Usmani.25:44: Or do you think that most of them listen or understand? They are but like cattle. Rather, they are even farther astray from the (right) way.
T. Usmani.25:45: Have you not observed how your Lord stretched out the shadow (of the sun)? If He so willed, He would have made it stand still. Then We made the sun an indicator for it.
T. Usmani.25:46: Then We pulled it toward Us in a gradual manner.
T. Usmani.25:47: He is the One who has made the night an apparel for you, and the sleep a means of rest, and has made the day a means of revival.
T. Usmani.25:48: And He is the One who has sent the winds conveying good news before His mercy, and We have sent down purifying water from the heavens,
T. Usmani.25:49: so that We revive a dead land therewith, and give drink to the many cattle and humans created by Us.
T. Usmani.25:50: And We have distributed it (the water) among them, so that they may take lesson. Yet most of the people refused all but ungratefulness.
T. Usmani.25:51: Had We so willed, We would have sent a (separate) warner for every town, (but, according to Our wisdom, We have sent Muhammad as a prophet for all these towns)
T. Usmani.25:52: So, (O Prophet,) do not obey the infidels, and strive against them with it (the Qur’ān), in utmost endeavor.
T. Usmani.25:53: He is the One who joined the two seas, so as this is sweet, very sweet, and this is bitter, very bitter, and made between them a buffer and an insurmountable barrier.
T. Usmani.25:54: And He is the One who created man from water, then made of him relations created by lineage and relations created by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.
T. Usmani.25:55: They worship, instead of Allah, what can neither give them any benefit nor can cause them any harm. The disbeliever is always a supporter (of Satan) against his Lord.
T. Usmani.25:56: We did not send you but as a bearer of good news and as a warner.
T. Usmani.25:57: Say, “I do not demand from you any return, except that one should adopt the (proper) way to his Lord, if he so wills.
T. Usmani.25:58: And place your trust in the Ever-Living who cannot die, and proclaim His purity along with His praise. Enough is He to be aware of the sins of His servants,
T. Usmani.25:59: the One who created in six days the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them, then He positioned Himself on the Throne. (He is) the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah). So ask about Him someone who knows.
T. Usmani.25:60: And when it is said to them, “Prostrate yourselves to the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah),” they say “What is RaHmān? Shall we prostrate ourselves to the one to whom you direct us?” And it increases nothing in them except aversion.
T. Usmani.25:61: Glorious is the One who made stellar formations in the sky, and placed therein a lamp (i.e. the sun) and a bright moon.
T. Usmani.25:62: And He is the One who made the day and the night following each other, for the one who wishes to be mindful or wishes to show gratitude.
T. Usmani.25:63: The servants of the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah) are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the ignorant people speak to them, they reply peacefully,
T. Usmani.25:64: and those who pass the night prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord,
T. Usmani.25:65: and those who say, “Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Jahannam (the Hell); indeed, its punishment is a persisting affliction.”
T. Usmani.25:66: Indeed, it is evil as an abode and a place to dwell in
T. Usmani.25:67: - and those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor miserly, and it (i.e. their spending) is moderate in between (the two extremes,)
T. Usmani.25:68: - and those who do not invoke any other god along with Allah, and do not kill a person whom Allah has given sanctity, except rightfully, nor do they fornicate; and whoever does it, shall face the recompense of his sin,
T. Usmani.25:69: the punishment will be doubled for him, and he will remain there disdained, for ever,
T. Usmani.25:70: except the one who repents and believes and does good deeds, then Allah will replace the evils of such people by good deeds, and Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.25:71: Whoever repents and does righteous deeds turns to Allah truly
T. Usmani.25:72: - and those who do not witness falsehood, and when they pass by the absurd things, Pass by them with dignity,
T. Usmani.25:73: and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall at them as deaf and blind ones,
T. Usmani.25:74: - and those who say, “Our Lord, Give us, from our spouses and our children, comfort of eyes, and make us heads of the God-fearing.”
T. Usmani.25:75: Such people will be rewarded with the high place - because they observed patience - and will be received therein with prayers of their eternal life and peace,
T. Usmani.25:76: living in it (the Paradise) for ever. It is best as an abode and as a place to dwell in.
T. Usmani.25:77: Say (O Prophet), “My Lord will never care about you, if you will not invoke Him. Now since you rejected (the truth), the punishment will be inseparable from you.”
T. Usmani.26:2: These are the verses of the manifest Book.
T. Usmani.26:3: (O Prophet,) perhaps you are going to let yourself collapse in grief because they do not believe.
T. Usmani.26:4: If We so will, We can send down to them a sign from the sky, for which their necks will stay bent in submission.
T. Usmani.26:5: Never a new message comes to them from the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah), but they become averse to it.
T. Usmani.26:6: Thus they rejected (the Truth); well, soon will come to them the real descriptions of what they used to ridicule.
T. Usmani.26:7: Have they not looked at the earth, how many of the noble pairs (of vegetation) We have caused to grow in it?
T. Usmani.26:8: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
T. Usmani.26:9: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
T. Usmani.26:10: (Remember) when your Lord called Mūsā saying, “Go to the transgressing people,
T. Usmani.26:11: the people of Pharaoh. Do they not fear Allah?”
T. Usmani.26:12: He (Mūsā) said, “My Lord, I fear that they will reject me.
T. Usmani.26:13: My heart gets straitened, and my tongue is not fluent; so send for Hārūn.
T. Usmani.26:14: Moreover, they have (leveled) a charge of offence against me, and I fear they will kill me;”
T. Usmani.26:15: He (Allah) said, “Never! (They will not be able to kill you.) So go, both of you, with Our signs. We are with you, listening (to the conversation you will have with him.)
T. Usmani.26:16: So go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, ‘We both are messengers of the Lord of all the worlds,
T. Usmani.26:17: (sent with the message) that you must send the children of Isrā’īl with us’”.
T. Usmani.26:18: He (Pharaoh) said, “Did we not nourish you among us as a child? And you remained amidst us for years,
T. Usmani.26:19: and you did the blunder you did; still you are ungrateful.”
T. Usmani.26:20: He said, “I did that at a time when I was mistaken.
T. Usmani.26:21: Then I fled away from you when I feared you. Thereafter my Lord granted wisdom to me, and made me one of the messengers.
T. Usmani.26:22: As for the favor with which you are obliging me, it is that you have enslaved the children of Isrā’īl.”
T. Usmani.26:23: Pharaoh said, “What is the Lord of the worlds?”
T. Usmani.26:24: He (Mūsā) said, “Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever there is between them, if you are to believe”
T. Usmani.26:25: He (The Pharaoh) said to those around him, “Are you not hearing?”
T. Usmani.26:26: He (Mūsā) said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your early forefathers”
T. Usmani.26:27: He (Pharaoh) said, “Your messenger who is sent to you is a mad man indeed.”
T. Usmani.26:28: He (Mūsā) said, “Lord of the East and the West and whatever lies between them, if you are to understand.”
T. Usmani.26:29: He (Pharaoh) said, “If you adopt a God other than me, I will certainly put you to prison.”
T. Usmani.26:30: He (Mūsā) said “Will you (do this) even if I bring to you something evident?”
T. Usmani.26:31: He said, “Then bring it, if you are truthful.”
T. Usmani.26:32: So, he threw down his staff, and in no time it was a serpent, clearly visible,
T. Usmani.26:33: and he drew out his hand, and right then it was a white light to the onlookers.
T. Usmani.26:34: He (Pharaoh) said to the chiefs around him “This man is certainly an expert sorcerer”.
T. Usmani.26:35: He wants to expel you from your land with his sorcery. So what do you suggest?”
T. Usmani.26:36: They said, “Leave him and his brother alone for some time, and send heralds to the cities,
T. Usmani.26:37: so that they bring to you every highly expert sorcerer.”
T. Usmani.26:38: So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointed time of a known day,
T. Usmani.26:39: and it was said to the people, “Would you assemble,
T. Usmani.26:40: so that we may follow the sorcerers if they are victorious?”
T. Usmani.26:41: So, when the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, “Will there be a sure reward for us, if we are the victorious?”
T. Usmani.26:42: He said, “Yes, and of course, you will then be among the closer ones.”
T. Usmani.26:43: Mūsā said to them, “Throw you down what you are to throw.”
T. Usmani.26:44: So they threw down their ropes and their staffs and said, “By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the triumphant for sure.”
T. Usmani.26:45: Then Mūsā threw down his staff, and in no time it started swallowing the falsehood they invented.
T. Usmani.26:46: So the sorcerers were made (by the truth they saw) to fall down in prostration.
T. Usmani.26:47: They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
T. Usmani.26:48: the Lord of Mūsā and Hārūn.”
T. Usmani.26:49: He (Pharaoh) said, “You have believed in him before I permit you. Surely, he (Mūsā) is the chief of you all, who has taught you sorcery. So you will soon know (your fate). I will cut off your hands and feet from different sides, and will crucify you all together.
T. Usmani.26:50: They said, “There is no harm. We will return to our Lord.
T. Usmani.26:51: We really hope that our Lord will forgive us our faults, as we are the first of the believers.”
T. Usmani.26:52: And We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Make My servants travel at night. You will be pursued.”
T. Usmani.26:53: So Pharaoh sent into the cities (his) men to muster (people)
T. Usmani.26:55: and indeed they are enraging us,
T. Usmani.26:56: and we are a host, well-armed.”
T. Usmani.26:57: Thus We expelled them (i.e. the people of Pharaoh) from gardens and springs,
T. Usmani.26:58: and from treasures and a noble abode.
T. Usmani.26:59: Thus it was. And We made the children of Isrā’īl inherit all such things.
T. Usmani.26:60: So they (the people of Pharaoh) pursued them (the people of Mūsā) at the time of sunrise.
T. Usmani.26:61: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mūsā said, “Surely we are overtaken.”
T. Usmani.26:62: He said, “Never! Indeed with me is my Lord. He will guide me.”
T. Usmani.26:63: So We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Strike the sea with your staff.” So it was severed apart, and each part became like a big mountain.
T. Usmani.26:64: Then We brought others close to that place.
T. Usmani.26:65: And We saved Mūsā and all those with him.
T. Usmani.26:67: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
T. Usmani.26:68: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
T. Usmani.26:69: And recite before them the narrative of Ibrāhīm,
T. Usmani.26:70: when he said to his father and to his people, “What do you worship?”
T. Usmani.26:71: They said, “We worship idols, and stay devoted to them.”
T. Usmani.26:72: He said, “Do they listen to you when you call (them)
T. Usmani.26:73: or do they bring benefit to you or harm?”
T. Usmani.26:74: They said, “No, but we have found our fathers doing like this.”
T. Usmani.26:75: He said, “Have you then ever considered what you have been worshipping,
T. Usmani.26:77: they all are an enemy to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
T. Usmani.26:78: who created me, and who guides me,
T. Usmani.26:79: and Who feeds me and gives me drink,
T. Usmani.26:80: and when I become sick, He heals me,
T. Usmani.26:81: and who will make me die, then will give me life,
T. Usmani.26:82: and who, I hope, will forgive my fault on the Day of Retribution.
T. Usmani.26:83: O my Lord, give me wisdom, and make me join the righteous,
T. Usmani.26:84: and destine for me a truthful description among the next generations,
T. Usmani.26:85: and make me among those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss,
T. Usmani.26:86: and forgive my father. Indeed he was one of those who went astray,
T. Usmani.26:87: and do not put me to disgrace on the Day when all will be raised to life,
T. Usmani.26:88: the Day when neither wealth will be of any use (to any one) nor sons,
T. Usmani.26:89: except to him who will come to Allah with a sound heart,
T. Usmani.26:90: and the Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing
T. Usmani.26:91: and the Hell will be fully uncovered for the perverse,
T. Usmani.26:92: and it will be said to them, ‘Where is that which you used to worship
T. Usmani.26:93: beside Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?’
T. Usmani.26:94: So they (their false gods) will be thrown on their faces into it - they and the erring people
T. Usmani.26:95: and the entire army of Iblīs (Satan), all together.
T. Usmani.26:96: They will say when they will be quarreling there with each other,
T. Usmani.26:97: ‘By Allah, we were in open error
T. Usmani.26:98: when we used to equate you with the Lord of the worlds,
T. Usmani.26:99: and it is only the sinners who misguided us.
T. Usmani.26:100: Now we have neither any intercessors
T. Usmani.26:102: Would that we have a chance to return whereby we may join the believers!’”
T. Usmani.26:103: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
T. Usmani.26:104: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
T. Usmani.26:105: The people of NūH rejected the messengers
T. Usmani.26:106: when their brother NūH said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
T. Usmani.26:107: I am an honest messenger for you.
T. Usmani.26:108: So, fear Allah and obey me.
T. Usmani.26:109: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds;
T. Usmani.26:110: so, fear Allah and obey me.”
T. Usmani.26:111: They said, “Shall we believe in you while you are followed by the lowest people?”
T. Usmani.26:112: He said, “I do not know about what they do;
T. Usmani.26:113: their account is with none but with my Lord, if you have sense.
T. Usmani.26:114: And I am not the one who would drive the believers away;
T. Usmani.26:115: I am no more than a plain warner.”
T. Usmani.26:116: They said, “Should you not stop, O NūH, you will surely be stoned.”
T. Usmani.26:117: He said, “My Lord, my people have rejected me.
T. Usmani.26:118: So judge between me and them with an open verdict, and save me and all the believers who are with me.”
T. Usmani.26:119: So We saved him and those with him in the Ark that was fully occupied.
T. Usmani.26:120: Then We drowned, after that, all the remaining.
T. Usmani.26:121: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers
T. Usmani.26:122: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.26:124: when their brother Hūd said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
T. Usmani.26:125: I am an honest messenger for you,
T. Usmani.26:126: so fear Allah and obey me.
T. Usmani.26:127: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.26:128: Do you erect on every height a monument, having no sound purpose,
T. Usmani.26:129: and take the objects of architecture as if you are going to live forever,
T. Usmani.26:130: and when you seize (someone) you seize as tyrants?
T. Usmani.26:131: So fear Allah and obey me.
T. Usmani.26:132: And fear the One who has supported you with what you know.
T. Usmani.26:133: He has supported you with cattle and sons,
T. Usmani.26:135: In fact I fear for you the punishment of a horrible day.”
T. Usmani.26:136: They said, “It is all equal for us, whether you give us advice or you do not become one of the advisors.
T. Usmani.26:137: This is nothing but the practice of the ancient,
T. Usmani.26:138: and we are not going to be punished.”
T. Usmani.26:139: Thus they rejected him, so We destroyed them. Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
T. Usmani.26:140: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
T. Usmani.26:141: The (people of) Thamūd rejected the messengers
T. Usmani.26:142: when their brother SāliH said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
T. Usmani.26:143: I am an honest messenger for you.
T. Usmani.26:144: So, fear Allah and obey me.
T. Usmani.26:145: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.26:146: Will you be left secure in whatever is here,
T. Usmani.26:148: and in farms and date-palms, the spathes of which are interwoven?
T. Usmani.26:149: You hew out houses from the hills with pride.
T. Usmani.26:150: So fear Allah and obey me,
T. Usmani.26:151: and do not obey the order of the transgressors
T. Usmani.26:152: who make mischief on the land and who do not set things right”.
T. Usmani.26:153: They said, “You are merely one of those bewitched.
T. Usmani.26:154: You are nothing but a human like us. So, bring a sign if you are one of the truthful.”
T. Usmani.26:155: He said, “This is a she-camel. She has a share of water, and you have a share of water on a specified day.
T. Usmani.26:156: So do not touch her with evil (intent), lest you should be seized by a painful punishment.”
T. Usmani.26:157: But they killed her, then they became remorseful,
T. Usmani.26:158: and the punishment seized them. Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
T. Usmani.26:159: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
T. Usmani.26:160: The people of LūT rejected the messengers
T. Usmani.26:161: when their brother LūT said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
T. Usmani.26:162: I am an honest messenger for you.
T. Usmani.26:163: So fear Allah and obey me.
T. Usmani.26:164: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.26:165: Do you go to the males (for having sex) out of the whole universe,
T. Usmani.26:166: and leave your wives whom your Lord has created for you? Indeed you are a people who cross (all) limits.”
T. Usmani.26:167: They said, “If you do not stop O LūT, you shall be included among the outcast.”
T. Usmani.26:168: He said “Indeed, I am annoyed with your act.
T. Usmani.26:169: My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.”
T. Usmani.26:170: So We saved him and his family, all of them
T. Usmani.26:171: except an old woman among those who remained behind.
T. Usmani.26:173: and subjected them to a terrible rain. So evil was the rain of those who were warned.
T. Usmani.26:174: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
T. Usmani.26:175: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
T. Usmani.26:176: The people of Aaikah rejected the messengers
T. Usmani.26:177: when Shu‘aib said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?
T. Usmani.26:178: I am an honest messenger for you.
T. Usmani.26:179: So fear Allah and obey me.
T. Usmani.26:180: And I do not claim from you any reward for it; my reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.26:181: Give full measure, and do not be among those who bring loss to others.
T. Usmani.26:183: and do not make people short of their things, and do not spread disorder in the land as mischief-makers,
T. Usmani.26:184: and be fearful of the One who created you and the former generations.”
T. Usmani.26:185: They said, “You are but one of the bewitched men.
T. Usmani.26:186: You are no more than a human like us, and in fact we consider you to be one of the liars.
T. Usmani.26:187: So cause a piece from the sky to fall down upon us, if you are one of the truthful.”
T. Usmani.26:188: He said, “My Lord knows well what you do.”
T. Usmani.26:189: Thus they rejected him, so they were seized by the torment of the Day of Canopy. Indeed it was the punishment of a terrible day.
T. Usmani.26:190: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
T. Usmani.26:191: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
T. Usmani.26:192: This (Qur’ān) is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.26:193: The Trusted Spirit has brought it down
T. Usmani.26:194: upon your heart, so that you become one of the warners
T. Usmani.26:196: And of course, it is (mentioned) in the Scriptures of the former people.
T. Usmani.26:197: Is it not a proof for them that the knowledgeable of the children of Isrā’īl recognize him (the prophet)?
T. Usmani.26:198: Even if We had revealed it to a Non-Arab,
T. Usmani.26:199: and he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
T. Usmani.26:200: This is how We have made it pass through the hearts of the sinners.
T. Usmani.26:201: They will not believe in it until they will see the painful punishment
T. Usmani.26:202: and it will come to them suddenly while they will not be anticipating (it),
T. Usmani.26:203: and (then) they will say, “Is it (possible) that we are given some respite?”
T. Usmani.26:204: Is it then Our punishment that they are trying to hasten up?
T. Usmani.26:205: So tell me, if We give them enjoyment for years,
T. Usmani.26:206: then comes to them what they are warned of,
T. Usmani.26:207: what help can they receive from the comforts they were given to enjoy?
T. Usmani.26:208: We did not destroy any town unless it has had warners
T. Usmani.26:209: to give advice, and We have never been unjust.
T. Usmani.26:210: And this (Qur’ān) is not brought down by devils.
T. Usmani.26:211: It neither suits them, nor are they able to (do this).
T. Usmani.26:212: In fact, they are kept far away from hearing (it at the time of revelation).
T. Usmani.26:213: So do not invoke any other god along with Allah, otherwise you will be among those who are to be punished.
T. Usmani.26:214: And warn the nearest people of your clan,
T. Usmani.26:215: and be kind with humbleness to the believers who followed you.
T. Usmani.26:216: So if they disobey you, then say, “I disown what you do,”
T. Usmani.26:217: and place your trust in the Mighty, the Merciful,
T. Usmani.26:218: Who sees you when you stand (in prayer,)
T. Usmani.26:219: and (sees) your movement among those who prostrate themselves.
T. Usmani.26:220: Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.26:221: Shall I tell you on whom the devils descend?
T. Usmani.26:222: They descend on every sinful liar.
T. Usmani.26:223: They give ear to hear (secretly,) and most of them tell lies.
T. Usmani.26:224: As for the poets, they are followed by the straying people.
T. Usmani.26:225: Did you not see that they wander in every valley,
T. Usmani.26:226: and that they say what they do not?
T. Usmani.26:227: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah very much, and defend themselves after they are wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know to which place they are going to return.
T. Usmani.27:1: Tā Sīn . These are the verses of the Qur’ān and an enlightening book,
T. Usmani.27:2: a guidance and good news to the believers
T. Usmani.27:3: who establish Salāh and pay Zakāh and who have faith in the Hereafter.
T. Usmani.27:4: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds look beautiful to them. So they are wandering astray.
T. Usmani.27:5: Those are the people who deserve the worst punishment and who are the worst losers in the Hereafter.
T. Usmani.27:6: Indeed you are being given the Qur’ān by a Wise, Knowledgeable Being.
T. Usmani.27:7: (Remember) when Mūsā said to his family, “I have noticed a fire. I shall bring to you some news from it, or bring to you a live ember, so that you may warm yourselves.”
T. Usmani.27:8: So when he came to it, he was called: “Blessed is the one who is in the fire and the one who is around it. And pure is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.27:9: O Mūsā, the fact is that I AM ALLAH, the Mighty, the Wise.
T. Usmani.27:10: And cast your staff down.” So when he saw it moving, as if it was a snake, he retreated turning his back, and did not look behind. “O Mūsā, be not scared. I am such that the messengers are not scared before Me,
T. Usmani.27:11: except him who did wrong, then after (having done) evil, replaced (it) with good, then I am Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.27:12: And put your hand into your bosom, and it will come out white, without any evil, as one of the nine signs (sent) to Pharaoh and his people. Surely they have been a sinful people.
T. Usmani.27:13: So when Our signs came to them as eye-openers, they said, “This is a clear magic.”
T. Usmani.27:14: And they denied them out of sheer injustice and arrogance, though their hearts believed them (to be true). See, then, how was the fate of the mischief-makers.
T. Usmani.27:15: Surely We gave knowledge to Dāwūd and Sulaimān, and they said, “Praise belongs to Allah who made us excel many of His believing servants.
T. Usmani.27:16: And Sulaimān inherited (the traits of) Dāwūd and said, “O people we have been taught the speech of birds, and all sorts of things are given to us. Indeed, this is the evident grace (of Allah).”
T. Usmani.27:17: And mustered for Sulaimān were his forces from among the Jinns and the humans and the birds. So all of them were kept under (his) control,
T. Usmani.27:18: until when they reached the valley of the ants, one of the ants said, “O ants, enter your dwelling places, lest Sulaimān and his armies crush you unknowingly.”
T. Usmani.27:19: So he (Sulaimān) smiled, laughing on her speech and said, “My Lord, enable me to become grateful to Your favor that you have bestowed on me and on my parents, and to do good deeds that You like, and admit me, with Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.”
T. Usmani.27:20: And (once) he (Sulaimān) checked the birds and said, “How is it with me that I do not see the hudhud (hoopoe)? Rather he has disappeared.
T. Usmani.27:21: I will punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings to me a clear plea.”
T. Usmani.27:22: Then the hoopoe did not take long and said (to Sulaimān), “I have discovered what you did not, and have brought to you a sure information from Saba’ (Sheba).
T. Usmani.27:23: I have found a woman ruling over them, and all sorts of things are given to her, and she has a great throne.
T. Usmani.27:24: I have found her and her people prostrating themselves to the sun, instead of Allah, and the Satan has beautified their deeds for them, and has prevented them from the way, so they do not take the right path,
T. Usmani.27:25: that is, they do not prostrate to Allah who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and the earth,-and who knows whatever you conceal and whatever you reveal.”
T. Usmani.27:26: Allah! There is no god but He, the Lord of the Great Throne.
T. Usmani.27:27: He (Sulaimān) said, “We shall see whether you have told the truth or you are one of the liars.
T. Usmani.27:28: Go with this letter of mine, and deliver it down to them, then turn back from them, and see how they react.”
T. Usmani.27:29: She (the queen) said (to her officials after receiving the letter), “O chieftains, there has been delivered to me an esteemed letter.
T. Usmani.27:30: It is from Sulaimān, and it is (in the following words :) With the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.27:31: Do not rebel against me, and come to me in submission.”
T. Usmani.27:32: She said, “O chieftains, advise me in the matter I have (before me). I am not the one who decides a matter absolutely unless you are present with me.”
T. Usmani.27:33: They said, “We are powerful and tough fighters, and the decision lies with you; so consider what command you should give.”
T. Usmani.27:34: She said, “In fact when the kings enter a town, they put it to disorder, and put its honorable citizens to disgrace, and this is how they normally do.
T. Usmani.27:35: And I am going to send a gift to them, then see, what response the envoys will bring back.”
T. Usmani.27:36: So when he (the envoy) came to Sulaimān, he said, “Are you extending a financial aid to me? So what Allah has given me is much better than what He has given to you. But you yourselves are proud of your gift.
T. Usmani.27:37: Go back to them, and we will bring to them forces they have no power to face, and we will certainly drive them out from there in humiliation while they are disgraced.”
T. Usmani.27:38: He said, “O chieftains, which one of you will bring her throne to me before they come to me submissively?”
T. Usmani.27:39: A stalwart of the Jinn said, “I will bring it to you before you rise up from your place, and for this (task) I am powerful, reliable.”
T. Usmani.27:40: Said the one who had the knowledge of the book, “I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.” So when he saw it (the throne) well placed before him, he said, “This is by the grace of my Lord, so that He may test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful. Whoever is grateful is grateful for his own benefit, and whoever is ungrateful, then my Lord is Need-Free, Bountiful”.
T. Usmani.27:41: He said, “Disguise the throne for her, and we will see whether she discovers the truth, or she does not recognize it.”
T. Usmani.27:42: So when she came, it was said (to her), “Is your throne like this?” She said, “It seems to be the same. We have been made to recognize the truth even before this, and we have already submitted.”
T. Usmani.27:43: And she was prevented (from submitting before this) by that which she used to worship instead of Allah. Indeed she was from a disbelieving people.
T. Usmani.27:44: It was said to her, “Enter the palace.” Then once she saw it, she thought it was flowing water, and uncovered her legs. He (Sulaimān) said, “This is a palace made of glasses.” She said, “My Lord, I had surely wronged myself, and now I submit, along with Sulaimān, to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.”
T. Usmani.27:45: And We sent to Thamūd their brother SāliH saying (to them), “Worship Allah”. Then suddenly they became two groups quarrelling with each other.
T. Usmani.27:46: He said, “My people, why do you seek evil to come sooner before good? Why do you not seek forgiveness from Allah, so that you are treated with mercy?”
T. Usmani.27:47: They said, “We regard you and those with you as a sign of bad omen.” He said, “Your omen is with Allah, but you are a people put to a test.”
T. Usmani.27:48: And there were nine persons in the city who used to make mischief on the earth and did not put things right.
T. Usmani.27:49: They said, “Let us swear a mutual oath by Allah that we shall attack him (SāliH) and his family at night, then will say to his heir, ‘We did not witness the destruction of his family, and we are really truthful.’”
T. Usmani.27:50: Thus they devised a plan, and We devised a plan, while they were not aware.
T. Usmani.27:51: So, look how was the fate of their plan, that We annihilated them and their people altogether.
T. Usmani.27:52: Now those are their houses, lying empty because of their transgression. Surely, in this there are signs for a people who have knowledge.
T. Usmani.27:53: And We saved those who believed and who used to be God-fearing.
T. Usmani.27:54: And (We sent) LūT when he said to his people, “Do you commit the shameful act while you can see (its shamefulness)?
T. Usmani.27:55: Is it that you really come to men lustfully instead of women? No, you are a people committing acts of ignorance.”
T. Usmani.27:56: So, the answer of his people was not else but that they said, “Expel the family of LūT from your town. They are a people who over-indulge in purity.”
T. Usmani.27:57: So, We saved him and his family, except his wife. We destined her to remain among those who stayed behind.
T. Usmani.27:58: And We rained on them a rain. So evil was the rain of those who were warned.
T. Usmani.27:59: Say, “Praise belongs to Allah, and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen.” Is Allah better or that which they associate (with Him as His partners)?
T. Usmani.27:60: Or the One who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky? Then We caused to grow with it gardens, full of glamour. It was not within your ability to grow their trees. Is there any god along with Allah? No, but they are a people who equate (others with Allah).
T. Usmani.27:61: Or the One who made the earth a place to settle and made rivers amidst it and made mountains for (making) it (firm), and made a barrier between two seas? Is there any god along with Allah? No, but most of them do not have knowledge.
T. Usmani.27:62: Or the One who responds to a helpless person when he prays to Him and removes distress, and who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god along with Allah? No, but little you heed to advice.
T. Usmani.27:63: Or the One who guides you in depths of darkness on land and sea, and who sends the winds bearing good news before His mercy? Is there any god along with Allah? Allah is far higher than the partners they ascribe to Him.
T. Usmani.27:64: Or the One who originated creation, then will reproduce it, and who gives you provision from the sky and the earth? Is there any god along with Allah? Say, “Bring your proof if you are true.”
T. Usmani.27:65: Say, “No one in the heavens and the earth has the knowledge of the Unseen except Allah.” And they do not know when they will be raised again.
T. Usmani.27:66: Rather, their knowledge has failed in respect of the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are blind to it.
T. Usmani.27:67: And said those who disbelieved, “Is it that, when we and our fathers become dust,-is it that we shall really be brought forth?
T. Usmani.27:68: Indeed, it was promised to us and to our fathers even before this. This is nothing but the tales of the ancients.”
T. Usmani.27:69: Say, “Travel in the land and see how was the fate of the sinners.”
T. Usmani.27:70: And do not grieve for them, nor should your heart be straitened because of what they plan.
T. Usmani.27:71: They say, “When shall this promise come to pass if you are true?”
T. Usmani.27:72: Say, “It is not unlikely that some part of that (punishment) which you are asking to come soon is already following you closely.”
T. Usmani.27:73: And surely, your Lord is graceful for the mankind, but most of the people are not grateful.
T. Usmani.27:74: Of course, your Lord knows for sure what their hearts conceal and what they reveal.
T. Usmani.27:75: There is nothing hidden in the heavens and the earth that is not (recorded) in a manifest book.
T. Usmani.27:76: Surely this Qur’ān mentions to the children of Isrā’īl most of the matters in which they dispute.
T. Usmani.27:77: It is guidance and mercy for the believers.
T. Usmani.27:78: And surely your Lord will decide between them by His judgment, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.27:79: So trust in Allah. Surely you are on the clear truth.
T. Usmani.27:80: Surely, you cannot make the dead to hear, nor can you make the deaf to hear your call when they turn their backs in retreat,
T. Usmani.27:81: nor can you show the right path to the blind against their wandering astray. You can make no one to listen (to you) except those who believe in Our verses, then submit themselves (to Allah).
T. Usmani.27:82: When the word will come to fall upon them, We will bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them that the human beings (i.e the infidels) did not believe in Our signs.
T. Usmani.27:83: And (remember) the day when We will gather from every nation a host of those who used to reject Our verses, and they will be kept under control.
T. Usmani.27:84: Until when they will come, He (Allah) will say, “Did you reject My verses while you did not comprehend them with knowledge, or what was it that you used to do?
T. Usmani.27:85: And the Word will come to fall on them because of their transgression, so they will not (be able to) speak.
T. Usmani.27:86: Did they not see that We made the night, so that they may have rest in it, and (made) the day to make them see? Surely, in this there are signs for a people who believe.
T. Usmani.27:87: And (remember) the day when the Horn will be blown; so all those in the heavens and the earth will be in panic, except those whom Allah wills. And All (of them) will come to Him in humility.
T. Usmani.27:88: And you see the mountains (at present) supposing them as fixed (forever), while (on that Day) they will fly like the flight of clouds - an act of Allah who has perfected every thing. Surely, He is All-Aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.27:89: Whoever will come with the good deed will have (a reward) better than that, and such people will be immune on that day from any panic.
T. Usmani.27:90: And whoever will come with evil deed, the faces of such people will be thrown down into the Fire. You will not be recompensed but for what you used to do.
T. Usmani.27:91: I am but ordered to worship the Lord of this city, which is sanctified by Him. And to Him belongs every thing, and I am ordered to be one of the Muslims (who submit themselves to Allah),
T. Usmani.27:92: and to recite the Qur’ān; so whoever takes the right path, takes it for his own benefit. As for the one who goes astray, say (to him), “I am only one of the warners.”
T. Usmani.27:93: And say, “Praise belongs to Allah. He will show you His signs, then you will recognize them.” And your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
T. Usmani.28:2: These are verses of the clear Book.
T. Usmani.28:3: We recite to you a part of the story of Mūsā and Pharaoh with truth for a people who believe.
T. Usmani.28:4: Indeed, Pharaoh had become high-handed in the land, and had divided its people into different groups; he used to persecute a group of them, slaughtering their sons and keeping their women alive. Indeed he was one of the mischief-makers,
T. Usmani.28:5: while We intended to favor those who were held as weak in the land, and to make them leaders and make them inheritors,
T. Usmani.28:6: and give them power in the land, and to show Pharaoh, Hāmān and their armies the very thing they were fearing from them.
T. Usmani.28:7: We inspired the mother of Mūsā saying, “Suckle him (Mūsā). Then once you fear about him, cast him in the river, and do not fear, and do not grieve. Surely We are going to bring him back to you and appoint him one of (Our) messengers.”
T. Usmani.28:8: So the family of Pharaoh picked him up, so that he becomes for them an enemy and a (cause of) grief. Indeed Pharaoh, Hāmān and their armies were mistaken.
T. Usmani.28:9: And the wife of Pharaoh said, (to Pharaoh about Mūsā), “He may be a delight of eye for me and you. Do not kill him. It is hoped that he will be of benefit to us, or we will adopt him as a son.” And they were not aware (of what was going to happen).
T. Usmani.28:10: And the heart of the mother of Mūsā became restless; indeed she was about to disclose this (the real facts about Mūsā), had We not strengthened her heart to remain among those who have firm belief (in Allah’s promise).
T. Usmani.28:11: She said to his sister, “Keep track of him.” So she watched him from a distance, while they were not aware.
T. Usmani.28:12: And We had already barred him (Mūsā) from (accepting) any suckling women, so she (his sister) said (to Pharaoh’s people), “Shall I point out to you a family who will nurse him for you, and they will be his well-wishers?”
T. Usmani.28:13: Thus We brought him back to his mother, so that her eye might have comfort and she might not grieve, and so that she might know that Allah’s promise is true, but most of them do not know.
T. Usmani.28:14: And when he reached his maturity and became perfect, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.
T. Usmani.28:15: Once he entered the city at a time when its people were heedless; so he found in it two men fighting each other: This one was from his own group, and that one from his enemies. So the one from his own group called him for help against the one who was from his enemies. So Mūsā gave him a blow with his fist and finished him off. (Then) He (Mūsā) said (out of remorse), “This is some of Satan’s act. He is indeed a clear enemy who misleads (people).”
T. Usmani.28:16: He said, “O my Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.” So He forgave him. Indeed He is the most Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.28:17: He (Mūsā) said, “O my Lord! As You have favored me, I will never be a supporter of the sinners.”
T. Usmani.28:18: Then next morning he was fearful in the city, waiting (for what comes next) when the man who sought his help the day before, shouted to him for help (again). Mūsā said to him, “You are surely a clear trouble-maker.”
T. Usmani.28:19: Thereafter when he intended to grasp at the one who was an enemy to both of them, he (i.e. the Israelite) said, “O Mūsā, do you want to kill me as you have killed a person yesterday? Your intention is only to become a tyrant in the land, and you do not intend to be one of the peace-makers.”
T. Usmani.28:20: And there came a man running from the farthest part of the city. He said, “The chiefs are counseling each other about you, so that they kill you. So, leave (the city). I am one of your well-wishers.”
T. Usmani.28:21: So, he went out of it (the city), looking around in a state of fear. He said, “O my Lord, save me from the cruel people.”
T. Usmani.28:22: When he set out towards Madyan, he said, “I hope my Lord will guide me to the straight path”.
T. Usmani.28:23: And when he arrived at the waters of Madyan, he found a large number of people watering (their animals) and found, aloof from them, two women keeping (their animals) back. He said, “What is the matter with you?” They said, “We cannot water (our animals) until these shepherds take (their animals) back after watering them, and our father is very old man.”
T. Usmani.28:24: So he (Mūsā) watered (their animals) for them, then he turned to a shade and said, “My Lord, I am in need of whatever good you send down to me.”
T. Usmani.28:25: Then one of the two women came to him, walking bashfully. She said, “My father is calling you, so that he may give you a reward for watering our animals. So when he (Mūsā) came to him (the father of the women) and narrated to him the whole story, the latter said, “Do not fear; you have escaped from the wrongdoing people.”
T. Usmani.28:26: One of the two women said, “Dear father, hire him; the best man you can hire is someone who is strong, trustworthy.”
T. Usmani.28:27: He (the father) said (to Mūsā), “I wish to marry to you one of these two daughters of mine on condition that you act as my employee for eight years. Then if you complete ten (years) it will be of your own accord. And I do not want to put you in any trouble; you will find me, Inshā’allah (God-willing) one of the righteous.”
T. Usmani.28:28: He (Mūsā) said, “This is (done) between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I fulfill, there should be no excess against me, and Allah is witness to what we are saying.”
T. Usmani.28:29: So, when Mūsā completed the term and set forth with his wife, he noticed a fire from the direction of (the mount) Tūr, he said to his wife, “Stay here; I have noticed a fire. May be I bring to you some information or an ember from the fire, so that you may warm yourself.”
T. Usmani.28:30: So when he came to it, he was called by a voice coming from a side of the right valley in the blessed ground, from the tree, saying, “O Mūsā, I AM ALLAH, the Lord of the worlds,”
T. Usmani.28:31: and saying, “Throw down your staff.” So when he saw it moving as if it were a snake, he turned back in retreat, and did not look back. (Allah said to him), “O Mūsā come forward and do not fear; you are one of those in peace.
T. Usmani.28:32: Insert your hand into your bosom, and it will come out white without any evil (disease), and press your arm to your side for (removing) fear. Thus these are two proofs from your Lord (sent) to Pharaoh and his chiefs. Indeed they are transgressing people.”
T. Usmani.28:33: He said, “My Lord, I have killed a person from them, therefore I fear that they will kill me.
T. Usmani.28:34: And my brother Hārūn is more eloquent than me in speech; so send him with me as a helper to bear me out. I am afraid, they will give the lie to me.”
T. Usmani.28:35: He (Allah) said, “We will strengthen your arm with your brother, and will give both of you such a power that they will have no access to you (to cause any harm) because of Our signs. You and your followers will be the victors.”
T. Usmani.28:36: So when Mūsā came to them with Our clear signs, they said, “This is nothing but a forged magic, and we have never heard of such a thing happening in the days of our forefathers.”
T. Usmani.28:37: Mūsā said, “My Lord is best aware of the one who has brought guidance from Him and who is going to meet the best end of the abode. It is certain that the wrongdoers will not succeed.”
T. Usmani.28:38: And Pharaoh said (to his people,) “O courtiers, I do not recognize any god for you other than me. So kindle for me, O Hāmān, a fire on the clay (to bake bricks) and build for me a tower, so that I may look on to the God of Mūsā. I deem him to be one of the liars.”
T. Usmani.28:39: (Thus) he and his hosts showed arrogance in the land with no justification and thought that they would not be returned to Us.
T. Usmani.28:40: So We seized him and his hosts and threw them into the sea. Look then, how was the fate of the wrongdoers.
T. Usmani.28:41: We made them leaders who called (people) towards hell; and on the Day of Judgment, they will not be helped.
T. Usmani.28:42: And We made a curse to pursue them in this world; and on the Day of Judgment they will be among those dejected.
T. Usmani.28:43: And We gave Mūsā, after We destroyed the earlier generations, the Book having insights for people and a guidance and mercy, so that they may receive the advice.
T. Usmani.28:44: And (O prophet,) you were not there at the Western side (of the mount Tūr) when We delegated the matter to Mūsā, nor were you among those present,
T. Usmani.28:45: but We created generations (after him) and a long time passed over them. And you were not dwelling among the people of Madyan, reciting Our verses to them, but it is We who do send messengers.
T. Usmani.28:46: And you were not at the side of (the mount) Tūr when We called (Mūsā), but it (your prophet-hood through which you knew all this) is a mercy from your Lord, so that you warn a people to whom no warner has come before you, that they may receive the advice.
T. Usmani.28:47: And (We have sent you as a messenger) lest, in case they suffered a calamity because of what their hands sent ahead, they should say, “Our Lord, why did You not send a messenger to us, so that we might have followed your verses and been among the believers?”
T. Usmani.28:48: But when the Truth came to them from Us, they said, “Why has he (the messenger) not been given (a book) similar to what Mūsā had been given?” Is it not that they denied what Mūsā had been given before? They said, “Both (Qur’ān and Torah) are works of magic that support each other.” And they said, “We disbelieve each one of them.”
T. Usmani.28:49: Say, “Then bring a book from Allah which is better than both, in guidance, and I shall follow it, if you are true.”
T. Usmani.28:50: So if they do not respond to you, be sure that they are only following their desires. And who is more astray than the one who follows his desire without guidance from Allah. Surely Allah does not take the wrongdoing people onto the right path.
T. Usmani.28:51: And We have conveyed (Our) word to them one after the other, so that they may receive the advice.
T. Usmani.28:52: As for those to whom We gave the Book before this, they believe in it (Qur’ān).
T. Usmani.28:53: And when this (Qur’ān) is recited to them, they say, “We believe in it. It is the truth from our Lord, and we are the ones who had submitted (to it) even before it (was revealed).”
T. Usmani.28:54: Such people will be given their reward twice, because they observed patience. And they repel evil with good, and spend from what We have given to them.
T. Usmani.28:55: And when they hear absurd talk, they withdraw from it and say, “Our deeds are for us and your deeds are for you. Peace be on you. We do not desire (to be entangled with) the ignorant people.”
T. Usmani.28:56: You cannot give guidance to whomsoever you wish, but Allah gives guidance to whomsoever He wills, and He best knows the ones who are on the right path.
T. Usmani.28:57: They said, “If we follow the guidance with you (O Muhammad), we will be driven out of our land.” Is it not that We have established them in the peaceful Haram (sanctuary) to which the fruits of everything are drawn as a provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
T. Usmani.28:58: And how many a town have We destroyed that were over-proud of their means of living. Now, those are their habitations, which were never inhabited after them except a few, and We alone were the inheritors.
T. Usmani.28:59: And your Lord is not such as He would destroy the towns unless he had sent to their central place a messenger who recites to them Our verses, nor are We such as would destroy the towns unless their people are wrongdoers.
T. Usmani.28:60: Moreover, whatever of anything you are given is (no more than) an enjoyment of the worldly life and its decoration, and that which lies with Allah is much better and far more lasting. So do you not use reason?
T. Usmani.28:61: Is then the one, to whom We have made a good promise which he is going to meet, like the one whom We have given the benefit of enjoying the worldly life, then on the Day of Judgment he will be among those arraigned?
T. Usmani.28:62: (Remember) the Day when He will call them and say, “Where are My ‘partners’ you used to claim?
T. Usmani.28:63: Those against whom the word will come true will say, “Our Lord, these are the ones whom we led astray. We led them astray as we ourselves went astray. We negate before you our responsibility (in respect of them); it was not we whom they worshipped.”
T. Usmani.28:64: And it will be said, “Call those whom you held as co-gods.” So they will call them, but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. Would that they had taken the right path!
T. Usmani.28:65: (Remember) the Day when He (Allah) will call them and say, “What response did you give to the messengers?”
T. Usmani.28:66: So all events will become too obscure for them (to give a correct reply), and they will not (be able to) consult each other.
T. Usmani.28:67: As for the one who repents and becomes a believer and acts righteously, hopefully he will be among the successful.
T. Usmani.28:68: Your Lord creates what He wills and chooses. Choice is not theirs. Pure is Allah and far higher than their ascribing of partners to Him.
T. Usmani.28:69: Your Lord knows what their hearts conceal and what they reveal.
T. Usmani.28:70: And He is Allah. There is no god but He. Praise is only for Him in the beginning and at the end, and He alone has the right to judge, and to Him you are to be returned.
T. Usmani.28:71: Say, “Tell me, if Allah were to impose the night over you, continuing forever up to the Day of Judgment, which god, other than Allah, would bring to you light? Then, do you not listen?”
T. Usmani.28:72: Say, “Tell me, if Allah were to impose the day over you, continuing for ever up to the Day of Judgment, which god, other than Allah, would bring to you night in which you may have rest? Then, do you not see?”
T. Usmani.28:73: And it is out of His mercy that He has made day and night for you, so that you may have rest in it, and so that you may search for His grace, and so that you may be grateful.
T. Usmani.28:74: And (remember) the Day when He (Allah) will call them (the disbelievers) and say, “Where are My ‘partners’ you used to claim?”
T. Usmani.28:75: And We will draw out a witness from every community (to prove their disbelief) and will say, “Bring your proof”. Then they will know that truth is from Allah, and all that they used to forge shall vanish from them.
T. Usmani.28:76: Indeed Qārūn was from the people of Mūsā, then he rebelled against them. And We had given to him such treasures as their keys would weigh too heavy for a strong group of people. (Remember) when his people said to him, “Do not exult. Surely, Allah does not like the exultant.
