T. Usmani.36:63: (Now) this is the Jahannam of which you were consistently warned.
T. Usmani.36:64: Enter it today, because you have been persistently denying (the truth).”
T. Usmani.36:65: Today We will set a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness about what they used to do.
T. Usmani.36:66: If We so will, We would wipe out their eyes (right here in this world), and they would be racing towards the way, but how would they see?
T. Usmani.36:67: And If We so will, We would disfigure them at their places, and they would not be able to move, nor would they return.
T. Usmani.36:68: And whomsoever We give long life, we reverse him in creation. Then, do they have no sense?
T. Usmani.36:69: We did not teach him (the Holy Prophet) poetry, and it is not proper for him. It is nothing (of that sort,) but (it is) an advice and a readable book that explains (the Truth),
T. Usmani.36:70: so that it may warn him who is alive (to listen to the truth), and so that the word may prove true against the disbelievers.
T. Usmani.36:71: Did they not see that We have created for them cattle, among things made (directly) by Our hands, and then they become their owners?
T. Usmani.36:72: And We have brought them under their control, so as some of them are their means of transport, and some of them they eat.
T. Usmani.36:73: And for them there are (other) benefits in them and things to drink. So, would they not be grateful?
T. Usmani.36:74: They have adopted gods other than Allah, so that they may be helped (by them).
T. Usmani.36:75: They cannot help them, rather they (the disbelievers themselves) are (like) an army brought forth for (protecting) them (the so-called co-gods)
T. Usmani.36:76: So, their remarks must not grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they disclose.
T. Usmani.36:77: Did man not see that We have created him from a drop of semen? Then suddenly he stood as an open adversary (to Us).
T. Usmani.36:78: He has set up an argument about Us and forgot his creation. He said, “Who will give life to the bones when they are decayed?”
T. Usmani.36:79: Say, “These will be revived by the same One who had created them for the first time, and who is fully aware of every creation,
T. Usmani.36:80: - the One who created for you fire from the green tree, and in no time you kindle from it.”
T. Usmani.36:81: Is it that the One who has created the heavens and the earth has no power to create ones like them? Why not? He is the Supreme Creator, the All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.36:82: His practice, when He intends to do something, is no more than He says, “Be”, and it comes to be.
T. Usmani.36:83: So, pure (from every fault) is the One in whose hand is the dominion of all things. And towards Him you are to be returned.
T. Usmani.37:1: (I swear) by those who stand in rows,
T. Usmani.37:2: then by those who prevent firmly,
T. Usmani.37:3: then by those who recite the dhikr,
T. Usmani.37:4: surely your God is but One,
T. Usmani.37:5: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.
T. Usmani.37:6: Verily, We have decorated the nearest sky with an adornment, the stars,
T. Usmani.37:7: and (have made them) a security against every rebellious devil.
T. Usmani.37:8: They cannot listen to the Upper Realm and are hit from every side
T. Usmani.37:9: to be driven off, and for them there is a lasting punishment;
T. Usmani.37:10: however, if one snatches a little bit, he is pursued by a bright flame.
T. Usmani.37:11: Now ask them, “Are they stronger in the formation of their bodies, or those (other beings) that We have created?” Certainly, We did create them from sticky clay.
T. Usmani.37:12: But you wonder (at their denial), and they mock (at the idea of an Hereafter).
T. Usmani.37:13: And when any advice is given to them, they pay no heed to it.
T. Usmani.37:14: And when they see a sign, they make fun of it,
T. Usmani.37:15: and say, “This is nothing but an open magic.
T. Usmani.37:16: Is it when we have died and become dust and bones, that we shall be raised again,
T. Usmani.37:17: and even our fathers of aforetime?”
T. Usmani.37:18: Say, “Yes, and you shall be disgraced (too)!”
T. Usmani.37:19: So, it will be only a single castigating call, and all of a sudden they will begin to see.
T. Usmani.37:20: And they will be saying, “Woe to us; this is the Day of Retribution.”
T. Usmani.37:21: (It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Judgment that you used to deny.”
T. Usmani.37:22: (It will be said to the angels,) “Muster all those who were unjust, and their fellows, and whatever they used to worship
T. Usmani.37:23: other than Allah, and show them the way to Jahannam ,
T. Usmani.37:24: and stop them (for a while,) for they are to be asked some questions.”
T. Usmani.37:25: (Then they will be asked, “What is wrong with you that you do not help each other?”
T. Usmani.37:26: On the contrary, that day all of them will have totally surrendered.
T. Usmani.37:27: And some of them (the followers of their chiefs) will turn to others (the chiefs), asking questions from one another.
T. Usmani.37:28: They (the followers) will say, “You were the ones who used to come to (mislead) us forcefully.”
T. Usmani.37:29: They (the chiefs) will say, “On the contrary, you yourselves were not believers.
T. Usmani.37:30: We had no authority over you at all, but you yourselves were a transgressing people.
T. Usmani.37:31: So, the word of our Lord has come true against us. Indeed, we have to taste (the punishment).
T. Usmani.37:32: We did misguide you, (because) we were ourselves erroneous”.
T. Usmani.37:33: So, that day, they will share each other in punishment.
T. Usmani.37:34: This is how We deal with the criminals.
T. Usmani.37:35: They were those to whom when it was said: “There is no god but Allah”, they waxed proud,
T. Usmani.37:36: and used to say, “Are we really to leave our gods because of an insane poet?”
T. Usmani.37:37: No, he has come with Truth and has confirmed all the messengers (of Allah).
T. Usmani.37:38: Surely you have to taste the painful punishment,-
T. Usmani.37:39: And you will be recompensed for nothing but for what you used to do-
T. Usmani.37:41: Those are the people for whom there is a known provision,
T. Usmani.37:42: the fruits; and they will be honored
T. Usmani.37:45: They will be served with a cup from a flowing drink,
T. Usmani.37:46: (that will be) white (and) delicious for those who drink.
T. Usmani.37:47: There will be no headache therein, nor will they be intoxicated with it,
T. Usmani.37:48: and by their side there will be females restricting their gazes (to their husbands), having pretty big eyes,
T. Usmani.37:49: as if they were eggs hidden (under feathers, protected from pollution).
T. Usmani.37:50: Then they will turn to each other asking questions mutually.
T. Usmani.37:51: A speaker from them will say, “I had a companion (in the worldly life)
T. Usmani.37:52: who used to say (to me), “Are you one of those who believe?
T. Usmani.37:53: Is it when we have died and become dust and bones? Is it true that we are going to be recompensed (for our deeds)?”
T. Usmani.37:54: He (the speaker) will say (to other people in Paradise) “Would you like to have a look (at Jahannam to find out what happened to that companion of mine)?”
T. Usmani.37:55: So he will look and will see him in the middle of Jahannam.
T. Usmani.37:56: He (the speaker) will say (to his companion seen in Jahannam ), “By Allah, you were going almost to ruin me.
T. Usmani.37:57: But for the favor of my Lord, I would have been among those produced for punishment.”
T. Usmani.37:58: (Then the speaker will address other people of Paradise in delight and wonder, saying,) “Are we not then to die anymore
T. Usmani.37:59: beyond our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”
T. Usmani.37:60: This is, indeed, the great achievement.
T. Usmani.37:61: For this kind (of achievement), all workers must work.
T. Usmani.37:62: Is that (blissful Paradise) better for hospitality or the tree of zaqqūm ?
T. Usmani.37:63: We have made it a test for the unjust.
T. Usmani.37:64: It is a tree that comes forth in the bottom of Jahannam.
T. Usmani.37:65: Its fruits are like the heads of devils.
T. Usmani.37:66: So, they have to eat from it and have to fill their bellies with it.
T. Usmani.37:67: Then they will have, on top of it, a mixture made of boiling water.
T. Usmani.37:68: Then, their final return is to the Fire.
T. Usmani.37:69: They found their fathers on the wrong path.
T. Usmani.37:70: So, they used to run in their footsteps.
T. Usmani.37:71: Most of the earlier ones (too) had gone astray before them.
T. Usmani.37:72: We did send warners among them.
T. Usmani.37:73: So look, how was the end of those warned -
T. Usmani.37:75: And NūH did call Us (for help after he was disappointed with his people), so (We accepted his prayer, as) We are the best to respond.
T. Usmani.37:76: And We delivered him and his family from the great agony,
T. Usmani.37:77: and made his progeny the sole survivors (from the Deluge).
T. Usmani.37:78: And We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people, (that is):
T. Usmani.37:79: Salām be on NūH among (the people of) all the worlds.
T. Usmani.37:80: Certainly, this is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.
T. Usmani.37:81: He was one of Our believing servants.
T. Usmani.37:83: And certainly one of his adherents was Ibrāhīm.
T. Usmani.37:84: (Remember) when he came to his Lord with a pure heart,
T. Usmani.37:85: when he said to his father and his people, “What is that which you worship?
T. Usmani.37:86: Do you wish (to have) fallacious gods other than Allah?
T. Usmani.37:87: Then, what do you think about the Lord of the worlds?”
T. Usmani.37:88: Then, he cast a look at the stars,
T. Usmani.37:90: So they went away from him, turning their backs.
T. Usmani.37:91: And he made his way to their ‘gods’ and said to them, “Why would you not eat?
T. Usmani.37:92: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”
T. Usmani.37:93: Then he attacked them striking with his right hand.
T. Usmani.37:94: Then, they (the idolaters) came to him rushing.
T. Usmani.37:95: He said, “Do you worship what is carved by yourselves,
T. Usmani.37:96: while Allah has created you and what you make?”
T. Usmani.37:97: They said, “Build for him a structure, and throw him into the blazing fire.”
T. Usmani.37:98: So, they intended to bring harm to him, but We made them the lowest (by frustrating their plan).
T. Usmani.37:99: And he said, “I am going to my Lord. He will show me the way.
T. Usmani.37:100: O my Lord, bless me with a righteous son.”
T. Usmani.37:101: So, We gave him the good news of a forbearing boy.
T. Usmani.37:102: Thereafter, when he (the boy) reached an age in which he could work with him, he (Ibrāhīm) said, “O my little son, I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you, so consider, what is your opinion?” He said, “O my dear father, do what you have been ordered to do. You will find me, inshā’allah , (if Allah wills) one of those who endure patiently.”
T. Usmani.37:103: So, (it was a great episode) when both of them submitted themselves (to Allah’s will), and he laid him on his forehead (to slaughter him),
T. Usmani.37:104: and then We called out to him, “O Ibrāhīm,
T. Usmani.37:105: you did make the dream come true.” This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.
T. Usmani.37:106: This was indeed a trial that clearly demonstrated (their obedience).
T. Usmani.37:107: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
T. Usmani.37:108: and We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people,
T. Usmani.37:110: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.
T. Usmani.37:111: Surely, he is among Our believing servants.
T. Usmani.37:112: And We gave him the good news of IsHāq (Isaac), a prophet from among the righteous.
T. Usmani.37:113: And We did bless him, and IsHāq. And among the progeny of both of them, some are good and some are utterly unjust to their own selves.
T. Usmani.37:114: Certainly We bestowed favors upon Mūsā and Hārūn,
T. Usmani.37:115: and We delivered them and their people from the great agony,
T. Usmani.37:116: and We helped them, so they became victors,
T. Usmani.37:117: and We gave them the clear book,
T. Usmani.37:118: and guided them to the straight path.
T. Usmani.37:119: And We left for them (a word of praise) among the later people,
T. Usmani.37:120: (that is,) Salām be on Mūsā and Hārūn!
T. Usmani.37:121: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.
T. Usmani.37:122: Surely, both of them were among Our believing servants.
T. Usmani.37:123: And surely, Ilyās is one of the messengers.
T. Usmani.37:124: (Remember) when he said to his people: “Do you not fear Allah?
T. Usmani.37:125: Do you invoke Ba‘l, and ignore the Best of the creators,
T. Usmani.37:126: that is, Allah who is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”
T. Usmani.37:127: Then they rejected him. Therefore, they will be arraigned -
T. Usmani.37:129: And We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people,
T. Usmani.37:131: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.
T. Usmani.37:132: Surely, he was from among Our believing servants.
T. Usmani.37:133: And surely, LūT is one of the messengers.
T. Usmani.37:134: (Remember) when We saved him and his family, all of them,
T. Usmani.37:135: except an old woman among those remaining behind.
T. Usmani.37:137: and you do pass by them at daybreak
T. Usmani.37:138: and by nightfall. Would you still not understand?
T. Usmani.37:139: And surely, Yūnus (Jonah) is from among the messengers.
T. Usmani.37:140: (Remember) when he ran away towards the boat that was already loaded.
T. Usmani.37:141: Then he participated in drawing lots (to offload one of the passengers) and was the one who was defeated.
T. Usmani.37:142: Then the fish swallowed him while he was reproaching his own self.
T. Usmani.37:143: Had he not been of those who proclaim Allah’s purity,
T. Usmani.37:144: he would have definitely lived in its belly till the day when the dead will be raised.
T. Usmani.37:145: Then We cast him ashore in the open while he was ill,
T. Usmani.37:146: and We caused a tree of ourds to grow over him.
T. Usmani.37:147: And We had sent him (as messenger) to one hundred thousand, or more.
T. Usmani.37:148: So, they believed, then, We let them enjoy for a time.
T. Usmani.37:149: So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”
T. Usmani.37:150: Or, had We created angels as females while they were witnessing?
T. Usmani.37:151: Beware! They are the ones who, by way of a lie of theirs, (have the audacity to) say,
T. Usmani.37:152: “Allah has children” - and they are absolute liars.
T. Usmani.37:153: Is it that Allah has chosen daughters (for Himself) instead of sons?
T. Usmani.37:154: What is the matter with you? How (arbitrarily) do you judge?
T. Usmani.37:155: Then, is it that you do not think about it?
T. Usmani.37:156: Or, is it that there is some open authority with you?
T. Usmani.37:157: Then bring your book, if you are truthful.
T. Usmani.37:158: And they have made up between Him (Allah) and the Jinns some kinship, while the Jinns already know that they are bound to be seized.-
T. Usmani.37:159: -Pure is Allah from what they describe-
T. Usmani.37:161: So, you and those whom you worship,
T. Usmani.37:162: none of you can make anyone turn away from Him (Allah),
T. Usmani.37:163: except him who is to burn in Jahannam.
T. Usmani.37:164: And (the angels say,) “There is no one among us who does not have a known station,
T. Usmani.37:165: and We, surely We, are those who stand in rows
T. Usmani.37:166: and We, surely We, are those who proclaim Allah’s purity.”
T. Usmani.37:167: And they (the pagans) used to say,
T. Usmani.37:168: “Had there been a scripture with us like that of the former people,
T. Usmani.37:169: we would have certainly been Allah’s chosen servants.”
T. Usmani.37:170: Then (once the divine book came to them,) they disbelieved in it. So, very soon they will come to know.
T. Usmani.37:171: And Our Word has already come to pass in favor of Our servants, the messengers
T. Usmani.37:172: (that) they are the ones who will be supported,
T. Usmani.37:173: and verily it is Our army (of chosen servants) that prevails.
T. Usmani.37:174: So, withdraw your attention from them for some time.
T. Usmani.37:175: But, watch them. They shall soon see (the reality).
T. Usmani.37:176: Are they asking for Our punishment to come sooner?
T. Usmani.37:177: So, when it will descend in their courtyard, then, evil will be the morning of those warned.
T. Usmani.37:178: So, withdraw your attention from them for some time,
T. Usmani.37:179: and watch. They shall soon see (the reality).
T. Usmani.37:180: Pure is your Lord, the Lord of all might and honor, from what they describe
T. Usmani.37:181: and Salām be on the messengers
T. Usmani.37:182: and praised is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
T. Usmani.38:1: Sād . I swear by the Qur’ān, (the book) containing advice, (this is true,)
T. Usmani.38:2: but those who disbelieve are (involved) in false pride and opposition.
T. Usmani.38:3: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, so they cried out (for mercy), while no time was left for having any refuge.
T. Usmani.38:4: They (the pagans) wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a sheer liar.
T. Usmani.38:5: Has he (not) turned all the gods into a single God? It is a very strange thing indeed.”
T. Usmani.38:6: And the leaders among them walked out saying (to their followers), “Walk away (from the Prophet,) and stay firm on (adhering to) your gods. This (call of the Prophet) is surely something designed (for his personal benefit).
T. Usmani.38:7: We never heard of it in the classical faith (of ours). This is nothing but a false invention.
T. Usmani.38:8: Is it (believable) that the message of advice has been sent down to him (alone) from among all of us?” The fact is that they are in doubt about My message; rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
T. Usmani.38:9: Do they have the treasures of the mercy of your Lord, the Mighty, the Bountiful?
T. Usmani.38:10: Or do they have the ownership of the heavens and the earth and what lies between them? Then let them ascend (to the sky) by ropes.
T. Usmani.38:11: What is there (in Makkah) is just a host of the (opposing) groups that has to be defeated.
T. Usmani.38:12: Even before them, the people of NūH and ‘Ād and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of stakes,
T. Usmani.38:13: and Thamūd and the people of LūT and the people of Aaikah have rejected (the messengers). They were the (strong) groups.
T. Usmani.38:14: All of them did nothing but declare the messengers as liars; hence, My punishment became due.
T. Usmani.38:15: And these people are waiting for nothing but for a single Cry (the sound of the Trumpet to be blown on Doomsday) that will have no pause.
T. Usmani.38:16: And they say, “O our Lord, give us our share (of the punishment) sooner, before the Day of Reckoning.”
T. Usmani.38:17: Bear patiently with what they say, and remember Our servant Dawūd, the man of might. Surely he was ever-turning to Allah.
T. Usmani.38:18: We had subjugated the mountains to join him (in) making tasbīH (i.e. pronouncing Allah’s purity) at evening and sunrise,
T. Usmani.38:19: and the birds as well, mustered together. All were turning to Allah with him.
T. Usmani.38:20: And We made his kingdom strong, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
T. Usmani.38:21: Has there come to you the story of the litigants, when they entered the sanctuary by climbing over the wall?
T. Usmani.38:22: When they entered upon Dawūd, and he was scared of them, they said, “Be not scared. We are two litigants; one of us has wronged the other, so decide between us with truth, and do not cross the limits, and guide us to the right path.
T. Usmani.38:23: This is my brother; he has ninety nine ewes, and I have a single ewe; still he said, ‘Give it into my charge.’ And he overpowered me in speech.”
T. Usmani.38:24: He (Dawūd) said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding your ewe to be added to his ewe. Many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and very few they are.” And Dawūd realized that We had put him to a test, so he prayed to his Lord for forgiveness, and bowing down, he fell in prostration, and turned (to Allah).
T. Usmani.38:25: So we forgave him that (lapse), and surely he has a place of nearness in Our presence, and an excellent resort.
T. Usmani.38:26: O Dawūd, We have made you a vicegerent on earth, so judge between people with truth, and do not follow the selfish desire, lest it should lead you astray from Allah’s path. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s path will have a severe punishment, because they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.
T. Usmani.38:27: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them in vain. That is the thinking of those who disbelieve. So, woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire (they have to face).
T. Usmani.38:28: Shall We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who commit mischief on the earth? Or shall We make the God-fearing equal to the sinners?
T. Usmani.38:29: This is a blessed Book We have revealed to you, so that they deliberate in its verses, and so that the men of understanding may heed to advice.
T. Usmani.38:30: And We blessed Dawūd with Sulaimān. He was an excellent servant (of Allah). Surely, he was great in turning (to Us, in penitence and praise).
T. Usmani.38:31: (Worth remembering is the incident) when the swift horses of high breeding were presented before him in the evening.
T. Usmani.38:32: He said, “I held the love of the good things (i.e. these horses) because of the remembrance of my Lord.” until it went behind the veil.
T. Usmani.38:33: (Then he said,) “Bring them back to me” - and he started passing his hands over the shanks and the necks (of the horses).
T. Usmani.38:34: And indeed We tested Sulaimān while We threw on his throne a body after which he turned (to Us).
T. Usmani.38:35: He said, “O my Lord, forgive me, and bless me with a kingdom that will not be available to anyone after me. Surely, You are the Bountiful.”
T. Usmani.38:36: Then We subjugated the wind for him that blew smoothly on his command to wherever he wished,
T. Usmani.38:37: and (We subjugated to him) the devils (among Jinns), all builders and divers,
T. Usmani.38:38: and many others held in chains.
T. Usmani.38:39: This is Our gift. So, do favor (to someone) or withhold (it), with no (requirement to give) account.
T. Usmani.38:40: He has a place of nearness in Our presence, and an excellent end.
T. Usmani.38:41: And remember Our servant, Ayyūb - when he called his Lord saying, “The ShaiTān (Satan) has inflicted weariness and pain upon me.”
T. Usmani.38:42: (Allah said to him,) “Strike (the ground) with your foot: Here is a cool water to bathe, and a drink!”
T. Usmani.38:43: And We let him have his family and the like of them besides, as a mercy from Us, and a reminder for the people of understanding.
T. Usmani.38:44: And (We said to him,) “Take (a bundle of) thin twigs in your hand, and strike with it, and do not violate your oath. Surely, We found him very enduring. He was really an excellent servant. Surely, he was great in turning (to Us, in penitence and praise).
T. Usmani.38:45: And remember Our servants - Ibrāhīm and IsHāq and Ya‘qūb - the men of strength and the men of vision.
T. Usmani.38:46: We chose them for a trait of remembering the (eternal) Home (in the Hereafter).
T. Usmani.38:47: And surely they are, in Our sight, among the chosen, the best of the righteous.
T. Usmani.38:48: And remember Ismā‘īl and Al-Yasa‘ and Dhul-Kifl. Each one of them was among the best of the righteous.
T. Usmani.38:49: This is a reminder (of what has passed). And surely the God-fearing will have the best place to return:
T. Usmani.38:50: - everlasting gardens, with (their) doors opened for them.
T. Usmani.38:51: They will be relaxing in it, calling there for plenteous fruits and drinks;
T. Usmani.38:52: and in their company there will be females restricting their glances (to their husbands, and) of matching ages.
T. Usmani.38:53: This is what you are being promised for the Day of Reckoning.
T. Usmani.38:54: Surely, that is provision provided by Us, to which there is no end.
T. Usmani.38:55: Having said this, the transgressors will surely have the most evil place to return:
T. Usmani.38:56: the Jahannam , in which they will enter. So, how evil is that place to rest?
T. Usmani.38:57: Let them taste this: hot water and pus,
T. Usmani.38:58: and other things similar to it of various kinds.
T. Usmani.38:59: (When the leaders of the infidels will see their followers entering the Hell after them, they will say to each other,) “This is a multitude rushing into (the Hell) with you - they are not welcome - they are to burn in the Fire.”
T. Usmani.38:60: They (the followers) will say (to their leaders) “No, it is you who are not welcome; you are the ones who brought this upon us.” So, how evil is the place to stay (for ever)!”
T. Usmani.38:61: They (the followers) will say, “Our Lord, whoever has brought this on us, do increase his punishment twofold in the Fire.”
T. Usmani.38:62: And they (the infidels) will say, “What is the matter with us that we do not see those men (here in Hell) whom we used to count amongst the worst? (i.e the Muslims whom the infidels used to treat as the worst people among them)
T. Usmani.38:63: Had we taken them as a laughing-stock (unjustly), or have our eyes missed them?”
T. Usmani.38:64: That is going to happen definitely, that is, the mutual quarrel of the people of the Fire.
T. Usmani.38:65: Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god but Allah, the One, the All-Dominant,
T. Usmani.38:66: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Mighty, the Very-Forgiving.”
T. Usmani.38:69: I had no knowledge of the Heavenly Beings when they were debating (about the creation of ’Ādam).
T. Usmani.38:70: Revelation is sent to me only because I am a plain warner.
T. Usmani.38:71: When your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create man from clay.
T. Usmani.38:72: So, once I make him perfectly and breath My spirit into him, you must fall down in prostration before him.”
T. Usmani.38:73: Then, the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together -
T. Usmani.38:74: except Iblīs (Satan). He waxed proud, and became one of the disbelievers.
T. Usmani.38:75: He (Allah) said, “O Iblīs, what did prevent you from prostrating yourself before what I created with My hands? Did you wax proud or were you among the lofty ones?”
T. Usmani.38:76: He said, “I am better than him. You created me from fire, and created him from clay.”
T. Usmani.38:77: He said, “Then, get out from here, for you are accursed,
T. Usmani.38:78: and on you shall remain My curse till the Day of Judgment.”
T. Usmani.38:79: He said, “O my Lord, then give me respite till the day they are raised again.”
T. Usmani.38:80: He said, “Then, you have been given respite,
T. Usmani.38:81: until the Day of the Appointed Time.”
T. Usmani.38:82: He said, “Then, I swear by Your Might, that I will definitely lead them astray, all of them -
T. Usmani.38:83: except Your chosen servants among them.”
T. Usmani.38:84: He (Allah) said, “Then, the truth is-and it is (always) the truth that I speak-
T. Usmani.38:85: that I will definitely fill the Jahannam with you and with those who will follow you from among them, all together.”
T. Usmani.38:86: Say (O Prophet to the unbelievers,) “I do not demand from you any fee for it, nor am I from among those who make up things artificially.
T. Usmani.38:87: It is nothing but an advice for all the worlds.
T. Usmani.38:88: And you will come to know its reality after a while.”
T. Usmani.39:1: This is the revelation of the Book from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
T. Usmani.39:2: Surely We have revealed the Book to you with truth; so worship Allah making your submission exclusive for Him.
T. Usmani.39:3: Remember, Allah alone deserves the exclusive submission. As for those who have adopted guardians other than Him (saying), “We worship them for no other reason but because they would bring us near to Allah closely”, Allah will judge between them in the matters in which they are differing. Surely, Allah does not guide anyone who is liar, highly infidel.
T. Usmani.39:4: Had Allah opted to have a son of His own, He would have definitely chosen anyone, as He wished, out of what He had created. (But), Pure is He. He is Allah, the Only One, the All-Dominant.
T. Usmani.39:5: He created the heavens and the earth for just purpose. He wraps the night over the day and He wraps the day over the night, and He has put the sun and the moon under His command, each one of them moving for an appointed term. Remember, He is the Mighty, the Most-Forgiving.
T. Usmani.39:6: He created you from a single person, then (once this person was created,) He made his match from him, and sent down for you eight pairs of the cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in three layers of darkness. That is your Allah, your Lord. To Him belongs the whole Kingdom. There is no god but He. Then, to where are you being diverted (by your whims)?
T. Usmani.39:7: If you disbelieve, then, Allah does not need you at all, however He does not like for His servants to be disbelievers; and if you are grateful, He will like it for you. No one will bear the burden of someone else. Then, to your Lord is your return; so He will tell you about what you used to do. He is aware of whatever lies in the hearts.
T. Usmani.39:8: And when man is afflicted by pain, he calls his Lord turning to Him passionately. Thereafter, when He blesses him with some favor from Him, he forgets that for which he was calling Him earlier, and sets up partners for Allah, so that he leads others astray from His way. Say, “Enjoy (the pleasure of) your disbelief for a while, (then) surely, you are from among the people of the Fire.”
T. Usmani.39:9: Can (such people be equal to) the one who worships during the hours of night, prostrating himself and standing, fearing the Hereafter and having hopes in his Lord’s mercy? Say, “Can those who know and those who do not know become equal?” It is only the people of understanding who are receptive of the advice.
T. Usmani.39:10: Say (on My behalf) “O My servants who believe, fear your Lord. Those who do good deeds in this world will have a good return, and the earth of Allah is wide. Certainly those who observe patience will be given their reward in full without measure.
T. Usmani.39:11: Say, “I have been ordered to worship Allah, making my submission exclusive to Him.
T. Usmani.39:12: And I have been ordered to be the first of those who submit.”
T. Usmani.39:13: Say, “If I were to disobey my Lord, I fear the punishment of a great day.”
T. Usmani.39:14: Say, “It is Allah whom I worship, making my submission exclusive to Him.
T. Usmani.39:15: So, worship what you wish other than Him.” Say, “Indeed, the losers are those who (will) lose their selves and their people on the Day of Judgment. Beware, that is really the obvious loss.”
T. Usmani.39:16: For them there are canopies of fire on top of them and canopies (of fire) underneath them. That is the thing against which Allah warns His servants. “So, O servants of Mine, fear Me.”
T. Usmani.39:17: And those who abstain from worshipping the Tāghūt and turn fervently to Allah, for them there is good news. So, give the good news to My servants
T. Usmani.39:18: who listen to what is said, then, follow the best of it. Those are the ones whom Allah has guided, and those are the ones who possess understanding.
T. Usmani.39:19: So tell Me about the one for whom the word of punishment is destined, - is it you, then, who would save someone who is already in the Fire?
T. Usmani.39:20: But, for those who fear their Lord, there are chambers with chambers built on top of them, with rivers running from underneath them. This is Allah’s promise. Allah does not go back on any promise.
T. Usmani.39:21: Have you not seen that Allah sent down water from the sky, then made it penetrate into the earth (and gush forth) in the form of springs? Then He brings forth with it crops of different colors, and afterwards they wither, and you see them turned yellow, then He makes them chaff. Surely in that there is a lesson for the people of understanding.
T. Usmani.39:22: So I ask about a person whose heart Allah has opened up for Islam, and consequently he proceeds in a light from his Lord. (Can he be equal to the one whose heart is hardened?) So, woe to those whose hearts are too hard to remember Allah. Those are wandering in open error.
T. Usmani.39:23: Allah has sent down the best discourse, a book containing subjects resembling each other, mentioned again and again, shivered from which are the skins of those who have awe of their Lord. Then, their skins and their hearts become soft enough to tend to the remembrance of Allah. This is the Guidance of Allah with which He brings to the right path whomsoever He wills. As for the one whom Allah lets go astray, for him there is no one to guide.
T. Usmani.39:24: Tell Me about the one who tries to save himself from the worst punishment with his face on the Day of Judgment, (whether he is equal to the one who is not liable to any punishment.) And it will be said to the wrongdoers, “Have a taste of what you used to earn.”
T. Usmani.39:25: Those before them had also rejected (the messengers) and consequently, the punishment came upon them in a way that they had never imagined.
T. Usmani.39:26: Then Allah made them taste disgrace in the worldly life, and of course the punishment of the Hereafter is much greater. Only if they knew!
T. Usmani.39:27: And We have cited for people all sorts of examples in this Qur’ān, so that they may receive the message
T. Usmani.39:28: through an Arabic Qur’ān that has no digression (from the truth), so that they may be God-fearing.
T. Usmani.39:29: Allah has given an example: There is a man (enslaved and) owned by some partners having rivalry with each other, and (on the other hand,) there is a man solely owned by a single man. Can they be equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! (The truth stands established). But, most of them do not know.
T. Usmani.39:30: Verily, you are to die and they are to die.
T. Usmani.39:31: After that, on the Day of Doom, you will surely place your disputes before your Lord.
T. Usmani.39:32: So, who is more unjust than him who forges a lie against Allah and rejects the truth when it reached him? Is it not that in Jahannam (Hell) there is an abode for the disbelievers?
T. Usmani.39:33: As for the one who has come with the truth and believed it to be true, then such people are the ones who are God-fearing.
T. Usmani.39:34: For them, with their Lord, there is what they wish. That is the reward of those who are good in their deeds,
T. Usmani.39:35: so that Allah wipes out from them the worst deeds they did, and gives their reward to them for the best of what they used to do.
T. Usmani.39:36: Is Allah not sufficient for (the protection of) His slave? They are frightening you of those (false gods whom they worship) other than Him. Whomsoever Allah would let go astray, for him there is no one to guide.
T. Usmani.39:37: And whomsoever Allah gives guidance, for him there is no one to misguide. Is it not that Allah is Mighty, Powerful to avenge?
T. Usmani.39:38: If you ask them as to who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “Allah.” Say, “Then, tell me about those whom you invoke other than Allah, if Allah intends to cause some harm to me, are they (able) to remove the harm caused by Him? Or if He intends to bless me with mercy, are they (able) to hold back His mercy (from me)?” Say, “Allah is sufficient for me. In Him trust those who (rightly) trust (in someone).”
T. Usmani.39:39: Say, “O my people, do at your place (what you are doing). I am to do (what I have been ordered to). Very soon, you will come to know
T. Usmani.39:40: as to who will be visited by a punishment that will disgrace him, and upon whom a lasting punishment will rest.
T. Usmani.39:41: We have sent down to you the Book for the people with truth. So, whoever follows the guidance, it is for his own good, and whoever goes astray, he will go astray only to his own detriment - and you are not responsible for them.
T. Usmani.39:42: Allah fully takes away the souls (of the people) at the time of their death, and (of) those who do not die, in their sleep. Then He withholds those on whom He had decreed death, and sends others back, up to an appointed term. Surely, in this, there are signs for a people who ponder.
T. Usmani.39:43: Is it that they have adopted intercessors out of those (whom they invoke) other than Allah? Say, “(Do you take them as intercessors) even though they have no power at all, nor do they understand?”
T. Usmani.39:44: Say, “Intercession belongs entirely to Allah.” To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.”
T. Usmani.39:45: When Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are filled with disgust, and when those (whom they worship) other than Him are mentioned, they become happy forthwith.
T. Usmani.39:46: Say, “O Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, the Knower of the unseen and the seen, you will judge between Your servants in that about which they used to differ.
T. Usmani.39:47: Were the wrongdoers to own all that is on earth, and even twice as much, they would surely seek to ransom themselves with it against the evil punishment on the Day of Judgment. There will appear to them from Allah what they have never imagined.
T. Usmani.39:48: Unveiled to them will be the evils of what they used to earn; and encircled they will be by what they used to ridicule.
T. Usmani.39:49: When man is visited by a trouble, he prays to Us, but when, after that, We favor him with some blessing from Us, he says, “This is given to me because of (my) knowledge.” No, but this is a trial, yet most of them do not know.
T. Usmani.39:50: The same was said by those before them, but what they used to earn was of no avail to them,
T. Usmani.39:51: and they were overtaken by the evils of what they had earned; and the wrongdoers from these (infidels too) will be overtaken by the evils of what they have earned - and they will not be able to escape.
T. Usmani.39:52: Do they not know that it is Allah who extends provision to whomsoever He wills, and straitens (it for whomsoever He wills). Surely in that, there are signs for a people who believe.
T. Usmani.39:53: Say (on My behalf), “O servants of Mine who have acted recklessly against their own selves, do not despair of Allah’s mercy. Surely, Allah will forgive all sins. Surely, He is the One who is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.39:54: Turn passionately towards your Lord, and submit to Him before the punishment comes to you, after which you will not be helped.
T. Usmani.39:55: And follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Lord before the punishment comes to you suddenly when you do not even expect,
T. Usmani.39:56: lest someone should say, “Pity on me, because I fell short in respect of (observing the rights of) Allah and in fact, I was one of those who mocked”,
T. Usmani.39:57: or, (lest) someone should say, “If Allah were to show me the way, I would have surely been among those who fear Allah”,
T. Usmani.39:58: or, (lest) someone should say when he sees the punishment, “Would that I have a chance to return, so that I may become one of those who are good in their deeds.”
T. Usmani.39:59: No! My verses had reached you, but you called them untrue, and waxed proud, and became of those who disbelieved.
T. Usmani.39:60: And on the Day of Judgment, you will see those who had forged lies against Allah (in a state) that their faces are turned black. Is it not that in Jahannam there is an abode for the arrogant?
T. Usmani.39:61: And Allah will save the God-fearing (from Jahannam ), with utmost success granted to them, so as no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
T. Usmani.39:62: Allah is Creator of everything, and He is the Guardian over everything.
T. Usmani.39:63: To Him belong the keys to the heavens and the earth. As for those who have rejected the verses of Allah, it is they who are the losers.
T. Usmani.39:64: Say, “Is it, then, someone other than Allah that you ask me to worship, O ignorant people?”
T. Usmani.39:65: It has already been revealed to you and to those before you (that): If you associate (partners with Allah), your deeds shall be rendered useless, and you shall be among the losers.
T. Usmani.39:66: On the contrary, it is Allah whom you should worship; and be among the grateful.
T. Usmani.39:67: They did not hold Allah in His true esteem. The whole earth will be in a single grip of His hand on the Day of Doom, and the heavens (will be) rolled up on his right hand. Pure is He, far too higher than what they associate with Him.
T. Usmani.39:68: And Horn (Sūr ) will be blown, and all those in the heavens and all those in the earth will faint, except the one whom Allah wills (otherwise). Thereafter, it will be blown once again, and suddenly they will stand up, looking around.
T. Usmani.39:69: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the book (of everyone’s deeds) will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and matters will be decided between them with justice, and they will not be wronged.
T. Usmani.39:70: And everyone will be paid in full for what he did - and He knows best what they do.
T. Usmani.39:71: Those who disbelieved will be driven towards Jahannam in groups, until when they reach it, its gates will be opened, and its keepers will say to them, “Did messengers from among you not come to you reciting to you the verses of your Lord, and warning you about the meeting of this day of yours?” They will say, “Yes (they did),but the word of punishment had become certain against those who disbelieved.”
T. Usmani.39:72: It will be said, “Enter the gates of Jahannam to live in it forever.” So, how evil is the dwelling-place of the arrogant!
T. Usmani.39:73: And those who used to fear their Lord will be led towards Jannah (Paradise) in groups, until when they reach it, while its gates will be (already) opened (for them), and its keepers will say to them, “Salāmun-’alaikum (peace be on you). How good are you! So, enter it to live here forever.”
T. Usmani.39:74: And they will say, “AlHamdulillāh : Praise belongs to Allah who made His promise come true for us, and made us inherit the territory, so as we can dwell anywhere we wish in Jannah (Paradise) . So, excellent is the reward of those who did (good) deeds.
T. Usmani.39:75: And you will see the angels ringed around the Throne proclaiming the purity of their Lord, along with His praise, and matters will stand settled between them rightfully, and it will be said: “AlHamdulillāhi-rabbil‘ālamīn : Praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.”
T. Usmani.40:2: This is revelation of the Book from Allah, the Mighty, the All-Knowing,
T. Usmani.40:3: the One who forgives sins and accepts repentance, the One who is severe in punishment, the One who is the source of all power. There is no god but He. To Him is the ultimate return (of all).
T. Usmani.40:4: No one quarrels about the verses of Allah, except those who disbelieve. So, their (prosperous) movements in the cities should not deceive you.
T. Usmani.40:5: Before these, the people of NūH and the groups after them had rejected (the messengers). Every group intended to seize their messenger, and raised disputes on the basis of falsehood, so that they might refute the truth with it, hence I seized them. So, how was My punishment?
T. Usmani.40:6: And similarly, the word of your Lord has become due against those who disbelieve-that they are the people of the Fire.
T. Usmani.40:7: Those who are bearing the Throne and those who are around it pronounce the purity of your Lord along with His praise, and believe in Him, and pray for the forgiveness of those who believe, (saying): “Our Lord, Your mercy and knowledge comprehends everything; so forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and save them from the punishment of the Fire.
T. Usmani.40:8: And, our Lord, admit them to the eternal gardens of Jannah (Paradise) that You have promised for them, and (admit) those as well who did good from among their fathers and wives and children. You, only You, are the Mighty, the Wise,
T. Usmani.40:9: and save them from evils (of punishment). And whomsoever you save from evils that day, it is surely because you bless him with mercy. And that is the great achievement indeed.”
T. Usmani.40:10: Those who disbelieve will be addressed (by a voice saying): “Allah’s hatred (for you), when you were invited to the true faith and you refused, was greater than your hatred for yourselves (today when you are hating your own selves out of remorse).
T. Usmani.40:11: They will say, “Our Lord, You gave us death twice and You gave us life twice. Now we confess our sins. So, is there any way to come out of here?”
T. Usmani.40:12: (The reply will be, “No.) This is because whenever Allah alone was invoked, you used to disbelieve, and if partners were associated with Him, you used to believe. Now the decision lies with Allah, the High, the Great.”
T. Usmani.40:13: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down provision for you from the sky; and no one takes lesson but the one who turns to Him.
T. Usmani.40:14: So, worship Allah, making your submission exclusive for Him, even though the disbelievers dislike (it).
T. Usmani.40:15: He is High in stations, the Lord of the Throne. He sends the spirit down, under His command, on whomever He wills from among His servants, so that he warns of the Day of Encounter -
T. Usmani.40:16: the day they will come in open view. Nothing about them will remain hidden from Allah. To whom belongs the kingdom today? To Allah alone, the One, the All-Dominant.
T. Usmani.40:17: Today, everyone will be recompensed for what one earned. There is no injustice today. Surely, Allah is swift in reckoning.
T. Usmani.40:18: And warn them of the Day of approaching horror, when hearts will jump up into the throats, (and they will be) choked. There will be neither a friend for the unjust, nor an intercessor to be listened to.
T. Usmani.40:19: He knows the treachery of the eyes and whatever is concealed by hearts.
T. Usmani.40:20: He will give His judgment with truth. And those whom they invoke beside Him cannot judge anything. Surely, it is Allah who is Hearing, Seeing.
T. Usmani.40:21: Have they not traveled through the earth and seen how was the fate of those who used to be before them? They were stronger than these in power and in traces left on the earth, but Allah seized them because of their sins. There was no one to save them from Allah.
T. Usmani.40:22: That was because messengers used to come to them with clear signs, but they disbelieved. Then, Allah seized them. Surely, He is Strong, severe in punishment.
T. Usmani.40:23: Indeed We sent Mūsā with Our signs and a manifest proof
T. Usmani.40:24: to Pharaoh and Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, “He is a sorcerer, a liar.”
T. Usmani.40:25: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who have accepted faith with him, and spare the lives of their women.” But the plot of the disbelievers is nothing but a failure.
T. Usmani.40:26: And Pharaoh said, “Let me kill Mūsā, and let him call his Lord. I am afraid that he will change your religion or he will cause havoc to appear in the land.”
T. Usmani.40:27: And Mūsā said, “I have sought protection of my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant man who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”
T. Usmani.40:28: And said a believing man from the House of Pharaoh who had kept his faith secret, “Would you kill a man because he says - ‘Allah is my Lord’ - while he has come to you with clear signs from your Lord? If he is a liar, his lie will fall back on himself, and if he is truthful, some of that (punishment) of which he warns you will afflict you. Indeed, Allah does not give guidance to anyone who is transgressor, a liar.
T. Usmani.40:29: O my people, the kingdom is yours today, while you are dominant on the land. But, who is going to help us against Allah’s punishment, if it comes upon us?” Pharaoh said, “I do not give you an opinion unless I myself believe it to be correct, and I do not direct you to anything but to the right way.”
T. Usmani.40:30: Said he who had believed, “I fear for you something like a day of the (disbelieving) groups (of the past),
T. Usmani.40:31: like the fate of the people of NūH and ‘Ād and Thamūd and those who were after them - and Allah does not intend to do any injustice to His servants.
T. Usmani.40:32: And O my people, I fear for you a day in which people will call one another,
T. Usmani.40:33: a day when you will turn back on your heels, having no one to save you from Allah - but, whomever Allah lets go astray, for him there is no one to guide.
T. Usmani.40:34: And Yūsuf had already come to you earlier with clear signs, but you remained in suspicion about what he brought to you - until when he died, you said, ‘Allah will never send a messenger after him.’ That is how Allah lets go astray anyone who crosses limits and lives in doubt, -
T. Usmani.40:35: those who quarrel in Allah’s verses without any authority having reached them. It is terribly hateful with Allah and with those who believe. That is how Allah stamps a seal on the entire heart of an arrogant tyrant.”
T. Usmani.40:36: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said, “O Hāmān, make a tower for me, perhaps I could reach the ways -
T. Usmani.40:37: the ways to the heavens, and peek towards the God of Mūsā. And indeed I deem him a liar.” That is how his evil deeds were made attractive to Fir‘aun, and (how) he was held back from the way. The evil design of Fir‘aun was (to end) in nothing but ruin.
T. Usmani.40:38: And said he who had believed, “O my people, follow me, I will show you the path of guidance.
T. Usmani.40:39: O my people, this life of the world is only a (momentary) benefit, while the Hereafter is, indeed, the place of permanent living.
T. Usmani.40:40: The one who does something evil will not be punished but in its equal proportion, but the one who does a righteous deed, be he male or female, while he is a believer, then, such people will enter the Jannah (Paradise) where they will be provided with bounties beyond reckoning.
T. Usmani.40:41: And O my people, what is wrong with me that I call you to salvation and you call me to the Fire?
T. Usmani.40:42: You invite me to reject my belief in Allah and ascribe to Him partners about whom I have no knowledge, while I invite you to (Him who is) the Mighty, the Most-Forgiving.
T. Usmani.40:43: It is obvious that those (gods) to whom you are inviting me are not worth calling, neither in this world nor in the world to come, and that we have to return back to Allah, and that the transgressors are indeed the people of the Fire.
T. Usmani.40:44: Soon you will remember what I am saying to you. And I entrust my matter with Allah. Surely, Allah has all (His) servants in sight.”
T. Usmani.40:45: Then Allah saved him from the evils of what they designed, and the House of Pharaoh was encircled by an evil punishment.
T. Usmani.40:46: It is the Fire before which they are presented morning and evening. And on the day when the Hour (of final judgment) will take place, (the order will be released,): “Admit the family of Pharaoh into the most severe punishment.”
T. Usmani.40:47: And (worth remembering is the time) when they (the infidels) will argue with each other in the Fire. So, the weak will say to those who were arrogant, “Surely, we used to be your followers, would you, then, stand for us in (suffering at least a) part of the (punishment of) Fire?”
T. Usmani.40:48: Those who were arrogant will say, “We all are in it. Allah has already passed the judgment between (His) servants.
T. Usmani.40:49: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Jahannam (Hell), “Pray to your Lord to lighten the punishment for us some day.”
T. Usmani.40:50: They will say, “Had your messengers not been coming to you with open signs?” They will say, “Of course, (they had come).” They (the keepers) will say, “Then, keep praying” - but praying of disbelievers (in the Hereafter) is only in vain.
T. Usmani.40:51: Surely, We do help Our messengers and the believers, in the worldly life, as well as (we will help them) on the day in which witnesses will stand (to give their testimony)-
T. Usmani.40:52: a day when apology of the unjust will bring them no benefit, and on them shall be the curse, and for them will be the evil abode.
T. Usmani.40:53: We gave Guidance to Mūsā, while We made the children of Isrā’īl inherit the Book -
T. Usmani.40:54: as a guide and advice for people of understanding.
T. Usmani.40:55: So, be patient - surely the promise of Allah is true - and seek forgiveness for your sins, and proclaim the purity and praise of your Lord in the afternoon and at dawn.
T. Usmani.40:56: Surely, those who quarrel in Allah’s verses without any authority having reached them, there is nothing in their hearts but pride of greatness that they are not (able) to reach. So, seek refuge with Allah. Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
T. Usmani.40:57: Certainly, the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of human beings, but most human beings do not know.
T. Usmani.40:58: The blind one and the sighted one are not equal, and those who believed and did good deeds and the evil ones are not (equal) either. Little you heed to the advice!
T. Usmani.40:59: Certainly, the Hour is bound to come. There is no doubt in it, but most of the people do not believe.
T. Usmani.40:60: Your Lord has said, “Call Me, I will respond to you. Definitely those who show arrogance against worshipping Me shall enter Jahannam (Hell) with disgrace.
T. Usmani.40:61: Allah is the One who made for you the night, so that you may have rest in it, and the day to let you see. Surely, Allah is most kind to people, but most of the people do not offer gratitude.
T. Usmani.40:62: This is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Then, from where are you being reversed (by your selfish desires)?
T. Usmani.40:63: Similarly reversed were those who used to deny Our verses.
T. Usmani.40:64: Allah is the One who made for you the earth a place to live, and the sky a roof, and shaped you, and made your shapes so good - and provided you with a lot of good things. That is Allah, your Lord. So, Glorious is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.40:65: He is Ever-living. There is no god but He. So worship Him making your submission exclusive for Him. All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
T. Usmani.40:66: Say, “I have been ordered not to worship those whom you invoke beside Allah when clear signs from my Lord have (already) come to me, and I have been ordered that I should submit to the Lord of the worlds.”
T. Usmani.40:67: He is the One who created you from dust, then from a drop of semen, then from a clot. After that, He takes you out as an infant. Then, (He makes you grow) so that you reach your full maturity, and, thereafter, become old - and some of you die earlier - and so that you reach the appointed term, and so that you understand.
T. Usmani.40:68: He is the One who gives life and brings death, and when He decides to do something, He only says to it: “Be” and it comes to be.
T. Usmani.40:69: Have you not seen those who quarrel in Allah’s verses? From where are they being turned away (by their selfish desires?)
T. Usmani.40:70: - those who rejected the Book and what We sent with Our messengers. So, they will soon come to know,
T. Usmani.40:71: when shackles will be round their necks, and chains. They will be dragged
T. Usmani.40:72: into the hot water after which they will be thrown into the Fire as a fuel.
T. Usmani.40:73: Then, it will be said to them, “Where are those whom you used to associate (in worship)
T. Usmani.40:74: beside Allah?” They will say, “They are lost to us, rather, we used to invoke nothing at all.” This is how Allah makes disbelievers get lost.
T. Usmani.40:75: (It will be said to them,) “This is because you used to rejoice on the earth wrongfully, and because you used to show arrogance.
T. Usmani.40:76: Enter the gates of Jahannam to live in it forever. So, how evil is the abode of the arrogant.
T. Usmani.40:77: Therefore, be patient. Surely, Allah’s promise is true. Then, (O Prophet,) whether We show you (in your life) a part of the promise We are making to them, or make you die (before they are punished), in any case they have to be returned to Us.
T. Usmani.40:78: We had sent messengers before you. Among them there are those whose history We have narrated to you, and of them there are those whose history We did not narrate to you. And it is not up to a messenger that he could come up with a sign without permission from Allah. So, when the command of Allah will come, matters will stand decided justly, and on that occasion all adherents of falsehood will turn into losers.
T. Usmani.40:79: Allah is the One who made for you the cattle, so that you may ride some of them,- and of them you eat;
T. Usmani.40:80: and for you there are (other) benefits in them- and so that, (by riding) on them, you meet any need you have in your hearts; and on them and on boats you are carried.
T. Usmani.40:81: He shows you His signs. Then, which of the signs of Allah would you (still) deny?
T. Usmani.40:82: Have they not traveled through the earth and seen how was the fate of those before them? Most of them were more in numbers than these, and superior in vigor and vestiges left on the earth. So then, whatever they used to earn did not work for them at all.
T. Usmani.40:83: When their messengers came to them with manifest signs, they exulted because of whatever knowledge they had, and they were encircled by what they used to ridicule.
T. Usmani.40:84: When they saw Our punishment, they said, “We have (now) come to believe in Allah alone, and We have rejected everything we used to ascribe (to Him) as partners.”
T. Usmani.40:85: But, their profession of faith was not (competent) to benefit them, once they had seen Our punishment - a customary practice of Allah that has been there all along in the matter of His servants - and hence, the disbelievers became the losers.
T. Usmani.41:2: This is a revelation from the All-Merciful, the Very-Merciful-
T. Usmani.41:3: - a book whose verses are elaborated in the form of an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who understand,
T. Usmani.41:4: as a bearer of good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away, so they do not listen.
T. Usmani.41:5: And they say, “Our hearts are (wrapped) in covers against that (faith) to which you invite us, and there is deafness in our ears, and there is a barrier between you and us. So, do (in your way). We too are doing (in our own way)”.
T. Usmani.41:6: Say, “I am but a human being like you; it is revealed to me that your god is only One God. So, turn straight towards Him, and seek forgiveness from Him, and woe to the Mushriks (those who ascribe partners to Allah)
T. Usmani.41:7: who do not pay Zakāh ; and of the life of the Hereafter, they are deniers.”
T. Usmani.41:8: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them there is a reward that will never be interrupted.
T. Usmani.41:9: Say, “Do you really disbelieve in the One who has created the earth in two days, and ascribe to Him partners? That is the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.41:10: He has placed firm mountains in it (the earth) towering above it, and put blessings in it, and proportioned its foods therein, in four days, equal for those who ask.
T. Usmani.41:11: Then He turned straight to the sky, while it was a smoke, and said to it and to the earth, “Come (to My obedience), both of you, willingly or unwillingly.” Both said, “We come willingly.”
T. Usmani.41:12: So He accomplished them as seven skies in two days, and settled in every sky its (due) thing. And We have decorated the closest sky with lamps, and protected it properly. All this is the determination of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.41:13: So, if they turn away, then say, “I have warned you of a calamity like the calamity of ‘Ād and Thamūd,
T. Usmani.41:14: when the messengers came to them from their front and from their rear, saying, “Do not worship anyone but Allah.” They said, “Had our Lord (really) willed (to send someone as messenger), He would have sent down angels. So, we are deniers of what you have been sent with.”
T. Usmani.41:15: As for ‘Ād, they showed arrogance in the land with no right (to do so), and said, “Who is stronger than us in power?” Did they not see that Allah, who created them, is stronger than them in power? And they used to reject Our signs.
T. Usmani.41:16: So, We let loose a wild wind on them in unlucky days to make them taste the humiliating punishment in the present life. And of course, the punishment of the Hereafter will be much more humiliating, and they will not be helped.
T. Usmani.41:17: As for Thamūd, We showed them the way, but they preferred blindness to the guidance. Therefore, they were seized by the bang of the abasing punishment because of what they used to earn.
T. Usmani.41:18: And We saved those who believed and used to be God-fearing.
T. Usmani.41:19: (Remind them of) the day when Allah’s enemies will be mustered towards the Fire. So they will be kept under control,
T. Usmani.41:20: until when they will come to it, their ears and their eyes and their skins will testify against them about what they used to do.
T. Usmani.41:21: And they will say to their skins, “Why did you testify against us?” They (the skins) will say, “We were made to speak by Allah, the One who has made every thing to speak.” And He had created you the first time, and to Him you are going to be returned.
T. Usmani.41:22: And you had not been hiding your selves (when committing sins) from your ears and your eyes and your skins that would bear witness against you, but you thought that Allah did not know much of what you did.
T. Usmani.41:23: This thought of yours that you conceived about your Lord brought you to ruin, and you became among the losers.
T. Usmani.41:24: Now, if they endure patiently, even then the Fire is their abode, and if they seek forgiveness, they are not among those (who could be) forgiven.
T. Usmani.41:25: And We had assigned for them fellows (in the worldly life) who beautified for them what was before them and what was behind them. And (thus) the word (of punishment) became due against them along with the communities that passed before them from Jinns and human beings. Surely they were the losers.
T. Usmani.41:26: And said those who disbelieved, “Do not listen to this Qur’ān, and make noise during its recitation, so that you may overcome.”
T. Usmani.41:27: So, We will certainly make them taste a severe punishment, and will certainly recompense them for the worst of what they used to do.
T. Usmani.41:28: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah- the Fire. For them there is the eternal home, as a recompense for their persistent denial of Our verses.
T. Usmani.41:29: And those who disbelieve will say, “Our Lord, show us the two, out of the Jinns and the humans, who led us astray and we will put both of them under our feet, so that they become among the lowest.”
T. Usmani.41:30: Surely, those who have declared: “Our Lord is Allah”, then remained steadfast, on them the angels will descend, saying, “Do not fear, and do not grieve; and be happy with the good news of the Jannah (Paradise) that you had been promised.
T. Usmani.41:31: We have been your friends in the worldly life, and (will remain as such) in the Hereafter. And for you here is whatever your souls desire, and for you here is whatever you call for
T. Usmani.41:32: - a gift of welcome from the Most-forgiving, the Very-Merciful”.
T. Usmani.41:33: Who can be better in words than the one who calls towards Allah, and acts righteously and says, “I am one of those who submit themselves (to Allah)”?
T. Usmani.41:34: Good and evil are not equal. Repel (evil) with what is best, and you will see that the one you had mutual enmity with him will turn as if he were a close friend.
T. Usmani.41:35: And no one is blessed with this (attitude) but those who observe patience, and no one is blessed with this (attitude) but a man of great luck.
T. Usmani.41:36: And should a stroke from ShaiTān (Satan) strike you, seek refuge with Allah. Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.41:37: Among His signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves to the sun, or to the moon. And prostrate yourselves to Allah who has created them, if it is Him whom you worship.
T. Usmani.41:38: Still, if they show arrogance, then those who are with your Lord proclaim His purity night and day, and they do not get weary.
T. Usmani.41:39: And among His signs is that you see the land inactive; then, once We send down water thereto, it gets excited and swells. Surely, the One who has given life to it is the One who gives life to the dead. No doubt, He is powerful to do everything.
T. Usmani.41:40: Surely those who adopt perversity about Our verses are not hidden from Us. So, tell me which one is better: the one who is thrown into the Fire, or the one who will come safely on the Day of Judgment? Do whatever you wish. He is watchful of whatever you do.
T. Usmani.41:41: Surely those who have rejected the advice (the Qur’ān) when it came to them (are the ones who adopted perversity, and are not hidden from Us). And surely, it is an unassailable book
T. Usmani.41:42: that cannot be approached by falsehood, neither from its front, nor from its behind -a revelation from the All-Wise, the Ever-Praised.
T. Usmani.41:43: Nothing is being said to you but what has been said to the messengers before you. Your Lord is certainly the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of painful punishment.
T. Usmani.41:44: Had We made it a non-Arabic Qur’ān, they would have said, “Why are its verses not clearly explained? Is it a non-Arabic (book) and an Arab (messenger)?” Say, “For those who believe, it is guidance and cure. As for those who do not believe, there is deafness in their ears, and for them it is blindness. Such people are being called from a distant place.”
T. Usmani.41:45: And We gave Mūsā the book, then it was disputed (as well). But for a word that had already come from your Lord, the matter would have been decided between them. They are in confounding doubt about it.
T. Usmani.41:46: If someone acts righteously, he does so for the benefit of his own soul, and if someone commits evil, he does so against it. Your Lord is not unjust to His servants.
T. Usmani.41:47: To Him alone the knowledge of the Hour (the exact time of Doomsday) is to be referred. No fruits come out of their sheaths, nor does a female conceive a baby, nor does she deliver it, but with His knowledge. And (remember) the Day when He will call them: “Where are My partners?” They will say, “We declare to you that no one of us is to testify (that you have partners).”
T. Usmani.41:48: And whatever they used to invoke earlier will vanish from them, and they will realize that they have no way to escape.
T. Usmani.41:49: Man does not get weary of craving for (all sorts of ) good things; and if he is touched by some evil, he is disappointed, devoid of any hope.
T. Usmani.41:50: And if We give him a taste of some mercy from Us after some hardship that has touched him, he will surely say, “This is my right. And I do not think the Hour (the Day of Judgment) is going to occur. And even if I am brought back to my Lord, I will surely have the best (life) with Him (too).”So, We will let the disbelievers know what they did, and let them taste a stern punishment.
T. Usmani.41:51: When We bestow Our favor upon man, he avoids (to appreciate it) and keeps himself far aside (from obedience), and when some evil touches him, he is full of lengthy prayers.
T. Usmani.41:52: Say (to the disbelievers), “Tell me, if it (the Qur’ān) is from Allah, and still you reject it, then who can be more erroneous than him who is (involved) in far reaching schism?”
T. Usmani.41:53: We will show them Our signs in the universe and within their own beings until it will become manifest to them that it is the truth. Is it not enough about your Lord that He is witness to everything?
T. Usmani.41:54: Beware, they are in doubt about meeting their Lord. Beware, He is the One who encompasses everything.
T. Usmani.42:3: This is how Allah, the Mighty, the Wise, sends revelation to you and to those who were before you.
T. Usmani.42:4: To him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and He is the High, the Supreme.
T. Usmani.42:5: The heavens almost burst apart from their above side, and angels proclaim the purity and praise of their Lord, and pray for forgiveness of those on the earth. Be aware that Allah is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.42:6: And those who have adopted patrons instead of Him, Allah is on watch against them, and you are not responsible for them.
T. Usmani.42:7: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān, so that you may warn the mother town, and those around it, and warn (them) of the Day of Gathering, about which there is no doubt-(when) one group of people will be in Paradise, and another group in blazing Fire.
T. Usmani.42:8: Had Allah willed, He would have made all of them a single group; but He admits whomsoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, they have neither a patron nor a helper.
T. Usmani.42:9: Is it that they have adopted patrons instead of Him? So, it is Allah who is the Patron, and He gives life to the dead, and He is Powerful to do every thing.
T. Usmani.42:10: And (Say O prophet to your opponents,) “Whatever dispute you have in any matter, its judgment lies with Allah. That One is Allah, the Lord of mine; in Him alone I have placed my trust, and to Him alone I turn (in every matter).”
T. Usmani.42:11: He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you pairs from among yourselves, and pairs from the cattle. He makes you expand in this way. Nothing is like Him. And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
T. Usmani.42:12: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whomsoever He wills, and straitens (it for whomsoever He wills). Surely He is All-Knowing in respect of every thing.
T. Usmani.42:13: He has ordained for you people the same religion as He had enjoined upon NūH, and that which We have revealed to you (O prophet,) and that which We had enjoined upon Ibrāhīm and Mūsā and ‘Īsā by saying, “Establish the religion, and be not divided therein.” Arduous for the mushriks (polytheists) is that to which you are inviting them. Allah chooses (and pulls) toward Himself anyone He wills, and guides to Himself anyone who turns to Him (to seek guidance).
T. Usmani.42:14: And they were not divided, in jealousy with each other, but after the knowledge had come to them. Had it not been for a word that had come forth earlier from your Lord (and was effective) until a specified time, the matter would have been decided between them. And those who were made to inherit the Book after them are in confounding doubt about it.
T. Usmani.42:15: So, (O prophet,) towards that (faith) invite (people), and be steadfast as you are commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say, “I believe in whatever book Allah has sent down. And I have been ordered to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you, your deeds. There is no argumentation between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the final return.”
T. Usmani.42:16: Those who argue about Allah after He has been responded to, their argument is void in the sight of their Lord, and upon them is wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
T. Usmani.42:17: Allah is the One who has sent down the Book with truth, and the Balance as well. And what can let you know? May be, the Hour (the Day of Judgment) is near.
T. Usmani.42:18: Those who do not believe in it demand that it should come soon, and those who believe are fearful of it, and they know for sure that it is the truth. Be aware that those who dispute concerning the Hour are wandering afar from the right path.
T. Usmani.42:19: Allah is kind to His servants. He gives provision to whom He wills, and He is the Strong, the Mighty.
T. Usmani.42:20: Whoever intends (to have) the harvest of the Hereafter, We will increase in his harvest; and whoever intends (to have) the harvest of the world (only), We will give him thereof, while in the Hereafter he will have no share.
T. Usmani.42:21: Is it that they have associate-gods who have prescribed for them a religion that is not sanctioned by Allah? Had it not been for a decisive word, the matter would have been decided between them (here in this world). And of course, for the wrongdoers there is a painful punishment (in the Hereafter).
T. Usmani.42:22: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they earned, and it is sure to befall them. As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they will be in meadows of the Gardens. For them there is, with their Lord, whatever they wish. That is the great bounty.
T. Usmani.42:23: That is the good news that Allah gives to His servants who believed and did righteous deeds. Say, “I do not ask you any fee for it, except the love of kinship.” And whoever performs a good act, We will increase for him goodness therein. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Appreciative.
T. Usmani.42:24: Is it that they say, “He has forged a lie against Allah”? So, if Allah wills, He may put a seal on your heart. And Allah blots out falsehood and establishes truth with His words. Surely, He is fully aware of what lies in the hearts.
T. Usmani.42:25: And He is the One who accepts repentance from His servants and forgives evil deeds and knows whatever you do.
T. Usmani.42:26: And He responds to (the prayer of) those who believe and do righteous deeds, and gives them more out of His grace. As for the disbelievers, for them there is a severe punishment.
T. Usmani.42:27: Should Allah expand the provision for His servants (to its full extent), they would spread mischief on earth; but He sends down what He wills in (due) measure. Surely, with regard to His slaves, He is All-Aware, Ever-Watchful.
T. Usmani.42:28: And He is the One who sends down rain after they have lost hope, and He extends His mercy. And He is the Guardian, Worthy of all praise.
T. Usmani.42:29: Among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the creatures He has spread in them. He is Powerful to assemble them whenever He so wills.
T. Usmani.42:30: Whatever hardship befalls you is because of what your own hands have committed, while He overlooks many (of your faults).
T. Usmani.42:31: You are not able to frustrate (Him) in the earth. And, besides Allah, you have neither someone to protect, nor someone to help.
T. Usmani.42:32: And among His signs are ships in the sea, like mountains.
T. Usmani.42:33: If He so wills, He may stop the wind, and they stand still on its surface. Surely in this, there are signs for everyone who is ever patient, fully grateful.
T. Usmani.42:34: Or He may destroy them because of what they earned, and may overlook many (whom He may save at least in this world),
T. Usmani.42:35: and (in such an event) those who raise disputes in Our verses will come to know that there is no way for them to escape.
T. Usmani.42:36: So, whatever thing has been given to you is an enjoyment of the worldly life. And that which is with Allah is much better, and much more durable for those who believe and place their trust in Allah,
T. Usmani.42:37: and (for) those who abstain from the major sins and from shameful acts; and (for those who) when they get angry, they forgive,
T. Usmani.42:38: and those who have responded to their Lord (in submission to Him), and have established Salāh, and whose affairs are (settled) with mutual consultation between them, and who spend out of what We have given to them,
T. Usmani.42:39: and those who, when they are subjected to aggression, defend themselves.
T. Usmani.42:40: The recompense of evil is evil like it. Then the one who forgives and opts for compromise has his reward undertaken by Allah. Surely, He does not like the unjust.
T. Usmani.42:41: The one who defends himself after having been wronged, there is no blame on such people.
T. Usmani.42:42: Blame, in fact, is upon those who wrong people and make mischief on earth unjustly. For such people there is a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.42:43: And if one observes patience and forgives, it is, of course, one of the courageous conducts.
T. Usmani.42:44: The one whom Allah lets go astray, there is no one for him to protect thereafter. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they will see the punishment, that they will say, “Is there any way to be sent back (to the world)? ”
T. Usmani.42:45: And you will see them that they will be presented to it (the Fire), downcast because of humiliation, looking with stealthy glance. And those who believe will say, “The real losers are those who have lost their own selves and their families on the Day of Judgment.” Be aware that the wrongdoers are in lasting punishment.
T. Usmani.42:46: And for them there will not be any friends who may help them besides Allah. And the one whom Allah lets go astray, for him there is no way (to save himself).
T. Usmani.42:47: Respond to your Lord before there comes a day for which there will be no reversal from Allah’s side. For you there will be neither a refuge that day, nor an opportunity to question (Allah about your fate).
T. Usmani.42:48: So, if they turn away, then We did not send you (O Prophet,) as a supervisor over them. You are not responsible but for conveying the message. And when We make man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices with it, and if an evil befalls him because of what their hands sent ahead, then man becomes ungrateful.
T. Usmani.42:49: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills. He grants females to whom He wills, and grants males to whom He wills.
T. Usmani.42:50: Or He combines for them couples, both males and females, and makes whom He wills barren. Surely, He is All-Knowing, Very-Powerful.
T. Usmani.42:51: It is not (possible) for a human being that Allah speaks to him, except by way of revelation, or from behind a curtain, or that He sends a messenger, and he reveals, with His permission, what He wills. Surely, He is All-High, All-Wise.
T. Usmani.42:52: In similar way, We have revealed to you a Spirit from Our command. You did not know earlier what was the Book or what was Īmān (true faith), but We have made it (the Qur’ān) a light with which We guide whomsoever We will from among Our servants. And indeed you are guiding (people) to a straight path,
T. Usmani.42:53: the path of Allah, the One to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Be aware that towards Allah all matters shall finally return.
