T. Usmani.43:3: We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān, so that you may understand.
T. Usmani.43:4: And it is, in the Mother of the Book (the Preserved Tablet) with us, surely sublime, full of wisdom.
T. Usmani.43:5: Shall We then take the advice away from you because you are a transgressing people?
T. Usmani.43:6: How many a messenger We have sent to the earlier people!
T. Usmani.43:7: No messenger came to them, but they used to mock at him.
T. Usmani.43:8: So We have destroyed those who were stronger than these (people of Makkah) in power, and the example of the earlier people has already passed.
T. Usmani.43:9: Should you ask them as to who has created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “They are created by the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing,”
T. Usmani.43:10: the One who has made the earth a cradle for you, and has made for you pathways therein, so that you may be guided,
T. Usmani.43:11: and the One who has sent down water from the sky in due measure. Then We have revived with it a dead town. In the same way, you will be brought forth (alive from the graves),
T. Usmani.43:12: and the One who has created all the pairs, and has made for you the boats and the cattle that you ride,
T. Usmani.43:13: so that you may mount upon their back, then recall the favour of your Lord after having mounted upon it and say, “Pure is the One who has subjugated this for us, and We were not able to have control over it,
T. Usmani.43:14: and of course, towards our Lord we have to return.”
T. Usmani.43:15: They have attributed to Him (that He is composed of) parts, (and that too) out of His servants. Surely, man is clearly ungrateful.
T. Usmani.43:16: Is it that He has adopted daughters from those whom He has created, and chosen you for (having) sons?
T. Usmani.43:17: When one of them is given the good news of (the birth of) that which he has attributed to RaHmān (i.e. the daughters), his face turns black, and he becomes choked with sorrow.
T. Usmani.43:18: Is it that (Allah has chosen) those (as His offspring) who are grown up in ornaments and who cannot express themselves in debate clearly?
T. Usmani.43:19: They have held angels, who are the servants of RaHmān, as females. Have they witnessed their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
T. Usmani.43:20: They say, “Had the RaHmān so willed, we would not have worshipped them.” They have no knowledge of that. They do nothing but make conjectures.
T. Usmani.43:21: Or have We given to them a book before this, and they are adhering to it?
T. Usmani.43:22: Instead, they say, “We have found our fathers on a certain way, and we are on their footprints, fully guided.”
T. Usmani.43:23: Similarly, We did not send a warner to a town before you, but its affluent people said, “We have found our fathers on a certain way, and we are following their footprints.”
T. Usmani.43:24: He said, “Even if I bring to you something better in guidance than that on which you have found your fathers?” They said, “We totally disbelieve in what you are sent with.”
T. Usmani.43:25: So, We took revenge from them. Now look, how was the end of those who rejected (Our messengers).
T. Usmani.43:26: (Recall) when Ibrāhīm said to his father and to his people, “I disown that which you worship,
T. Usmani.43:27: except the One who has originated me; so He will guide me.”
T. Usmani.43:28: He made it a word lasting among his posterity, so that they may return.
T. Usmani.43:29: But, I gave these and their fathers enjoyment, until the truth came to them, and a messenger as well who explains (it).
T. Usmani.43:30: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally disbelieve in it.”
T. Usmani.43:31: They say, “Why was this Qur’ān not revealed on a great man from (either of) the two towns?”
T. Usmani.43:32: Is it they who allocate the mercy of your Lord? We have allocated among them their livelihood in the worldly life, and have raised some of them over others in ranks, so that some of them may put some others to work. And the mercy of your Lord is much better than what they accumulate.
T. Usmani.43:33: Were it not that all people would become of a single creed (i.e. disbelief), We would have caused, for those who disbelieve in RaHmān, roofs of their houses to be made of silver, and the stairs as well, on which they would climb,
T. Usmani.43:34: and doors of their homes, and the coaches on which they would recline,
T. Usmani.43:35: and (would have made some of these things) of gold-ornaments. And all this is nothing but an enjoyment of the worldly life. And the Hereafter, with your Lord, is (destined) for the God-fearing.
T. Usmani.43:36: Whoever makes himself blind against the advice of RaHmān, We assign for him a devil who accompanies him all the time.
T. Usmani.43:37: And they (the devils) prevent such people from the (right) way, while they deem themselves to be on the right path,
T. Usmani.43:38: until when such a person will come to us, he will say (to the devil), “Would that there were the distance of East and West between me and you, because you were the worst companion.”
T. Usmani.43:39: And (it will be said to such people,) “Since you were wrongdoers, it will never benefit you today that you are sharing the punishment with each other.”
T. Usmani.43:40: So, can you (O prophet) make the deaf to hear, or can you show the way to the blind and the one who is in open error?
T. Usmani.43:41: So, even if We take you away, We will surely take vengeance on them.
T. Usmani.43:42: Or (if) We show you (in your life) that (punishment) with which We have threatened them, then We have full control over them.
T. Usmani.43:43: So, hold fast to that which has been revealed to you. Surely, you are on the straight path.
T. Usmani.43:44: And certainly this (Qur’ān) is a word of honour for you and your people, and you will be questioned.
T. Usmani.43:45: Ask Our messengers whom We sent before you whether We had appointed gods to be worshipped besides RaHmān.
T. Usmani.43:46: We sent Mūsā with Our signs to Fir’aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs; so he said, “I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds.”
T. Usmani.43:47: So, when he came to them with Our signs, they at once started laughing at them.
T. Usmani.43:48: And We did not show them a sign, but it used to be greater than the one that preceded it. And We seized them with punishment, so that they may return.
T. Usmani.43:49: And they said, “O magician, pray for us to your Lord by the covenant He has made with you; we will certainly come to guidance.”
T. Usmani.43:50: Then, once We removed the punishment from them, in no time they broke their promise.
T. Usmani.43:51: And Fir’aun (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people, saying, “Does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers are flowing right underneath me? Do you, then, not discern?
T. Usmani.43:52: Or (do you not see that) I am much better than this one (Mūsā) who is worthless and can hardly express himself?
T. Usmani.43:53: So why were the bracelets of gold not sent down to him, or (why) did the angels not come along with him as companions?”
T. Usmani.43:54: Thus he made fool of his people, and they obeyed him. Surely they were a sinful people.
T. Usmani.43:55: So, when they provoked Our anger, We took vengeance on them, and drowned them all together,
T. Usmani.43:56: and made them a people of the past, and an example for the later generations.
T. Usmani.43:57: When the example of the son of Maryam was cited, your people started at once shouting at it (in joy),
T. Usmani.43:58: and said, “Are Our gods better or is he?” They did not cite it (the example) but for the sake of disputation. Rather, they are a quarrelsome people.
T. Usmani.43:59: He (‘Īsā) is no more than a servant (of Allah) whom We favoured and made an example for the children of Isrā’īl.
T. Usmani.43:60: And if We will, We may create angels from you who succeed you on the earth.
T. Usmani.43:61: And he (‘Īsā) is a source of knowledge of the Hour (the Day of Judgment); so do not be in doubt about it, and follow me. This is the straight way.
T. Usmani.43:62: And let not the ShaiTān (Satan) prevent you (from following this way). He is surely an open enemy for you.
T. Usmani.43:63: When ‘Īsā came with clear proofs, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to explain to you some of those matters in which you differ. So, fear Allah, and obey me.
T. Usmani.43:64: Surely, it is Allah who is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is the straight way.”
T. Usmani.43:65: Then different groups, out of them, fell into disagreement. Woe to the wrongdoers because of the punishment of a painful day!
T. Usmani.43:66: They are waiting for nothing but for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they would not even imagine (it).
T. Usmani.43:67: Friends, on that day, will become enemies to one another, except the God-fearing,
T. Usmani.43:68: (to whom it will be said) “O my servants, there is no fear for you today, nor will you grieve-
T. Usmani.43:69: -O those (servants) who believed in Our signs, and remained obedient.
T. Usmani.43:70: - Enter the Paradise, you and your spouses, showered with bliss.”
T. Usmani.43:71: Circulated among them will be the bowls of gold, and glasses. And there will be whatever souls desire and that which eyes enjoy. “And you will be living in it for ever.
T. Usmani.43:72: That is the Paradise you are made to inherit because of what you used to do.
T. Usmani.43:73: For you there are fruits in abundance from which you will eat.”
T. Usmani.43:74: The sinners (on the other hand) will be in the punishment of Jahannam (Hell), living there forever.
T. Usmani.43:75: It will not be lightened for them, and they will be there, devoid of all hopes.
T. Usmani.43:76: We did not do injustice to them, rather, they themselves were the unjust.
T. Usmani.43:77: And they will call (Mālik, the keeper of the Hell,) “O Mālik, let your Lord do away with us.” He will say, “You have to stay on.”
T. Usmani.43:78: (O disbelievers,) indeed We have brought to you the truth, but it is the truth that most of you detest.
T. Usmani.43:79: Is it that they have firmly resolved to do something (harmful to Our messenger)? Then, We have firmly resolved (to frustrate their plan.)
T. Usmani.43:80: Do they think that We do not hear their secrets and their whispers? Yes of course, Our messengers (angels) are with them who record (whatever they plan).
T. Usmani.43:81: Say, “Had there been a son for the RaHmān, I would have been the first to worship.”
T. Usmani.43:82: Pure is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from what they attribute (to Him).
T. Usmani.43:83: So, let them indulge (in their fallacy) and play, until they face their Day that they are promised.
T. Usmani.43:84: He is the One who is God to be worshipped in the sky, and God to be worshipped on the earth. And He is the Wise, the All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.43:85: Glorious is the One to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and towards Him you are to be returned.
T. Usmani.43:86: And those whom they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede; but those who bear witness to the truth, while they have knowledge (may intercede for the believers with Allah’s permission).
T. Usmani.43:87: And if you ask them as to who has created them, they will certainly say, “Allah”. Then, to where are they driven back (by their false desires)?
T. Usmani.43:88: And (Allah has the knowledge) of his (prophet’s) saying, “O my Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”
T. Usmani.43:89: So, turn away from them, and say, “Salām !” (good-bye!). Then, soon they will come to know (the end of their attitude).
T. Usmani.44:3: We have sent it down in a blessed night, (because) We had to warn (people).
T. Usmani.44:4: In that (night), every wise matter is allocated
T. Usmani.44:5: through a command from Us. We were to send the Messenger
T. Usmani.44:6: as a mercy from your Lord, -Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing-
T. Usmani.44:7: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever there is between them, if you are to believe.
T. Usmani.44:8: There is no god, but He. He gives life and brings death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
T. Usmani.44:9: But they, being in doubt, are playing around.
T. Usmani.44:10: So, wait for a day when the sky will come up with a visible smoke
T. Usmani.44:11: that will envelop people. This is a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.44:12: (Then they will say,) “O our Lord, remove from us the punishment; we will truly believe.”
T. Usmani.44:13: How will they take lesson, while there has already come to them a messenger making things clear?
T. Usmani.44:14: Then they turned away from him, and said, “(He is) tutored, crazy.”
T. Usmani.44:15: (Well,) We are going to remove the punishment for a while, (but) you will certainly go back (to your original position).
T. Usmani.44:16: (Then,) the day We will seize (you) with the greatest seizure, We will take vengeance.
T. Usmani.44:17: And We tested the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) prior to them, and a noble messenger came to them
T. Usmani.44:18: saying, “Deliver to me the servants of Allah. I am an honest messenger to you,”
T. Usmani.44:19: and saying, “Do not be haughty against Allah. I bring to you a clear proof.
T. Usmani.44:20: And I have sought refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death.
T. Usmani.44:21: And if you do not believe in me, then keep away from me.”
T. Usmani.44:22: Then he prayed to his Lord saying, “These are a guilty people.”
T. Usmani.44:23: (So, Allah answered his prayer saying,) “Now, take away my servants at night. You will certainly be chased,
T. Usmani.44:24: and leave the sea in the state of stillness; they are an army that is sure to be drowned.”
T. Usmani.44:25: How many gardens and fountains have they left behind-
T. Usmani.44:26: - and how many fields and noble sites,
T. Usmani.44:27: and how many a luxury they used to rejoice in!
T. Usmani.44:28: This is how it happened. And We made other people inherit all this.
T. Usmani.44:29: So, neither the sky and earth wept over them, nor were they given a respite.
T. Usmani.44:30: And We delivered the children of Isrā’īl from the humiliating punishment,
T. Usmani.44:31: from Fir‘aun. Indeed, he was haughty, one of the transgressors.
T. Usmani.44:32: And We chose them, with knowledge, above all the worlds.
T. Usmani.44:33: And We gave them the clear signs in which there was a manifest blessing.
T. Usmani.44:35: “There is nothing more than our first death, and we are not going to be resurrected.
T. Usmani.44:36: So, (O believers,) bring our fathers, if you are true (in your belief in resurrection.)”
T. Usmani.44:37: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those who were before them? We have destroyed them. They were guilty indeed.
T. Usmani.44:38: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them just as players.
T. Usmani.44:39: We did not create them but with true purpose, but most of them do not know.
T. Usmani.44:40: The Day of Decision is the appointed time for all of them-
T. Usmani.44:41: the day when no close relation will be of any use to any close relation, nor will they be helped,
T. Usmani.44:42: except the One on whom Allah has mercy. Of course, He is the All-Mighty, the Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.44:44: is the food of the sinful,
T. Usmani.44:45: like dregs of oil. It will boil in the bellies
T. Usmani.44:46: like the boiling of hot water.
T. Usmani.44:47: (It will be said to angels,) “Seize him, and drag him into the midst of the Hell.
T. Usmani.44:48: Then pour on his head some torment of boiling water.”
T. Usmani.44:49: “Have a taste! You are the ‘man of might’, the ‘man of honour’.
T. Usmani.44:50: This is the thing about which you used to be skeptic.”
T. Usmani.44:51: Indeed the God-fearing will be in a place free from fear,
T. Usmani.44:53: They will be dressed in fine silk and thick silk, facing each other.
T. Usmani.44:54: Thus (it will happen,) and We will marry them with houris having big dark eyes.
T. Usmani.44:55: They will call therein for every fruit peacefully.
T. Usmani.44:56: They will not taste death therein beyond the first death (they faced in the world). And He (Allah) will save them from the torment of Hell,
T. Usmani.44:57: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great achievement.
T. Usmani.44:58: So, We had made it (the Qur’ān) easy in your tongue, so that they may take lesson.
T. Usmani.44:59: Now wait. They too are waiting.
T. Usmani.45:2: This is revelation of the Book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.45:3: Surely in the heavens and the earth, there are signs for those who have faith.
T. Usmani.45:4: And in your creation and in the living beings that He scatters on the earth, there are signs for a people who believe.
T. Usmani.45:5: And in the alternation of the day and the night, and in the provision He has sent down from the sky, then has revived the earth after its death, and in changing of the winds, there are signs for a people who understand.
T. Usmani.45:6: These are Allah’s verses that We recite to you rightly. Then, in which discourse, after Allah and His verses, will they believe?
T. Usmani.45:8: who hears Allah’s verses being recited to him, then he remains adamant out of arrogance, as if he never heard them. So give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.45:9: When he learns about something of Our verses, he takes it as a laughing stock. For such people, there is a humiliating punishment.
T. Usmani.45:10: In front of them, there is Jahannam (Hell). And whatever they have earned will not be of any use to them, nor the patrons they have adopted instead of Allah. And for them, there is a horrible punishment.
T. Usmani.45:11: This is guidance, and those who reject the verses of their Lord, for them there is a painful punishment of the divine scourge.
T. Usmani.45:12: Allah is the One who has subjugated for you the sea, so that the ships may sail in it with His command, and so that you may seek His grace, and so that you offer gratitude.
T. Usmani.45:13: He has subjugated for you whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, all on His own. Surely in this there are signs for a people who reflect.
T. Usmani.45:14: Tell those who believe that they should forgive those who do not believe in Allah’s days, so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
T. Usmani.45:15: Whoever acts righteously, it is for his own benefit, and who does evil, it is against his own soul. Then towards your Lord, you will be returned.
T. Usmani.45:16: We gave the children of Isrā’īl the book and the wisdom and the prophet-hood, and provided them with good things, and preferred them above all (people of) the world,
T. Usmani.45:17: and We gave them clear proofs of the Matter (i.e. the religion). So they did not fall into disagreement out of mutual jealousy, but after the knowledge had come to them. Surely your Lord will judge between them, on the Day of Judgment, in the matters in which they used to differ.
T. Usmani.45:18: Then We have put you on a certain way of the Matter (i.e. the religion); so follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.
T. Usmani.45:19: They will never help you against Allah in the least. The wrongdoers are friends to one another, and Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.
T. Usmani.45:20: These are insights for the people, and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
T. Usmani.45:21: Do those who have committed evils assume that We will make them like those who believe and do righteous deeds, so as their life and death becomes equal? Evil is what they judge.
T. Usmani.45:22: Allah has created the heavens and the earth with just purpose, and so that everybody is recompensed for what he (or she) earned, and they will not be wronged.
T. Usmani.45:23: So, have you seen him who has taken his desires as his god, and Allah has let him go astray, despite having knowledge, and has sealed his ear and his heart, and put a cover on his eye? Now who will guide him after Allah? Still, do you not take lesson?
T. Usmani.45:24: And they say, “There is no life but our worldly life. We die and live, and nothing destroys us except time.” They have no knowledge about that; they do nothing but make conjectures.
T. Usmani.45:25: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, their argument is none but that they say, “Bring our fathers, if you are truthful.”
T. Usmani.45:26: Say, “Allah gives you life, then makes you die, then He will assemble you on the Day of Judgement in which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know.
T. Usmani.45:27: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. The day the Hour will take place, it will be the day in which the adherents of falsehood shall lose,
T. Usmani.45:28: and you will see every community kneeling down. Every community will be called to its book (of record). Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
T. Usmani.45:29: This is Our book that speaks against you with truth. We used to get recorded all that you used to do.
T. Usmani.45:30: Then, as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them to His mercy. That is indeed the achievement, visible to all.
T. Usmani.45:31: And as to those who disbelieved, (it will be said to them,) “Had My verses not been recited to you? But you showed arrogance, and you were a guilty people;
T. Usmani.45:32: and when it was said to you that Allah’s promise is true and there is no doubt in the (arrival of the) Hour, you used to say, ‘We do not know what the Hour is. We do not think (about it) but as an assumption, and we are not sure.’”
T. Usmani.45:33: And revealed to them will be the evils of what they did, and encircled they will be by what they used to ridicule.
T. Usmani.45:34: It will be said, “Today We will forget you, as you forgot facing this your day, and your abode is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers at all.
T. Usmani.45:35: That is because you took Allah’s verses as a laughing stock, and the worldly life deceived you.” So today they will neither be brought out of it, nor will they be asked to repent.
T. Usmani.45:36: So, to Allah belongs all praise, who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.45:37: And to Him belongs majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.
T. Usmani.46:2: This is revelation of the book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.46:3: We did not create the heavens and the earth but with true purpose and for a specified term. But those who disbelieve are averse to what they are warned of.
T. Usmani.46:4: Say, “Tell me about those whom you invoke instead of Allah, (and) show me what they have created from the earth; Or have they a share in (the creation of) the heavens? Bring to me a book (revealed) before this one, or a trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.”
T. Usmani.46:5: Who is more astray than him who invokes, instead of Allah, those who will not respond to him up to the Day of Judgement; and they are totally unaware of their prayers,
T. Usmani.46:6: and when people will be assembled (on the Day of Judgment), they will be enemies to them, and will refuse even their having worshipped them.
T. Usmani.46:7: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say about the truth when it comes to them, “This is an open magic.”
T. Usmani.46:8: Is it that they say, “He has forged it (the Qur’ān)”? Say, “If I have forged it, then you do not have any power to help me against Allah. He is well aware of what you are engaged in. He is enough as a witness between me and you, and He is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.”
T. Usmani.46:9: Say, “I am not something unprecedented among the messengers, and I do not know what will be done to me or to you. I do not follow anything but what is revealed to me, and I am only a clear warner.”
T. Usmani.46:10: Say, “Tell me, If it (the Qur’ān) is from Allah and you reject it, and a witness from the children of Isrā’īl testifies about something similar to it and comes to believe (in it), while you persist in your arrogance, (then, how unjust you are!) Surely, Allah does not give guidance to the unjust people.
T. Usmani.46:11: The disbelievers say about the believers, “Had it (Islamic faith) been a good thing, these (weak and poor) people would not have preceded us (in proceeding) towards it.” Since they did not accept guidance through it (the Qur’ān), they will say, “This is a classical lie.”
T. Usmani.46:12: And before this there was the Book of Mūsā, a guide and a mercy. And this is a Book confirming (it) in Arabic tongue, so that it may warn the wrongdoers and give good news to those who are good in their deeds.
T. Usmani.46:13: Surely, those who say, “Our Lord is Allah” and then stay firm, they will have no fear, nor shall they grieve.
T. Usmani.46:14: Those are the people of Paradise, who will live there for ever as a reward for what they used to do.
T. Usmani.46:15: And We have enjoined upon man to do good to his parents. His mother carried him with difficulty and delivered him with difficulty. And his carrying and his weaning is (in) thirty months, until when he attains his maturity and reaches forty years, he says, “My Lord, grant me that I offer gratitude for the favour You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and that I do righteous deeds that You like. And set righteousness, for my sake, in my progeny. Of course, I repent to you, and truly I am one of those who submit to You.”
T. Usmani.46:16: Such are the people from whom We accept the best of what they did, and overlook their evil deeds, (so as they will be) among the people of Paradise according to the true promise that was made to them.
T. Usmani.46:17: And (Contrary to this is the case of) the one who said to his parents, “Fie upon you both! Do you promise to me that I shall be brought out (from the grave), while generations have passed before me?” And they (the parents) were crying for Allah’s help, (and saying to their son,) “Woe to you. Accept the true faith. Allah’s promise is certainly true.” Then he says, “This is nothing but the tales of the ancients.”
T. Usmani.46:18: Such are the people on whom the word (of punishment) has come true along with the communities of the Jinn and the humans that have passed before them. Surely they were losers.
T. Usmani.46:19: For each (of these two groups) there are (different) ranks because of what they did, and so that He may repay them in full for their deeds; and they will not be wronged.
T. Usmani.46:20: And the day the disbelievers will be presented before the Fire, (it will be said to them,) “You have consumed your good things in your worldly life, and have enjoyed them. So, you will be punished today with the torment of humiliation for the arrogance you used to show on earth with no right (to do so), and for the sins you used to commit.
T. Usmani.46:21: And recall the brother of (the nation of) ‘Ād, when he warned his people at the long, curved sand dunes- while many warners have passed before him and after him (with the same message)-saying, “Do not worship anyone except Allah. Surely I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day.”
T. Usmani.46:22: They said, “Have you come to make us deviate from our gods? So bring us that with which you are threatening us, if you are truthful.”
T. Usmani.46:23: He said, “The knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am conveying to you what I am sent with, but I see you are a people who act ignorantly.”
T. Usmani.46:24: So, when they saw it as a cloud proceeding towards their valleys, they said, “This is a cloud that will bring us rain.” No, it is the very thing you asked to hasten up - a wind in which there is a painful punishment,
T. Usmani.46:25: that will destroy every thing with the command of its Lord! So they became such that nothing remained to be seen except their dwelling places. This is how We punish the guilty people.
T. Usmani.46:26: And indeed We had established them in a powerful position in which We did not establish you (O people of Makkah), and had given to them ears and eyes and hearts, but neither their ears benefited them in the least, nor their eyes, nor their hearts, as they used to reject Allah’s signs; and they were encircled by what they used to ridicule.
T. Usmani.46:27: And We have (also) destroyed (other) towns around you, while We had given to them a variety of signs, so that they might return (from disbelief).
T. Usmani.46:28: So, why is it that they were not helped by those whom they had taken as gods beside Allah in order to attain closeness (to Him)? Instead, they vanished from them. That was, in fact, their falsity and a thing they used to fabricate.
T. Usmani.46:29: And (recall) when We directed a group of Jinns towards you, listening to the Qur’ān. So, when they attended it, they said (to each other), “Keep quiet.” Then once it was over, they went back to their people as warners.
T. Usmani.46:30: They said, “O our people, we have heard a book sent down after Mūsā, confirming what was before it, which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
T. Usmani.46:31: O our people, respond to Allah’s herald, and believe in him, and (once you do that,) Allah will forgive your sins for you, and will save you from a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.46:32: The one who does not respond to Allah’s herald is not (able) to frustrate (Allah by escaping) in the land, and for him there are no supporters besides Him. Such people are in open error.
T. Usmani.46:33: Have they not seen that Allah who has created the heavens and the earth, and was not wearied by their creation, does have power to give life to the dead? Yes of course, He is powerful to do every thing.
T. Usmani.46:34: The day the disbelievers will be presented to the Fire, (it will be said to them,) “Is this not true?” They will say, “Yes of course, Our Lord!” He will say, “Then taste the punishment, for you used to disbelieve.”
T. Usmani.46:35: So, (O prophet,) observe patience, as the resolute messengers observed patience, and be not in haste about them. The Day they will see what they are promised, (it will be) as if they did not stay (in the world) more than an hour in a single day. This is a message. So, none will be destroyed except the sinners.
T. Usmani.47:1: Those who disbelieved, and prevented (others) from Allah’s way, He (Allah) has rendered their deeds vain.
T. Usmani.47:2: And those who believed and did righteous deeds and believed in that which is revealed to MuHammad,-and it is the truth (that has come) from their Lord-He will write off their evil deeds, and will set aright their state of affairs.
T. Usmani.47:3: That is because the disbelievers have followed falsehood, while the believers have followed the truth (that has come) from their Lord. This is how Allah explains their (respective) situations to the people.
T. Usmani.47:4: So, when you encounter those who disbelieve, then (aim at) smiting the necks, until when you have broken their strength thoroughly, then tie fast the bond, (by making them captives). Then choose (to release them) either (as) a favour (shown to them,), or (after receiving) ransom,until the war throws down its load of arms. That (is Our command.) If Allah willed, He would have (Himself) subjected them to retribution, but (Allah ordered you to fight,) so that He may test some of you through some others. And those who are killed in Allah’s way, He will never let their deeds go to waste.
T. Usmani.47:5: (Instead,) He will guide them, and will set aright their state of affairs,
T. Usmani.47:6: and will admit them to the Paradise He has identified for them.
T. Usmani.47:7: O you who believe, if you will help (the religion prescribed by) Allah, He will help you, and will stabilize your footings.
T. Usmani.47:8: As for those who disbelieve, (destined) for them is destruction, and He has rendered their deeds vain.
T. Usmani.47:9: That is because they hate what Allah has sent down; therefore Allah has nullified their deeds.
T. Usmani.47:10: Have they not travelled in the land so that they might see how was the end of those before them? Allah brought utter destruction to them. And (ready) for (these) disbelievers are the likes thereof.
T. Usmani.47:11: That is because Allah is the supporter of those who believe. As for the disbelievers, there is no supporter for them.
T. Usmani.47:12: Surely, Allah will admit those who believe and do good deeds to the gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for those who disbelieve, they enjoy (the worldly life), and eat as cattle eat, and the Fire is the final abode for them.
T. Usmani.47:13: How many a town, stronger in might than your town that has expelled you, have We destroyed! Then, there was none to help them.
T. Usmani.47:14: Then, can one who holds on to a clear proof from his Lord be like those for whom their evil deeds are beautified, and who followed their desires?
T. Usmani.47:15: (Here is) a description of the Paradise that is promised for the God-fearing! In it there are rivers of water, never spoiling, and rivers of milk the taste of which would not go bad, and rivers of wine, delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of honey, fully purified. And for them there are all sorts of fruits, and forgiveness from their Lord. Are they like those who will live in Fire forever, and will be given boiling water to drink, and it will tear their bowels into pieces?
T. Usmani.47:16: Among them there are ones who (pretend to) give ear to you, until when they go out from your presence, they say to those who have been given knowledge, “What did he say just now?” Those are the ones on whose hearts Allah has put a seal, and they have followed their desires.
T. Usmani.47:17: As for those who have adopted right path, Allah improves them in guidance, and gives them their piety.
T. Usmani.47:18: They are waiting for nothing but for the Hour (of Doom) that it should come upon them suddenly. So, its signs have already come. Then, once it will come upon them, how would they have an opportunity to accept the advice (already) given to them?
T. Usmani.47:19: So, be assured that there is no god but Allah, and seek forgiveness for your fault, and for (the faults of) the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows your moving from place to place and your permanent abode.
T. Usmani.47:20: And the believers say, “Why has a (new) Sūrah not been revealed?” Then, once an operative Sūrah is sent down, and fighting (in Allah’s way) is mentioned in it, you notice those who have disease in their hearts, looking to you like one who is faint because of death. So, destruction is very close to them.
T. Usmani.47:21: The (reality of their) obedience and (truthfulness of their) speech is fully known (as being mere deception). So, had they been truthful to Allah when the matter had become serious, it would have been much better for them.
T. Usmani.47:22: So, (O hypocrites,) do you not apprehend that, in case you turn away (from Jihād ), you will spread disorder in the land and will sever your ties of kinship?
T. Usmani.47:23: Those are the ones whom Allah has cursed; so He has made them deaf, and made their eyes blind.
T. Usmani.47:24: Then, do they not give serious thought to the Qur’ān, or do they have locks on their hearts?
T. Usmani.47:25: Surely those who turn back after the guidance has appeared to them clearly, it is Satan who has tempted them and involved them in far-fetched fancies.
T. Usmani.47:26: That is because they say to those who hate that which Allah has revealed, “We will obey you in some respects.” And Allah knows their secret talk.
T. Usmani.47:27: So, how (miserable) will they be when the angels will exact their souls, smiting their faces and their backs?
T. Usmani.47:28: That is because they followed that which has angered Allah, and they disliked His pleasure; therefore He has nullified their deeds.
T. Usmani.47:29: Do those having malady in their hearts think that Allah will never expose their grudges (against Islam)?
T. Usmani.47:30: Had We willed, We would have shown them to you (by identifying each one of them,) so as you would definitely recognize them by their features. However, you will recognize them by the tone of (their) speech. And Allah knows (all) your deeds.
T. Usmani.47:31: And We will certainly test you until We know those of you who carry out Jihād (struggle in Allah’s way) and observe patience, and until We check your episodes.
T. Usmani.47:32: Those who disbelieve and prevent (others) from Allah’s way, and oppose the Messenger, after the Guidance has appeared to them clearly, shall never bring harm to Allah in the least, and He will render their deeds vain.
T. Usmani.47:33: O you who believe, obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not nullify your deeds.
T. Usmani.47:34: Those who disbelieved and prevented (others) from Allah’s way, then died as disbelievers, Allah will never forgive them.
T. Usmani.47:35: So, do not lose heart, and do not appeal for peace; you will be the uppermost, and Allah is with you; and He will never deprive you of your deeds.
T. Usmani.47:36: The worldly life is but play and pastime. If you believe and be God-fearing, He will give you your rewards, and will not ask you your riches.
T. Usmani.47:37: If He were to ask you of it, and press you (to spend all your wealth), you would show miserliness, and He would expose your disgusts.
T. Usmani.47:38: Yes, you are such that you are called upon to spend in Allah’s way, but some of you withhold in miserliness- and he who withholds in miserliness withholds against himself- and Allah is the Need-Free, and you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you by some other people, then they will not be like you.
T. Usmani.48:1: Surely, We have granted you an open victory,
T. Usmani.48:2: so that Allah may forgive you of your previous and subsequent faults, and may complete His favour upon you, and may guide you to a straight path,
T. Usmani.48:3: and so that Allah may support you with a mighty support.
T. Usmani.48:4: He (Allah) is such that He sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers, so that they grow more in faith in addition to their (existing) faith- And to Allah belong the forces of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise-
T. Usmani.48:5: so that He admits believing men and believing women to the gardens beneath which rivers flow, to live therein for ever, and so that He may write off their evil deeds, which is a great achievement in Allah’s sight,
T. Usmani.48:6: and so that He may punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the mushriks (polytheists), men and women, who think evil thoughts about Allah. Bound for them there is a vicious circle, and Allah has become angry with them, and He has prepared Jahannam (Hell) for them, and it is an evil destination.
T. Usmani.48:7: To Allah belong the forces of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
T. Usmani.48:8: Indeed, We have sent you (O prophet,) as a witness and as a bearer of good news and as a warner,
T. Usmani.48:9: so that you (O people,) believe in Allah and His Messenger, and support him and revere him, and pronounce His (Allah’s) purity morning and evening.
T. Usmani.48:10: Those who pledge allegiance with you (by placing their hands in your hand)- they, in fact, pledge allegiance with Allah. Allah’s hand is over their hands. Then, whoever breaks his pledge breaks it to his own detriment, and whoever fulfils the covenant he has made with Allah, He will give him a great reward.
T. Usmani.48:11: Those of the Bedouins who remained behind will say to you, “Our possessions and our families kept us busy, (hence we could not accompany you in your journey to Hudaibiyah). So, pray to Allah for our forgiveness.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts.Say, “Then, who has power to help you in any thing against Allah, if He intends to do you harm, or intends to do you good? Rather, Allah is fully aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.48:12: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never ever return to their families, and it seemed good to your hearts, and you thought an evil thought and became a people who are ruined (by their selfishness).”
T. Usmani.48:13: If one does not believe in Allah and His Messenger, then We have prepared a blazing fire for the disbelievers.
T. Usmani.48:14: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomsoever He wills, and punishes whomsoever He wills. And Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.48:15: Those who remained behind will say, when you will proceed to the spoils (of war) to receive them, “Let us follow you.”They wish to change the words of Allah. Say, “You shall not follow us. Allah had said like this beforehand.” Then they will say, “No, but you are jealous of us.” On the contrary, they do not understand (the reality) but a little.
T. Usmani.48:16: Say to those of the Bedouins who remained behind, “You will be called against a people possessed of strong fighting power; you will have to fight them until they submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward, and if you turn away, as you had turned away earlier, He will punish you with a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.48:17: There is no blame on the blind, nor is there any blame on the lame, nor is there any blame on the sick. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, He will admit him to the gardens beneath which rivers flow. But whoever turns away, He will punish him with a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.48:18: Allah was pleased with the believers when they were pledging allegiance with you (by placing their hands in your hands) under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them, and rewarded them with a victory, near at hand,
T. Usmani.48:19: and many spoils that they would receive. And Allah is Mighty, Wise.
T. Usmani.48:20: Allah had promised you many spoils that you would receive, so He gave these to you sooner, and stopped the hands of the people from (harming) you. And (He did this) so that it becomes a sign for believers, and so that He guides you to the right path.
T. Usmani.48:21: And (there is) another (victory) that has not come within your power as yet, (but) Allah has encompassed it. And Allah is Powerful over every thing.
T. Usmani.48:22: Had the disbelievers fought you, they would have certainly turned their backs, then they would have found neither a supporter nor a helper-
T. Usmani.48:23: - according to the consistent practice of Allah that went on since before, and you will never find a change in Allah’s consistent practice.
T. Usmani.48:24: And He is the One who restrained their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Makkah after He had let you prevail over them, and Allah is watchful over what you do.
T. Usmani.48:25: They are those who disbelieved and prevented you from the Sacred Mosque (Al-Masjid-ul-Harām ), and (prevented) the sacrificial animals that were detained from reaching their due place. And (Allah would have allowed you to fight,) had there not been believing men and believing women whom you did not know that you might have trampled them, and thus a painful situation might have arisen for you because of them unknowingly; (This situation was avoided) so that Allah may admit to His mercy whom He wills.And if they (the believing men and women) had moved (from Makkah), We would surely have punished those of them who disbelieved with a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.48:26: When the disbelievers developed in their hearts indignation, the indignation of ignorance; then Allah sent down tranquility from Himself upon His Messenger and upon the believers, and made them stick to the word of piety, and they were very much entitled to it and competent for it. And Allah is All-Knowing about every thing.
T. Usmani.48:27: Indeed, Allah has made true to His Messenger the dream (shown) with truth: You will definitely enter the Sacred Mosque inshā’allāh (if Allah wills,) peacefully, with your heads shaved, and your hairs cut short, having no fear. So He knew what you did not know, and He assigned before that a victory, near at hand.
T. Usmani.48:28: He is the One who has sent His Messenger with Guidance and the religion of truth, so that He makes it prevail over all religions. And enough is Allah for being a witness (to His promise).
T. Usmani.48:29: Muhammad(ﷺ) is the messenger of Allah, and those who are with him are hard on the disbelievers, compassionate among themselves; you will see them bowing down in Rukū‘, prostrating themselves in Sajdah, seeking grace from Allah, and (His) good pleasure; their distinguishing feature is on their faces from the effect of Sajdah (prostration). This is their description in Torah; and their description in Injīl is: like a sown crop that brings forth its shoot, then makes it strong, then it grows thick and stands straight on its stem, looking good to the farmers, so that He may enrage the disbelievers through them. Allah has promised forgiveness and a huge reward to those of them who believe and do good deeds.
T. Usmani.49:1: O you who believe, do not proceed ahead of Allah and His Messenger, and fear Allah. Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.49:2: O you who believe, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and be not loud when speaking to him, as you are loud when speaking to one another, lest your good deeds should become void while you are not aware.
T. Usmani.49:3: Surely, those who lower their voices before Allah’s Messenger are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for piety; for them there is forgiveness, and a great reward.
T. Usmani.49:4: As for those who call you from behind the chambers, most of them have no sense.
T. Usmani.49:5: Had they remained patient until you come out to them, it would have been much better for them. And Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.49:6: O you who believe, if a sinful person brings you a report, verify its correctness, lest you should harm a people out of ignorance, and then become remorseful on what you did.
T. Usmani.49:7: And know that among you there is the Messenger of Allah. If he obeys you in many a matter, you will certainly fall into hardship. But Allah has endeared to you the Faith, and made it beautiful in your hearts, and made detestable to you the disbelief and sins and disobedience. Such people are rightly guided,
T. Usmani.49:8: as a grace from Allah, and as a blessing. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
T. Usmani.49:9: If two groups of the believers fight each other, seek reconciliation between them. And if one of them commits aggression against the other, fight the one that commits aggression until it comes back to Allah’s command. So if it comes back, seek reconciliation between them with fairness, and maintain justice. Surely Allah loves those who maintain justice.
T. Usmani.49:10: All believers are but brothers, therefore seek reconciliation between your two brothers, and fear Allah, so that you may be blessed with mercy.
T. Usmani.49:11: O you who believe, no men should ever scoff at other men. May be, the latter are better than the former. Nor should women (ever scoff) at other women. May be, the latter women are better than the former ones. And do not find fault with one another, nor call one another with bad nicknames. Bad is the name of sinfulness after embracing Faith. If anyone does not repent, then such people are the wrongdoers.
T. Usmani.49:12: O you who believe, abstain from many of the suspicions. Some suspicions are sins. And do not be curious (to find out faults of others), and do not backbite one another. Does one of you like that he eats the flesh of his dead brother? You would abhor it. And fear Allah. Surely Allah is Most-Relenting, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.49:13: O mankind, We have created you from a male and a female, and made you into races and tribes, so that you may identify one another. Surely the noblest of you, in Allah’s sight, is the one who is most pious of you. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
T. Usmani.49:14: The Bedouins say, “We have come to believe.” Say, “You have not come to believe; instead, you (should) say, ‘We have surrendered’ and the belief has not entered your hearts so far. If you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not curtail (the reward of) any of your deeds in the least. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.”
T. Usmani.49:15: Believers, in fact, are those who believe in Allah and His Messenger, then have no doubt, and struggle, with their riches and their lives, in the way of Allah. Those are the truthful.
T. Usmani.49:16: Say, “Would you apprise Allah of your religion, while Allah knows all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is All-Knowing about every thing?”
T. Usmani.49:17: They oblige you that they have accepted Islam, (as if it was a favour shown to you). Say, “Do not oblige me for your accepting Islam. Rather, Allah makes you obliged for His having guided you to the Faith, if you are truthful.
T. Usmani.49:18: Surely Allah knows the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and Allah keeps in sight whatever you do.”
T. Usmani.50:1: Qāf . (I swear) by the glorious Qur’ān, (you are sent as a messenger.)
T. Usmani.50:2: But they wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves; so the disbelievers said, “This is something strange.
T. Usmani.50:3: Is it when we die and become dust (that we will be brought to life again?) That is a return, far (from understanding).”
T. Usmani.50:4: We know very well how much of them is diminished by the earth, and We have a Book that Preserves every thing.
T. Usmani.50:5: Rather, they rejected the truth when it came to them; so they are in a confused state.
T. Usmani.50:6: Did they not, then, look to the sky above them, how We have built it and beautified it, and it has no cracks?
T. Usmani.50:7: As for the earth, We have spread it out, and cast on it firm hills, and caused to grow therein every kind of delightful things,
T. Usmani.50:8: as a source of vision and as a lesson to every servant (of Allah) who turns (to Him for guidance).
T. Usmani.50:9: And We sent down blessed water from the sky, and caused to grow therewith gardens and grain of harvest,
T. Usmani.50:10: and towering date palms that have spadices, put one upon another,
T. Usmani.50:11: as a provision to the servants (of Allah). And We gave life with it to a dead land. Similar will be the exit (of the dead from their graves).
T. Usmani.50:12: It (resurrection) was rejected before them by the people of NūH, and the people of Rass and Thamūd,
T. Usmani.50:13: and ‘Ād, and Fir’aun (Pharaoh), and the brothers of LūT,
T. Usmani.50:14: and dwellers of Aaikah, and the people of Tubba’. Each one of them rejected the messengers; so My threat came true.
T. Usmani.50:15: Is it, then, that We were worn out by the first creation? No, but they are still in confusion about the new creation.
T. Usmani.50:16: Indeed We have created man, and We know whatever thoughts his inner self develops, and We are closer to him than (his) jugular vein,
T. Usmani.50:17: when the two receiving angels receive (every human act to record it), seated (one) on the right and (one) on the left.
T. Usmani.50:18: Not a single word is uttered by one but there is a watcher near him, ready (to record).
T. Usmani.50:19: The daze of death has (to) come with truth. That is what you tried to escape.
T. Usmani.50:20: And the Horn will be blown. That will be the day of (which) threat (was given).
T. Usmani.50:21: And everybody will come, along with one (angel) to drive (him to the field of reckoning) and one (angel) to testify (about his deeds).
T. Usmani.50:22: “You were heedless of this. Now We have removed your veil from you; so your sight today is sharp.”
T. Usmani.50:23: And his companion (i.e. the angel who recorded his deeds) will say, “This is what I have with me, ready (to be presented as his record of deeds).”
T. Usmani.50:24: (Then it will be said,) “Cast, (O two angels,) into Jahannam (Hell) every obstinate disbeliever
T. Usmani.50:25: who used to prevent (others) from good (behavior), who transgressed all bounds, who cast doubts (in true faith),
T. Usmani.50:26: who set up another god along with Allah. So cast him (O angels) in the painful punishment.”
T. Usmani.50:27: His (evil) companion (i.e. the Satan) will say, “O our Lord, I did not cause him to rebel, but he was himself (involved) in straying far from the track.”
T. Usmani.50:28: He (Allah) will say, “Do not quarrel before Me, while I had sent to you My threat well in advance.
T. Usmani.50:29: The Word is not changed with Me, and I Am not so unjust to My servants.”
T. Usmani.50:30: (Remind them of) the Day when We will say to Jahannam (Hell), “Are you filled up?” and it will say, “Are there some more?”
T. Usmani.50:31: And the Jannah (Paradise) will be brought close for the God-fearing, no longer distant.
T. Usmani.50:32: (And it will be said,) “This is what you were promised for everyone who was oft-returning to Allah, vigilant (against sins),
T. Usmani.50:33: the one who feared the RaHmān (The All-Merciful Allah), without seeing Him, and came up with a heart oriented towards Him.
T. Usmani.50:34: Enter it in peace. That is the Day of Eternity.”
T. Usmani.50:35: They will have in it whatever they wish, and with Us there are things even more than that.
T. Usmani.50:36: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger than these in their grip on power, and they searched out the cities. Was there any place (for them) to escape?
T. Usmani.50:37: Indeed, there is a lesson in all this for him who has a heart and gives ear (to the truth) attentively.
T. Usmani.50:38: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and no weariness even touched Us.
T. Usmani.50:39: So, (O Prophet,) endure with patience what they say, and proclaim His purity, along with your Lord’s praise, before sunrise and before sunset.
T. Usmani.50:40: And in hours of night, proclaim His purity, and at the ends of prostration.
T. Usmani.50:41: And listen: The Day when the caller will call out from a near place,
T. Usmani.50:42: the Day they will hear the Cry in reality- that will be the Day of Resurrection.
T. Usmani.50:43: Surely We alone give life and bring death, and to Us is the final return
T. Usmani.50:44: on the Day when the earth will burst apart exposing them, while they will be hurrying up (to come out). That is an assembly, so easy for Us (to muster).
T. Usmani.50:45: We know well what they say, and you are not (sent) as one who compels them. So exhort, through the Qur’ān, the one who fears My warning.
T. Usmani.51:2: then those that bear load (of clouds),
T. Usmani.51:3: then those that float with ease,
T. Usmani.51:5: whatever you are being promised is surely true,
T. Usmani.51:6: and Recompense (of deeds) is sure to happen.
T. Usmani.51:8: you are (involved) in a contradictory discussion.
T. Usmani.51:9: Turned away from this (Qur’ān) is the one who is turned away (totally from the truth.)
T. Usmani.51:10: Death upon those who make conjectures (against the true faith),
T. Usmani.51:11: - those who are drowned in ignorance, forgetful!
T. Usmani.51:12: They ask, “When shall be the Day of Recompense?”
T. Usmani.51:13: (It will be) the Day when they will be heated on the Fire,
T. Usmani.51:14: (and it will be said to them,) “Taste (the punishment of) your mischief. This is what you have been asking to be brought sooner.”
T. Usmani.51:15: The God-fearing (on the other hand) will be in gardens and springs,
T. Usmani.51:16: receiving what their Lord will have given to them. Indeed, prior to this, they were good in their deeds.
T. Usmani.51:17: They used to sleep little in the night;
T. Usmani.51:18: and in the hours before dawn they used to pray for forgiveness,
T. Usmani.51:19: and in their wealth, there was a right for one who asks and for one who is deprived.
T. Usmani.51:20: In the earth, there are signs for those who (seek truth to) believe,
T. Usmani.51:21: and in your own selves! So, do you not perceive?
T. Usmani.51:22: And in the heavens, there is your sustenance and all that you have been promised.
T. Usmani.51:23: So, by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it (the Day of Recompense) is a reality, as sure as the fact that you (can) speak.
T. Usmani.51:24: Has there come to you the story of the honoured guests of Ibrāhīm?
T. Usmani.51:25: When they (the angels in human form) entered unto him and said, “We greet you with Salām .” He said, “Salām on you.” (And he said to himself,) “(They are) unknown people.”
T. Usmani.51:26: Then he slipped off to his home and fetched a fattened calf.
T. Usmani.51:27: So he presented it before them (to eat, but being angels, they refrained.) He said, “Would you not eat?”
T. Usmani.51:28: So he felt some fear in his heart. They said, “Be not scared.” And they gave him the good news of (the birth of) a knowledgeable boy.
T. Usmani.51:29: So his wife came forward with a clamor, and slapped her own face and said, “(How can I have a child when I am) a barren old woman?”
T. Usmani.51:30: They said, “This is how your Lord has said. Surely, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.”
T. Usmani.51:31: He (Ibrāhīm) said (to the angels), “Then, what is your mission O messengers?”
T. Usmani.51:32: They said, “We are sent to a guilty people, (i.e. the people of Sodom)
T. Usmani.51:33: so that we may send down upon them stones of clay,
T. Usmani.51:34: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
T. Usmani.51:35: So, We let the believers who were there to come out (from danger),
T. Usmani.51:36: but We did not find in it any Muslims, except one house.
T. Usmani.51:37: And We left in this (event) a sign (of deterrence) for those who fear the painful punishment.
T. Usmani.51:38: And (We left a similar sign) in (the story of) Mūsā, when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a clear proof.
T. Usmani.51:39: So he turned away along with his chiefs and said, “ (Mūsā is) a magician or a madman!”
T. Usmani.51:40: So We seized him and his army, and cast them into the sea, as he was of culpable behaviour.
T. Usmani.51:41: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) ‘Ād, when We sent upon them the wind that was barren (from any benefit);
T. Usmani.51:42: it spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like a stuff smashed by decay.
T. Usmani.51:43: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) Thamūd, when it was said to them, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
T. Usmani.51:44: Then they rebelled against the command of your Lord; so the thunderbolt (of divine punishment) seized them, while they were looking on.
T. Usmani.51:45: Then they were neither able to stand (before the punishment), nor could they defend themselves.
T. Usmani.51:46: And (We have destroyed) the people of NūH even before; indeed they were a sinful people.
T. Usmani.51:47: And the sky was built by Us with might; and indeed We are the expanders.
T. Usmani.51:48: And the earth was spread out by Us as a floor; so how well have We spread it out!
T. Usmani.51:49: And from every thing We have created pairs of twos, so that you may heed.
T. Usmani.51:50: So, flee to Allah. Indeed I am a plain warner sent by Him for you.
T. Usmani.51:51: And do not make up any other god along with Allah. Indeed I am a plain warner sent by Him for you.
T. Usmani.51:52: In similar way, no messenger came to those before them, but they said, “(He is) a magician or a madman.”
T. Usmani.51:53: Have they handed down (this saying) to each other as a legacy? Rather they are a rebellious people.
T. Usmani.51:54: So, turn away from them, for you are not blamed.
T. Usmani.51:55: And keep reminding, because reminding benefits the believers.
T. Usmani.51:56: I did not create the Jinns and the human beings except for the purpose that they should worship Me.
T. Usmani.51:57: I do not want any sustenance from them, nor do I want them to feed Me.
T. Usmani.51:58: In fact, Allah is the All-Sustainer, Possessor of power, the Strong.
T. Usmani.51:59: So, those who did wrong will have their turn like the turn of their counterparts. So, they should not ask Me to hasten on.
T. Usmani.51:60: Woe, then, to those who disbelieve because of the Day of theirs that they are promised (for punishment).
T. Usmani.52:5: and by the roof, raised high,
T. Usmani.52:6: and by the sea, flared up (with fire),
T. Usmani.52:7: the punishment of your Lord is sure to fall.
T. Usmani.52:8: There is nothing to push it back,
T. Usmani.52:9: the Day when the sky will tremble, a horrible trembling,
T. Usmani.52:10: and the mountains will move about, a terrible movement.
T. Usmani.52:11: So, woe to those who reject (the true faith),
T. Usmani.52:12: who are indulged in vain talk, playing (with truth),
T. Usmani.52:13: the Day they will be pushed to the Fire forcefully,
T. Usmani.52:14: (and it will be said to them,) “This is the Fire you used to deny.
T. Usmani.52:15: Is it then magic, or do you not see?
T. Usmani.52:16: Enter it. Now, whether you endure (it) patiently or impatiently, it is all the same for you; you are merely rewarded for what you used to do.”
T. Usmani.52:17: Of course, the God-fearing will be in gardens and bliss,
T. Usmani.52:18: enjoying what their Lord will have given to them, and their Lord will have saved them from the punishment of Hell.
T. Usmani.52:19: (It will be said to them,) “Eat and drink pleasantly because of what you used to do,
T. Usmani.52:20: relaxing on lined up couches”. And We will marry them with big-eyed houris.
T. Usmani.52:21: And those who believed and their children followed them in belief, We will join their children with them, and will not curtail (the reward of) any of their deeds at all. Every person will be pledged for what he earned.
T. Usmani.52:22: And We will go on giving them whatever they desire of fruits and meat.
T. Usmani.52:23: They will snatch from one another (in a friendly manner) a glass (of wine) carrying neither absurd talk, nor something leading to sin.
T. Usmani.52:24: And their own serving boys will rotate around them, (who will be as neat and clean) as if they were hidden pearls.
T. Usmani.52:25: And they will advance to one another, asking (about each other’s welfare).
T. Usmani.52:26: They will say, “Indeed we were afraid (of Allah’s punishment) when we were amidst our family,
T. Usmani.52:27: but Allah did favour to us and saved us from the torment of Fire’s scorching breath.
T. Usmani.52:28: We used to pray to Him before. He is surely the Most-Kind, the Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.52:29: So keep reminding (them), because by the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a mad man.
T. Usmani.52:30: Do they rather say, “He is a poet for whom we are awaiting the accident of death?”
T. Usmani.52:31: Say, “Wait! I am waiting with you, too.”
T. Usmani.52:32: Is it their intellects that direct them to (say) this, or are they a rebellious people?
T. Usmani.52:33: Do they rather say, “He has forged it (the Qur’ān.)”? No, but they do not believe.
T. Usmani.52:34: So, let them bring a discourse like this, if they are truthful.
T. Usmani.52:35: Is it that they are created by none, or are they themselves the creators?
T. Usmani.52:36: Or have they created the heavens and the earth? No, but they are sure of nothing.
T. Usmani.52:37: Or do they have the treasures of your Lord, or have they acquired control (over them)?
T. Usmani.52:38: Or have they a stairway (to the heavens) by means of which they listen (to the divine decrees)? If so, their listener must bring a clear proof.
T. Usmani.52:39: Is it that He has daughters and you have sons?
T. Usmani.52:40: Or is it that you (O prophet) ask them for a fee, and therefore they are burdened with a liability?
T. Usmani.52:41: Or have they the knowledge of the Unseen, and they are recording it?
T. Usmani.52:42: Or do they intend to plan to do harm (to the prophet)? Then the disbelievers themselves shall be harmed by the plan.
T. Usmani.52:43: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Pure is Allah from what they associate with Him.
T. Usmani.52:44: Even if they see a piece falling down from the sky, they would say, “It is a cumulated cloud.”
T. Usmani.52:45: So, leave them alone until they face their Day, in which they will be turned unconscious,
T. Usmani.52:46: the Day their planning will not benefit them in the least, nor will they be helped.
T. Usmani.52:47: And for those who did wrong there is another punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
T. Usmani.52:48: And (O Prophet) be patient about the decision of your Lord, because you are in front of Our Eyes. And proclaim the purity of your Lord along with His praise when you stand (in Prayer),
T. Usmani.52:49: And, in parts of night too, proclaim His purity, and at the time of setting of the stars.
T. Usmani.53:1: By the star when it goes down to set,
T. Usmani.53:2: your fellow (the Holy Prophet) has neither missed the way, nor did he deviate.
T. Usmani.53:3: He does not speak out of (his own) desire.
T. Usmani.53:4: It is but revelation revealed (to him).
T. Usmani.53:5: It is taught to him by one (angel) of strong faculties,
T. Usmani.53:6: the one of vigour. So he stood poised,
T. Usmani.53:7: while he was on the upper horizon.
T. Usmani.53:8: Then he drew near, and came down,
T. Usmani.53:9: so as he was at a distance like that of two bows (joined together), rather even nearer.
T. Usmani.53:10: Thus He (Allah) revealed to His slave what He revealed.
T. Usmani.53:11: The heart did not err in what he saw.
T. Usmani.53:12: Do you quarrel with him in what he sees?
T. Usmani.53:13: Indeed he saw him another time
T. Usmani.53:14: by Sidrat-ul-Muntahā (the lote-tree in the upper realm),
T. Usmani.53:15: near which there is Jannat-ul-Ma’wā (the Paradise of Abode),
T. Usmani.53:16: when the lote-tree was covered by that which covered it.
T. Usmani.53:17: The eye neither went wrong, nor did exceed the limit.
T. Usmani.53:18: He has indeed seen a part of the biggest signs of your Lord.
T. Usmani.53:19: Have you ever considered about the (idols of) Lāt and ‘Uzzā,
T. Usmani.53:20: and about the other, the third (idol), namely, Manāt,?
T. Usmani.53:21: Is it that you have males and He (Allah) has females?
T. Usmani.53:22: If so, it is a bizarre division.
T. Usmani.53:23: These are nothing but names you and your fathers have invented; Allah has sent down no authority attached to them. They are following nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire, while guidance from their Lord has surely reached them.
T. Usmani.53:24: Is it that man can get whatever he wishes?
T. Usmani.53:25: (No,) because to Allah alone belongs the (good of) the Hereafter and the former life (of this world).
T. Usmani.53:26: How many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession cannot benefit (any one) at all, but after Allah allows (it) for whomsoever He wills and pleases.
T. Usmani.53:27: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter call the angels by names of females.
T. Usmani.53:28: They do not have knowledge about it. They follow nothing but conjecture, and conjecture is of no avail in (the matter of) Truth.
T. Usmani.53:29: So, turn away from him who turns away from Our advice, and seeks nothing but (pleasure of) the worldly life.
T. Usmani.53:30: That is the limit of their access to knowledge. Indeed only your Lord knows well about the one who has gone astray from his way, and He knows well about the one who has adopted the right path.
T. Usmani.53:31: To Allah belongs whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, so that He gives punishment to evildoers for what they did, and gives good reward to those who did good
T. Usmani.53:32: -those who abstain from the major sins and from shameful acts, except minor involvements. Indeed your Lord is extensive in forgiveness. He knows you more than anyone else (from a time) when He created you from the earth and when you were embryos in the wombs of your mothers. So, do not claim purity (from faults) for your selves. He knows best who is God-fearing.
T. Usmani.53:33: Did you see the one who turned away,
T. Usmani.53:34: and gave a little, and stopped?
T. Usmani.53:35: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen whereby he sees (what he believes)?
T. Usmani.53:36: Has he not been told of what was (revealed) in the scriptures of Mūsā
T. Usmani.53:37: and of Ibrāhīm who fulfilled (his duties)?
T. Usmani.53:38: (It was) that no bearer of burden shall bear the burden of the other,
T. Usmani.53:39: and that a man shall not deserve but (the reward of) his own effort,
T. Usmani.53:40: and that his effort will soon be seen,
T. Usmani.53:41: then he will be recompensed for it in full,
T. Usmani.53:42: and that to your Lord is the end (of every one),
T. Usmani.53:43: and that He is the One who makes (one) laugh and makes (him) weep,
T. Usmani.53:44: and that He is the One who gives death and gives life,
T. Usmani.53:45: and that He creates the pairs, male and female,
T. Usmani.53:46: from a sperm-drop when it is poured (into a womb),
T. Usmani.53:47: and that the second creation is undertaken by Him,
T. Usmani.53:48: and that He is the One who gives wealth and preserves (it),
T. Usmani.53:49: and that He is the One who is the Lord of Sirius (the star worshipped by pagans),
T. Usmani.53:50: and that He has destroyed the earlier ‘Ād,
T. Usmani.53:52: and (destroyed) the people of NūH even earlier. Surely they were more unjust and more rebellious.
T. Usmani.53:53: And He destroyed the overturned towns (of the people of LūT) also,
T. Usmani.53:54: so enveloped they were by that which enveloped.
T. Usmani.53:55: Then concerning which of your Lord’s bounties would you remain in doubt?
T. Usmani.53:56: This (Prophet) is a warner from the (genus of the) previous warners.
T. Usmani.53:57: The Imminent (Hour of Judgment) has approached.
T. Usmani.53:58: There is no one, beside Allah, to remove it.
T. Usmani.53:59: Do you then wonder at this discourse,
T. Usmani.53:60: and laugh (at it), and not weep,
T. Usmani.53:61: while you are engaged in vain play?
T. Usmani.53:62: Now, fall down in prostration and worship (Allah).
T. Usmani.54:1: The Hour (of doom) has drawn near, and the moon has split asunder.
T. Usmani.54:2: When these people see a sign, they turn away and say, “(This is) a transient magic.”
T. Usmani.54:3: They have rejected (the Truth) and followed their desires, while every matter has to settle (at some time).
T. Usmani.54:4: And there has come to them as much news (of the earlier communities) as it is enough to deter,
T. Usmani.54:5: (containing) a perfect wisdom. But the warnings are of no avail (to them).
T. Usmani.54:6: Therefore, turn aside (O Prophet,) from them. (They will see the reality) on the day in which the caller will call (them) to a gruesome object.
T. Usmani.54:7: With their eyes humbled, they will come out of the graves like locusts spread all over,
T. Usmani.54:8: rushing quickly towards the caller. (On that Day) the disbelievers will say, “This is a hard day.”
T. Usmani.54:9: The people of NūH denied (the truth) before them. So they rejected Our servant, and said, “(He is) a madman”, and he was (also) threatened (by them).
T. Usmani.54:10: So he prayed to his Lord saying, “I am overpowered, so defend (me).”
T. Usmani.54:11: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring forth profusely,
T. Usmani.54:12: and We caused the earth to gush forth as springs; so the water (of both kinds) met together for a destined event.
T. Usmani.54:13: And We caused him (NūH) to board that (ship) which had planks and nails,
T. Usmani.54:14: which sailed under Our Eyes, as a reward for the one who was rejected (by the infidels).
T. Usmani.54:15: And We left it (the ship) as a sign. So, is there one to take lesson?
T. Usmani.54:16: Then how was My torment and My warnings?
T. Usmani.54:17: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?
T. Usmani.54:18: (The people of) ‘Ād rejected (their prophet). So how was My torment and My warnings?
T. Usmani.54:19: We did send to them a furious wind in a day of continuous misfortune,
T. Usmani.54:20: plucking people away, as if they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
T. Usmani.54:21: So how was My torment and My warnings?
T. Usmani.54:22: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?
T. Usmani.54:23: (The people of) Thamūd rejected the warners.
T. Usmani.54:24: So they said, “Shall we follow a single human being from among us? Then we will be in error and insanity.
T. Usmani.54:25: Is it that the advice has been cast upon him alone out of all of us? No, but he is a bragging liar.”
T. Usmani.54:26: Tomorrow they will know who the bragging liar is!
T. Usmani.54:27: We are going to send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch them (O SāliH,) and keep patience,
T. Usmani.54:28: and tell them that water (of the well) is to be shared between them (and the she-camel), so as the right of having water shall be attended by each (alternatively).
T. Usmani.54:29: Then they called their man (to kill the she-camel,) so he undertook (the task) and killed (the she-camel).
T. Usmani.54:30: So how was My torment and My warnings?
T. Usmani.54:31: We sent upon them a single Cry, and they were like crushed leafs of a hedge-builder.
T. Usmani.54:32: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?
T. Usmani.54:33: The people of LūT rejected the warners.
T. Usmani.54:34: We sent upon them a rain of stones, except the family of LūT whom We saved in the last hours of night,
T. Usmani.54:35: as a grace from Us. This is how We reward the one who offers gratitude.
T. Usmani.54:36: And he (LūT) had certainly warned them of Our grasp, but they disputed the warnings.
T. Usmani.54:37: And they had even tried to tempt him against his guests (so that they may snatch them away for bad purpose,) but We blinded their eyes: “Now taste My torment and My warnings!”
T. Usmani.54:38: And on the next morning, a lasting torment overtook them:
T. Usmani.54:39: “Now taste My torment and My warnings.”
T. Usmani.54:40: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?
T. Usmani.54:41: And the warners came to the family of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).
T. Usmani.54:42: (But) they rejected all Our signs; so We seized them- a seizure by One Mighty, Powerful.
T. Usmani.54:43: Are the disbelievers among you in a better position than all of the aforesaid (punished people), or do you have immunity (recorded) in the sacred books?
T. Usmani.54:44: Or do they say, “We are a large group, well-defended.”?
T. Usmani.54:45: Soon this ‘large group’ shall be defeated, and all of them will turn their backs.
T. Usmani.54:46: Rather the Hour (of judgment) is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour is more calamitous and much more bitter.
T. Usmani.54:47: Surely the guilty ones are in error and madness.
T. Usmani.54:48: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, (it will be said to them,) “Taste the touch of Hell.”
T. Usmani.54:49: Verily, We have created every thing according to (Our) predestination.
T. Usmani.54:50: And (implementation of) Our command is no more than a single act like the twinkling of an eye.
T. Usmani.54:51: We have destroyed people like you; so, is there one to take lesson?
T. Usmani.54:52: And every thing they have done is recorded in the books (of deeds).
T. Usmani.54:53: And every thing, small and big, is written down.
T. Usmani.54:54: Of course, the God-fearing will be in gardens and rivers,
T. Usmani.54:55: in a seat of Truth, near to the Omnipotent Sovereign.
T. Usmani.55:4: He has taught him (how) to express himself.
T. Usmani.55:5: The sun and the moon are (bound) by a (fixed) calculation.
T. Usmani.55:6: And the vine and the tree both prostrate (to Allah).
T. Usmani.55:7: He raised the sky high, and has placed the scale,
T. Usmani.55:8: so that you should not be wrongful in weighing.
T. Usmani.55:9: Observe the correct weight with fairness, and do not make weighing deficient.
T. Usmani.55:10: As for the earth, He has placed it for creatures,
T. Usmani.55:11: in which there are fruits and date palms having sheaths,
T. Usmani.55:12: and the grain having chaff, and fragrant flowers.
T. Usmani.55:13: So, (O mankind and Jinn,) which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:14: He has created man from dry clay, ringing like pottery,
T. Usmani.55:15: and created Jann (father of the Jinn) from a smokeless flame of fire.
T. Usmani.55:16: So, (O mankind and Jinn,) which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:17: He is the Lord of both points of sunrise and both points of sunset.
T. Usmani.55:18: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:19: He let forth the two seas to meet together,
T. Usmani.55:20: while there is a barrier between them; they do not encroach (upon one another).
T. Usmani.55:21: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:22: From both of them come forth the pearl and the coral.
T. Usmani.55:23: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:24: And His are the sailing ships raised up in the sea like mountains.
T. Usmani.55:25: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:26: Every one who is on it (the earth) has to perish.
T. Usmani.55:27: And your Lord’s Countenance will remain, full of majesty, full of honour.
T. Usmani.55:28: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:29: All those in the heavens and the earth beseech Him (for their needs.) Every day He is in a state of action.
T. Usmani.55:30: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:31: Soon We are going to spare Ourselves for you (to reckon your deeds), O two heavy species (of Jinn and mankind)!
T. Usmani.55:32: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:33: O genera of Jinn and mankind, If you are able to penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate. You cannot penetrate without power.
T. Usmani.55:34: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:35: A flame of fire and a smoke will be loosed against you, and you will not (be able) to defend.
T. Usmani.55:36: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:37: So, (it will be a terrible event) when the sky will be split apart and will become rosy, like (red) hides.
T. Usmani.55:38: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:39: On that day, neither a man will be questioned about his sin, nor a Jinn.
T. Usmani.55:40: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:41: The guilty ones will be recognized (by angels) through their marks and will be seized by foreheads and feet.
T. Usmani.55:42: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:43: This is Jahannam (Hell) that the guilty people deny.
T. Usmani.55:44: They will circle around between it and between hot, boiling water.
T. Usmani.55:45: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:46: And for the one who is fearful of having to stand before his Lord, there are two gardens, -
T. Usmani.55:47: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:49: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:50: In both there are two flowing springs.
