T. Usmani.55:51: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:52: In both there are two kinds of every fruit.
T. Usmani.55:53: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:54: (The people of these gardens will be) reclining on floorings whose (even) linings will be of thick silk, and the fruits plucked from the two gardens will be at hand.
T. Usmani.55:55: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:56: In them there will be maidens restraining (their) glances, whom neither a man might have touched before them, nor a Jinn.
T. Usmani.55:57: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:58: They will look like rubies and corals.
T. Usmani.55:59: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:60: Is there any reward for goodness other than goodness?
T. Usmani.55:61: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:62: And besides these two, there are two other gardens (for the second category of the God-fearing),-
T. Usmani.55:63: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:65: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:66: In both there are two springs gushing forth profusely.
T. Usmani.55:67: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:68: In both there are fruits and date-palms and pomegranates.
T. Usmani.55:69: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:70: In them there will be women, good and gorgeous,-
T. Usmani.55:71: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:72: - the houris, kept guarded in pavilions-
T. Usmani.55:73: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:74: - whom neither a man might have touched before them, nor a Jinn.
T. Usmani.55:75: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:76: (The people of these gardens will be) reclining on green cushions and marvelously beautiful mattresses.
T. Usmani.55:77: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
T. Usmani.55:78: Glorious is the name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty, the Lord of Honour.
T. Usmani.56:1: When the Imminent Event (of Doom) will occur,
T. Usmani.56:2: there will be no one to deny its occurrence.
T. Usmani.56:4: when the earth will be jolted with a terrible jolt,
T. Usmani.56:5: and the mountains will be crumbled a thorough crumbling,
T. Usmani.56:6: until they will become dust, scattered in the air,
T. Usmani.56:7: and you will be (divided into) three categories.
T. Usmani.56:8: As for the People of the Right, how (lucky) are the People of the Right!
T. Usmani.56:9: And the People of the Left ? How (wretched) are the People of the Left!
T. Usmani.56:10: And the Foremost are the foremost.
T. Usmani.56:11: Those are the ones blessed with nearness (to Allah)
T. Usmani.56:14: and a few from the later ones.
T. Usmani.56:15: (They will be sitting) on thrones woven with gold,
T. Usmani.56:16: reclining on them, facing each other.
T. Usmani.56:17: Immortal boys will rotate around them
T. Usmani.56:18: with bowls and jugs and a goblet of pure wine,
T. Usmani.56:19: from which they will neither suffer headache, nor will they be intoxicated,
T. Usmani.56:21: and the flesh of birds that they desire.
T. Usmani.56:22: And (for them there will be) houris, having lovely big eyes,
T. Usmani.56:23: all (neat and clean) like a hidden pearl,
T. Usmani.56:24: as a reward for what they used to do.
T. Usmani.56:25: They will hear neither an absurd talk in it, nor something leading to sin,
T. Usmani.56:26: but (they will hear) the words of Salām , Salām (as greetings).
T. Usmani.56:27: And the People of the right? How (lucky) are the People of the Right!
T. Usmani.56:28: (They will be) amid lote-trees with no thorns,
T. Usmani.56:29: and the trees of TalH , (banana, or a fragrant tree) having layers one upon the other,
T. Usmani.56:30: and a shade, spread all over,
T. Usmani.56:33: neither interrupted (in any season), nor prohibited,
T. Usmani.56:35: Surely We have made up those females in a special creation,
T. Usmani.56:37: amorous to their husbands, matching them in age,
T. Usmani.56:38: for the People of the Right,
T. Usmani.56:40: and many from the later ones.
T. Usmani.56:41: And the People of the Left? How (wretched) are the People of the Left!
T. Usmani.56:42: (They will be) in scorching wind and boiling water,
T. Usmani.56:43: and in a shade of black smoke,
T. Usmani.56:46: and used to persist in major sins,
T. Usmani.56:47: and used to say, “Is it that when we die and become dust-is it that we will be raised again,
T. Usmani.56:48: and our ancient fathers as well?”
T. Usmani.56:49: Say, “All the earlier and the later ones
T. Usmani.56:50: will be gathered together for a fixed time of a specified Day.
T. Usmani.56:51: Then O you, the erring, the denying people,
T. Usmani.56:52: you will have to eat from the tree of zaqqūm,
T. Usmani.56:53: and to fill with it the bellies,
T. Usmani.56:54: then on top of it you will have to drink boiling water,
T. Usmani.56:55: and to drink like camels suffering from the disease of over-thirst.
T. Usmani.56:56: This will be their welcome entertainment on the Day of Requital.
T. Usmani.56:57: We have created you; then why do you not believe in it?
T. Usmani.56:58: So, tell Me about the semen you drop (in the wombs):
T. Usmani.56:59: Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator?
T. Usmani.56:60: We have appointed (the times of) death among you, and We cannot be frustrated
T. Usmani.56:61: from replacing you with others like you, and creating you (afresh) in that (form) which you do not know.
T. Usmani.56:62: And you certainly know the first creation; then why do you not take lesson?
T. Usmani.56:63: Well, tell Me about that (seed) which you sow:
T. Usmani.56:64: Is it you who grow it, or are We the One who grows?
T. Usmani.56:65: If We so will, We can certainly make it crumbled, and you will remain wondering,
T. Usmani.56:68: Again, tell Me about the water you drink:
T. Usmani.56:69: Is it you who have brought it down from the clouds, or are We the One who sends (it) down?
T. Usmani.56:70: If We so will, We can make it bitter in taste. So why do you not offer gratitude?
T. Usmani.56:71: Now tell Me about the fire you kindle:
T. Usmani.56:72: Is it you who have originated its tree, or are We the Originator?
T. Usmani.56:73: We have made it a reminder (of Our infinite power, and of the fire of Hell) and a benefit for travelers in deserts.
T. Usmani.56:74: So, proclaim purity of the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.
T. Usmani.56:75: So, I swear by the setting places of the stars,
T. Usmani.56:76: -and indeed it is a great oath, if you are to appreciate-
T. Usmani.56:77: it is surely the Noble Qur’ān,
T. Usmani.56:78: (recorded already) in a protected book (i.e. the Preserved Tablet)
T. Usmani.56:79: that is not touched except by the purified ones (the angels).
T. Usmani.56:80: - a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.56:81: Is it this discourse that you take lightly,
T. Usmani.56:82: and take your denial as your livelihood?
T. Usmani.56:83: So why (do you) not (intervene) when the soul (of a dying person) reaches the throat,
T. Usmani.56:85: And We are closer to him than you, but you do not perceive.
T. Usmani.56:86: So, if you are not going to be recompensed (in the Hereafter for your deeds), then why do you not
T. Usmani.56:87: bring the soul back, if you are truthful?
T. Usmani.56:88: So, in case he (the dying person) is from among those blessed with nearness,
T. Usmani.56:89: then (for him) there is comfort and fragrance and garden of bliss.
T. Usmani.56:90: And in case he is from among the People of the Right,
T. Usmani.56:91: then, (it will be said to him,) “Peace is for you, as you are one of the People of the Right.”
T. Usmani.56:92: But if he is one of the deniers, the astray,
T. Usmani.56:93: then (for him) there is entertainment from boiling water,
T. Usmani.56:95: Indeed this is certainty in its true sense.
T. Usmani.56:96: So, proclaim purity of the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.
T. Usmani.57:1: All that is in the heavens and the earth proclaims Allah’s purity, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
T. Usmani.57:2: To Him belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and brings death, and He is Powerful to do any thing.
T. Usmani.57:3: He is the First and the Last, and the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is All-Knowing about every thing.
T. Usmani.57:4: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then He positioned Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out from it, and whatever descends from the sky, and whatever ascends thereto. He is with you wherever you are, and Allah is watchful of whatever you do.
T. Usmani.57:5: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned.
T. Usmani.57:6: He makes the night enter into the day, and makes the day enter into the night, and He is All-Knowing about whatever lies in the hearts.
T. Usmani.57:7: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend out of that (wealth) in which He has appointed you as deputies. So, for those of you who have believed and spent (in Allah’s way), there is a big reward.
T. Usmani.57:8: What is wrong with you that you do not believe in Allah, while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord, and He has taken your covenant, if you are to believe?
T. Usmani.57:9: He is the One who reveals clear verses to His servant, so that He brings you out from layers of darkness into the light. And to you, Allah is Very-Kind indeed, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.57:10: And what is wrong with you that you should not spend in the way of Allah, while to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent before the Conquest (of Makkah) and fought are not at par (with others). Those are much greater in rank than those who spent later and fought, though Allah has promised the good (reward) for each. Allah is well aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.57:11: Who is there to advance a loan, a good loan, to Allah so that He multiplies it for him, and he may have a noble reward?
T. Usmani.57:12: On the Day when you will see the believing men and the believing women, their light proceeding in front of them and to their right hands, (it will be said to them,) “Good news for you today! Gardens beneath which rivers flow, to live therein forever! That is the great achievement,
T. Usmani.57:13: - the Day when the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believe, “Wait for us, so that we may have a share from your light.”It will be said (to them), “Go back to your rear, and search for light.” Then a wall will be placed between them, which will have a gate. In its inner side, there will be the divine mercy, while towards its outer side, there will be the divine punishment.
T. Usmani.57:14: They (the hypocrites) will call out to them (the believers), “Were we not with you?” They will say, “Yes, (you were,) but you led your souls to a wrong way, and kept waiting (for an evil end to the Muslims), and remained in doubt, and were deluded by fancies, until Allah’s command came to pass, and you were deceived about Allah by the Big Deceiver (Iblīs).
T. Usmani.57:15: So, no ransom will be accepted from you today, nor from those who disbelieved (openly). Your abode is the Fire, and it is an evil end.”
T. Usmani.57:16: Has the time not yet come for those who believe that their hearts should be humble for the remembrance of Allah and for the truth that has descended (through revelation)? They must not be like those to whom the Book was given before, but a long period passed on them (in which they did not repent), therefore their hearts became hard, and (thus) many of them are sinners.
T. Usmani.57:17: Know well that Allah revives the land after its death. We have made the signs clear for you, so that you may understand.
T. Usmani.57:18: Surely those men who give Sadaqah (alms) and those women who give Sadaqah and have advanced a good loan to Allah, for them it will be multiplied, and for them there is a noble reward.
T. Usmani.57:19: And those who believed in Allah and His messengers, - those are the Siddīqs (the most righteous after prophets) and the Shuhadā’ (martyrs) in the sight of your Lord. For them shall be their reward and their light. As for those who disbelieved and rejected Our verses, they are the inmates of Hell.
T. Usmani.57:20: Know well that the worldly life is but a play and an amusement, and a show of beauty, and exchange of boastful claims between you, and a competition of increase in riches and children. (All this is) like a rain, the growth of which attracts the farmers, then it withers, and you see it turning yellow, then it becomes straw. And in the Hereafter there is a severe punishment (for the disbelievers), and forgiveness from Allah and (Allah’s) pleasure (for the believers and the righteous). The worldly life is nothing but a material of delusion.
T. Usmani.57:21: Compete each other in proceeding towards forgiveness from your Lord and to Paradise the width of which is like the width of the sky and the earth. It has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whomsoever He Wills and Allah is the Lord of the great bounty.
T. Usmani.57:22: No calamity befalls the earth or your own selves, but it is (pre-destined) in a Book before We bring it into being, -Indeed it is easy for Allah.
T. Usmani.57:23: - so that you may neither grieve on what has escaped you, nor over-exult on what He has given to you. And Allah does not love any self-admirer, over-proud,
T. Usmani.57:24: -those who are miserly and bid others to be miserly. And whoever turns away, then Allah is the All-Independent, the Ever-Praised.
T. Usmani.57:25: We have indeed sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and sent down with them the Book and the Balance, so that people may uphold equity. And We sent down iron in which there is strong power, and benefits for the people; and (We did it) so that Allah knows the one who helps Him and His messengers without seeing (Him). Surely Allah is Strong, Mighty.
T. Usmani.57:26: Indeed We sent NūH and Ibrāhīm, and kept the Book and prophet-hood (continuing) in their progeny. So, some of those (to whom they were sent) were on the right path, and many of them were sinners.
T. Usmani.57:27: Then We made Our messengers follow them one after the other, then We sent after them ‘Īsā, the son of Maryam (Jesus, son of Mary), and gave him the Injīl, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of his followers. As for monasticism, it was invented by them; We did not ordain it for them, but (they adopted it) to seek Allah’s pleasure, then could not observe it as was due. So We gave the believers from among them their reward. And many of them are sinners.
T. Usmani.57:28: O you who believe, fear Allah, and believe in His Messenger, and He will give you two shares (of reward) out of His mercy, and will make for you a light whereby you will walk, and will forgive you- And Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.57:29: - so that the People of the Book may know that they have no control over any thing from Allah’s bounty, and that bounty is in Allah’s hand; He gives it to whom He wills, and Allah is the Lord of the great bounty.
T. Usmani.58:1: Allah has heard the talk of the woman who was debating with you about her husband, and was complaining to Allah. Allah was hearing the conversation between both of you. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
T. Usmani.58:2: Those of you who declare Zihār against their wives, they are not their mothers. Their mothers are none else but those who gave birth to them. Undoubtedly they utter an evil word and a lie; and Allah is surely Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.58:3: Those who declare Zihār against their wives, then retract what they said, obligated on them is to free the neck (of a slave) before the two (spouses) touch one another. This is what you are advised, and Allah is well aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.58:4: But whoever does not find (a slave) has to fast for two consecutive months before the two (spouses) touch one another. Then the one who is not able to do so has to feed sixty indigent persons. This is (laid down) so that you believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the limits set by Allah; and for the disbelievers there is a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.58:5: Surely those who oppose Allah and His Messenger shall be disgraced, just as those before them were disgraced. We have sent down clear verses, and for the disbelievers there is a humiliating punishment
T. Usmani.58:6: on the Day when Allah will resurrect them all together, and will tell them what they did; Allah has its full account, while they have forgotten it. Allah is witness to every thing.
T. Usmani.58:7: Have you not observed that Allah knows everything in the heavens and everything in the earth? No secret consulta-tion takes place between three, but He is fourth of them, nor between five, but He is sixth of them, nor between fewer than that or more, but He is with them wherever they may be. Then He will tell them on the Day of Judgment what they did. Surely Allah is All-Knowing about every thing.
T. Usmani.58:8: Did you not see those who were forbidden from holding secret talks; then they do again what they were forbidden to do? They whisper for sinful act and wrongdoing and disobedience of the prophet, and when they come to you, they greet you the way Allah does not greet you, and say to themselves, “Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?” Enough for them is Jahannam (Hell); they will enter it, and it is an evil end.
T. Usmani.58:9: O you who believe, when you hold secret counsel, do not whisper for sinful act and wrongdoing and disobedience of the prophet, and do whisper for righteousness and taqwā (piety). And fear Allah, before whom you will be gathered together.
T. Usmani.58:10: Whispering (for sinful acts) comes from the ShaiTān (Satan), so that he may grieve those who believe, while it is not harmful to them in the least, except with Allah’s permission. And in Allah the believers must place their trust.
T. Usmani.58:11: O you who believe, when it is said to you, “Make room (for others) in the sittings”, then make room, and Allah will make room for you (in the Hereafter). And when it is said, “Rise up”, then rise up, and Allah will raise those, in ranks, who have believed and are given knowledge. Allah is well-aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.58:12: O you who believe, when you consult the Messenger in private, then offer something in charity before your consultation. That is better for you and purer. But if you find nothing (to offer), then Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.58:13: Have you become afraid of offering charities before your consultation? So when you did not do so, and Allah has forgiven you, then establish Salāh, and pay Zakāh, and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is well aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.58:14: Have you not seen those who have friendship with a people with whom Allah is angry. They are neither of you nor of them. They swear false oaths while they know.
T. Usmani.58:15: Allah has prepared a severe punishment for them. Indeed, evil is what they have been doing.
T. Usmani.58:16: They have taken their oaths as a shield, and then have prevented (people) from the way of Allah. Therefore, for them there is a humiliating punishment.
T. Usmani.58:17: Their riches and their children will never benefit them against Allah. They are the inmates of the Fire. They will live there forever,
T. Usmani.58:18: the Day Allah will raise all of them, and they will swear before Him as they swear before you, and will think that they have something to stand upon. Be assured that they are sheer liars.
T. Usmani.58:19: The ShaiTān (Satan) has prevailed upon them; so he has made them neglect to remember Allah. They are the party of ShaiTān . Be assured that it is (the members of the) party of ShaiTān that are the losers.
T. Usmani.58:20: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, they are among the lowest.
T. Usmani.58:21: Allah has written (in His pre-destined decree), “I will certainly prevail, both I and My messengers.” Surely Allah is All-Strong, All-Mighty.
T. Usmani.58:22: You will not find those who believe in Allah and in the Hereafter having friendship with those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even though they may be their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their clan. They are such that Allah has inscribed faith on their hearts, and has supported them with a spirit from Him. He will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, in which they will live forever. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Allah. Those are the party of Allah. Be assured that it is (the members of) the party of Allah that are the successful.
T. Usmani.59:1: Allah’s purity has been proclaimed by all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.59:2: He is the One who expelled the disbelievers of the People of the Book from their homes at the time of the first gathering. You did not expect that they would leave, and they deemed that their fortresses would protect them from Allah. But Allah came to them from where they did not expect, and cast fear in their hearts when they were spoiling their homes with their own hands and with the hands of the believers. So, learn a lesson, O you who have eyes to see.
T. Usmani.59:3: If Allah had not destined exile for them, He would have punished them in the world. And for them in the Hereafter is the torment of the Fire.
T. Usmani.59:4: That is because they were hostile to Allah and His Messenger. And whoever has hostility with Allah (must know that) Allah is severe in punishment.
T. Usmani.59:5: Whatever palm-trees you have cut down, or have left them standing on their roots, it was with Allah’s permission, and so that He might disgrace the transgressors.
T. Usmani.59:6: And whatever fai’ (left over property) Allah has passed on to His Messenger from them, you had not urged on your horses or camels for it, but Allah gives predominance to His messengers over whomsoever He wills, and Allah is Powerful over every thing.
T. Usmani.59:7: Whatever fai’ Allah has passed on to His Messenger from the people of the towns is for Allah and for the Messenger, and for the kinsmen and the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, so that it may not circulate only between the rich among you. And whatever the Messenger gives you, take it, and whatever he forbids you from, abstain (from it). And fear Allah. Indeed Allah is severe in punishment.
T. Usmani.59:8: (And fai’ is especially) for the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and properties, while they were seeking Allah’s grace and pleasure, and were helping (the religion of) Allah and His Messenger. They are the truthful.
T. Usmani.59:9: And (fai’ is also) for those who established themselves in the homeland (of Madīnah) and in faith before the former ones (arrived in Madīnah), who have love for those who emigrated to them, and do not feel in their hearts any ambition for what is given to the former ones (from fai’), and give preference (to them) over themselves, even though they are in poverty. -And those who are saved from the greed of their hearts are the successful.-
T. Usmani.59:10: And (fai’ is also) for those who came after them saying, “Our Lord, forgive us and those of our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any rancor against those who believe; Surely, Our Lord, you are Very-Kind, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.59:11: Did you not see the hypocrites saying to their brothers from those of the people of the Book who are unbelievers, “If you are expelled, we will certainly go out with you, and we will never obey anyone about you. And if you are fought against, we will definitely help you.” Allah bears witness that they are pure liars.
T. Usmani.59:12: If they are expelled, they will not go out with them, and if they are fought against, they will not help them. And even if they help them, they will surely turn their backs, then they will not be helped.
T. Usmani.59:13: In fact, your fear in their hearts is greater than (that of) Allah. That is because they are a people who do not understand.
T. Usmani.59:14: They do not fight you, even assembled together, but in fortified towns, or from behind the walls. Their quarrelling between themselves is severe. You think that they are united, while their hearts are divided. That is because they are a people who have no sense.
T. Usmani.59:15: The example (of Banū NaDīr) is like those who were before them in near past, who tasted the evil consequence of their conduct, and for them (in the Hereafter) there is a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.59:16: The example (of the hypocrites) is like the ShaiTān when he says to a human being, “Become disbeliever” then once he disbelieves, he says, “I disown you; I fear Allah, the Lord of the worlds.”
T. Usmani.59:17: So the end of both of them is that they will be in the Fire, living there forever. That is the punishment of the wrongdoers.
T. Usmani.59:18: O you who believe, fear Allah, and everybody must consider what he (or she) has sent ahead for tomorrow. And fear Allah. Surely Allah is fully aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.59:19: Do not be like those who forgot Allah, so He made them forget their own selves. Those are the sinners.
T. Usmani.59:20: The people of Hell and the people of Paradise are not equal. The people of Paradise are the successful.
T. Usmani.59:21: Had We sent down this Qur’ān to a mountain, you would have seen it humbled, burst apart out of awe for Allah. We cite such examples for people, so that they may ponder.
T. Usmani.59:22: He is Allah, besides whom there is no god, the Knower of the unseen and the seen. He is All-Merciful, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.59:23: He is Allah, besides whom there is no god, the Sovereign, the Supreme-In-Holiness, the Safe (from all defects), the Giver-Of-Peace, the Guardian, the All-Mighty, the All-Repairer, the Sublime. Pure is Allah from what they associate with Him.
T. Usmani.59:24: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Shaper. His are the Most Beautiful Names. His purity is proclaimed by all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.60:1: O you who believe, do not take My enemies and your enemies for friends, expressing love with them, while they have rejected the Truth that has come to you, expelling the Messenger and your selves (from Makkah) merely because you have faith in Allah who is your Lord, if you have set out to do Jihād (struggle) in My way, and to seek My pleasure. You express love with them secretly, while I know what you have concealed and what you have revealed. Any of you who does this has missed the straight path.
T. Usmani.60:2: Should they have access to you, they will become your enemies, and will stretch their hands and tongues towards you with evil; and they desire that you should reject the (true) faith.
T. Usmani.60:3: Neither your womb-relations nor your children will benefit you on the Day of Judgment. He will decide between you, and Allah is watchful of what you do.
T. Usmani.60:4: Indeed, there is an excellent example for you in Ibrāhīm and those with him, when they said to their people, “We disown you and what you worship instead of Allah. We disbelieve in you. Enmity and hatred has arisen between us and you forever, unless you believe in Allah alone”,- but (his example is) not (to be followed) in what Ibrāhīm said to his father, “I will pray to my Lord for your forgiveness, and I have no power from Allah (to do any thing) for you.” - “O our Lord, in You alone we trust, and to You alone we turn for help, and to You is the final return.
T. Usmani.60:5: Our Lord, do not make us persecuted by those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! You, only You, are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.”
T. Usmani.60:6: Indeed, for you there is an excellent example in them, for anyone who hopes (to meet) Allah and the Last Day. And if one turns away, Allah is Free of all needs, Worthy of all Praise.
T. Usmani.60:7: It is hoped that Allah will bring about love between you and those of them with whom you have enmity. Allah is Powerful, and Allah is Most-forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.60:8: Allah does not forbid you as regards those who did not fight you on account of faith, and did not expel you from your homes, that you do good to them, and deal justly with them. Surely Allah loves those who maintain justice.
T. Usmani.60:9: Allah forbids you only about those who fought you on account of faith, and expelled you from your homes, and helped (others) in expelling you, that you have friendship with them. Those who develop friendship with them are the wrongdoers.
T. Usmani.60:10: O you who believe, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, put them to a test. Allah knows best about their faith. So, if you find them faithful, do not send them back to the disbelievers. Neither these (women) are lawful for them, nor are those (disbelievers) lawful for these (women). And give them (the disbelievers) that (dower) which they had paid (to these women). And there is no sin for you if you marry them, when you give them their dowers. And do not hold on to the ties of marriage with the disbelieving women,and ask (their new Non-Muslim husbands to pay to you) that (dower) which you had paid (to your previous wives), and they (the previous Non-Muslim husbands of the Muslim women) should ask (their new Muslim husbands) to pay that (dower) which they had paid (to their previous wives). That is the decision of Allah. He decides between you. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
T. Usmani.60:11: And if some of your (Non-Muslim) wives have slipped from you, (and their present Non-Muslim husbands do not pay to you the dower as aforesaid,) and you have your turn (of paying dower to the previous Non-Muslim husbands of your present wives), then (instead of paying dower to them,) give those whose wives have slipped the like amount of what they had paid (to them). And fear Allah, the One in whom you believe.
T. Usmani.60:12: O you who believe, when the believing women come to you, seeking bai’ah (a pledge of allegiance) with you that they will not ascribe any partner to Allah, and will not commit theft, and will not commit fornication,and will not kill their children, and will not come up with a false claim (about the parentage of a child) that they falsely attribute (to the sperm of their husbands being dropped) between their hands and their feet (i.e. their private parts), and will not disobey you in what is recognized (in Sharī‘ah), then take them in your bai’ah, and pray Allah for their forgiveness. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.60:13: O you who believe, do not have friendship with a people with whom Allah is angry. They have despaired from the Hereafter as the infidels have despaired from those (buried) in the graves.
T. Usmani.61:1: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth proclaim Allah’s purity, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.61:2: O you who believe, why do you say what you do not do?
T. Usmani.61:3: It is severely hateful in Allah’s sight that you say what you do not do.
T. Usmani.61:4: Surely Allah loves those who fight in His way in firm rows, as if they were solid edifice.
T. Usmani.61:5: And (remember) when Mūsā said to his people, “O my people, why do you hurt me, while you know that I am a messenger of Allah sent towards you.” So, when they adopted deviation, Allah let their hearts become deviate. And Allah does not guide the sinful people.
T. Usmani.61:6: (Remember) when ‘Īsā, son of Maryam, said, “O children of Isrā’īl, I am a messenger of Allah sent towards you, confirming the Torah that is (sent down) before me, and giving you the good news of a messenger who will come after me, whose name will be AHmad.” But when he came to them with manifest signs, they said, “This is a clear magic.”
T. Usmani.61:7: And who is more unjust than the one who forges a lie against Allah, while he is invited to Islām? And Allah does not guide the unjust people.
T. Usmani.61:8: They wish to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah is to perfect His light, even though the disbelievers dislike (it).
T. Usmani.61:9: He is the One who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, so that He makes it prevail over all religions, even though the mushriks (those who ascribe partners to Allah) dislike (it).
T. Usmani.61:10: O you who believe, shall I tell you about a trade that saves you from a painful punishment?
T. Usmani.61:11: That you believe in Allah and His Messenger, and carry out Jihād in His way with your riches and your lives. That is much better for you, if you but know.
T. Usmani.61:12: (If you do this,) He will forgive your sins, and will admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow, and to pleasant dwellings in gardens of eternity. That is the great achievement.
T. Usmani.61:13: And (He will give you) another thing, which you love: Help from Allah, and victory, near at hand. And give good news to the believers.
T. Usmani.61:14: O you who believe, be supporters of (the religion of) Allah, just as ‘Īsā, son of Maryam, said to the Disciples, “Who are my supporters towards Allah?” The Disciples said, “We are the supporters of (the religion of) Allah.” So a group from the children of Isrā’īl believed, and another group disbelieved. Then We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became victors.
T. Usmani.62:1: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth proclaim the purity of Allah, the Sovereign, the Supreme in Holiness, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.62:2: He is the One who raised amidst the unlettered people a messenger from among themselves who recites to them His verses, and purifies them, and teaches them the Book and the wisdom, while they were earlier in open error.
T. Usmani.62:3: And (this Messenger is sent also) to others from them who did not join them so far, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.62:4: It is Allah’s bounty that He gives to whomsoever He wills, and Allah is the Lord of the great bounty.
T. Usmani.62:5: The example of those who were ordered to bear (the responsibility of acting upon) the Torah, then they did not bear it, is like a donkey that carries a load of books. Evil is the example of those who have rejected Allah’s verses. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
T. Usmani.62:6: Say, “O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are the friends of Allah to the exclusion of all other people, then express your desire for death, if you are true.
T. Usmani.62:7: And they will never express this desire, because of what their hands have sent ahead. And Allah is fully aware of the wrongdoers.
T. Usmani.62:8: Say, “Indeed, the death from which you (try to) run away has to visit you, then you will be sent back to the Knower of the Unseen and the seen, and He will tell you what you used to do.
T. Usmani.62:9: O you who believe, when the call for Salāh (prayer) is proclaimed on Friday, hasten for the remembrance of Allah, and leave off business. That is much better for you, if you but know.
T. Usmani.62:10: Then once the Salāh is over, disperse in the land, and seek the grace of Allah, and remember Allah abundantly, so that you may be successful.
T. Usmani.62:11: And when they see some merchandise or amusement, they break away to it, and leave you (O prophet,) standing. Say, “What is with Allah is much better than the amusement and the merchandise, and Allah is the best giver of sustenance.
T. Usmani.63:1: When the hypocrites come to you, they say, “We bear witness that you are indeed the messenger of Allah.”-Allah knows that you are really His messenger-But Allah testifies that the hypocrites are actually liars.
T. Usmani.63:2: They have made their oaths a shield, and thus they have prevented (others) from the way of Allah. Surely evil is what they have been doing.
T. Usmani.63:3: That is because they declared faith (in Islam apparently), then disbelieved (secretly). Therefore a seal has been set on their hearts, and thus they do not understand.
T. Usmani.63:4: And if you see them, their physiques would attract you, and if they speak, you would (like to) listen to their speech (because of their eloquence). (Yet, being devoid of substance,) it is as if they were propped up beams of timber. They deem every shout (they hear) to be against them (out of cowardice). They are the enemy; so beware of them. May Allah destroy them. How perverted are they!
T. Usmani.63:5: And when it is said to them, “Come on, so that Allah’s Messenger may pray for your forgiveness”, they twist their heads (in aversion), and you see them turning away in arrogance.
T. Usmani.63:6: It is equal in their case, whether you (O prophet,) pray for their forgiveness or do not pray, Allah will never forgive them. Indeed Allah does not guide the sinning people.
T. Usmani.63:7: They are those who say, “Do not spend on those who are with Allah’s Messenger until they disperse. And to Allah belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.
T. Usmani.63:8: They say, “If we return to Madīnah, the more honorable ones will drive out the meaner ones from there.” And to Allah belongs the honour, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.
T. Usmani.63:9: O you who believe, your riches and your children must not divert you from the remembrance of Allah. And those who do that are the losers.
T. Usmani.63:10: And spend out of what We have given to you before death overtakes one of you and he says, “My Lord, would you not give me respite to a near term, so that I should pay Sadaqah (alms) and become one of the righteous?”
T. Usmani.63:11: But Allah will never give respite to anyone, once his appointed time will come. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.64:1: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth proclaim Allah’s purity. To Him belongs the kingdom, and for Him is all praise, and He is powerful over every thing.
T. Usmani.64:2: He is the One who created you, then some of you are disbelievers, and some of you are believers. And Allah is Watchful of what you do.
T. Usmani.64:3: He has created the heavens and the earth rightly, and shaped your figures, and made your figures good, and to Him is the final return.
T. Usmani.64:4: He knows all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He knows whatever you conceal and whatever you reveal. Allah is fully aware of what lies in the hearts.
T. Usmani.64:5: Did the news of those people not come to you who disbelieved earlier, and tasted (in this world) the evil consequence of their conduct, and for them (in the Hereafter) there is a painful punishment?
T. Usmani.64:6: That is because their messengers used to bring them clear proofs, but they said, “Shall some mortals give us guidance?” Thus they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah did not care. Allah is All-Independent, Ever-Praised.
T. Usmani.64:7: The disbelievers claim that they will never be raised again (after death). Say, “Why not? By my Lord, you will be raised again, and then you will be told about what you did. That is so easy for Allah.”
T. Usmani.64:8: So, believe in Allah and His Messenger, and in the light We have sent down. And Allah is fully aware of what you do.
T. Usmani.64:9: (Be mindful of) the day when He will gather you for the Day of Gathering. That will be the Day of loss and gain. Whoever believes in Allah, and does righteously, He will write off his evil deeds, and will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, where they will live forever. That is the great achievement.
T. Usmani.64:10: As for those who disbelieve and reject Our signs, they are the people of the Fire. And it is an evil place to return.
T. Usmani.64:11: No calamity befalls (one), but with the leave of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart. Allah is All-Knowing about every thing.
T. Usmani.64:12: Obey Allah, and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away, then Our Messenger has only to convey the message clearly.
T. Usmani.64:13: Allah is such that there is no god but He. And in Allah alone the believers must place their trust.
T. Usmani.64:14: O you who believe, among your wives and your children there are some enemies for you, so beware of them. And if you forgive and overlook and pardon, then Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.64:15: Your riches and your children are but a trial. As for Allah, with Him is a great reward.
T. Usmani.64:16: So, observe taqwā (total obedience to Allah in awe of Him) as far as you can, and listen and obey, and spend (in Allah’s way), it being good for you. And those who are saved from the greed of their hearts are the successful.
T. Usmani.64:17: If you advance a good loan to Allah, He will multiply it for you, and will forgive you. And Allah is Appreciative, Forbearing,
T. Usmani.64:18: the Knower of the Unseen and the seen, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.65:1: O prophet, when you people divorce women, divorce them at a time when the period of ‘Iddah may start. And count the period of ‘Iddah, and fear Allah, your Lord. Do not expel them from their houses, nor should they go out, unless they come up with a clearly shameless act. These are the limits prescribed by Allah. And whoever exceeds the limits prescribed by Allah wrongs his own self. You do not know (what will happen in future); it may be that Allah brings about a new situation thereafter.
T. Usmani.65:2: So, when they (the divorced women) have (almost) reached their term, then either retain them with fairness, or part with them with fairness. And make two just men from among you witnesses (of your either decision). And (O witnesses,) keep your testimony upright for the sake of Allah. That is what anyone who believes in Allah and the Last Day is exhorted to do. Whoever fears Allah, He brings forth a way out for him,
T. Usmani.65:3: and provides him (with what he needs) from where he does not even imagine. And whoever places his trust in Allah, He is sufficient for him. Surely Allah is to accomplish His purpose. Allah has set a measure for every thing.
T. Usmani.65:4: And those women from among you who have despaired of (further) menstruation, if you are in doubt, their ‘Iddah is three months, as well as of those who have not yet menstruated. As for those having pregnancy, their term (of ‘Iddah ) is that they give birth to their child. And whoever fears Allah, He brings about ease for him in his affair.
T. Usmani.65:5: This is the command of Allah that He has sent down to you. And whoever fears Allah, He will write off his evil deeds, and will give him a huge reward.
T. Usmani.65:6: Provide to them (the divorced women) residence where you reside according to your means, and do not hurt them to straiten (life) for them. And if they are pregnant, spend on them till they give birth to their child. Then if they suckle the child for you, give them their fees, and consult each other (for determining the fee) with fairness, and if you create a deadlock between you, then another woman will suckle him.
T. Usmani.65:7: A man of vast means should spend according to his vast means. And anyone whose sustenance is limited should spend from whatever Allah has given to him. Allah makes no one liable beyond what He has given to him. Allah will soon bring ease after a difficulty.
T. Usmani.65:8: And how many a township rebelled against the command of its Lord, and against His messengers, so We called them to a severe account, and punished them with a punishment that was unimagined by them.
T. Usmani.65:9: Thus they tasted the evil consequence of their acts, and the end of their conduct was loss.
T. Usmani.65:10: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah O men of understanding who have believed! Allah has sent down to you a Reminder,
T. Usmani.65:11: a messenger who recites to you the verses of Allah, making (the truth) clear, so that He may bring forth those who believe and do righteous deeds from the layers of darkness into the light. And whoever believes in Allah, and acts righteously, He will admit him to the gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein such people will live forever. Allah has made for him a good provision.
T. Usmani.65:12: Allah is the One who has created seven skies, and their like from earth. The Command descends among them, so that you may know that Allah is powerful over every thing, and that Allah has encompassed every thing in knowledge.
T. Usmani.66:1: O Prophet, why do you ban (on your self) something that Allah has made lawful for you, seeking to please your wives? And Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.66:2: Allah has prescribed (the way of) absolution from your oaths. And Allah is your protector, and He is the All- Knowing, the All-Wise.
T. Usmani.66:3: And (remember) when the Prophet told one of his wives something in secret. So, when she disclosed it (to another wife), and Allah made it known to him, he told (the disclosing wife) part of it,and avoided another part. So when he informed her about it, she said, “Who told you about this?” He said, “I was told of it by the All-Knowing, the All-Aware.
T. Usmani.66:4: (O two wives of the Prophet,) If both of you repent to Allah, then (your conduct calls for it, because) your hearts have departed from the correct way. And if you back each other against him (the Prophet), then Allah is his supporter, and Jibra’īl (Gabriel) and righteous believers, and after all that, angels are his helpers.
T. Usmani.66:5: It is hoped that, if he divorces you, Allah will give him in your place wives better than you, submissive to Allah, believing, devout, penitent, steadfast in worship, fasting, previously married and virgins.
T. Usmani.66:6: O you who believe, save yourselves and your families from a fire, the fuel of which is human beings and stones, appointed on which are angels, stern and severe, who do not disobey Allah in what He orders them, and do whatever they are ordered to do.
T. Usmani.66:7: O you who disbelieve, do not make excuses today. You will only be recompensed for what you have been doing.
T. Usmani.66:8: O you who believe, turn to Allah with a faithful repentance. It is hoped from your Lord that he will write off your faults, and will admit you to the gardens beneath which rivers flow, on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will run before them and to their right hands. They will say, “Our Lord, perfect for us our light, and forgive us. Indeed you are powerful over every thing.”
T. Usmani.66:9: O Prophet, carry out Jihād (struggle) against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be harsh with them. Their final abode is Jahannam (Hell), and it is an evil end.
T. Usmani.66:10: Allah has cited for the disbelievers the example of the wife of NūH and the wife of LūT. Both were married with two of Our righteous servants, but betrayed them. So they could not benefit them against Allah at all, and it was said, “Enter the Fire along with those who enter.”
T. Usmani.66:11: And Allah has cited for the believers the example of the wife of Fir’aun (Pharaoh), when she said, “My Lord, build for me, near You, a house in the Paradise, and deliver me from Fir’aun and his deeds, and deliver me from the unjust people.”
T. Usmani.66:12: And (Allah has also cited the example of) Maryam, daughter of ‘Imrān who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her Our spirit, and she testified to the truth of the words of her Lord and His books, and she was one of the devout.
T. Usmani.67:1: Glorious is the One in whose hand is the Kingdom (of the whole universe), and He is powerful over every thing,
T. Usmani.67:2: the One who created death and life, so that He may test you as to which of you is better in his deeds. And He is the All-Mighty, the Most-Forgiving,
T. Usmani.67:3: who has created seven skies, one over the other. You will see nothing out of proportion in the creation of the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah). So, cast your eye again. Do you see any rifts?
T. Usmani.67:4: Then cast your eye again and again, and the eye will come back to you abased, in a state of weariness.
T. Usmani.67:5: And We have decorated the nearest sky with lamps, and have made them devices to stone the devils, and We have prepared for them the punishment of Hell.
T. Usmani.67:6: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord, there is the punishment of Jahannam , and it is an evil end.
T. Usmani.67:7: When they will be thrown in it, they will hear a terrible sound from it, and it will be boiling,
T. Usmani.67:8: seeming as if it will burst out of fury. Whenever a group is thrown into it, its keepers will say to them, “Had no warner come to you?”
T. Usmani.67:9: They will say, “Yes, a warner had come to us, but We had rejected, and said, ‘Allah has not revealed anything. You are only in great error.’”
T. Usmani.67:10: And they will say, “Had we been listening or understanding, we would not have been among the people of the Hell.”
T. Usmani.67:11: Thus they will confess their sin. So, away with the people of the Hell!
T. Usmani.67:12: Surely, for those who have awe of their Lord without seeing (Him), there is forgiveness and a big reward.
T. Usmani.67:13: Whether you keep your talk secret or make it aloud, He knows well what lies in the hearts.
T. Usmani.67:14: Is it (imaginable) that He who has created (them) will not have (such a) knowledge, while He is the Knower of the finest things, the All-Aware?
T. Usmani.67:15: He is the One who has made the earth subjugated for you, so walk on its shoulders, and eat out of His provision, and to Him is the Resurrection.
T. Usmani.67:16: Have you become fearless of Him who is in the sky if He makes you sink into the earth, and it starts trembling at once?
T. Usmani.67:17: Or, have you become fearless of Him who is in the sky if He looses a violent wind with stones against you? So, you will soon come to know how was My warning!
T. Usmani.67:18: And of course, those before them (also) rejected (the truth). So, how was My censure?
T. Usmani.67:19: Have they not looked to the birds above them spreading their wings, and (at times) they fold (them) in? No one holds them up except the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah). Surely He is watchful of every thing.
T. Usmani.67:20: Now, who is there to act as a force for you to help you, except the RaHmān ? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.
T. Usmani.67:21: Or, who is there to give you sustenance, if He withholds His sustenance? Still, they persist in rebellion and aversion.
T. Usmani.67:22: Then, is the one who walks falling down (frequently) on his face more right or the one who walks properly on a straight path?
T. Usmani.67:23: Say, “He is the One who has originated you, and made for you ears and eyes and hearts. How little you pay gratitude!”
T. Usmani.67:24: Say, “He is the One who has scattered you on the earth, and to Him you will be assembled.”
T. Usmani.67:25: And they say, “When will this promise (of the Day of Judgment) be fulfilled, if you are true?”
T. Usmani.67:26: Say, “The knowledge (of that Day) is only with Allah, and I am only a plain warner.
T. Usmani.67:27: Then, once they will see it approaching, the faces of the disbelievers will be turned awkward, and it will be said, “This is what you were calling for!”
T. Usmani.67:28: Say, “Tell me, if Allah destroys me and those who are with me (as you wish), or has mercy on us (as we wish), who can (in either case) save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
T. Usmani.67:29: Say, “He is the RaHmān; we have believed in Him, and in Him we placed our trust. So, you will soon come to know who is in open error.”
T. Usmani.67:30: Say, “Tell me, Should your water vanish into the earth, who will bring you a flowing (stream of) water?
T. Usmani.68:1: Nūn , by the pen and what they write,
T. Usmani.68:2: with the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.
T. Usmani.68:3: And you will definitely have a reward that will never end.
T. Usmani.68:4: And you are surely on an excellent standard of character.
T. Usmani.68:5: So, you will see, and they will see
T. Usmani.68:7: Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from his way, and He is well aware of those who are on the right path.
T. Usmani.68:8: So, do not obey those who reject (the true faith.)
T. Usmani.68:9: They wish that you become flexible (in your faith), so that they should become flexible (in their hostile attitude.)
T. Usmani.68:10: And do not obey any contemptible one who swears much,
T. Usmani.68:11: a slanderer who goes about with calumnies,
T. Usmani.68:12: one who prevents good, (and who is) transgressor, sinful,
T. Usmani.68:14: (do not obey such a person merely) because he is a man of wealth and sons.
T. Usmani.68:15: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) the tales of the ancient.”
T. Usmani.68:16: We will soon brand him on the snout.
T. Usmani.68:17: We have tested them as We had tested the Owners of the Garden, when they had sworn an oath that they would pluck its fruits on the next morning,
T. Usmani.68:18: and did not make any exception (by saying inshā’allāh ).
T. Usmani.68:19: Then, there whirled around it a whirl (of calamity) from your Lord, while they were asleep.
T. Usmani.68:20: Thus, on the next morning, it was like a harvested field.
T. Usmani.68:21: So, they called out each other as the morning broke,
T. Usmani.68:22: saying, “Set out early, if you are going to pluck (the fruits).”
T. Usmani.68:23: So they set out while they were whispering to each other,
T. Usmani.68:24: saying, “Let no poor man enter into it upon you today.”
T. Usmani.68:25: And in early hours they rushed quickly, while they were (assuming themselves) powerful (to pluck the fruits and prevent the poor.)
T. Usmani.68:26: But when they saw it (the place of the ruined garden), they said, “We have missed the way.”
T. Usmani.68:27: (Then, once they realized that the garden is the same, but it has been destroyed, they said,) “No, but we are deprived (of the fruits).”
T. Usmani.68:28: Said he who was the best among them, “Did I not say to you, ‘Why do you not pronounce tasbīH (Allah’s purity)?”
T. Usmani.68:29: They said, “We pronounce the purity of our Lord. No doubt, we were wrongdoers.”
T. Usmani.68:30: Then, (at the beginning,) they started reproaching one another;
T. Usmani.68:31: (and at last,) they said, “Woe to us! In fact, we (all) were outrageous.
T. Usmani.68:32: We hope that our Lord will give us in exchange something better than this. Truly we turn to Allah.”
T. Usmani.68:33: In this way the punishment comes. And, of course, the punishment of the Hereafter is even greater, if they but realize!
T. Usmani.68:34: Surely, for the God-fearing there are gardens of bliss.
T. Usmani.68:35: Otherwise, shall We make the obedient like the sinners?
T. Usmani.68:36: What has happened to you? How do you judge?
T. Usmani.68:37: Do you have a book in which you read
T. Usmani.68:38: that for you there is what you choose?
T. Usmani.68:39: Or do you have oaths sworn by Us, remaining effective up to the Day of Judgment, that you will get what you decide?
T. Usmani.68:40: Ask them which of them stands surety for that.
T. Usmani.68:41: Or do they have associate-gods (who have guaranteed safety for them)? Then, let them bring their associate-gods, if they are true.
T. Usmani.68:42: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called upon to prostrate themselves, they will not be able to.
T. Usmani.68:43: With their eyes downcast, they will be enveloped by ignominy. They used to be called upon to prostrate when they were healthy (but they did not.)
T. Usmani.68:44: So, leave Me alone with those who reject this discourse. We will draw them on little by little (towards Hell) from a way they do not know.
T. Usmani.68:45: And I give them respite. Indeed, My plan is firm.
T. Usmani.68:46: Is it that you ask them for a fee, due to which they are burdened with debt?
T. Usmani.68:47: Or do they have the (knowledge of the) Unseen, and they write it down?
T. Usmani.68:48: So, remain patient with your Lord’s judgment, and be not like the Man of the Fish, he cried out while he was in anguish.
T. Usmani.68:49: Had not a favour from His Lord come to his help, he would have been cast in the wilderness in a reproachable state.
T. Usmani.68:50: Then his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous.
T. Usmani.68:51: And indeed the disbelievers seem to trip you up with their glances when they hear the Reminder, and say, “He is a madman indeed.”
T. Usmani.68:52: And it is nothing else but a Reminder for all the worlds.
T. Usmani.69:3: And what can let you know what the Imminent happening is?
T. Usmani.69:4: Thamūd and ‘Ād had denied (the happening of) the Shocking Event (the Day of Judgment).
T. Usmani.69:5: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by that (dreadful cry), which exceeded all limits.
T. Usmani.69:6: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a violent windstorm
T. Usmani.69:7: that He imposed on them for seven nights and eight consecutive days; so you could see them thrown on the ground, as if they were trunks of hollow palm-trees.
T. Usmani.69:8: Now, do you see any remnant of them?
T. Usmani.69:9: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and those before him and the overthrown towns came up with evil,
T. Usmani.69:10: and they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an extremely severe seizure.
T. Usmani.69:11: When the water overflowed (in the Deluge of NūH), We let you (O mankind,) board the floating ship,
T. Usmani.69:12: so that We make it a reminder for you, and so that a preserving ear (that hears their story) may preserve it.
T. Usmani.69:13: Then, once the Trumpet will be blown for the first time,
T. Usmani.69:14: and the earth and the mountains will be lifted and crushed into pieces with a single blow,
T. Usmani.69:15: then on that Day the Happening will happen,
T. Usmani.69:16: and the sky will burst apart, while it will have become frail on that day.
T. Usmani.69:17: And the angels will be on its borders. And on that Day, the Throne of your Lord will be carried above them by eight (angels).
T. Usmani.69:18: On that day, you will be brought forward in a way that no secret of yours will remain secret.
T. Usmani.69:19: Now, as for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say (to his colleagues), “Come here, read my book.
T. Usmani.69:20: I was sure that I would encounter my reckoning.”
T. Usmani.69:21: So he will be in a well-pleasing life
T. Usmani.69:23: the fruits of which will be close at hand.
T. Usmani.69:24: (It will be said to such people,) “Eat and drink with pleasure, as a reward for what you did in advance during past days.”
T. Usmani.69:25: As for him who will be given his book in his left hand, he will say, “ Oh, would that I had not been given my book,
T. Usmani.69:26: and I had never known what my account is!
T. Usmani.69:27: Oh, would that it (death) had been the end of the matter!
T. Usmani.69:28: My wealth has not been of any use to me.
T. Usmani.69:29: My power has gone from me for good.”
T. Usmani.69:30: (Then it will be said to angels,) “Seize him, then put a collar around his neck,
T. Usmani.69:31: and then, let him burn in the blazing fire.
T. Usmani.69:32: Thereafter, fasten him with a chain the measure of which is seventy hands.”
T. Usmani.69:33: Indeed, he did not believe in Allah, the Almighty,
T. Usmani.69:34: and did not persuade (others) to feed the needy.
T. Usmani.69:35: So, he has no friend here today,
T. Usmani.69:36: nor any food except that which comes out from wounds when washing,
T. Usmani.69:37: which is eaten by none but the sinners.
T. Usmani.69:38: I swear by what you see,
T. Usmani.69:39: and what you do not see,
T. Usmani.69:40: it is surely the speech of a noble Messenger, (that he conveys from Allah).
T. Usmani.69:41: and it is not the speech of a poet, (but) little you believe,
T. Usmani.69:42: nor is it the speech of a soothsayer, (but) little you heed to the advice.
T. Usmani.69:43: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
T. Usmani.69:44: Had he (the prophet) forged some statements in Our name,
T. Usmani.69:45: We would have certainly seized him by the right hand,
T. Usmani.69:47: and none of you could have saved him from it.
T. Usmani.69:48: It is infact a Reminder for the God-fearing.
T. Usmani.69:49: And, of course, We know that among you there are deniers.
T. Usmani.69:50: And surely, it is a cause of remorse for the disbelievers.
T. Usmani.69:51: And it is surely an absolute truth.
T. Usmani.69:52: So, pronounce the purity of the name of your magnificent Lord.
T. Usmani.70:1: A demanding person has asked for the punishment that is going to befall
T. Usmani.70:2: the disbelievers; there is no one to avert it,
T. Usmani.70:3: (and it will come) from Allah, the Lord of the stairways,
T. Usmani.70:4: to whom ascend the angels and the Spirit in a day the length of which is fifty thousand years.
T. Usmani.70:5: So, observe patience, a good patience.
T. Usmani.70:8: (This punishment will befall) on the Day when the sky will be like dregs of oil,
T. Usmani.70:9: and the mountains will be like dyed wool,
T. Usmani.70:10: and no friend will ask about any friend,
T. Usmani.70:11: (though) they will be made to see each other. A guilty person will desire that he may be able to ransom himself from the torment of that day even by his sons,
T. Usmani.70:12: and his wife and his brother,
T. Usmani.70:13: and his kindred that sheltered him,
T. Usmani.70:14: and all those on earth, then he may redeem himself.
T. Usmani.70:15: By no means! It is the flaming fire
T. Usmani.70:16: that will pull out the skin of the scalp.
T. Usmani.70:17: It will call him who had turned his back and fled away (from the truth)
T. Usmani.70:19: Indeed man is created weak in courage,
T. Usmani.70:20: very upset when touched by evil,
T. Usmani.70:21: and very niggard when visited by good (fortune),
T. Usmani.70:23: who are regular in their Salāh,
T. Usmani.70:24: and those in whose riches there is a specified right
T. Usmani.70:25: for the one who asks and the one who is deprived,
T. Usmani.70:26: and those who believe in the Day of Judgment as true,
T. Usmani.70:27: and those who are fearful of the torment of their Lord-
T. Usmani.70:28: -Indeed the torment of their Lord is not something to be fearless from.-
T. Usmani.70:29: and those who guard their private parts,
T. Usmani.70:30: except from their wives and those (slave-girls) owned by their hands,- because they are not to be blamed,
T. Usmani.70:31: but the one who seeks (sexual gratification) beyond that, then such people are the transgressors,-
T. Usmani.70:32: and those who are careful about their trusts and covenants,
T. Usmani.70:33: and those who are upright in their testimonies,
T. Usmani.70:34: and those who take due care of their Salāh .
T. Usmani.70:35: Those will be honoured in gardens (of Jannah ).
T. Usmani.70:36: So what has happened to those who disbelieve that they are rushing towards you
T. Usmani.70:37: from the right and from the left, in groups?
T. Usmani.70:38: Does every one of them aspire to be admitted to the garden of bliss?
T. Usmani.70:39: By no means! We have created them from what they know.
T. Usmani.70:40: So, I swear by the Lord of the points of sunrise and those of sunset, We are powerful
T. Usmani.70:41: to bring those better than them in their place, and We are not to be frustrated.
T. Usmani.70:42: So, leave them involved in pastime and play until they encounter their Day, which they are promised,
T. Usmani.70:43: the Day they will come out of the graves quickly, as if they were rushing toward idols,
T. Usmani.70:44: with their eyes downcast, enveloped by ignominy. That is the Day, which they were being promised.
T. Usmani.71:1: We sent NūH to his people (and said to him): “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
T. Usmani.71:2: He said, “O my people, I openly warn you
T. Usmani.71:3: that you must worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me,
T. Usmani.71:4: and Allah will forgive you your sins, and will respite you to an appointed term. Indeed when Allah’s term comes, it is not deferred, if you only know!”
T. Usmani.71:5: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
T. Usmani.71:6: but my call added only to their flight (from the truth).
T. Usmani.71:7: Whenever I called them, so that You might forgive them, they put their fingers into their ears, and wrapped their clothes around themselves, and grew obstinate, and waxed proud in extreme arrogance.
T. Usmani.71:9: and then I spoke to them in public and spoke to them in private.
T. Usmani.71:10: So I said, ‘Pray to your Lord for your forgiveness,- Indeed He is Very-Forgiving, -
T. Usmani.71:11: and He will cause the heavens to rain upon you in abundance,
T. Usmani.71:12: and will help you with riches and sons, and will cause gardens to grow for you, and cause rivers to flow for you.
T. Usmani.71:13: What has happened to you that you do not appreciate the Majesty of Allah,
T. Usmani.71:14: while He has created you in different phases?
T. Usmani.71:15: Did you not see how Allah has created seven heavens one upon another,
T. Usmani.71:16: and has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
T. Usmani.71:17: And Allah has caused you to grow well out of the earth,
T. Usmani.71:18: then He will send you back into it, and will bring you forth once again.
T. Usmani.71:19: And Allah has made the earth a spread for you,
T. Usmani.71:20: so that you may go about its broad ways.’”
T. Usmani.71:21: And said NūH, “My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed him whose wealth and children added nothing to him but loss,
T. Usmani.71:22: and they devised a mighty plot,
T. Usmani.71:23: and said (to their people), “Never forsake your gods, and never forsake Wadd, nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr.
T. Usmani.71:24: And they have led many astray. And (O my Lord,) let not the wrongdoers progress in anything but deviation from the right path.”
T. Usmani.71:25: Because of their sins they were drowned, and then admitted into the Fire. So they found no helpers for them besides Allah.
T. Usmani.71:26: And said NūH, “My Lord, do not leave on earth even a single inhabitant (surviving) out of the disbelievers.
T. Usmani.71:27: If You leave them (surviving), they will lead Your servants astray, and will beget none but a sinful disbeliever.
T. Usmani.71:28: My Lord, grant pardon to me, and to my parents, and to everyone who enters my home as a believer, and to all the believing men and believing women, and do not increase the wrongdoers but in ruin.
T. Usmani.72:1: Say, “It has been revealed to me that a group from Jinn has listened (to the Qur’ān), and said (to their people), ‘Indeed we have heard an amazing Recital (Qur’ān)
T. Usmani.72:2: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate a partner with our Lord.’
T. Usmani.72:3: and (then the Jinns started talking to each other) that exalted is the Glory of our Lord; He has taken neither a wife, nor a son,
T. Usmani.72:4: and that the fools among us used to attribute to Allah extremely absurd things,
T. Usmani.72:5: and that we thought that the humans and the Jinn would never tell a lie about Allah, (therefore, we had followed them in shirk under this impression),
T. Usmani.72:6: and that some guys from human beings used to seek refuge with some guys of the Jinn, and thus they increased them (the Jinns) in arrogance,
T. Usmani.72:7: and that they (humans) thought as you (O Jinns) thought that Allah will never resurrect anyone,
T. Usmani.72:8: and that we sought (to reach) the sky, but we found it filled with stern guards and flames,
T. Usmani.72:9: and that we used to sit at places therein to listen; but if one will (try to) listen now, he will find a flame in ambush for him,
T. Usmani.72:10: and that we do not know whether it is a bad end that is intended for those on earth, or their Lord has intended for them a right thing,
T. Usmani.72:11: and that some of us are (already) righteous, and some of us are otherwise, and we were on different ways;
T. Usmani.72:12: and that we have now believed that we can never frustrate Allah on the earth, nor can we baffle Him by escape,
T. Usmani.72:13: and that when we heard the Guiding Discourse, we believed in it; so if one believes in his Lord, he will have no fear of either any curtailment (in his reward) or any excess (in his punishment),
T. Usmani.72:14: and that some of us are Muslims, and some of us are unjust. Now, those who submitted to Islam have found out the right path,
T. Usmani.72:15: As for the unjust, they have become firewood for Hell.”
T. Usmani.72:16: “(And it is also revealed to me) that if they (the people of Makkah) had stood firm on the (right) way, We would have supplied water to them in abundance,
T. Usmani.72:17: so that We test them thereby; and if one turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will thrust him into a severe torment,
T. Usmani.72:18: and that masājid (mosques) belong to Allah; so, do not invoke anyone along with Allah,
T. Usmani.72:19: and that when Allah’s servant stood invoking Him, they almost rushed on him in crowds.”
T. Usmani.72:20: Say, “I invoke my Lord, and do not associate anyone with Him.”
T. Usmani.72:21: Say, “I possess no power to cause you any harm or bring you to a right way.”
T. Usmani.72:22: Say, “No one can ever save me from Allah, and I can never find a refuge save with Him.
T. Usmani.72:23: However, (I have been given power) of conveying (commands) from Allah, and His messages. The one who disobeys Allah and His Messenger, for him there is the fire of Hell, wherein such people will live forever.
T. Usmani.72:24: (The disbelievers will continue denying the truth and mock at it) until when they will see what they are promised, they will know whose supporters are weaker, and whose numbers are less.
T. Usmani.72:25: Say, “I do not know whether that which you are promised is near, or my Lord has appointed for it a distant term.
T. Usmani.72:26: (He is the) Knower of the Unseen. So He does not let anyone know the Unseen created by Him,
T. Usmani.72:27: except a messenger whom He chooses (to inform through revelation), and then He appoints (angels as) watching guards before him and behind him, (so that devils may not tamper with the divine revelation,)
T. Usmani.72:28: so that He knows that they (angels) have conveyed the messages of their Lord. And He has encompassed all that is with them, and has comprehensive knowledge of every thing by numbers.
T. Usmani.73:1: O you, wrapped up in clothes,
T. Usmani.73:2: stand at night (for prayer) except a little-
T. Usmani.73:3: -half of it, or make it a little less,
T. Usmani.73:4: or make it a little more; and recite the Qur’ān clearly with tartīl (in a distinct and measured tone).
T. Usmani.73:5: We are going to send down to you a weighty discourse.
T. Usmani.73:6: Truly, rising by night (for prayer of tahajjud) is the most effective way to subdue (one’s base self) and to make speech more upright.
T. Usmani.73:7: Surely, in daytime, you have a lengthy work to do.
T. Usmani.73:8: And remember the name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.
T. Usmani.73:9: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He; so take Him for (your) Guardian.
T. Usmani.73:10: And bear patiently what they (the opponents) say, and part with them in a beautiful manner.
T. Usmani.73:11: And leave Me alone (to deal) with the deniers, the people of luxury, and give them respite for a while.
T. Usmani.73:12: Surely with Us are fetters and flaming fire,
T. Usmani.73:13: and food that chokes, and a painful punishment
T. Usmani.73:14: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will turn into a slipping heap of sand.
T. Usmani.73:15: (O people,) We have sent to you a messenger, as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).
T. Usmani.73:16: Then, Fir‘aun disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a severe seizure.
T. Usmani.73:17: So, if you disbelieve, how will you save yourself from a day that will turn the small boys into grey-headed old men,
T. Usmani.73:18: whereby the sky will burst apart. His promise has to be fulfilled.
T. Usmani.73:19: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.
T. Usmani.73:20: Your Lord knows that you stand (in prayer) for nearly two thirds of the night, and (at times) for half of it, and (at times) for one third of it, and (so do) a group of those who are with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you (O Muslims,) cannot do it in regular way; therefore He turned to you in mercy.Now, recite as much of the Qur’ān as is easy (for you). He knows that some of you may be sick, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and yet others fighting in Allah’s way. Therefore, recite as much of it as is easy. And establish Salāh, and pay Zakāh, and advance to Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you will send ahead for your own-selves, you will find it with Allah much better in condition, and much greater in reward. And seek forgiveness from Allah. Indeed Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
T. Usmani.74:1: O you, enveloped in a mantle,
T. Usmani.74:3: and pronounce the greatness of your Lord,
T. Usmani.74:6: and do not do a favour (to anyone merely) to seek more (in return).
T. Usmani.74:7: And for the sake of your Lord, observe patience.
T. Usmani.74:8: For when the trumpet will be blown,
T. Usmani.74:9: that day will be a difficult day,
T. Usmani.74:11: Leave me alone (to deal) with the one whom I created lonely,
T. Usmani.74:14: and extended (power and honour) to him pretty well.
T. Usmani.74:15: Still, he aspires that I should give him more.
T. Usmani.74:16: Never! He is inimical towards Our verses.
T. Usmani.74:17: I will force him to climb the mountain Sa‘ūd.
T. Usmani.74:19: Death onto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!
T. Usmani.74:20: Again, death unto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!
T. Usmani.74:21: Then he looked (to those around him,)
T. Usmani.74:23: then turned his back, and waxed proud,
T. Usmani.74:24: then said, “This is nothing but traditional magic;
T. Usmani.74:25: this is nothing but saying of a mortal.”
T. Usmani.74:26: I will put him into Saqar (Hell).
T. Usmani.74:27: And what can let you know what Saqar is?
T. Usmani.74:28: It neither spares (anything inside it from burning) nor leaves (any disbeliever outside).
T. Usmani.74:31: And We did not make wardens of the Fire but (from) angels, and did not fix their number but as a test for those who disbelieve, so that those who are given the Book may come to believe, and those who believe may improve in belief, and so that those who are given the Book and those who believe may not doubt (its correctness), and so that those having malady in their hearts and the disbelievers say, “What has Allah meant by this strange statement?” Thus Allah lets go astray whomever He wills, and leads to the right path whomever He wills. And no one knows the hosts of your Lord but He. And this is nothing else but a reminder for mankind.
T. Usmani.74:32: Truly, I swear by the moon,
T. Usmani.74:33: and by the night when it goes back,
T. Usmani.74:34: and by the morning when it becomes bright,
T. Usmani.74:35: it (Saqar : Hell) is one of the greatest things
T. Usmani.74:36: as a warning to the mankind,
T. Usmani.74:37: to the one from among you who wishes to come forward (towards good deeds) or to go back (from them).
T. Usmani.74:38: Everyone will be detained (in the Hell) because of what he did,
T. Usmani.74:39: except the People of the Right, (i.e. those who will be given their Book of Deeds in their right hands)
T. Usmani.74:40: who will be in gardens, asking
T. Usmani.74:43: They will say, “We were not among those who offered Salāh , (obligatory prayer)
T. Usmani.74:44: and we did not give food to the needy,
T. Usmani.74:45: and we indulged (in mocking at the truth) along with those who indulged,
T. Usmani.74:46: and we used to deny the Day of Requital,
T. Usmani.74:47: until when we were overtaken by that which is certain.”
T. Usmani.74:48: Then intercession of intercessors will not benefit them.
T. Usmani.74:49: So what has happened to them that they are turning away from the Reminder,
T. Usmani.74:50: as if they were wild donkeys,
T. Usmani.74:52: Rather, every one of them wishes that he should be given unrolled (divine) scriptures.
T. Usmani.74:53: Never! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
T. Usmani.74:54: Never! Indeed, this is a Reminder.
T. Usmani.74:55: So, whoever so wishes may take advice from it.
T. Usmani.74:56: And they will not take advice unless Allah so wills. He is worthy to be feared, and worthy to forgive.
T. Usmani.75:1: I swear by the Day of Resurrection,
T. Usmani.75:2: and I swear by the self-reproaching conscience, (that Resurrection is a reality.)
T. Usmani.75:3: Does man think that We will never reassemble his bones?
T. Usmani.75:4: Why (can We) not (do so), while We are able to reset (even) his fingertips perfectly?
T. Usmani.75:5: But man wishes to go on violating Allah’s injunctions (even in future) ahead of him.
T. Usmani.75:6: He asks, “When will be this Day of Resurrection?”
T. Usmani.75:7: So, when the eyes will be dazzled,
T. Usmani.75:8: and the moon will lose its light,
T. Usmani.75:9: and the sun and the moon will be joined together,
T. Usmani.75:10: on that day man will say, “Where to escape?”
T. Usmani.75:11: Never! There will be no refuge at all.
T. Usmani.75:12: On that day, towards your Lord will be the destination (of everyone.)
T. Usmani.75:13: Man will be informed of what he sent ahead and what he left behind.
T. Usmani.75:14: Rather, man will be a witness against himself,
T. Usmani.75:15: even though he may offer his excuses.
T. Usmani.75:16: (O Prophet,) do not move your tongue (during revelation) for (reciting) it (the Qur’ān) to receive it in hurry.
T. Usmani.75:17: It is surely undertaken by Us to store it (in your heart), and to let it be recited (by you after revelation is completed).
T. Usmani.75:18: Therefore, when it is recited by Us (through the angel), follow its recitation (by concentration of your heart).
T. Usmani.75:19: Then, it is undertaken by Us to explain it.
T. Usmani.75:20: Never, (your denial of Resurrection is never based on any sound reason!) Instead, you love that which is immediate,
T. Usmani.75:22: Many faces, that day, will be glowing,
T. Usmani.75:24: and many faces, that day, will be gloomy,
T. Usmani.75:25: realizing that a back-breaking calamity is going to be afflicted on them.
T. Usmani.75:26: Never, (you will never remain in this world forever!) When the soul (of a patient) reaches the clavicles,
T. Usmani.75:27: and it is said, “Who is an enchanter (that can save him?)”
T. Usmani.75:28: and he realizes that it is (the time of) departure (from the world,)
T. Usmani.75:29: and one shank is intertwined with the other shank,
T. Usmani.75:30: then on that day, it is to your Lord that one has to be driven.
T. Usmani.75:31: So (the denier of the Hereafter) neither believed, nor prayed,
T. Usmani.75:32: but rejected the truth and turned away (from it),
