T. Usmani.75:33: then he went to his home, puffed up with pride.
T. Usmani.75:34: (It will be said to such a man,) Woe to you, then woe to you!
T. Usmani.75:35: Again, woe to you, then woe to you!
T. Usmani.75:36: Does man presume that he will be left unchecked?
T. Usmani.75:37: Was he not an ejaculated drop of semen?
T. Usmani.75:38: Then he became a clot of blood, then He created (him) and made (him) perfect,
T. Usmani.75:39: and made from him two kinds, male and female.
T. Usmani.75:40: Has He no power to give life to the dead?
T. Usmani.76:1: There has come upon man a period of time in which he was nothing worth mentioning.
T. Usmani.76:2: We have created man from a mixed sperm-drop to put him to a test; then We made him able to hear, able to see.
T. Usmani.76:3: We have shown him the way to be either grateful or ungrateful.
T. Usmani.76:4: We have prepared, for the disbelievers, shackles and iron-collars and a blazing Fire.
T. Usmani.76:5: Indeed, the righteous will have a drink from a goblet, blended with (a drink from) Camphor
T. Usmani.76:6: that will be a spring from which Allah’s servants will drink, making it flow (wherever they wish) profusely.
T. Usmani.76:7: They (are the ones who) fulfill their vows, and fear a day whose evil (events) will spread far and wide,
T. Usmani.76:8: and they give food, out of their love for Him (Allah), to the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,
T. Usmani.76:9: (saying to them,) “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we have no intention of (receiving) either a return from you or thanks.
T. Usmani.76:10: In fact, we are fearful of a day, from the side of our Lord, that will be frowning, extremely malignant.”
T. Usmani.76:11: So Allah will save them from the evil of that day, and will grant them bloom and delight,
T. Usmani.76:12: and will give them, in return for their patience, Paradise and (garments of) silk,
T. Usmani.76:13: wherein they will be reclining on couches, feeling neither heat of the sun nor intense cold.
T. Usmani.76:14: And shades of gardens will be hanging low on them, and their fruits will be placed totally under their command.
T. Usmani.76:15: Circulated among them will be vessels of silver, and cups that will be (as transparent as) crystals,
T. Usmani.76:16: -crystals (as shining as if made) of silver, measured by those (who filled them) with due measure.
T. Usmani.76:17: And they will be served with goblet of a drink blended with ginger,
T. Usmani.76:18: (acquired from) a spring therein called Salsabīl.
T. Usmani.76:19: And circling around them will be serving boys, blessed with eternal youth; when you would see them, you would take them as scattered pearls.
T. Usmani.76:20: When you will look around there, you will see the Bliss and a magnificent realm.
T. Usmani.76:21: Upon them will be garments of green sundus (a kind of fine silk), and of istabraq (a kind of thick silk), and they will be adorned by bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure beverage to drink:
T. Usmani.76:22: “This is a reward for you, and your effort has been appreciated.”
T. Usmani.76:23: Indeed we have revealed to you the Qur’ān through a gradual process.
T. Usmani.76:24: So, be steadfast patiently in (obeying) your Lord’s command, and do not obey any one of them who is sinner or ungrateful.
T. Usmani.76:25: And pronounce the name of Allah morning and evening.
T. Usmani.76:26: And in some parts of night prostrate yourself before Him, and pronounce His purity for long times at night.
T. Usmani.76:27: In fact these people love that which is immediate, and neglect a Heavy Day ahead of them.
T. Usmani.76:28: We have created them and have made their joints strong. And whenever We will, We would replace them with others like them, a total replacement.
T. Usmani.76:29: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.
T. Usmani.76:30: And you will not so wish unless Allah so wills. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
T. Usmani.76:31: He admits whomsoever He wills to His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
T. Usmani.77:1: (I swear) by those (winds) that are sent one after the other,
T. Usmani.77:2: and by those that blow violently,
T. Usmani.77:3: and by those that spread (clouds) all over,
T. Usmani.77:4: and by those (angels) who differentiate (between right and wrong) distinctly,
T. Usmani.77:6: leaving no excuse (for the disbelievers) or giving warnings,
T. Usmani.77:7: that which you are promised is sure to happen.
T. Usmani.77:8: So, when the stars will be extinguished,
T. Usmani.77:9: and when the sky will be split,
T. Usmani.77:10: and when the mountains will be blown away as dust,
T. Usmani.77:11: and when the messengers will be assembled at the appointed time, (then all matters will be decided.)
T. Usmani.77:12: (Do you know) for which day has all this been delayed?
T. Usmani.77:14: And what may let you know what the Day of Decision is?
T. Usmani.77:15: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:16: Did We not destroy the earlier people?
T. Usmani.77:17: Then We will cause the later ones to follow them.
T. Usmani.77:18: Thus We deal with the guilty people.
T. Usmani.77:19: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:20: Did We not create you from a worthless fluid?
T. Usmani.77:21: Then We put it in a firm place of rest
T. Usmani.77:23: Thus We did (all this with perfect) measure; so We are the best to measure.
T. Usmani.77:24: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:25: Did We not make the earth a container that collects
T. Usmani.77:27: And We placed towering mountains therein, and provided you with sweet water to drink.
T. Usmani.77:28: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:29: (It will be said to them on that day,) “Push on to what you used to deny.
T. Usmani.77:30: Push on to a canopy (of Hell’s smoke) having three branches,
T. Usmani.77:31: that neither has a comfortable shade, nor is it of any use against the scorching heat.
T. Usmani.77:32: It emits sparks (as huge) as castles,
T. Usmani.77:33: as if they were yellowish camels.”
T. Usmani.77:34: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:35: This is the day when they will not speak,
T. Usmani.77:36: nor will they be allowed to offer excuses.
T. Usmani.77:37: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:38: (It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Decision. We have assembled you and the earlier ones together.
T. Usmani.77:39: Now, if you have a trick, use the trick against Me.”
T. Usmani.77:40: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:41: Of course, the God-fearing will be amid shades and streams,
T. Usmani.77:43: It will be said to them, “Eat and drink with pleasure because of what you used to do.”
T. Usmani.77:44: This is how We reward those who do good deeds.
T. Usmani.77:45: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:46: “(O disbelievers,) eat and drink for a while! You are guilty ones.”
T. Usmani.77:47: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:48: And when it is said to them, “Bow down (i.e. submit to Allah’s commands)”, they do not bow down.
T. Usmani.77:49: Woe that Day to the deniers!
T. Usmani.77:50: Now, in which discourse, after this, will they believe?
T. Usmani.78:1: About what are they asking each other?
T. Usmani.78:5: Again, indeed they will soon know.
T. Usmani.78:6: Did We not make the earth a floor,
T. Usmani.78:8: And We have created you in pairs,
T. Usmani.78:9: and made your sleep a source of rest,
T. Usmani.78:10: and made the night a covering,
T. Usmani.78:11: and made the day a source of livelihood.
T. Usmani.78:12: And We have built seven strong (skies),
T. Usmani.78:13: and created a luminous lamp (the sun).
T. Usmani.78:14: And We have sent down abundant water from the rain-laden clouds,
T. Usmani.78:15: so that We bring out therewith grain and vegetation,
T. Usmani.78:17: Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,
T. Usmani.78:18: a day when the trumpet will be blown, so you will come in multitudes,
T. Usmani.78:19: and the sky will be opened, so it will become as gates,
T. Usmani.78:20: and the mountains will be set in motion, so they will be as mirage.
T. Usmani.78:21: Surely Jahannam (the Hell) lurks in ambush.
T. Usmani.78:22: (It is) abode for the rebellious people
T. Usmani.78:23: who will be abiding in it for ages.
T. Usmani.78:24: They will taste nothing cool in it, nor a drink,
T. Usmani.78:26: this being a punishment, fully commensurate (with their deeds).
T. Usmani.78:27: They did not expect (to face) accounting (of their deeds),
T. Usmani.78:28: and they rejected Our signs totally.
T. Usmani.78:29: And everything (from their deeds) is thoroughly recorded by Us in writing.
T. Usmani.78:30: “So now taste! We will add nothing to you but torment.”
T. Usmani.78:31: Of course, the God-fearing will have great achievement,
T. Usmani.78:33: and buxom maidens of matching age,
T. Usmani.78:34: and goblets filled up to the brim.
T. Usmani.78:35: They will not hear any vain talk therein, nor lies,
T. Usmani.78:36: this being a reward from their Lord, a well calculated grant,
T. Usmani.78:37: (from) the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the All-Merciful. No one will have power to address Him,
T. Usmani.78:38: on the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows. They will not speak, except the one who is permitted by the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) and speaks aright.
T. Usmani.78:39: That is the Day that is sure to come. So whoever so wishes may take refuge with his Lord.
T. Usmani.78:40: We have warned you of an approaching torment (that will be inflicted) on a day when one will see what his hands have sent ahead, and the disbeliever will say, “O would that I had turned into dust.”
T. Usmani.79:1: I swear by those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the infidels) with extreme force,
T. Usmani.79:2: and by those (angels) who untie the knot (of the souls of the believers) smoothly,
T. Usmani.79:3: and by those who float (in the atmosphere) swiftly,
T. Usmani.79:5: then manage (to do) everything (they are ordered to do,)
T. Usmani.79:6: (you will be resurrected) on the Day when the shocking event (i.e. the first blowing of the trumpet) will shock (everything),
T. Usmani.79:7: followed by the next one (i.e. the second blowing of the trumpet.)
T. Usmani.79:8: On that day, hearts (of people) will be throbbing,
T. Usmani.79:10: They (the infidels) say, “Are we going to be brought back to our former state (of Life)?
T. Usmani.79:11: Is it when we are turned into decayed bones?”
T. Usmani.79:12: They say, “If so, that will be a harmful homecoming.”
T. Usmani.79:13: In fact, it will be only a single harsh voice,
T. Usmani.79:14: and in no time they will be (brought) into the plain (of Hashr).
T. Usmani.79:15: Has there come to you the narrative about Mūsā?
T. Usmani.79:16: (Recall) when his Lord called to him in the blessed valley of Tuwā:
T. Usmani.79:17: “Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh). Indeed, he has crossed all bounds.
T. Usmani.79:18: And say (to him,) ‘Would you like to purify yourself,
T. Usmani.79:19: and that I should guide you to your Lord, so that you fear (Him)?’”
T. Usmani.79:20: So, he (Mūsā) showed him the biggest sign.
T. Usmani.79:22: then he turned back, and tried hard (to refute the Messenger),
T. Usmani.79:23: then he gathered (his people) and shouted
T. Usmani.79:24: and said, “I am your supreme lord.”
T. Usmani.79:25: So, Allah seized him for an exemplary punishment in the Hereafter and the present world.
T. Usmani.79:26: Indeed, there is a lesson for him who fears (Allah).
T. Usmani.79:27: Is your creation more difficult or that of the sky? He has built it,
T. Usmani.79:28: He has raised its height, then made it proper,
T. Usmani.79:29: and darkened its night, and brought forth its daylight,
T. Usmani.79:30: and, after that, He spread out the earth.
T. Usmani.79:31: From it, He brought out its water and its meadows,
T. Usmani.79:33: (all this) as a benefit to you and your cattle.
T. Usmani.79:34: So when the Greatest Havoc will take place
T. Usmani.79:35: on the day when man will recall what he did,
T. Usmani.79:36: and the Hell will be exposed for all who see,
T. Usmani.79:37: then for the one who had rebelled,
T. Usmani.79:38: and preferred the worldly life (to the Hereafter),
T. Usmani.79:39: the Hell will be the abode,
T. Usmani.79:40: whereas for the one who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained his self from the (evil) desire,
T. Usmani.79:41: the Paradise will be the abode.
T. Usmani.79:42: They ask you (O Prophet,) about the Hour (the Day of Judgment) as to when it will take place.
T. Usmani.79:43: In which capacity are you to tell this?
T. Usmani.79:44: With your Lord is the final word about it.
T. Usmani.79:45: You are only a warner for anyone who fears it.
T. Usmani.79:46: The day they will see it, it will seem to them as if they did not live (in the world) but only for one afternoon or for the morning thereof.
T. Usmani.80:1: He (the Prophet) frowned and turned his face,
T. Usmani.80:2: because the blind man came to him!
T. Usmani.80:3: What could tell you (O prophet about the prospects of the blind man?) May be, (if you had attended him properly,) he would have attained purity,
T. Usmani.80:4: or have received the advice, and the advice would have benefited him.
T. Usmani.80:5: As for the one who does not care (about faith),
T. Usmani.80:6: you are anxious to pursue him,
T. Usmani.80:7: while there is no blame on you, if he does not attain purity.
T. Usmani.80:8: As regards the one who has come to you rushing eagerly,
T. Usmani.80:10: to him you pay no heed!
T. Usmani.80:11: Never! (you should never act in this way,) Indeed this (Qur’ān) is an advice.
T. Usmani.80:12: So, whoever so wills may pay heed to it.
T. Usmani.80:13: It is (recorded) in those scripts (of the Preserved Tablet) that are honoured,
T. Usmani.80:15: in the hands of those scribes
T. Usmani.80:17: Damned is the man! How ungrateful he is!
T. Usmani.80:18: From which stuff did He (Allah) create him?
T. Usmani.80:19: from a drop of semen! He created him, and designed him in due proportion,
T. Usmani.80:20: then He made the way easy for him,
T. Usmani.80:21: Later, he made him die, and put him into grave,
T. Usmani.80:22: Thereafter, when He will intend, He will raise him up.
T. Usmani.80:23: No! He has not yet fulfilled what He (Allah) had commanded him.
T. Usmani.80:24: So, the man should consider his food,
T. Usmani.80:26: then how nicely We split the earth,
T. Usmani.80:27: then We grew in it grain,
T. Usmani.80:30: and gardens, full of thick trees,
T. Usmani.80:32: as a benefit for you and your cattle.
T. Usmani.80:33: So when the Deafening Noise will occur,
T. Usmani.80:34: the Day when one will flee from his brother,
T. Usmani.80:35: and from his mother and father,
T. Usmani.80:36: and from his wife and sons,
T. Usmani.80:37: every one of them will be too engaged in his own affairs to care for others.
T. Usmani.80:38: Many faces, on that day, will be bright,
T. Usmani.80:40: and many faces, on that day, will be stained with dust,
T. Usmani.80:42: Those are the disbelievers, the nefarious.
T. Usmani.81:1: When the sun will be folded up,
T. Usmani.81:2: and when the stars will swoop down,
T. Usmani.81:3: and when the mountains will be set in motion,
T. Usmani.81:4: and when the ten-months pregnant she-camels will be abandoned,
T. Usmani.81:5: and when the wild beasts will be gathered together,
T. Usmani.81:6: and when the seas will be flared up,
T. Usmani.81:7: and when the people will be arranged in categories,
T. Usmani.81:8: and when the girl-child that was buried alive will be asked,
T. Usmani.81:9: for what sin she was killed,
T. Usmani.81:10: and when the scrolls (of deeds) will be unrolled,
T. Usmani.81:11: and when the sky will be stripped off,
T. Usmani.81:12: and when the Hell will be set ablaze,
T. Usmani.81:13: and when the Paradise will be brought close,
T. Usmani.81:14: then everyone will know what he (or she) has put forward.
T. Usmani.81:15: So, I swear by those (stars) that recede,
T. Usmani.81:16: that proceed, that withdraw from the scene,
T. Usmani.81:17: and by the night when it departs,
T. Usmani.81:18: and the morning when it starts breathing,
T. Usmani.81:19: it (the Qur’ān) is surely the word of a noble messenger (Jibra’īl X),
T. Usmani.81:20: the one possessing power and a high status with the Lord of the Throne,
T. Usmani.81:22: Your companion (Muhammad ) is not a madman,
T. Usmani.81:23: and he did see him (Jibra’īl X) on the clear horizon.
T. Usmani.81:24: And he (the Prophet) is not stingy about (the news of) the unseen.
T. Usmani.81:25: Nor is it the word of an outcast satan (devil).
T. Usmani.81:27: It is nothing else but a message of advice for all the worlds,
T. Usmani.81:28: for the benefit of any one from among you who intends to go straight.
T. Usmani.81:29: And you cannot intend (to do anything) unless it is so willed by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
T. Usmani.82:1: When the sky will be cleft asunder,
T. Usmani.82:2: and when the stars will disperse,
T. Usmani.82:3: and when the seas will be burst forth,
T. Usmani.82:4: and when the graves will be overturned,
T. Usmani.82:5: then one will know what he sent ahead and what he left behind.
T. Usmani.82:6: O man! What has deceived you about your Gracious Lord,
T. Usmani.82:7: who created you, then perfected you, then brought you in due proportion?
T. Usmani.82:8: He composed you in whichever form He willed.
T. Usmani.82:9: Never! (i.e. one should never be heedless towards him.) But you deny the Requital,
T. Usmani.82:10: while (appointed) over you there are watchers,
T. Usmani.82:11: who are noble, writers (of the deeds),
T. Usmani.82:13: Surely the righteous will be in bliss,
T. Usmani.82:15: in which they will enter on the Day of Requital,
T. Usmani.82:16: and they will not (be able to) keep away from it.
T. Usmani.82:17: And what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?
T. Usmani.82:18: Again, what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?
T. Usmani.82:19: A Day when no one will have power to do any thing for another! And command, on that Day, will belong to Allah (alone).
T. Usmani.83:2: who, when they measure something to receive from people, take it in full,
T. Usmani.83:3: and when they measure or weigh something to give it to them, give less than due.
T. Usmani.83:4: Do they not think that they have to be raised up
T. Usmani.83:6: the Day when all the people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
T. Usmani.83:7: Never! (i.e. they should never act in such a way.) Indeed the record of deeds of the sinners is in Sijjīn .
T. Usmani.83:8: And what may let you know what Sijjīn is?
T. Usmani.83:10: Woe that day to the deniers,
T. Usmani.83:11: who deny the Day of Requital!
T. Usmani.83:12: And none denies it but every sinful transgressor.
T. Usmani.83:13: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) tales of the ancients.”
T. Usmani.83:14: No! But that which they used to commit has covered their hearts with rust.
T. Usmani.83:15: No! Indeed they will be screened off from their Lord on that Day.
T. Usmani.83:16: Then they will have to enter the Hell.
T. Usmani.83:17: Then it will be said, “This is what you used to deny.”
T. Usmani.83:18: No! The record of deeds of the righteous is in ‘Illiyyūn .
T. Usmani.83:19: And what may let you know what ‘Illiyyūn is ?
T. Usmani.83:21: attended by those (angels) who are blessed with nearness to Allah!
T. Usmani.83:22: Indeed the righteous will be in absolute bliss.
T. Usmani.83:23: While (sitting) on thrones they will be watching (the scenes of Paradise).
T. Usmani.83:24: You will recognize the glamour of bliss on their faces.
T. Usmani.83:25: They will be served with a pure sealed wine to drink,
T. Usmani.83:26: the seal of which will be of musk.-It is this (bliss) in aspiring for which the competitors should race each other.
T. Usmani.83:27: -and it will be blended with (a drink from) Tasnīm ,
T. Usmani.83:28: a spring from which will drink those who are blessed with nearness.
T. Usmani.83:29: Indeed those who were guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
T. Usmani.83:30: and when they passed by them, they used to wink at one another,
T. Usmani.83:31: and when they went back to their family, they went enjoying their mockery,
T. Usmani.83:32: and when they saw them, they said, “Surely these are the ones who have gone astray”
T. Usmani.83:33: while they were not sent as watchmen over them.
T. Usmani.83:34: So, today those who believed will laugh at the disbelievers.
T. Usmani.83:35: While (sitting) on thrones, they will be seeing
T. Usmani.83:36: whether the disbelievers have been paid back for what they used to do.
T. Usmani.84:1: When the sky will split apart,
T. Usmani.84:2: and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,-
T. Usmani.84:3: and when the earth will be stretched (to give room to more people),
T. Usmani.84:4: and it will throw up whatever it contains, and will become empty,
T. Usmani.84:5: and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,- (then man will see the consequences of his deeds.)
T. Usmani.84:6: O man, you have to work hard constantly to reach your Lord, and then you have to meet Him.
T. Usmani.84:7: So, as for him whose book (of deeds) will be given to him in his right hand,
T. Usmani.84:8: he will be called to account in an easy manner,
T. Usmani.84:9: and he will go back to his people joyfully.
T. Usmani.84:10: As for the one whose book (of deeds) will be given to him from his backside,
T. Usmani.84:12: and will enter the blazing fire.
T. Usmani.84:13: He had been joyful among his people (in the world).
T. Usmani.84:14: He thought he would never revert (to Allah).
T. Usmani.84:15: No! Indeed his Lord was watchful over him.
T. Usmani.84:16: So, I swear by the twilight (after sunset),
T. Usmani.84:17: and by the night and what it envelops,
T. Usmani.84:18: and by the moon when it develops at the full,
T. Usmani.84:19: you shall certainly ascend from stage to stage.
T. Usmani.84:20: So, what is wrong with them that they do not believe,
T. Usmani.84:21: and when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not offer sajdah (prostration)?
T. Usmani.84:22: Rather, those who disbelieve deny (the truth).
T. Usmani.84:23: And Allah is most aware of what they store.
T. Usmani.84:24: So, give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment,
T. Usmani.84:25: but those who believed and did righteous deeds will have a reward that will never be interrupted.
T. Usmani.85:1: I swear by the sky, the one having stellar formations,
T. Usmani.85:3: and by that which attends, and that which is attended,
T. Usmani.85:4: cursed were the People of the Trench,
T. Usmani.85:5: the (people of the) fire that was rich with fuel,
T. Usmani.85:6: when they were sitting by it,
T. Usmani.85:7: and were watching what they were doing with the believers.
T. Usmani.85:8: They punished them for nothing but that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Worthy of All Praise,
T. Usmani.85:9: the One to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is witness over every thing.
T. Usmani.85:10: Surely, those who persecuted the believing men and the believing women, then did not repent, -for them there is the torment of Jahannam (Hell), and for them there is the torment of burning.
T. Usmani.85:11: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them there are gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the big achievement.
T. Usmani.85:12: The seizure of your Lord is severe indeed!
T. Usmani.85:13: Surely He originates (creation) and repeats (it after death).
T. Usmani.85:14: And He is the Most-Forgiving, the Most-Loving,
T. Usmani.85:15: the Master of the Throne, the Glorious.
T. Usmani.85:16: He is ever doer of what He intends.
T. Usmani.85:17: Has there come to you the story of the forces,
T. Usmani.85:19: But those who disbelieve are (engaged) in denying (the truth).
T. Usmani.85:20: Allah has encompassed them from all sides.
T. Usmani.85:21: The reality is that it is the glorious Qur’ān,
T. Usmani.86:1: I swear by the sky and by the Night-Comer,-
T. Usmani.86:2: -and what may let you know what the Night-Comer is?
T. Usmani.86:4: -there is no human being, but there is a watcher over him.
T. Usmani.86:5: So, let man consider of which stuff he is created.
T. Usmani.86:6: He is created of spouting water
T. Usmani.86:7: that comes out from between the loins and the chest-bones.
T. Usmani.86:8: Surely He is Powerful to bring him back
T. Usmani.86:9: on a day when all the secrets will be searched out,
T. Usmani.86:10: and he will have neither strength (to defend), nor a supporter.
T. Usmani.86:11: I swear by the sky that rains,
T. Usmani.86:12: and the earth that cracks open (for plants),
T. Usmani.86:14: and it is not a joke.
T. Usmani.86:17: So leave the disbelievers alone at the moment; give them respite for a while.
T. Usmani.87:1: Pronounce the purity of the name of your most exalted Lord,
T. Usmani.87:3: and who determined a measure (for everything), then guided (it),
T. Usmani.87:5: then turned it into a blackening stubble.
T. Usmani.87:6: We will make you recite, then you will not forget
T. Usmani.87:7: except that which Allah wills. Indeed He knows what is manifest and what is hidden.
T. Usmani.87:8: And We will facilitate for you (to reach) the easiest way.
T. Usmani.87:9: So, extend advice (to people) if advice is useful.
T. Usmani.87:10: The one who fears (Allah) will observe the advice,
T. Usmani.87:11: and it will be avoided by the most wretched one
T. Usmani.87:12: who will enter the Biggest Fire,
T. Usmani.87:13: then he will neither die therein, nor live (a desirable life).
T. Usmani.87:14: Success is surely achieved by him who purifies himself,
T. Usmani.87:15: and pronounces the name of his Lord, then offers prayer.
T. Usmani.87:16: But you prefer the worldly life,
T. Usmani.87:17: while the Hereafter is much better and much more durable.
T. Usmani.87:18: Indeed this is (written) in the earlier divine scripts,
T. Usmani.87:19: the scripts of Ibrāhīm and Mūsā.
T. Usmani.88:1: Has there come to you the description of the Overwhelming Event?
T. Usmani.88:2: Many faces that day will be humbled,
T. Usmani.88:4: They will enter into the scorching fire.
T. Usmani.88:5: They will be made to drink water from a boiling spring.
T. Usmani.88:6: There will be no food for them except from a thorny plant
T. Usmani.88:7: that will neither nourish, nor satisfy hunger.
T. Usmani.88:8: Many faces that day will be full of glamour,
T. Usmani.88:11: in which they will not hear any absurd talk.
T. Usmani.88:12: In it there is a flowing spring.
T. Usmani.88:13: In it there are elevated couches
T. Usmani.88:17: So, do they not look at the camels how they are created,
T. Usmani.88:18: and at the sky, how it is raised high,
T. Usmani.88:19: and at the mountains, how they are installed,
T. Usmani.88:20: and at the earth, how it is spread out?
T. Usmani.88:21: So, (O Prophet,) keep on preaching; you are only a preacher.
T. Usmani.88:22: You are not a taskmaster set up over them,
T. Usmani.88:23: but whoever turns away and disbelieves,
T. Usmani.88:24: Allah will punish him with the greatest torment.
T. Usmani.88:25: Surely towards Us they have to return,
T. Usmani.88:26: then it is Our job to call them to account.
T. Usmani.89:3: and by the even and the odd,
T. Usmani.89:4: and by the night when it moves away,
T. Usmani.89:5: -Is there (not) in such an oath (enough assurance) for a man of sense?-
T. Usmani.89:6: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with (the people) of ‘Ād
T. Usmani.89:7: of Iram , the men of tall pillars,
T. Usmani.89:8: the like of whom were never created in the lands,
T. Usmani.89:9: and (how He dealt) with (the people of) Thamūd who had carved out the rocks in the Valley (of Qurā),
T. Usmani.89:10: and with Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of the stakes,
T. Usmani.89:11: - those who had rebelled in the cities,
T. Usmani.89:12: and spread a lot of mischief therein.
T. Usmani.89:13: So, your Lord let loose on them the whip of torment.
T. Usmani.89:14: Surely your Lord is ever on the watch.
T. Usmani.89:15: As for man, when his Lord tests him, and thus gives him honour and bounties, he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”
T. Usmani.89:16: But when he tests him, and thus straitens his provision for him, he says, “My Lord has disgraced me.”
T. Usmani.89:17: No! But you do not honour the orphan,
T. Usmani.89:18: and do not encourage one another to feed the needy.
T. Usmani.89:19: And you devour the inheritance with a sweeping gulp,
T. Usmani.89:20: and love wealth, an excessive love.
T. Usmani.89:21: No! When the earth will be crushed thoroughly to be turned into bits,
T. Usmani.89:22: and your Lord will come, and the angels as well, lined up in rows,
T. Usmani.89:23: and Jahannam (Hell), on that day, will be brought forward, it will be the day when man will realize the truth, but from where will he take advantage of such realization?
T. Usmani.89:24: He will say, “O Would that I had sent ahead (some good deeds) for (this) my life!”
T. Usmani.89:25: So no one can punish like He will punish, that day,
T. Usmani.89:26: nor can anyone shackle like He will shackle.
T. Usmani.89:27: (As for an obedient man, it will be said to him,) “O content soul,
T. Usmani.89:28: come back to your Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing.
T. Usmani.90:2: -and (O Prophet,) you are going to be allowed (to fight) in this city-
T. Usmani.90:3: and by the father and all those he begot,
T. Usmani.90:4: indeed We have created man (to live) in hard struggle.
T. Usmani.90:5: Does he think that no one has power over him?
T. Usmani.90:6: He says, “I have spent a lot of wealth.”
T. Usmani.90:7: Does he think that no one has seen him?
T. Usmani.90:8: Did We not make for him two eyes,
T. Usmani.90:9: and one tongue and two lips,
T. Usmani.90:10: and showed him the two ways?
T. Usmani.90:11: Yet he did not make his way through the steep course,- -
T. Usmani.90:12: - And what may let you know what the steep course is?
T. Usmani.90:13: (It is) freeing of the neck of a slave,
T. Usmani.90:14: or giving food in a day of hunger
T. Usmani.90:15: to an orphan near of kin,
T. Usmani.90:16: or to a needy person lying in dust- -
T. Usmani.90:17: - then he did not join those who believe and advise each other to be patient and advise each other to be merciful.
T. Usmani.90:18: Those are the People of the Right Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their right hands)
T. Usmani.90:19: As for those who reject Our verses, they are the People of the Left Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their left hands.)
T. Usmani.90:20: Upon them will be the Fire, enveloping them with closed exits.
T. Usmani.91:1: I swear by the sun and his broad light,
T. Usmani.91:2: and by the moon when she follows him,
T. Usmani.91:3: and by the day when it shows his brightness,
T. Usmani.91:4: and by the night when it envelops him,
T. Usmani.91:5: and by the sky, and the One who built it,
T. Usmani.91:6: and by the earth, and the One who spread it,
T. Usmani.91:7: and by the soul, and the One who made it well,
T. Usmani.91:8: then inspired it with its (instincts of) evil and piety,
T. Usmani.91:9: success is really attained by him who purifies it,
T. Usmani.91:10: and failure is really suffered by him who pollutes it.
T. Usmani.91:11: (The People of) Thamūd denied the truth because of their transgression,
T. Usmani.91:12: when rose up the one who was most wretched of them.
T. Usmani.91:13: So, the Messenger of Allah said to them, “Be careful of Allah’s she-camel and her right to drink.”
T. Usmani.91:14: But they rejected him and killed her, so their Lord sent eradicating torment upon them because of their sin, and made it equal for all.
T. Usmani.91:15: And He has no fear of its consequence.
T. Usmani.92:1: I swear by the night when it covers (the sun),
T. Usmani.92:2: and by the day when it unveils itself,
T. Usmani.92:3: and by the One who created the male and the female,
T. Usmani.92:5: As for the one who gives (in charity) and fears Allah,
T. Usmani.92:7: We will facilitate for him the way to extreme ease (i.e. the comforts of Paradise).
T. Usmani.92:8: But the one who is miser and deems himself self-sufficient,
T. Usmani.92:10: We will facilitate for him the way to extreme distress.
T. Usmani.92:11: And his wealth will not help him when he will fall down (into Hell).
T. Usmani.92:12: Of course, it is undertaken by Us to guide,
T. Usmani.92:13: and in Our control is the Hereafter and the worldly life.
T. Usmani.92:14: So I have warned you of a blazing fire.
T. Usmani.92:15: None will enter it but the wretched one,
T. Usmani.92:16: who rejected (the truth) and turned away (from it).
T. Usmani.92:17: And saved from it will be the most God-fearing one,
T. Usmani.92:18: who gives his wealth (in charity) to become purified,
T. Usmani.92:19: while no one has conferred any favour on him for which he would give a return,
T. Usmani.92:20: but (he gave his wealth in charity) only to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.
T. Usmani.92:21: And surely he will soon be happy.
T. Usmani.93:2: and by the night when it becomes peaceful,
T. Usmani.93:3: your Lord (O Prophet,) has neither forsaken you, nor has become displeased.
T. Usmani.93:4: Surely the Hereafter is much better for you than the present life.
T. Usmani.93:5: And of course, your Lord will give you so much that you will be pleased.
T. Usmani.93:6: Did He not find you an orphan, and give you shelter?
T. Usmani.93:7: And He found you unaware of the way (the Sharī‘ah ), then He guided you.
T. Usmani.93:8: and He found you in need, then made you need-free.
T. Usmani.93:9: Therefore, as for orphan, do not oppress him,
T. Usmani.93:10: and as for the beggar, do not scold him.
T. Usmani.93:11: And about the bounty of your Lord, do talk.
T. Usmani.94:1: Have We not caused your bosom to be wide open for you?
T. Usmani.94:2: And We removed from you your burden
T. Usmani.94:4: and We raised high your name.
T. Usmani.94:5: So, undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.
T. Usmani.94:6: Undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.
T. Usmani.94:7: So, when you are free (from collective services), toil hard (in worship),
T. Usmani.94:8: and towards your Lord turn with eagerness.
T. Usmani.95:1: I swear by the Fig and the Olive,
T. Usmani.95:2: and by Tūr, the mount of Sinai,
T. Usmani.95:4: We have created man in the best composition,
T. Usmani.95:5: then We turned him into the lowest of the low,
T. Usmani.95:6: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, because for them there is a reward never ending.
T. Usmani.95:7: So, what can make you, after all this, to deny the Requital?
T. Usmani.95:8: Is Allah not the Greatest Ruler of all the rulers?
T. Usmani.96:1: Read with the name of your Lord who created (every thing),
T. Usmani.96:2: He created man from a clot of blood.
T. Usmani.96:3: Read, and your Lord is the most gracious,
T. Usmani.96:4: who imparted knowledge by means of the pen.
T. Usmani.96:5: He taught man what he did not know.
T. Usmani.96:6: In fact, man crosses the limits,
T. Usmani.96:7: because he deems himself to be free of need.
T. Usmani.96:8: Surely to your Lord is the return.
T. Usmani.96:9: Have you seen him who forbids
T. Usmani.96:10: a servant of Allah when he prays?
T. Usmani.96:11: Tell me, if he is on the right path,
T. Usmani.96:12: or bids piety, (would the former still forbid him?)
T. Usmani.96:13: Tell me, if he rejects (the true faith) and turns away,
T. Usmani.96:14: does he not know that Allah is watching (him)?
T. Usmani.96:15: No! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag (him) by forelock,
T. Usmani.96:17: So let him call the men of his council,
T. Usmani.96:18: We will call the soldiers of the Hell.
T. Usmani.96:19: No! Never obey him, and bow down in sajdah, and come close to Me.
T. Usmani.97:1: We have sent it (the Qur’ān) down in the Night of Qadr.
T. Usmani.97:2: And what may let you know what the Night of Qadr is?
T. Usmani.97:3: The Night of Qadr is much better than one thousand months.
T. Usmani.97:4: The angels and the Spirit descend in it, with the leave of your Lord, along with every command.
T. Usmani.97:5: Peace it is till the debut of dawn.
T. Usmani.98:1: Those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not (expected) to desist (from their wrong beliefs) unless there comes to them a clear proof,
T. Usmani.98:2: a messenger from Allah who recites the purified scrolls
T. Usmani.98:4: And those who were given the Book did not disagree but after the clear proof came to them,
T. Usmani.98:5: while they were not ordered but to worship Allah, making their submission exclusive for him with no deviation, and to establish Salāh and pay Zakāh. That is the way of the straight religion.
T. Usmani.98:6: Surely those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Jahannam , in which they will be living forever. Those are the worst of all human beings.
T. Usmani.98:7: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they are the best of all human beings.
T. Usmani.98:8: Their reward, with their Lord, is gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow, in which they will be abiding forever. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. That (reward) is for him who has awe of his Lord.
T. Usmani.99:1: When the earth will be trembled with its quake,
T. Usmani.99:2: and the earth will bring forth its burdens,
T. Usmani.99:3: and man will say, “What has happened to it?”
T. Usmani.99:4: That day it will describe all its happenings,
T. Usmani.99:5: because its Lord will have so commanded it.
T. Usmani.99:6: That day the people will come back (from the place of reckoning) in different groups, so that they may be shown (the fruits of) their deeds.
T. Usmani.99:7: So, whoever does any good act (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.
T. Usmani.99:8: And whoever does evil (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.
T. Usmani.100:1: (I swear) by those (horses) that run snorting,
T. Usmani.100:2: then those that create sparks by striking (their hoofs) on the stones,
T. Usmani.100:3: then those that invade at morning,
T. Usmani.100:4: then raise, at the same time, a trail of dust,
T. Usmani.100:5: then enter, at the same time, into the centre of the (opposing) host,
T. Usmani.100:6: man is, indeed, very ungrateful to his Lord,
T. Usmani.100:7: and he himself is a witness to that fact,
T. Usmani.100:8: and in his love for wealth, he is very intense.
T. Usmani.100:9: Does he not then know (what will happen) when all that is contained in the graves will be overturned,
T. Usmani.100:10: and all that is contained in the hearts will be exposed.
T. Usmani.100:11: Surely your Lord, that day, is fully aware of them.
T. Usmani.101:3: And what may let you know what the Striking Event is?
T. Usmani.101:4: (It will happen) on a day when people will be like scattered moths,
T. Usmani.101:5: and the mountains will be like carded wool.
T. Usmani.101:6: Then, as for him whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy,
T. Usmani.101:7: he will be in a happy life.
T. Usmani.101:8: But he whose scales are light,
T. Usmani.101:10: And what may let you know what that (Abyss) is?
T. Usmani.102:1: You are distracted by mutual competition in amassing (worldly benefits),
T. Usmani.102:3: No! (This is not a correct attitude.) You will soon know (the reality).
T. Usmani.102:5: No! Only if you knew (it) with a sure knowledge!
T. Usmani.102:6: You will certainly see the Hell,
T. Usmani.102:7: then you will see it with full certitude.
T. Usmani.102:8: Then you will be asked about all the pleasures (you enjoyed in the world).
T. Usmani.103:2: man is in a state of loss indeed,
T. Usmani.103:3: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, and exhorted each other to follow truth, and exhorted each other to observe patience.
T. Usmani.104:2: who accumulates wealth and counts it.
T. Usmani.104:3: He thinks that his wealth has made him eternal.
T. Usmani.104:4: Never! He will certainly be thrown into the Crushing Fire.
T. Usmani.104:5: And what may let you know what the Crushing Fire is?
T. Usmani.104:7: that will peep into the hearts.
T. Usmani.104:8: It will be closed on them,
T. Usmani.105:1: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?
T. Usmani.105:2: Has He not turned their plan into nullity?
T. Usmani.105:3: And He sent upon them flying birds in flocks,
T. Usmani.105:4: throwing upon them stones of baked clay,
T. Usmani.105:5: and thus He turned them into an eaten-up chaff.
T. Usmani.106:1: Because of the familiarity of the Quraish,
T. Usmani.106:2: that is, their familiarity with the trips of winter and summer,
T. Usmani.106:3: they must worship the Lord of this House,
T. Usmani.106:4: who gave them food against hunger, and gave them security against fear.
T. Usmani.107:1: Have you seen him who denies the Requital?
T. Usmani.107:2: So, he is the one who pushes away the orphan,
T. Usmani.107:3: and does not persuade (others) to feed the needy.
T. Usmani.107:4: So, Woe to those performers of Salāh,
T. Usmani.107:5: who are neglectful of their Salāh,
T. Usmani.107:6: who (do good only to) show off,
T. Usmani.107:7: and refuse (to give even) small gifts.
T. Usmani.108:1: (O Prophet,) surely We have given to you Al-Kauthar.
T. Usmani.108:2: So, offer Salāh (prayer) to your Lord, and sacrifice.
T. Usmani.108:3: Surely it is your enemy whose traces are cut off.
T. Usmani.109:2: I do not worship that which you worship,
T. Usmani.109:3: nor do you worship the One whom I worship.
T. Usmani.109:4: And neither I am going to worship that which you have worshipped,
T. Usmani.109:5: nor will you worship the One whom I worship.
T. Usmani.109:6: For you is your faith, and for me, my faith.”
T. Usmani.110:1: (O Prophet,) When there comes Allah’s help and the Victory,
T. Usmani.110:2: and you see people entering Allah’s (approved) religion in multitudes,
T. Usmani.110:3: then pronounce the purity and praise of your Lord, and seek forgiveness from Him. Surely He is Ever-Relenting.
T. Usmani.111:1: Perish the two hands of Abū Lahab, and perish he!
T. Usmani.111:2: Neither his wealth benefited him, nor what he earned.
T. Usmani.111:3: He will soon enter a Fire, full of flames,
T. Usmani.111:4: and his wife as well,-the wicked carrier of firewood.
T. Usmani.111:5: Around her neck, there is (a collar of iron, like) a well-twisted rope.
T. Usmani.112:1: Say, “The truth is that Allah is One.
T. Usmani.112:2: Allah is Besought of all, needing none.
T. Usmani.112:3: He neither begot anyone, nor was he begotten.
T. Usmani.112:4: And equal to Him has never been any one.”
T. Usmani.113:1: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak
T. Usmani.113:2: from the evil of everything He has created,
T. Usmani.113:3: and from the evil of the dark night when it penetrates,
T. Usmani.113:4: and from the evil of the women who blow on the knots,
T. Usmani.113:5: and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
T. Usmani.114:1: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,
T. Usmani.114:4: from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws (when Allah’s name is pronounced),
T. Usmani.114:5: the one who whispers in the hearts of people,
T. Usmani.114:6: whether from among the Jinn or Mankind.

A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).1:1: In the name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).1:2: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the entire universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).1:4: The Master of the Day of Recompense.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).1:5: You alone do we worship, and You alone do we turn for help
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).1:6: Direct us on to the Straight Way,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).1:7: The way of those whom You have favoured, who did not incur Your wrath, who are not astray.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:2: This is the Book of Allah, there is no doubt in it; it is a guidance for the pious,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:3: for those who believe in the existence of that which is beyond the reach of perception, who establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:4: who believe in what has been revealed to you and what was revealed before you, and have firm faith in the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:5: Such are on true guidance from their Lord; such are the truly successful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:6: As for those who have rejected (these truths), it is all the same whether or not you warn them, for they will not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:7: Allah has sealed their hearts and their hearing, and a covering has fallen over their eyes. They deserve severe chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:8: There are some who say: “We believe in Allah and in the Last Day,” while in fact they do not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:9: They are trying to deceive Allah and those who believe, but they do not realize that in truth they are only deceiving themselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:10: There is a disease in their hearts and Allah has intensified this disease. A painful chastisement awaits them for their lying.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:11: Whenever they are told: “Do not spread mischief on earth,” they say: “Why! We indeed are the ones who set things right.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:12: They are the mischief makers, but they do not realize it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:13: Whenever they are told: “Believe as others believe,” they answer: “Shall we believe as the fools have believed?” Indeed it is they who are the fools, but they are not aware of it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:14: When they meet the believers, they say: “We believe,” but when they meet their evil companions (in privacy), they say: “Surely we are with you; we were merely jesting.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:15: Allah jests with them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their rebellion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:16: These are the ones who have purchased error in exchange for guidance. This bargain has brought them no profit and certainly they are not on the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:17: They are like him who kindled a fire, and when it lit up all around him, Allah took away the light (of their perception) and left them in utter darkness where they can see nothing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:18: They are deaf, they are dumb, they are blind; they will never return (to the Right Way).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:19: Or they are like those who encounter a violent rainstorm from the sky, accompanied by pitch-dark clouds, thunder-claps and flashes of lightning: on hearing thunder-claps they thrust their fingers into their ears in fear of death. Allah encompasses these deniers of the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:20: It is as if the lightning would snatch their sight; whenever it gleams a while for them they walk a little, and when darkness covers them they halt. If Allah so willed, He could indeed take away their hearing and their sight. Surely Allah is All-Powerful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:21: O mankind, serve your Lord Who has created you as well as those before you; do so that you are saved.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:22: It is He Who has made the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy, and sent down water from above wherewith He brought forth fruits for your sustenance. Do not, then, set up rivals to Allah when you know (the Truth).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:23: If you are in any doubt whether it is We Who have revealed this Book to Our servant, then produce just a surah like it, and call all your supporters and seek in it the support of all others save Allah. Accomplish this if you are truthful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:24: But if you fail to do this – and you will most certainly fail – then have fear of the Fire whose fuel is men and stones and which has been prepared for those who deny the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:25: (O Prophet), announce glad tidings to those who believe in this Book and do righteous deeds (in accordance with its teachings), that for them are gardens beneath which rivers flow. Their fruits will have such resemblance to those of the earth that whenever they will be provided with those fruits they will say: “It was this which was granted to us on earth before.” For them there shall be pure spouses, and there they shall abide forever.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:26: Behold! Allah is not ashamed to propound the parable of a gnat, or even of something more lowly. On hearing these parables the believers know that it is the truth from their Lord, while those bent on denying the Truth say: “What does Allah mean by these parables?” Thus He causes many to go astray just as He directs many to the Right Way. And He thereby causes to go astray only the transgressors,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:27: who break the covenant of Allah after its firm binding, and cut asunder what Allah has commanded to be joined, and spread mischief on earth. They are the utter losers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:28: How can you be ungrateful to Allah Who bestowed life upon you when you were lifeless, then He will cause you to die and will again bring you back to life so that you will be returned to Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:29: It is He Who created for you all that is on earth and then turned above and fashioned it into seven heavens. He knows all things.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:30: Just think when your Lord said to the angels: “Lo! I am about to place a vicegerent on earth,” they said: “Will You place on it one who will spread mischief and shed blood while we celebrate Your glory and extol Your holiness?” He said: “Surely I know what you do not know.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:31: Then Allah taught Adam the names of all things and presented them to the angels and said: “If you are right (that the appointment of a vicegerent will cause mischief) then tell Me the names of these things.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:32: They said. “Glory to You! We have no knowledge except what You taught us. You, only You, are All-Knowing, All-Wise.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:33: Then Allah said to Adam: “Tell them the names of these things.” And when he had told them the names of all things, Allah said: “Did I not say to you that I know everything about the heavens and the earth which are beyond your range of knowledge and I know all that you disclose and also all that you hide?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:34: And when We ordered the angels: “Prostrate yourselves before Adam,” all of them fell prostrate, except Iblis. He refused, and gloried in his arrogance and became one of the defiers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:35: And We said: “O Adam, live in the Garden, you and your wife, and eat abundantly of whatever you wish but do not approach this tree or else you will be counted among the wrong-doers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:36: But Satan caused both of them to deflect from obeying Our command by tempting them to the tree and brought them out of the state they were in, and We said: “Get down all of you; henceforth, each of you is an enemy of the other, and on earth you shall have your abode and your livelihood for an appointed time.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:37: Thereupon Adam learned from his Lord some words and repented and his Lord accepted his repentance for He is Much-Relenting, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:38: We said: “Get you down from here, all of you, and guidance shall come to you from Me: then, whoever will follow My guidance need have no fear, nor shall they grieve.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:39: But those who refuse to accept this (guidance) and reject Our Signs as false are destined for the Fire where they shall abide for ever.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:40: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I had bestowed on you, and fulfil your covenant with Me and I shall fulfil My covenant with you, and fear Me alone.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:41: And believe in the Book which I have revealed and which confirms the Scripture you already have, and be not foremost among its deniers. Do not sell My signs for a trifling gain, and beware of My wrath.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:42: Do not confound Truth by overlaying it with falsehood, nor knowingly conceal the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:43: Establish Prayer and dispense Zakah (the Purifying Alms) and bow in worship with those who bow.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:44: Do you enjoin righteousness on people and forget your own selves even though you recite the Scripture? Have you no sense?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:45: And resort to patience and Prayer for help.  Truly Prayer is burdensome for all except the devout,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:46: who realize that ultimately they will have to meet their Lord and that to Him they are destined to return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:47: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I bestowed upon you, exalting you above all nations.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:48: Fear the Day when no one shall avail another, when no intercession will be accepted, when no one will be ransomed, and no criminal will receive any help.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:49: And recall when We rescued you from the slavery of Pharaoh’s people who had afflicted you with dreadful suffering, slaying your males and sparing your females. That was a tremendous trial for you from your Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:50: And recall when We split the sea, providing passage for you, and thus saved you and caused Pharaoh’s people to drown before your very eyes.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:51: And recall when We summoned Moses for a term of forty nights, and then you set up the calf as your god in his absence. You indeed committed a grave wrong.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:52: Yet We pardoned you that you might be grateful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:53: And recall (that while you were committing this wrong) We gave Moses the Scripture and the Criterion that you are guided to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:54: And recall when (on returning with this favour) Moses said to his people: “My people! You have wronged yourselves by taking the calf for an object of worship, so turn in repentance to your Creator and kill yourselves. This will be best for you in your Creator’s sight.” Thereupon He accepted your repentance. Indeed He is Much-Relenting, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:55: And recall when you said: “O Moses, we will not believe in you until we clearly see Allah (speaking to you).” Thereupon a tremendous thunderbolt struck you before your very eyes.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:56: Then We revived you after your extinction, that you might be grateful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:57: And We caused a cloud to comfort you with shade, and We sent down upon you manna and the quails, (saying): “Eat of the good wherewithal that We have provided you as sustenance.” And by their sinning (your forefathers) did not wrong Us: it is they themselves whom they wronged.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:58: And recall when We said: “Go into this town and eat abundantly of its food; but enter the gate prostrate, saying, “Repentance”.We will forgive you your sins and shall bestow more favour on the doers of good.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:59: Then the wrong-doers substituted another saying for that which had been given them; and so We sent down a scourge upon the wrong-doers from the heavens for their transgression.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:60: And recall when Moses prayed for water for his people and We replied: “Strike the rock with your staff.” And there gushed out from it twelve springs and each tribe knew its drinking-place. (Then you were directed): “Eat and drink of the sustenance provided by Allah, and do not go about acting wickedly on earth, spreading mischief.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:61: And recall when you said: “O Moses, surely we cannot put up with one sort of food, so pray to your Lord to bring out for us what the earth produces – its herbs and its cucumbers and its corn and its lentils and its garlic and its onions.” Then Moses said: “Will you take a meaner thing in exchange for what is better? Go down to some city and there you shall get what you ask for.” And ignominy and wretchedness were pitched upon them and they were laden with the burden of Allah’s wrath. This was because they denied the Signs of Allah and slew the Prophets unrightfully. All this, because they disobeyed and persistently exceeded the limits (of the Law).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:62: Whether they are the ones who believe (in the Arabian Prophet), or whether they are Jews, Christians or Sabians – all who believe in Allah and the Last Day, and do righteous deeds – their reward is surely secure with their Lord; they need have no fear, nor shall they grieve.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:63: And recall when We made a covenant with you and caused the Mount Sinai to tower above you, (saying): “Hold fast to the Book that We have given you, and remember the directives and commandments in it, that you be pious.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:64: Then you turned away from your covenant, and had it not been for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you, you would have long been utter losers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:65: And you know the case of those of you who broke the Sabbath, how We said to them: “Become apes, despised and hated.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:66: And thus We made their end a warning for the people of their own time and for the succeeding generations, and an admonition to the God-fearing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:67: And then recall when Moses said to his people: “Behold, Allah commands you to slaughter a cow.” They said: “Are you jesting with us?” Moses answered: “I seek refuge in Allah that I should behave in the manner of the ignorant.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:68: They said: “Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us what she is like.” Moses answered: “He says, she is a cow, neither old nor immature, but of an age in between the two. Do, then, what you have been commanded.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:69: They said: “Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us of what colour she is.” Moses answered: “He says, she is a yellow cow, with a bright colour which is pleasing to those who see!”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:70: They said: “Pray to your Lord that He make clear to us what cow she is. Cows seem much alike to us, and if Allah wills, we shall be guided.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:71: Moses answered: “Lo! He says, she is a cow unyoked to plough the earth or to water the tillage, one that has been kept secure, with no blemish on her!” Thereupon they cried out: “Now you have come forth with the information that will direct us aright.” And they slaughtered her although they scarcely seemed to do so.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:72: And recall when you killed a man and then began to remonstrate and cast the blame (of killing) upon one another even though Allah was determined to bring to light what you were hiding.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:73: Then We ordered: “Smite the corpse with a part of it.” Thus does Allah bring the dead to life and thus does He show His Signs that you might understand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:74: Then (even after observing this) your hearts hardened and became like stones, or even harder. For surely there are some stones from which streams burst forth and some that split asunder and water issues out, and some that crash down for fear of Allah. Allah is not heedless of the things you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:75: Do you hope that these people will believe in the Message you are preaching, even though a party of them has been wont to listen to the Word of Allah and after they had fully grasped it, knowingly distorted it?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:76: And when they meet those who believe (in Muhammad) they say: “We too believe in him.” But in their intimate meetings they say to one another: “How foolish! Why should you intimate to them what Allah has revealed to you, for they will use it as argument against you before your Lord?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:77: Are they unaware that Allah knows all that they hide and all that they disclose?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:78: Among them are also the unlettered folk who do not know about the Scriptures but cherish baseless wishes and merely follow their conjectures.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:79: Woe, then, to those who write out the Scriptures with their own hands and then, in order to make a trifling gain, claim: “This is from Allah.” Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they thus earn.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:80: They say: “The Fire will certainly not touch us except for a limited number of days.” Say (to them): “Have you received a promise from Allah – for Allah never breaks His promise – or do you attribute to Allah something about which you have no knowledge?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:81: Those who earn evil and are encompassed by their sinfulness are the people of the Fire, and there will they abide;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:82: those who believe and do righteous deeds are the people of the Garden, and there will they abide.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:83: And recall when We made a covenant with the Children of Israel: “You shall serve none but Allah and do good to parents, kinsmen, orphans and the needy; you shall speak kindly to people, and establish Prayer and give Zakah (Purifying Alms). And yet, except for a few of you, you turned back on this covenant, and you are still backsliders.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:84: And recall when We made a covenant with you, that you shall not shed one another’s blood, and shall not turn out one another from your homelands; you confirmed it, and you yourselves are witnesses to it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:85: And here you are, killing one another, turning out a party of your own from their homelands, aiding one another against them in sin and enmity, and if they come to you as captives you ransom them although the very act of expelling them was unlawful to you. Do you believe in a part of the Scripture and reject the rest? What else, then, could be the retribution of those among you who do this than that they should live in degradation in the present life, and that on the Day of Resurrection they should be sent to the severest chastisement? Allah is not heedless of what you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:86: These are the ones who have bought the present life in exchange for the World to Come. Their chastisement shall not be lightened, nor shall they be helped.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:87: Surely We gave Moses the Scripture and caused a train of Messengers to follow him and then sent Jesus, the son of Mary, with Clear Proofs and supported him with the spirit of holiness. But is it not true that every time a Messenger brought to you something that was not to your liking, you acted arrogantly: you called some Messengers liars and killed others?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:88: They say: “Our hearts are well-protected.” No! The fact is that Allah has cursed them because of their denying the Truth. So, scarcely do they believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:89: And now that there has come to them a Book from Allah, how are they treating it? Even though it confirms the Truth already in their possession, and even though they had prayed for victory against the unbelievers, and yet when that Book came to them – and they recognized it – they refused to acknowledge its Truth. Allah’s curse be upon the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:90: Evil indeed is what they console themselves with. They deny the guidance revealed by Allah, grudging that He chose to bestow His gracious bounty (of revelation and prophethood) on some of His servants whom He willed. Thus they have brought on themselves wrath after wrath, and a humiliating chastisement is in store for such unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:91: When they are told: “Believe in what Allah has revealed,” they say: “We believe only in what was revealed to us (Israel).” They deny everything else even though it be the Truth which confirms what they possess. Say (to them): “If indeed you are believers, why is it that in the past you killed the Prophets of Allah (who were from Israel)?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:92: Moses came to you with clear proofs and yet you were so wont to wrong-doing that as soon as he was gone you took to worshipping the calf.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:93: Recall the covenant We made with you and caused the Mount to tower above you, stressing: “Hold to what We have given you with full strength and give heed to it.” But their forefathers said: “We hear, but we disobey” – for their hearts were overflowing with love for the calf because of their unbelief. Say: “If you are people of faith, then evil are the things that your faith enjoins upon you.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:94: Say to them: “If indeed the Last Abode with Allah is yours, in exclusion of other people, then long for death if you are truthful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:95: But they shall never long for it because of the (evil) deeds they have committed; Allah is well aware of the wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:96: You will certainly find them most eager to cling on to life, indeed even more eager than those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Each one of them wishes to live a thousand years although the bestowal of long life cannot remove him from chastisement. Allah sees whatever they do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:97: Say: “Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel (should know that) he revealed this (Qur’an) to your heart by Allah’s leave: it confirms the Scriptures revealed before it, and is a guidance and good tiding to the people of faith.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:98: (And if this is the cause of their hostility to Gabriel, let them know) whoever is an enemy to Allah, His Angels and His Messengers and to Gabriel and Michael will surely find Allah an enemy to such unbelievers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:99: We surely sent down to you clear verses that elucidate the Truth, (verses) which only the transgressors reject as false.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:100: Is it not that every time they made a covenant with Allah a party of them set it aside? The truth is that most of them do not truly believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:101: And whenever a Messenger from Allah came to them, confirming what they already possessed, a party of those who had been given the Scripture flung the Book of Allah behind their backs as if they knew nothing,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:102: and then followed what the evil ones falsely attributed to the Kingdom of Solomon even though Solomon had never disbelieved; it is the evil ones who disbelieved, teaching people magic. And they followed what had been revealed to the two angels in Babylon – Harut and Marut – although these two (angels) never taught it to anyone without first declaring: “We are merely a means of testing people; so, do not engage in unbelief.” And yet they learned from them what might cause division between a man and his wife. They could not cause harm to anyone except by the leave of Allah, and still they learned what harmed rather than profited them, knowing well that he who bought it will have no share in the World to Come. Evil indeed is what they sold themselves for. Had they but known!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:103: Had they believed and been God-fearing Allah’s reward would have been better! Had they but known!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:104: O you who believe! Do not say (to the Prophet): Ra'ina (Lend ear to us), but say Unzurna (Favour us with your attention) and pay heed (to him). A painful chastisement awaits the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:105: The unbelievers, be they the People of the Book or those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity, do not wish that any good should be sent down upon you from your Lord. But Allah chooses for His mercy whomsoever He wills. Allah is Lord of Abounding Bounty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:106: For whatever verse We might abrogate or consign to oblivion, We bring a better one or the like of it. Are you not aware that Allah is All-Powerful?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:107: Are you not aware that the dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah, and that none apart from Allah is your protector or helper?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:108: Or would you ask your Messenger in the manner Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for unbelief has surely strayed from the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:109: Out of sheer envy many People of the Book would be glad to turn you back into unbelievers after you have become believers even though the Truth has become clear to them. Nevertheless, forgive and be indulgent towards them until Allah brings forth His decision. Surely Allah is All-Powerful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:110: Establish Prayer and dispense Zakah. Whatever good deeds you send forth for your own good, you will find them with Allah. Surely Allah sees all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:111: They say: “None shall enter the Garden unless he be a Jew or (according to the Christians), a Christian.” These are their vain desires. Say: “Bring your proof if you are speaking the truth.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:112: (None has any special claim upon reward from Allah.) Whoever submits himself completely to the obedience of Allah and does good will find his reward with his Lord. No fear shall come upon them, nor shall they grieve.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:113: The Jews say: “The Christians have no basis for their beliefs,” and the Christians say: “The Jews have no basis for their beliefs.” They say so even though they read the Scripture. The claim of those who have no knowledge (of the Scripture) is similar. Allah will judge between them concerning their differences on the Day of Resurrection.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:114: Who is more iniquitous than he who bars Allah’s places of worship, that His name be mentioned there, and seeks their destruction? It does not behove such people to enter them, and should they enter, they should enter in fear. There is degradation for them in this world and a mighty chastisement in the Next.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:115: The East and the West belong to Allah. To whichever direction you turn, you will be turning to Allah. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:116: They say: “Allah has taken to Himself a son.” Glory to Him! Nay, whatever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him; to Him are all in obeisance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:117: He is the Originator of the heavens and the earth; whenever He decrees a matter He (merely) says: “Be”, and it is.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:118: The ignorant say: “Why does Allah not speak to us? Why does no Sign come to us?” The same was said by people before them. Their hearts are all alike. We have made the Signs clear for people of firm faith.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:119: (What greater Sign can there be than that) We sent you with the Truth as a bearer of good tidings and a warner! And you will not be answerable about the people of the Blazing Flame!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:120: Never will the Jews be pleased with you, (O Prophet), nor the Christians until you follow their way. Say: “Surely Allah’s guidance, is the true guidance.” Should you follow their desires disregarding the knowledge which has come to you, you shall have no protector or helper against Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:121: Those to whom We have given the Scripture, and who recite it as it ought to be recited, they truly believe in it; and those who disbelieve in it, they are the real losers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:122: Children of Israel! Recall My favour which I bestowed upon you and I exalted you above the nations of the world,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:123: and beware of the Day when no one shall avail another, when ransom shall be accepted from no one, when no one’s intercession will profit anyone, when there shall be no help from any quarter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:124: Recall when Abraham’s Lord tested him in certain matters and when he successfully stood the test, He said: “Indeed I am going to appoint you a leader of all people.” When Abraham asked: “And is this covenant also for my descendants?” the Lord responded: “My covenant does not embrace the wrong-doers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:125: And We made this House (Ka'bah) a resort for mankind and a place of security, commanding people: “Take the station of Abraham as a permanent place for Prayer,” and enjoined Abraham and Ishmael: “Purify My House for those who walk around it, and those who abide in devotion, and those who bow, and who prostrate themselves (in Prayer).”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:126: And when Abraham prayed: “O my Lord! Make this a place of security and provide those of its people that believe in Allah and the Last Day with fruits for sustenance,” Allah answered, “And I shall still provide him who disbelieves with the wherewithal for this short life, and then I shall drive him to the chastisement of the Fire; that is an evil end.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:127: Recall when Abraham and Ishmael raised the foundations of the House, praying: “Our Lord! Accept this from us; You are All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:128: Our Lord! Make us submissive to You and make out of our descendants a community that submits itself to You, and show us the ways of Your worship, and turn to us in mercy. You are Much-Relenting, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:129: Our Lord! Raise up in the midst of our offspring a Messenger from among them who shall recite to them Your verses, and instruct them in the Book and in Wisdom, and purify their lives. Verily, You are the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:130: And who but a fool would be averse to the way of Abraham? For it is We Who chose Abraham for Our mission in this world, and surely in the World to Come he shall be reckoned among the righteous.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:131: Such was Abraham that when his Lord said to him: “Submit,” he said: “I have submitted to the Lord of the Universe.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:132: And Abraham enjoined the same upon his children, and so did Jacob: “My children! Behold, Allah has chosen this religion for you. Remain till death in submission (to Allah).”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:133: Why, were you witnesses when death came to Jacob? He asked his children: “Whom will you serve after me?” They said: “We shall serve your God, the God of your forefathers, Abraham, Ishmael and Isaac, the One God, and unto Him do we submit.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:134: Now, they were a people who passed away. Theirs is what they have earned, and yours is what you have earned. You shall not be asked concerning what they did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:135: They say: “Be Jews,” or “Be Christians.” “Then you will be rightly guided.” Say to them: “No, follow exclusively the way of Abraham who was not one of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:136: Say: “We believe in Allah, and in what has been revealed to us and to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob and the descendants (of Jacob) and in what was given to Moses and Jesus and in what the other Prophets received from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are those who submit to Allah.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:137: And then if they come to believe as you believe, they are on right guidance; and if they turn away, then quite obviously they have merely fallen into opposition to the Truth. Allah will suffice you for protection against them. He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:138: Say: “Take on Allah’s colour.” And whose colour is better than Allah’s? It is Him that we serve.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:139: Say (O Prophet): “Will you then dispute with us concerning Allah when He is our Lord and your Lord? Our deeds are for us and your deeds are for you. And it is Him that we serve exclusively.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:140: Or do you claim that Abraham and Ishmael, Isaac and Jacob and the descendants (of Jacob) were “Jews” or “Christians?” Say: “Who has greater knowledge, you or Allah?” Who does greater wrong than he who conceals a testimony he has received from Allah? Allah is not heedless of the things you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:141: Now, they were a people who passed away. Theirs is what they earned, and yours is what you earn; you shall not be questioned concerning what they did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:142: The block-headed will say: “What has turned them away from the direction they formerly observed in Prayer?” Say: “To Allah belong the East and the West; He guides whomsoever He wills onto a Straight Way.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:143: And it is thus that We appointed you to be the community of the middle way so that you might be witnesses to all mankind and the Messenger might be a witness to you. We appointed the direction which you formerly observed so that We might distinguish those who follow the Messenger from those who turn on their heels. For it was indeed burdensome except for those whom Allah guided. And Allah will never leave your faith to waste. Allah is full of gentleness and mercy to mankind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:144: We see you oft turning your face towards the sky; now We are turning you to the direction that will satisfy you. Turn your face towards the Holy Mosque, and wherever you are, turn your faces towards it in Prayer.Those who have been granted the Scripture certainly know that this (injunction to change the direction of Prayer) is right and is from their Lord. Allah is not heedless of what they do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:145: And yet no matter what proofs you bring before the People of the Book they will not follow your direction of Prayer; nor will you follow their direction of Prayer. None is prepared to follow the other’s direction of Prayer. Were you to follow their desires in disregard of the knowledge which has come to you, you will surely be reckoned among the wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:146: Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize the place (towards which one must turn in Prayer) as fully as they recognize their own sons, this even though a group of them knowingly conceals the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:147: This is a definite Truth from your Lord; be not, then, among the doubters.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).2:148: Everyone has a direction towards which he turns; so excel one another in good works. Allah will bring you all together wherever you might be, for nothing is beyond His power.
