He has made every fruit in pairs, two and two, and He it is Who causes the night to cover the day. Surely there are signs in these for those who reflect.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:4: And on the earth there are many tracts of land neighbouring each other. There are on it vineyards, and sown fields, and date palms: some growing in clusters from one root, some standing alone. They are irrigated by the same water, and yet We make some excel others in taste. Surely there are signs in these for a people who use their reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:5: And were you to wonder, then wondrous indeed is the saying of those who say: "What! After we have been reduced to dust, shall we be created afresh?" They are the ones who disbelieved in their Lord; they are the ones who shall have shackles around their necks. They shall be the inmates of the Fire, wherein they will abide for ever.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:6: They challenge you to hasten the coming of evil upon them before the coming of any good, although people who followed a like course before had met with exemplary punishment (from Allah). Verily your Lord is forgiving to mankind despite all their wrong-doing. Verily your Lord is also severe in retribution.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:7: Those who refused to believe in you say: "Why has no (miraculous) sign been sent down upon him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and every people has its guide.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:8: Allah knows what every female bears; and what the wombs fall short of (in gestation), and what they may add. With Him everything is in a fixed measure.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:9: He knows both what is hidden and what is manifest. He is the Supreme One, the Most High.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:10: It is all the same for Him whether any of you says a thing secretly, or says it loudly, and whether one hides oneself in the darkness of night, or struts about in broad daylight.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:11: There are guardians over everyone, both before him and behind him, who guard him by Allah's command. Verily Allah does not change a people's condition unless they change their inner selves. And when Allah decides to make a people suffer punishment, no one can avert it. Nor can any be of help to such a people against Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:12: He it is Who causes you to see lightning that inspires you with both fear and hope, and He it is Who whips up heavy clouds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:13: The thunder celebrates His praise and holiness, and the angels, too, celebrate His praise for awe of Him. He hurls thunderbolts, striking with them whom He wills while they are engaged in disputation concerning Allah. He is Mighty in His contriving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:14: To Him alone should all prayer be addressed, for those to whom they do address their prayers beside Him are altogether powerless to respond to them. The example of praying to any other than Allah is that of a man who stretches out his hands to water, asking it to reach his mouth, although water has no power to reach his mouth. The prayers of the unbelievers are a sheer waste.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:15: All that is in the heavens and the earth prostrates itself, whether willingly or by force, before Allah; and so do their shadows in the morning and in the evening.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:16: Ask them: "Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?" Say: "Allah." Tell them: "Have you taken beside Him as your patrons those who do not have the power to benefit or to hurt even themselves?" Say: "Can the blind and the seeing be deemed equals? Or can light and darkness be deemed equals?" If that is not so, then have those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity ever created anything like what Allah did so that the question of creation has become dubious to them? Say: "Allah is the creator of everything. He is the One, the Irresistible."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:17: Allah sends down water from the heavens and the river-beds flow, each according to its measure, and the torrent carries along a swelling scum. In like manner, from that metal which they smelt in the fire to make ornaments and utensils, there arises scum like it. Thus does Allah depict truth and falsehood. As for the scum, it passes away as dross; but that which benefits mankind abides on the earth. Thus does Allah explain (the truth) through examples.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:18: There is good reward for those who respond to the call of their Lord. And those who do not respond to their Lord, (a time will come when) they shall offer all they have - even if they have all the riches of the world and the like of it besides to redeem themselves (from the chastisement of Allah). They will be subjected to a severe reckoning and Hell shall be their refuge. What a wretched resting place it is!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:19: He who knows that the Book which has been sent to you from your Lord is the Truth, is he like him who is blind to that truth? It is only people of understanding who take heed:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:20: those who fulfil their covenant with Allah and do not break their compact after firmly confirming it;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:21: who join together the ties which Allah has bidden to be joined; who fear their Lord and dread lest they are subjected to severe reckoning;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:22: who are steadfast in seeking the good pleasure of their Lord; who establish Prayer and spend both secretly and openly out of the wealth We have provided them, and who ward off evil with good. Theirs shall be the ultimate abode
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:23: - the Ever-lasting Gardens which they shall enter and so shall the righteous from among their fathers, and their spouses, and their offspring. And angels shall enter unto them from every gate, and say:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:24: "Peace be upon you. You merit this reward for your steadfastness." How excellent is the ultimate abode!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:25: As for those who break the covenant of Allah after firmly confirming it, who cut asunder the ties that Allah has commanded to be joined, and who create corruption in the land: Allah's curse shall be upon them and theirs shall be a wretched abode (in the Hereafter).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:26: Allah grants the provision to whomsoever He wills abundantly and grants others in strict measure. They exult in the life of the world, although compared with the Hereafter, the life of the world is no more than temporary enjoyment.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:27: Those who have rejected (the message of Muhammad) say: "Why has no sign been sent down upon him from his Lord?" Tell them: "Allah lets go astray those whom He wills, and guides to Himself those who turn to Him."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:28: Such are the ones who believe (in the message of the Prophet) and whose hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah. Surely in Allah's remembrance do hearts find rest.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:29: So those who believe (in the message of the Truth) and do good are destined for happiness and a blissful end.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:30: Thus have We sent you as a Messenger to a community before which many other communities have passed away that you may recite to them whatever We have revealed to you. And yet they deny the Lord of Mercy. Say to them: "He is my Lord, there is no god but Him. In Him I have placed all my trust and to Him I shall return."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:31: And what would have happened were a Qur'an to be revealed wherewith mountains could be set in motion, or the earth cleft, or the dead made to speak? (To show such signs is not at all difficult for) everything rests entirely with Allah. So, do not the people of faith (still look forward to such a sign in response to the demand of the unbelievers and) despair as a result of knowing that had Allah so willed, He could have guided all to the Truth. Misfortune continues to afflict the unbelievers on account of their misdeeds, or to befall on locations close to their habitation. This will continue until Allah's promise (of chastisement) is fulfilled. Indeed Allah does not go back upon His promise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:32: Surely the Messengers before you were ridiculed, but I always initially granted respite to those who disbelieved, and then I seized them (with chastisement). Then, how awesome was My chastisement!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:33: Is it, then, in regard to Him Who watches over the deeds of every person that they are acting blasphemously by setting up His associates? Tell them: "Name those associates (if Allah Himself has made them His associates)! Or are you informing Allah of something the existence of which He does not even know?" Or do people arbitrarily utter empty words? Indeed, their foul contriving has been made to seem fair to the unbelievers and they have been barred from finding the Right Way. Whomsoever Allah lets go astray will have none to guide him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:34: They shall suffer chastisement in the life of the world, and surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more grievous. None has the power to shield them from (the chastisement of) Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:35: And such will be the Paradise promised to the God-fearing: rivers will flow beneath it, its fruits will be eternal, and so will be its blissful shade. That is the ultimate destiny of the God-fearing while Fire is the destiny of the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:36: Those upon whom We bestowed the Scriptures earlier rejoice at the Book revealed to you, while there are also some among different groups that reject part of it. Tell them: "I have only been commanded to serve Allah and not to associate anyone with Him. To Him do I call, and to Him is my return."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:37: And it is with the same directive that We revealed to you this Arabic Writ. Were you indeed to follow the vain desires of people after the true knowledge has come to you, none will be your supporter against Allah, and none will have the power to shield you from His punishment.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:38: We indeed sent many Messengers before you and We gave them wives and children; and no Messenger had the power to produce a miraculous sign except by the command of Allah. Every age has its own (revealed) Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:39: Allah effaces whatever He wills and retains whatever He wills. With Him is the Mother of the Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:40: (O Prophet), whether We make you see a part of the punishment that We have threatened them with come to pass during your life-time, or We take you away before that happens, your duty is no more than to convey the Message, and it is for Us to make a reckoning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:41: Do they not see that We are advancing in the land, diminishing it by its borders on all sides? Allah judges, and no one has the power to reverse His judgement. He is swift in reckoning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:42: Those who lived before them also devised many a plot, but the master plot rests with Allah. He knows what everyone does. The deniers of the truth will soon come to know whose end is good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).13:43: The unbelievers claim that you have not been sent by Allah. Tell them: "Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you; and so also do those who know the Scriptures."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:1: Alif. Lam. Ra'. This is a Book which We have revealed to you that you may bring forth mankind from every kind of darkness into light, and direct them, with the leave of their Lord, to the Way of the Mighty, the Innately Praiseworthy,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:2: (to the Way of) Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Woe be to those who reject the Truth for a severe chastisement,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:3: to those who have chosen the life of the world in preference to the Hereafter, who hinder people from the Way of Allah, and seek to make it crooked. They have gone far astray.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:4: Never have We sent a Messenger but he has addressed his people in their language that he may fully expound his Message to them. (And after the Message is expounded), Allah lets go astray whomsoever He wills, and guides to the Right Way whomsoever He wills. He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:5: We indeed sent Moses with Our Signs, saying: "Lead your people out of all kinds of darkness into light, and admonish them by narrating to them anecdotes from the Days of Allah." Verily in it there are great Signs for everyone who is patient and gives thanks (to Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:6: And call to mind when Moses said to his people: "Remember Allah's favour upon you when He delivered you from Pharaoh's people who afflicted you with a grievous chastisement, slaughtering your sons, while letting your women live. In it there was a terrible trial from your Lord."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:7: Also call to mind when your Lord proclaimed: "If you give thanks, I will certainly grant you more; but if you are ungrateful for My favours, My chastisement is terrible.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:8: Moses said: "Were you to disbelieve - you and all those who live on earth - Allah is still Self-Sufficient, Innately Praiseworthy."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:9: Have the accounts of your predecessors not reached you: the people of Noah, the Ad, the Thamud, and those who came after them - they whose number is not known to any except Allah? Their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs, but they thrust their hands in their mouths, and said: "We do surely reject the Message you have brought, and we are in disquieting doubt about what you are summoning us to."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:10: Their Messengers said: "Can there be any doubt about Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He invites you that He may forgive you your sins and grant you respite till an appointed term." They replied: "You are only a human being like ourselves. You seek to prevent us from serving those whom our forefathers have been serving all along. If that is so, produce a clear authority for it."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:11: Their Messengers told them: "Indeed we are only human beings like yourselves, but Allah bestows His favour on those of His servants whom He wills. It does not lie in our power to produce any authority except by the leave of Allah. It is in Allah that the believers should put their trust.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:12: And why should we not put our trust in Allah when it is indeed He Who has guided us to the ways of our life? We shall surely continue to remain steadfast in face of your persecution. All those who have to put trust, should put their trust only in Allah."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:13: Then the unbelievers told their Messengers: "You will have to return to the fold of our faith or else we shall banish you from our land." Thereupon their Lord revealed to them: "We will most certainly destroy these wrong-doers,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:14: and will then cause you to settle in the land as their successors. That is the reward for him who fears to stand for reckoning and holds My threat in awe."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:15: They sought Our judgement. And (thanks to that judgement) every obstinate tyrant opposed to the Truth was brought to naught.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:16: Hell is before him and he shall be made to drink of the oozing pus,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:17: which he will gulp but will scarcely swallow, and death will come upon him from every quarter, and yet he will not be able to die. A terrible chastisement lies ahead in pursuit of him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:18: This is the example of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are like ashes upon which the wind blows fiercely on a tempestuous day. They shall find no reward for their deeds. That indeed is the farthest point in straying.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:19: Do you not see that Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth? Were He to will, He could take you away and bring a new creation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:20: That is not at all difficult for Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:21: Then all of them will appear exposed before Allah, and the weak ones will say to the haughty ones: "We merely followed you. Will you, then, protect us from Allah's chastisement?" They will say: "Had Allah shown us the Way to our salvation, we would surely have also guided you. Now it is all the same whether we cry or suffer patiently, we have no escape."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:22: After the matter has been finally decided Satan will say: "Surely whatever Allah promised you was true; as for me, I went back on the promise I made to you. I had no power over you except that I called you to my way and you responded to me. So, do not blame me but blame yourselves. Here, neither I can come to your rescue, nor can you come to mine. I disavow your former act of associating me in the past with Allah. A grievous chastisement inevitably lies ahead for such wrong-doers."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:23: As for those who had believed and did good in the world, they shall be admitted to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. There, with the leave of Allah, they shall abide forever, and will be greeted with: "Peace".
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:24: Do you not see how Allah has given the example of a good word? It is like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and whose branches reach the sky,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:25: ever yielding its fruit in every season with the leave of its Lord. Allah gives examples for mankind that they may take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:26: And the example of an evil word is that of an evil tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, wholly unable to endure.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:27: Thus, through a firm word, Allah grants firmness to the believers both in this world and in the Hereafter. As for the wrong-doers, Allah lets them go astray. Allah does whatever He wills.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:28: Did you not see those who have exchanged Allah's favour with ingratitude to Him, causing their people to be cast in the abode of utter perdition
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:29: Hell, wherein they shall roast? How wretched a place to settle in!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:30: They have set up rivals to Allah that they may lead people astray from His way. Tell them: "Enjoy for a while. You are doomed to end up in the Fire!"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:31: (O Prophet), tell those of My servants who believe that they should establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them with, both secretly and openly, before there arrives the Day when there will be no bargaining, nor any mutual befriending.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:32: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth, Who sent down water from the heaven and thereby brought forth a variety of fruits as your sustenance, Who subjected for you the ships that they may sail in the sea by His command, Who subjected for you the rivers,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:33: Who subjected for you the sun and the moon and both of them are constant on their courses, Who subjected for you the night and the day,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:34: and Who gave you all that you asked Him for. Were you to count the favours of Allah you shall never be able to encompass them. Verily man is highly unjust, exceedingly ungrateful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:35: And call to mind when Abraham prayed: "My Lord! Make this city secure, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping the idols.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:36: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. Now, if anyone follows my way, he is from me; and if anyone follows a way opposed to mine, then surely You are Ever-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:37: "Our Lord! I have made some of my offspring settle in a barren valley near Your Sacred House! Our Lord! I did so that they may establish Prayer. So make the hearts of people affectionately inclined to them, and provide them with fruits for their sustenance that they may give thanks.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:38: Our Lord! Surely You know all that we conceal and all that we reveal, and nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:39: All praise be to Allah Who, despite my old age, has given me Ishmael and Isaac. Surely my Lord hears all prayers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:40: My Lord! Enable me and my offspring to establish Prayer, and do accept, our Lord, this prayer of mine.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:41: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:42: Do not think Allah is heedless of the evil deeds in which the evil-doers are engaged. He is merely granting them respite until a Day when their eyes shall continue to stare in horror,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:43: when they shall keep pressing ahead in haste, their heads lifted up, their gaze directed forward, unable to look away from what they behold, their hearts utterly void.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:44: (O Muhammad), warn mankind of the Day when a severe chastisement shall overtake them, and the wrong-doers will say: "Our Lord, grant us respite for a short while; we shall respond to Your call and will follow Your Messengers." (But they will be clearly told): "Are you not the same who swore earlier that they shall never suffer decline?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:45: You said so even though you had lived in the dwellings of those who had wronged themselves (by sinning), and you were aware how We dealt with them, and We had even explained to you all this by giving examples.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:46: Indeed the unbelievers contrived their plan, but it is in Allah's power to nullify their plan, even though their plans were such that would move even mountains.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:47: So, do not think, (O Prophet), that Allah will go back upon His promise to His Messengers. Surely Allah is Mighty, Lord of retribution.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:48: (Do warn them of the) Day when the heavens and the earth shall be altogether changed; when all will appear fully exposed before Allah, the One, the Irresistible!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:49: On that Day you shall see the guilty ones secured in chains;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:50: their garments shall be black as if made out of pitch, and flames of the Fire shall cover their faces
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:51: so that Allah may requite each person for his deeds. Allah is swift in reckoning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).14:52: This is a proclamation for all mankind that they may be warned by it, and that they may know that their God is none but the One True God, and that men of understanding may take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:1: Alif. Lam. Ra'. These are the verses of the Book, and a Clear Qur'an.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:2: Soon will the time come when the unbelievers will wish they were Muslims.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:3: Leave them to eat and enjoy life and let false hopes amuse them. They will soon come to know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:4: Whenever We destroyed a town, a definite term had previously been decreed for it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:5: No people can outstrip the term for its destruction nor can it delay it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:6: They say: "O you to whom the Admonition has been revealed, you are surely crazed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:7: Why do you not bring down angels upon us if you are indeed truthful?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:8: We do not send down the angels (in frivolity); and when We do send them down, We do so with Truth; then people are granted no respite.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:9: As for the Admonition, indeed it is We Who have revealed it and it is indeed We Who are its guardians.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:10: (O Muhammad), certainly We did send Messengers before you among the nations which have gone by.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:11: And whenever a Messenger came to them, they never failed to mock him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:12: Even so We make a way for it (that is, the Admonition) in the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod);
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:13: they do not believe in it. This has been the wont of people of this kind from ancient times.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:14: If We were even to open for them a way to the heavens, and they could continually climb up to it in broad daylight,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:15: they would still have said: "Surely our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we have been enchanted."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:16: We have indeed set constellations in the heavens and have beautified them for the beholders,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:17: and have protected them against every accursed satan
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:18: save him who may eavesdrop, and then a bright flame pursues him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:19: As for the earth, We have stretched it out and have cast on it firm mountains, and have caused to grow in it everything well-measured.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:20: And We have provided sustenance for you on it and also for those of whom you are not the providers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:21: There is nothing except that its treasuries are with Us and We do not send it down except in a known measure.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:22: We send fertilizing winds, and then cause rain to descend from the sky, providing you abundant water to drink even though you could not have stored it up for yourselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:23: It is indeed We Who grant life and cause death and it is We who shall be the sole Inheritors of all.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:24: Surely We know those of you who have passed before and those who will come later.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:25: Indeed your Lord will gather them all together. Surely He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:26: Surely We brought man into being out of dry ringing clay which was wrought from black mud,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:27: while We had brought the jinn into being before out of blazing fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:28: Recall when your Lord said to the angels: "I will indeed bring into being a human being out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:29: When I have completed shaping him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall you down before him in prostration."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:30: So, the angels - all of them - fell down in prostration,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:31: except Iblis; he refused to join those who prostrated.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:32: The Lord inquired: "Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:33: He said: "It does not behove of me to prostrate myself before a human being whom You have created out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:34: The Lord said: "Then get out of here; you are rejected,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:35: and there shall be a curse upon you till the Day of Recompense."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:36: Iblis said: "My Lord! Grant me respite till the Day when they will be resurrected."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:37: Allah said: "For sure you are granted respite
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:38: until the day of a known time."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:39: Iblis said: "My Lord! In the manner You led me to error, I will make things on earth seem attractive to them and lead all of them to error,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:40: except those of Your servants whom You have singled out for Yourself."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:41: Allah said: "Here is the path that leads straight to Me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:42: Over My true servants you will be able to exercise no power, your power will be confined to the erring ones, those who choose to follow you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:43: Surely Hell is the promised place for all of them."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:44: There are seven gates in it, and to each gate a portion of them has been allotted.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:45: As for the God-fearing, they shall be amid gardens and springs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:46: They will be told: "Enter it in peace and security."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:47: And We shall purge their breasts of all traces of rancour; and they shall be seated on couches facing one another as brothers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:48: They shall face no fatigue in it, nor shall they ever be driven out of it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:49: (O Prophet), declare to My servants that I am indeed Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:50: At the same time, My chastisement is highly painful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:51: And tell them about Abraham's guests.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:52: When they came to Abraham they said: "Peace be upon you!" He replied: "Indeed we feel afraid of you."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:53: They said: "Do not feel afraid, for we give you the good news of a wise boy."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:54: Abraham said: "What, do you give me this tiding though old age has smitten me? Just consider what tiding do you give me!"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:55: They said: "The good tiding we give you is of truth. Do not, therefore, be of those who despair."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:56: Abraham said: "Who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except the misguided?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:57: He added: "What is your errand O sent ones?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:58: They said: "Verily we have been sent to a guilty people
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:59: excepting the household of Lot. We shall deliver all of them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:60: except his wife (about whom Allah says that) We have decreed that she shall be among those who stay behind."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:61: So when the envoys came to the household of Lot,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:62: he said: "Surely you are an unknown folk."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:63: They said: "Nay, we have brought to you that concerning which they have been in doubt.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:64: We truly tell you that we have brought to you the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:65: So set out with your family in a watch of the night, and keep yourself behind them, and no one of you may turn around, and keep going ahead as you have been commanded."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:66: And We communicated to him the decree that by the morning those people will be totally destroyed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:67: In the meantime the people of the city came to Lot rejoicing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:68: He said: "These are my guests, so do not disgrace me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:69: Have fear of Allah, and do not humiliate me."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:70: They replied: "Did we not forbid you again and again to extend hospitality to all and sundry?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:71: Lot exclaimed in exasperation: "If you are bent on doing something, then here are my daughters."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:72: By your life, (O Prophet), they went about blindly stumbling in their intoxication.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:73: Then the mighty Blast caught them at sunrise,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:74: and turned the land upside down, and rained down stones of baked clay.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:75: There are great Signs in this for those endowed with intelligence.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:76: The place (where this occurred) lies along a known route.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:77: Verily there is a Sign in this for the believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:78: And the people of Aykah were also wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:79: So We chastised them. The desolate locations of both communities lie on a well-known highway.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:80: Surely the people of al-Hijr also rejected the Messengers, calling them liars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:81: We also gave them Our Signs, yet they turned away from them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:82: They used to hew out houses from the mountains and lived in security.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:83: Then the Blast caught them in the morning
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:84: and whatever they had been earning proved of no avail.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:85: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them except with Truth. Surely the Hour will come. So, (O Muhammad), do graciously overlook them (despite their misdeeds).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:86: Your Lord is indeed the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:87: We have indeed bestowed on you the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Qur'an.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:88: Do not even cast your eyes towards the worldly goods We have granted to different kinds of people, nor grieve over the state they are in, but turn your loving attention to the believers instead,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:89: and clearly tell the unbelievers: "I am most certainly a plain warner,"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:90: even as We had sent warning to those who had divided their religion into fragments;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:91: those who had split up their Qur'an into pieces.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:92: By your Lord, We will question them all
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:93: concerning what they have been doing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:94: (O Prophet), proclaim what you are commanded, and pay no heed to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:95: Surely We suffice to deal with those who scoff at you,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:96: those who set up another deity alongside Allah. They shall soon come to know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:97: We certainly know that their statements sorely grieve you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:98: When (you feel so) glorify your Lord with His praise and prostrate yourself before Him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).15:99: and worship your Lord until the last moment (of your life) that will most certainly come.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:1: Allah's judgement has (all but) come; do not, then, call for its speedy advent. Holy is He, and far above their associating others with Him in His Divinity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:2: He sends down this spirit(of prophecy) by His command through His angels on any of His servants whom He wills, (directing them): "Warn people that there is no deity but Me; so hold Me alone in fear."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:3: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth. Exalted is He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:4: He created man out of a mere drop of fluid, and lo! he turned into an open wrangler.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:5: He created the cattle. They are a source of clothing and food and also a variety of other benefits for you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:6: And you find beauty in them as you drive them to pasture in the morning and as you drive them back home in the evening;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:7: and they carry your loads to many a place which you would be unable to reach without much hardship. Surely your Lord is Intensely Loving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:8: And He created horses and mules and asses for you to ride, and also for your adornment. And He creates many things (for you) that you do not even know about.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:9: It rests with Allah alone to show you the Right Way, even when there are many crooked ways. Had He so willed, He would have (perforce) guided you all aright.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:10: He it is Who sends down water for you from the sky out of which you drink and out of which grow the plants on which you pasture your cattle,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:11: and by virtue of which He causes crops and olives and date-palms and grapes and all kinds of fruit to grow for you. Surely in this there is a great Sign for those who reflect.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:12: He has subjected for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon and the stars have also been made subservient by His command. Surely there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:13: And there are also Signs for those who take heed in the numerous things of various colours that He has created for you on earth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:14: And He it is Who has subjected the sea that you may eat fresh fish from it and bring forth ornaments from it that you can wear. And you see ships ploughing their course through it so that you may go forth seeking His Bounty and be grateful to Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:15: And He has placed firm mountains on the earth lest it should move away from you, and has made rivers and tracks that you may find your way,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:16: and He has set other landmarks in the earth. And by the stars too do people find their way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:17: Is then the One Who creates like the one who does not create? Will you not, then, take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:18: For, were you to count the favours of Allah, you will not be able to count them. Surely Allah is Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:19: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you disclose.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:20: Those whom they call upon beside Allah have created nothing; rather, they themselves were created;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:21: they are dead, not living. They do not even know when they will be resurrected.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:22: Your God is the One God. But the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are steeped in rejection of the Truth, and they are given to arrogance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:23: Surely Allah knows all that they conceal and all that they disclose. He certainly does not love those who are steeped in arrogance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:24: When they are asked: "What is it that your Lord has revealed?" They answer: "They are merely tales of olden times!"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:25: (They say so) that they may bear the full weight of their burdens on the Day of Resurrection and also of the burdens of those whom they misled on account of their ignorance. What a heavy burden are they undertaking to bear!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:26: Surely many people before them had plotted in a similar manner to (vanquish the Truth), but Allah uprooted the whole structure of their plot from its foundations so that the roof fell in upon them, and the chastisement (of Allah) visited them from unknown directions.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:27: And again, on the Day of Resurrection, He will bring them to disgrace, and say: "Tell Me, now, where are those to whom you ascribed a share in My Divinity, and for whose sake you disputed (with the upholders of the Truth)?" Those who were endowed with knowledge (in the world) will say: "Surely today humiliation and misery shall be the lot of the unbelievers";
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:28: the same unbelievers who, when the angels seize them and cause them to die while they are engaged in wrong-doing, they will proffer their submission saying: "We were engaged in no evil." (The angels will answer them): "Surely Allah knows well all that you did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:29: Go now, and enter the gate of Hell, and abide in it for ever." Evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:30: And when the God-fearing are asked: "What has your Lord revealed?" they answer: "Something excellent!" Good fortune in this world awaits those who do good; and certainly the abode of the Hereafter is even better for them. How excellent is the abode of the God-fearing:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:31: everlasting gardens that they shall enter; the gardens beneath which rivers shall flow, and where they shall have whatever they desire! Thus does Allah reward the God-fearing,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:32: those whose souls the angels seize while they are in a state of purity, saying: "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise as a reward for your deeds."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:33: (O Muhammad), are they waiting for anything else than that the angels should appear before them, or that your Lord's judgement should come? Many before them acted with similar temerity. And then what happened with them was not Allah's wrong-doing; they rather wronged themselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:34: The evil consequences of their misdeeds overtook them and what they mocked at overwhelmed them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:35: Those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity say: "Were Allah to will so, neither we nor our forefathers would have worshipped any other than Him, nor would we have prohibited anything without His command." Their predecessors proffered similar excuses. Do the Messengers have any other duty but to plainly convey the Message?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:36: We raised a Messenger in every community (to tell them): "Serve Allah and shun the Evil One." Thereafter Allah guided some of them while others were overtaken by error. Go about the earth, then, and observe what was the end of those who rejected the Messengers, calling them liars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:37: (O Muhammad), howsoever eager you may be to show them the Right Way, Allah does not bestow His guidance on those whom He lets go astray; and in fact none will be able to help them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:38: They swear most solemnly in the name of Allah and say: "Allah shall not raise to life any who dies." (Yes, He will do so); that is a promise by which He is bound, even though most people do not know that.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:39: (That is bound to happen in order that) He may make clear to them the reality regarding the matters on which they differ and that the unbelievers may realize that they were liars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:40: (As for the possibility of resurrection, bear in mind that) whenever We do will something, We have to do no more than say: "Be", and it is.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:41: As for those who have forsaken their homes for the sake of Allah after enduring persecution, We shall certainly grant them a good abode in this world; and surely the reward of the Hereafter is much greater. If they could but know (what an excellent end awaits)
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:42: those who remain steadfast and put their trust in their Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:43: (O Muhammad), whenever We raised any Messengers before you, they were no other than human beings; (except that) to them We sent revelation. So ask those who possess knowledge if you do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:44: We raised the Messengers earlier with Clear Signs and Divine Books, and We have now sent down this Reminder upon you that you may elucidate to people the teaching that has been sent down for them, and that the people may themselves reflect.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:45: Do those who have been devising evil plans (against the mission of the Messenger) feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them up or that chastisement will not come upon them from a direction that they will not even be able to imagine;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:46: or that He will not suddenly seize them while they are going about to and fro and they will be unable to frustrate His design,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:47: or that He will not seize them when they are apprehensive of the impending calamity? Surely your Lord is Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:48: Do the people not see how the objects Allah has created cast their shadows right and left, prostrating themselves in utter submission to Allah?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:49: All living creatures and all angels in the heavens and on the earth are in prostration before Allah; and never do they behave in arrogant defiance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:50: They hold their Lord, Who is above them, in fear, and do as they are bidden.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:51: Allah has commanded: "Do not take two gods; for He is but One God. So fear Me alone."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:52: His is whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and obedience to Him inevitably pervades the whole universe. Will you, then, hold in awe any other than Allah?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:53: Every bounty that you enjoy is from Allah; and whenever any misfortune strikes you, it is to Him that you cry for the removal of your distress.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:54: But as soon as He removes the distress from you, some of you associate others with their Lord in giving thanks,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:55: that they may show ingratitude for the bounties We bestowed upon them. So enjoy yourselves for a while, soon you will come to know (the truth).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:56: They set apart for those, whose reality they do not even know, a portion of the sustenance We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be called to account for the lies that you have invented!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:57: They assign daughters to Allah - glory be to Him - whereas they assign to themselves what they truly desire!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:58: When any of them is told about the birth of a female his face turns dark, and he is filled with suppressed anger,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:59: and he hides himself from people because of the bad news, thinking: should he keep the child despite disgrace, or should he bury it in dust? How evil is their estimate of Allah!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:60: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter deserve to be characterized with evil attributes whereas Allah's are the most excellent attributes. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:61: Were Allah to take people to task for their wrong-doing, He would not have spared even a single living creature on the face of the earth. But He grants them respite until an appointed term. And when that term arrives, they have no power to delay it by a single moment, nor to hasten it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:62: They assign to Allah what they dislike for themselves and their tongues utter a sheer lie in stating that a happy state awaits them. Without doubt the Fire awaits them and it is to it that they shall be hastened.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:63: By Allah, (O Muhammad), We sent Messengers to other communities before you but Satan made their evil deeds attractive to them (so they paid no heed to the call of the Messengers). The same Satan is their patron today and they are heading towards a painful chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:64: We have sent down the Book that you may explain to them the truth concerning what they are disputing and that the Book may serve as a guidance and mercy for those who believe in it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:65: Allah sends down water from the heaven, and thereby He instantly revives the earth after it lay dead. Verily there is a sign in it for those who have ears.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:66: Surely there is a lesson for you in the cattle: We provide you to drink out of that which is in their bellies between the faeces and the blood - pure milk - which is a palatable drink for those who take it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:67: And out of the fruits of date-palms and grapes you derive intoxicants as well as wholesome sustenance. Surely there is a sign for those who use reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:68: Your Lord inspired the bee, saying: "Set up hives in the mountains and in the trees and in the trellises that people put up,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:69: then suck the juice of every kind of fruit and keep treading the ways of your Lord which have been made easy." There comes forth from their bellies a drink varied in colours, wherein there is healing for men. Verily there is a sign in this for those who reflect.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:70: Allah has created you, and then He causes you to die. Some of you have your lives prolonged to an abject old age, when one loses all knowledge after having acquired it. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:71: Allah has favoured some of you with more worldly provisions than others. Then those who are more favoured do not give away their provisions to their slaves lest they become equal sharers in it. Do they, then, deny the favour of Allah?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:72: And Allah has given you spouses from your kind, and has granted you through your spouses, sons and grandsons, and has provided you wholesome things as sustenance. (After knowing all this), do they still believe in falsehood and deny Allah's bounty,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:73: and worship instead of Allah, those helpless beings who have no control over providing them any sustenance from the heavens and the earth; do you worship those who have no power to do anything of this sort?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:74: So do not strike any similitudes to Allah. Allah knows whereas you do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:75: Allah sets forth a parable: There is one who is a slave and is owned by another and has no power over anything; and there is one whom We have granted good provision Ourselves, of which he spends both secretly and openly. Can they be equal? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not even know (this simple fact).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:76: Allah sets forth another parable: There are two men, one of whom is dumb and has no power over anything; he is a burden to his master, and wheresoever his master directs him, he fails to bring forth any good. Can such a person be the equal of one who enjoins justice and himself follows the Right Way?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:77: Allah has full knowledge of the truths beyond the reach of perception both in the heavens and the earth; and the coming of the Hour will take no more than the twinkling of an eye; it may take even less. Indeed Allah has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:78: Allah has brought you forth from your mothers' wombs when you knew nothing, and then gave you hearing, and sight and thinking hearts so that you may give thanks.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:79: Have they never noticed the birds how they are held under control in the middle of the sky, where none holds them (from falling) except Allah? Surely there are signs in this for those who believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:80: Allah has made your houses a repose, and has provided you with the skins of the cattle for your habitation which are light to handle both when you travel and when you camp; and out of their wool and their fur and their hair He has given you furnishings and goods for use over a period of time.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:81: And Allah has provided shade for you out of some of the things He has created; and He has provided you with shelters in the mountains, and has given you coats that protect you from heat as well as coats that protect you in battle. Thus does He complete His favour upon you that you may submit to Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:82: But if they turn away, your only duty is to clearly deliver the message of the truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:83: They are aware of the favours of Allah, and yet refuse to acknowledge them. Most of them are determined not to accept the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:84: (They are heedless of) the Day when We shall raise a witness from each community and then the unbelievers will neither be allowed to plead nor will they be asked to repent and seek pardon.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:85: Once the wrong-doers have beheld the chastisement, neither will it be lightened for them nor will they be granted any respite.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:86: And when those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity will see those to whom they ascribed this share, they will say: "Our Lord! These are the beings to whom we ascribed a share in Your Divinity and whom we called upon instead of You," whereupon those beings will fling at them the words: "You are liars."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:87: On that Day they will offer their submission and all that they had fabricated will have vanished.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:88: As for those who disbelieved and barred others from the way of Allah, We shall add further chastisement to their chastisement for all the mischief they did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:89: (O Muhammad), warn them of the coming of a Day when We shall bring forth a witness against them from each community and We shall bring you forth as a witness against them all; (and it is for that purpose that) We sent down the Book to you which makes everything clear, and serves as a guidance and mercy and glad tidings to those who have submitted to Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:90: Surely Allah enjoins justice, kindness and the doing of good to kith and kin, and forbids all that is shameful, evil and oppressive. He exhorts you so that you may be mindful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:91: And fulfil the covenant which you have made with Allah and do not break your oaths after having firmly made them, and after having made Allah your witness. Surely Allah knows all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:92: And do not become like the woman who, after having painstakingly spun her yarn, caused it to disintegrate into pieces. You resort to oaths as instruments of mutual deceit so that one people might take greater advantage than another although Allah puts you to the test through this. Surely on the Day of Resurrection He will make clear the Truth concerning the matters over which you differed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:93: Had Allah so willed, He would have made you all one single community. However, He lets go astray whomsoever He wills and shows the Right Way to whomsoever He wills. Surely you shall be called to account regarding what you did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:94: Do not make your oaths a means of deceiving one another or else your foot may slip after having been firm, and you may suffer evil consequences because of hindering people from the way of Allah. A mighty chastisement awaits you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:95: Do not barter away the covenant of Allah for a paltry gain. Verily that which is with Allah is far better for you, if you only knew.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:96: Whatever you have is bound to pass away and whatever is with Allah will last. And We shall surely grant those who have been patient their reward according to the best of what they did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:97: Whosoever acts righteously - whether a man or a woman - and embraces belief, We will surely grant him a good life; and will surely grant such persons their reward according to the best of their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:98: Whenever you read the Qur'an seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:99: Surely he has no power over those who have faith and who place their trust in their Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:100: He has power only over those who take him as their patron and who, under his influence, associate others with Allah in His Divinity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:101: Whenever We replace one verse by another verse - and Allah knows what He should reveal - they are wont to say: "You are nothing but a fabricator (who has invented the Qur'an)." The fact is that most of them are ignorant of the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:102: Tell them: "It is the spirit of holiness that has brought it down, by stages, from your Lord so that it might bring firmness to those who believe, and guidance to the Right Way, and give glad tidings of felicity and success to those who submit to Allah."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:103: Surely We know well that they say about you: "It is only a human being who teaches him," (notwithstanding) that he whom they maliciously hint at is of foreign tongue, while this (Qur'an) is plain Arabic speech.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:104: Surely Allah will not enable those who do not believe in the signs of Allah to be directed to the Right Way, and a painful chastisement awaits them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:105: (It is not the Prophet who invents lies), it is rather those who do not believe in the signs of Allah who invent lies. They are liars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:106: Except for those who were forced to engage in infidelity to Allah after believing the while their hearts remained firmly convinced of their belief, the ones whose hearts willingly embraced disbelief shall incur Allah's wrath and a mighty chastisement lies in store for them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:107: That is because they love the life of this world more than the Hereafter; and Allah does not guide those who are ungrateful to Allah for His favours.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:108: They are the ones upon whose hearts and hearing and eyes Allah has set a seal. They are utterly steeped in heedlessness.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:109: No doubt they shall be losers in the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:110: And surely your Lord will be Most Forgiving and Most Merciful towards those who left their homes after they were persecuted, and who thereafter struggled hard and remained constant.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:111: Allah's judgement will come about them all on the Day when everyone shall come pleading in his defence, and everyone shall be fully requited for his deeds and none shall be wronged in the least.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:112: Allah sets forth the parable of (the people of) a town who were secure and content and whose sustenance came in abundance from every quarter. But then the people of the town showed ingratitude towards Allah for His bounties, so Allah afflicted them with hunger and fear in punishment for their evil deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:113: Most certainly a Messenger came to them from among them; but they rejected him, calling him a liar. Therefore chastisement seized them while they engaged in wrong-doing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:114: So eat out of the lawful and good sustenance that Allah has bestowed upon you, and thank Allah for His bounty, if it is Him that you serve.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:115: Allah has forbidden you only carrion, and blood, and the flesh of swine; also any animal over which the name of any other than Allah has been pronounced. But whoever eats of them under compelling necessity - neither desiring it nor exceeding the limit of absolute necessity - surely for such action Allah is Much Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:116: And do not utter falsehoods by letting your tongues declare: "This is lawful" and "That is unlawful," thus fabricating lies against Allah. Surely those who fabricate lies against Allah will never prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:117: Brief is their enjoyment of the world, and thereafter they shall suffer a painful chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:118: We have already recounted to you what We prohibited to the Jews. In so doing We did not wrong them; it is they who wronged themselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:119: But to those who commit evil out of ignorance and then repent and amend their ways, thereafter your Lord will be Much Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:120: Indeed Abraham was a whole community by himself, obedient to Allah, exclusively devoted to Him. And he was never one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:121: He rendered thanks to Allah for His bounties so that Allah chose him (for His favours) and directed him to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:122: We bestowed good upon him in this world, and in the Hereafter he shall certainly be among the righteous.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:123: Then We revealed to you: "Follow the way of Abraham with exclusive devotion to Allah. He was not one of those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:124: As for the Sabbath, it was made incumbent only on those who differed about its laws. Certainly your Lord will judge on the Day of Resurrection between them regarding the matters they disputed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:125: (O Prophet), call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and goodly exhortation, and reason with them in the best manner possible. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed away from His path, and He also knows well those who are guided to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:126: If you take retribution, then do so in proportion to the wrong done to you. But if you can bear such conduct with patience, indeed that is best for the steadfast.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:127: And bear with patience, (O Muhammad) - and your patience is only because of the help of Allah - and do not grieve over them, nor feel distressed by their evil plans.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).16:128: For surely Allah is with those who hold Him in fear and do good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:1: Holy is He Who carried His servant by night from the Holy Mosque (in Makkah) to the farther Mosque (in Jerusalem) whose surroundings We have blessed that We might show him some of Our Signs. Indeed He alone is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:2: We gave Moses the Book, and made it a source of guidance for the Children of Israel, commanding: "Take no other Guardian beside Me."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:3: You are the descendants of those whom We carried (in the Ark) with Noah. He was truly a thankful servant.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:4: Then We clearly declared to the Children of Israel in the Book: "Twice you will make mischief in the land and will commit transgression."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:5: So, when the occasion for the first of the transgressions arrived, We raised against you some of Our creatures who were full of might, and they ran over the whole of your land. This was a promise that was bound to be fulfilled.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:6: Then We granted you an upper hand against them, and strengthened you with wealth and children, and multiplied your numbers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:7: Whenever you did good, it was to your own advantage; and whenever you committed evil, it was to your own disadvantage. So, when the time of the fulfilment of the second promise arrived, (We raised other enemies that would) disfigure your faces and enter the Temple (of Jerusalem) as they had entered the first time, and destroy whatever they could lay their hands on.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:8: Your Lord may well show Mercy to you, but if you revert to your evil behaviour, We shall revert to chastising you. We have made Hell a prison for those who are thankless of Allah's bounties.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:9: Verily this Qur'an guides to the Way that is the Straight most. To those who believe in it, and do righteous works, it gives the good news that a great reward awaits them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:10: and warns those who do not believe in the Hereafter that We have prepared for them a grievous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:11: Man prays for evil in the manner he ought to pray for good. Man is ever hasty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:12: We have made night and day as two signs. We made the sign of the night devoid of light, and made the sign of the day radiant that you may seek the bounty of your Lord and know the computation of years and numbers. Thus We have expounded everything in detail to keep everything distinct from the other.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:13: We have fastened every man's omen to his neck. On the Day of Resurrection We shall produce for him his scroll in the shape of a wide open book, (saying):
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:14: "Read your scroll; this Day you suffice to take account of yourself."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:15: He who follows the Right Way shall do so to his own advantage; and he who strays shall incur his own loss. No one shall bear another's burden. And never do We punish any people until We send a Messenger (to make the Truth distinct from falsehood).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:16: When We decide to destroy a town We command the affluent among them, whereupon they commit sins in it, then the decree (of chastisement) becomes due against them and thereafter We destroy that town utterly.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:17: Many a generation has been destroyed by Our command since Noah's time. Your Lord is well aware and fully observant of the sins of His servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:18: If anyone desires immediate benefits, We hasten to grant whatever benefits We will in the present life to whomsoever We please, but thereafter We decree for him Hell wherein he shall burn, condemned and rejected.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:19: But he who desires the Hereafter and strives for it in the manner he should, and is a true believer, his striving will come to fruition.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:20: To all of these as well as those We shall provide the wherewithal of this life in the present world by dint of your Lord's Bounty; and from none shall the Bounty of your Lord be withheld.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:21: See, how We have exalted some above others in this world, and in the Life to Come they will have higher ranks and greater degrees of excellence over others.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:22: Do not set up any other god with Allah lest you are rendered humiliated and helpless.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:23: Your Lord has decreed: (i) Do not worship any but Him; (ii) Be good to your parents; and should both or any one of them attain old age with you, do not say to them even "fie" neither chide them, but speak to them with respect,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:24: and be humble and tender to them and say: "Lord, show mercy to them as they nurtured me when I was small."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:25: Your Lord is best aware of what is in your hearts. If you are righteous, He will indeed forgive those who relent and revert (to serving Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:26: (iii) Give to the near of kin his due, and also to the needy and the wayfarer. (iv) Do not squander your wealth wastefully,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:27: for those who squander wastefully are Satan's brothers, and Satan is ever ungrateful to his Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:28: (v) And when you must turn away from them - (that is, from the destitute, the near of kin, the needy, and the wayfarer) - in pursuit of God's Mercy which you expect to receive, then speak to them kindly.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:29: (vi) Do not keep your hand fastened to your neck nor outspread it, altogether outspread, for you will be left sitting rebuked, destitute.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:30: Certainly Your Lord makes plentiful the provision of whomsoever He wills and straitens it for whomsoever He wills. He is well-aware and is fully observant of all that relates to His servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:31: (vii) Do not kill your children for fear of want. We will provide for them and for you. Surely killing them is a great sin.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:32: (viii) Do not even approach fornication for it is an outrageous act, and an evil way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:33: (ix) Do not kill any person whom Allah has forbidden to kill, except with right. We have granted the heir of him who has been wrongfully killed the authority to (claim retribution);so let him not exceed in slaying. He shall be helped.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:34: (x) And do not even go near the property of the orphan - except that it be in the best manner - till he attains his maturity. (xi) And fulfil the covenant, for you will be called to account regarding the covenant.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:35: (xii) Give full measure when you measure, and weigh with even scales. That is fair and better in consequence.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:36: (xiii) Do not follow that of which you have no knowledge. Surely the hearing, the sight, the heart - each of these shall be called to account.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:37: (xiv) Do not strut about in the land arrogantly. Surely you cannot cleave the earth, nor reach the heights of the mountains in stature.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:38: The wickedness of each of that is hateful to your Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:39: That is part of the wisdom your Lord has revealed to you. So do not set up any deity beside Allah lest you are cast into Hell, rebuked and deprived of every good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:40: What, has your Lord favoured you with sons and has taken for Himself daughters from among the angels? You are indeed uttering a monstrous lie.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:41: We have expounded (the Truth) in diverse ways in this Qur'an that they might take it to heart but all this only aggravates their aversion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:42: Say, (O Muhammad): "Had there been other gods with Him, as they claim, they would surely have attempted to find a way to the Lord of the Throne.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:43: Holy is He and far above all that they say.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:44: The seven heavens, the earth, and all that is within them give glory to Him. There is nothing but gives glory to Him with His praise, though you do not understand their hymns of praise. He is Most Forbearing, Exceedingly Forgiving."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:45: When you recite the Qur'an, We place a hidden barrier between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:46: and We place a covering on their hearts so that they do not comprehend it, and We cause a heaviness in their ears; and when you mention your Lord, the Only True Lord, in the Qur'an, they turn their backs in aversion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:47: We are well aware of what they wish to hear when they listen to you and what they say when they confer in whispers, when the wrong-doers say: "You are only following one who is bewitched."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:48: Just see how strange are the things they invent about you. They have altogether strayed, and are unable to find the right way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:49: They say: "When we are turned to bones and particles (of dust), shall we truly be raised up as a new creation?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:50: Tell them: "(You will be raised afresh even if) you turn to stone or iron,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:51: or any other form of creation you deem hardest of all (to recreate from)." They will certainly ask: "Who will bring us back (to life)?" Say: "He Who created you in the first instance." They will shake their heads at you and inquire: "When will that be?" Say: "Perhaps that time might have drawn near;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:52: on the Day when He will call you and you will rise praising Him in response to His call, and you will believe that you had lain in this state only for a while."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:53: Tell My servants, (O Muhammad), to say always that which is best. Verily it is Satan who sows discord among people. Satan indeed is an open enemy to mankind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:54: Your Lord knows you best. He will have mercy on you if He wills and chastise you if He wills. We have not sent you, (O Muhammad), as an overseer over them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:55: Your Lord knows all who dwell in the heavens and the earth. We have exalted some Prophets over others, and We gave the Psalms to David.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:56: Tell them: "Call upon those whom you fancy to be (your helpers) instead of Him! They have no power to remove any affliction from you, nor can they shift it (to any other)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:57: Those whom they call upon are themselves seeking the means of access to their Lord, each trying to be nearer to Him. They crave for His Mercy and dread His chastisement. Surely your Lord's punishment is to be feared.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:58: There is not a town but We shall destroy it or upon which We shall inflict severe chastisement before the Day of Resurrection. This is written down in the Eternal Book (of Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:59: Nothing hindered Us from sending Our Signs except that the people of olden times rejected them as lies. We publicly sent the she-camel to the Thamud to open their eyes but they wronged her. We never send Our Signs except to cause people to fear.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:60: And recall when We said to you, (O Muhammad), that your Lord encompasses these people; and that We have made that vision that We have shown you, and the tree accursed in the Qur'an, but as a trial for people. We go about warning them, but each warning leads them to greater transgression.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:61: And recall when We asked the angels to prostrate themselves before Adam; all prostrated themselves except Iblis, who said: "Shall I prostrate myself before him whom You created of clay?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:62: He then continued: "Look! This is he whom You have exalted above me! If you will grant me respite till the Day of Resurrection I shall uproot the whole of his progeny except only a few."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:63: Thereupon He retorted: "Be gone! Hell shall be the recompense - and a most ample one - of whosoever of them who follows you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:64: Tempt with your call all whom you wish. Muster against them all your forces - your cavalry and your foot soldiers; share with them riches and offspring, and seduce them with rosy promises - and Satan's promise is nothing but a deception -
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:65: but know well that you will have no power against My servants. Your Lord suffices for them to place their trust in."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:66: Your Lord is He Who steers your vessels across the seas that you may seek of His Bounty. He is ever Merciful towards you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:67: When a calamity befalls you on the sea, all those whom you invoke forsake you except Him. But when He delivers you safely to the shore you turn away from Him, for man is indeed most thankless.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:68: Do you, then, feel secure against His causing you to be swallowed up by a tract of the earth, or letting loose a deadly whirlwind charged with stones towards you, and there you will find none to protect you?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:69: Or do you feel secure that He will not cause you to revert to the sea, and let a tempest loose upon you and then drown you for your ingratitude whereupon you will find none even to inquire of Us what happened to you?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:70: Indeed, We honoured the progeny of Adam, and bore them across land and sea and provided them with good things for their sustenance, and exalted them above many of Our creatures.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:71: Then think of the Day We shall summon every community with its leader. Those who are given their Record in their right hand shall read the Record of their deeds and shall not be wronged a whit.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:72: Whoever lived in this world as blind shall live as blind in the Life to Come; rather, he will be even farther astray than if he were (just) blind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:73: (O Muhammad), they had all but tempted you away from what We have revealed to you that you may invent something else in Our Name. Had you done so, they would have taken you as their trusted friend.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:74: Indeed, had We not strengthened you, you might have inclined to them a little,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:75: whereupon We would have made you taste double (the chastisement) in the world and double (the chastisement) after death, and then you would have found none to help you against Us.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:76: They were bent upon uprooting you from this land and driving you away from it. But were they to succeed, they would not be able to remain after you more than a little while.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:77: This has been Our Way with the Messengers whom We sent before you. You will find no change in Our Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:78: Establish Prayer from the declining of the sun to the darkness of the night; and hold fast to the recitation of the Qur'an at dawn, for the recitation of the Qur'an at dawn is witnessed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:79: And rise from sleep during the night as well- this is an additional Prayer for you. Possibly your Lord will raise you to an honoured position.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:80: And pray: "My Lord! Cause me to enter wherever it be, with Truth, and cause me to exit, wherever it be, with Truth, and support me with authority from Yourself."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:81: And proclaim: "The Truth has come, and falsehood has vanished. Surely falsehood is ever bound to vanish."101
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).17:82: What We are sending down in the course of revealing the Qur'an is a healing and a grace for those who have faith; but it adds only to the ruin of the wrong-doers.
