A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:97: and the time for the fulfilment of the true promise of Allah draws near, whereupon the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in fear, and they will say: "Woe to us, we were indeed heedless of this; nay, we were wrongdoers."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:98: (They will be told): "Verily you and the gods you worshipped beside Allah are the fuel of Hell. All of you are bound to arrive there.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:99: Had these indeed been gods they would not have gone there. But (as it is), all of you shall ever abide in it."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:100: There they shall groan with anguish and the din and noise in Hell will not let them hear anything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:101: But for those whom We had decided to favour with good reward, they shall be kept far removed from Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:102: They shall not hear even a whisper of it, and they shall live for ever in the delights which they had desired.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:103: The Hour of the Great Terror shall not grieve them, and the angels shall receive them saying: "This is your Day which you had been promised."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:104: On that Day We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll for writing. Even as We originated the creation first so We shall repeat it. This is a promise binding on Us; and so We shall do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:105: Surely We wrote in the Psalms, after the exhortation, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:106: Herein, surely, is a message for those devoted to worship.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:107: We have sent you forth as nothing but mercy to people of the whole world.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:108: Say: "It is revealed to me that your God is only One God. Will you, then, submit to Him?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:109: If they turn away, say to them: "I have warned you all alike; and I cannot say whether what you have been promised is near or distant.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:110: Indeed He knows what you say loudly and what you hide.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:111: I think that this [reprieve] is possibly a trial for you, an opportunity to enjoy yourselves until an appointed time."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).21:112: The Messenger said: "My Lord! Judge with truth. Our Compassionate Lord alone is our support against your (blasphemous) utterances."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:1: O mankind, fear the (wrath of) your Lord! Indeed, the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgement) will be an awesome thing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:2: On the Day when you witness it, the suckling woman shall utterly neglect the infant she suckles, and every pregnant woman shall cast her burden, and you will see people as though they are drunk, when they are not drunk; but dreadful shall be Allah's chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:3: Among people there are some who wrangle about Allah without knowledge and follow every rebellious devil,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:4: although it is decreed about him that he shall lead into error whosoever takes him for a friend, and will direct him to the torment of the Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:5: O mankind! If you have any doubt concerning Resurrection, then know that it is surely We Who created you from dust, then from a drop of sperm, then from a clot of blood, then from a little lump of flesh, some of it shapely and other shapeless. (We are rehearsing this) that We may make the reality clear to you. We cause (the drop of sperm) that We please to remain in the wombs till an appointed time. We bring you forth as infants (and nurture you) that you may come of age. Among you is he that dies (at a young age) and he who is kept back to the most abject age so that after once having known, he reaches a stage when he knows nothing. You see the earth dry and barren and then no sooner than We send down water upon it, it begins to quiver and swell and brings forth every kind of beauteous vegetation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:6: All this is because Allah, He is the Truth, and because He resurrects the dead, and because He has power over everything,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:7: (all of which shows that) the Hour shall surely come to pass - in this there is no doubt - and Allah shall surely resurrect those that are in graves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:8: And among people are those that wrangle about Allah without knowledge, without any true guidance, and without any scripture to enlighten them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:9: They wrangle arrogantly, intent on leading people astray from the Way of Allah. Such shall suffer disgrace in this world and We shall cause them to taste the chastisement of burning (in the Next).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:10: That is the outcome of what your own hands have wrought, for Allah never wrongs His creatures.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:11: And among people is he who worships Allah on the borderline; if any good befalls him, he is satisfied; but if a trial afflicts him, he utterly turns away. He will incur the loss of this world and the Hereafter. That indeed is a clear loss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:12: He invokes, instead of Allah, those who can neither harm nor benefit him. That indeed is straying far away.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:13: He invokes those that are more likely to cause him harm than benefit. Such is surely an evil patron, and an evil associate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:14: (In contrast) Allah will assuredly cause those who believe and act righteously to enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. For, most certainly, Allah does whatever He pleases.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:15: Anyone who fancies that Allah will not support him in this world and in the Hereafter, let him reach out to heaven through a rope, and then make a hole in the sky and see whether his device can avert that which enrages him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:16: Even so We have revealed the Qur'an with Clear Signs. Verily Allah guides whomsoever He wills.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:17: On the Day of Resurrection Allah will most certainly judge among those who believe, and those who became Jews, and Sabaeans, and Christians, and Magians, and those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely Allah watches over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:18: Have you not seen that all those who are in the heavens and all those who are in the earth prostrate themselves before Allah; and so do the sun and the moon, and the stars and the mountains, and the trees, and the beasts, and so do many human beings, and even many of those who are condemned to chastisement? And he whom Allah humiliates, none can give him honour. Allah does whatever He wills.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:19: These two groups (the believers and unbelievers) are in dispute about their Lord. As for those that disbelieve, garments of fire have been cut out for them; boiling water shall be poured down over their heads,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:20: causing (not only) their skins but all that is in their bellies as well to melt away.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:21: There shall be maces of iron to lash them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:22: Whenever they try, in their anguish, to escape from Hell, they will be driven back into it, (and shall be told): "Now taste the torment of burning."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:23: (On the other hand), Allah will cause those who believed and acted righteously to enter the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall be decked in them with bracelets of gold and pearls and their raiment shall be of silk.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:24: They were guided (to accept) the pure word; they were guided to the Way of the Praiseworthy (Lord).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:25: Indeed those who disbelieve and who (now) hinder people from the Way of Allah and hinder them from the Holy Mosque which We have set up (as a place of worship) for all people, equally for those who dwell therein and for those who come from outside, (they surely deserve punishment). Whosoever deviates therein from the Right Way and acts with iniquity, We shall cause him to taste a painful chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:26: Call to mind when We assigned to Abraham the site of the House (Kabah), directing him: "Do not associate aught with Me" and "Keep My House pure for those who walk around it, and for those who stand and who bow down and who prostrate themselves (in worship),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:27: and publicly proclaim Pilgrimage for all mankind so that they come to you on foot and mounted on lean camels from every distant point
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:28: to witness the benefits in store for them, and pronounce the name of Allah during the appointed days over the cattle that He has provided them. So eat of it and feed the distressed and the needy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:29: Thereafter, let them tidy up and fulfil their vows and circumambulate the Ancient House."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:30: Such (was the purpose of building the Kabah). Whosoever, then, venerates Allah's sanctities will find it to be good for him in the sight of his Lord. Cattle have been made lawful for you except those mentioned to you (as unlawful). So shun the abomination of idols and shun all words of falsehood.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:31: Become exclusively devoted to Allah, ascribing Divinity to none other than Him. Whoso ascribes Divinity to aught beside Allah, it is as though he fell down from the sky whereafter either the birds will snatch him away, or the wind will sweep him to a distant place (causing him to be shattered to pieces).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:32: Such is the fact. And whoso venerates the sanctity of all that have been ordained as symbols of Allah surely does so because it is part of the true piety of the hearts.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:33: You may derive benefit (from sacrificial animals) until an appointed time. Thereafter their place (of sacrifice) is near the Ancient House.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:34: For every people We have laid down a ritual of sacrifice (- although the purpose of the ritual is the same -) that they pronounce the name of Allah over the cattle He has provided them. Your Lord is One God; so submit yourselves to Him alone. And give, (O Prophet), glad tidings to those that humble themselves (before Allah),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:35: whose hearts shiver whenever Allah is mentioned, who patiently bear whatever affliction comes to them, who establish Prayer, and who spend (for good purposes) out of what We have provided them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:36: We have appointed sacrificial camels among the symbols of (devotion to) Allah. There is much good in them for you. So make them stand (at the time of sacrifice) and pronounce the name of Allah over them, and when they fall down on their sides(after they are slaughtered), eat and also feed them who do not ask and those who ask. Thus have We subjected these animals that you may give thanks.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:37: Neither their flesh reaches Allah nor their blood; it is your piety that reaches Him. He has subjected these animals (to you) that you may magnify Allah for the guidance He has bestowed upon you. Give glad tidings, (O Prophet), to those who do good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:38: Surely Allah defends those who believe. Certainly Allah has no love for the perfidious, the thankless.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:39: Permission (to fight) has been granted to those for they have been wronged. Verily Allah has the power to help them:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:40: those who were unjustly expelled from their homes for no other reason than their saying: "Allah is Our Lord." If Allah were not to repel some through others, monasteries and churches and synagogues and mosques wherein the name of Allah is much mentioned, would certainly have been pulled down. Allah will most certainly help those who will help Him. Verily Allah is Immensely Strong, Overwhelmingly Mighty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:41: (Allah will certainly help) those who, were We to bestow authority on them in the land, will establish Prayers, render Zakah, enjoin good, and forbid evil. The end of all matters rests with Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:42: (O Prophet), if they give the lie to you, then before them the people of 'Ad and Thamud, also gave the lie (to the Prophets),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:43: and so too did the people of Abraham and the people of Lot;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:44: and so did the dwellers of Midian, and Moses too was branded a liar. Initially I granted respite to the unbelievers for a while and then seized them. How dreadful was My punishment!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:45: How many towns have We destroyed because their people were steeped in iniquity: so they lie fallen down upon their turrets! How many wells lie deserted; and how many towering palaces lie in ruins!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:46: Have they not journeyed in the land that their hearts might understand and their ears might listen? For indeed it is not the eyes that are blinded; it is rather the hearts in the breasts that are rendered blind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:47: They ask you to hasten the punishment. Allah shall most certainly not fail His promise; but a Day with your Lord is as a thousand years of your reckoning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:48: How many towns did I respite at first though they were steeped in iniquity, and then I seized them! To Me are all destined to return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:49: Say (O Muhammad): "O people! I have been sent to you only as a plain warner (before the Doom strikes you)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:50: So those who believe and act righteously shall be granted forgiveness and an honourable sustenance,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:51: whereas those who strive against Our Signs, seeking to profane them, they are the friends of the Fire!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:52: Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you (O Muhammad), but that whenever he had a desire, Satan interfered with that desire. Allah eradicates the interference of Satan and strengthens His Signs. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:53: (He does this) in order that He may make the evil caused by Satan a trial for those in whose hearts there is sickness (of hypocrisy), whose hearts are hard (and vitiated). Surely these wrong-doers have gone too far in their dissension.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:54: (He also does this) in order that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the Truth from your Lord and that they may have faith in it and their hearts may humble themselves before Him. Verily Allah always directs those that believe to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:55: The unbelievers will not cease to be in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly comes upon them, or the chastisement of an ominous day overtakes them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:56: On that Day all sovereignty shall be Allah's and He will judge among them. Then those who believed and acted righteously shall be in Gardens of Bliss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:57: A humiliating chastisement awaits those who disbelieved and denied Our Signs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:58: As for those who migrated in the way of Allah, whereafter they were slain, or died, Allah will certainly grant them a goodly provision. Indeed, Allah is the Best of all those who provide.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:59: He will surely admit them to a resort which will please them. Most certainly Allah is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:60: That indeed is so, as for him who retaliates in proportion to the excess committed against him, and is thereafter again subjected to transgression, Allah will surely aid him. Verily Allah is All-Pardoning, All-Forgiving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:61: So shall it be because it is Allah Who causes the night to emerge out of the day and causes the day to emerge out of the night and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:62: So shall it be because Allah, He is the Truth, and all whom they invoke instead of Him are false. Allah is Most High, All-Great.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:63: Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky whereby the earth turns green? Verily Allah is Subtle, All-Aware.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:64: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Surely Allah - He alone is Self- Sufficient, Praiseworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:65: Have you not seen how Allah has subjected to you all that is in the earth, and the vessels that sail in the sea by His command, and it is He Who holds back the sky that it may not fall on earth except by His leave? Surely Allah is Most Gentle, Ever Compassionate to people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:66: And it is He Who has endowed you with life and it is He who causes you to die, and it is He Who will then resurrect you. Man is indeed extremely prone to denying the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:67: For every people We have prescribed a way of worship which they follow. So, (O Muhammad), let them not dispute with you concerning this, and call them to Your Lord. You are certainly on the Straight Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:68: And if they dispute with you, say: "Allah knows well what you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:69: Allah will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection concerning matters about which you disagreed."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:70: Are you not aware that Allah knows all that is in the heaven and the earth? Surely it is all preserved in a Book. Indeed that is easy with Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:71: Instead of Allah they worship those concerning whom He has revealed no sanction and concerning whom they have no true knowledge. None shall be able to help such evil-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:72: When Our Signs are plainly recited to them, you will perceive utter repugnance on their faces and it all but seems as if they will soon pounce upon those who recite Our Signs to them. Say: "Shall I tell you what is worse than that? The Fire with which Allah has threatened those who disbelieve. That is truly an evil end."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:73: O people, a parable is set forth: pay heed to it. Those who call upon aught other than Allah shall never be able to create even a fly, even if all of them were to come together to do that. And if the fly were to snatch away anything from them, they would not be able to recover that from it. Powerless is the supplicant; and powerless is he to whom he supplicates.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:74: They have not formed a true estimate of Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:75: Allah chooses Messengers from among angels and from among human beings (to convey His command). Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:76: He knows all that is before them and that which is hidden from them. And it is to Allah that all affairs are returned.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:77: Believers, bow down and prostrate yourselves before Your Lord and serve Your Lord and do good that you may prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).22:78: Strive in the cause of Allah in a manner worthy of that striving. He has chosen you (for His task), and He has not laid upon you any hardship in religion. Keep to the faith of your father Abraham. Allah named you Muslims earlier and even in this (Book), that the Messenger may be a witness over you, and that you may be witnesses over all mankind. So establish Prayer, and pay Zakah, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector; what an excellent Helper!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:1: The believers have indeed attained true success:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:2: those who, in their Prayers, humble themselves;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:3: who avoid whatever is vain and frivolous;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:5: who strictly guard their private parts
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:6: save from their wives, or those whom their right hands possess; for with regard to them they are free from blame "
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:7: As for those who seek beyond that, they are transgressors"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:8: who are true to their trusts and their covenants,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:11: that shall inherit Paradise; and in it they shall abide for ever.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:12: We created man out of the extract of clay,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:13: then We made him into a drop of life-germ, then We placed it in a safe depository,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:14: then We made this drop into a clot, then We made the clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We caused it to grow into another creation. Thus Most Blessed is Allah, the Best of all those that create.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:15: Thereafter you are destined to die,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:16: and then on the Day of Resurrection you shall certainly be raised up.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:17: We have indeed fashioned above you seven paths. Never were We unaware of the task of creation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:18: We sent down water from the sky in right measure, and caused it to stay in the earth, and We have the power to cause it to vanish (in the manner We please).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:19: Then through water We caused gardens of date-palms and vines to grow for you wherein you have an abundance of delicious fruits and from them you derive your livelihood.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:20: And We also produced the tree which springs forth from Mount Sinai, containing oil and sauce for those that eat.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:21: And indeed there is also a lesson for you in cattle. We provide you with drink out of what they have in their bellies; and you have many other benefits in them: you eat of them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:22: and are carried on them and also on ships.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:23: We sent Noah to his people, and he said: "My people! Serve Allah; you have no deity other than He. Do you have no fear?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:24: But the notables among his people had refused to believe, and said: "This is none other than a mortal like yourselves who desires to attain superiority over you. Had Allah wanted (to send any Messengers) He would have sent down angels. We have heard nothing like this in the time of our forebears of old (that humans were sent as Messengers).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:25: He is a person who has been seized with a little madness; so wait for a while (perhaps he will improve)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:26: Noah said: "My Lord! Come to my help at their accusation that I am lying."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:27: Thereupon We revealed to him, saying: "Build the Ark under Our eyes and according to Our revelation. And when Our command comes to pass and the oven boils over, take on board a pair each from every species, and also take your household except those of them against whom sentence has already been passed and do not plead to Me on behalf of the wrong-doers. They are doomed to be drowned.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:28: And then when you and those accompanying you are firmly seated in the Ark, say: "Thanks be to Allah Who has delivered us from the wrong-doing people."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:29: And say: "My Lord! Make my landing a blessed landing, for You are the Best of those Who can cause people to land in safety."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:30: There are great Signs in this story; and surely We do put people to test.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:31: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:32: and We sent among them a Messenger from among themselves, saying: "Serve Allah; you have no god other than He. Do you have no fear?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:33: The notables among his people who had refused to believe and who denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and those whom We had endowed with ease and comfort in this life, cried out: "This is no other than a mortal like yourselves who eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:34: If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, you will certainly be losers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:35: Does he promise you that when you are dead and are reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth to life?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:36: Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are being promised.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:37: There is no other life than the life of the world. We shall live here and here shall we die; and we are not going to be raised again.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:38: This man has forged a mere lie in the name of Allah and we shall never believe what he says."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:39: The Messenger said: "My Lord! Come to my help at their accusing me of lying."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:40: He answered: "A short while, and they shall be repenting."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:41: Then a mighty blast quite justly overtook them, and We reduced them to a rubble. So away with the wrong-doing folk!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:42: Then, after them, We brought forth other generations.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:43: No nation can outstrip its term, nor can it put it back.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:44: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Whenever a Messenger came to his people they rejected him, calling him a liar. Thereupon, We made each people to follow the other (to its doom), reducing them to mere tales (of the past). Scourged be the people who do not believe!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:45: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our Signs and a clear authority
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:46: to Pharaoh and to his chiefs, but they behaved superciliously and they were haughty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:47: They said: "Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves when their people are slaves to us?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:48: So they rejected them, calling them liars, and they too eventually became of those that were destroyed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:49: And We gave Moses the Book that people might be guided by it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:50: And We made Mary's son, and his mother, a Sign, and We gave them refuge on a lofty ground, a peaceful site with springs flowing in it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:51: Messengers! Partake of the things that are clean, and act righteously. I know well all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:52: This community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord; so hold Me alone in fear.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:53: But people later cut up their religion into bits, each group rejoicing in what they have.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:54: So leave them immersed in their heedlessness till an appointed time.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:55: Do they fancy that Our continuing to give them wealth and children (means) that
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:56: We are busy lavishing on them all kinds of good? Nay, they do not perceive the reality of the matter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:57: Surely those who stand in awe for fear of their Lord,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:58: who have full faith in the Signs of their Lord;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:59: who associate none with their Lord in His Divinity,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:60: who give, whatever they give in charity, with their hearts trembling at the thought that they are destined to return to their Lord;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:61: it is these who hasten to do good works and vie in so doing with one another.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:62: We do not lay a burden on anyone beyond his capacity. We have a Book with Us that speaks the truth(about everyone); and they shall in no wise be wronged.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:63: Nay, their hearts are lost in ignorance of all this; and their deeds too vary from the way (mentioned above). They will persist in these deeds
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:64: until We seize with Our chastisement those of them that are given to luxuriant ways. They will then begin to groan.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:65: "Put a stop to your groaning now! Surely no help shall be provided to you from Us.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:66: My Signs were rehearsed to you and you turned back on your heels and took to flight,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:67: behaving arrogantly, and making fun, and talking nonsense (about the Book in your nightly chats)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:68: Did they never ponder over this Word (of God)? Or has he (to wit, the Messenger) brought something the like of which did not come to their forefathers of yore?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:69: Or is it that they were unaware of their Messenger and were therefore repelled by him for he was a stranger to them?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:70: Or do they say that there is madness in him? Nay, he has brought them the Truth and it is the Truth that most of them disdain.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:71: Were the Truth to follow their desires, the order of the heavens and the earth and those who dwell in them would have been ruined. Nay, the fact is that We have brought to them their own remembrance; and yet it is from their own remembrance that they are turning away.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:72: Are you asking them for something? What Allah has given you is the best. He is the Best of providers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:73: You are calling them to a Straight Way,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:74: but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are ever prone to deviate from the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:75: Were We to be merciful to them and remove from them their present afflictions, they would persist in their transgression, blindly wandering on.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:76: (They are such) that We seized them with chastisement (and yet) they did not humble themselves before their Lord, nor do they entreat
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:77: until We opened upon them the door of a severe chastisement. Then lo, in this state they become utterly despaired of any good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:78: It is He Who has endowed you with the faculties of hearing and sight and has given you hearts (to think). Scarcely do you give thanks.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:79: It is He Who has dispersed you all around the earth, and it is unto Him that you shall all be mustered.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:80: It is He Who gives life and causes death, and He holds mastery over the alternation of night and day. Do you not understand this?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:81: Nay, but they say the like of what their predecessors of yore had said.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:82: They say: "Is it that when we are dead and have been reduced to dust and bones, shall we then be raised up again?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:83: We were promised such things and so were our forefathers before us. All these are no more than tales of the past."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:84: Ask them: "Whose is the earth and those who are in it? Tell us if you know"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:85: They will surely say: "Allah's." Say: "Then why do you not take heed?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:86: Ask them: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, the Lord of the Great Throne?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:87: They will surely say: "Allah." Say: "Will you not, then, fear (Allah)?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:88: Ask them: "Say, if you indeed know, to whom belongs the dominion over all things; (Who is it) that grants asylum, but against Whom no asylum is available?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:89: They will surely say: "(The dominion over all things) belongs to Allah." Say: "Whence are you then deluded?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:90: We have brought before them the Truth, and there is no doubt that they are lying.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:91: Never did Allah take unto Himself any son, nor is there any god other than He. (Had there been any other gods) each god would have taken his creatures away with him, and each would have rushed to overpower the other. Glory be to Allah from all that they characterize Him with!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:92: He knows both what is visible and what is not visible. Exalted is Allah above all that they associate with Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:93: Pray, (O Muhammad): "My Lord, if You should bring the scourge of which they had been warned in my presence,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:94: then do not include me, my Lord, among these wrong-doing people."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:95: Surely We are able to show you what We warn them against.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:96: (O Muhammad)! Repel evil in the best manner. We are well aware of all that they say about you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:97: And pray: "My Lord! I seek Your refuge from the suggestions of the evil ones;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:98: I even seek Your refuge, my Lord, lest they should approach me."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:99: (They shall persist in their deeds) until when death comes to anyone of them he will say: "My Lord, send me back to the world
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:100: that I have left behind. I am likely to do good." Nay, it is merely a word that he is uttering. There is a barrier behind all of them (who are dead) until the Day when they will be raised up.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:101: And then no sooner the Trumpet is blown than there will remain no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask one another.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:102: It will be an Hour when those whose scales are heavy, they alone will attain success;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:103: and those whose scales are light, those will be the ones who will have courted loss. They will abide in Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:104: The Fire shall scorch their faces, exposing their jaws.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:105: "Are you not those to whom My revelations were recited, and you dubbed them as lies?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:106: They will say: "Our Lord! Our misfortune prevailed over us. We were indeed an erring people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:107: Our Lord! Take us out of this. Then if we revert (to evil-doing) we shall indeed be wrongdoers."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:108: Allah will say: "Away from Me; stay where you are and do not address Me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:109: You are those that when a party of My servants said: 'Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of those that are merciful,'
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:110: you made a laughingstock of them and your hostility to them caused you to forget Me, and you simply kept laughing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:111: Lo! I have rewarded them this Day for their steadfastness, so that they, and they alone, are triumphant."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:112: Then Allah will ask them: "For how many years did you stay on earth?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:113: They will say: "We stayed for a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count of this."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:114: He will say: "You stayed only for a while, if you only knew that.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:115: Did you imagine that We created you without any purpose, and that you will not be brought back to Us?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:116: So, exalted be Allah, the True King! There is no god but He, the Lord of the Great Throne.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:117: He who invokes any other god along with Allah " one for whom he has no evidence" his reckoning is with his Lord alone. Indeed, these unbelievers shall not prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).23:118: And say, (O Muhammad): "My Lord, forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of those that are merciful."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:1: This is a surah which We have revealed, and which We have made obligatory; We have revealed in it clear instructions so that you may take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:2: Those who fornicate - whether female or male - flog each one of them with a hundred lashes. And let not tenderness for them deter you from what pertains to Allah's religion, if you do truly believe in Allah and the Last Day; and let a party of believers witness their punishment.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:3: Let the fornicator not marry any except a fornicatress or idolatress and let the fornicatress not marry any except a fornicator or an idolater. That is forbidden to the believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:4: Those who accuse honourable women (of unchastity) but do not produce four witnesses, flog them with eighty lashes, and do not admit their testimony ever after. They are indeed transgressors,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:5: except those of them that repent thereafter and mend their behaviour. For surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Ever Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:6: As for those who accuse their wives (of unchastity), and have no witnesses except themselves: the testimony of such a one is that he testify, swearing by Allah four times, that he is truthful (in his accusation),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:7: and a fifth time, that the curse of Allah be on him if he be lying (in his accusation).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:8: And the punishment shall be averted from the woman if she were to testify, swearing by Allah four times that the man was lying,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:9: and a fifth time that the wrath of Allah be on her if the man be truthful (in his accusation).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:10: Were it not for Allah's Bounty and His Mercy unto you and that Allah is much prone to accept repentance and is Wise, (you would have landed yourselves into great difficulty on the question of unsubstantiated accusation of your spouses).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:11: Surely those who invented this calumny are a band from among you. Do not deem this incident an evil for you; nay, it is good for you. Every one of them has accumulated sin in proportion to his share in this guilt; and he who has the greater part of it shall suffer a mighty chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:12: When you heard of it, why did the believing men and women not think well of their own folk and say: "This is a manifest calumny?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:13: Why did they not bring four witnesses in support of their accusation? Now that they have brought no witnesses, it is indeed they who are liars in the sight of Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:14: Were it not for Allah's Bounty and His Mercy unto you in the world and in the Hereafter a grievous chastisement would have seized you on account of what you indulged in.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:15: (Just think, how wrong you were) when one tongue received it from another and you uttered with your mouths something you knew nothing about. You deemed it to be a trifle while in the sight of Allah it was a serious matter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:16: And why, no sooner than you had heard it, did you not say: "It becomes us not even to utter such a thing? Holy are You (O Allah)! This is a mighty calumny."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:17: Allah admonishes you: If you are true believers, never repeat the like of what you did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:18: Allah clearly expounds to you His instructions. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:19: Verily those who love that indecency should spread among the believers deserve a painful chastisement in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knows, but you do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:20: Were it not for Allah's Bounty and His Mercy unto you, and that Allah is Most Forgiving and Wise, (the evil that had been spread among you would have led to terrible consequences).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:21: Believers! Do not follow in Satan's footsteps. Let him who follows in Satan's footsteps (remember that) Satan bids people to indecency and evil. Were it not for Allah's Bounty and His Mercy unto you, not one of you would have ever attained purity. But Allah enables whomsoever He wills to attain purity. Allah is All- Hearing, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:22: Let those among you who are bounteous and resourceful not swear to withhold giving to the kindred, to the needy, and to those who have forsaken their homes in the cause of Allah; rather, let them forgive and forbear. Do you not wish that Allah should forgive you? Allah is Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:23: Those that accuse chaste, unwary, believing women, have been cursed in the world and the Hereafter, and a mighty chastisement awaits them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:24: (Let them not be heedless of) the Day when their own tongues, their hands, and their feet shall all bear witness against them as to what they have been doing.21a
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:25: On that Day Allah will justly requite them, and they will come to know that Allah - and He alone - is the Truth, the One Who makes the Truth manifest.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:26: Corrupt women are for corrupt men, and corrupt men for corrupt women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women. They are innocent of the calumnies people utter. There shall be forgiveness for them and a generous provision.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:27: Believers! Enter not houses other than your own houses until you have obtained the permission of the inmates of those houses and have greeted them with peace. This is better for you. It is expected that you will observe this.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:28: Then if you find no one in them, do not enter until you have been given permission (to enter). And if you are told to go back, then do go back. This is a purer way for you. Allah knows all what you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:29: However, it is not blameworthy for you if you enter houses that are uninhabited but wherein there is something of use to you. Allah is well aware of what you disclose and what you conceal.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:30: (O Prophet), enjoin believing men to cast down their looks and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Surely Allah is well aware of all what they do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:31: And enjoin believing women to cast down their looks and guard their private parts and not reveal their adornment except that which is revealed of itself, and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and not to reveal their adornment save to their husbands, or their fathers, or the fathers of their husbands, or of their own sons, or the sons of their husbands, or their brothers, or the sons of their brothers, or the sons of their sisters, or the women with whom they associate, or those that are in their bondage, or the male attendants in their service free of sexual interest, or boys that are yet unaware of illicit matters pertaining to women. Nor should they stamp their feet on the ground in such manner that their hidden ornament becomes revealed. Believers, turn together, all of you, to Allah in repentance that you may attain true success.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:32: Marry those of you that are single, (whether men or women), and those of your male and female slaves that are righteous. If they are poor, Allah will enrich them out of His Bounty. Allah is Immensely Resourceful, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:33: Let those who cannot afford to marry keep themselves chaste until Allah enriches them out of His Bounty. And write out a deed of manumission for such of your slaves that desire their freedom in lieu of payment - if you see any good in them - and give them out of the wealth that Allah has given you. And do not compel your slave-girls to prostitution for the sake of the benefits of worldly life the while they desire to remain chaste. And if anyone compels them to prostitution, Allah will be Most Pardoning, Much Merciful (to them) after their subjection to such compulsion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:34: Verily We have sent down for you revelations which clearly expound true guidance, and examples of those who passed away before you, and an admonition for those who fear (Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:35: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. His Light (in the Universe) may be likened to a niche wherein is a lamp, and the lamp is in the crystal which shines in star-like brilliance. It is lit from (the oil) of a blessed olive tree that is neither eastern nor western. Its oil well nigh glows forth (of itself) though no fire touched it: Light upon Light. Allah guides to His Light whom He wills. Allah sets forth parables to make people understand. Allah knows everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:36: (Those who are directed to this Light are found) in houses which Allah has allowed to be raised and wherein His name is to be remembered: in them people glorify Him in the morning and in the evening,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:37: people whom neither commerce nor striving after profit diverts them from remembering Allah, from establishing Prayer, and from paying Zakah; people who dread the Day on which all hearts will be overturned and eyes will be petrified;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:38: (people who do all this so) that Allah may reward them in accordance with the best that they did; indeed He will bestow upon them more out of His Bounty, for Allah grants whomsoever He wills beyond all measure.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:39: But for those who deny the Truth, their deeds are like a mirage in the desert, which the thirsty supposes to be water until he comes to it only to find that it was nothing; he found instead that Allah was with Him and He paid his account in full. Allah is swift in settling the account.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:40: Or its similitude is that of depths of darkness upon an abysmal sea, covered by a billow, above which is a billow, above which is cloud, creating darkness piled one upon another; when he puts forth his hand, he would scarcely see it. He to whom Allah assigns no light, he will have no light.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:41: Do you not see that all that is in the heavens and the earth, even the birds that go about spreading their wings in flight, extol His glory? Each knows the way of its prayer and of its extolling Allah's glory. Allah is well aware of whatever they do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:42: Allah's is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and to Him are all destined to return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:43: Do you not see that it is Allah Who gently drives the clouds, then He joins them together and then turns them into a thick mass and thereafter you see rain-drops fall down from its midst? And then He sends down hail from the heaven - thanks to the mountains - and causes it to smite whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of His lightning almost takes away the sight.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:44: It is Allah Who alternates the night and the day. Surely there is a lesson in it for those that have sight.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:45: Allah has created every animal from water. Of them some move on their bellies, some move on two legs and some on four. Allah creates whatever He wills. Surely Allah has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:46: Verily We have sent down revelations that clearly explain the Truth. Allah guides whomsoever He wills to a Straight Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:47: They say: "We believe in Allah and the Messenger, and we obey," but thereafter a faction of them turns away (from obedience). These indeed are not believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:48: When they are called to Allah and His Messenger that he (that is, the Messenger) may judge (the disputes) among them, a faction of them turns away.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:49: However if the right is on their side they come to him (professing) their submissiveness.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:50: Do their hearts suffer from the disease (of hypocrisy)? Or have they fallen prey to doubts? Or do they fear that Allah and His Messenger will wrong them? Nay, the truth is that they themselves are wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:51: When those that believe are called to Allah and His Messenger in order that he (that is, the Messenger) may judge their disputes among them, nothing becomes them but to say: "We hear and we obey." Such shall attain true success.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:52: Those who obey Allah and His Messenger and fear Him and avoid disobeying Him: such, indeed, shall triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:53: (The hypocrites) solemnly swear by Allah: "If you order us, we shall surely go forth (and fight in the cause of Allah)." Tell them: "Do not swear. The state of your obedience is known. Allah is well aware of all that you do."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:54: Say: "Obey Allah and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away, then (know well) that the Messenger is responsible for what he has been charged with and you are responsible for what you have been charged with. But if you obey him, you will be guided to the Right Way. The Messenger has no other responsibility but to clearly convey (the command)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:55: Allah has promised those of you who believe and do righteous deeds that He will surely bestow power on them in the land even as He bestowed power on those that preceded them, and that He will firmly establish their religion which He has been pleased to choose for them, and He will replace with security the state of fear that they are in. Let them serve Me and associate none with Me in My Divinity. Whoso thereafter engages in unbelief, such indeed are the ungodly.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:56: Establish Prayer and pay Zakah and obey the Messenger so that mercy may be shown to you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:57: Do not even imagine that those who disbelieve can render Allah powerless in the land. Their abode is the Fire; what an evil abode!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:58: Believers! At three times let those whom your right hands possess and those of your children who have not yet reached puberty ask leave of you before entering your quarters: before the Morning Prayer and when you take off your clothes at noon, and after the Night Prayer. These are the three times of privacy for you. If they come to you at other times then there is no sin for them nor for you, for you have to visit one another frequently. Thus does Allah clearly explain His directives to you. Allah is All- Knowing, All-Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:59: And when your children attain puberty let them ask leave to come to you like their elders used to ask leave. Thus does Allah clearly explain to you His Signs. He is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:60: The women who are past their youth (and can no longer bear children) and do not look forward to marriage will incur no sin if they cast off their outer garments without displaying their adornment. But if they remain modest, that is still better for them. Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:61: There is no blame on the blind nor any blame on the lame nor any blame on the sick nor on yourselves that you eat in your own houses, or your fathers' houses, or your mothers' houses, or your brothers' houses, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or in the houses of your mothers' brothers, or in the houses of your mothers' sisters or in the houses whose keys you possess, or the house of a friend. There is no blame if you eat together or separately. But when you enter such houses, greet each other with a salutation appointed by Allah, a salutation that is blessed and good. Thus, does Allah expound His signs to you in order that you will act with understanding.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:62: The true believers are only those who sincerely believe in Allah and in His Messenger and who, whenever they are with him on some common errand, they do not go away until they have asked leave of him. Verily those who ask leave of you, it is they who truly believe in Allah and His Messenger. So if they ask your leave in connection with some of their affairs, give leave to those whom you will, and ask Allah for forgiveness on their behalf. Surely Allah is Much Forgiving, Ever Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:63: (Muslims!) Do not make the calling of the Messenger among you as your calling one another. Allah knows well those of you who surreptitiously steal away, taking shelter behind one another. Let those who go against the order (of the Messenger) beware lest a trial or severe punishment afflict them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).24:64: Lo! Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He is well aware of your ways. And the Day when they will be returned to Him, He will tell them all what they did. Allah knows everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:1: Most blessed is He Who sent down this Criterion on His servant, to be a warner to all mankind;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:2: He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; Who has taken to Himself no son nor has He taken any partner in His kingdom; Who created everything and then determined its destiny.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:3: Yet people have taken, instead of Him, other deities; those that create nothing but are themselves created; who do not have the power to hurt or benefit even themselves; who have no power over death, nor over life, nor over the resurrection of the dead.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:4: Those who disbelieve in the Message of the Prophet say: "This (Criterion) is nothing but a lie which he has forged with the help of others." Such have indeed resorted to a grievous wrong and sheer falsehood.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:5: They say: "These are merely fairy tales of the ancients which he has got inscribed and they are then recited to him morning and evening."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:6: Say to them (O Muhammad): "It is He Who knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth Who has sent down this Book. Indeed, He is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:7: They say: "What sort of a Messenger is this: he eats food and walks about in the markets? Why was an angel not sent down to him so that he may remain with the Messenger and warn those that do not believe in him?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:8: Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him, or a garden whereof he might obtain his sustenance?" The evil-doers say: "You are simply following a bewitched man."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:9: See what specious arguments they put forth before you: they are so strayed that they will not find their way to anything sound.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:10: Most blessed is He Who, if He wills, can grant you even better than what they propose: Gardens beneath which rivers flow, and stately mansions.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:11: Nay, the truth is that it is the Hour  to which they give the lie.; We have kept a Blazing Fire ready for him who denies the Hour.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:12: When it sees them from a place afar, they will hear its raging and roaring,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:13: and when they are flung, chained together, into a narrow place in it, they will fervently call there for annihilation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:14: (They will then be told): "Do not call for a single annihilation, but for many an annihilation."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:15: Ask them: "Is this state better or the Garden of Eternity which the God-fearing have been promised?" It shall be their recompense and the end-point of their journey;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:16: the Garden wherein whatever they desire will be fulfilled. In it they shall abide for ever. This is a promise whose fulfilment Your Lord has made incumbent on Himself.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:17: On the Day when He will muster together all the unbelievers as well as the deities that they worship beside Allah, and He will ask them: "Was it you who caused these servants of Mine to stray away, or did they themselves stray away from the Right Path?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:18: They will say: "Glory be to You! It did not behove us to take any other than You as our guardians, but You lavished the pleasures of life upon them and their forefathers until they forgot the Admonition and became doomed to destruction."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:19: Thus will those deities give the lie to all what you now say, and you will not be able to avert your doom, nor obtain any succour. We shall cause whoever of you commits wrong to taste an enormous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:20: (O Muhammad), We never sent any Messengers before you but they ate food and walked about in the markets. We made some of you a means to test each by the other to see whether you remain patient. Your Lord is All-Seeing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:21: Those who do not look forward to meet Us say: "Why should angels not be sent to us, or why do we ourselves not observe our Lord?" Surely they are too proud of themselves and have gone beyond all limits in their rebellion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:22: On that Day - the Day when they will behold angels - there will be no good news for those immersed in evil, and they will cry out: "We seek refuge (in Allah)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:23: And We shall turn to their deeds and shall reduce them to scattered dust.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:24: On that Day it is the inmates of Paradise that will be graced with a better abode and a fairer resting place.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:25: On that Day the sky shall be rent asunder by a cloud and a whole cavalcade of angels will be made to descend.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:26: On that Day the true kingdom will belong only to the Merciful Lord. That will be a hard day for those that deny the Truth;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:27: a Day when the wrong-doer will bite his hands, saying: "Would that I had stood by the Messenger!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:28: Woe is me! Would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:29: He led me astray from the Admonition that had come to me. Satan proved to be a great betrayer of man."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:30: And the Messenger will say: "My Lord! My own people had made this Qur'an an object of laughter."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:31: (O Muhammad), thus did We make for every Prophet enemies from among those immersed in evil. Your Lord suffices you as a Guide and a Helper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:32: Those who disbelieve say: "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" It was revealed thus that We may fully impress it on your mind; (and for the same end) We have revealed it gradually (according to a scheme) in fragments.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:33: (This was also done so that) whenever they put any strange question to you, We sent its right answer and explained the matter in the best manner.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:34: Those who shall be mustered in the Hell upon their faces, their stand is the worst and their way most erroneous.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:35: Verily We granted Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron with him as his helper
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:36: and said to him: "Go the two of you to the people who have given the lie to Our Signs." Thereafter We utterly destroyed them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:37: (The same happened with) the people of Noah: when they gave the lie to the Messengers We drowned them and made of them a Sign of warning for all mankind. We have kept ready a painful chastisement for the wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:38: And in like manner were the 'Ad and the Thamud destroyed and the people of al-Rass and many a nation in the centuries in between.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:39: We warned each (of them) by examples (of the nations so destroyed in the past), and We totally annihilated each of them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:40: They have surely passed by the town which was rained upon by an evil rain. Have they not seen it? Nay; but they do not believe in being raised up after death.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:41: Whenever they see you they take you for nothing else but an object of jest, saying: "Is this whom Allah has sent as a Messenger?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:42: Had we not firmly persevered in our devotion to them (he had almost) led us astray from our gods." But soon, when they see the chastisement, they will come to know who had strayed too far from the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:43: Have you ever considered the case of him who has taken his carnal desire for his god? Can you take responsibility for guiding him to the Right Way?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:44: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? For they are merely like cattle; nay, even worse than them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:45: Have you not seen how your Lord spreads the shade? If He will, He could have made it stationary; instead, We have made the sun its pilot.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:46: So (as the sun rises), We gradually roll up that shade unto Us.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:47: It is Allah Who has made night a garment for you, and sleep the repose (of death), and has made day the time of rising to life.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:48: And He it is Who sends forth the winds as glad tidings, heralding His Mercy. Then We send down pure water from the sky
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:49: that We may revive through it a dead land and give it for drink to many cattle and human beings from among Our creation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:50: We present this wondrous phenomenon to them over and over again that they may learn a lesson from it. But most people simply decline everything except disbelief and ingratitude.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:51: Had We so willed, We would have raised up in every town a warner.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:52: So, (O Prophet), do not follow the unbelievers but engage in a mighty striving against them with this Qur'an.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:53: And He it is Who has joined the two seas: one sweet and palatable and the other saltish and bitter; and He has set a barrier and an insurmountable obstruction between the two that keeps them apart.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:54: And He it is Who has created man from water and then produced from him two sorts of kindred: by descent and by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:55: And yet people worship deities other than Allah that can neither benefit them nor hurt them. Besides, the unbeliever is ever prone to come to the support of everyone who rebels against his Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:56: We have not sent you, (O Muhammad), except as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:57: Say to them: "I ask of you no reward for my work. My only reward is that whoever so wills may follow the way leading to His Lord."71a
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:58: (O Muhammad), put your trust in Him Who is Ever-Living, Who will never die, and glorify Him with His praise. He suffices as the Knower of the sins of His servants,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:59: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them in six days, and then ascended the Throne; the Merciful One. Ask concerning Him the one who knows.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:60: When they are told: "Prostrate yourselves before the Merciful One," they say: "What is the Merciful One? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whomsoever you command us to prostrate?" This even further increases their aversion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:61: Most blessed is He Who set a constellation in the heavens, and placed in it a great lamp and a shining moon.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:62: He it is Who has appointed night and day to succeed one another (as a Sign) for him who desires to take heed, or desires to be thankful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:63: The true servants of the Merciful One are those who walk on the earth gently and when the foolish ones address them, they simply say: "Peace to you";
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:64: who spend the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:65: who entreat: "Our Lord! Ward off from us the chastisement of Hell, for its chastisement is one that clings.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:66: Verily it is a wretched abode and restingplace."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:67: (The true servants of the Merciful One are) those who are neither extravagant nor niggardly in their spending but keep the golden mean between the two;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:68: who invoke no other deity along with Allah, nor take any life - which Allah has forbidden - save justly; who do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse - and whoso does that shall meet its penalty;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:69: his torment shall be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide in it in ignominy -
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:70: unless he repents and believes and does righteous works. For such, Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds. Allah is Ever Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:71: Whosoever repents and does good, he returns to Allah in the manner that he should.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:72: (The true servants of the Merciful One) are those who do not bear witness to any falsehood and who, when they pass by frivolity, pass by it with dignity;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:73: who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, do not fall at them deaf and blind;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:74: who are prone to pray: "Our Lord! Grant us that our spouses and our offspring be a joy to our eyes, and do make us the leaders of the God-fearing."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:75: They are the ones who will be rewarded for their patience: lofty palaces  will be granted to them, and they will be received with greeting and salutation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:76: Therein they shall abide for ever: how good an abode, and how good a resting-place!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).25:77: Say to them (O Muhammad): "My Lord would not care for you were it not for your prayer. But now that you have given the lie to (the Message of Allah), an inextricable punishment shall soon come upon you."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:2: These are the verses of the Clear Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:3: (O Muhammad), you will perhaps grieve yourself to death because these people do not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:4: If We will, We can send down a Sign to them from heaven, so their necks will be humbled to it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:5: Never does there come to them an admonition from the Merciful Lord but they turn away from it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:6: They will soon come to know the truth of that which they have been scoffing at.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:7: Do they not look at the earth, how We caused a variety of fine vegetation to grow from it (in abundance)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:8: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:9: Verily Your Lord is Infinitely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:10: (Recount to them about the time) when Your Lord called Moses: "Go to the wrong-doing people,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:11: the people of Pharaoh: do they have no fear?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:12: He said: "My Lord! I fear that they will brand me a liar.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:13: My breast is constricted and my tongue is not fluent, so endow Messengership on Aaron.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:14: As for me, they hold the charge of a crime against me. I fear they will put me to death."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:15: He said: "Certainly not! So go both of you with Our Signs. We shall be with you listening to everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:16: Go, then, to Pharaoh and say to him: 'The Lord of the Universe has sent us
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:17: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.'"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:18: Pharaoh said: "Did we not bring you up among us when you were a child?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:19: You spent many years of your life among us and then you committed that deed of yours. You are very ungrateful indeed."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:20: Moses replied: "I committed that act erringly.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:21: Then I fled for fear of you. Then my Lord bestowed wisdom and authority on me and made me one of the Messengers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:22: Now this is the favour that you tauntingly remind me of: that you enslaved the Children of Israel!"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:23: Pharaoh said: "And who is this Lord of the Universe?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:24: Moses answered: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them, if you were only to believe."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:25: Pharaoh said to those around him: "Do you hear (what he says)?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:26: Moses said: "(He is) Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:27: Pharaoh said to the audience: "This Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is simply mad."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:28: Moses continued: "(He is) the Lord of the east and the west, and all between them. If you only had any understanding!"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:29: Pharaoh said: "If you take any god other than me, I will certainly make you one of those (who are rotting) in prison."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:30: Moses said: "Even if I were to bring a Clear Sign to you?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:31: Pharaoh said: "Then bring it if you are truthful at all."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:32: (No sooner had he said this than) Moses threw down his rod and behold, it was a veritable serpent,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:33: and he drew his hand (out of his armpit) and lo! it had become a shining object to the beholders.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:34: Pharaoh said to the nobles around him: "Surely this man is a skilled magician
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:35: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. Tell us, what do you advise us?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:36: They said: "Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:38: So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:39: and the people were told: "Will you join the assembly?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:40: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:41: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: "Is there a reward for us if we triumph?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:42: He said: "Yes, you will then become those near-stationed to me."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:43: Moses said to them: "Throw down whatever you wish to throw."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:44: Thereupon they threw down their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the glory of Pharaoh, we shall prevail."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:45: Thereafter, Moses threw down his rod and behold, it went about swallowing up all the false devices they had contrived.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:46: Thereupon the magicians fell down in prostration,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:47: saying: "We (now) believe in the Lord of the Universe,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:48: the Lord of Moses and Aaron."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:49: Pharaoh said: "You accepted the word of Moses even before I granted you the leave to do so. Surely he is your chief who has taught you magic. Soon shall you come to know. I shall cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and shall crucify all of you."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:50: They said: "We do not care, for we are bound to return to our Lord,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:51: and we surely expect that Our Lord will forgive us our sins for we are the first ones to believe."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:52: We revealed to Moses: "Set forth with My servants by night for you will be pursued."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:53: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities (to mobilise troops)
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:54: saying: "These (Israelites) are only a small band of people
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:55: who have certainly provoked our wrath.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:56: But we are a numerous host, ever on guard."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:57: Thus did We drive them out of their gardens and springs
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:58: and their treasures and excellent dwellings.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:59: This happened with them; (but on the other hand), We enabled the Children of Israel to inherit those bounties.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:60: At sunrise they set off in pursuit of them
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:61: and when the groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out: "We are overtaken!"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:62: Moses said: "Certainly not. My Lord is with me; He will direct me."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:63: Then We revealed to Moses, (commanding him): "Strike the sea with your rod." Thereupon the sea split up, and then each became like the mass of a huge mount.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:64: We also brought the other party close to the same spot,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:65: and We delivered Moses and his companions, all of them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:67: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:68: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:69: And recount to them the story of Abraham:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:70: when he asked his father and his people: "What do you worship?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:71: They answered: "There are some idols that we worship and are devoted to them with constancy."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:72: He asked: "Do they hear you when you call them
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:73: or do they cause you any benefit or harm?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:74: They answered: "No; but we found our forefathers doing so."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:75: Thereupon, Abraham said: "Have you seen (with your eyes) those whom you have been worshipping,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:76: you and your forefathers of yore?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:77: They are all enemies to me; all, except the Lord of the Universe
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:78: Who created me and Who guides me;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:79: Who gives me food and drink,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:80: and Who, when I am ill, heals me;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:81: Who will cause me to die and then will again restore me to life;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:82: Who, I hope, will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgement."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:83: (And then Abraham prayed): "My Lord, endow me with knowledge and wisdom and join me with the righteous,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:84: and grant me an honourable reputation among posterity,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:85: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:86: and forgive my father for he is among those who strayed,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:87: and disgrace me not on the Day when people will be raised to life,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:88: the Day when nothing will avail, neither wealth nor offspring,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:89: but only he that brings to Allah a sound heart will (attain to success)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:90: (On that Day)the Garden will be brought near to the God-fearing,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:91: and the Fire will be uncovered for those who strayed,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:92: and they will be asked: "Where are the gods that you worshipped
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:93: beside Allah? Can they be of any help to you, or even be of any help to themselves?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:94: Then the idols and those who strayed will be hurled into the Fire headlong, one upon another,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:95: and so too the hosts of Iblis, all of them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:96: There they will quarrel with one another and the erring ones will say (to their deities):
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:97: "By Allah, we were surely in clear error
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:98: when we assigned to you a position equal to that of the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:99: It is none but those steeped in guilt who led us into this error,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:100: and now we have none to intercede on our behalf,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:101: nor do we have a truly sincere friend.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:102: If only we could return we would be among the believers."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:103: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:104: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:105: The people of Noah gave the lie to the Messengers.
