A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:106: Recall when their brother Noah said to them: "Do you have no fear?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:107: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:108: so fear Allah and obey me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:109: I seek of you no reward for this: my reward is with none except the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:110: So fear Allah and obey me."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:111: They answered: "Shall we accept you even though it is the meanest of people who follow you?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:112: Noah said: "What knowledge do I have about their deeds?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:113: It is only for my Lord to take account of them. Would that you made use of your understanding!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:114: It is not for me to repel those who choose to believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:115: I am none but a plain warner."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:116: They said: "O Noah! If you do not desist, you will certainly become one of the accursed."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:117: He said: "My Lord! My people have branded me a liar.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:118: So pass a clear judgement between me and them and rescue me and the believers with me."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:119: Thereafter We rescued him and those who were with him in the laden Ark
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:121: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:122: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:123: The Ad gave the lie to the Messengers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:124: Recall, when their brother Hud said to them: "Have you no fear?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:125: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:126: So fear Allah and obey me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:127: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:128: What, you build a monument on every hill merely for fun
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:129: and erect huge palaces as though you will live for ever,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:130: and when you strike you strike like tyrants?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:131: So fear Allah and obey me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:132: Have fear of Him Who has provided you with all the (good) things you know;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:133: Who has provided you with flocks and children
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:135: I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:136: They replied: "It is all the same for us whether you admonish us or not.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:137: This has been happening all along.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:138: We will not be subjected to any chastisement."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:139: Eventually they gave the lie to him and We destroyed them. Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:140: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:141: The Thamud gave the lie to the Messengers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:142: Recall when their brother Salih said to them: "Have you no fear?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:143: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:144: So fear Allah and obey me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:145: I ask of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:146: Do you believe that you will be left here to live securely in the present state
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:148: and cornfields and date-palms laden with juicy fruits?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:149: You hew dwellings in mountains and exult in that.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:151: and do not follow the biddings of those that go to excesses
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:152: and spread mischief in the land rather than set things right."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:153: They replied: "You are nothing but one of those who are bewitched;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:154: you are no different from a mortal like us. So produce a sign if you are truthful."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:155: Salih said: "This is a she-camel. There is a day set for her to drink and there is a day set for you to drink.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:156: Do not molest her lest the chastisement of an Awesome Day should seize you."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:157: But they hamstrung her and then regretted it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:158: So the chastisement seized them. Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:159: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:160: The people of Lot rejected the Messengers, branding them liars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:161: Recall, when their brother Lot said to them: "Have you no fear?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:162: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:163: So fear Allah and obey me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:164: I seek of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:165: What, of all creation will you go to (fornicate with) the males,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:166: leaving aside those whom Allah has created for you as your mates. Nay, you are a people that has transgressed all limits."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:167: They said: "O Lot! If you do not desist, you will be one of those expelled (from our towns)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:168: He said: "I am one of those who abhor your practice.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:169: My Lord, deliver me and my family from their wicked deeds."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:170: Then We delivered him and all his family
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:171: except an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:172: Thereafter, We utterly destroyed the rest,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:173: and We sent upon them a rain, an evil rain that fell on those who had been warned.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:174: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:175: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:176: The people of Aykah also gave the lie to the Messengers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:177: Recall, when Shuayb said to them: "Have you no fear?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:178: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:179: So fear Allah and obey me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:180: I ask of you no reward for this. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:181: Fill up the measure and do not diminish the goods of people,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:183: and do not deliver short, and do not go about creating mischief in the land,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:184: and have fear of Him Who created you and the earlier generations."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:185: They said: "You are no more than one of those who have been bewitched,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:186: you are only a mortal like us. Indeed we believe that you are an utter liar.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:187: So cause a piece of the sky to fall upon us if you are truthful."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:188: Shuayb said: "My Lord knows well all what you do."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:189: Then they branded him a liar, whereupon the chastisement of the Day of Canopy overtook them. It was the chastisement of a very awesome day.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:190: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:191: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:192: Indeed this is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:193: which the truthful spirit has carried down
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:194: to your heart that you might become one of those who warn (others on behalf of Allah),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:196: (a revelation embodied) in the scriptures of the ancients.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:197: Is it not a Sign to them � (to wit, the Makkans) � that the learned men of the Children of Israel know that?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:198: (But such is their adamance) that had We revealed it to one of the non-Arabs and even if he had recited(this clear Arabic discourse) to them
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:199: they would still not have believed in it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:200: Thus have We caused this (Admonition) to penetrate the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:201: They will not believe in it until they clearly see the grievous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:202: But when it comes upon them suddenly, taking them unawares,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:203: they say: "Can we be granted some respite?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:204: Do they really want Our chastisement to be expedited?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:205: Did you consider that if We were to let them enjoy life for many years
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:206: and then the chastisement of which they were being warned were to come upon them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:207: of what avail will be the provisions of life which they have been granted to enjoy?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:208: We never destroyed any habitation but that it had warners
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:209: to admonish them. We have never been unjust.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:210: The satans did not bring down this (Clear Book),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:211: nor does it behove them, nor does it lie in their power.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:212: Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:213: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:215: and be meek to the believers who follow you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:216: Then if they disobey you say to them: "I am quit of what you do."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:217: And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:218: Who observes you when you rise (to pray)
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:219: and observes your movements among those who prostrate themselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:221: O people, shall I tell you on whom it is that satans descend?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:222: They descend on every forgerer steeped in sin,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:223: on those who whisper hearsay in the ears of people; and most of them are liars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:224: As for poets, only the wayward follow them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:225: Do you not see that they wander about in every valley
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:226: and say things which they do not act upon,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).26:227: except those who believed and acted righteously and remembered Allah much, and when they themselves were subjected to wrong, they exacted retribution no more than to the extent of the wrong? Soon will the wrong-doers know the end that they shall reach.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:1: Ta'. Sin. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a Clear Book;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:2: a guidance and good tidings for the believers
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:3: who establish Prayer and give Zakah, and have firm faith in the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:4: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds seem attractive to them so they stumble around in perplexity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:5: It is they for whom a grievous chastisement lies in store; it is they who shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:6: As for you, (O Muhammad), you are receiving the Qur'an from the Most Wise, the All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:7: (Recount to them) when Moses said to his family: "I perceive something like fire: soon will I bring to you some information from there, or I will bring you a burning brand that you may warm yourselves."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:8: But when Moses came to the fire, a call was sounded: "Blessed is He Who is in the fire and whatever is around it. Glory be to Allah, the Sustainer of all in the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:9: O Moses, verily this is Me, Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:10: Now cast your rod!" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent, he turned his back in retreat and did not even look behind. "O Moses, have no fear. Messengers have no fear in My presence,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:11: except he who has committed some wrong. But if he substitutes good in place of evil, I am Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:12: Now put your hand into your bosom, and it will come forth shining without any blemish. (These are two of the) nine Signs to be carried to Pharaoh and his people. They are surely a wicked people."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:13: But when Our Clear Signs came to them, they said: "This is plain magic."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:14: They denied those Signs out of iniquity and arrogance although their hearts were convinced of their truth. So see how evil was the end of those mischief-makers!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:15: (On the other hand), We granted knowledge to David and Solomon and they said: "All praise be to Allah Who has exalted us above many of His believing servants!"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:16: And Solomon succeeded David and said: "O people, we have been taught the speech of birds and we have been endowed with all kinds of things. Surely this is a conspicuous favour (from Allah)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:17: Hosts of jinn and humans and birds were marshalled for Solomon and were kept under full control.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:18: (Solomon was once on the move with them) until when they reached a valley of ants one of the ants said: "O ants, get into your holes, lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under their feet) without even knowing."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:19: Smiling at the ant's utterance, Solomon burst into laughter and said: "My Lord! Hold me under (Your) control that I may render thanks for the favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may act righteously in a manner that would please You. Include me, out of Your Mercy, among Your righteous servants."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:20: (On another occasion) Solomon inspected the birds and said: "Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Is he among the absentees?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:21: I will inflict a severe punishment on him or maybe even slaughter him unless he comes forth with a convincing reason (for his absence)."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:22: Not before long the hoopoe came up and said: "I have obtained a knowledge which you could not. I have brought for you sure news about Sheba.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:23: I found there a woman ruling over them, one who has been endowed with all things and has a mighty throne.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:24: I found that she and her people prostrate themselves before the sun rather than Allah." Satan has made their deeds appear attractive to them and has, thus, debarred them from the Right Path so they do not find true guidance
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:25: that they would prostrate themselves before Allah Who brings to light all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:26: Allah - none is worthy of worship save He; He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:27: Solomon said: "Soon shall we see whether you have spoken the truth or are one of those that lie.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:28: Take this letter of mine, deliver it to them, and then draw back from them, and observe what they do."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:29: The Queen said:" Know my nobles that a gracious letter has been delivered to me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:30: It is from Solomon, and it is: "In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:31: (It says): "Do not act towards me with defiance, but come to me in submission."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:32: (After reading the letter) the Queen said: "Nobles, let me have your counsel in this matter for I make no firm decision without you."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:33: They said: "We are strong and are given to vehement fighting. But the decision is yours. Therefore, consider what you would like to command."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:34: The Queen said: "When the kings enter a country they cause corruption in it and abase those of its people who are held in honour. This is what they are wont to do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:35: I will send them a gift and then see with what answer my envoys return."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:36: Now, when (the envoy of the Queen) came to Solomon, he said: "Do you want to aid me with wealth? Whatever Allah has granted me is much more than what He has given you. (Keep for yourselves) your gift in which you are exulting.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:37: Envoy, go back to those who sent you and we shall certainly come upon them with hosts whom they will be unable to resist. We shall drive them out from there, and they will suffer humiliation and disgrace."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:38: Solomon said: "My nobles, which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:39: A stalwart of the jinn said: "I will bring it to you before you rise from your council. Surely I have the power to do so and I am trustworthy."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:40: And he who had some knowledge of the Book said: "I will bring it before the twinkling of your eye." When Solomon saw the throne placed firmly beside him, he cried out: "This is by the grace of my Lord so that He may test me whether I give thanks for (His Bounty) or act with ingratitude. Whoever is grateful is so to his own good; and whoever is ungrateful, let him know that my Lord is Immensely Resourceful, Most Bountiful."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:41: Solomon said:" Set the throne before her casually, and let us see whether she gets to the Truth or is one of those who are not guided to what is right."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:42: When the Queen arrived, she was asked: "Is your throne like this one?" She said: "It seems as if it is the same. We had already come to know this and we had submitted ourselves."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:43: What prevented her (from accepting the True Faith) was her worshipping deities other than Allah, for she belonged to an unbelieving people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:44: She was told: "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a pool of water and she bared both her calves (to enter into it). Solomon said: "This is a slippery floor of crystal." Thereupon she cried out: "My Lord, I have been inflicting much wrong on myself. Now I submit myself with Solomon to Allah, the Lord of the whole Universe."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:45: And We sent to Thamud their brother Salih (with the Message): "Serve Allah," but all of a sudden they became split into two quarrelling factions.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:46: Salih said: "My people, why do you wish to hasten that evil rather than good should come upon you? Why should you not seek pardon from Allah so that mercy be shown to you?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:47: They said: "We augur ill of you and those who are with you." Salih replied: "Your augury is with Allah. The truth is that you are a people who are being tried."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:48: Now there were nine ring-leaders in the city who created corruption in the land and never worked to set things right.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:49: They said: "Swear to one another in the name of Allah that we shall make a sudden night swoop on Salih and his family and will then tell their heirs that we did not witness the destruction of his family. We are indeed truthful."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:50: Thus they planned and We too planned, the while they did not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:51: So see what was the outcome of the plan they made: We utterly destroyed them and their people, all of them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:52: Now behold their houses that lie in utter ruins because of their wrong-doing. Verily there is a Sign in this for the people who know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:53: And We delivered those who believed and were wont to avoid disobeying (Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:54: We also sent Lot, and recall when he told his people: "Do you commit shameless acts with your eyes open?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:55: Do you lustfully approach men instead of women? Nay, you engage in acts of sheer ignorance."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:56: But this had only one answer from his people. They said: "Expel Lot's folk from your city. They pretend to be absolutely clean."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:57: Eventually We saved (Lot) and his family, except his wife. We had decreed that she should be among those who would remain behind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:58: And We rained down upon them a rain. It was an evil rain for those who had already been warned.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:59: Say, (O Muhammad): "All praise be to Allah, and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen." (Ask them): "Who is better: Allah or the false gods that they associate with Him as His partners?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:60: Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky and then We caused to grow therewith orchards full of beauty whose trees you could never grow. Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)?" Nay, they are a people who are veering away from the Right Path.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:61: Who is it Who has made the earth a place of resort, and has caused rivers to flow in its midst, and has placed upon it firm mountains, and has placed a barrier between two masses of water? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Nay; but most of them do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:62: Who is it Who heeds the prayers of the distressed when he calls out to Him and Who removes his affliction? And who is it Who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? How little do you reflect!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:63: Who is it Who guides you through the darkness on land and sea? And Who sends winds as heralds of good tidings ahead of His Mercy? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate with Him in His Divinity!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:64: Who is it Who creates in the first instance and then repeats it? Who is it Who provides you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Say: "Bring forth your evidence, if you are truthful."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:65: Say: "None in the heavens or on the earth has knowledge of the Unseen save Allah. They do not know when they will be raised to life."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:66: Nay, but they have lost their knowledge of the Hereafter. They are steeped in doubt and uncertainty about it: rather they are blind to it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:67: The unbelievers say: "When we become dust, we and our forefathers, shall we really be brought out (from our graves)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:68: We were told about this and so were our forefathers before us. But these are no more than fairy tales that have been recounted from ancient times."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:69: Say: "Go about through the earth and see what has been the end of the evil-doers."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:70: (O Prophet), do not grieve over them, nor be distressed at their designs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:71: They also say: "Tell us when this threat will come to pass, if you are truthful."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:72: Say: "The chastisement whose hastening you have been asking for, maybe a part of it has drawn quite near to you."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:73: Indeed Your Lord is exceedingly bountiful to mankind. Yet most of them do not give thanks.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:74: Verily your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal as well as all that they reveal.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:75: There is nothing that is hidden - be it in the heaven or the earth - but is recorded in a Clear Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:76: Surely this Qur'an explains to the Children of Israel most of the matters concerning which they have disagreements
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:77: and it is a guidance and mercy for the believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:78: Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. He is All-Mighty, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:79: So put your trust in Allah for you are on the manifest truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:80: Surely you cannot make the dead hear you, nor can you make the deaf hear your call if they turn back in flight,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:81: nor can you direct the blind to the Right Way, preventing them from falling into error. You can make only those who believe in Our verses to hear the call and then submit.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:82: And when the time for the fulfilment of Our Word against them will come, We shall bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them because people did not believe in Our Signs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:83: Just imagine the Day when We shall muster from every nation a large group of those who gave the lie to Our Signs, and they shall be duly arranged in ranks
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:84: until, when all of them have arrived, Allah will say: "Did you give the lie to My Signs even without encompassing them with your knowledge? If that is not so, what did you do?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:85: And the Word will come to pass against them because of their wrong-doing: they will then be able to utter nothing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:86: Did they not perceive that We had made the night so that they may repose in it and made the day clear and shining. Surely there are Signs in this for those who believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:87: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown all those who are in the heavens and on the earth shall be terror stricken - all except those whom Allah wills - and everyone shall come to Him utterly abject.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:88: You now see the mountains and consider them firmly fixed, but then they shall pass away even as clouds pass away. That will be the handiwork of Allah Who has created everything with perfect wisdom. He is well aware of what you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:89: Whosoever comes with good will receive a reward better than his deed, and they will be made secure from the terror of that Day.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:90: And whosoever comes with evil, they will be flung upon their faces into the Fire. Will you be recompensed for aught other than what you do?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:91: (Tell them, O Muhammad): "I have been commanded only to serve the Lord of this city that He has made inviolable, to serve Him to Whom all things belong. I have been commanded to be of those that submit to Allah,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:92: and to recite the Qur'an." So, whosoever is guided, his guidance will be to his own good. As for those who stray, tell them: "I am none but a warner."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).27:93: And say: "All praise be to Allah, Who will soon show you His Signs that you will recognize." Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:2: These are the verses of the Clear Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:3: We recount to you with truth some parts of the story of Moses and Pharaoh for the benefit of those who believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:4: Indeed Pharaoh transgressed in the land and divided its people into sections. One group of them he humiliated, and slew their sons and spared their daughters. Truly he was among the mischief-makers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:5: We wanted to bestow favour on those who were oppressed in the land. We wanted to make them leaders and heirs
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:6: and to grant them power in the land, and make Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts see what they had feared.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:7: We suggested to the mother of Moses: "Suckle your child, but when you fear for his life cast him into the river and be not fearful nor grieve, for We shall restore him to you and make him one of the Messengers."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:8: Then Pharaoh's household picked him up (from the river) that he may be their adversary and be a cause of sorrow to them. Surely Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts erred (in their scheming).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:9: The wife of Pharaoh said: "Here is a delight of the eye to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will prove useful for us, or we may adopt him as a son." They were unaware of the end of it all.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:10: On the other hand, the heart of Moses' mother was sorely distressed. Had We not strengthened her heart that she might have full faith (in Our promise), she would have disclosed the secret.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:11: She told the sister of Moses: "Follow him." So she kept watch over him unperceived (by the enemies).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:12: And We had already forbidden the breasts of the nurses for the child. (So seeing the girl) said: "Shall I direct you to the people of a household that will rear him with utter sincerity?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:13: Thus did We restore Moses to his mother that her eyes might be comforted and she might not grieve, and realise that the promise of Allah was true. But most people are unaware of this.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:14: When Moses reached the age of full youth and grew to maturity, We bestowed upon him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward those who do good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:15: Once he entered the city at a time when its people were heedless, and he encountered two men fighting, one of whom belonged to his own people and the other to his foes. Now the man belonging to Moses' own people cried out to him for help against the man from the foes, and Moses struck him with his fist and finished him. Moses said: "This is an act of Satan. Surely he is an enemy who openly misleads."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:16: Then he prayed: "My Lord! I have indeed inflicted wrong on myself, so do forgive me," wherefore Allah forgave him for He is Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:17: Thereupon Moses vowed: "My Lord, because of the favour that You have done me I shall never support the guilty."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:18: The next morning he proceeded to the city in fear and looking around as one apprehensive of danger when all of a sudden, the man who had sought his help the day before again called out to him for his help. Moses said to him: "Clearly, you are a very misguided fellow."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:19: And when Moses decided to lay his violent hands on the man belonging to the enemy, he cried out: "Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed a person yesterday?" You simply want to live in the land as a tyrant, and do not wish to set things right."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:20: Then a man came running from the farther end of the city and said: "O Moses, the nobles are deliberating about you that they may put you to death. So do be gone. I am one of your well-wishers."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:21: Soon after hearing this Moses departed in a state of fear, looking around as one in apprehension and prayed: "My Lord, deliver me from these unjust people."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:22: When (after his departure from Egypt) Moses headed towards Midian, he said: "I hope my Lord will show me the right Path."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:23: When he arrived at the spring of Midian, he found there a crowd of people watering their flocks, and he found apart from them two women holding their flocks back. He asked the women: "What is it that troubles you?" They said: "We cannot water our flocks until the shepherds take their flocks away, and our father is a very old man."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:24: On hearing this Moses watered their flocks for them, and then returned in a shaded place and said: "My Lord, I am truly in great need of any good that You might send down to me."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:25: Soon thereafter one of the two women came to him, walking bashfully, and said: "My father invites you that he may reward you for your having watered our flocks for us." When Moses came to him and narrated to him the whole of his story, he said: "Have no fear. You are now safe from the iniquitous people."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:26: One of the two women said: "Father, employ this man in your service. The best whom you might employ is he who is strong and trustworthy."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:27: Her father said to Moses: "I want to marry one of these two daughters of mine to you if you serve me for eight years. But if you complete ten years, that will be of your own accord (but not an obligation). I do not intend to treat you harshly. If Allah wills, you will find me an upright man."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:28: Moses replied: "So that is agreed between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil, I trust that I shall not be wronged. Allah is a witness over the covenant we are committing ourselves to."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:29: When Moses had fulfilled the term and was journeying with his family, he perceived a fire in the direction of the Mount (Sinai). He said to his family: "Wait here; I have observed a fire. Maybe I will bring to you some news or a brand of fire from there that you may warm yourselves."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:30: But when he came to the fire, a cry was heard from the right bank of the valley, from a tree in the hallowed ground: "O Moses, verily I am Allah, the Lord of all creatures of the Universe."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:31: He received the command: "Throw away your rod!" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent, he turned back in retreat, and did not even look behind. (He was told): "O Moses, go ahead and have no fear. You are perfectly secure.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:32: Put your hand into your bosom, and it will come out shining without any blemish; and draw your hand close to your body to still your fear. Those are the two clear Signs from your Lord for Pharaoh and his chiefs, for truly they are a disobedient people."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:33: Moses said: "My Lord, I have killed one person from among them, and I fear that they will kill me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:34: My brother Aaron is more eloquent in speech than I: so send him with me as a helper to confirm my truthfulness for I fear that they will reject me as a liar."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:35: He said: "We will certainly strengthen you through your brother and will invest both of you with such power that they shall not be able to hurt you. With the help of Our Signs the two of you and your followers will prevail."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:36: But when Moses came to them with Our Clear Signs, they said: "This is nothing but a magic that has been contrived. We never heard anything like it from our ancestors of yore."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:37: Moses replied: "My Lord knows best who comes with guidance from Him, and also whose end will be the best in the Hereafter. As for the wrongdoers, they shall not prosper."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:38: Pharaoh said: "O nobles, I do not know that you have any god beside myself. Haman, bake bricks out of clay and build a lofty palace for me so that I may mount up and be able to observe the god of Moses, even though I believe that Moses is a liar."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:39: And he and his hosts waxed arrogant in the land without any right, believing that they will never have to return to Us!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:40: Eventually We seized him and his hosts and We flung them into the sea. So do see the end of the wrong-doers!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:41: And We made them leaders who invite people to the Fire. On the Day of Judgement they shall not find help from any quarter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:42: We have made a curse to pursue them in this world, and on the Day of Judgement they shall be among the despised.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:43: After We had destroyed the earlier generations We bestowed the Book on Moses - a source of enlightenment for people and a guidance and mercy - that they may take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:44: (O Muhammad), you were then not on the western side when We bestowed this commandment (of Law), and you were not among its witnesses.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:45: Thereafter We raised up many a generation and a long time passed. You were then not even present among the people of Midian to rehearse Our verses to them. But it is We Who are sending news about that.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:46: Nor were you on the side of the Mount (Sinai) when We called out to Moses (in the first instance). But it is out of Mercy from your Lord (that you are being informed of all this) so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you. Maybe they will take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:47: (We did so) lest a calamity might seize them because of the misdeeds they committed whereafter they would say: "Our Lord, why did you not send a Messenger to us that we follow Your revelation and become among those who believe?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:48: But when the Truth reached them from Us, they said: "Why was he not given that which was given to Moses?" But did they not reject before what had been given to Moses? They said: "Both are magic, each supporting the other!" And they said: "We deny each of these."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:49: Tell them, (O Prophet): "Then do bring a Book from Allah which is a better guide than either of them, and I will follow it! Do so if you are truthful!"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:50: But if they do not hearken to this, know well that they only follow their lusts and who is in greater error than he who follows his lusts without any guidance from Allah? Allah does not guide those given to wrong-doing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:51: We have constantly conveyed them the word (of admonition) that they may take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:52: Those on whom We bestowed the Book before do believe in this (to wit, the Qur'an).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:53: When it is recited to them they say: "We believe in it for it is the Truth from our Lord. Indeed we were already Muslims."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:54: These will be granted their reward twice over because they remained steadfast; they repel evil with good, and spend (in alms) out of the sustenance We provided them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:55: and when they hear any vain talk, they turn away from it, saying: "We have our deeds and you have your deeds. Peace be to you. We do not desire to act like the ignorant."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:56: (O Prophet), you cannot grant guidance to whom you please. It is Allah Who guides those whom He will. He knows best who are amenable to guidance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:57: They say: "If we were to follow this guidance with you, we should be snatched away from our land." Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary to which fruits of all kinds are brought as a provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:58: And how many a town did We destroy whose inhabitants exulted on account of their affluence. These are their dwellings in which very few dwelt after them. Eventually it is We Who inherited them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:59: Your Lord would not destroy a town until He had sent to its centre a Messenger who would recite to them Our verses. Nor would We destroy any town unless its inhabitants were iniquitous.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:60: Whatever you have been given is a provision for the life of this world and its glitter. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring. Do you not use your intellect?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:61: Now, he to whom We have promised a good which he is going to obtain � can he be like him whom We have given the good things of this life, but who will be brought up for punishment on the Day of Judgement?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:62: (Let them not forget) that the Day when Allah will call unto them, and say: "Where are those whom you imagined to be My associates?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:63: Those against whom the Word will be realised will say: "Our Lord, these are the ones whom we led astray just as we ourselves strayed. We absolve ourselves before You of all blame. It was not us that they worshipped."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:64: They will then be told: "Call upon those for help whom you declared to be Our associates." They will then call upon them but they will not answer them. They will have observed the chastisement in front of them. Would that they were guided!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:65: (Let them not disregard) that the Day when Allah will call out to them saying: "What was the answer you gave to the Messengers?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:66: Then they will not be able to think of any reply, nor will they be able to ask one another.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:67: But those who repented and believed and acted righteously, they will perhaps be among those who will prosper there.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:68: Your Lord creates what He will and chooses (for His tasks) whomsoever He will. It is not for them to make the choice. Glory be to Allah. He is exalted far above their associating others in His Divinity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:69: Your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal and all that they reveal.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:70: He is Allah; there is no god but He. His is the praise in this world and in the Hereafter. His is the command and to Him will all of you be returned.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:71: (O Prophet), tell them: "Did you consider: if Allah were to make the night perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement, is there a god other than Allah who can bring forth light for you? Do you not hear?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:72: Say: "Did you consider: if Allah were to make the day become perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement, is there a god other than Allah who can bring in night for you that you may repose in it? Will you not see?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:73: It is out of His Mercy that He has made for you night and day that you may repose (during the night) and seek His Bounty (during the day) that you might be grateful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:74: (Let them bear in mind) that on that Day when He will call out to them saying: "Where are My associates, those whom you imagined to be so?"
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:75: And from each people We shall draw a witness, and shall say to them: "Do produce your evidence now." Then they shall know that the Truth is with Allah alone, and the lies which they had invented will forsake them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:76: To be sure, Qarun (Korah) was one of Moses' people; then he transgressed against them. We had bestowed on him such treasure that their very keys would have been raised with difficulty by a whole group of strong people. Once when his people said to him: "Do not exult, for Allah does not love those who exult (in their riches).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:77: Seek by means of the wealth that Allah has granted you the Abode of the Hereafter, but forget not your share in this world and do good as Allah has been good to you and do not strive to create mischief in the land, for Allah loves not those who create mischief."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:78: He replied: "All this has been given to me on account of a certain knowledge that I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him those who were stronger in might than he and were more numerous in multitude? The wicked are not asked about their acts of sin.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:79: Once Korah went forth among his people in full glitter. Those seeking the life of this world said: "Would that we had the like of what Korah has! He truly has a great fortune."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:80: But those endowed with true knowledge said: "Woe to you. The reward of Allah is best for those who believe and act righteously. But none except those who are patient shall attain to this."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:81: At last We caused the earth to swallow him and his house. Thereafter there was no group of people that could come to his aid against Allah; nor was he able to come to his own aid.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:82: And those who had envied his position the day before began to say on the morrow: "Alas, we had forgotten that it is Allah Who increases the provision of those of His servants whom He will and grants in sparing measure to those whom He will. But for Allah's favour upon us, He could have made us to be swallowed too. Alas, we had forgotten that the unbelievers do not prosper."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:83: As for the Abode of the Hereafter, We shall assign it exclusively for those who do not seek glory on earth nor want to cause mischief. The God-fearing shall have the best end.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:84: He who shall bring a good deed shall be rewarded with what is better. But those who bring evil deeds shall not be requited more than their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:85: (O Prophet), surely He Who has ordained the Qur'an on you will bring you to the best end. Say to them: "My Lord knows best who has brought true guidance and who is in clear error."
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:86: (O Prophet), you never looked forward for the Book to be revealed to you. It is out of sheer Mercy of your Lord that it was (revealed to you). So do not lend any support to the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:87: And let it never happen that the unbelievers might turn you away from the revelations of Allah after they have been revealed to you. Call people to your Lord and never become one of the unbelievers,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).28:88: and do not invoke any god beside Allah. There is no god but He. All will perish but He. To Him belongs the command. And to Him shall all of you return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:2: Do people think that they will be let go merely by saying: “We believe,” and that they will not be tested,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:3: for We indeed tested those who went before them? Allah will most certainly ascertain those who spoke the truth and those who lied.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:4: Do the evil-doers suppose that they will get the better of Us? How evil is their judgement!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:5: Let him who looks forward to meeting Allah know that Allah's appointed term will surely come to pass. He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:6: Whosoever strives(in the cause of Allah) does so to his own good. Surely Allah stands in no need of anyone in the whole Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:7: Those who believe and do good deeds, We shall cleanse them of their evil deeds and reward them according to the best of their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:8: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents, but if they exert pressure on you to associate with Me in My Divinity any that you do not know (to be My associate), do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I shall let you know all that you have done.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:9: As for those who believed and acted righteously, We shall certainly admit them among the righteous.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:10: Among people there are some who say: “We believe in Allah.” But when such a person is made to endure suffering in Allah's cause, he reckons the persecution he suffers at the hands of people as though it is a chastisement from Allah. But if victory comes from your Lord, the same person will say “We were with you.” Does Allah not know whatever is in the hearts of the people of the world?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:11: Allah will surely ascertain who are the believers and who are the hypocrites.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:12: The unbelievers say to the believers: “Follow our way and we will carry the burden of your sins.” (They say so even though) they are not going to carry any part of their sins. Surely they are lying.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:13: They will certainly carry their own burdens and other burdens besides their own. They will assuredly be called to account on the Day of Resurrection concerning the fabrications which they contrived.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:14: We did indeed send Noah to his people and he lived among them a thousand years save fifty. Eventually the Flood overtook them while they were engaged in wrongdoing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:15: Then We rescued Noah together with the people in the Ark and made it (that is, the Ark) a lesson for all people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:16: We sent Abraham and he said to his people: “Serve Allah and fear Him.This is better for you if you only knew.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:17: Those that you worship instead of Allah are merely idols, and you are simply inventing lies (about them). Indeed those whom you worship beside Allah have no power to provide you with any sustenance. So seek your sustenance from Allah and serve only Him and give thanks to Him alone. It is to Him that you will be sent back.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:18: And if you give the lie (to the Messenger), then many nations before you also gave the lie (to their Messengers). The Messenger is charged with no other duty than to deliver the Message in clear terms.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:19: Have they never observed how Allah creates for the first time and then repeats it? Indeed (to repeat the creation of a thing) is even easier for Allah (than creating it for the first time).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:20: Say: “Go about the earth and see how He created for the first time, and then Allah will recreate life.” Surely, Allah has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:21: He chastises whom He will and forgives whom He will. To Him all of you will be sent back.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:22: You cannot overpower Allah, neither on the earth nor in the heaven. None can protect you from Allah nor come to your aid against Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:23: Those who disbelieved in Allah's signs and in meeting Him, it is they who have despaired of My Mercy; it is they for whom a painful chastisement lies ahead.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:24: The people (of Abraham) had no other answer than to say: “Kill him or burn him.” But Allah delivered him from the fire. There are many Signs in this for those who believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:25: He said: “You have taken up idols instead of Allah as a bond of love among yourselves in the present life, but on the Day of Resurrection you will disown and curse one another. Your refuge shall be the Fire, and none will come to your aid.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:26: Then did Lot believe him, and Abraham said: “I am emigrating unto my Lord. He is All-Powerful, All-Wise,”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:27: and We bestowed upon him (offspring like) Isaac and Jacob, and bestowed prophethood and the Book on his descendants and granted him his reward in this world; he will certainly be among the righteous in the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:28: We sent Lot and he said to his people: “You commit the abomination that none in the world ever committed before you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:29: What! Do you go to men (to satisfy your lust), engage in highway robbery, and commit evil deeds in your gatherings?” Then they had no answer to offer other than to say: “Bring Allah's chastisement upon us if you are truthful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:30: Lot said: “My Lord, aid me against these mischievous people.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:31: When Our emissaries brought the good news to Abraham, and said (to him): “We are surely going to destroy the inhabitants of this city; its inhabitants are immersed in wrong-doing.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:32: Abraham said: “But Lot is there.” They replied: “We are well aware of those who are there. We shall save him and all his household except his wife.” His wife is among those who will stay behind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:33: When Our emissaries came to Lot he was distressed and embarrassed on their account. They said: “Do not fear nor be distressed. We shall save you and all your household except your wife who is among those that will stay behind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:34: We shall bring down upon the people of this city a scourge from the heaven because of their evildoing.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:35: And We have left a vestige of it in that city as a Clear Sign for a people who use their reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:36: And We sent to Midian their brother Shuayb. He said: “My people, serve Allah and look forward to the Last Day and do not go about the earth committing mischief.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:37: But they denounced him as a liar. So a mighty earthquake overtook them, and by the morning they lay overturned in their houses.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:38: And We destroyed Ad and Thamud, whose dwellings you have observed. Satan had embellished their deeds for them and had turned them away from the Right Path although they were a people of clear perception.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:39: And We destroyed Qarun (Korah) and Pharaoh and Haman. Moses came to them with Clear Signs but they waxed arrogant in the land although they could not have outstripped (Us).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:40: So We seized each for their sin. We let loose upon some a violent tornado with showers of stones; some were overtaken by a mighty Cry; some were caused to be swallowed up by the earth, and some We drowned. Allah would not wrong them, but it is they who wronged themselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:41: The case of those who took others than Allah as their protectors is that of a spider who builds a house; but the frailest of all houses is the spider's house; if they only knew.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:42: Surely Allah knows fully what they call upon apart from Him. He is the Most Powerful, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:43: These are the parables that We set forth to make people understand. But only those endowed with knowledge will comprehend them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:44: Allah has created the heavens and the earth in Truth. Certainly there is a Sign in this for those who believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:45: (O Prophet), recite the Book that has been revealed to you and establish Prayer. Surely Prayer forbids indecency and evil. And Allah's remembrance is of even greater merit. Allah knows all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:46: Argue not with the People of the Book except in the fairest manner, unless it be those of them that are utterly unjust. Say to them: “We believe in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to you. One is our God and your God; and we are those who submit ourselves to Him.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:47: (O Prophet), thus have We bestowed the Book on you. So those on whom We had bestowed the Book before believe in it, and of these (Arabs) too a good many believe in it. It is none but the utter unbelievers who deny Our Signs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:48: (O Prophet), you did not recite any Book before, nor did you write it down with your hand; for then the votaries of falsehood would have had a cause for doubt.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:49: But it is a set of Clear Signs in the hearts of those who have been endowed with knowledge. None except the utterly unjust will deny Our Signs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:50: They say: “Why were Signs from his Lord not sent down upon him?” Say: “The Signs are only with Allah. As for me, I am no more than a plain warner.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:51: Does it not suffice for them (as a Sign) that We revealed to you the Book that is recited to them? Surely there is mercy and good counsel in it for those who believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:52: Say (O Prophet): “Allah suffices as a witness between me and you. He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth. As for those who believe in falsehood and are engaged in infidelity with Allah, it is they who will be the losers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:53: They ask you to hasten in bringing chastisement upon them. Had there not been an appointed term for it, the chastisement would have already visited them; in fact it will come down upon them all of a sudden (at its appointed time) while they will not be aware of it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:54: They ask you to hasten the chastisement upon them although Hell encompasses the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:55: (They will become aware of it) the Day when the chastisement will overwhelm them from above and from under their feet, and He will say to them: “Taste now the consequence of the deeds that you used to commit.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:56: O My servants who believe, verily My earth is vast; so serve Me alone.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:57: Every being shall taste death, then it is to Us that you shall be sent back.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:58: We shall house those who believed and acted righteously in the lofty mansions of Paradise beneath which rivers flow. There they shall remain for ever. How excellent a reward it is for those who acted (in obedience to Allah),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:59: who remained steadfast and put their trust in their Lord!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:60: How many an animal there is that does not carry about its sustenance. Allah provides sustenance to them and to you. He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:61: If you were to ask them: “Who created the heavens and the earth and Who has kept the sun and the moon in subjection?” they will certainly say: “Allah.” How come, then, they are being deluded from the Truth?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:62: Allah enlarges the sustenance of any of His servants whom He will, and straitens the sustenance of whom He will. Surely Allah has knowledge of everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:63: If you were to ask them: “Who sent down water from the sky and therewith revived the earth after its death?” they will certainly say: “Allah.” Say: “To Allah alone be praise and thanks.” But most people do not understand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:64: The present life is nothing but sport and amusement. The true life is in the Abode of the Hereafter; if only they knew.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:65: When they embark in the ships they call upon Allah, consecrating their faith to Him. But when He rescues them and brings them to land, they suddenly begin to associate others with Allah in His Divinity
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:66: that they may be ungrateful for the rescue that We granted them, and that they may revel in the pleasures (of the present life). Soon they shall come to know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:67: Do they not see that We have given them a sanctuary of safety whereas people around them are being snatched away? So, do they believe in falsehood and ungratefully deny Allah's bounties?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:68: Who can be more unjust than he who foists a lie on Allah or gives the lie to the Truth after it has come to him? Is Hell not the resort of the unbelievers?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).29:69: As for those who strive in Our cause, We shall surely guide them to Our Ways. Indeed Allah is with those who do good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:3: in the neighbouring land; but after their defeat they shall gain victory in a few years.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:4: All power belongs to Allah both before and after. On that day will the believers rejoice
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:5: at the victory granted by Allah. He grants victory to whomsoever He pleases. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:6: This is Allah's promise and He does not go back on His promise. But most people do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:7: People simply know the outward aspect of the worldly life but are utterly heedless of the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:8: Do they not reflect on themselves? Allah created the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them in Truth and for an appointed term. Yet many people deny that they will meet their Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:9: Have they not travelled through the earth that they may observe what was the end of their predecessors who were far mightier and tilled the land and built upon it more than these have ever built? And Allah's Messengers came to them with Clear Signs. It was not Allah Who wronged them, but it is they who wronged themselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:10: Evil was the end of those evil-doers, for they gave the lie to Allah's Signs and scoffed at them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:11: Allah creates in the first instance and will later repeat it. Thereafter it is to Him that you shall be sent back.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:12: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass, the criminals shall be dumbfounded.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:13: None whom they had associated with Allah in His Divinity will intercede on their behalf; rather, they will disown those whom they had set up as Allah's associates in His Divinity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:14: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass, people will be split into groups.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:15: Then those who believed and acted righteously will be placed in a Garden and will be happy and jubilant.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:16: As for those who disbelieved and gave the lie to Our Signs and to the encounter of the Hereafter, they will be arraigned for chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:17: So glorify Allah in the evening and the morning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:18: His is all praise in the heavens and in the earth; (and glorify Him) in the afternoon and when the sun begins to decline.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:19: He brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living, and revives the earth after it is dead. Likewise will you be raised to life (after you die).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:20: And of His Signs is that He created you from dust and behold, you became human beings, and are multiplying around (the earth).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:21: And of His Signs is that He has created mates for you from your own kind that you may find peace in them and He has set between you love and mercy. Surely there are Signs in this for those who reflect.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:22: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your tongues and colours. Indeed there are Signs in this for the wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:23: And of His Signs is your sleeping at night and your seeking His Bounty during the day. Indeed there are Signs in this for those who hearken.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:24: And of His Signs is that He shows you lightning, arousing both fear and hope, and sends down water from the sky and revives the earth after it is dead. Indeed there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:25: And of His Signs is that the sky and the earth stand firm by His command. Then no sooner than He summons you out of the earth you will come forth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:26: To Him belong all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth. All are in obedience to Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:27: It is He Who creates in the first instance and it is He Who will repeat the creation, and that is easier for Him. His is the loftiest attribute in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:28: He sets forth for you a parable from your own lives. Do you have among your slaves some who share with you the sustenance that We have bestowed on you so that you become equals in it, all being alike, and then you would hold them in fear as you fear each other? Thus do We make plain the Signs for those who use reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:29: But the wrong-doers follow their desires without any knowledge. Who, then, can show the way to him whom Allah lets go astray? Such shall have no helpers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:30: (O Prophet and his followers), turn your face singlemindedly to the true Faith and adhere to the true nature on which Allah has created human beings. The mould fashioned by Allah cannot be altered. That is the True, Straight Faith, although most people do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:31: (Adhere to the True Faith and) turn to Him, and hold Him in awe, and establish Prayer, and do not be of those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:32: those who have split up their religion and have become divided into sects, each party exulting in what they have.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:33: (Such are human beings) that when any misfortune befalls them, they cry to their Lord, penitently turning to Him. But no sooner that He lets them have a taste of His Mercy than some of them begin associating others with their Lord in His Divinity
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:34: so that they may show ingratitude to Us for the favours We had bestowed upon them. So, enjoy yourselves a while; but then you shall soon come to know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:35: Have We sent down any sanction which provides support to their associating others with Allah in His Divinity?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:36: When We make people have a taste of Our Mercy, they exult in it; and when any misfortune befalls them in consequence of their deeds, then lo and behold, they despair.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:37: Do they not see that Allah enlarges and straitens the sustenance of those whom He pleases? There are Signs in this for those who believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:38: So give his due to the near of kin, and to the needy, and to the wayfarer. That is better for those who desire to please Allah. It is they who will prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:39: Whatever you pay as interest so that it may increase the wealth of people does not increase in the sight of Allah. As for the Zakah that you give, seeking with it Allah's good pleasure, that is multiplied manifold.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:40: It is Allah Who created you, then bestowed upon you your sustenance, and He will cause you to die and then will bring you back to life. Can any of those whom you associate with Allah in His Divinity! do any such thing? Glory be to Him and exalted be He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:41: Evil has become rife on the land and at sea because of men's deeds; this in order that He may cause them to have a taste of some of their deeds; perhaps they will turn back (from evil).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:42: (O Prophet), say: “Traverse in the earth and see what was the end of those who went before you: most of them associated others with Allah in His Divinity.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:43: So turn your face exclusively towards the True Faith before there comes the Day whose coming from Allah cannot be averted, the Day when people will split into groups.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:44: He who disbelieves will suffer the consequence of it and he who acts righteously, they will pave the way for their own good
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:45: so that Allah may, out of His Bounty, reward those who believe and act righteously. Verily He does not love the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:46: And of His Signs is that He sends winds to herald good tidings and that He may give you a taste of His Mercy, and that ships may sail at His bidding, and you may seek His Bounty and give thanks to Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:47: We sent Messengers before you to their respective nations, and they brought Clear Signs to them. Then We took vengeance upon those who acted wickedly. It was incumbent on Us to come to the aid of the believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:48: Allah sends the winds that stir up clouds and then He spreads them in the sky as He pleases and splits them into different fragments, whereafter you see drops of rain pouring down from them. He then causes the rain to fall on whomsoever of His servants He pleases, and lo, they rejoice at it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:49: although before that they were given to despair.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:50: See, then, the tokens of Allah's Mercy: how He revives the earth after it is dead. Verily He is the One Who will revive the dead. He has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:51: But if We were to send a wind and then their tilth has become yellow, they would never cease to disbelieve.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:52: (O Prophet), you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear your call when they turn back in retreat,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:53: nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make none hear (your call) except those who believe in Our Signs and have surrendered themselves (to Him).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:54: It is Allah Who created you in a state of weakness; then after weakness He gave you strength, then after strength He made you weak and old. He creates what He pleases. He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:55: On that Day when the Hour will come to pass the wicked shall swear that they had stayed (in the world) no more than an hour. Thus they used to be deceived in the life of the world.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:56: But those who had been endowed with knowledge and faith shall say: “According to Allah's Record you have stayed till the Day of Resurrection. Now, this is the Day of Resurrection. But you did not know.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:57: So that will be the Day when the excuses of the wrong-doers will not avail them, nor will they be asked to make amends.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:58: In the Qur'an We have explained things to people in myriad ways. But no matter what Sign you bring to them, those who are resolved upon denying the Truth will say: “You are given to falsehood.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:59: Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who have no knowledge.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).30:60: Therefore, (O Prophet), have patience. Surely Allah's promise is true. Let those who lack certainty not cause you to be unsteady.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:2: These are the verses of the Wise Book,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:3: a guidance and mercy for the doers of good,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:4: who establish Prayer and pay Zakah, and have firm faith in the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:5: It is they who are on true guidance from their Lord, and it is they who shall prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:6: There are some human beings who purchase an enchanting diversion in order to lead people away from the way of Allah without having any knowledge, who hold the call to the Way of Allah to ridicule. A humiliating chastisement awaits them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:7: When Our verses are recited to such a person, he arrogantly turns away, as though he had not heard them, or as though there was a deafness in his ears. So announce to him the tidings of a grievous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:8: Surely those who believe and do good deeds shall have Gardens of Bliss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:9: They shall abide in them forever. This is Allah's promise that shall come true. He is the Most Powerful, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:10: He created the heavens without any pillars visible to you and He placed mountains in the earth as pegs lest it should turn topsy turvy with you, and He dispersed all kinds of animals over the earth, and sent down water from the sky causing all kinds of excellent plants to grow on it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:11: Such is Allah's creation. Show me, then, what any others, apart from Allah, have created. Nay, the fact is that the wrong-doers are in manifest error.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:12: We bestowed wisdom upon Luqman, (enjoining): “Give thanks to Allah.” Whoso gives thanks to Allah, does so to his own good. And whoso disbelieves (let him know that) Allah is All-Sufficient, Immensely Praiseworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:13: And call to mind when Luqman said to his son while exhorting him: “My son, do not associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely, associating others with Allah in His Divinity is a mighty wrong.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:14: We enjoined upon man to be dutiful to his parents. His mother bore him in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning lasted two years. (We, therefore, enjoined upon him): “Give thanks to Me and to your parents. To Me is your ultimate return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:15: But if they press you to associate others with Me in My Divinity, (to associate) those regarding whom you have no knowledge (that they are My associates), do not obey them. And yet treat them well in this world, and follow the way of him who turns to Me in devotion. Eventually it is to Me that all of you shall return, and I shall then tell you all that you did.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:16: (Luqman said): “Son, Allah will bring forth everything even if it be as small as the grain of a mustard seed even though it be hidden inside a rock or (anywhere) in the heavens or earth. Allah is Most Subtle, All-Aware.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:17: Son, establish Prayer, enjoin all that is good and forbid all that is evil, and endure with patience whatever affliction befalls you. Surely these have been emphatically enjoined.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:18: Do not (contemptuously) turn your face away from people, nor tread haughtily upon earth. Allah does not love the arrogant and the vainglorious.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:19: Be moderate in your stride and lower your voice. Verily the most disgusting of all voices is the braying of the donkey.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:20: Have you not seen that Allah has subjected to your service all that is in the heavens and on the earth and has abundantly bestowed upon you all His bounties, both visible and invisible? Yet some persons dispute regarding Allah without having any knowledge or guidance or any illuminating Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:21: When they are told: “Follow what Allah has revealed,” they say: “We will rather follow that which we have found our forefathers following.” (Will they follow that) even though Satan might invite them to the chastisement of the Blazing Fire?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:22: Whoever surrenders himself to Allah and lives righteously grasps the most firm handle. The ultimate decision of all matters rests with Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:23: So let the unbelief of the unbeliever not grieve you. To Us is their return and then We shall inform them of all that they did. Surely Allah knows well even the secrets that are hidden in the breasts (of people).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:24: We allow them to enjoy themselves a while in the world and then We shall drive them in utter helplessness to a harsh chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:25: If you were to ask them: “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they will certainly reply: “Allah.” Say: “All praise and thanks be to Allah.” Yet most of them do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:26: All that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. Verily He is All-Sufficient, Immensely Praiseworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:27: If all the trees on earth become pens, and the sea replenished by seven more seas were to supply them with ink, the Words of Allah would not be exhausted.Verily Allah is Most Mighty, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:28: To create all of you or to resurrect all of you is to Him like (creating or resurrecting) a single person. Verily Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:29: Do you not see that Allah makes the night phase into the day and makes the day phase into the night and has subjected the sun and the moon to His will so that each of them is pursuing its course till an appointed time? (Do you not know that) Allah is well aware of all that you do?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:30: All this is because Allah, He alone, is the Truth and all that which they call upon beside Him is false. Surely Allah, He alone, is All-High, Incomparably Great.
