A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:31: Do you not see that ships sail in the sea by Allah's Grace that He may show you some of His Signs? Surely there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast, thankful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:32: When waves engulf them (in the sea) like canopies, they call upon Allah, consecrating their faith solely to Him. But when He delivers them safely to the land, some of them become lukewarm. None denies Our Signs except the perfidious, the ungrateful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:33: O people, fear (the wrath) of your Lord, and dread the Day when no father will stand for his child, nor any child stand for his father. Surely Allah's promise is true. So let the life of this world not beguile you, nor let the Deluder delude you about Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).31:34: Surely Allah alone has the knowledge of the Hour. It is He Who sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs, although no person knows what he will earn tomorrow, nor does he know in which land he will die. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:2: This Book, beyond all doubt, was revealed by the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:3: Or do they say: “He has fabricated it?” Nay, it is the Truth from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you; perhaps they will be guided to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:4: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between the two, in six days, and then He established Himself on the Throne. You have no guardian or intercessor other than He. Will you, then, not take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:5: He governs from the heaven to the earth and then the record (of this governance) goes up to Him in a day whose measure is a thousand years in your reckoning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:6: He knows all that is beyond as well as all that is within a creature's sense-perception. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:7: He Who excelled in the creation of all that He created. He originated the creation of man from clay,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:8: then made his progeny from the extract of a mean fluid,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:9: then He duly proportioned him, and breathed into him of His spirit, and bestowed upon you ears and eyes and hearts. And yet, little thanks do you give.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:10: They say: “Shall we be created afresh after we have become lost in the earth?” Nay, the fact is that they deny that they will meet their Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:11: Tell them: “The angel of death who has been charged with your souls shall gather you, and then you shall be brought back to your Lord.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:12: Would that you could see the guilty standing before their Lord with their heads downcast, (saying to Him): “Our Lord, we have now seen and heard, so send us back (to the world) that we might act righteously. For now we have come to have firm faith.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:13: (They will be told): “If We had so willed, We could have bestowed guidance on every person. But the Word from Me that I will fill Hell with men and jinn, all together, has been fulfilled.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:14: So taste the chastisement on account of your forgetting the encounter of this Day. We, too, have forgotten you. Taste the eternal chastisement as a requital for your misdeeds.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:15: None believes in Our Signs except those who, when they are given good counsel through Our verses, fall down prostrate and celebrate the praise of their Lord and do not wax proud.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:16: Their sides forsake their beds, and they call upon their Lord in fear and hope, and expend (in charity) out of the sustenance We have granted them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:17: No one knows what delights of the eyes are kept hidden for them as a reward for their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:18: Would a true believer be like him who was an evil-doer? Surely they are not equal.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:19: As for those who believe and act righteously, theirs shall be Gardens to dwell in, a hospitality to reward them for their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:20: As for the evil-doers, their refuge shall be the Fire. Every time they want to escape from it they shall be driven back and shall be told: “Taste the chastisement of the Fire which you used to reject as a lie.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:21: We shall certainly have them taste some chastisement in this world in addition to the greater chastisement (of the Hereafter); perhaps they will retract (from their transgression).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:22: And who is more unjust than he who is given good counsel through the Signs of his Lord and yet he turns away from them? Surely We will exact full retribution from such criminals.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:23: Verily We bestowed the Book upon Moses. So entertain no doubt if (the Prophet Muhammad) received the same. We had made that Book a guidance for the Children of Israel,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:24: and when they remained steadfast and firmly believed in Our Signs, We created among them leaders who guided people by Our command.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:25: Surely your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection concerning the matters about which the Children of Israel used to differ.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:26: Did (these historical events) not make them realise that We destroyed many nations before them amidst whose dwellings they now move about? Surely there are many Signs in this. Are they unable to hear?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:27: Have they not seen that We drive water to the parched land, thereby bringing forth crops which they and their cattle eat? Are they unable to see?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:28: They say: “If you are truthful, (tell us) when will the Judgement come?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:29: Tell them: “If the unbelievers were to believe on the Day of Judgement that will not avail them. For then they will be granted no respite.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).32:30: So (leave them to themselves and) turn away from them and wait; they too are waiting.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:1: O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the unbelievers and the hypocrites. Verily Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:2: Follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Verily Allah is fully aware of all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:3: Put your trust in Allah: Allah is sufficient as Guardian.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:4: Allah has never put two hearts within one person's body; nor has He made your wives, whom you compare to your mothers' backs (to divorce them), your true mothers; nor has He made those whom you adopt as sons your own sons. These are only words that you utter with your mouths. But Allah proclaims the Truth and directs you to the Right Path.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:5: Call your adopted sons after their true fathers; that is more equitable in the sight of Allah. But if you do not know their true fathers, then regard them as your brethren in faith and as allies. You will not be taken to task for your mistaken utterances, but you will be taken to task for what you say deliberately. Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:6: Surely the Prophet has a greater claim over the believers than they have over each other, and his wives are their mothers. According to the Book of Allah, blood relatives have greater claim over each other than the rest of the believers and the Emigrants (in the cause of Allah), except that you may do some good to your allies (if you so wish). This is inscribed in the Book of Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:7: And call to mind, (O Prophet), when We took the covenant from all Prophets; and also from you and Noah and Abraham, Moses, and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:8: so that (their Lord) may question the truthful about their truthfulness. As for the unbelievers, He has kept a painful chastisement in store for them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:9: Believers, call to mind Allah's favour to you when enemy hosts invaded you. Then We sent against them a wind and hosts that you did not see although Allah was observing all that you were then doing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:10: When they came upon you from above you and from below you, when your eyes were stupefied with horror and your hearts leapt to your throats, and you began to entertain diverse thoughts about Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:11: The believers were then put to a severe test and were most violently convulsed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:12: And call to mind when the hypocrites and all those with diseased hearts said: “All that Allah and His Messenger had promised us was nothing but deceit.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:13: And when a section of them said: “(O people of Yathrib), now there is no place for you to stay, so turn back.” (And call to mind) when a section of them was seeking permission from the Prophet to leave, saying: “Our houses are exposed (to attack),” although they were not exposed (to attack);  they only wished to flee (from the battle-front).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:14: If the enemy were to enter the town from various directions, and they were summoned to act treacherously, they would have succumbed to it and would have shown little reluctance in doing so.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:15: They had earlier covenanted with Allah that they would not turn their backs in flight. And a covenant made with Allah must needs be answered for.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:16: (O Prophet), tell them: “If you run away from death or slaying, this flight will not avail you. You will have little time after that to enjoy (the pleasures of life).”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:17: Say (to them): “Who can protect you from Allah if He desires an evil for you? And who can prevent Him if He desires to show mercy to you?” They shall find none other than Allah to be their protector or helper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:18: Allah knows well those of you who create obstructions (in war efforts) and say to their brethren: “Come and join us.” They hardly take any part in battle.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:19: They are utterly niggardly (in coming to your aid). Whenever there is danger, you will see them looking at you, their eyes rolling as though they were on the verge of fainting at the approach of death. But when the danger passes away, their greed for wealth prompts them to greet you with their sharp, scissor-like tongues. These are the ones who never truly believed, and so Allah has caused their deeds to be reduced to naught. That is easy enough for Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:20: They think that the invading confederates have not yet gone. But if the confederates were to mount another assault, they would wish to be in the desert among the bedouins and keep themselves informed about you from there. But even if they remained in your midst, hardly would they fight.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:21: Surely there was a good example for you in the Messenger of Allah, for all those who look forward to Allah and the Last Day and remember Allah much.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:22: As for the true believers, when they saw the invading confederates, they cried out: “This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and what Allah and His Messenger said was absolutely true.” This only increased their faith and submission.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:23: Among the believers there are those who have remained true to the covenant they made with Allah. Among those some of them have fulfilled their vow and others await the appointed time. They have not changed in the least.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:24: (All this is) in order that Allah may reward the truthful for their truthfulness, and either punish the hypocrites or, if He so wills, accept their repentance. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:25: Allah sent back the unbelievers empty-handed, their hearts seething with rage. Allah sufficed the believers in their fight. Allah is Most Powerful, Most Mighty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:26: Allah brought down from their fortresses those People of the Book who had supported the invading confederates and cast such terror into their hearts that some of them you kill and some of them you take captive.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:27: Allah made you inherit their land, their dwellings, and their goods, and a piece of land on which you had not yet trodden. Verily Allah has power over all things.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:28: O Prophet, tell your wives: “If you seek the world and its embellishments, then come and I will make some provision for you and release you in an honourable way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:29: But if you seek Allah and His Messenger and the Abode of the Hereafter, then surely Allah has prepared a great reward for those of you who do good.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:30: Wives of the Prophet, if any of you commit flagrant indecency, her chastisement shall be doubled. That is easy for Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:31: But whoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Messenger and does good deeds, Allah will double her reward. We have prepared for her a generous provision.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:32: Wives of the Prophet, you are not like other women. If you fear Allah, do not be too complaisant in your speech lest those with diseased hearts should covet you; but speak in a straight forward manner.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:33: And stay in your homes and do not go about displaying your allurements as in the former Time of Ignorance. Establish Prayer, give Zakah, and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only wishes to remove uncleanness from you, O members of the (Prophet's) household, and to purify you completely.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:34: Remember the Signs of Allah and the words of wisdom which are rehearsed in your homes. Verily Allah is All-Subtle, All-Aware.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:35: Surely the men who submit (to Allah) and the women who submit (to Allah), the men who have faith and the women who have faith, the men who are obedient and the women who are obedient, the men who are truthful and the women who are truthful; the men who are steadfast and the women who are steadfast, the men who humble themselves (to Allah) and the women who humble themselves (to Allah), the men who give alms and the women who give alms, the men who fast and the women who fast, the men who guard their chastity and the women who guard their chastity, the men who remember Allah much and the women who remember Allah much: for them has Allah prepared forgiveness and a mighty reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:36: It does not behove a believer, male or female, that when Allah and His Messenger have decided an affair they should exercise their choice. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has strayed to manifest error.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:37: (O Prophet), call to mind when you said to himwhom Allah had favoured and you had favoured: “Cleave to your wife and fear Allah,” and you concealed within yourself for fear of people what Allah was to reveal, although Allah has greater right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had accomplished what he would of her, We gave her in marriage to you so that there should not be any constraint for the believers regarding the wives of their adopted sons after they had accomplished whatever they would of them. And Allah's command was bound to be accomplished.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:38: There could be no hindrance to the Prophet regarding what Allah ordained for him. Such has been Allah's Way (with the Prophets) who went before. Allah's command is a decree firmly determined.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:39: (This is Allah's Way) regarding those who deliver the Messages of Allah and who fear Him, and fear no one else than Allah. Allah is Sufficient as a Reckoner.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:40: Muhammad is not the father of any of your men, but he is the Messenger of Allah and the seal of the Prophets. Allah has full knowledge of everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:42: and glorify Him morning and evening.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:43: It is He Who lavishes His blessings on you and His angels invoke blessings on you that He may lead you out of darkness into light. He is Most Compassionate to the believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:44: On the Day they meet Him they will be greeted with: “Peace.” He has prepared for them a generous reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:45: O Prophet, We have sent you forth as a witness, a bearer of good tidings, and a warner,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:46: as one who calls people to Allah by His leave, and as a bright, shining lamp.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:47: Announce to the believers the good tidings that Allah has kept bounteous blessings in store for them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:48: Do not yield to the unbelievers and the hypocrites, and disregard the hurt that comes from them, and put your trust in Allah. Allah suffices as the Guardian to entrust one's affairs to.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:49: Believers, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them, you may not require them to observe a waiting period that you might reckon against them. So make provision for them and release them in an honourable manner.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:50: O Prophet, We have made lawful for you your wives whose bridal dues you have paid, and the slave-girls you possess from among the prisoners of war, and the daughters of your paternal uncles and paternal aunts, and the daughters of your maternal uncles and maternal aunts who have migrated with you, and a believing woman who gives herself to the Prophet and whom he wants to take in marriage. (O Prophet), this privilege is yours alone to the exclusion of other believers. We know well what restrictions We have imposed upon them as regards their wives and those whom their right hands possess, (and have exempted you from those restrictions) that there may be no constraint upon you. Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:51: Of them you may put off any of them you wish, and you may take any of them whom you wish, and you may call back any of those whom you had (temporarily) set aside: there will be no blame on you (on this account). It is likelier that they will thus be comforted, and will not grieve, and every one of them will be well-pleased with what you give them. Allah knows what is in your hearts. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Forbearing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:52: Thereafter women will not be lawful for you, and it will not be lawful for you to take other wives in place of them, even though their beauty might please you,unless they be those whom your right hand owns. Allah is watchful over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:53: Believers, enter not the houses of the Prophet without his permission,nor wait for a meal to be prepared; instead enter when you are invited to eat, and when you have had the meal, disperse. Do not linger in idle talk. That is hurtful to the Prophet but he does not express it out of shyness; but Allah is not ashamed of speaking out the Truth. And if you were to ask the wives of the Prophet for something, ask from behind a curtain. That is more apt for the cleanness of your hearts and theirs. It is not lawful for you to cause hurt to Allah's Messenger, nor to ever marry his wives after him. Surely that would be an enormous sin in Allah's sight.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:54: (It does not matter) whether you disclose something or conceal it, for Allah certainly knows everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:55: It will not be blameworthy for the wives of the Prophet if their fathers, their sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, and the women with whom they have social relations, and the persons whom their right hands possess enter their houses. (O women), shun disobeying Allah. Allah is watchful over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:56: Allah and His angels bless the Prophet. Believers, invoke blessings and peace on him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:57: Verily those who cause annoyance to Allah and His Messenger � Allah has cursed them in this world and in the Hereafter and has prepared for them a humiliating chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:58: Those who cause hurt to believing men and to believing women have invited upon themselves a calumny and a manifest sin.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:59: O Prophet, enjoin your wives and your daughters and the believing women, to draw a part of their outer coverings around them. It is likelier that they will be recognised and not molested. Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:60: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts there is a sickness, and the scandal mongers in Madinah do not desist from their vile acts, We shall urge you to take action against them, and then they will hardly be able to stay in the city with you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:61: They shall be cursed from all around and they shall be ruthlessly killed wherever they are seized.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:62: This has been Allah's Way with those who have gone before, and you shall find no change in Allah's Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:63: People ask you concerning the Hour (of Resurrection). Say: “Allah alone has knowledge of it. What do you know? Perhaps the Hour is nigh.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:64: Allah has cursed the unbelievers and has prepared for them a Blazing Fire;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:65: therein they shall abide for ever. They shall find none to protect or help them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:66: On that Day when their faces shall be turned around in the Fire, they will say: “Would that we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:67: They will say: “Our Lord, we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones, and they turned us away from the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:68: Our Lord, mete out to them a double chastisement and lay upon them a mighty curse.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:69: Believers, do not be like those who distressed Moses and then Allah declared him quit of the ill they spoke about him; and he had a high standing with Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:70: Believers, fear Allah and speak the truth:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:71: Allah will set your deeds right for you and will forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has achieved a great triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:72: We offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to carry it and were afraid of doing so; but man carried it. Surely he is wrong-doing, ignorant.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).33:73: (The consequence of man's carrying the trust is) that Allah may chastise hypocritical men and hypocritical women and accept the repentance of believing men and believing women. He is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:1: All praise be to Allah to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and all praise be to Him in the World to Come. He is Most Wise, All-Aware.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:2: He knows what penetrates into the earth and what goes forth from it, what descends from the heaven and what ascends to it. He is the Most Merciful, the Most Forgiving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:3: The unbelievers say: “How come the Hour is not coming upon us!” Say to them: “Yes indeed, by my Lord, by Him Who fully knows the realm beyond the ken of perception, that the Hour shall inevitably come upon you.Nothing escapes Him, not even the smallest particle in the heavens or the earth; nor is anything smaller or bigger than that but is in a Manifest Book.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:4: (The Hour shall come) that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a generous provision.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:5: As for those who worked against Our Signs in order to frustrate them, they shall suffer a painful chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:6: (O Prophet), those who have knowledge see clearly that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the Truth and directs to the Way of the Most Mighty, the Immensely Praiseworthy Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:7: The unbelievers say: “Shall we direct you to the man who tells you that when you have been utterly broken to pieces, you will be raised to life again?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:8: Has he forged a lie against Allah, or is he afflicted with madness?” Nay, but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are doomed to be chastised and are far gone in error.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:9: Do they not see how the heavens and the earth encompass them from the front and the rear? We could, if We so wished, cause the earth to swallow them or let fragments of the sky fall upon them. Verily there is a Sign in this for every servant (of Allah) who penitently turns to Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:10: We bestowed Our favour upon David. (We commanded): “O mountains, sing Allah's praises with him”; (and so did We command) the birds. We softened the iron for him, (saying):
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:11: “Fashion coats of mail and measure their links with care and act righteously. I am watching over whatever you do.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:12: And We subdued the wind to Solomon: its morning course was a month's journey and its evening course was a month's journey. We gave him a spring flowing with molten brass, and We subdued for him jinn who, by his Lord's permission, worked before him. Such of them as swerved from Our commandment, We let them taste the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:13: They made for him whatever he would desire: stately buildings, images, basins like water-troughs and huge, built-in-cauldrons: “Work, O house of David, in thankfulness (to your Lord). Few of My servants are truly thankful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:14: When We executed Our decree of death on Solomon, nothing indicated to the jinn that he was dead except a worm eating away his staff. So when Solomon fell down, the jinn realised that had they known what lies in the realm beyond perception, they would not have continued to be in this humiliating chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:15: For Sheba there was also a Sign in their dwelling place: the two gardens to the right and to the left.“ Eat of your Lord's provision, and render thanks to Him. Most pleasant is your land and Most Forgiving is your Lord.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:16: But they turned away and so We let loose upon them a devastating flood that swept away the dams and replaced their gardens by two others bearing bitter fruits, tamarisks, and a few lote trees.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:17: Thus did We retribute them for their ingratitude. And none do We retribute in this manner except the utterly ungrateful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:18: We placed other prominent towns between them, the towns that We had blessed and had set well-measured stages between them. Move back and forth between them, night and day, in perfect security.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:19: But they said: “Lord, make the stages of our journeys longer.” They wronged their own selves so We reduced them to bygone tales, and utterly tore them to pieces. Verily there are Signs in this for everyone who is steadfast and thankful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:20: Iblis found his estimate of them to be true, and they followed him, except a party of the believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:21: Iblis had no authority over them and whatever happened was in order that We might know him who believes in the Hereafter as distinct from him who is in doubt about it. Your Lord is watchful over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:22: (O Prophet), say to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity: “Call upon those whom you fancied to be deities beside Allah. They own not even the smallest particle, neither in the heavens nor on the earth; nor do they have any share in the ownership of either of them. Nor is any of them even a helper of Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:23: No intercession can avail with Allah except for him whom Allah permits (to intercede). When their hearts are relieved of fright they will ask the intercessors: “What did your Lord say?” They will reply: “(He said) what is right, and He is the High, the Great.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:24: Ask them, (O Prophet): “Who provides you sustenance from the heavens and the earth?” Say: “Allah. Now, inevitably only one of us is rightly guided, either we or you; and the other is in manifest error.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:25: Tell them: “You will not be called to account about the guilt we committed, nor will we be called to account for what you did.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:26: Say: “Our Lord will bring us together and then He will rightly judge between us. He is the Great Judge, the All-Knowing.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:27: Say: “Show me those whom you have attached to Him as His associates (in Divinity).” Nay, Allah alone is Most Mighty, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:28: (O Prophet), We have not sent you forth but as a herald of good news and a warner for all mankind. But most people do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:29: They ask you: “When will this promise (of Resurrection) be fulfilled, if what you say is true?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:30: Say: “Your day is appointed, you can neither hold back its coming by an hour, nor hasten it by an hour.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:31: The unbelievers say: “We shall never believe in this Qur'an, nor in any Scripture before it.” If you could only see the wrong-doers arrayed before their Lord, each bandying charges against the other. Those who were suppressed will say to those who waxed arrogant: “Had it not been for you, we would have been believers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:32: The arrogant ones will retort to those who were suppressed: “What! Did we bar you from the guidance after it came to you? Not at all; rather you yourselves were evil-doers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:33: Those who were suppressed will say to those who waxed arrogant: “By no means; it was your scheming, night and day, when you would enjoin us to disbelieve in Allah and set up others as equals to Him.” When they are confronted with the chastisement, they will be remorseful in their hearts. We shall put fetters around the necks of the unbelievers. Can people be requited except for their deeds?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:34: We never sent a warner to any town but its wealthy ones said: “We disbelieve in the Message you have brought.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:35: They always said: “We have more wealth and children than you have, and we shall not be chastised.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:36: (O Prophet), say to them: “My Lord grants provision abundantly to whomsoever He pleases and straitens it for whomsoever He pleases. But most people do not know this.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:37: It is not your riches nor your children that make you near-stationed to Us, except for him who has faith and acts righteously; it is they who will receive double the recompense for their deeds. They shall live in lofty mansions in perfect peace.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:38: As for those who work against Our Signs so as to frustrate them, they shall be arraigned into the chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:39: Say, (O Prophet): “Verily, my Lord grants provision abundantly to whomsoever He pleases and straitens it for whomsoever He pleases. Whatever you spend, He will replace it. He is the Best of all Providers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:40: And on the Day when He will muster them all and will ask the angels: “Are they the ones who worshipped you?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:41: They will reply: “Glory to You! You are our Protector, not they. Nay, they rather used to worship the jinn. Most of them believe in them.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:42: Today none of you has the power to benefit or harm another; and We shall say to the evil-doers: “Taste now the chastisement of the Fire which you used to deny, calling it a lie.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:43: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them they say: “This is a person who wants to turn you away from the deities whom your ancestors worshipped.” They say: “This is nothing but an invented falsehood.” And when the Truth came to the unbelievers they declared: “This is nothing but plain sorcery,”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:44: whereas We gave them no Books that they could study nor sent to them any warner before you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:45: Those who went before them also denounced (Allah's Messengers) as liars. They have not attained even a tenth of what We had given them. But when they rejected My Messengers, calling them liars, how terrible was My chastisement!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:46: Say to them, (O Prophet): “I give you but one counsel: stand up (for heaven's sake), singly and in pairs, and then think: what is it in your companion(to wit, Muhammad) that could be deemed as madness?” He is nothing but a warner, warning you before the coming of a grevious chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:47: Say to them: “Whatever recompense I might ask of you, it shall be yours. My recompense is with Allah, and He is witness over everything.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:48: Say to them: “My Lord hurls down the Truth (upon me). He knows fully all that lies beyond the range of perception.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:49: Say: “The Truth has come and falsehood can neither originate nor recreate anything.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:50: Say: “If I go astray then the hurt of straying will come only upon me. But if I am rightly-guided, that is only because of the revelation that my Lord makes to me. He is All-Hearing, Ever Nigh.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:51: If you could only see when the unbelievers will go about in a state of terror. They will have no escape and will be seized from a place near at hand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:52: They will then say: “We believe in it”; but whence can they attain it from so far-off a place?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:53: They disbelieved in it before and indulged in conjectures from far away.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).34:54: A barrier will be placed between them and what they desire, as was done with the likes of them before. Surely they were in a disquieting doubt.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:1: All praise be to Allah, the Fashioner of the heavens and earth, Who appointed angels as His message bearers, having two, three, four wings. He adds to His creation whatever He pleases. Verily Allah has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:2: Whatever Mercy Allah accords to people, none can withhold; and whatever He withholds, no other will be able to release after Him. He is Most Mighty, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:3: O people, remember Allah's favour upon you. Is there any creator, apart from Allah, who provides you your sustenance out of the heavens and earth? There is no god but He. Whither are you, then, being misdirected?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:4: (O Prophet), (there is nothing novel in it) if they cry lies to you;Messengers before you were also cried lies to. To Allah shall all matters be sent back.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:5: O people, assuredly Allah's promise is true. So let the life of the world not delude you, and let not the Deluder delude you concerning Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:6: Surely Satan is an enemy to you. Therefore, do take him as an enemy. He calls his followers to his way so that they may be among the inmates of the Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:7: A severe chastisement lies in store for those that disbelieve, but there is pardon and a great reward for those that believe and work righteous deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:8: (How awful is the straying of the person) for whom his evil deed has been embellished so that it looks fair to him? The fact is that Allah causes whomsoever He will to fall into error and shows the Right Way to whomsoever He will. So, (O Prophet), let not your life go to waste sorrowing over them. Allah is well aware of all that they do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:9: It is Allah Who sends forth winds which then set the clouds in motion, which We drive to some dead land giving a fresh life to earth after it had become dead. Such will be the resurrection of the dead.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:10: He who seeks glory, let him know that all glory belongs to Allah alone.  To Him do good words go up, and righteous action uplifts them. But those who contrive evil deeds, a severe punishment lies in store for them, and their contriving will come to naught.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:11: Allah created you from dust, then from a drop of sperm, then He made you into pairs. No female conceives, nor delivers (a child) except with His knowledge. None is given a long life nor is any diminished in his life but it is written in a Book. Surely that is quite easy for Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:12: The two masses of water are not alike. The one is sweet, sates thirst, and is pleasant to drink from, while the other is salt, bitter on the tongue. Yet from both you eat fresh meat, and extract from it ornaments that you wear; and you see ships cruising through it that you may seek of His Bounty and be thankful to Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:13: He causes the night to phase into the day and the day into the night, and He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running its course to an appointed term. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs the Kingdom; but those whom you call upon, apart from Allah, possess not so much as the skin of a date-stone.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:14: If you call upon them, they cannot hear your prayer. And if they hear it, they cannot answer it. On the Day of Resurrection they will disown you for associating others with Allah in His Divinity. No one can inform you of the truth save the All-Aware.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:15: O people, it is you who stand in need of Allah; as for Allah, He is Self-Sufficient, Immensely Praiseworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:16: If He wishes, He can remove you and put in your place a new creation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:17: That surely is not difficult for Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:18: No one can bear another's burden. If a heavily laden one should call another to carry his load, none of it shall be carried by the other, even though he be a near of kin. (O Prophet), you can warn only those who fear their Lord without seeing Him and establish Prayer. Whoever purifies himself does so to his own good. To Allah is the final return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:19: The blind and the seeing are not alike,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:21: nor cool shade and torrid heat;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:22: nor are the living and the dead alike. Allah makes to hear whomsoever He wishes, but you, (O Prophet), cannot cause to hear those who are in their graves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:23: You are no more than a warner.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:24: We have sent you with the Truth to proclaim good news and to warn. Never has there been a nation but a warner came to it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:25: If they give the lie to you now, those that went before them also gave the lie to their Messengers when they came to them with Clear Proofs, with Scriptures, and with the Illuminating Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:26: Then I seized those who denied the Truth, and how terrible was My punishment!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:27: Do you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky with which We brought forth fruits of diverse hues? In the mountains there are white and red, of diverse hues, and pitchy black;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:28: and human beings too, and beasts, and cattle � diverse are their hues.From among His servants, it is only those who know that fear Allah. Verily Allah is Most Mighty, Most Forgiving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:29: Surely those who recite the Book of Allah and establish Prayer and spend, privately and publicly, out of what We have provided them, look forward to a trade that shall suffer no loss;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:30: (a trade in which they have invested their all) so that Allah may pay them their wages in full and may add to them out of His Bounty. He is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:31: (O Prophet), the Book We have revealed to you is the Truth, confirming the Books that came before it. Verily Allah is well aware of His servants and sees everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:32: Then We bequeathed the Book to those of Our servants that We chose.Now, some of them wrong themselves and some follow the medium course; and some, by Allah's leave, vie with each other in acts of goodness. That is the great bounty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:33: They shall enter the everlasting Gardens, shall be adorned with bracelets of gold and with pearls, and their apparel therein shall be silk.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:34: They will say: “All praise be to Allah Who has taken away all sorrow from us. Surely our Lord is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:35: (the Lord) Who, out of His Bounty, has made us dwell in an abodewherein no toil, nor fatigue affects us.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:36: As for those who disbelieved,  the Fire of Hell awaits them. There they shall not be finished off and die; nor will the torment (of Hell) be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every thankless being.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:37: They will cry out in Hell and say: “Our Lord, let us out so that we may act righteously, different from what we did before.” (They will be told): “Did we not grant you an age long enough for anyone to take heed if he had wanted to take heed?Besides, there came a warner to you. So have a taste of the torment now. None may come to the help of the wrong-doers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:38: Surely Allah knows the Unseen in the heavens and the earth. He even knows the secrets hidden in people's breasts.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:39: It is He Who made you vicegerents in the earth. So whoever disbelieves will bear the burden of his unbelief. The unbelievers' unbelief adds nothing but Allah's wrath against them. The unbelievers' unbelief adds nothing but their own loss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:40: Say to them (O Prophet): “Have you ever seen those of your associates upon whom you call apart from Allah? Show me what have they created in the earth? Or do they have any partnership (with Allah) in the heavens? Or have We given them a Book so that they have a clear proof (for associating others with Allah in His Divinity)?” Nay, what these wrong-doers promise each other is nothing but delusion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:41: Surely Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they should be displaced there, for if they were displaced none would be able to hold them after Him.Surely He is Most Forbearing, Most Forgiving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:42: Swearing by Allah their strongest oaths they claimed that if a warner came to them they would be better-guided than any other people. But when a warner did come to them, his coming only increased their aversion (to the Truth).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:43: They began to wax even more proud on earth and contrived evil designs although the contriving of evil designs only overtakes their authors. Are they waiting, then, for anything except what happened to the nations before them? You shall not find any change in the Way of Allah; and you shall not find anything that can ever alter the Way of Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:44: Have they not journeyed in the earth to behold the end of those who went before them though they were stronger than them in might? Nothing in the heavens nor on earth can frustrate Him in the least. He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).35:45: If Allah were to take people to task for their deeds, He would not leave any living creature on earth, but He grants them respite to an appointed time. When their appointed time comes to an end, surely Allah fully observes His servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:3: you are truly among the Messengers,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:5: (and this Qur'an) is a revelation from the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:6: so that you may warn a people whose ancestors were not warned before wherefore they are heedless.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:7: Surely most of them merit the decree of chastisement; so they do not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:8: We have put fetters around their necks which reach up to their chins so that they are standing with their heads upright,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:9: and We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have covered them up, so they are unable to see.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:10: It is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them for they shall not believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:11: You can warn only him who follows the Admonition and fears the Merciful Lord without seeing Him. Give such a one good tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:12: We shall surely raise the dead to life and We record what they did and the traces of their deeds that they have left behind. We have encompassed that in a Clear Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:13: Recite to them, as a case in point, the story of the people of the town when the Messengers came to them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:14: We sent to them two Messengers and they rejected both of them as liars. Then We strengthened them with a third (Messenger).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:15: They said: “We have been sent to you as Messengers.” The people of the town said: “You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Merciful Lord has revealed nothing. You are simply lying.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:16: The Messengers said: “Our Lord knows that we have indeed been sent to you
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:17: and our duty is no more than to clearly convey the Message.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:18: The people of the town said: “We believe you are an evil omen for us. If you do not desist, we will stone you or you will receive a grievous chastisement from us.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:19: The Messengers replied: “Your evil omen is with you. (Are you saying this) because you were asked to take heed? The truth is that you are a people who have exceeded all bounds.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:20: In the meantime a man came running from the far end of the town, saying: “My people, follow the Messengers;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:21: follow those who do not ask any recompense from you and are rightly-guided.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:22: Why should I not serve the One Who created me and to Whom all of you shall be sent back?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:23: What! Shall I take any deities apart from Him whose intercession will not avail me the least were the Merciful One to bring any adversity upon me, nor will they be able to rescue me?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:24: Surely in that case I should indeed be in evident error.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:25: I believe in your Lord; so listen to me.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:26: (Eventually they killed him and he was told): “Enter Paradise.” The man exclaimed: “Would that my people knew
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:27: for what reason Allah has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured ones.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:28: After him, We did not send down any hosts from the heaven; We stood in no need to send down any host.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:29: There was but a single Blast and suddenly they became silent and still.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:30: Alas for My servants! Never does a Messenger come to them but they mock him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:31: Have they not seen how many nations before them did We destroy? Thereafter they never came back to them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:32: All of them shall (one day) be gathered before Us.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:33: Let the dead earth be a Sign for them. We gave it life and produced from it grain whereof they eat.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:34: We made in it gardens of date-palms and vines, and We caused springs to gush forth
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:35: that they might eat of its fruits. It was not their hands that made them. Will they not, then, give thanks?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:36: Holy is He Who created all things in pairs, whether it be of what the earth produces, and of themselves, and of what they do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:37: And the night is another Sign for them. We strip the day from it and they become plunged in darkness.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:38: The sun is running its course to its appointed place. That is the ordaining of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:39: We have appointed stages for the moon till it returns in the shape of a dry old branch of palm-tree.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:40: Neither does it lie in the sun's power to overtake the moon nor can the night outstrip the day. All glide along, each in its own orbit.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:41: Another Sign for them is that We carried all their offspring in the laden vessel
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:42: and then created for them other vessels like those on which they ride.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:43: Should We so wish, We can drown them, and there will be none to heed their cries of distress, nor will they be rescued.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:44: It is only Our Mercy (that rescues them) and enables enjoyment of life for a while.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:45: When it is said to such people: “Guard yourselves against what is ahead of you and what has preceded you that mercy be shown to you” (they pay scant heed to it).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:46: Never does any Sign of their Lord come to them, but they turn away from it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:47: And when it is said to them: “Spend (in the Way of Allah) out of the sustenance that Allah has provided you,” the unbelievers say to the believers: “Shall we feed him whom, Allah would have fed, had He so wished?” Say: “You are in evident error.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:48: They say: “When will this threat (of Resurrection) come to pass? Tell us if indeed you are truthful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:49: The Truth is that they are waiting for nothing but a mighty Blast to seize them the while they are disputing (in their worldly affairs),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:50: and they will not even be able to make a testament, nor to return to their households.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:51: Then the Trumpet shall be blown and lo! they will come out of their graves and be on the move towards their Lord,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:52: (nervously) exclaiming. “Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping-place?” “This is what the Merciful One had promised, and what (His) Messengers had said was true.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:53: Then there will simply be one single Blast, and all will have gathered before Us.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:54: Today no one shall suffer the least injustice, and you shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:55: Indeed, the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:56: they and their spouses shall be reclining on their couches in shady groves;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:57: therein there will be all kinds of fruits to eat, and they shall have all that they desire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:58: “Peace” shall be the word conveyed to them from their Merciful Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:60: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan � he is to you an open enemy
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:61: and serve Me alone: this is the Straight Way?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:62: Still, he misguided a whole throng of you. Did you have no sense?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:63: Now this is the Hell of which you were warned.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:64: Burn in it on account of your disbelieving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:65: Today We shall put a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they had been doing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:66: If We so willed, We would have put out their eyes, then they would rush to see the Way, but how would they be able to see?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:67: If We so willed, We would have transformed them where they were so that they would not go forward or backward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:68: Whomsoever We grant a long life, We reverse him in his constitution. Do they still not understand?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:69: We did not teach him (to wit, the Messenger) poetry and it does not behove him. This is none but an Admonition, and a Clear Book
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:70: that he may warn him who is alive and establish an argument against those that deny the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:71: Do they not see Our handiwork: We created for them cattle which they own?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:72: We have subjected the cattle to them so that some of them they ride and eat the flesh of others.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:73: They derive a variety of benefits and drinks from them. Will they, then, not give thanks?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:74: They set up deities apart from Allah, hoping that they will receive help from them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:75: Those deities can render them no help. Yet these devotees act as though they were an army in waiting for them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:76: Let not their words grieve you. Surely We know all things about them, what they conceal and what they reveal.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:77: Does man not see that We created him of a sperm drop, and lo! he is flagrantly contentious?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:78: He strikes for Us a similitude and forgot his own creation. He says: “Who will quicken the bones when they have decayed?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:79: Say: “He Who first brought them into being will quicken them; He knows well about every kind of creation;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:80: He Who created from a green tree a fire for you, a fire to light your stoves with.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:81: Has He Who created the heavens and the earth no power to create the likes of them? Yes, indeed, He is the Superb Creator.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:82: Whenever He wills a thing, He just commands it “Be” and it is.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).36:83: Holy is He Who has full control over everything, and to Him you shall all be recalled.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:1: By those who range themselves in rows;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:3: and those who recite the Exhortation;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:5: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two, the Lord of the Easts.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:6: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:7: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:8: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:9: and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:10: And if any is able to snatch a fragment, he is pursued by a piercing flame.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:11: So ask them (that is, human beings): “Were they harder to create than the objects We created?” We created them from sticky clay.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:12: You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:13: and when they are admonished, they pay no heed;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:14: and if they see any Sign, they laugh it away
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:15: and say: “This is nothing but plain sorcery.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:16: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones, we will be raised to life?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:17: And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:18: Tell them: “Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:19: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo, they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:20: They will then say: “Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:21: “Yes, this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:22: (Then will the command be given): “Muster all the wrong-doers and their spouses and the deities whom they used to serve
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:23: apart from Allah, and direct them to the path of Hell,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:24: and detain them there; they will be called to account.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:25: How is it that you are not helping one another?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:26: Indeed, today they are surrendering themselves completely.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:27: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:28: (The followers will say to their leaders): “You used to come to us from the right hand.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:29: They will say: “Nay, you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:30: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:31: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:32: So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:33: On that Day, they will all share the chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:34: Thus do We treat the culprits.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:35: Whenever it was said to them: “There is no true deity apart from Allah,” they waxed proud
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:36: and said: “Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:37: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:38: (They will be told): “You shall taste the grievous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:39: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:40: But Allah's chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:41: For them awaits a known provision,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:42: a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:44: They will be seated upon couches set face to face;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:45: a cup filled with wine from its springs, will be passed around to them;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:46: white, sparkling (wine), a delight to the drinkers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:47: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:48: Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens with bashful, restrained glances,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:49: so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg's shell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:50: Then some of them will turn to others, and will ask each other.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:51: One of them will say: “I had a companion in the world
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:52: who used to say: �Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:53: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?'
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:54: He will say: �Do you wish to know where he is now?'
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:55: Then he will look downwards, and will see him in the depths of Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:56: He will say to him: �By Allah, you almost ruined me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:57: But for Allah's favour, I should be one of those who have been mustered here.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:58: So, are we not going to die,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:59: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?'”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:60: Surely this is the supreme triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:61: For the like of it should the workers work.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:62: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:63: We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:64: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:65: Its spathes are like the heads of satans.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:66: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it, filling their bellies with it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:67: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:68: Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:69: These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:70: and they are running in their footsteps.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:71: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:72: and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:73: Observe, then, what was the end of those that had been warned,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:74: except for the chosen servants of Allah?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:75: Noah had called upon Us (earlier). See, how excellent We were in answering him!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:76: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:77: and made his offspring the only ones to survive,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:78: and We established for him a good name among posterity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:79: Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:80: Thus do We reward all those who do good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:81: Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:82: Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:83: Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:84: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:85: and said to his father and his people: “Whom do you worship?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:86: Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:87: What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:88: Then he looked carefully at the stars
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:90: So turning their backs, they went away from him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:91: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said: “What is the matter with you, why do you not eat?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:92: What is the matter with you, why do you not speak?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:93: Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:94: whereupon people came to him running.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:95: Abraham said to them: “Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:96: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:97: They spoke among themselves: “Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:98: They had contrived an evil plan against him, but We abased them all.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:99: Abraham said: “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:100: Lord, grant me a righteous son.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:101: (In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:102: and when he was old enough to go about and work with him, (one day) Abraham said to him: “My son, I see in my dream that I am slaughtering you. So consider (and tell me) what you think.” He said: “Do as you are bidden. You will find me, if Allah so wills, among the steadfast.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:103: When both surrendered (to Allah's command) and Abraham flung the son down on his forehead,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:105: you have indeed fulfilled your dream. Thus do We reward the good-doers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:106: This was indeed a plain trial.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:107: And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:108: and We preserved for him a good name among posterity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:110: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:111: Surely he was one of Our believing servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:112: And We gave him the good news of Isaac, a Prophet and among the righteous ones.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:113: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among the offspring of the two some did good and some plainly wronged themselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:114: Verily We bestowed Our favours on Moses and Aaron
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:115: and We delivered both of them and their people from the great calamity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:116: We succoured them, and they gained the upper hand (against their enemies).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:117: We granted them a Clear Book,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:118: and showed them the Straight Way,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:119: and preserved for them a good name among posterity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:120: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:121: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:122: Surely both of them were among Our believing servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:123: Surely, Elias too was among the Messengers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:124: (Call to mind) when he said to his people: “Will you not fear Allah?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:125: Do you call upon Baal and forsake the Best of the Creators?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:126: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of yore.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:127: But they denounced him as a liar, so they will surely be arraigned (for punishment),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:129: We preserved a good name for him among posterity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:131: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:132: He was one of Our believing servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:133: And Lot too was one of the Messengers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:134: (Call to mind) when We delivered him and all his kinsfolk,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:135: except for an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:136: Then We utterly destroyed the rest of them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:137: You pass by their desolate habitations in the morning
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:138: and at night. Do you still not understand?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:139: And Jonah too was one of the Messengers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:140: Call to mind when he fled to the laden ship,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:141: cast lots, and was among the losers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:142: Then a fish swallowed him, and he was blameworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:143: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:144: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:145: But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:146: and caused a gourd tree to grow over him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:147: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:148: and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:149: So ask their opinion: “(Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:150: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:151: Behold, it is one of their fabrications that they say:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:153: Did He choose daughters rather than sons?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:154: What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:155: Will you then not take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:156: Do you have any clear authority for such claims?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:157: Bring your Book, if you are truthful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:158: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels; and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:159: (They say): “Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:160: all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:162: shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:163: except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:164: As for us, there is none but has an appointed station.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:165: Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:166: and we are of those who glorify Allah.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:168: “If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:169: we would surely have been Allah's chosen servants.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:170: But when it came to them, they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:171: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:172: that they shall certainly be succoured,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:173: and that Our hosts shall triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:174: So, (O Prophet), leave them alone for a while,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:175: and see, and soon they too shall see.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:176: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:177: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard, evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:178: Leave them alone for a while,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:179: and see; and they too shall soon see.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:180: Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, above what they attribute to Him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:181: and peace be upon the Messengers,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).37:182: and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:1: Sad, and by the Qur'an full of exhortation!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:2: Nay, but the unbelievers are steeped in arrogance and stubborn defiance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:3: How many a nation did We destroy before them! (When they approached their doom) they cried out (for deliverance), but the time for deliverance was already past.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:4: They wondered that a warner had come to them from among themselves,and the deniers of the Truth said: “This is a sorcerer, and a big liar.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:5: Has he made the gods one single God? This is truly astounding.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:6: And the elders among them went forth saying: “Go ahead and be steadfast in adhering to your deities. What is being said is with a design.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:7: We have not heard this in the religious community close to our time. This is nothing but a fabrication.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:8: Has this Exhortation been sent down among us only to him, to the exclusion of all others?” Nay, they are in doubt regarding My Exhortation, and are saying all this because they have not yet had any taste of My chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:9: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord, the Most Mighty, the Great Bestower?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:10: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and of all that is in between them? If so, let them ascend the heights of the realm of causation and see!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:11: This is only a small army out of the several armies that will suffer defeat here.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:12: Before them the people of Noah, Ad, and Pharaoh of the tent-pegs gave the lie (to the Messengers)
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:13: and so did Thamud and the people of Lot and the people of Aykah. These were all leagued together.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:14: Each of them gave the lie to Messengers and My decree of chastisement came upon them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:15: They are waiting for nothing except a single Cry, after which there will be no second Cry.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:16: They say: “Our Lord, hasten to us our share (of chastisement) before the Day of Reckoning.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:17: (O Prophet), bear with patience what they say, and call to mind Our servant David, who was endowed with great strength and who constantly turned (to Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:18: With him We had subjected the mountains that they join him in celebrating Allah's glory, evening and morning,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:19: and the birds, too, in their flocks, and turn again and again to celebrating Allah's glory.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:20: And We strengthened his kingdom and endowed him with wisdom and decisive judgement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:21: Has the story of the litigants reached you � of those who entered his private chambers by climbing over the wall?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:22: As they came upon David � and he was frightened of them � they said: “Be not afraid. We are just two litigants: one of us has committed excess against the other. So judge rightly between us, and be not unjust; and guide us to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:23: Behold, this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one ewe.” And yet he said: “Give her into my charge,” and he got the better of me in argument.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:24: David said: “He has certainly wronged you in seeking to add your ewe to his ewes; and indeed many who live together commit excesses, one to the other, except those that believe and act righteously; and they are but few.” (While so saying) David realized that it is We Who have put him to test; therefore, he sought the forgiveness of his Lord, and fell down, bowing and penitently turning (to Him).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:25: Thereupon We forgave him his shortcoming and indeed (an exalted position of) nearness awaits him, and an excellent resort.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:26: (We said to him): “O David, We have appointed you vicegerent on earth. Therefore, rule among people with justice and do not follow (your) desire lest it should lead you astray from Allah's Path. Allah's severe chastisement awaits those who stray away from Allah's Path, for they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:27: We did not create this heaven and earth and all that lies between them in vain. That is the fancy of those who denied the Truth. So woe from the Fire to all who deny the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:28: Shall We then treat alike those that believe and act righteously and those that create mischief on earth? Or treat alike the God-fearing and the wicked?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:29: This is the Blessed Book that We have revealed to you, (O Muhammad), that people with understanding may reflect over its verses and those with understanding derive a lesson.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:30: We bestowed upon David (an illustrious son), Solomon. How excellent a servant (of Ours he was)! Indeed he constantly turned to Us in devotion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:31: And when one evening well-trained and running horses of noble breed were brought to him
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:32: he said: “Lo! I have come to love this wealth on account of the remembrance of my Lord.” And when the horses disappeared,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:33: (he ordered): “Bring these horses back to me,” and then he began to gently stroke their shanks and necks.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:34: Surely We put Solomon to the test and cast upon his throne a mere body. Thereupon he penitently turned (to Us).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).38:35: He said: “My Lord, forgive me and bestow upon me a kingdom such as none other after me will deserve. Surely You are the Bounteous Giver.”
