A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:33: and bestowed upon them the Signs wherein lay an evident test for them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:35: “This is our first and only death, and we shall never be raised again.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:36: Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:37: Are these better or the people of Tubba and those who went before them? We destroyed them for they were a criminal people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:38: It was not in idle sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:39: We did not create them except in Truth. But most of them do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:40: The Day of Final Decision is the appointed time for all;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:41: the Day when a friend shall be of no avail to his friend nor shall they be helped,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:42: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:44: shall be the food of the sinful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:45: Like dregs of oil, it will boil in their bellies
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:47: “Seize him and drag him to the middle of the Blazing Fire,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:48: then pour boiling water over his head as chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:49: Taste this, you are a person mighty and noble!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:50: This is what you used to doubt.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:51: Verily the God-fearing shall be in a secure place
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:53: Attired in silk and brocade, they shall be arrayed face to face.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:54: Thus shall it be: and We shall espouse them to fair, wide-eyed maidens.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:55: While resting in security, they shall call for all kinds of fruit.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:56: They shall not taste death except the death in this world. And Allah will save them from the chastisement of Hell
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:57: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:58: (O Prophet), We have made this Book easy in your tongue so that they may take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).44:59: Wait, then; they too are waiting.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:2: This Book is a revelation from the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:3: Behold, for those who believe there are (myriad) Signs in the heavens and the earth
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:4: and in your own creation; and in the animals which He spreads out over the earth too there are Signs for those endowed with sure faith;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:5: and in the succession of night and day, and in the provision that Allah sends down from the sky wherewith He gives life to the earth after it had been lifeless, and in the change of the winds: (in all these) there are Signs for people who use reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:6: These are Allah's Signs that We rehearse to you in Truth. In what kind of discourse after Allah and His Signs will they, then, believe?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:8: who hears Allah's Signs being rehearsed to him, and yet persists in his pride, as though he had not heard it. Announce to him, then, the tidings of a grievous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:9: Whenever he comes to know anything of Our Signs, he makes them an object of jest. For such there awaits a humiliating chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:10: Hell is behind them. Their worldly earnings shall not avail them, nor those whom they took as protectors instead of Allah. An awesome chastisement lies in store for them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:11: This (Qur'an) is the true guidance. Those who deny the Signs of their Lord shall suffer the torment of a woeful scourge.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:12: Allah it is Who has subjected the sea to you so that ships may sail upon it at His bidding and you may seek of His Bounty and give thanks to Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:13: He has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and the earth, all being from Him. Verily there are Signs in this for those who reflect.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:14: (O Prophet), tell the believers to indulge those who have no fear of any evil days coming upon them from Allah so that Allah may Himself requite them for their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:15: Whoever acts righteously, does so to his own good; and whoever commits an evil will suffer its consequence. All of you will then be sent back to your Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:16: Indeed We endowed the Children of Israel with the Book and Wisdom and Prophethood, and provided them with good things as sustenance, and exalted them above the peoples of the whole world.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:17: We gave them clear directions in matters pertaining to religion. Yet they differed among themselves (not out of ignorance but) after knowledge had come to them; and they did so out of the desire to commit excesses against one another. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will judge among them regarding what they had differed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:18: And then We set you, (O Prophet), on a clear high road in religious matters. So follow that and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:19: Surely they will be of no avail to you against Allah. Indeed the wrong-doers are friends of each other, whereas Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:20: These are the lights of discernment for people and guidance and mercy for those endowed with sure faith.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:21: Do the evil-doers imagine that We shall make them equal to those who believe and do good, making their lives and deaths alike? How vile is their judgement!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:22: Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth that each person may be requited for his deeds. They shall not be wronged.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:23: Did you ever consider the case of him who took his desire as his god, and then Allah caused him to go astray despite knowledge, and sealed his hearing and his heart, and cast a veil over his sight? Who, after Allah, can direct him to the Right Way? Will you not take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:24: They say: “There is no life other than our present worldly life: herein we live and we die, and it is only (the passage of) time that destroys us. Yet the fact is that they know nothing about this and are only conjecturing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:25: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, their only contention is: “Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:26: Tell them, (O Prophet): “It is Allah Who gives you life and then causes you to die, and He it is Who will then bring all of you together on the Day of Resurrection, a Day regarding which there can be no doubt. Yet most people do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:27: Allah's is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and on the Day when the Hour (of Resurrection) shall come to pass, the followers of falsehood shall be in utter loss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:28: On that Day you shall see every people fallen on their knees. Every people will be summoned to come forth and see its Record and will be told: “Today you shall be requited for your deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:29: This is Our Record which bears witness against you with truth; We used to record all what you did.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:30: As for those who believe and act righteously, their Lord shall admit them to His Mercy. That indeed is the manifest triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:31: But those who denied the Truth, they shall be told: “Were My Signs not rehearsed to you? But you waxed proud and became a guilty people.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:32: And when it was said to them: “Surely Allah's promise is true, and there is no doubt regarding the Hour of Resurrection,” you were wont to say: “We do not know what the Hour (of Resurrection) is. We are simply making conjectures and are not at all certain.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:33: (On that Day) the evil of their deeds will become apparent to them and what they had mocked at will encompass them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:34: and it will be said: “We will forget you today as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. The Fire shall now be your abode, and you shall have none to come to your aid.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:35: You reached this end because you made Allah's Signs an object of jest and the life of the world deluded you.” So they shall not be taken out of the Fire nor shall they be asked to make amends (and thus please their Lord).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:36: So all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the heavens, the Lord of the earth, the Lord of the whole Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).45:37: His is the glory in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:2: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:3: We have created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in Truth and for an appointed term. But those who disbelieve have turned away from what they were warned against.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:4: Tell them, (O Prophet): “Did you consider those whom you call upon beside Allah? Show me, which part of the earth they created? Or do they have any share in creating the heavens? Bring to me any Scripture earlier than this one, or any vestige of knowledge (in support of your belief) if you are truthful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:5: Who is farther strayed from the Right Path than he who calls upon others than Allah that cannot answer his call till the Day of Resurrection, the while they are not even conscious that callers are calling upon them?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:6: When all human beings will be gathered together those who had been called upon will become the enemies to their votaries and will disown their worship.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:7: When Our Clear Messages are rehearsed to them, the unbelievers exclaim about the Truth when it came to them: “This is plain sorcery.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:8: Do they claim that the Messenger himself has fabricated it? (If so), tell them: “If I have fabricated it, then you have no power to protect me from Allah's chastisement. He knows well the idle talk in which you indulge. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:9: Tell them: “I am not the first of the Messengers; and I do not know what shall be done with me or with you. I follow only what is revealed to me, and I am nothing but a plain warner.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:10: Tell them, (O Prophet): “Did you consider (what would be your end) if this Qur'an were indeed from Allah and yet you rejected it? And this even though a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to the like of it. But he believed, while you waxed arrogant. Verily Allah does not guide such wrong-doers to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:11: The unbelievers say to the believers: If there was any good in this Book, others would not have beaten us to its acceptance.” But since they have not been guided to it, they will certainly say: “This is an old fabrication.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:12: Yet before this the Book was revealed to Moses as a guide and a mercy. This Book, which confirms it, is in the Arabic tongue to warn the wrong-doers and to give good tidings to those who do good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:13: Surely those who said: “Our Lord is Allah” and then remained steadfast shall have nothing to fear nor to grieve.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:14: They are the people of Paradise. They shall remain in it forever as a reward for their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:15: We have enjoined man to be kind to his parents. In pain did his mother bear him and in pain did she give birth to him. The carrying of the child to his weaning is a period of thirty months. And when he is grown to full maturity and reaches the age of forty, he prays: “My Lord, dispose me that I may give thanks for the bounty that You have bestowed upon me and my parents, and dispose me that I may do righteous deeds that would please You, and also make my descendants righteous. I repent to You, and I am one of those who surrender themselves to You.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:16: Such are those from whom We accept their best deeds and whose evil deeds We overlook. They will be among the people of Paradise in consonance with the true promise made to them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:17: But he who says to his parents: “Fie on you! Do you threaten me that I shall be resurrected, although myriad generations have passed away before me (and not one of them was resurrected)?” The parents beseech Allah (and say to their child): “Woe to you, have faith. Surely Allah's promise is true.” But he says: “All this is nothing but fables of olden times.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:18: It is against such that Allah's sentence (of punishment) has become due. They will join the communities of humans and jinn that have preceded them. Verily all of them will court utter loss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:19: Of these all have ranks according to their deeds so that Allah may fully recompense them for their deeds. They shall not be wronged.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:20: And on the Day when the unbelievers will be exposed to the Fire, they will be told: “You have exhausted your share of the bounties in the life of the world, and you took your fill of enjoyments. So, degrading chastisement shall be yours on this Day for you waxed arrogant in the earth without justification and acted iniquitously.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:21: Recount to them the story of (Hud), the brother of (the tribe of) 'Ad. Hud warned his people beside the sand-dunes � and there have been other warners before him and since his time � saying: “Serve none but Allah. Verily I fear that the chastisement of an awesome day shall come upon you.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:22: They said: “Have you come to us to turn us away from our gods? Then, bring upon us the scourge that you threaten us with. Do so if you are truthful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:23: He replied: “Allah alone knows about this. I only convey to you the Message that I have been sent with. But I see that you are an ignorant people.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:24: When they saw the scourge advancing towards their valleys, they said: “This is a cloud that will bring much rain to us.” “By no means; it is what you had sought to hasten � a wind-storm bearing a grievous chastisement
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:25: that will destroy everything by the command of its Lord.” Thereafter nothing was left to be seen except their dwellings. Thus do We requite the wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:26: We had established them firmly in a manner We have not established you. We had given them ears and eyes and hearts. But nothing availed them � neither their ears, nor their eyes, nor their hearts, for they denied the Signs of Allah. Then what they had mocked at encompassed them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:27: Surely We destroyed many a town around you. We sent Our Messages to them repeatedly and in diverse forms that they may eschew (their evil ways) and return (to Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:28: So why did those whom they had set up as gods apart from Allah, hoping that they would bring them nearer to Him, not come to their aid? Instead, they failed them. This was the end of the lie they had fabricated and the false beliefs they had invented.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:29: And call to mind when We sent to you a party of the jinn that they may listen to the Qur'an. When they reached the place (where you were reciting the Qur'an), they said to one another: “Be silent (and listen).” And when the recitation ended, they went back to their people as warners.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:30: They said: “Our people, We have heard a Scripture revealed after Moses, verifying the Scriptures revealed before it; it guides to the Truth and to the Straight Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:31: Our people, respond to the call of him who calls you to Allah and believe in him. Allah will forgive your sins and will protect you from a grievous chastisement.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:32: And he who does not respond to the one who calls to Allah will not be able to frustrate Him on earth, nor will they have anyone to protect them from Allah. Such people are in manifest error.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:33: Do they not see that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth � and creating them did not wear Him out � has the power to bring the dead back to life? Why not! He certainly has the power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:34: On the Day when the unbelievers will be brought within sight of the Fire, they will be asked: “Is this not the Truth?” and they will answer “Yes, by Our Lord (this is the Truth).” Allah will say: “Then suffer the chastisement as a requital for your disbelieving.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).46:35: So bear with patience, (O Prophet), even as the Messengers endowed with firmness of resolve (before you) bore with patience, and do not be hasty in their regard. The Day when they see what they had been warned against they will feel as though they had remained in the world no more than an hour of a day. (The Truth has been conveyed.) Will any, then, suffer perdition except those who disobey?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:1: Allah has caused the works of those who disbelieve and hinder people from the way of Allah to go to waste.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:2: As for those who attained to faith and did righteous works and believed in what was revealed to Muhammad � which indeed is the Truth from their Lord � Allah has remitted their evil deeds and has set their condition right.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:3: That is because those who disbelieved followed falsehood whereas those who believed followed the Truth that came to them from their Lord. Thus does Allah set forth to people parables showing their true state.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:4: When you meet the unbelievers (in battle), smite their necks until you have crushed them, then bind your captives firmly; thereafter (you are entitled to) set them free, either by an act of grace, or against ransom, until the war ends. That is for you to do. If Allah had so willed, He would have Himself exacted retribution from them. (But He did not do so) that He may test some of you by means of others. As for those who are slain in the way of Allah, He shall never let their works go to waste.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:5: He will guide them and set their condition right
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:6: and will admit them to Paradise with which He has acquainted them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:7: Believers, if you aid Allah, He will come to your aid and will plant your feet firmly.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:8: As to those who disbelieve, perdition lies in store for them and Allah has reduced their works to nought.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:9: That was because they were averse to what Allah had revealed; so He let their works go to waste.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:10: Have they not journeyed through the land to see the end of those who went before them? Allah utterly destroyed them. These unbelievers are doomed to the same end.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:11: That is because Allah is the Protector of the believers whereas the unbelievers have none to protect them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:12: Allah shall admit those who believe and do righteous works to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for the unbelievers, they enjoy the pleasures of this transient life and eat as cattle eat. The Fire shall be their resort.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:13: (O Prophet), how many are the cities that had greater power than your city that drove you out? We destroyed them and there was none to protect them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:14: Then, can he, who is on a Clear Guidance from His Lord, be like him whose evil deeds have been embellished to him, and who pursued their lusts?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:15: Here is the parable of Paradise which the God-fearing have been promised: in it shall be rivers of incorruptible water, rivers of milk unchanging in taste,and rivers of wine, a delight to those that drink; and rivers of pure honey. In it they will have every kind of fruit as well as forgiveness from their Lord. Can such be like those who will abide in the Fire and will be given a boiling water to drink that will tear their bowels apart?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:16: Among them some give ear to you. But no sooner do they leave your presence than they ask those endowed with knowledge: “What is it that he said just now?” Such are those whose hearts Allah has sealed and who pursue their lusts.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:17: As for those who were led to the Guidance, Allah increases them in their guidance and causes them to grow in God-fearing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:18: Are they waiting, then, for anything else than the Last Hour to suddenly come upon them? Already some of its tokens have come. But when it does actually come upon them, where will any time be left for them to take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:19: Know, therefore, (O Prophet), that there is no god but Allah, and ask forgiveness for your shortcomings and also for (the shortcomings of) believing men and believing women. Allah knows the places where you move about and where you dwell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:20: The believers used to say: “Why is a surah (that would ordain fighting) not revealed?” But when a definitive surah was revealed wherein fighting was mentioned, you saw that those in whose hearts there was a sickness looked at you as though they were about to faint at the approach of death. Pity on them!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:21: (They keep affirming their) obedience and saying good words. But when a course of action was clearly determined, it would have been better for them if they had proved true to Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:22: Now, if you were to turn away, what else can be expected but that you will work corruption in the land and fly at each other's throats?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:23: It is these upon whom Allah has laid His curse: so He made them deaf and deprived them of their sight.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:24: Do they, then, not reflect on the Qur'an? Or are there locks on their hearts?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:25: Certainly those who have turned their backs on the True Guidance after it became manifest to them, Satan has embellished their ways for them and has buoyed them up with false hopes.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:26: This, because they said to those who are averse to the faith that Allah has revealed: “In some matters we shall obey you.” Allah has full knowledge of their secret parleys.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:27: But how will they fare when angels will take their souls at death and will carry them, striking their faces and backs?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:28: That is because they have followed a way that angered Allah, and have been averse to His good pleasure. So He reduced all their works to nought.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:29: Or do they, in whose hearts there is a sickness, believe that Allah will not bring their failings to light?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:30: If We were to so will, We could have shown them to you so that you would recognise them by their faces, and you would certainly know them by the manner of their speech. Allah knows all your deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:31: We shall certainly test you until We know those of you who truly strive and remain steadfast, and will ascertain about you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:32: Those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah's Way and opposed the Messenger after the True Guidance had become manifest to them, they shall not be able to cause Allah the least harm; rather, Allah will reduce all their works to nought.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:33: Believers, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not cause your works to be nullified.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:34: Verily Allah shall not forgive those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah's Way and clung to their unbelief until their death.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:35: So, be not faint-hearted and do not cry for peace. You shall prevail. Allah is with you and will not bring your works to nought.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:36: The life of this world is but sport and amusement. If you believe and are God-fearing, He will grant you your reward, and will not ask you for your possessions.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:37: If He were to ask you for your possessions and press you (in that regard), you would have grown niggardly, and Allah would have brought your failings to light.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).47:38: Behold, you are those who are called upon to spend in Allah's Way, but some of you are niggardly. Whoever is niggardly is in fact niggardly to himself. For Allah is All-Sufficient, whereas it is you who are in need of Him. If you turn away, He will replace you by a people other than you, and they will not be like you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:1: (O Prophet), surely We have granted you a clear victory
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:2: so that Allah may forgive you your shortcomings, whether earlier or later, and may complete His favours upon you and guide you to the Straight Way,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:3: and that Allah may bestow upon you a mighty help.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:4: He it is Who bestowed inner peace on the hearts of the believers so that they may grow yet more firm in their faith. To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth; Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:5: (He did this) to admit the believers, both men and women, to Gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they shall abide, and to efface their evil deeds from them. That, in Allah's sight, is the supreme triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:6: (He also did this) to chastise the hypocrites, both men and women, and those who associate others in His Divinity, both men and women, and who harbour evil thoughts about Allah. They shall be afflicted with misfortune, Allah is wroth with them. He has laid His curse upon them and has prepared for them Hell. What an evil end!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:7: To Allah belong the legions of the heavens and the earth. Allah is Most Mighty, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:8: (O Prophet), We have sent you forth as a witness, as a bearer of good news, and as a warner
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:9: so that (all of) you may all believe in Allah and His Messenger, and support him, and revere him, and celebrate Allah's glory, morning and evening.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:10: Those who swore fealty to you, (O Prophet), in fact swore fealty to Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whoever breaks his covenant breaks it to his own hurt; and whoever fulfils the covenant that he made with Allah, He will bestow on him a great reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:11: (O Prophet), the bedouins who were left behind say to you: “We were occupied with our goods and families. So ask forgiveness for us.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say to them: “Who can be of any avail to you against Allah if He should intend to cause you any harm or confer upon you any benefit?” Allah is well aware of all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:12: (But the truth is not what you say.) You had imagined that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, and this notion was embellished in your hearts. You harboured an evil thought, and you are an immensely evil people.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:13: As for those who do not believe in Allah and His Messenger, for such unbelievers We have prepared a Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:14: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He pleases and chastises whom He pleases. He is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:15: When you press forth for the spoils, those who were left behind will say: “Let us accompany you.” They want to change the command of Allah. Say to them (in clear words): “You shall not accompany us. Thus has Allah already said.” Then they will say: “Nay; but you are jealous of us.” The truth is that they understand little.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:16: Say to the bedouins who were left behind: “You will be called against those who possess great might and be asked to fight against them unless they surrender. If you obey (the command to fight), Allah will bestow upon you a goodly reward. But if you turn away, as you turned away before, He shall inflict upon you a grievous chastisement.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:17: There is no blame on the blind, nor on the lame, nor on the sick (if they do not go forth to fight). Allah will admit those who obey Allah and His Messenger to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow and will inflict a grievous chastisement on those who turn away.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:18: Allah was much pleased with the believers when they swore fealty to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts. So He bestowed inner peace upon them and rewarded them with a victory near at hand
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:19: and with abundant spoils which they shall acquire. Allah is Most Mighty, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:20: Allah has promised you abundant spoils which you shall acquire. He has instantly granted you this (victory) and has restrained the hands of people from you that it may be a Sign for the believers and He may guide you to a Straight Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:21: He also promises you other spoils which you have not yet taken, but Allah has encompassed them. Allah has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:22: Had the unbelievers fought against you at that time, they would have turned their backs (in flight), and would have found none to protect or help them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:23: Such is Allah's Way that has come down from the past. Never shall you find any change in the Way of Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:24: He it is Who restrained their hands from you, and your hands from them in the valley of Makkah, even though He had made you victorious against them. Allah was watching all that you did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:25: They are the ones who disbelieved and barred you from the Inviolable Mosque and prevented the animals you had designated for sacrifice from reaching the place of their offering. If it had not been for the believing men and believing women (who lived in Makkah and) whom you did not know, and had there not been the fear that you might trample on them and unwittingly incur blame on their account, (then fighting would not have been put to a stop. It was stopped so that) Allah may admit to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. Had those believers been separated from the rest, We would certainly have inflicted a grievous chastise-ment on those of them [i.e. the Makkans) who disbelieved.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:26: (This is why) when the unbelievers set in their hearts a fierce bigotry � the bigotry of ignorance � Allah bestowed inner peace upon His Messenger and upon the believers and made the word of piety binding on them. They were more deserving and worthier thereof. Allah has knowledge of everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:27: Allah indeed showed His Messenger the true vision, one fully in accord with reality. If Allah so wills you shall certainly enter the Inviolable Mosque, in full security, you will shave your heads and cut your hair short, and do so without any fear. He knew what you did not know, and He granted you a victory near at hand even before (the fulfilment of the vision).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:28: He it is Who sent His Messenger with the True Guidance and the Religion of Truth that He may make it prevail over every religion. Sufficient is Allah as a witness (to this).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).48:29: Muhammad is Allah's Messenger, and those who are with him are firm with the unbelievers but compassionate with one another. You see them occupied in bowing and prostrating and in seeking Allah's bounty and good pleasure. They are distinguished from others by the marks of prostration on their faces. Thus are they described in the Torah. And their parable in the Gospel is that of a tilth that puts forth its shoot, then strengthens it so that it becomes stout and stands firmly on its stem. This is a sight pleasing to the sowers and one by which the unbelievers will be enraged. As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, Allah has promised them forgiveness and a great reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:1: Believers, do not advance before Allah and His Messenger, and fear Allah. Verily Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:2: Believers, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet and when speaking to him do not speak aloud as you speak aloud to one another, lest all your deeds are reduced to nothing without your even realising it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:3: The ones who lower their voices in the presence of the Messenger of Allah are those whose hearts Allah has tested for God-fearing. Theirs shall be forgiveness and a great reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:4: Surely most of those who call out to you, (O Prophet), from behind the apartments, are devoid of understanding.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:5: If they were patient until you went out to them, that would have been better for them. Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:6: Believers, when an ungodly person brings to you a piece of news, carefully ascertain its truth, lest you should hurt a people unwittingly and thereafter repent at what you did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:7: Know that Allah's Messenger is among you. Were he to follow you in many an affair, you yourselves would suffer. But Allah has endeared faith to you and has embellished it in your hearts, and has made unbelief and evil-doing and disobedience abhorrent to you. Such are those who are rightly guided,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:8: by Allah's favour and bounty. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:9: If two parties of the believers happen to fight, make peace between them. But then, if one of them transgresses against the other, fight the one that transgresses until it reverts to Allah's command. And if it does revert, make peace between them with justice, and be equitable for Allah loves the equitable.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:10: Surely the believers are none but brothers unto one another, so set things right between your brothers, and have fear of Allah that you may be shown mercy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:11: Believers, let not a group (of men) scoff at another group, it may well be that the latter (at whom they scoff) are better than they; nor let a group of women scoff at another group, it may well be that the latter are better than they. And do not taunt one another, nor revile one another by nicknames. It is an evil thing to gain notoriety for ungodliness after belief. Those who do not repent are indeed the wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:12: Believers, avoid being excessively suspicious, for some suspicion is a sin. Do not spy, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would surely detest it. Have fear of Allah. Surely Allah is much prone to accept repentance, is Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:13: Human beings, We created you all from a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes so that you may know one another. Verily the noblest of you in the sight of Allah is the most God-fearing of you. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:14: The Bedouins say: “We believe.”(O Prophet), say to them: “You do not believe; you should rather say: 'We have submitted'”; for belief has not yet entered your hearts. If you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not diminish anything from the reward of any of your deeds. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:15: Indeed the ones possessed of true faith are those who believed in Allah and His Messenger and then they did not entertain any doubt and strove hard in the Way of Allah with their lives and their possessions. These are the truthful ones.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:16: Say, (O Prophet), (to these pretenders to faith): “Are you apprising Allah of your faith? Allah knows all that is in the heavens and the earth. Allah has full knowledge of everything.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:17: They count it as a favour to you that they accepted Islam. Say: “Do not regard your (accepting) Islam as a favour to me; rather, Allah has bestowed a favour on you by guiding you to faith, if you are truthful (in your claim to be believers).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).49:18: Surely Allah knows every hidden thing of the heavens and the earth. Allah sees all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:2: Nay; they wondered that a warner should have come to them from among themselves. The unbelievers said: “This indeed is a strange thing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:3: What! When we are dead and reduced to mere dust, (shall we be raised to life)? Such a return is far-fetched.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:4: (Thus do they imagine, although) We know well what the earth takes away from them. With Us is a Record that preserves everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:5: They gave the lie to the Truth when it came to them. So they are now in a state of great perplexity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:6: Did they never observe the sky above them: how We built it and beautified it; and it has no cracks;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:7: and We have spread out the earth, and have set upon it firm mountains, and have caused it to bring out plants of all beauteous kinds?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:8: All these are to serve as eye openers and as a lesson to every being who is prone to turn (to the Truth).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:9: We also sent down blessed water from the heaven, wherewith We caused gardens and harvest-grain to grow,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:10: and tall palm-trees with their thickly-clustered spathes;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:11: all this as sustenance for Our servants. And thus We do bring the dead land back to life with water. Such shall be the coming forth (of human beings from the earth).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:12: In the past Noah's people, and the people of Rass and Thamud gave the lie (to Messengers),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:13: and so did 'Ad, and Pharaoh and Lot's brethren,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:14: and the people of Aykah, and the people of Tubba'. They all gave the lie to the Messengers. Thereafter My threat of chastisement against them was fulfilled.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:15: Did We, then, become worn out by the first creation? Not at all; but they are in doubt about a fresh creation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:16: Surely We have created man, and We know the promptings of his heart, and We are nearer to him than even his jugular vein.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:17: Moreover, there are two scribes, one each sitting on the right and the left, recording everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:18: He utters not a word, but there is a vigilant watcher at hand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:19: Lo, the agony of death has indeed come with the Truth. That is what you had sought to avoid.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:20: And then the Trumpet was blown. This is the day of the promised chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:21: Everyone has come, each attended by one who will drive him on, and another who will bear witness.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:22: You were heedless of this. Now We have removed your veil and so your vision today is sharp.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:23: His companion said:“ Here is he who was in my charge.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:24: The command was given: “Cast into Hell every hardened, stubborn unbeliever,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:25: who hinders good, exceeds the limits, is immersed in doubts,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:26: and has set up another deity with Allah. Hurl him into the grievous torment.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:27: His companion said:“ I did not incite him to rebel; he was far gone into error of his own accord.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:28: (It was said): “Do not remonstrate in My presence. I had warned you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:29: My Word is not changed; and never do I inflict the least wrong upon My servants.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:30: On that Day We shall ask Hell: “Are you full?” And it will reply: “Are there any more?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:31: And when Paradise shall be brought close to the God-fearing, and will no longer be far away,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:32: it will be said: “This is what you were promised, a promise made to everyone who turned much (to Allah) and was watchful of his conduct,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:33: to everyone who feared the Merciful One though He is beyond the reach of perception, to everyone who has come with a heart ever wont to turn (to Him).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:34: Enter this Paradise in peace.” That will be the Day of Eternity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:35: Therein they shall get whatever they desire; and with Us there is even more.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:36: How many a nation did We destroy before them that were stronger in prowess than these. They searched about the lands of the world. But could they find a refuge?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:37: Verily there is a lesson in this for everyone who has a (sound) heart and who listens with an attentive mind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:38: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and weariness did not even touch Us.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:39: Hence bear with patience whatever they say, and celebrate your Lord's glory before the rising of the sun and before its setting;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:40: and in the night, too, celebrate His glory, in the wake of prostration.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:41: Hearken on the Day when the caller will call from a place nearby,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:42: the Day when they shall hear the Blast in truth. That will be the Day (for the dead) to come forth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:43: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death, and to Us shall all return
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:44: on the Day when the earth will be rent asunder and people, rising from it, will hasten forth. To assemble them all will be easy for Us.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).50:45: (O Prophet), We are well aware of what they say; and you are not required to force things on them. So exhort with the Qur'an all those who fear My warning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:1: By the winds which scatter dust,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:2: which carry clouds laden with water,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:4: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:5: surely what you are being warned against is true,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:6: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:7: By the heaven with its numerous forms:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:8: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:9: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:11: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:12: They ask: “When will the Day of Judgement be?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:13: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:14: (and be told): “Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:15: As for the God-fearing, they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:16: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:17: they used to sleep but little by night,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:18: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:19: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:20: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:21: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:22: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:23: So, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is certainly true, as true as the fact of your speaking.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:24: (O Prophet), did the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reach you?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:25: When they came to him, they said: “Peace”; he said: “Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:26: Then he went back to his family and brought a fat roasted calf
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:27: and laid it before them, saying: “Will you not eat?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:28: Then he became afraid of them. They said: “Fear not,” and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:29: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed: “A barren old woman am I.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:30: They said: “So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:31: Abraham said: “Envoys (of Allah), what is your errand?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:32: They replied: “Behold, we have been sent to a wicked people
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:33: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:34: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:35: Then We evacuated there from all the believers
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:36: – and We did not find there any, apart from a single house of Muslims –
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:37: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:38: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:39: But Pharaoh turned away, showing arrogance on account of his power, and said (about Moses): “He is either a sorcerer or a madman.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:40: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:41: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad, when We let loose upon them an ominous wind
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:42: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:43: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told: “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:44: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord’s command, and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:45: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:46: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:47: And heaven – We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:48: And the earth – We spread it out, and how well have We smoothed it!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:49: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:50: Flee, therefore, to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:51: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:52: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said: “(He is) a sorcerer, or a mad-man.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:53: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:54: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:55: Do, however, keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:56: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:57: I desire from them no provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:58: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision, the Lord of all power, the Strong.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:59: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).51:60: Woe, then, betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:7: verily your Lord's chastisement shall come to pass,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:9: (It shall come to pass) on the Day when the heaven will convulse in a great convulsion,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:10: and the mountains shall violently fly about.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:11: Woe, then, on that Day to those who give the lie (to this Message)
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:12: and amuse themselves with vain argumentation.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:13: On the Day when they shall be thrust into Hell with a violent thrust (and shall be told):
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:14: “This is the Hell which you used to give the lie to.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:15: Is this, then, any feat of magic or are you unable to see?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:16: Go now and burn in it. It is all the same whether you bear it patiently or do not bear it with patience. You are only being recompensed for your deeds.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:17: Surely the God-fearing shall be in Gardens and bliss,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:18: enjoying what Allah will have endowed them with; and their Lord will have saved them from the torment of the Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:19: (They will be told): “Eat and drink to your hearts' content as a reward for your deeds.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:20: The God-fearing shall be reclining on couches facing each other, and We shall wed them to maidens with large, beautiful eyes.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:21: We shall unite the believers with those descendants of theirs who followed them in their faith, and shall not deny them any part of the reward for their good deeds. Every person is pledged to what he did.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:22: We shall provide them in abundance with all kinds of fruit and meat, whatever they may desire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:23: They shall pass on to one another a cup that will incite neither levity nor sin.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:24: Youths as fair as hidden pearls will be set apart to wait upon them; they will be running to and fro to serve them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:25: They will turn to one another and ask (regarding the past events).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:26: They will say: “When we were living before among our kinsfolk we lived in constant fear (of Allah's displeasure).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:27: Then Allah graced us with His favour and saved us from the chastisement of the scorching wind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:28: Formerly we had always prayed to Him. Surely He is Most Benign, Most Compassionate.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:29: So exhort (them, O Prophet), for by your Lord's Grace, you are neither a soothsayer nor a madman.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:30: Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await an adverse turn of fortune.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:31: Tell them: “Wait; I too am waiting with you.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:32: Do their minds prompt them to say such things, or are they a people immersed in transgression?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:33: Do they say: “He has himself fabricated the Qur'an?” No; the truth is that they are altogether averse to believing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:34: (If they are truthful in this), then let them produce a discourse of similar splendour.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:35: Did they come into being without any creator? Or were they their own creators?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:36: Or is it they who created the heavens and the earth? No; the truth is that they lack sure faith.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:37: Or do they have your Lord's treasures in their keeping? Or have absolute authority over them?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:38: Or do they have a ladder whereon they can climb and attempt to listen (to what is transpiring in the Higher Realm)? Then, let any of them who has listened to it produce a clear proof of it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:39: Or does Allah have daughters whereas you have sons?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:40: Or is it that you ask of them any recompense so that they should fear to be weighed down under the burden of debt?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:41: Or is it that they have access to (the Truths in) the realm beyond sense-perception which they are writing down?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:42: Or are they contriving a stratagem against you? If so, that stratagem will rebound against the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:43: Do they have any god other than Allah? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate (with Him in His Divinity).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:44: (So obstinate are they that) even if they were to see some fragments of the sky falling down they would still say: “It is only a mass of cloud.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:45: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs when they shall be struck down,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:46: when their stratagem shall be of no avail to them, nor shall they be succoured.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:47: Surely a chastisement awaits the wrong-doers even before the coming of that Day; but most of them do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:48: Be patient, then, (O Prophet), until the judgement of your Lord comes. For surely you are before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).52:49: and also celebrate His praise at night, and at the retreat of the stars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:1: By the star when it sets:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:2: your companion has neither strayed nor is he deluded;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:3: nor does he speak out of his desire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:4: This is nothing but a revelation that is conveyed to him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:5: something that a very powerful one has imparted to him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:6: one endowed with immense wisdom. He came forth and stood poised,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:8: Then he drew near and hung above suspended,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:9: until he was two bows' length away, or nearer.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:10: Then he revealed to Allah's servant whatever he had to reveal.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:11: His heart added no untruth to what he saw.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:12: Are you, then, going to contend with him regarding what he sees with his eyes?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:13: Indeed he saw him a second time,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:14: by the lote-tree at the farthest boundary,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:15: near which is the Garden of Abode.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:16: (This was) when the lote-tree was covered with that which covered it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:17: His eye did not waver, nor did it stray,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:18: and he certainly saw some of the greatest Signs of His Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:19: Have you ever thought about al-Lat and al-Uzza,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:20: and about the third deity, al-Manat?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:21: Shall you have the male issues, and He the female issues?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:22: That is indeed an unfair division!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:23: These are nothing but names that you and your forefathers have invented, for which Allah has sent down no authority. They are merely following their conjectures and their carnal desires although guidance has come to them from their Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:24: Does man imagine that whatever he wishes for is right for him?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:25: To Allah belong both the Next World and the present.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:26: Numerous are the angels in the heavens; yet their intercession shall be of no avail, except in regard to those whom He grants the leave of intercession and whose plea He is pleased to accept.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:27: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give angels the names of females,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:28: although they have no knowledge regarding that. They only follow their conjecture and conjecture can never take the place of the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:29: So leave alone those who turn away from the remembrance of Us and who seek nothing but the life of the world –
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:30: that being the utmost of their knowledge. Surely your Lord fully knows those who have strayed away from His Path and He also fully knows those who are rightly guided.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:31: To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. He will requite the evil-doers for their deeds and bestow a goodly reward on those who have done good,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:32: on those who avoid grave sins and shameful deeds, even if they may sometimes stumble into lesser offences. Surely your Lord is abounding in His Forgiveness. Very well is He aware of you since He produced you from the earth, and while you were still in your mothers' wombs and not yet born. So do not boastfully claim yourselves to be purified. He fully knows those that are truly Godfearing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:33: (O Prophet), did you see him who turned away (from the Path of Allah),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:34: who gave a little, and then stopped?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:35: Does he have any knowledge of the world beyond the ken of sense-perception, and therefore, clearly sees (the Truth)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:36: Has he not been informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:37: and of Abraham, who lived up to the trust?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:38: “That no bearer of a burden shall bear the burden of another,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:39: and that man shall have nothing but what he has striven for,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:40: and that (the result of) his striving shall soon be seen,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:41: and that he shall then be fully recompensed,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:42: and that the final end is with your Lord,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:43: and that He it is Who causes people to laugh and to cry,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:44: and that He it is Who causes death and grants life,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:45: and He it is Who created the two kinds, the male and the female,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:46: from a drop of sperm when it was emitted,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:47: and that it is for Him to grant the second life,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:48: that He it is Who bestowed wealth and riches,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:49: that He is the Lord of Sirius,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:50: that He it is Who destroyed the ancient 'Ad,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:51: and Thamud, leaving no trace of them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:52: and that He it is Who destroyed the people of Noah before for they were much given to iniquity and transgression.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:53: And He brought perdition upon the subverted cities
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:54: and caused them to be covered with that which He covered them with.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:55: So, which of your Lord's bounties will you doubt?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:56: This is a warning among the warnings of yore.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:57: The imminent Hour has drawn near,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:58: and none but Allah can avert it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:59: Will you, then, wonder at this?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:60: Will you laugh at it rather than weep?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:61: Will you occupy yourselves simply in merriment?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).53:62: Prostrate yourselves before Allah, and serve Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:1: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:2: (Regardless of any Signs these people see), they turn away and say: “This is an ongoing sorcery.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:3: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires. Yet everything is destined to reach an end.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:4: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:5: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:6: So turn away from them, (O Prophet). On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:7: with down-cast eyes they shall go forth from their graves, as though they were scattered locusts.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:8: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller, and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day), will say: “This is a woeful Day.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:9: Before them Noah's people also gave the lie (to his Message). They rejected Our servant as a liar, saying: “He is a madman”; and he was rebuffed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:10: Then he called upon His Lord: “Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:11: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:12: and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:13: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:14: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:15: And We left the Ark as a Sign. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:16: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:17: We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:18: 'Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:19: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:20: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:21: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:22: We have made the Qur'an easy to derive lessons from. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:23: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:24: saying: “Are we to follow a single mortal, one from among ourselves? If we do that, we shall surely be in error and folly.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:25: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:26: (We told Our Messenger): “Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:27: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:28: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel, each availing their turn.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:29: Eventually, they summoned their companion, and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:30: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:31: Behold, We sent a single Blast against them, and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:32: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:33: Lot's people also gave the lie to the warnings,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:34: and behold, We let loose upon them a tempest which rained stones upon them, except upon Lot's household whom We rescued in the last hours of the night
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:35: as a favour from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:36: Surely Lot warned his people that We shall seize them (with Our chastisement), but they doubted the warnings.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:37: Then they even solicited his guests from him, whereupon We blotted out their eyes, (telling them): “Now have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:38: Indeed an abiding chastisement came upon them in the morning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:39: So have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:40: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:41: Warnings also came to the Pharaonites,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:42: but they gave the lie to Our Signs, to all of them. Thereupon We seized them with the seizing of the Most Mighty, the Most Powerful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:43: Are your unbelievers (of Makkah) any better than they? Or have you been granted any immunity in the Scriptures?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:44: Or do they say: “We are a strong legion, strong enough for victory?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:45: Soon shall this legion be routed and shall turn their backs and flee.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:46: Nay; the Hour of Doom is their appointed time, and the Hour shall be more calamitous and bitter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:47: The evil-doers are victims of error and madness.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:48: There shall come a Day when they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire and will be told: “Now taste the flame of Hell.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:49: We have created everything in a determined measure.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:50: Our command consists of only one Word which is carried out in the twinkling of an eye.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:51: We did indeed destroy many like you. Is there, then, any who will heed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:52: All their deeds are recorded in the Scrolls;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:53: everything large or small, is duly inscribed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:54: Surely those who shun disobedience will dwell amidst Gardens and running streams
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).54:55: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King, Mighty in Power.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:4: and has taught him articulate speech.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:5: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:6: and the stars and the trees all prostrate themselves,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:7: and He has raised up the heaven and has set a balance
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:8: that you may not transgress in the balance,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:9: but weigh things equitably and skimp not in the balance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:10: And He has set up the earth for all beings.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:11: Therein are fruit and palm-trees with their dates in sheaths,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:12: and a variety of corn with both husk and grain.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:13: Which of the bounties of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:14: He has created man from dry, rotten clay like the potter's,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:15: and has created the jinn from the flame of fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:16: Which of the wonders of your Lord's power will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:17: Lord of the two easts and of the two wests is He.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:18: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:19: He unleashed the two seas so that they merge together,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:20: and yet there is a barrier between them which they may not overstep.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:21: Which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:22: From these seas come forth pearls and coral.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:23: Which of the wonders of your Lord's power will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:24: His are the ships, towering on the sea like mountains.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:25: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:26: All that is on earth will perish,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:27: only the Person of your Lord, full of majesty and splendour, will endure.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:28: So which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:29: All in the heavens and the earth entreat Him for their needs; a new, mighty task engages Him each day.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:30: Which of your Lord's laudable attributes will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:31: O you twain, who are a burden (on the earth), We shall attend to you and call you to account.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:32: (We shall then see), which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:33: O company of jinn and men, if you have the power to go beyond the bounds of the heavens and the earth, go beyond them! Yet you will be unable to go beyond them for that requires infinite power.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:34: Which of your Lord's powers will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:35: (If you so venture) a flame of fire and smoke shall be lashed at you, which you shall be unable to withstand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:36: Which of your Lord's powers will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:37: (What will happen) when the heaven will be split asunder and will become crimson like leather?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:38: Which of your Lord's powers will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:39: On that Day there will be no need to ask either men or jinn about their sins.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:40: (We shall see) which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:41: The culprits shall be known by their marks, and shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:42: Which of the powers of your Lord, will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:43: (It will be said): “This is the Hell that the culprits had cried lies to.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:44: They will keep circling around between Hell and boiling water.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:45: Which of your Lord's powers will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:46: For any who fears to stand before his Lord are two Gardens.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:47: Which of your Lord's favours will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:48: These Gardens will abound in green, blooming branches.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:49: Which of your Lord's favours will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:50: In each of the two Gardens are two flowing springs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:51: Which of your Lord's favours will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:52: In both these is a pair of every fruit.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:53: Which of your Lord's favours will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:54: They shall recline on couches lined with brocade, and within reach shall hang the fruits of the two Gardens.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:55: Which of your Lord's favours will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:56: In the midst of these shall be maidens with modest, restrained glances; maidens whom no man or jinn has ever touched before.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:57: Which of your Lord's favours will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:59: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:60: Can the reward of goodness be any other than goodness?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:61: Which of the laudable attributes of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:62: And besides these two there shall be two other Gardens.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:63: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:64: Two Gardens, dark green and fresh.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:65: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:66: In them will be two gushing springs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:67: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:68: Therein will be fruits and dates and pomegranates.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:69: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:70: In the midst of these will be maidens, good and comely.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:71: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:72: There shall be maidens sheltered in tents.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:73: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:74: No man or jinn ever touched them before.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:75: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:76: They shall be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:77: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).55:78: Blessed be the name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty and Glory.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:1: When the Event will come to pass
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:2: – and then there will be no one to deny its occurrence –
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:3: (a calamitous Event) that shall turn things upside down:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:4: when the earth will suddenly shake with a terrible shaking,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:6: and will scatter abroad into fine dust.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:7: You shall then become three groups.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:8: The People on the Right: and how fortunate will be the People on the Right!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:9: And the People on the Left: and how miserable will be the People on the Left!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:10: As for the Foremost, they will be the foremost!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:11: They shall be near-stationed (to their Lord),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:14: and a few from later times.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:15: They (will be seated) on gold-encrusted couches,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:16: reclining on them, arrayed face to face;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:17: immortal youths shall go about them
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:18: with goblets and ewers and a cup filled with a drink drawn from a running spring,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:19: a drink by which their minds will not be clouded nor will it cause drunkenness;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:20: they will also go about them with the fruits of which they may choose,
