A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:21: and with the flesh of any fowl that they may desire to eat;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:22: and there shall be wide-eyed maidens,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:23: beautiful as pearls hidden in their shells.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:24: All this shall be theirs as a reward for their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:25: There they shall hear no idle talk nor any sinful speech.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:26: All talk will be sound and upright.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:27: As for the People on the Right, how fortunate shall be the people on the Right!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:28: They shall be in the midst of thornless lote trees,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:34: They shall be on upraised couches,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:35: and their spouses We shall have brought them into being afresh,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:36: and shall have made them virgins,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:37: intensely loving and of matching age.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:38: All this will be for the People on the Right;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:39: a large throng from the ancients,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:40: and also a large throng from those of later times.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:41: As for the People on the Left: how miserable will be the People on the Left!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:42: They will be in the midst of scorching wind and boiling water,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:43: and a shade of thick, pitch-black smoke,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:44: which will neither be cool nor soothing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:45: Surely they had lived before in luxury,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:46: and had persisted in the Great Sin.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:47: They used to say: “What! Once we are dead and are reduced to dust and bones, shall we still be raised to a new life from the dead?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:49: Tell them, (O Prophet): “The earlier ones and the later ones
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:50: shall all be brought together on an appointed Day.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:51: Then you, the erring ones and those that gave the lie to the Truth,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:52: shall all eat from the Tree of al-Zaqqum,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:54: and thereupon you shall drink boiling water,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:55: drinking it as thirsty camels do.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:56: Thus shall they be entertained on the Day of Recompense.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:57: We have created you, then why would you not confirm it?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:58: Did you ever consider the sperm that you emit?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:59: Do you create a child out of it, or are We its creators?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:60: It is We Who ordained death upon you and We are not to be frustrated.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:61: Had We so wished, nothing could have hindered Us from replacing you by others like yourselves, or transforming you into beings you know nothing about.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:62: You are well aware of the first creation; then, do you learn no lesson from it?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:63: Have you considered the seeds you till?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:64: Is it you or We Who make them grow?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:65: If We so wished, We could have reduced your harvest to rubble, and you would have been left wonder-struck to exclaim:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:68: Did you cast a good look at the water that you drink?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:69: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds or is it We Who brought it down?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:70: If We had so pleased, We could have made it bitter. So why would you not give thanks?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:71: Did you consider the fire which you kindle?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:72: Did you make its tree grow or was it We Who made it grow?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:73: We made it a reminder and a provision for the needy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:74: Glorify, then, (O Prophet), the name of your Great Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:75: No! I swear by the positions of the stars –
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:76: and this is indeed a mighty oath, if only you knew –
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:77: that this indeed is a noble Qur'an,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:79: which none but the pure may touch;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:80: a revelation from the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:81: Do you, then, take this discourse in light esteem,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:82: and your portion in it is simply that you denounce it as false?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:83: Why, then, when the soul leaps up to the throat,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:84: the while you are helplessly watching that he is on the verge of death,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:85: – at that moment when We are closer to him than you, although you do not see (Us)
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:86: if you are not subject to anyone's authority,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:87: why are you then not able to bring them back to life if you are truthful?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:88: So if he is one of those who are near-stationed (to Allah),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:89: then happiness and delight and Gardens of Bliss are his.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:90: And if he is one of the People on the Right,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:91: he will be welcomed by the words: “Peace to you” from the People on the Right.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:92: And if he is one of those who give the lie (to this Message) and go astray,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:93: then he will be served boiling water,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:94: and will be scorched by the Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:95: That indeed is the absolute truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).56:96: So glorify the name of your Great Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:1: All that is in the heavens and the earth extols the glory of Allah. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:2: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:3: He is the First and the Last, and the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has knowledge of everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:4: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself on the Throne. He knows all that enters the earth and all that comes forth from it, and all that comes down from the heaven and all that goes up to it. He is with you wherever you are. Allah sees all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:5: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Him are all matters referred (for judgement).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:6: He causes the night to pass into the day, and causes the day to pass into the night, and He fully knows all that is hidden in the breasts of people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:7: Believe in Allah and in His Messenger and expend of what He has entrusted to you. A great reward awaits those of you who believe and spend their wealth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:8: How is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord and although he has taken a covenant from you, if indeed you are believers?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:9: He it is Who sends down Clear Signs to His servant so as to bring you out from darkness into light. Surely Allah is Most Kind and Most Compassionate to you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:10: How is it that you do not expend in the Way of Allah when to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting before the Victory cannot be equated (with those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting afterwards). They are higher in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to each Allah has promised a good reward. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:11: Who is it that will give Allah a beautiful loan? A loan that Allah will repay after increasing it many times and grant him a generous reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:12: On that Day you will see believing men and women that their light will be running before them and on their right hands. (They will be told): “A good tiding to you today.” There shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall abide. That indeed is the great triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:13: On that Day the hypocrites, both men and women, shall say to the believers: “Look at us that we may extract some light from your light.” They will be told: “Go back and seek light for yourselves elsewhere.” Then a wall shall be erected between them with a door in it. On the inside of it there will be mercy, and on the outside of it there will be chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:14: The hypocrites will call out to the believers: “Were we not with you?” The believers will reply: “Yes; but you allowed yourselves to succumb to temptations, and you wavered and you remained in doubt and false expectations deluded you until Allah's command came to pass, and the Deluder deluded you concerning Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:15: So no ransom shall be accepted from you today, nor from those who disbelieved. You are destined for the Fire. That will be your guardian. And that indeed is a grievous destination.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:16: Is the time not come that the hearts of the believers should be humbled to Allah's remembrance and to the Truth that He has revealed, and that they should not be like those who were vouchsafed the Book and then a long time elapsed so that their hearts were hardened? A great many of them are now evil-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:17: Know well that Allah revives the earth after it becomes lifeless. We have clearly shown Our Signs to you, perchance you will use your reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:18: Verily those who give alms be they men or women, and give Allah a beautiful loan shall be repaid after increasing it many times; and theirs shall be a generous reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:19: In Allah's sight only those who truly believe in Allah and His Messengers are utterly truthful and true bearers of witness(for the sake of Allah). For them is their reward and their light. As for those who gave the lie to Our Signs, they are the people of Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:20: Know well that the life of this world is merely sport and diversion and adornment and an object of your boasting with one another, and a rivalry in the multiplication of riches and children. Its likeness is that of rain: when it produces vegetation it delights the tillers. But then it withers and you see it turn yellow, and then it crumbles away. In the Hereafter there is (either) grievous chastisement (or) forgiveness from Allah and (His) good pleasure. The life of this world is nothing but delusion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:21: So vie with one another in seeking to attain your Lord's forgiveness and a Garden whose width is as the width of the heaven and the earth, one which has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. That is Allah's bounty which He bestows upon those whom He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:22: No misfortune ever befalls on earth, nor on yourselves but We have inscribed it in the Book before We make it manifest. Surely that is easy for Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:23: (We do so) that you may not grieve over the loss you suffer, nor exult over what He gave you. Allah does not love the vainglorious, the boastful,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:24: those who are niggardly and bid others to be niggardly. And he who turns away, (should know that) Allah is Self-Sufficient, Immensely Praiseworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:25: Indeed We sent Our Messengers with Clear Signs, and sent down with them the Book and the Balance that people may uphold justice. And We sent down iron, wherein there is awesome power and many benefits for people, so that Allah may know who, without even having seen Him, helps Him and His Messengers. Surely Allah is Most Strong, Most Mighty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:26: Indeed We sent forth Noah and Abraham and established in their line Prophecy and the Book. Then some of them embraced the guidance and many of them are wicked.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:27: In their wake, We sent a succession of Our Messengers, and raised Jesus, son of Mary, after all of them, and bestowed upon him the Evangel, and We set tenderness and mercy in the hearts of those that followed him. As for monasticism, it is they who invented it; We did not prescribe it for them. They themselves invented it in pursuit of Allah's good pleasure, and then they did not observe it as it ought to have been observed. So We gave their reward to those of them that believed. But many of them are wicked.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:28: Believers, have fear of Allah and believe in His Messenger, and He will grant you a two-fold portion of His Mercy, and will appoint for you a light whereby you shall walk; and He will forgive you. Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).57:29: (You should do this) so that the People of the Book know that they have no control over Allah's Bounty, and that all bounty is in Allah's Hand; He bestows it on whomsoever He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:1: Allah has surely heard the words of her who contends with you concerning her husband and complains to Allah. Allah hears what both of you say. Verily Allah is All- Hearing, All-Seeing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:2: Those among you who divorce their wives by declaring them to be their mothers, such are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave birth to them. Indeed what they say is highly contemptible and false. Verily Allah is Most Pardoning, Most Forgiving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:3: Those who declare their wives to be their mothers and thereafter go back on what they have said shall free a slave before they may touch each other. That is what you are exhorted to do. Allah is fully aware of all your deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:4: And he who does not find a slave (to free), shall fast for two months consecutively before they may touch each other; and he who is unable to do so shall feed sixty needy people. All this is in order that you may truly believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the bounds set by Allah; and a grievous chastisement awaits the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:5: Verily those who oppose Allah and His Messenger shall be brought low even as those before them were brought low. Surely We have sent down Clear Signs; and a humiliating chastisement awaits the unbelievers;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:6: a chastisement that shall come upon them on the Day when Allah will raise them all to a new life and will inform them of their deeds. Allah has recorded it all while they have forgotten it. Allah is a witness over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:7: Are you not aware that Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth? Never is there any whispering among three but He is their fourth; nor among five but He is their sixth; nor fewer nor more but He is with them wherever they may be. And then He will tell them on the Day of Judgement all that they have done. Surely Allah knows everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:8: Have you not seen those who were forbidden to whisper and yet they engaged in what they had been forbidden? They secretly converse among themselves concerning sin and transgression and disobedience to the Messenger. And when they come to you, they greet you in a manner that Allah does not greet you, and say to themselves: “Why does Allah not chastise us for these utterances of ours?” Hell it is that shall suffice them, and in it will they burn. How woeful is their destination!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:9: Believers, when you converse in secrecy, let that not be concerning sin and transgression and disobedience to the Messenger; rather, converse concerning virtue and piety. And fear Allah to Whom all of you shall be mustered.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:10: Whispering is an act of Satan, one that aims at causing grief to the believers; yet without Allah's leave no harm can be caused to them. So in Allah should the believers put all their trust.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:11: Believers, when you are told: “Make room for one another in your assemblies,” then make room; Allah will bestow amplitude on you. And when it is said: “Rise up,” then rise up; Allah will raise to high ranks those of you who believe and are endowed with knowledge. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:12: Believers, when you come to the Messenger for private consultation, offer some charity before your consultation with him. That is better for you and more conducive to purity. But if you find nothing to offer in charity, then know that Allah is Most Merciful, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:13: Are you afraid that you will have to offer charity when you hold private conversation with the Prophet? But if you are unable to do so and Allah pardons you, then establish Prayer and pay Zakah, and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:14: Do you not see those who took for friends a people whom Allah is wroth with? They neither belong to you nor you to them. They swear to a falsehood, and they do so knowingly.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:15: Allah has prepared for them a grievous chastisement. Indeed, evil are the acts in which they are engaged.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:16: They have taken their oaths as a shield by means of which they hinder people from the Way of Allah. Theirs shall be a humiliating chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:17: Neither their possessions nor their offspring will be of any avail to them against Allah. They are the people of the Fire; therein they shall abide.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:18: On the Day when Allah will raise them all from the dead they will swear before Him as they swear before you today, thinking that this will avail them. Behold, they are utter liars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:19: Satan has gained mastery over them and has made them neglect remembering Allah. They are the party of Satan. Behold, the party of Satan will be the losers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:20: Verily those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will be among the most abject beings.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:21: Allah has written: “Surely I will prevail; I and My Messengers.” Verily Allah is Most Strong, Most Mighty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).58:22: You shall not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day befriending those who oppose Allah and His Messenger even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. He has inscribed faith in their hearts and has strengthened them with a spirit from Him, and He shall make them enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Therein they shall abide. Allah is well-pleased with them, and they are well-pleased with Him. They belong to Allah's party. Verily Allah's party shall prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:1: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols Allah's Glory: He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:2: He it is Who in the first assault drove forth the People of the Book that disbelieved from their homes at the first gathering of forces. You did not believe that they would leave; while they too thought that their fortresses would defend them against Allah. Then Allah came upon them from whence they did not even imagine, casting such terror into their hearts that they destroyed their homes by their own hands and their destruction was also caused by the hands of the believers. So learn a lesson from this, O you who have perceptive eyes!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:3: If Allah had not decreed banishment for them, He would certainly have chastised them in this world. As for the Hereafter, the chastisement of the Fire awaits them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:4: That is because they set themselves against Allah and His Messenger; and whoever sets himself against Allah should know that Allah is surely Most Stern in retribution.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:5: The palm-trees that you cut down or those that you left standing on their roots, it was by Allah's leave that you did so. (Allah granted you this leave) in order that He might humiliate the evil-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:6: Whatever Allah has taken away from them and bestowed (as spoils) on His Messenger for which you spurred neither horses nor camels; but Allah grants authority to His Messengers over whomsoever He pleases. Allah has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:7: Whatever (from the possessions of the towns people) Allah has bestowed on His Messenger belongs to Allah, and to the Messenger, and to his kinsfolk, and to the orphans, and to the needy, and to the wayfarer so that it may not merely circulate between the rich among you. So accept whatever the Messenger gives you, and refrain from whatever he forbids you. And fear Allah: verily Allah is Most Stern in retribution.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:8: It also belongs to the poor Emigrants who have been driven out of their homes and their possessions, those who seek Allah's favour and good pleasure and help Allah and His Messenger. Such are the truthful ones.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:9: It also belongs to those who were already settled in this abode (of Hijrah)  having come to faith before the (arrival of the) Muhajirun (Emigrants).They love those who have migrated to them and do not covet what has been given them; they even prefer them above themselves though poverty be their own lot. And whosoever are preserved from their own greed, such are the ones that will prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:10: (And it also belongs to) those who came after them, and who pray: “Lord, forgive us and our brethren who have preceded us in faith, and do not put in our hearts any rancour towards those who believe. Lord, You are the Most Tender, the Most Compassionate.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:11: Did you not see the hypocrites say to their brethren, the unbelievers among the People of the Book: “If you are banished we too will go with you and will not listen to anyone concerning you; and if war is waged against you, we will come to your aid.” But Allah bears witness that they are liars.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:12: To be sure, if they are banished, they will not go with them and if war is waged against them, they will not aid them; and even if they provide any aid to them, they will still turn their backs, and thereafter no aid will be forthcoming to them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:13: Surely they have greater dread for you in their hearts than for Allah. That is because they are a people who are devoid of understanding.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:14: They will never fight against you as a body (in an open battlefield); and if they fight against you they will fight only in fortified townships or from behind walls. Intense is their hostility to one another. You reckon them united while their hearts are divided. That is because they are a people devoid of reason.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:15: They are like those who tasted the evil consequences of their deeds a short while before. A grievous chastisement awaits them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:16: Their parable is that of Satan when he says to man: “Disbelieve,” but when he disbelieves, he says: “I am quit of you. Verily I fear Allah, the Lord of the Universe.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:17: In the end both will be in the Fire, and will abide in it. That is the recompense of the wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:18: Believers, fear Allah and let every person look to what he sends forward for the morrow. Fear Allah; Allah is well aware of all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:19: And be not like those who forgot Allah and so He made them oblivious of themselves. They are the wicked ones.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:20: Those destined for the Fire and those destined for Paradise cannot be alike. Verily it is those destined for Paradise who shall triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:21: Had We sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain you would indeed have seen it humbling itself and breaking asunder out of fear of Allah. We propound such parables to people that they may reflect.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:22: He is Allah: there is no god but He; the Knower of the unseen and the manifest, He is the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:23: He is Allah: there is no god but He: the King, the Holy, the All-Peace, the Giver of security, the Overseer, the Most Mighty, the Overpowering, the All-Great. Exalted be He from whatever they associate with Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).59:24: He is Allah, the Planner, Executer and Fashioner of creation. His are the names most beautiful. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth extols His Glory. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:1: Believers, if you have left (your homes and) have come forth to struggle in My Way and to seek My good pleasure, do not make friends with My enemies and your enemies. You befriend them whereas they have spurned the Truth that has come to you; and (such is their enmity that) they expel the Messenger and yourselves for no other reason than that you believe in Allah, your Lord. You send to them messages of friendship in secrecy, although I know well whatever you do, be it secretly or publicly. And whosoever of you does so has indeed strayed far away from the Straight Path.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:2: If they could overcome you, they would act as your foes and would hurt you by their hands and tongues, and would love to see you become unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:3: On the Day of Resurrection neither your blood-kindred nor your own offspring will avail you. (On that Day) He will separate you. Allah sees all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:4: You have a good example in Abraham and his companions: they said to their people: “We totally dissociate ourselves from you, and from the deities that you worship instead of Allah. We renounce you and there has come to be enmity and hatred between us and you until you believe in Allah, the One True God.” (But you may not emulate) Abraham's saying to his father: “Certainly I will ask pardon for you, although I have no power over Allah to obtain anything on your behalf.” (And Abraham and his companions prayed): “Our Lord, in You have we put our trust, and to You have we turned, and to You is our ultimate return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:5: Our Lord, do not make us a test for the unbelievers, and forgive us, our Lord. Surely You are Most Mighty, Most Wise.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:6: Indeed there is a good example for you in them; a good example for anyone who looks forward to Allah and the Last Day. As for him who turns away, Allah is All-Sufficient, Immensely Praiseworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:7: It may well be that Allah will implant love between you and those with whom you have had enmity. Allah is Most Powerful; and Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:8: Allah does not forbid that you be kind and just to those who did not fight against you on account of religion, nor drove you out of your homes. Surely Allah loves those who are equitable.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:9: Allah only forbids you to be friends with those who have fought against you on account of religion and who have driven you out of your homes and have abetted in your expulsion. And any who make friends with them, they are the wrong-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:10: Believers, when believing women come to you as Emigrants (in the cause of faith), examine them. Allah fully knows (the truth) concerning their faith. And when you have ascertained them to be believing women, do not send them back to the unbelievers. Those women are no longer lawful to the unbelievers, nor are those unbelievers lawful to those (believing) women. Give their unbelieving husbands whatever they have spent (as bridal-dues); and there is no offence for you to marry those women if you give them their bridal-dues. Do not hold on to your marriages with unbelieving women: ask for the return of the bridal-due you gave to your unbelieving wives and the unbelievers may ask for the return of the bridal-due they had given to their believing wives. Such is Allah's command. He judges between you. Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:11: And if you fail to receive from the unbelievers a part of the bridal-due of your disbelieving wives, and then your turn comes, pay to those who have been left on the other side an amount the like of the bridal-due that they have paid. And have fear of Allah in Whom you believe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:12: O Prophet, when believing women come to you and pledge to you that they will not associate aught with Allah in His Divinity, that they will not steal, that they will not commit illicit sexual intercourse, that they will not kill their children, that they will not bring forth a calumny between their hands and feet, and that they will not disobey you in anything known to be good, then accept their allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).60:13: Believers, do not make friends with those against whom Allah is wrathful and who are despaired of the Hereafter, as despaired as are the unbelievers lying in their graves.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:1: All that is in the heavens and all that is on earth extols Allah's glory. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:2: Believers, why do you profess that which you do not practise?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:3: It is most loathsome in the sight of Allah that you should profess what you do not practise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:4: Allah indeed loves those who fight in His Way as though they are a solid wall cemented with molten lead.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:5: And call to mind when Moses said to his people: “O my people, why do you torment me when you know well that I am Allah's Messenger to you?” So when they deviated, Allah made their hearts deviant. Allah does not direct the evil-doers to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:6: And call to mind when Jesus, son of Mary, said: “O Children of Israel, I am Allah's Messenger to you, I verify the Torah which has come before me, and I give you the glad tiding of a Messenger who shall come after me, his name being Ahmad.” Yet when he came to them with Clear Signs they said: “This is sheer trickery.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:7: Who would be more unjust than he who invents a lie about Allah the while he is being called to Islam? Allah does not direct such evildoing folk to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:8: They seek to extinguish Allah's light (by blowing) with their mouths, but Allah shall spread His light in all its fullness, howsoever the unbelievers may abhor this.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:9: He it is Who has sent forth the Messenger with the Guidance and the True Religion that He may make it prevail over all religion, however those that associate aught with Allah in His Divinity might dislike this.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:10: Believers, shall I direct you to a commerce that will deliver you from a grievous chastisement?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:11: Have faith in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the Way of Allah with your possessions and your lives. That is better for you if you only knew.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:12: He will forgive you your sins and will admit you to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. He will lodge you in excellent mansions in the Gardens of eternity. That is the supreme triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:13: He will also grant you the other favour that you desire: help from Allah and a victory that will come soon. Give glad tidings of this to the believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).61:14: Believers, become Allah's helpers, as Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples: “Who is my helper in (calling people) to Allah?” The disciples had responded by saying: “We are Allah's helpers.” Then a section of the Children of Israel believed and a section rejected the call. Thereafter We aided the believers against their enemies, and they prevailed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:1: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols the glory of Allah, the Sovereign, the Holy, the All- Mighty, the All-Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:2: He it is Who has sent to the gentiles a Messenger from among themselves, one who rehearses to them His verses, purifies their lives, and imparts to them the Book and the Wisdom although before that they were in utter error;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:3: and (He has also) sent him to those others who have not yet joined them. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:4: Such is Allah's favour: He bestows it on whomsoever He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding favour.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:5: The parable of those who were charged with the Torah and then they failed to live up to it is that of a donkey laden with books. Even more evil is the parable of the people who gave the lie to the Signs of Allah. Allah does not direct such wrong-doers to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:6: Tell them: “O you who have become Judaised, if you arrogantly fancy that you are Allah's favourites to the exclusion of all people, then wish for death, if you are truthful in your claim.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:7: But they shall never wish for death because of the (evil) deeds they have committed. Allah is well aware of these evil-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:8: Tell them: “The death from which you flee will certainly overtake you. Then you will be returned to Him Who fully knows what is hidden and what is manifest. Thereupon He will let you know all that you used to do.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:9: Believers, when the call for Prayer is made on Friday, hasten to the remembrance of Allah and give up all trading. That is better for you, if you only knew.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:10: But when the Prayer is ended, disperse in the land and seek Allah's Bounty, and remember Allah much so that you may prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).62:11: Yet no sooner than they saw some trading or amusement, they flocked to it and left you standing by yourself. Tell them: “That which is with Allah is far better than amusement and trading. Allah is the Best Provider of sustenance.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:1: (O Prophet), when the hypocrites come to you, they say: “We bear witness that you are certainly Allah's Messenger.” Allah certainly knows that you are His Messenger. But Allah also bears witness that the hypocrites are utter liars!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:2: They shelter behind their oath, and thus hinder their own selves and others from the Path of Allah. Evil indeed is what they do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:3: All that is because they first believed and then disbelieved, and therefore a seal was set on their hearts; as a result they understand nothing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:4: When you look at them, their persons are pleasing, and when they speak, you pay heed to what they say. But in truth they are (merely) beams of timber propped-up (against a wall). They consider every shout they hear to be directed against them. They are your utter enemies; guard against them. May Allah do away with them! How are they being turned away (from the Truth)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:5: When it is said to them: “Come, Allah's Messenger will seek forgiveness for you,” they (contemptuously) shake their heads and you see them holding back in pride.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:6: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or not; for Allah shall never forgive them. Surely Allah does not direct the transgressing folk to the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:7: It is they who say: “Give nothing to those who are with the Messenger of Allah so that they may disperse.” (They say so although) the treasures of the heavens and the earth belong to Allah. But the hypocrites do not understand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:8: They say: “When we return to Madinah, the honourable ones will drive out from it those that are abject.” In truth, all honour belongs to Allah, and to His Messenger, and to the believers. But the hypocrites do not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:9: Believers, let your possessions and your offspring not make you negligent of Allah's remembrance. For whoso does that, they will be the losers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:10: And spend of what Allah has granted you by way of sustenance before death should come to any of you and he should say: “Lord, why did You not defer my return for a while so that I might give alms and be among the righteous?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).63:11: But when a person's term comes to an end, Allah never grants any respite. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:1: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth extols Allah's glory. His is the sovereignty and to Him is all praise due; He has power over everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:2: He it is Who has created you: and among you are those that deny the Truth and among you are those that believe in it. Allah observes all that you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:3: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth and shaped you, giving you excellent shapes. And to Him is your ultimate return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:4: He knows what is in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you disclose. Allah even knows what lies hidden in the breasts of people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:5: Has the news of the unbelievers of the past not reached you? (They disbelieved) and then tasted its evil consequence. A grievous chastisement awaits them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:6: This was because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs, but they would say: “Shall mortals (like ourselves) guide us to the Right Way?” They rejected the Truth and turned away. Thereupon Allah became unconcerned with them, for Allah is Self-Sufficient, Innately Praiseworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:7: The unbelievers have vehemently contended that they shall not be raised to life. Say to them: “Yes, by my Lord, you shall surely be raised to life, and you shall certainly be fully informed of all that you did.  That is easy enough for Allah.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:8: So believe in Allah and in His Messenger and in the Light that We have sent down. Allah is fully aware of what you do.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:9: (You shall come to know that) when He will assemble you on the Day of Gathering. That shall be the Day (to determine) mutual gains and losses. Whoever believes in Allah and acts righteously, Allah will have his evil deeds expunged and will admit him to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Therein they shall abide forever. That is the supreme triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:10: As for those who disbelieved and gave the lie to Our Signs: they shall be the inmates of the Fire, and will abide in it. That is a woeful resort!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:11: No misfortune ever befalls unless it be by Allah's leave. And whosoever has faith in Allah, Allah directs his heart along the Right Path. Allah has knowledge of everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:12: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away from obedience, (then know that) Our Messenger has no other duty than to clearly convey the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:13: Allah there is no god but He; in Allah should the believers put all their trust.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:14: Believers, there are enemies to you from among your spouses and your off-spring, so beware of them. But if you forgive and overlook their offences and pardon them, then surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:15: Your possessions and your offspring are nothing but a trial for you. And there awaits a great reward for you with Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:16: So hold Allah in awe as much as you can, and listen and obey, and be charitable. This is for your own good. And whoever remains safe from his own greediness, it is such that will prosper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:17: If you give Allah a goodly loan, He will increase it for you several fold and will forgive you. Allah is Most Appreciative, Most Forbearing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).64:18: He knows that which is beyond the ken of perception as well as that which can be perceived. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:1: O Prophet, when you divorce women, divorce them for their waiting-period, and compute the waiting period accurately, and hold Allah, your Lord, in awe. Do not turn them out of their homes (during the waiting period) – nor should they go away (from their homes)– unless they have committed a manifestly evil deed. Such are the bounds set by Allah; and he who transgresses the bounds set by Allah commits a wrong against himself. You do not know: maybe Allah will cause something to happen to pave the way (for reconciliation).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:2: And when they reach the end of their term (of waiting), then either honourably retain them (in the bond of wedlock) or honourably part with them, and call two persons of known probity as witnesses from among yourselves, and (let these witnesses) give upright testimony for the sake of Allah. That is to what all those that believe in Allah and the Last Day are exhorted. Allah will find a way out for him who fears Allah,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:3: and will provide him sustenance from whence he never even imagined. Whoever puts his trust in Allah, He shall suffice him. Surely Allah brings about what He decrees; Allah has set a measure for everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:4: The waiting period of those of your women who have lost all expectation of menstruation shall be three months in case you entertain any doubt; and the same shall apply to those who have not yet menstruated. As for pregnant women, their waiting period shall be until the delivery of their burden. Allah will create ease for him who fears Allah.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:5: This is the commandment of Allah that He has revealed to you. Whoever fears Allah, He will expunge his evil deeds and will richly reward him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:6: (During the waiting period) lodge them according to your means wherever you dwell, and do not harass them to make them miserable. And if they are pregnant, provide for them maintenance until they have delivered their burden. And if they suckle your offspring whom they bore you, then give them due recompense, and graciously settle the question of compensation between yourselves by mutual understanding. But if you experience difficulty (in determining the compensation for suckling) then let another woman suckle the child.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:7: Whoever has abundant means, let him spend according to his means; and he whose means are straitened, let him spend out of what Allah has given him. Allah does not burden any human being beyond the means that He has bestowed upon him. Possibly Allah will grant ease after hardship.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:8: How many towns rebelled against the commandment of their Lord and His Messengers. Then We called them to a stern accounting, and subjected them to a harrowing chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:9: So they tasted the evil fruit of their deeds; and the fruit of their deeds was utter loss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:10: Allah has laid in store for them a grievous chastisement. So fear Allah, O people of understanding who have attained to faith. Allah has sent down to you an Exhortation,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:11: a Messenger who rehearses to you Allah's verses that clearly expound the Guidance so that He may bring out those that believe and act righteously, from every kind of darkness into light. He will admit whosoever believes in Allah and acts righteously to Gardens beneath which rivers flow. They shall abide in them forever. For such has Allah made an excellent provision.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).65:12: Allah it is He Who created seven heavens, and, like them, the earth. His commandment descends among them. (All this is being stated so that you know) that Allah has power over everything, and that Allah encompasses all things in His knowledge.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:1: O Prophet, why do you forbid what Allah has made lawful for you? Is it to please your wives? Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:2: Allah has prescribed for you a way for the absolution of your oaths. Allah is your Guardian. He is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:3: The Prophet confided something to one of his wives and then she disclosed it (to another); so after Allah revealed to the Prophet (that she had disclosed that secret), he made a part of it known to her and passed over a part of it. And when he told her about this (i.e., that she had disclosed the secret entrusted to her), she asked: “Who informed you of this?” He said: “I was told of it by He Who is All-Knowing, All-Aware.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:4: If the two of you turn in repentance to Allah (that is better for you), for the hearts of both of you have swerved from the Straight Path. But if you support one another against the Prophet, then surely Allah is his Protector; and after that Gabriel and all righteous believers and the angels are all his supporters.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:5: Maybe if he were to divorce you, your Lord might grant him in exchange wives better than you – those who truly submit to Allah, are full of faith, obedient, disposed to repentance, and given to worship and fasting – both previously wedded ones and virgins.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:6: Believers, guard yourselves and your kindred against a Fire whose fuel is human beings and stones, a Fire held in the charge of fierce and stern angels who never disobey what He has commanded them, and always do what they are bidden.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:7: (It will then be said): “Unbelievers, make no excuses today. You are being recompensed for nothing else but your deeds.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:8: Believers, turn to Allah in sincere repentance; maybe your Lord will expunge your evil deeds and admit you to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. This will be on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who have embraced faith and are with him; their light will be running before them and on their right hands, and they will say: “Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Surely You have power over everything.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:9: O Prophet, strive against the unbelievers and the hypocrites, and be severe with them. Hell shall be their resort. What a grievous end!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:10: Allah has set forth for the unbelievers the parable of the wives of Noah and Lot. They were wedded to two of Our righteous servants, but each acted treacherously with her husband, and their husbands could be of no avail to them against Allah. The two of them were told: “Enter the Fire with all the others who enter it.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:11: Allah has set forth for the believers the parable of Pharaoh's wife. She prayed: “My Lord, build for me a house with You in Paradise and deliver me from Pharaoh and his misdeeds; and deliver me from the iniquitous people.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).66:12: Allah has also set forth the parable of Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, and into whom We breathed of Our Spirit, and who testified to the words of her Lord and His Books. She was among the obedient.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:1: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion of the Universe, and Who has power over everything;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:2: Who created death and life that He might try you as to which of you is better in deed. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:3: Who created the seven heavens one upon another. You will see no incongruity in the Merciful One's creation. Turn your vision again, can you see any flaw?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:4: Then turn your vision again, and then again; in the end your vision will come back to you, worn out and frustrated.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:5: We have adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and have made them a means to drive away the satans. We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:6: The chastisement of Hell awaits those who disbelieve in their Lord. What a wretched destination!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:7: When they will be cast into it, they will hear it roar as it boils,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:8: as though it will burst with rage. Every time a multitude is cast into it, its keepers will ask them: “Did no warner come to you?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:9: They will say: “Yes, a warner came to us, but we gave the lie to him and said: 'Allah has revealed nothing. You are surely in huge error.'
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:10: They will say: 'If we had only listened and understood, we would not be among the inmates of the Blazing Fire.'”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:11: Thus will they confess their sins. Damned are these inmates of the Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:12: Surely forgiveness and a mighty reward await those who fear Allah without seeing Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:13: Whether you speak in secrecy or aloud, (it is all the same to Allah). He even knows the secrets that lie hidden in the breasts of people.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:14: Would He not know, He Who has created, when He is All-Subtle, All-Aware?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:15: He it is Who made the earth subservient to you. So traverse in its tracks and partake of the sustenance He has provided. To Him will you be resurrected.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:16: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not cause the earth to cave in with you, and then suddenly it will begin to rock violently?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:17: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not let loose upon you a storm of stones? Then shall you know what My warning is like!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:18: Those who came before them also gave the lie (to the Messengers): then how awesome was My chastisement!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:19: Have they not seen birds above them spreading and closing their wings, with none holding them except the Merciful One? He oversees everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:20: Which is your army that will come to your aid against the Merciful Lord? But the unbelievers are in utter delusion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:21: Who shall provide for you if He withholds His sustenance? Nay; but they persist in rebellion and aversion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:22: Who is better guided: he who walks grovelling on his face, or he who walks upright on a Straight Path?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:23: Say: “He it is Who has brought you into being, and has given you hearing and sight, and has given you hearts to think and understand. How seldom do you give thanks!”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:24: Say: “Allah it is Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be mustered.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:25: They say: “If you are truthful, tell us when will this promise (of the Hereafter) be fulfilled?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:26: Say: “Allah alone knows about that; and I am no more than a plain warner.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:27: When they will see it near at hand, the faces of all those who had denied it will be distraught, and then they will be told: “This is the doom which you used to ask for.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:28: Say to them: “Did you ever consider: whether Allah destroys me and those that are with me, or shows mercy to us, who can protect the unbelievers from a grievous chastisement?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:29: Say to them: “He is Merciful, and it is in Him that we believe, and it is in Him that we put all our trust. Soon will you know who is in manifest error.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).67:30: Say to them: “Did you even consider: if all the water that you have (in the wells) were to sink down into the depths of the earth, who will produce for you clear, flowing water?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:1: Nun. By the pen and what the scribes write.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:2: By your Lord's Grace, you are not afflicted with madness,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:3: and surely yours shall be a never-ending reward,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:4: and you are certainly on the most exalted standard of moral excellence.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:5: So you will soon see, and they too will see,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:6: which of you is afflicted with madness.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:7: Surely your Lord knows well those who have strayed from His Way just as He knows well those who are on the Right Way.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:8: Do not, then, yield to those who reject the Truth, decrying it as false;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:9: they would wish you to be pliant so that they too may be pliant.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:10: And do not yield to any contemptible swearer,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:11: the fault-finder who goes around slandering,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:12: the hinderer of good, the transgressor, the sinful;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:13: the coarse-grained, and above all mean and ignoble;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:14: (who so acts) simply because he has wealth and sons,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:15: and whenever Our verses are rehearsed to him, he says: “These are fairy- tales of times gone by.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:16: Soon shall We brand him on his snout.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:17: We have put them [i.e., the Makkans] to test even as We put to test the owners of the orchard when they vowed that they would gather the fruit of their orchard in the morning,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:18: without making any allowance (for the will of Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:19: Thereupon a calamity from your Lord passed over it while they were asleep,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:20: and so by morning the orchard lay as though it had been fully harvested.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:21: At daybreak they called out to one another:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:22: “Hurry to your orchard if you would gather its fruit.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:23: So off they went, whispering to one another:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:24: “No destitute person shall enter it today.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:25: They went forth early, believing that they had the power (to gather the fruit).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:26: But as soon as they beheld the orchard, (they cried out): “We have certainly lost the way;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:28: The best among them said: “Did I not say to you: why do you not give glory to (your Lord)?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:29: They cried out: “Glory be to our Lord! Certainly we were sinners.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:30: Then they began to reproach one another.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:31: They said: “Woe to us! We had indeed transgressed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:32: Maybe our Lord will give us a better orchard in its place; to our Lord do we penitently turn.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:33: Such is the chastisement; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly even greater, if only they knew.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:34: Surely the God-fearing shall have Gardens of bliss with their Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:35: What! Shall We treat those who have submitted (to Our command) like those who have acted as criminals?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:36: What is the matter with you? How ill do you judge!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:37: Or do you have a Book wherein you read
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:38: that (in the Hereafter) you shall have all that you choose for yourselves?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:39: Or have We sworn a covenant with you which We are bound to keep till the Day of Resurrection, (a covenant requiring that whatever you ordain for yourselves shall be yours)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:40: Ask them: “Which of them can guarantee that?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:41: Or has something been guaranteed by any of those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity?” If so, let them bring forth their associates, if they are truthful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:42: On the Day when the dreadful calamity will unfold, when people will be summoned to prostrate themselves, and yet they will not be able to prostrate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:43: Their eyes shall be downcast and ignominy shall overwhelm them. For when they were safe and sound, they were summoned to prostrate themselves, (and they refused).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:44: So leave Me, (O Prophet), to deal with him who gives the lie to this Discourse. We shall draw them little by little (to their undoing) in a way that they will not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:45: I am giving them a respite. Great is My scheme!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:46: Or are you asking them for some compensation so that they feel burdened with debt?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:47: Or do they have any knowledge of the Unseen which they are now writing down?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:48: So bear with patience until the Judgement of your Lord comes, and do not belike the man in the fish (i.e., Jonah) who called out, choking with grief:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:49: had his Lord not bestowed His favour upon him, he would have been cast upon that barren shore (and would have remained there) in disgrace.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:50: But his Lord exalted him, and included him among His righteous servants.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:51: When the unbelievers hear this Exhortation, they look at you as though they would knock you off your feet with their (hostile) glances. They say: “Surely he is afflicted with madness”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).68:52: although this is nothing but an Exhortation (to goodness) for everyone in the world.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:2: And what is that indubitable event?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:3: And what do you know what that indubitable event is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:4: The Thamud and the Ad denied the (possibility of a) sudden calamity, calling it false.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:5: Then the Thamud were destroyed by an awesome upheaval;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:6: and the Ad were destroyed by a furiously raging wind-storm
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:7: which He let loose upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession; so that (if you had been there) you might have seen people lying prostrate, as though they were uprooted trunks of hollowed palm trees.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:8: Do you now see any trace of them?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:9: Pharaoh and those before him and the people of the overturned habitations all engaged in the same great sin.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:10: They did not follow the Messenger of their Lord, and so He seized them with a severe grip.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:11: Verily when the water rose to great heights, We bore you upon a floating vessel (i.e. the Ark)
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:12: so that We might make it an instructive event for you, and retentive ears might preserve its memory.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:13: So when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:14: and the earth and the mountains are carried aloft and are crushed to bits at one stroke,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:15: on that Day shall that indubitable event come to pass;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:16: when the sky will be rent asunder, the grip holding it together having loosened on that Day,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:17: and the angels will stand on the sides, with eight of them bearing aloft the Throne of your Lord on that Day.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:18: That will be the Day when you shall be brought forth (before Allah) and no secret of yours shall remain hidden.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:19: On that Day, he whose Record is given to him in his right hand will say: “Lo! Read my Record!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:20: Verily I was sure that I would be handed over my account.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:21: Then he shall find himself in a life of bliss;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:23: the clusters of whose fruit will be hanging low to be within reach (of the inmates of Paradise).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:24: (They will be told): “Eat and drink with good cheer as a reward for the good deeds you did in the days that have passed by.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:25: As for him whose Record will be given to him in his left hand, he will exclaim: “Would that I had never been given my Record,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:26: and had not known my account.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:27: Oh! Would that the death that came to me in the world had made an end of me!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:28: My riches have not availed me,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:30: (A command will be issued): “Seize him and shackle him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:31: then cast him in the Fire,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:32: then fasten him with a chain, seventy cubits long.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:33: He would not believe in Allah, the Most Great;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:34: nor would he urge the feeding of the poor.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:35: Today he has been left here friendless;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:36: and has no food except the filth from the washing of wounds,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:37: which only the sinners will eat.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:38: But no; I swear by what you see,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:39: and by what you do not see,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:40: that this is the speech of an honourable Messenger,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:41: not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:42: Nor is this the speech of a soothsayer. Little do you reflect!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:43: It has been revealed by the Lord of the Universe.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:44: And if he [i.e., the Prophets] had forged this Discourse and thereafter ascribed it to Us,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:45: We would surely have seized him by the right hand,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:46: and then severed his life vein;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:47: and not one of you would have been able to withhold Us from doing so.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:48: Surely it is a Good Counsel for the God-fearing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:49: We certainly know that some among you will give the lie to it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:50: and surely it will be a cause of regret for the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:51: Certainly it is a Truth of absolute certainty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).69:52: So glorify the name of your Lord Most Great.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:1: A beseecher besought the visitation of chastisement,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:2: (a chastisement meant) for the unbelievers, one which none can avert;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:3: a chastisement from Allah, the Lord of the ascending steps,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:4: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in one Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:5: So, (O Prophet), persevere with gracious perseverance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:6: Verily they think that the chastisement is far off,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:7: while We think that it is near at hand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:8: It shall befall on a Day whereon the sky will become like molten brass,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:9: and the mountains will become like dyed tufts of wool,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:10: and no bosom friend will enquire about any of his bosom friends
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:11: although they shall be within sight of one another. The guilty one would fain ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his children,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:12: and his spouse and his brother,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:13: and his kinsfolk who had stood by him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:14: and all persons of the earth, if only he could thus save himself.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:15: By no means! It will be the fierce flame
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:16: that will strip off the scalp.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:17: It shall insistently summon him who turned his back and retreated,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:18: and amassed wealth and covetously hoarded it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:19: Verily man is impatient by nature:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:21: and tight-fisted when good fortune visits him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:23: and are constant in their Prayer;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:24: and those in whose wealth there is a known right
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:25: for those that ask and those that are dispossessed,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:26: those who firmly believe in the Day of Recompense,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:27: and fear the chastisement of their Lord–
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:28: surely the chastisement of their Lord is a thing none can feel secure from –
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:29: and those who guard their private parts,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:30: except in regard to their spouses and those whom their right hands possess, for in regard to them they are not reproachable,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:31: but any who seeks to go beyond that, it is indeed they who are the transgressors,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:32: and those who fulfil their trusts and their covenants,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:33: and those who are upright in their testimonies;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:34: and who take due care of their Prayer:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:35: all these shall live honourably in the Gardens.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:36: But what is the matter with the unbelievers who are hurrying towards you
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:37: in crowds, both on the right and on the left?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:38: Does everyone of them wish to enter the Garden of Bliss?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:39: By no means! They know that which We have created them from.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:40: I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We have the power
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:41: to replace them by others who would be better than they; and We shall certainly not be overpowered.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:42: So leave them to engage in vain talk and to amuse themselves until they come face to face with the Day which they are promised,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:43: the Day on which they will hastily come forth from their graves, as though they were hurrying on to the altars of their deities.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).70:44: Their eyes will be downcast and disgrace will overwhelm them. Such is the Day that they were promised.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:1: We sent Noah to his people (and directed him): “Warn your people before a grievous chastisement comes upon them.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:2: Noah said: “My people, I have certainly been sent as a clear warner to you,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:3: that you serve Allah and fear Him, and follow me;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:4: He will forgive your sins and will grant you respite until an appointed term. Indeed when Allah's appointed term comes, it cannot be deferred; if you only knew!”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:5: He said: “My Lord, I called my people by night and by day,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:6: but the more I called, the farther they fled.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:7: And every time I called them so that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped up their faces with their garments and obstinately clung to their attitude, and waxed very proud.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:9: and preached to them in public, and also addressed them in secret.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:10: I said to them: “Ask forgiveness from your Lord; surely He is Most Forgiving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:11: He will shower upon you torrents from heaven,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:12: and will provide you with wealth and children, and will bestow upon you gardens and rivers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:13: What is amiss with you that you do not look forward to the majesty of Allah
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:14: when He has created you in stages?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:15: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens, one upon the other,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:16: and has placed the moon in them as a light, and the sun as a radiant lamp?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:17: And Allah has caused you to grow out of the earth so wondrously,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:18: and He will later cause you to return to it and will then again bring you out of it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:19: Allah has made the earth a wide expanse for you
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:20: so that you may tread its spacious paths.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:21: Noah said: “My Lord, they did not pay heed to what I said, and followed those (nobles) whose possession of wealth and children has led them to an even greater loss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:22: They contrived a plot of great magnitude.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:23: They said: “Do not abandon your deities; do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, nor Yauq, nor Nasr.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:24: They have misled many. So do not enable these evildoers to increase in anything except straying (from the Right Way).”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:25: And so they were drowned on account of their sins, and then cast into the Fire, and did not find any other than Allah, to come forth to their help.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:26: Noah said: “My Lord, do not leave out of these unbelievers even a single dweller on earth,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:27: for certainly if You should leave them (alive), they will mislead Your servants, and will beget none but sinners and utter unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).71:28: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and forgive all believers, both men and women, and do not increase the wrong-doers in anything except perdition.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:1: Say, (O Prophet), it was revealed to me that a band of jinn attentively listened to (the recitation of the Qur'an) and then (went back to their people) and said:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:2: “We have indeed heard a wonderful Qur'an which guides to the Right Way; so we have come to believe in it, and we will not associate aught with Our Lord in His Divinity”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:3: and that “He – exalted be His Majesty – has not taken to Himself either a wife or a son”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:4: and that “the foolish among us have been wont to say outrageous things about Allah”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:5: and that “we had thought that men and jinn would never speak a lie about Allah”,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:6: and that “some from among the humans used to seek protection of some among the jinn, and thus they increased the arrogance of the jinn”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:7: and that “they thought, even as you thought, that Allah would never raise anyone (as a Messenger)”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:8: and that “we tried to pry (the secrets of) the heaven, but we found it full of terrible guards and shooting meteors”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:9: and that “we would take up stations in the heaven to try to hear but anyone who now attempts to listen finds a shooting meteor in wait for him”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:10: and that “we do not know whether evil is intended for those on the earth, or whether their Lord intends to direct them to the Right Way”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:11: and that “some of us are upright and some of us are otherwise for we follow widely divergent paths”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:12: and that “we thought that we will neither be able to frustrate Allah on earth, nor frustrate Him by flight”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:13: and that “when we heard the teaching of the Right Way we came to believe in it; he who believes in His Lord shall have no fear of suffering loss or being subjected to any injustice”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:14: and that “among us some are Muslims (Those who have submitted to Allah), and some of us are deviant. So those who became Muslims found the Right Course;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:15: but those who deviated from the Truth, will be the fuel for Hell.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:16: If people were to keep firmly to the Right Way, We would have vouchsafed them abundant rain
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:17: so that We might try them through this bounty. Whoso turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to suffer a grievous chastisement;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:18: and that “mosques belong to Allah, so do not invoke anyone with Him”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:19: and when Allah's servant stood up to call on Him, they well-nigh swarmed him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:20: Say, (O Prophet): “I call on my Lord alone, and I do not associate aught with Him in His Divinity.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:21: Say: “Surely neither it is in my power to hurt you nor to bring you to the Right Way.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:22: Say: “None can protect me from Allah, nor can I find a refuge apart from Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:23: (My task is no more than) to deliver Allah's proclamation and His messages. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, surely the Fire of Hell awaits him; therein he will abide in perpetuity.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:24: (They shall not change their ways) until they see that against which they had been warned, and then they will know whose helpers are weaker and whose supporters are fewer in number.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:25: Say: “I know not whether what you are promised is near or whether my Lord will prolong its term.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:26: He is the Knower of the Unseen, and He does not disclose His Unseen to anyone
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:27: other than to a Messenger whom He chooses (for the bestowal of any part of the knowledge of the Unseen), whereafter He appoints guards who go before him and behind him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).72:28: so that He may know that they have delivered the messages of their Lord. He encompasses in His knowledge their surroundings and keeps a count of all things.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:2: Stand up in Prayer by night, all but a small part of it;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:3: half of it, or reduce it a little;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:4: or add to it a little; and recite the Qur'an slowly and distinctly.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:5: Behold, We shall cast upon you a Weighty Word.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:6: Surely getting up at night is the best means of subduing the self and is more suitable for uprightness in speech.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:7: You are indeed much occupied during the day with the affairs of the world.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:8: So remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:9: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He. So take Him alone for your Guardian,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:10: And bear patiently the vain things they utter, and gracefully forsake them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:11: Leave it to Me to deal with the affluent ones who give the lie (to the Truth), and bear with them for a while.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:12: We have heavy fetters and a blazing Fire in store for them;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:13: and a food that chokes, and a grievous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:14: (They will come across all this) on the Day when the earth and the mountains shall tremble violently and the mountains shall crumble into heaps of scattered sand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:15: Surely We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness over you, just as We had sent a Messenger to Pharaoh.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:16: But Pharaoh disobeyed Our Messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.
