A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:17: If you persist in disbelieving, how will you guard yourself against the (woe of the) Day that will turn children grey-haired,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:18: the Day whose severity shall cause the heaven to split asunder? Allah's promise is ever bound to be fulfilled.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:19: Indeed this is nothing but a Good Counsel; so let him who will take a way leading to his Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).73:20: (O Prophet), your Lord knows that you sometimes stand up in Prayer nearly two-thirds of the night, and sometimes half or one-third of it,  and so does a party of those with you; Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He has shown mercy to you. So now recite as much of the Qur'an as you can. He knows that there are among you those who are sick and others who are journeying in the land in quest of Allah's bounty, and still others who are fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite as much of the Qur'an as you easily can, and establish Prayer, and pay Zakah, and give Allah a goodly loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you shall find it with Allah. That is better and its reward is greater. And ask for Allah's forgiveness; surely He is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:1: O you enveloped in your cloak!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:3: and magnify the glory of your Lord,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:6: and bestow not favour in order to seek from others a greater return,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:7: and persevere for your Lord's sake.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:8: When the Trumpet shall be sounded,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:9: that will surely be a hard day,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:10: not an easy day for the unbelievers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:11: Leave Me with him whom I alone have created,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:12: whom I have endowed with abundant riches,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:13: and sons ever present with him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:14: and for whom I have smoothed the way (to power and riches),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:15: and who still greedily desires that I should bestow upon him more.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:16: By no means; he is stubbornly opposed to Our Signs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:17: I shall soon constrain him to a hard ascent.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:18: He reflected and then hatched a scheme.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:19: Ruin seize him, how did he hatch a scheme?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:20: Again, ruin seize him, how did he hatch a scheme?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:23: then he retreated and waxed proud,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:24: and said: “This (Qur'an) is merely a sorcery of yore;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:25: this is nothing but the word of a mere mortal!”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:26: Him shall I soon roast in Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:27: And what do you know what Hell is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:28: It spares nothing; it leaves nothing intact;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:31: We have appointed none but angels as the keepers of the Fire, and We have not made their number but as a trial for the unbelievers so that those who have been endowed with the Book will be convinced and the believers' faith will increase,  and neither those who have been endowed with the Book nor the believers will fall into any doubt. As for those in whose hearts there is a sickness as well as the unbelievers, they will say: “What did Allah aim at by this strange parable?” Thus does Allah let whomsoever He pleases to go astray, and directs whomsoever He pleases to the Right Way. And none knows the hosts of your Lord but He. (And Hell has only been mentioned here) that people may take heed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:33: and by the night when it recedes,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:34: and by the day when it dawns (with its radiance),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:35: surely (Hell) is one of the greatest Signs,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:37: a warning to everyone of you whether he would like to come forward or lag behind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:38: Each one is a hostage to one's deeds,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:39: save the People of the Right Hand
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:40: who shall be in the Gardens, and shall ask
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:43: They will answer: “We were not among those who observed Prayer,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:44: and we did not feed the poor,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:45: and we indulged in vain talk with those who indulged in vain talk,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:46: and we gave the lie to the Day of Judgement
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:47: until the inevitable event overtook us.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:48: The intercession of the intercessors shall then be of no avail to them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:49: What is the matter with people that they are turning away from this Exhortation,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:50: as though they were frightened wild asses,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:52: No indeed; each one of them desires that open letters be sent to each of them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:53: No indeed; the truth is that they have no fear of the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:55: So, whoever wills may benefit from it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).74:56: But they will not benefit from it unless Allah Himself so wills. He is worthy to be feared; and He is worthy to forgive (those that fear Him).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:1: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:2: and nay, I swear by the self-reproaching soul!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:3: Does man imagine that We will not be able to bring his bones together again?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:4: Yes indeed; We have the power to remould even his finger-tips.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:5: But man desires to persist in his evil ways.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:6: He asks: “When will the Day of Resurrection be?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:9: and the sun and the moon are joined together,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:10: on that Day will man say: “Whither the refuge?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:12: With your Lord alone will be the retreat that Day.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:13: On that Day will man be apprised of his deeds, both the earlier and the later.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:14: But lo, man is well aware of himself,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:15: even though he might make up excuses.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:16: (O Prophet), do not stir your tongue hastily (to commit the Revelation to memory).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:17: Surely it is for Us to have you commit it to memory and to recite it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:18: And so when We recite it, follow its recitation attentively;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:19: then it will be for Us to explain it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:20: Nay; the truth is that you love ardently (the good of this world) that can be obtained hastily,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:21: and are oblivious of the Hereafter.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:22: Some faces on that Day will be fresh and resplendent,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:23: and will be looking towards their Lord;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:24: and some faces on that Day will be gloomy,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:25: believing that a crushing calamity is about to strike them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:26: Nay; when a man's soul reaches up to the throat,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:27: and it is said: “Is there any enchanter who can step forward and help (by his chanting)?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:28: and he realises that the hour of parting is come,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:29: and calf is inter-twined with calf.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:30: On that Day you will be driven to your Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:31: But he did not verify the Truth, nor did he observe Prayer;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:32: on the contrary, he gave the lie to the Truth and turned his back upon it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:33: then he went back to his kinsfolk, elated with pride.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:34: This (attitude) is worthy of you, altogether worthy;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:35: again, it is worthy of you, altogether worthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:36: Does man think that he will be left alone, unquestioned?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:37: Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:38: then he became a clot, and then Allah made it into a living body and proportioned its parts,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:39: and then He made of him a pair, male and female?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).75:40: Does He, then, not have the power to bring back the dead to life?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:1: Was there a period of time when man was not even worthy of a mention?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:2: Verily We created man out of a drop of intermingled sperm so that We might try him, and We therefore endowed him with hearing and sight.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:3: Surely We showed him the Right Path, regardless of whether he chooses to be thankful or unthankful (to his Lord).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:4: For the unbelievers, We have kept ready chains and fetters and a Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:5: The virtuous shall drink from a cup tempered with camphor water.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:6: This will be a gushing spring wherefrom Allah's servants shall drink wine, a spring from which they will take out channels wherever they wish.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:7: These will be the ones who fulfil their vows and dread the Day whose woe shall be spread far and wide;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:8: those who, for the love of Him, feed the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:9: (saying): “We feed you only for Allah's sake; we do not seek of you any recompense or thanks,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:10: we fear from our Lord a Day that shall be long and distressful.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:11: So Allah shall guard them against the woe of that Day, and will procure them freshness and joy,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:12: and will reward them for their steadfastness with Paradise and robes of silk.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:13: There they will recline on elevated couches and will be subjected neither to the burning heat of the sun nor to bitter cold.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:14: The shades of Paradise will bend over them, and its fruits will be brought within their easy reach;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:15: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:16: goblets bright as crystal but made of silver, filled to exact measure.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:17: Therein they shall be served a cup flavoured with ginger,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:18: drawn from a spring (in Paradise) called Salsabil.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:19: There boys of everlasting youth shall go about attending them: when you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:20: Whitherto you look around, you will see an abundance of bliss and the glories of a great kingdom.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:21: They [i.e., the virtuous] shall be attired in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade and will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure wine to drink.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:22: Behold, this is your recompense and your endeavour has been appreciated.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:23: (O Prophet), indeed We have revealed the Qur'an to you in portions.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:24: So persevere with the command of your Lord and do not pay any heed to the wicked and the unbelieving,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:25: and remember the name of your Lord, morning and evening;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:26: and prostrate yourself before Him at night, and extol His Glory during the long watches of the night.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:27: Verily they love (the good of this world) that is hastily obtainable and are oblivious of the burdensome Day ahead of them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:28: We created them and strengthened their joints; and whenever We wish, We can change their faces entirely.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:29: Verily this is an Exhortation; so let him who so will take a way to his Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:30: But your willing shall be of no avail until Allah Himself so wills. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).76:31: He admits to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. As for the wrong-doers, He has prepared for them a grievous chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:1: By the (winds) sent forth in quick succession,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:3: and raise (clouds) and scatter them around,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:5: and then cast (Allah's) remembrance (in people's hearts),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:6: to serve as an excuse or a warning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:7: Surely what you are promised shall come to pass.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:8: So when the stars are extinguished,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:9: and the sky is rent asunder,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:10: and the mountains are blown away,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:11: and the appointed time to bring the Messengers together arrives,(then shall the promised event come to pass).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:12: To which Day has this task been deferred?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:14: What do you know what the Day of Judgement is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:15: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:16: Did We not destroy many a nation of the earlier times?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:17: And We shall cause those of later times to follow them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:18: Thus do We deal with the guilty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:19: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:20: Did We not create you of a mean fluid,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:21: which We then placed in a secure repository
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:23: See that We had the power to do so. Great indeed is Our power to do what We will.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:24: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:25: Did We not make the earth a receptacle,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:26: for the living and the dead,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:27: and did We not firmly fix towering mountains on it and give you sweet water to drink?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:28: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:29: Proceed now towards that which you were wont to deny as false;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:31: which neither provides (cooling) shade nor protection against the flames;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:32: it indeed throws up sparks like castles,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:33: which seem as though they are yellow-coloured camels.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:34: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:35: That will be the Day on which they will not (be able to) utter a word,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:36: nor will they be allowed to proffer excuses.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:37: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:38: That is the Day of Judgement on which We have assembled you as well as all those who went before you.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:39: So if you have any ploy, try it against Me!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:40: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:41: Behold, today the God-fearing will be amidst shades and springs,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:42: and the fruits that they desire (will be ready at hand).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:43: Eat and drink and may every joy attend you as a reward for your deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:44: Thus do We reward those that do good.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:45: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:46: Eat and enjoy yourselves for a while. Surely you are evil-doers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:47: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:48: When it is said to them: “Bow down (before Allah),” they do not bow down.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:49: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).77:50: In what discourse after this (Qur'an) will they, then, believe?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:1: About what are they asking one another?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:2: Is it about the awesome tiding
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:3: that they are in utter disagreement?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:4: No indeed; soon will they come to know;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:5: again, no indeed; soon will they come to know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:6: Have We not spread the earth like a bed,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:7: and fixed the mountains like pegs,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:8: and created you in pairs (as men and women),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:9: and made your sleep a means of repose,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:10: and made the night a covering,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:11: and made the day to seek livelihood,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:12: and built above you seven strong firmaments,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:13: and placed therein a hot, shining lamp,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:14: and sent down abundant water from the clouds
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:15: so that We may thereby bring forth grain and vegetation,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:17: Surely the Day of Judgement has an appointed time;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:18: the Day when the Trumpet shall be blown, and you will come forth in multitudes;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:19: and when the sky shall be opened up and will become all doors;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:20: and the mountains will be set in motion and become a mirage.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:21: Surely the Hell is an ambush,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:23: therein they shall abide for ages,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:24: they shall taste in it no coolness, nor any pleasant drink
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:25: save boiling water and wash of the wounds;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:26: a befitting recompense for their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:27: For indeed they did not look forward to any reckoning,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:28: and roundly denied Our Signs as false.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:29: And everything have We recorded in a Book.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:30: So taste (the fruit of your deeds). We shall only increase your torment.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:31: Surely the state of triumph awaits the God-fearing:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:33: and youthful maidens of like age,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:35: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, nor any falsehood;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:36: a recompense from your Lord and an ample reward
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:37: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of that which is between them; the Most Merciful Lord before Whom none dare utter a word.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:38: The Day when the Spirit and the angels are ranged row on row. None shall speak save he whom the Merciful Lord will permit; and he too will speak what is right.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:39: That Day is sure to come. So let him who will seek a resort with his Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).78:40: Lo! We warn you of a chastisement near at hand; the Day when a man will look on what his own hands have sent forth, and the unbelievers shall say: “Oh would that I were utter dust.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:1: By those (angels) that pluck out the soul from depths,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:3: and by those that speedily glide along (the cosmos),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:4: and vie with the others(in carrying out their Lord's behests);
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:5: and then manage the affairs of the Universe(according to their Lord's commands).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:6: The Day when the quaking will cause a violent convulsion,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:7: and will be followed by another quaking.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:8: On that Day some hearts shall tremble (with fright),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:9: and their eyes shall be downcast with dread.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:10: They say: “Shall we indeed be restored to life,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:11: even after we have been reduced to bones, hollow and rotten?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:12: They say: “That will then be a return with a great loss!”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:13: Surely they will need no more than a single stern blast,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:14: and lo, they will all be in the open plain.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:16: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:17: and directed him: “Go to Pharaoh, he has rebelled,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:18: and say to him: 'Are you willing to be purified,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:19: that I may direct you to your Lord and then you hold Him in awe?' ”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:20: Then Moses (went to Pharaoh and) showed him the Great Sign;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:21: but he denied it as false and disobeyed,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:22: and then he turned back to have recourse to his craftiness,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:23: and gathered his people and declared:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:24: “I am the supreme lord of you all.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:25: Thereupon Allah seized him for the chastisement of the World to Come as well as of the present.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:26: Surely there is a great lesson in it for whoever would fear (Allah).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:27: Is it harder to create you or the heaven? But Allah built it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:28: and raised its vault high and proportioned it;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:29: and covered its night with darkness and brought forth from it its day;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:30: and thereafter spread out the earth,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:31: and brought out of it its water and its pasture,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:32: and firmly fixed in it mountains;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:33: all this as provision for you and your cattle.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:34: But when the great calamity will come about
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:35: on the Day when man will recall all his strivings,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:36: and Hell will be brought in sight for anyone to see:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:38: and preferred the life of this world,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:39: most surely his abode shall be Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:40: But he who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained himself from evil desires,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:41: most surely his abode shall be Paradise.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:42: They ask you about the Hour: “When will it be?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:43: What concern do you have to speak about that?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:44: Its knowledge rests with your Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:45: You are only a warner to him who has a fear of it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).79:46: On the Day they see it, they will feel as though they had stayed (in the grave) no more than one evening or one morning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:2: that the blind man came to him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:3: How could you know? Perhaps he would cleanse himself,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:4: or he might be mindful and good counsel might avail him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:7: though you are not to blame if he would not cleanse himself.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:8: But he who comes to you running,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:10: you pay no heed to him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:11: No indeed; this is only a Reminder.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:12: So whoso wills may give heed to it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:13: It is contained in scrolls highly honoured,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:15: borne by the hands of scribes,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:17: Accursed be man! How stubbornly he denies the Truth.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:18: Out of what did Allah create him?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:19: Out of a sperm-drop did He create him and then determined a measure for him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:20: and then made the course of life easy for him,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:21: then He caused him to die and brought him to the grave,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:22: and then, whenever He wishes, He will raise him back to life.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:23: Nay, but man did not fulfil what Allah had enjoined upon him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:24: So let man just consider his food:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:25: We poured water, pouring it in great abundance,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:26: and cleaved the earth, cleaving it asunder;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:27: then caused the grain to grow out of it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:32: all this as a provision for you and your cattle.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:33: But when the deafening cry shall be sounded
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:34: on the Day when each man shall flee from his brother,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:35: and his mother and his father;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:36: and his consort and his children;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:37: on that Day each will be occupied with his own business, making him oblivious of all save himself.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:38: Some faces on that Day shall be beaming with happiness,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:40: Some faces on that Day shall be dust-ridden,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).80:42: These will be the unbelievers, the wicked.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:1: When the sun shall be folded up,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:2: when the stars shall scatter away,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:3: when the mountains shall be set in motion,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:4: when the ten-months pregnant camels shall be abandoned,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:5: when the savage beasts shall be brought together,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:6: when the seas shall be set boiling,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:7: when the souls shall be rejoined (with their bodies),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:8: and when the girl-child buried alive shall be asked:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:9: for what offence was she killed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:10: and when the scrolls of (men's) deeds shall be unfolded,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:11: and when Heaven is laid bare;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:14: then shall each person know what he has brought along.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:15: No indeed; I swear by the alternating stars
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:17: and by the night as it recedes,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:18: and the morn as it breathes.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:19: Verily this is the word of a noble message-bearer;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:20: one mighty and held in honour with the Lord of the Throne;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:21: there he is obeyed and held trustworthy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:22: (O people of Makkah), your companion is not mad;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:23: he indeed saw the message-bearer on the clear horizon;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:24: nor does he grudge (conveying this knowledge about) the Unseen;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:25: nor is it a word of an accursed Satan.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:26: Where to are you then heading?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:27: It is nothing but Good Counsel for everyone in the world,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:28: for everyone of you who wishes to follow the Straight Way;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).81:29: but your wishing will not avail unless Allah, the Lord of the Universe, so wishes.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:1: When the heaven is split asunder,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:3: when the seas are made to burst forth,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:4: and when graves are laid open,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:5: everyone shall know all his deeds, both the earlier and the later.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:6: O man! What has deceived you about your generous Lord
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:7: Who created you, shaped you, and made you well-proportioned,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:8: and set you in whatever form He pleased?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:9: No indeed; (the fact is that) you deny the Reckoning, declaring it a lie;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:10: you do so the while there are watchers over you;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:13: Surely the virtuous shall be in Bliss,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:14: and the wicked shall be in the Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:15: They shall enter it on the Day of Recompense
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:16: and then shall never come out of it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:17: What do you know what the Day of Recompense is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:18: Again, what do you know what the Day of Recompense is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).82:19: It is the Day when no one shall have the power to do anything for another, and all command shall be Allah's.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:2: those who, when they take from others by measure, take their full share;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:3: but who, when they measure or weigh for others, give less than their due.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:4: Do they not realise that they will be raised to life
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:6: a Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Universe?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:7: No indeed! Verily the deeds of the wicked are in the Record locked up in the prison-house!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:8: And how would you know what the Record of the prison-house is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:10: Woe, then, to those that give the lie,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:11: those that give the lie to the Day of Recompense.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:12: Yet none gives the lie to it except the transgressor immersed in sin;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:13: who, when Our verses are recited to him, says: “Mere tales of olden times!”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:14: No indeed! The truth is that their hearts have become rusted on account of their evil deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:15: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from seeing their Lord,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:16: and then they shall enter Hell,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:17: whereafter they will be told: “This is what you used to give the lie to.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:18: No indeed! Verily, the deeds of the virtuous shall be in the record of the exalted ones.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:19: And what do you know what the Record of the exalted ones is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:21: which the angels placed near Allah to safeguard.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:22: Verily the virtuous shall be in Bliss;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:24: You shall see upon their faces the glow of bliss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:25: They will be served a drink of the finest sealed wine,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:26: whose seal is musk – so let all aspirants aspire after that –
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:27: a wine whose mixture is Tasnim,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:28: a fountain at which the chosen ones shall drink.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:29: Behold, the wicked were wont to laugh at the believers:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:30: when they passed by them they winked,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:31: and when they went back to their families, they went back jesting,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:32: and when they saw the believers, they said: “Lo! These are the erring ones”;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:33: (they said so although) they had not been appointed watchers over them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:34: But today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:35: seated upon their couches, they are looking around.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).83:36: Have the unbelievers been duly rewarded for their deeds?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:1: When the sky is rent asunder
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:2: and hearkens to the command of its Lord, doing what it should;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:3: and when the earth is stretched out
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:4: and casts out what is within it and is emptied,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:5: and hearkens to the command of its Lord, doing what it should.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:6: O man, you are striving unto your Lord and you will meet Him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:7: Whoever is given the Record in his right hand
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:8: shall be called to an easy accounting,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:9: and shall return to his people joyfully.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:10: But he who is given the Record behind his back,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:12: and will enter the Blazing Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:13: He used to live joyfully among his people,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:14: thinking he would never revert (to Us).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:15: But no; (how would he not revert)? His Lord was ever watching him.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:16: Nay; I swear by the twilight;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:17: and by the night and what it enfolds,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:18: and by the moon, when it reaches its fullness:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:19: you shall proceed onwards from stage to stage.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:20: So, what is the matter with them that they do not believe,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:21: and when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate themselves?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:22: Instead, the unbelievers reject it, calling it a lie.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:23: Allah knows best what they are accumulating (in their Record).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:24: So give them the good news of a painful chastisement,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).84:25: except for those who believe and do good deeds. Theirs shall be an unending reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:1: By the heaven with its impregnable castles;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:3: and by the witness and what is witnessed:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:4: the people of the pit were destroyed
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:7: and were witnessing what they did to the believers.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:8: Against these they had no grudge except that they believed in Allah, the Most Mighty, the Most Praiseworthy,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:9: to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Allah witnesses everything.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:10: Surely those who tormented the believing men and the believing women and then did not repent, theirs shall be the chastisement of Hell, and theirs shall be the chastisement of burning.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:11: As for those who believed and acted righteously, theirs shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great triumph.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:12: Stern indeed is your Lord's punishment.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:13: He it is Who creates for the first time and He it is Who will create again,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:14: and He is the Ever Forgiving, the Most Loving
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:15: – the Lord of the Glorious Throne,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:16: the Executor of what He wills.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:17: Has the story of the armies reached you,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:18: the armies of Pharaoh and Thamud?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:19: The unbelievers are indeed engaged in denying it, calling it a lie,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).85:21: Nay; but this is a glorious Qur'an,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:1: By the heaven, and the night-visitor,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:2: what do you know what the night-visitor is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:4: There is no living being but there is a protector over it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:5: So let man consider of what he was created.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:6: He was created of a gushing fluid,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:7: emanating from between the loins and the ribs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:8: Surely He (the Creator) has the power to bring him back (to life).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:9: On the Day when man's deepest secrets shall be put to the test
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:10: he shall have no power, and no helper.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:11: By the heaven with its recurring cycle of rain,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:12: and by the earth ever bursting with verdure,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:13: this (Qur'an) is surely a decisive Word,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:16: and I too am devising a guile.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).86:17: So leave the unbelievers to themselves; respite them awhile.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:1: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:2: Who created all things and fashioned them in good proportion;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:5: and then made it into a blackish straw.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:6: We shall make you recite and then you will not forget,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:7: except what Allah should wish. He knows all that is manifest and all that is hidden.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:8: We shall ease you to follow the way of Ease.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:9: So render good counsel if good counsel will avail.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:10: He who fears (Allah) shall heed it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:11: but the wretched will turn away from it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:12: He will be cast into the Great Fire.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:13: Then he will neither die in it, nor live.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:14: He who purified himself shall prosper,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:15: remembering his Lord's name and praying.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:16: No; but you prefer the present life,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:17: whereas the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:18: This, indeed, was in the ancient Scrolls,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).87:19: the Scrolls of Abraham and Moses.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:1: Has the news of the overwhelming event reached you?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:2: Some faces that Day shall be downcast with fear,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:4: they shall burn in a Scorching Fire;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:5: their drink shall be from a boiling spring.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:6: They shall have no food except bitter dry thorns
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:7: that will neither nourish nor satisfy their hunger.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:8: On that very Day some faces shall be radiant with joy,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:10: They will be in a lofty Garden
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:11: wherein they shall hear no vain talk.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:12: In it there shall be a flowing spring,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:17: Do (these unbelievers) not observe the camels: how they were created?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:18: And the sky: how it was raised high?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:19: And the mountains: how they were fixed?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:20: And the earth: how it was spread out?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:21: So render good counsel, for you are simply required to counsel,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:22: and are not invested with the authority to compel them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:23: But whoever will turn away (from the Truth),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:24: Allah will chastise him with the most terrible chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:25: Surely to Us is their return;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).88:26: and then it is for Us to call them to account.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:3: and the even and the odd,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:4: and by the night when it departs.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:5: Is there in this an oath for one endowed with understanding?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:6: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with Ad
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:7: of Iram, known for their lofty columns,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:8: the like of whom no nation was ever created in the lands of the world?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:9: And how did He deal with Thamud who hewed out rocks in the valley?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:10: And with Pharaoh of the tent pegs
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:11: who transgressed in the countries of the world
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:13: Then their Lord unloosed upon them the lash of chastisement.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:14: Truly your Lord is ever watchful.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:15: As for man, when his Lord tests him by exalting him and bestowing His bounties upon him, he says: “My Lord has exalted me.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:16: But when He tests him by straitening his sustenance, he says: “My Lord has humiliated me.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:17: But no; you do not treat the orphan honourably,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:18: and do not urge one another to feed the poor,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:19: and greedily devour the entire inheritance,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:20: and love the riches, loving them ardently.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:21: But no; when the earth is ground to powder,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:22: and when your Lord appears with rows upon rows of angels,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:23: and when Hell is brought near that Day. On that Day will man understand, but of what avail will that understanding be?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:24: He will say: “Would that I had sent ahead what would be of avail for this life of mine!”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:25: Then on that Day Allah will chastise as none other can chastise;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:26: and Allah will bind as none other can bind.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:27: (On the other hand it will be said): “O serene soul!
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).89:28: Return to your Lord well-pleased (with your blissful destination), well-pleasing (to your Lord).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:1: Nay! I swear by this city
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:2: – this city wherein you have been rendered violable–
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:3: and I swear by the parent and his offspring:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:4: Verily We have created man into toil and hardship.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:5: Does he think that no one can overpower him?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:6: He says: “I have squandered enormous wealth.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:7: Does he believe that none has seen him?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:8: Did We not grant him two eyes,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:9: and a tongue and two lips?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:10: And did We not show him the two highroads (of good and evil)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:11: But he did not venture to scale the difficult steep.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:12: And what do you know what that difficult steep is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:13: It is freeing someone's neck from slavery;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:14: or giving food on a day of hunger
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:15: to an orphan near of kin;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:16: or to a destitute lying in dust;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:17: and, then besides this, he be one of those who believed, and enjoined upon one another steadfastness and enjoined upon one another compassion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:18: These are the People of the Right Hand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:19: As for those who rejected Our Signs, they are the People of the Left Hand.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).90:20: Upon them shall be a Fire that will hem them in.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:1: By the sun and its heat and brightness,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:2: and by the moon as it follows it;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:3: and by the day as it displays the sun's glory,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:4: and by the night as it envelopes the sun;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:5: and by the sky and by Him Who made it;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:6: and by the earth and by Him Who stretched it out;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:7: and by the soul and by Him Who perfectly proportioned it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:8: and imbued it with (the consciousness of) its evil and its piety:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:9: He who purifies it will prosper,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:10: and he who suppresses it will be ruined.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:11: In their presumptuous insolence the Thamud called the Truth a lie
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:12: when their arch-criminal rose up in rage.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:13: Then Allah's Messenger warned them: “Hands off the she-camel and her drink!”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:14: But they rejected his statement as a lie and hamstrung the she-camel. For that crime their Lord rumbled down upon them, utterly razing them to the ground.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).91:15: He has no fear of its sequel.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:1: By the night when it enshrouds,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:2: and by the day when it breaks in its glory,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:3: and by Him Who created the male and the female:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:5: As for him who gave out his wealth (for Allah's sake) and abstained (from disobeying Him),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:6: and affirmed the Truth of goodness:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:7: We shall facilitate for him the Way to Bliss.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:8: As for him who was a miser and behaved with aversion (to Allah),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:9: and denied the Truth of goodness:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:10: We shall facilitate for him the way to Hardship,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:11: and his wealth shall be of no avail to him when he perishes.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:12: Surely it is for Us to show the Right Way,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:13: and to Us belong the Next Life and the present.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:14: I have now warned you of a Blazing Fire,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:15: where none shall burn except the most wicked,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:16: who rejected the Truth, calling it falsehood and turned his back on it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:17: But the God-fearing shall be kept away from it,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:18: the Godfearing who spends his wealth to purify himself;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:19: not as payment for any favours that he received,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:20: but only to seek the good pleasure of his Lord Most High.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).92:21: He will surely be well-pleased (with him).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:2: and by the night when it covers the world with peace:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:3: (O Prophet), your Lord has neither forsaken you, nor is He displeased.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:4: Indeed what is to come will be better for you than what has gone by.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:5: Verily your Lord will soon give you so amply that you will be well-pleased.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:6: Did He not find you an orphan and then gave you shelter?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:7: Did He not find you unaware of the Right Way, and then directed you to it?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:8: And did He not find you in want, and then enriched you?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:9: Therefore, be not harsh with the orphan;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:10: and chide not him who asks,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).93:11: and proclaim the bounty of your Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).94:1: (O Prophet), Did We not lay open your breast
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).94:2: and relieve you of the burden
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).94:3: that had well-nigh broken your back?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).94:4: And did We not exalt your fame?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).94:5: Indeed, there is ease with hardship.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).94:6: Most certainly, there is ease with hardship.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).94:7: So, whenever you are free, strive in devotion,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).94:8: and turn to your Lord with longing.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).95:1: By the fig and the olive;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).95:3: and by this city (of Makkah), a haven of peace:
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).95:4: surely We created man in the best mould;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).95:5: then We reverted him to the lowest of the low,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).95:6: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. Theirs is a never ending reward.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).95:7: Who, then, can give the lie to you, (O Prophet), about the Reward and the Punishment?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).95:8: Is not Allah the Greatest of all sovereigns?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:1: Recite in the name of your Lord Who created,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:2: created man from a clot of congealed blood.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:3: Recite: and your Lord is Most Generous,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:5: taught man what he did not know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:7: for he believes himself to be self-sufficient.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:8: Surely to your Lord is your return.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:9: Did you see him who forbids
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:10: a servant (of Allah) when he prays?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:11: Did you consider: what if he is on the Right Way,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:13: Did you consider: what if he gives the lie (to the Truth) and turns away (from it)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:14: Does he not know that Allah sees everything?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:15: No indeed; if he does not desist, We shall drag him by the forelock;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:16: by the lying forelock steeped in sin.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:17: So let him summon his helpmates;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:18: We too shall summon the guards of Hell.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).96:19: No, not at all. Never obey him. But prostrate yourself and become nigh (to your Lord).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).97:1: Behold, We revealed this (Qur'an) on the Night of Power.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).97:2: And what do you know what the Night of Power is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).97:3: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).97:4: The angels along with the Spirit descend in it by the permission of their Lord with all kinds of decrees.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).97:5: All peace is that night until the rise of dawn.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).98:1: Those who disbelieved – be they from the People of the Book or from those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity – will not desist from unbelief until the Clear Proof should come to them;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).98:2: a Messenger from Allah, reciting from Purified Scrolls;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).98:3: in writings wherein are scriptures, absolutely true and unerring.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).98:4: Nor did those to whom the Book had been given split up until after the Proof (of the Right Way) had come to them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).98:5: Yet all that they had been commanded was that they serve Allah, with utter sincerity, devoting themselves exclusively to Him, and that they establish Prayer and pay Zakah. That is the Right Faith.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).98:6: Those who disbelieved – be they from among the People of the Book or among those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity– shall be in the Fire, and will abide in it. They are the worst of creatures.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).98:7: But those that believe and work righteous deeds, they are the best of creatures.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).98:8: Their recompense lies with their Lord: Gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall dwell, forever and ever. Allah is well-pleased with them, and they are well-pleased with Him. All this is for him who fears his Lord.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).99:1: When the earth will be shaken with a mighty shaking,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).99:2: and the earth will throw up all her burdens,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).99:3: and man will cry out: “What is the matter with her?”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).99:4: On that Day it will relate all her news,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).99:5: for your Lord will have commanded her (to do so).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).99:6: On that Day people will go forth in varying states so that they be shown their deeds.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).99:7: So, whoever does an atom's weight of good shall see it;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).99:8: and whoever does an atom's weight of evil shall see it.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:2: then raise sparks of fire (by their hoofs),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:4: and blaze a trail of dust,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:5: and penetrate deep into a host.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:6: Verily man is most ungrateful to his Lord;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:7: and he himself is a witness to that,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:8: and surely he loves riches with a passionate loving.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:9: Is he not aware that when whatever lies (buried) in the graves is overthrown;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:10: and the secrets of the hearts are laid bare (and examined)?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).100:11: Surely on that Day will their Lord be fully informed about them.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).101:3: And what do you know what the Calamity is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).101:4: On that Day human beings shall be like scattered moths,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).101:5: and the mountains shall be like fluffs of carded wool in varying colours.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).101:6: Then he whose scales weigh heavier
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).101:8: but he whose scales weigh lighter,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).101:9: his shall be the deep pit for a dwelling.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).101:10: And what do you know what that is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).102:1: The craving for ever-greater worldly gains and to excel others in that regard keeps you occupied
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).102:3: Nay, you will soon come to know;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).102:4: nay, again, you shall soon come to know.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).102:5: Nay, would that you knew with certainty of knowledge (what your attitude will lead to, you would never have acted the way you do).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).102:6: You will surely end up seeing Hell;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).102:7: again, you shall most certainly end up seeing it with absolute certainty.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).102:8: Then, on that Day, you will be called to account for all the bounties you enjoyed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).103:2: Lo! Man is in a state of loss;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).103:3: save those who have faith and do righteous deeds, and counsel each other to hold on to truth and counsel each other to be steadfast.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).104:2: who amasses wealth and counts it over and again.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).104:3: He thinks that his wealth will immortalise him forever.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).104:4: Nay, he shall be thrown into the Crusher.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).104:5: And what do you know what the Crusher is?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).104:6: It is the Fire kindled by Allah,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).104:7: the Fire that shall rise to the hearts (of criminals).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).104:8: Verily it will close in upon them,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).105:1: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the people of the elephants?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).105:2: Did He not bring their plan to naught?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).105:3: And He sent against them swarms of birds
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).105:4: which smote them with stones of baked clay,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).105:5: and made them like straw eaten up (by cattle).
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).106:2: accustomed to the journey of winter and summer,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).106:3: therefore, let them worship the Lord of this House;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).106:4: Who fed them against hunger, and secured them against fear.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).107:1: Did you see him who gives the lie to the Reward and Punishment of the Hereafter?
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).107:2: Such is the one who repulses the orphans away,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).107:3: and urges not the feeding of the needy.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).107:4: Woe, then, to those who pray,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).107:5: but are heedless in their Prayers,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).107:6: those who do good (in order) to be seen,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).107:7: and deny people the articles of common necessity.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).108:1: (O Prophet), We have surely bestowed upon you good in abundance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).108:2: So offer Prayer and sacrifice to your Lord alone.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).108:3: Verily your enemy alone has been cut off from the roots.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).109:2: I do not worship those that you worship
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).109:3: neither do you worship Him Whom I worship;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).109:4: nor will I worship those whom you have worshipped;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).109:5: nor are you going to worship Him Whom I worship.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).109:6: To you is your religion, and to me, my religion.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).110:1: When the help comes from Allah, and victory (is granted),
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).110:2: and you see people entering Allah's religion in multitudes,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).110:3: then extol the praise of your Lord and pray to Him for forgiveness. For He indeed is ever disposed to accept repentance.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).111:1: Destroyed were the hands of Abu Lahab, and he lay utterly doomed.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).111:2: His wealth did not avail him, nor his acquisitions.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).111:3: Surely, he will be cast into a Flaming Fire
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).111:4: along with his wife, that carrier of slanderous tales;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).111:5: upon her neck shall be a rope of palm-fibre.
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).112:1: Say: “He is Allah, the One and Unique;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).112:2: Allah, Who is in need of none and of Whom all are in need;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).112:3: He neither begot any nor was He begotten,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).112:4: and none is comparable to Him.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).113:1: Say: “I seek refuge with the Lord of the rising day;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).113:2: from the evil of all that He created;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).113:3: from the evil of night's darkness when it spreads around;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).113:4: from the evil of the women who blow on knots;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).113:5: and from the evil of the envier when he envies.”
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).114:1: Say: “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).114:4: from the mischief of the whispering, elusive prompter who returns again and again,
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).114:5: who whispers in the hearts of people;
A. Maududi (Tafhim commentary).114:6: whether he be from the jinn or humans.”

M. Pickthall.1:1: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
M. Pickthall.1:2: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,
M. Pickthall.1:4: Master of the Day of Judgment,
M. Pickthall.1:5: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.
M. Pickthall.1:7: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.
M. Pickthall.2:2: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).
M. Pickthall.2:3: Who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them;
M. Pickthall.2:4: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.
M. Pickthall.2:5: These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.
M. Pickthall.2:6: As for the Disbelievers, Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not it is all one for them; they believe not.
M. Pickthall.2:7: Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom.
M. Pickthall.2:8: And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not.
M. Pickthall.2:9: They think to beguile Allah and those who believe, and they beguile none save themselves; but they perceive not.
M. Pickthall.2:10: In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie.
M. Pickthall.2:11: And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only.
M. Pickthall.2:12: Are not they indeed the mischief-makers? But they perceive not.
M. Pickthall.2:13: And when it is said unto them: believe as the people believe, they say: shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish? But they know not.
M. Pickthall.2:14: And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe; but when they go apart to their devils they declare: Lo! we are with you; verily we did but mock.
M. Pickthall.2:15: Allah (Himself) doth mock them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their contumacy.
M. Pickthall.2:16: These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided.
M. Pickthall.2:17: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see,
M. Pickthall.2:18: Deaf, dumb and blind; and they return not.
M. Pickthall.2:19: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder and the flash of lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears by reason of the thunder-claps, for fear of death, Allah encompasseth the disbelievers (in His guidance, His omniscience and His omnipotence).
M. Pickthall.2:20: The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things.
M. Pickthall.2:21: O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you and those before you, so that ye may ward off (evil).
M. Pickthall.2:22: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).
M. Pickthall.2:23: And if ye are in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto Our slave (Muhammad), then produce a surah of the like thereof, and call your witness beside Allah if ye are truthful.
M. Pickthall.2:24: And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones.
M. Pickthall.2:25: And give glad tidings (O Muhammad) unto those who believe and do good works; that theirs are Gardens underneath which rivers flow; as often as they are regaled with food of the fruit thereof, they say: this is what was given us aforetime; and it is given to them in resemblance. There for them are pure companions; there for ever they abide.
M. Pickthall.2:26: Lo! Allah disdaineth not to coin the similitude even of a gnat. Those who believe know that it is the truth from their Lord; but those who disbelieve say: What doth Allah wish (to teach) by such a similitude? He misleadeth many thereby, and He guideth many thereby; and He misleadeth thereby only miscreants;
M. Pickthall.2:27: Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers.
M. Pickthall.2:28: How disbelieve ye in Allah when ye were dead and He gave life to you! Then He will give you death, then life again, and then unto Him ye will return.
M. Pickthall.2:29: He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth. Then turned He to the heaven, and fashioned it as seven heavens. And He is knower of all things.
M. Pickthall.2:30: And when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to place a viceroy in the earth, they said: Wilt thou place therein one who will do harm therein and will shed blood, while we, we hymn Thy praise and sanctify Thee? He said: Surely I know that which ye know not.
M. Pickthall.2:31: And He taught Adam all the names, then showed them to the angels, saying: Inform Me of the names of these, if ye are truthful.
M. Pickthall.2:32: They said: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise.
M. Pickthall.2:33: He said: O Adam! Inform them of their names, and when he had informed them of their names, He said: Did I not tell you that I know the secret of the heavens and the earth? And I know that which ye disclose and which ye hide.
M. Pickthall.2:34: And when We said unto the angels: Prostrate yourselves before Adam, they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He demurred through pride, and so became a disbeliever.
M. Pickthall.2:35: And We said: O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden, and eat ye freely (of the fruits) thereof where ye will; but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.
M. Pickthall.2:36: But Satan caused them to deflect therefrom and expelled them from the (happy) state in which they were; and We said: Fall down, one of you a foe unto the other! There shall be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a time.
M. Pickthall.2:37: Then Adam received from his Lord words (of revelation), and He relented toward him. Lo! He is the relenting, the Merciful.
M. Pickthall.2:38: We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
M. Pickthall.2:39: But they who disbelieve, and deny Our revelations, such are rightful Peoples of the Fire. They will abide therein.
M. Pickthall.2:40: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you, and fulfil your (part of the) covenant, I shall fulfil My (part of the) covenant, and fear Me.
M. Pickthall.2:41: And believe in that which I reveal, confirming that which ye possess already (of the Scripture), and be not first to disbelieve therein, and part not with My revelations for a trifling price, and keep your duty unto Me.
M. Pickthall.2:42: Confound not truth with falsehood, nor knowingly conceal the truth.
M. Pickthall.2:43: Establish worship, pay the poor-due, and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship).
M. Pickthall.2:44: Enjoin ye righteousness upon mankind while ye yourselves forget (to practise it)? And ye are readers of the Scripture! Have ye then no sense?
M. Pickthall.2:45: Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded,
M. Pickthall.2:46: Who know that they will have to meet their Lord, and that unto Him they are returning.
M. Pickthall.2:47: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you and how I preferred you to (all) creatures.
M. Pickthall.2:48: And guard yourselves against a day when no soul will in aught avail another, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be received from it, nor will they be helped.
M. Pickthall.2:49: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk, who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaying your sons and sparing your women: that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.
M. Pickthall.2:50: And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.
M. Pickthall.2:51: And when We did appoint for Moses forty nights (of solitude), and then ye chose the calf, when he had gone from you, and were wrong-doers.
M. Pickthall.2:52: Then, even after that, We pardoned you in order that ye might give thanks.
M. Pickthall.2:53: And when We gave unto Moses the Scripture and the criterion (of right and wrong), that ye might be led aright.
M. Pickthall.2:54: And when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Ye have wronged yourselves by your choosing of the calf (for worship) so turn in penitence to your Creator, and kill (the guilty) yourselves. That will be best for you with your Creator and He will relent toward you. Lo! He is the Relenting, the Merciful.
M. Pickthall.2:55: And when ye said: O Moses! We will not believe in thee till we see Allah plainly; and even while ye gazed the lightning seized you.
M. Pickthall.2:56: Then We revived you after your extinction, that ye might give thanks.
M. Pickthall.2:57: And We caused the white cloud to overshadow you and sent down on you the manna and the quails, (saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you - they wronged Us not, but they did wrong themselves.
M. Pickthall.2:58: And when We said: Go into this township and eat freely of that which is therein, and enter the gate prostrate, and say: "Repentance." We will forgive you your sins and will increase (reward) for the right-doers.
M. Pickthall.2:59: But those who did wrong changed the word which had been told them for another saying, and We sent down upon the evil-doers wrath from heaven for their evil-doing.
M. Pickthall.2:60: And when Moses asked for water for his people, We said: Smite with thy staff the rock. And there gushed out therefrom twelve springs (so that) each tribe knew their drinking-place. Eat and drink of that which Allah hath provided, and do not act corruptly, making mischief in the earth.
M. Pickthall.2:61: And when ye said: O Moses! We are weary of one kind of food; so call upon thy Lord for us that He bring forth for us of that which the earth groweth - of its herbs and its cucumbers and its corn and its lentils and its onions. He said: Would ye exchange that which is higher for that which is lower? Go down to settled country, thus ye shall get that which ye demand. And humiliation and wretchedness were stamped upon them and they were visited with wrath from Allah. That was because they disbelieved in Allah's revelations and slew the prophets wrongfully. That was for their disobedience and transgression.
M. Pickthall.2:62: Lo! Those who believe (in that which is revealed unto thee, Muhammad), and those who are Jews, and Christians, and Sabaeans - whoever believeth in Allah and the Last Day and doeth right - surely their reward is with their Lord, and there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
M. Pickthall.2:63: And (remember, O Children of Israel) when We made a covenant with you and caused the mount to tower above you, (saying): Hold fast that which We have given you, and remember that which is therein, that ye may ward off (evil).
M. Pickthall.2:64: Then, even after that, ye turned away, and if it had not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy ye had been among the losers.
M. Pickthall.2:65: And ye know of those of you who broke the Sabbath, how We said unto them: Be ye apes, despised and hated!
M. Pickthall.2:66: And We made it an example to their own and to succeeding generations, and an admonition to the Allah-fearing.
M. Pickthall.2:67: And when Moses said unto his people: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow, they said: Dost thou make game of us? He answered: Allah forbid that I should be among the foolish!
M. Pickthall.2:68: They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us what (cow) she is. (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith, Verily she is a cow neither with calf nor immature; (she is) between the two conditions; so do that which ye are commanded.
M. Pickthall.2:69: They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us of what colour she is. (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith: Verily she is a yellow cow. Bright is her colour, gladdening beholders.
M. Pickthall.2:70: They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us what (cow) she is. Lo! cows are much alike to us; and Lo! if Allah wills, we may be led aright.
M. Pickthall.2:71: (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith: Verily she is a cow unyoked; she plougheth not the soil nor watereth the tilth; whole and without mark. They said: Now thou bringest the truth. So they sacrificed her, though almost they did not.
M. Pickthall.2:72: And (remember) when ye slew a man and disagreed concerning it and Allah brought forth that which ye were hiding.
M. Pickthall.2:73: And We said: Smite him with some of it. Thus Allah bringeth the dead to life and showeth you His portents so that ye may understand.
M. Pickthall.2:74: Then, even after that, your hearts were hardened and became as rocks, or worse than rocks, for hardness. For indeed there are rocks from out which rivers gush, and indeed there are rocks which split asunder so that water floweth from them. And indeed there are rocks which fall down for the fear of Allah. Allah is not unaware of what ye do.
M. Pickthall.2:75: Have ye any hope that they will be true to you when a party of them used to listen to the word of Allah, then used to change it, after they had understood it, knowingly?
M. Pickthall.2:76: And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe. But when they go apart one with another they say: Prate ye to them of that which Allah hath disclosed to you that they may contend with you before your Lord concerning it? Have ye then no sense?
M. Pickthall.2:77: Are they then unaware that Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim?
M. Pickthall.2:78: Among them are unlettered folk who know the Scripture not except from hearsay. They but guess.
M. Pickthall.2:79: Therefore woe be unto those who write the Scripture with their hands and then say, "This is from Allah," that they may purchase a small gain therewith. Woe unto them for that their hands have written, and woe unto them for that they earn thereby.
M. Pickthall.2:80: And they say: The Fire (of punishment) will not touch us save for a certain number of days. Say: Have ye received a covenant from Allah - truly Allah will not break His covenant - or tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?
M. Pickthall.2:81: Nay, but whosoever hath done evil and his sin surroundeth him; such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.
M. Pickthall.2:82: And those who believe and do good works: such are rightful owners of the Garden. They will abide therein.
M. Pickthall.2:83: And (remember) when We made a covenant with the Children of Israel, (saying): Worship none save Allah (only), and be good to parents and to kindred and to orphans and the needy, and speak kindly to mankind; and establish worship and pay the poor-due. Then, after that, ye slid back, save a few of you, being averse.
M. Pickthall.2:84: And when We made with you a covenant (saying): Shed not the blood of your people nor turn (a party of) your people out of your dwellings. Then ye ratified (Our covenant) and ye were witnesses (thereto).
M. Pickthall.2:85: Yet ye it is who slay each other and drive out a party of your people from their homes, supporting one another against them by sin and transgression? - and if they came to you as captives ye would ransom them, whereas their expulsion was itself unlawful for you - Believe ye in part of the Scripture and disbelieve ye in part thereof? And what is the reward of those who do so save ignominy in the life of the world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be consigned to the most grievous doom. For Allah is not unaware of what ye do.
M. Pickthall.2:86: Such are those who buy the life of the world at the price of the Hereafter. Their punishment will not be lightened, neither will they have support.
M. Pickthall.2:87: And verily We gave unto Moses the Scripture and We caused a train of messengers to follow after him, and We gave unto Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs (of Allah's sovereignty), and We supported him with the Holy spirit. Is it ever so, that, when there cometh unto you a messenger (from Allah) with that which ye yourselves desire not, ye grow arrogant, and some ye disbelieve and some ye slay?
M. Pickthall.2:88: And they say: Our hearts are hardened. Nay, but Allah hath cursed them for their unbelief. Little is that which they believe.
M.
