A. Yusuf Ali.67:8: Almost bursting with fury: Every time a Group is cast therein, its Keepers will ask, "Did no Warner come to you?"
A. Yusuf Ali.67:9: They will say: "Yes indeed; a Warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said, 'Allah never sent down any (Message): ye are nothing but an egregious delusion!'"
A. Yusuf Ali.67:10: They will further say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we should not (now) be among the Companions of the Blazing Fire!"
A. Yusuf Ali.67:11: They will then confess their sins: but far will be (Forgiveness) from the Companions of the Blazing Fire!
A. Yusuf Ali.67:12: As for those who fear their Lord unseen, for them is Forgiveness and a great Reward.
A. Yusuf Ali.67:13: And whether ye hide your word or publish it, He certainly has (full) knowledge, of the secrets of (all) hearts.
A. Yusuf Ali.67:14: Should He not know,- He that created? and He is the One that understands the finest mysteries (and) is well-acquainted (with them).
A. Yusuf Ali.67:15: It is He Who has made the earth manageable for you, so traverse ye through its tracts and enjoy of the Sustenance which He furnishes: but unto Him is the Resurrection.
A. Yusuf Ali.67:16: Do ye feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not cause you to be swallowed up by the earth when it shakes (as in an earthquake)?
A. Yusuf Ali.67:17: Or do ye feel secure that He Who is in Heaven will not send against you a violent tornado (with showers of stones), so that ye shall know how (terrible) was My warning?
A. Yusuf Ali.67:18: But indeed men before them rejected (My warning): then how (terrible) was My rejection (of them)?
A. Yusuf Ali.67:19: Do they not observe the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them in? None can uphold them except (Allah) Most Gracious: truly it is He that watches over all things.
A. Yusuf Ali.67:20: Nay, who is there that can help you, (even as) an army, besides (Allah) Most Merciful? In nothing but delusion are the Unbelievers.
A. Yusuf Ali.67:21: Or who is there that can provide you with Sustenance if He were to withhold His provision? Nay, they obstinately persist in insolent impiety and flight (from the Truth).
A. Yusuf Ali.67:22: Is then one who walks headlong, with his face grovelling, better guided,- or one who walks evenly on a Straight Way?
A. Yusuf Ali.67:23: Say: "It is He Who has created you (and made you grow), and made for you the faculties of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give.
A. Yusuf Ali.67:24: Say: "It is He Who has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered together."
A. Yusuf Ali.67:25: They ask: When will this promise be (fulfilled)? - If ye are telling the truth.
A. Yusuf Ali.67:26: Say: "As to the knowledge of the time, it is with Allah alone: I am (sent) only to warn plainly in public."
A. Yusuf Ali.67:27: At length, when they see it close at hand, grieved will be the faces of the Unbelievers, and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise fulfilled), which ye were calling for!"
A. Yusuf Ali.67:28: Say: "See ye?- If Allah were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty?"
A. Yusuf Ali.67:29: Say: "He is (Allah) Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which (of us) it is that is in manifest error."
A. Yusuf Ali.67:30: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost (in the underground earth), who then can supply you with clear-flowing water?"
A. Yusuf Ali.68:1: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write,-
A. Yusuf Ali.68:2: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:3: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing:
A. Yusuf Ali.68:4: And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:5: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see,
A. Yusuf Ali.68:6: Which of you is afflicted with madness.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:7: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:8: So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth).
A. Yusuf Ali.68:9: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:10: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths,
A. Yusuf Ali.68:11: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,
A. Yusuf Ali.68:12: (Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin,
A. Yusuf Ali.68:13: Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born,-
A. Yusuf Ali.68:14: Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:15: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries!
A. Yusuf Ali.68:16: Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout!
A. Yusuf Ali.68:17: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:18: But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will").
A. Yusuf Ali.68:19: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:20: So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered).
A. Yusuf Ali.68:21: As the morning broke, they called out, one to another,-
A. Yusuf Ali.68:22: "Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits."
A. Yusuf Ali.68:23: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)-
A. Yusuf Ali.68:24: "Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day."
A. Yusuf Ali.68:25: And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:26: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way:
A. Yusuf Ali.68:27: "Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)!"
A. Yusuf Ali.68:28: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)?'"
A. Yusuf Ali.68:29: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong!"
A. Yusuf Ali.68:30: Then they turned, one against another, in reproach.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:31: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!
A. Yusuf Ali.68:32: "It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)!"
A. Yusuf Ali.68:33: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew!
A. Yusuf Ali.68:34: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:35: Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin?
A. Yusuf Ali.68:36: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
A. Yusuf Ali.68:37: Or have ye a book through which ye learn-
A. Yusuf Ali.68:38: That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?
A. Yusuf Ali.68:39: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand?
A. Yusuf Ali.68:40: Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that!
A. Yusuf Ali.68:41: Or have they some “ Partners ” (in Godhead)? Then let them produce Their “ partners ”,  If they are truthful !
A. Yusuf Ali.68:42: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able,-
A. Yusuf Ali.68:43: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).
A. Yusuf Ali.68:44: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:45: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:46: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
A. Yusuf Ali.68:47: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down?
A. Yusuf Ali.68:48: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:49: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:50: Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous.
A. Yusuf Ali.68:51: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"
A. Yusuf Ali.68:52: But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:3: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
A. Yusuf Ali.69:4: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:5: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:6: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;
A. Yusuf Ali.69:7: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:8: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?
A. Yusuf Ali.69:9: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:10: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:11: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),
A. Yusuf Ali.69:12: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:13: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,
A. Yusuf Ali.69:14: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-
A. Yusuf Ali.69:15: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:16: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,
A. Yusuf Ali.69:17: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:18: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:19: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:20: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"
A. Yusuf Ali.69:21: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
A. Yusuf Ali.69:23: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:24: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"
A. Yusuf Ali.69:25: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:26: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:27: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:28: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:30: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,
A. Yusuf Ali.69:31: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:32: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:33: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:34: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:35: "So no friend hath he here this Day.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:36: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
A. Yusuf Ali.69:37: "Which none do eat but those in sin."
A. Yusuf Ali.69:38: So I do call to witness what ye see,
A. Yusuf Ali.69:40: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;
A. Yusuf Ali.69:41: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!
A. Yusuf Ali.69:42: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:43: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:44: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,
A. Yusuf Ali.69:45: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,
A. Yusuf Ali.69:46: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:
A. Yusuf Ali.69:47: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).
A. Yusuf Ali.69:48: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:49: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).
A. Yusuf Ali.69:50: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:51: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.
A. Yusuf Ali.69:52: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
A. Yusuf Ali.70:1: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:2: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:3: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
A. Yusuf Ali.70:4: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:
A. Yusuf Ali.70:5: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
A. Yusuf Ali.70:6: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):
A. Yusuf Ali.70:8: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,
A. Yusuf Ali.70:9: And the mountains will be like wool,
A. Yusuf Ali.70:10: And no friend will ask after a friend,
A. Yusuf Ali.70:11: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,
A. Yusuf Ali.70:14: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:
A. Yusuf Ali.70:15: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:16: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:17: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
A. Yusuf Ali.70:18: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
A. Yusuf Ali.70:19: Truly man was created very impatient;-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:21: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:22: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:23: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
A. Yusuf Ali.70:24: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
A. Yusuf Ali.70:25: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
A. Yusuf Ali.70:26: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
A. Yusuf Ali.70:27: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:28: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:29: And those who guard their chastity,
A. Yusuf Ali.70:30: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
A. Yusuf Ali.70:31: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:32: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
A. Yusuf Ali.70:33: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
A. Yusuf Ali.70:34: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:35: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
A. Yusuf Ali.70:36: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:37: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
A. Yusuf Ali.70:38: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
A. Yusuf Ali.70:39: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
A. Yusuf Ali.70:40: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:41: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
A. Yusuf Ali.70:42: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:43: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
A. Yusuf Ali.70:44: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
A. Yusuf Ali.71:1: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
A. Yusuf Ali.71:2: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
A. Yusuf Ali.71:3: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:
A. Yusuf Ali.71:4: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
A. Yusuf Ali.71:5: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
A. Yusuf Ali.71:6: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
A. Yusuf Ali.71:7: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
A. Yusuf Ali.71:8: "So I have called to them aloud;
A. Yusuf Ali.71:9: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
A. Yusuf Ali.71:10: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
A. Yusuf Ali.71:11: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
A. Yusuf Ali.71:12: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
A. Yusuf Ali.71:13: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-
A. Yusuf Ali.71:14: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
A. Yusuf Ali.71:15: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
A. Yusuf Ali.71:16: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
A. Yusuf Ali.71:17: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
A. Yusuf Ali.71:18: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
A. Yusuf Ali.71:19: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
A. Yusuf Ali.71:20: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"
A. Yusuf Ali.71:21: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
A. Yusuf Ali.71:22: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
A. Yusuf Ali.71:23: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-
A. Yusuf Ali.71:24: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."
A. Yusuf Ali.71:25: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.
A. Yusuf Ali.71:26: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
A. Yusuf Ali.71:27: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
A. Yusuf Ali.71:28: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
A. Yusuf Ali.72:1: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
A. Yusuf Ali.72:2: 'It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:3: 'And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:4: 'There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah;
A. Yusuf Ali.72:5: 'But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:6: 'True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:7: 'And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment).
A. Yusuf Ali.72:8: 'And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:9: 'We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:10: 'And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:11: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:12: 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:13: 'And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:14: 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
A. Yusuf Ali.72:15: 'But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire'-
A. Yusuf Ali.72:16: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:17: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:18: "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;
A. Yusuf Ali.72:19: "Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."
A. Yusuf Ali.72:20: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."
A. Yusuf Ali.72:21: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."
A. Yusuf Ali.72:22: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,
A. Yusuf Ali.72:23: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."
A. Yusuf Ali.72:24: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:25: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
A. Yusuf Ali.72:26: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-
A. Yusuf Ali.72:27: "Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,
A. Yusuf Ali.72:28: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."
A. Yusuf Ali.73:2: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-
A. Yusuf Ali.73:3: Half of it,- or a little less,
A. Yusuf Ali.73:4: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:5: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:6: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
A. Yusuf Ali.73:7: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
A. Yusuf Ali.73:8: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:9: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:10: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
A. Yusuf Ali.73:11: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:12: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
A. Yusuf Ali.73:13: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:14: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:15: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:16: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:17: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-
A. Yusuf Ali.73:18: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.
A. Yusuf Ali.73:19: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!
A. Yusuf Ali.73:20: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
A. Yusuf Ali.74:1: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:3: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:4: And thy garments keep free from stain!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:6: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:7: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:8: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
A. Yusuf Ali.74:9: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:10: Far from easy for those without Faith.
A. Yusuf Ali.74:11: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:12: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
A. Yusuf Ali.74:13: And sons to be by his side!-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:14: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:15: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:16: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:17: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:18: For he thought and he plotted;-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:19: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:20: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:22: Then he frowned and he scowled;
A. Yusuf Ali.74:23: Then he turned back and was haughty;
A. Yusuf Ali.74:24: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
A. Yusuf Ali.74:25: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
A. Yusuf Ali.74:26: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:27: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
A. Yusuf Ali.74:28: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:29: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:31: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
A. Yusuf Ali.74:33: And by the Night as it retreateth,
A. Yusuf Ali.74:34: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:35: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
A. Yusuf Ali.74:37: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:38: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
A. Yusuf Ali.74:39: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
A. Yusuf Ali.74:40: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
A. Yusuf Ali.74:43: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
A. Yusuf Ali.74:44: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
A. Yusuf Ali.74:45: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
A. Yusuf Ali.74:46: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
A. Yusuf Ali.74:47: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
A. Yusuf Ali.74:48: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
A. Yusuf Ali.74:49: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
A. Yusuf Ali.74:50: As if they were affrighted asses,
A. Yusuf Ali.74:52: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:53: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
A. Yusuf Ali.74:54: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
A. Yusuf Ali.74:55: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
A. Yusuf Ali.74:56: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:1: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;
A. Yusuf Ali.75:2: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
A. Yusuf Ali.75:3: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?
A. Yusuf Ali.75:4: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:5: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:6: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
A. Yusuf Ali.75:7: At length, when the sight is dazed,
A. Yusuf Ali.75:8: And the moon is buried in darkness.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:9: And the sun and moon are joined together,-
A. Yusuf Ali.75:10: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"
A. Yusuf Ali.75:11: By no means! No place of safety!
A. Yusuf Ali.75:12: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:13: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:14: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,
A. Yusuf Ali.75:15: Even though he were to put up his excuses.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:16: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:17: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
A. Yusuf Ali.75:18: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
A. Yusuf Ali.75:19: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):
A. Yusuf Ali.75:20: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,
A. Yusuf Ali.75:22: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
A. Yusuf Ali.75:24: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,
A. Yusuf Ali.75:25: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;
A. Yusuf Ali.75:26: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),
A. Yusuf Ali.75:27: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"
A. Yusuf Ali.75:28: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;
A. Yusuf Ali.75:29: And one leg will be joined with another:
A. Yusuf Ali.75:30: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!
A. Yusuf Ali.75:31: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-
A. Yusuf Ali.75:32: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!
A. Yusuf Ali.75:33: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!
A. Yusuf Ali.75:34: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
A. Yusuf Ali.75:35: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
A. Yusuf Ali.75:36: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?
A. Yusuf Ali.75:37: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
A. Yusuf Ali.75:38: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:39: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.
A. Yusuf Ali.75:40: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
A. Yusuf Ali.76:1: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
A. Yusuf Ali.76:2: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:3: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
A. Yusuf Ali.76:4: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:5: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
A. Yusuf Ali.76:6: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:7: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:8: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
A. Yusuf Ali.76:9: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:10: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
A. Yusuf Ali.76:11: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:12: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:13: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:14: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:15: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
A. Yusuf Ali.76:16: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
A. Yusuf Ali.76:17: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
A. Yusuf Ali.76:19: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:20: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:21: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:22: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
A. Yusuf Ali.76:23: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:24: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:25: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,
A. Yusuf Ali.76:26: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:27: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:28: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:29: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:30: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
A. Yusuf Ali.76:31: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:1: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);
A. Yusuf Ali.77:2: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
A. Yusuf Ali.77:4: Then separate them, one from another,
A. Yusuf Ali.77:6: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
A. Yusuf Ali.77:7: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:8: Then when the stars become dim;
A. Yusuf Ali.77:9: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
A. Yusuf Ali.77:10: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
A. Yusuf Ali.77:11: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
A. Yusuf Ali.77:12: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
A. Yusuf Ali.77:13: For the Day of Sorting out.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:14: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
A. Yusuf Ali.77:15: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:16: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
A. Yusuf Ali.77:17: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:18: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:19: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:20: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
A. Yusuf Ali.77:21: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
A. Yusuf Ali.77:22: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
A. Yusuf Ali.77:23: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
A. Yusuf Ali.77:24: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:25: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:27: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
A. Yusuf Ali.77:28: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:29: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:30: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
A. Yusuf Ali.77:31: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:32: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
A. Yusuf Ali.77:33: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
A. Yusuf Ali.77:34: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:35: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:36: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:37: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:38: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:39: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:40: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:41: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
A. Yusuf Ali.77:42: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:43: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
A. Yusuf Ali.77:44: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:45: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:46: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:47: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:48: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
A. Yusuf Ali.77:49: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
A. Yusuf Ali.77:50: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
A. Yusuf Ali.78:4: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!
A. Yusuf Ali.78:5: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!
A. Yusuf Ali.78:6: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:8: And (have We not) created you in pairs,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:9: And made your sleep for rest,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:10: And made the night as a covering,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:11: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
A. Yusuf Ali.78:12: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:13: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
A. Yusuf Ali.78:14: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:15: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:17: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:18: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
A. Yusuf Ali.78:19: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:20: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
A. Yusuf Ali.78:21: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:22: For the transgressors a place of destination:
A. Yusuf Ali.78:23: They will dwell therein for ages.
A. Yusuf Ali.78:24: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:25: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:27: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
A. Yusuf Ali.78:28: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
A. Yusuf Ali.78:29: And all things have We preserved on record.
A. Yusuf Ali.78:30: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
A. Yusuf Ali.78:31: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;
A. Yusuf Ali.78:33: And voluptuous women of equal age;
A. Yusuf Ali.78:34: And a cup full (to the brim).
A. Yusuf Ali.78:35: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
A. Yusuf Ali.78:36: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
A. Yusuf Ali.78:37: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
A. Yusuf Ali.78:38: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
A. Yusuf Ali.78:39: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
A. Yusuf Ali.78:40: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (mere) dust!"
A. Yusuf Ali.79:1: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
A. Yusuf Ali.79:2: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
A. Yusuf Ali.79:3: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
A. Yusuf Ali.79:4: Then press forward as in a race,
A. Yusuf Ali.79:5: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
A. Yusuf Ali.79:6: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
A. Yusuf Ali.79:8: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
A. Yusuf Ali.79:9: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.
A. Yusuf Ali.79:10: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
A. Yusuf Ali.79:11: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
A. Yusuf Ali.79:12: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
A. Yusuf Ali.79:13: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
A. Yusuf Ali.79:14: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
A. Yusuf Ali.79:15: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
A. Yusuf Ali.79:16: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
A. Yusuf Ali.79:17: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
A. Yusuf Ali.79:18: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
A. Yusuf Ali.79:19: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"
A. Yusuf Ali.79:20: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
A. Yusuf Ali.79:22: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
A. Yusuf Ali.79:23: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
A. Yusuf Ali.79:24: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
A. Yusuf Ali.79:25: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
A. Yusuf Ali.79:26: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).
A. Yusuf Ali.79:27: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
A. Yusuf Ali.79:28: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
A. Yusuf Ali.79:29: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
A. Yusuf Ali.79:30: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
A. Yusuf Ali.79:31: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
A. Yusuf Ali.79:32: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
A. Yusuf Ali.79:33: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
A. Yusuf Ali.79:34: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
A. Yusuf Ali.79:35: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
A. Yusuf Ali.79:36: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
A. Yusuf Ali.79:37: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
A. Yusuf Ali.79:38: And had preferred the life of this world,
A. Yusuf Ali.79:40: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
A. Yusuf Ali.79:41: Their abode will be the Garden.
A. Yusuf Ali.79:42: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?
A. Yusuf Ali.79:43: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
A. Yusuf Ali.79:44: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
A. Yusuf Ali.79:45: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
A. Yusuf Ali.79:46: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
A. Yusuf Ali.80:2: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
A. Yusuf Ali.80:3: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
A. Yusuf Ali.80:4: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
A. Yusuf Ali.80:5: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:7: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
A. Yusuf Ali.80:8: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:11: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
A. Yusuf Ali.80:12: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
A. Yusuf Ali.80:13: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:14: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:17: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;
A. Yusuf Ali.80:18: From what stuff hath He created him?
A. Yusuf Ali.80:19: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
A. Yusuf Ali.80:20: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
A. Yusuf Ali.80:21: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
A. Yusuf Ali.80:22: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
A. Yusuf Ali.80:23: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.
A. Yusuf Ali.80:24: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
A. Yusuf Ali.80:25: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:26: And We split the earth in fragments,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:30: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:32: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
A. Yusuf Ali.80:33: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
A. Yusuf Ali.80:34: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:35: And from his mother and his father,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:36: And from his wife and his children.
A. Yusuf Ali.80:37: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
A. Yusuf Ali.80:38: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:40: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
A. Yusuf Ali.80:42: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
A. Yusuf Ali.81:1: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:2: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:3: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
A. Yusuf Ali.81:4: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:5: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
A. Yusuf Ali.81:6: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:7: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);
A. Yusuf Ali.81:8: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -
A. Yusuf Ali.81:9: For what crime she was killed;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:10: When the scrolls are laid open;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:11: When the world on High is unveiled;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:12: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:13: And when the Garden is brought near;-
A. Yusuf Ali.81:14: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
A. Yusuf Ali.81:15: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
A. Yusuf Ali.81:17: And the Night as it dissipates;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:18: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
A. Yusuf Ali.81:19: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
A. Yusuf Ali.81:20: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
A. Yusuf Ali.81:21: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
A. Yusuf Ali.81:22: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
A. Yusuf Ali.81:23: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
A. Yusuf Ali.81:24: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
A. Yusuf Ali.81:25: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
A. Yusuf Ali.81:27: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
A. Yusuf Ali.81:28: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
A. Yusuf Ali.81:29: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
A. Yusuf Ali.82:1: When the Sky is cleft asunder;
A. Yusuf Ali.82:3: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
A. Yusuf Ali.82:4: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-
A. Yusuf Ali.82:5: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
A. Yusuf Ali.82:6: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
A. Yusuf Ali.82:7: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
A. Yusuf Ali.82:8: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
A. Yusuf Ali.82:9: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!
A. Yusuf Ali.82:10: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
A. Yusuf Ali.82:11: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
A. Yusuf Ali.82:12: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
A. Yusuf Ali.82:13: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
A. Yusuf Ali.82:14: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
A. Yusuf Ali.82:15: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
A. Yusuf Ali.82:16: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
A. Yusuf Ali.82:17: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
A. Yusuf Ali.82:18: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
A. Yusuf Ali.82:19: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:1: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
A. Yusuf Ali.83:2: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
A. Yusuf Ali.83:3: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:4: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
A. Yusuf Ali.83:6: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
A. Yusuf Ali.83:7: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:8: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
A. Yusuf Ali.83:10: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
A. Yusuf Ali.83:11: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:12: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
A. Yusuf Ali.83:13: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
A. Yusuf Ali.83:14: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
A. Yusuf Ali.83:15: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:16: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:17: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
A. Yusuf Ali.83:18: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:19: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
A. Yusuf Ali.83:21: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
A. Yusuf Ali.83:22: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
A. Yusuf Ali.83:23: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
A. Yusuf Ali.83:24: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:25: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
A. Yusuf Ali.83:26: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
A. Yusuf Ali.83:27: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
A. Yusuf Ali.83:28: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
A. Yusuf Ali.83:29: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
A. Yusuf Ali.83:30: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
A. Yusuf Ali.83:31: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
A. Yusuf Ali.83:32: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
A. Yusuf Ali.83:33: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
A. Yusuf Ali.83:34: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
A. Yusuf Ali.83:35: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
A. Yusuf Ali.83:36: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
A. Yusuf Ali.84:1: When the sky is rent asunder,
A. Yusuf Ali.84:2: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
A. Yusuf Ali.84:3: And when the earth is flattened out,
A. Yusuf Ali.84:4: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
A. Yusuf Ali.84:5: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
A. Yusuf Ali.84:6: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
A. Yusuf Ali.84:7: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
A. Yusuf Ali.84:8: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
A. Yusuf Ali.84:9: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
A. Yusuf Ali.84:10: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
A. Yusuf Ali.84:11: Soon will he cry for perdition,
A. Yusuf Ali.84:12: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
A. Yusuf Ali.84:13: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
A. Yusuf Ali.84:14: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
A. Yusuf Ali.84:15: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
A. Yusuf Ali.84:16: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
A. Yusuf Ali.84:18: And the Moon in her fullness:
A. Yusuf Ali.84:19: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
A. Yusuf Ali.84:20: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
A. Yusuf Ali.84:21: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
A. Yusuf Ali.84:22: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
A. Yusuf Ali.84:23: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
A. Yusuf Ali.84:24: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
A. Yusuf Ali.84:25: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
A. Yusuf Ali.85:1: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
A. Yusuf Ali.85:3: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
A. Yusuf Ali.85:4: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
A. Yusuf Ali.85:6: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
A. Yusuf Ali.85:7: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
A. Yusuf Ali.85:8: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
A. Yusuf Ali.85:9: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.
A. Yusuf Ali.85:10: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
A. Yusuf Ali.85:11: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
A. Yusuf Ali.85:12: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
A. Yusuf Ali.85:13: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
A. Yusuf Ali.85:14: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
A. Yusuf Ali.85:15: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
A. Yusuf Ali.85:16: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
A. Yusuf Ali.85:17: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
A. Yusuf Ali.85:19: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
A. Yusuf Ali.85:20: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!
A. Yusuf Ali.85:21: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,
A. Yusuf Ali.86:1: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
A. Yusuf Ali.86:2: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
A. Yusuf Ali.86:3: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-
A. Yusuf Ali.86:4: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
A. Yusuf Ali.86:5: Now let man but think from what he is created!
A. Yusuf Ali.86:6: He is created from a drop emitted-
A. Yusuf Ali.86:7: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
A. Yusuf Ali.86:8: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
A. Yusuf Ali.86:9: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,
A. Yusuf Ali.86:10: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
A. Yusuf Ali.86:11: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),
A. Yusuf Ali.86:12: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-
A. Yusuf Ali.86:13: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
A. Yusuf Ali.86:14: It is not a thing for amusement.
A. Yusuf Ali.86:15: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
A. Yusuf Ali.86:16: And I am planning a scheme.
A. Yusuf Ali.86:17: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
A. Yusuf Ali.87:1: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
A. Yusuf Ali.87:2: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
A. Yusuf Ali.87:3: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
A. Yusuf Ali.87:4: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,
A. Yusuf Ali.87:5: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
A. Yusuf Ali.87:6: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
A. Yusuf Ali.87:7: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
A. Yusuf Ali.87:8: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
A. Yusuf Ali.87:9: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
A. Yusuf Ali.87:10: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
A. Yusuf Ali.87:11: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
A. Yusuf Ali.87:12: Who will enter the Great Fire,
A. Yusuf Ali.87:13: In which they will then neither die nor live.
A. Yusuf Ali.87:14: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
A. Yusuf Ali.87:15: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
A. Yusuf Ali.87:16: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
A. Yusuf Ali.87:17: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
A. Yusuf Ali.87:18: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
A. Yusuf Ali.87:19: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
A. Yusuf Ali.88:1: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
A. Yusuf Ali.88:2: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
A. Yusuf Ali.88:4: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
A. Yusuf Ali.88:5: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
A. Yusuf Ali.88:6: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'
A. Yusuf Ali.88:7: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
A. Yusuf Ali.88:8: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
A. Yusuf Ali.88:11: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
A. Yusuf Ali.88:12: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
A. Yusuf Ali.88:13: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
A. Yusuf Ali.88:17: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
A. Yusuf Ali.88:18: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
A. Yusuf Ali.88:19: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
A. Yusuf Ali.88:20: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
A. Yusuf Ali.88:21: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
A. Yusuf Ali.88:22: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
A. Yusuf Ali.88:23: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-
A. Yusuf Ali.88:24: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
A. Yusuf Ali.88:25: For to Us will be their return;
A. Yusuf Ali.88:26: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
A. Yusuf Ali.89:4: And by the Night when it passeth away;-
A. Yusuf Ali.89:5: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?
A. Yusuf Ali.89:6: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-
A. Yusuf Ali.89:7: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,
A. Yusuf Ali.89:8: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?
A. Yusuf Ali.89:9: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-
A. Yusuf Ali.89:10: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?
A. Yusuf Ali.89:11: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
A. Yusuf Ali.89:13: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
A. Yusuf Ali.89:14: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
A. Yusuf Ali.89:15: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
A. Yusuf Ali.89:16: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
A. Yusuf Ali.89:17: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
A. Yusuf Ali.89:18: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
A. Yusuf Ali.89:19: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,
A. Yusuf Ali.89:20: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!
A. Yusuf Ali.89:21: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,
A. Yusuf Ali.89:22: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
A. Yusuf Ali.89:23: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
A. Yusuf Ali.89:24: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"
A. Yusuf Ali.89:25: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
A. Yusuf Ali.89:26: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
A. Yusuf Ali.89:27: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
A. Yusuf Ali.89:28: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
A. Yusuf Ali.90:1: I do call to witness this City;-
A. Yusuf Ali.90:2: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
A. Yusuf Ali.90:3: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
A. Yusuf Ali.90:4: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
A. Yusuf Ali.90:5: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
A. Yusuf Ali.90:6: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
A. Yusuf Ali.90:7: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
A. Yusuf Ali.90:8: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
A. Yusuf Ali.90:9: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
A. Yusuf Ali.90:10: And shown him the two highways?
A. Yusuf Ali.90:11: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
A. Yusuf Ali.90:12: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
A. Yusuf Ali.90:14: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
A. Yusuf Ali.90:15: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
A. Yusuf Ali.90:16: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
A. Yusuf Ali.90:17: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
A. Yusuf Ali.90:18: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
A. Yusuf Ali.90:19: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
A. Yusuf Ali.90:20: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
A. Yusuf Ali.91:1: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
A. Yusuf Ali.91:2: By the Moon as she follows him;
A. Yusuf Ali.91:3: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;
A. Yusuf Ali.91:4: By the Night as it conceals it;
A. Yusuf Ali.91:5: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;
A. Yusuf Ali.91:6: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:
A. Yusuf Ali.91:7: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;
A. Yusuf Ali.91:8: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
A. Yusuf Ali.91:9: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
A. Yusuf Ali.91:10: And he fails that corrupts it!
A. Yusuf Ali.91:11: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
A. Yusuf Ali.91:12: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
A. Yusuf Ali.91:13: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
A. Yusuf Ali.91:14: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
A. Yusuf Ali.91:15: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
A. Yusuf Ali.92:1: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
A. Yusuf Ali.92:2: By the Day as it appears in glory;
A. Yusuf Ali.92:3: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
A. Yusuf Ali.92:4: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
A. Yusuf Ali.92:5: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),
A. Yusuf Ali.92:6: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
A. Yusuf Ali.92:7: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
A. Yusuf Ali.92:8: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
A. Yusuf Ali.92:9: And gives the lie to the best,-
A. Yusuf Ali.92:10: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
A. Yusuf Ali.92:11: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
A. Yusuf Ali.92:12: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
A. Yusuf Ali.92:13: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
A. Yusuf Ali.92:14: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
A. Yusuf Ali.92:15: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
A. Yusuf Ali.92:16: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
A. Yusuf Ali.92:17: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-
A. Yusuf Ali.92:18: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
A. Yusuf Ali.92:19: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
A. Yusuf Ali.92:20: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
A. Yusuf Ali.92:21: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
A. Yusuf Ali.93:2: And by the Night when it is still,-
A. Yusuf Ali.93:3: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
A. Yusuf Ali.93:4: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
A. Yusuf Ali.93:5: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
A. Yusuf Ali.93:6: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
A. Yusuf Ali.93:7: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
A. Yusuf Ali.93:8: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
A. Yusuf Ali.93:9: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
A. Yusuf Ali.93:11: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
A. Yusuf Ali.94:1: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
A. Yusuf Ali.94:2: And removed from thee thy burden
A. Yusuf Ali.94:3: The which did gall thy back?-
A. Yusuf Ali.94:4: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
A. Yusuf Ali.94:5: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
A. Yusuf Ali.94:6: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
A. Yusuf Ali.94:7: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
A. Yusuf Ali.94:8: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
A. Yusuf Ali.95:1: By the Fig and the Olive,
A. Yusuf Ali.95:4: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
A. Yusuf Ali.95:5: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
A. Yusuf Ali.95:6: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
A. Yusuf Ali.95:7: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
A. Yusuf Ali.95:8: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?
A. Yusuf Ali.96:1: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
A. Yusuf Ali.96:2: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
A. Yusuf Ali.96:3: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
A. Yusuf Ali.96:4: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-
A. Yusuf Ali.96:5: Taught man that which he knew not.
A. Yusuf Ali.96:6: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,
A. Yusuf Ali.96:7: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
A. Yusuf Ali.96:8: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).
A. Yusuf Ali.96:10: A votary when he (turns) to pray?
A. Yusuf Ali.96:11: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
A. Yusuf Ali.96:13: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
A. Yusuf Ali.96:14: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?
A. Yusuf Ali.96:15: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
A. Yusuf Ali.96:17: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
A. Yusuf Ali.96:18: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
A. Yusuf Ali.96:19: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
A. Yusuf Ali.97:1: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:
A. Yusuf Ali.97:2: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
A. Yusuf Ali.97:3: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
A. Yusuf Ali.97:4: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:
A. Yusuf Ali.97:5: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!
A. Yusuf Ali.98:1: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence,-
A. Yusuf Ali.98:2: An messenger from Allah, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy:
A. Yusuf Ali.98:3: Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.
A. Yusuf Ali.98:4: Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence.
A. Yusuf Ali.98:5: And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship Allah, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight.
A. Yusuf Ali.98:6: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.
A. Yusuf Ali.98:7: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures.
A. Yusuf Ali.98:8: Their reward is with Allah: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; Allah well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher.
A. Yusuf Ali.99:1: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
A. Yusuf Ali.99:2: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
A. Yusuf Ali.99:3: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-
A. Yusuf Ali.99:4: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
A. Yusuf Ali.99:5: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
A. Yusuf Ali.99:6: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
A. Yusuf Ali.99:7: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!
A. Yusuf Ali.99:8: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
A. Yusuf Ali.100:1: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
A. Yusuf Ali.100:3: And push home the charge in the morning,
A. Yusuf Ali.100:4: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
A. Yusuf Ali.100:5: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
A. Yusuf Ali.100:6: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
A. Yusuf Ali.100:7: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
A. Yusuf Ali.100:8: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
A. Yusuf Ali.100:9: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
A. Yusuf Ali.100:10: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
A. Yusuf Ali.100:11: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
A. Yusuf Ali.101:2: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?
A. Yusuf Ali.101:3: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
A. Yusuf Ali.101:4: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,
A. Yusuf Ali.101:5: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
A. Yusuf Ali.101:6: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,
A. Yusuf Ali.101:7: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
A. Yusuf Ali.101:8: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-
A. Yusuf Ali.101:9: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.
A. Yusuf Ali.101:10: And what will explain to thee what this is?
A. Yusuf Ali.102:1: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
A. Yusuf Ali.102:3: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
A. Yusuf Ali.102:5: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
A. Yusuf Ali.102:7: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
A. Yusuf Ali.102:8: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
A. Yusuf Ali.103:1: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages),
A. Yusuf Ali.103:3: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.
A. Yusuf Ali.104:1: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
A. Yusuf Ali.104:2: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,
A. Yusuf Ali.104:3: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
A. Yusuf Ali.104:4: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
A. Yusuf Ali.104:5: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
A. Yusuf Ali.104:6: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),
A. Yusuf Ali.104:7: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:
A. Yusuf Ali.104:8: It shall be made into a vault over them,
A. Yusuf Ali.105:1: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
A. Yusuf Ali.105:2: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
A. Yusuf Ali.105:3: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
A. Yusuf Ali.105:4: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
A. Yusuf Ali.105:5: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
A. Yusuf Ali.106:1: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,
A. Yusuf Ali.106:2: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
A. Yusuf Ali.106:3: Let them adore the Lord of this House,
A. Yusuf Ali.106:4: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
A. Yusuf Ali.107:1: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?
A. Yusuf Ali.107:2: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),
A. Yusuf Ali.107:3: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.
A. Yusuf Ali.107:5: Who are neglectful of their prayers,
A. Yusuf Ali.107:6: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
A. Yusuf Ali.108:1: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
A. Yusuf Ali.108:2: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
A. Yusuf Ali.108:3: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
A. Yusuf Ali.109:1: Say: O ye that reject Faith!
A. Yusuf Ali.109:2: I worship not that which ye worship,
A. Yusuf Ali.109:3: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
A. Yusuf Ali.109:4: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,
A. Yusuf Ali.109:5: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
A. Yusuf Ali.109:6: To you be your Way, and to me mine.
A. Yusuf Ali.110:1: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,
A. Yusuf Ali.110:2: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,
A. Yusuf Ali.110:3: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
A. Yusuf Ali.111:1: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
A. Yusuf Ali.111:2: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
A. Yusuf Ali.111:3: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
A. Yusuf Ali.111:4: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
A. Yusuf Ali.111:5: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
A. Yusuf Ali.112:1: Say: He is Allah, the One and Only;
A. Yusuf Ali.112:3: He begetteth not, nor is He begotten;
A. Yusuf Ali.112:4: And there is none like unto Him.
A. Yusuf Ali.113:1: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
A. Yusuf Ali.113:2: From the mischief of created things;
A. Yusuf Ali.113:3: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads;
A. Yusuf Ali.113:4: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts;
A. Yusuf Ali.113:5: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy.
A. Yusuf Ali.114:1: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind,
A. Yusuf Ali.114:4: From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper),-
A. Yusuf Ali.114:5: (The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind,-

Saheeh International.1:1: In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
Saheeh International.1:2: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds -
Saheeh International.1:3: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
Saheeh International.1:4: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
Saheeh International.1:5: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
Saheeh International.1:6: Guide us to the straight path -
Saheeh International.1:7: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
Saheeh International.2:2: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allāh -
Saheeh International.2:3: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,
Saheeh International.2:4: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
Saheeh International.2:5: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
Saheeh International.2:6: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
Saheeh International.2:7: Allāh has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.
Saheeh International.2:8: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh and the Last Day," but they are not believers.
