Saheeh International.67:12: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
Saheeh International.67:13: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
Saheeh International.67:14: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
Saheeh International.67:15: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
Saheeh International.67:16: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
Saheeh International.67:17: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
Saheeh International.67:18: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
Saheeh International.67:19: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
Saheeh International.67:20: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
Saheeh International.67:21: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
Saheeh International.67:22: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
Saheeh International.67:23: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
Saheeh International.67:24: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
Saheeh International.67:25: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
Saheeh International.67:26: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
Saheeh International.67:27: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
Saheeh International.67:28: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
Saheeh International.67:29: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
Saheeh International.67:30: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
Saheeh International.68:1: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,
Saheeh International.68:2: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
Saheeh International.68:3: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
Saheeh International.68:4: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
Saheeh International.68:5: So you will see and they will see.
Saheeh International.68:6: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
Saheeh International.68:7: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
Saheeh International.68:8: Then do not obey the deniers.
Saheeh International.68:9: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
Saheeh International.68:10: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
Saheeh International.68:11: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
Saheeh International.68:12: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
Saheeh International.68:13: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
Saheeh International.68:14: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
Saheeh International.68:15: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
Saheeh International.68:16: We will brand him upon the snout.
Saheeh International.68:17: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
Saheeh International.68:19: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
Saheeh International.68:20: And it became as though reaped.
Saheeh International.68:21: And they called one another at morning,
Saheeh International.68:22: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
Saheeh International.68:23: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
Saheeh International.68:24: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
Saheeh International.68:25: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
Saheeh International.68:26: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
Saheeh International.68:28: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"
Saheeh International.68:29: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
Saheeh International.68:30: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
Saheeh International.68:31: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
Saheeh International.68:32: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
Saheeh International.68:33: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
Saheeh International.68:34: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
Saheeh International.68:35: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
Saheeh International.68:36: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
Saheeh International.68:37: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
Saheeh International.68:38: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
Saheeh International.68:39: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
Saheeh International.68:40: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
Saheeh International.68:41: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
Saheeh International.68:42: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
Saheeh International.68:43: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
Saheeh International.68:44: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
Saheeh International.68:45: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
Saheeh International.68:46: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
Saheeh International.68:47: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
Saheeh International.68:48: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.
Saheeh International.68:49: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
Saheeh International.68:50: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
Saheeh International.68:51: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
Saheeh International.68:52: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
Saheeh International.69:3: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
Saheeh International.69:4: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
Saheeh International.69:5: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
Saheeh International.69:6: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
Saheeh International.69:7: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
Saheeh International.69:8: Then do you see of them any remains?
Saheeh International.69:9: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
Saheeh International.69:10: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
Saheeh International.69:11: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship
Saheeh International.69:12: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
Saheeh International.69:13: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
Saheeh International.69:14: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
Saheeh International.69:15: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
Saheeh International.69:16: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
Saheeh International.69:17: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
Saheeh International.69:18: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
Saheeh International.69:19: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
Saheeh International.69:20: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
Saheeh International.69:21: So he will be in a pleasant life -
Saheeh International.69:23: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
Saheeh International.69:24: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
Saheeh International.69:25: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
Saheeh International.69:26: And had not known what is my account.
Saheeh International.69:27: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.
Saheeh International.69:28: My wealth has not availed me.
Saheeh International.69:29: Gone from me is my authority."
Saheeh International.69:30: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
Saheeh International.69:32: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
Saheeh International.69:33: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,
Saheeh International.69:34: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
Saheeh International.69:35: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
Saheeh International.69:36: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
Saheeh International.69:37: None will eat it except the sinners.
Saheeh International.69:38: So I swear by what you see
Saheeh International.69:39: And what you do not see
Saheeh International.69:40: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
Saheeh International.69:41: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
Saheeh International.69:42: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
Saheeh International.69:43: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
Saheeh International.69:44: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
Saheeh International.69:45: We would have seized him by the right hand;
Saheeh International.69:46: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
Saheeh International.69:47: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
Saheeh International.69:48: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
Saheeh International.69:49: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
Saheeh International.69:50: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
Saheeh International.69:51: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
Saheeh International.69:52: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
Saheeh International.70:1: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
Saheeh International.70:2: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
Saheeh International.70:3: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.
Saheeh International.70:4: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
Saheeh International.70:5: So be patient with gracious patience.
Saheeh International.70:8: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
Saheeh International.70:9: And the mountains will be like wool,
Saheeh International.70:10: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
Saheeh International.70:11: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.
Saheeh International.70:12: And his wife and his brother
Saheeh International.70:13: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.
Saheeh International.70:14: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
Saheeh International.70:15: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
Saheeh International.70:17: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
Saheeh International.70:21: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
Saheeh International.70:23: Those who are constant in their prayer
Saheeh International.70:24: And those within whose wealth is a known right
Saheeh International.70:25: For the petitioner and the deprived -
Saheeh International.70:26: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
Saheeh International.70:27: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
Saheeh International.70:28: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
Saheeh International.70:29: And those who guard their private parts
Saheeh International.70:30: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
Saheeh International.70:31: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
Saheeh International.70:32: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.
Saheeh International.70:33: And those who are in their testimonies upright
Saheeh International.70:34: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
Saheeh International.70:35: They will be in gardens, honored.
Saheeh International.70:36: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],
Saheeh International.70:37: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
Saheeh International.70:38: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
Saheeh International.70:39: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
Saheeh International.70:40: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
Saheeh International.70:41: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
Saheeh International.70:42: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
Saheeh International.70:43: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
Saheeh International.70:44: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
Saheeh International.71:1: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
Saheeh International.71:2: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -
Saheeh International.71:3: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.
Saheeh International.71:4: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
Saheeh International.71:5: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
Saheeh International.71:6: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
Saheeh International.71:7: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
Saheeh International.71:9: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
Saheeh International.71:10: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
Saheeh International.71:11: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
Saheeh International.71:12: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
Saheeh International.71:13: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur
Saheeh International.71:14: While He has created you in stages?
Saheeh International.71:15: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers
Saheeh International.71:16: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
Saheeh International.71:17: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
Saheeh International.71:18: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
Saheeh International.71:19: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse
Saheeh International.71:20: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
Saheeh International.71:21: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
Saheeh International.71:22: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
Saheeh International.71:23: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'
Saheeh International.71:24: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
Saheeh International.71:25: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.
Saheeh International.71:26: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
Saheeh International.71:27: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
Saheeh International.71:28: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
Saheeh International.72:1: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
Saheeh International.72:2: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
Saheeh International.72:3: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
Saheeh International.72:4: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
Saheeh International.72:5: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
Saheeh International.72:6: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
Saheeh International.72:7: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
Saheeh International.72:8: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
Saheeh International.72:9: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
Saheeh International.72:10: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
Saheeh International.72:11: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
Saheeh International.72:12: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
Saheeh International.72:13: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
Saheeh International.72:14: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
Saheeh International.72:15: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
Saheeh International.72:16: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
Saheeh International.72:17: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
Saheeh International.72:18: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
Saheeh International.72:19: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
Saheeh International.72:20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
Saheeh International.72:21: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
Saheeh International.72:22: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
Saheeh International.72:23: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
Saheeh International.72:24: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
Saheeh International.72:25: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
Saheeh International.72:26: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
Saheeh International.72:27: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
Saheeh International.72:28: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
Saheeh International.73:1: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]
Saheeh International.73:2: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
Saheeh International.73:3: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
Saheeh International.73:4: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
Saheeh International.73:5: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
Saheeh International.73:6: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
Saheeh International.73:7: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
Saheeh International.73:8: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
Saheeh International.73:9: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
Saheeh International.73:10: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
Saheeh International.73:11: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
Saheeh International.73:12: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.
Saheeh International.73:13: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
Saheeh International.73:14: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
Saheeh International.73:15: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
Saheeh International.73:16: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
Saheeh International.73:17: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?
Saheeh International.73:18: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
Saheeh International.73:19: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
Saheeh International.73:20: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
Saheeh International.74:1: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
Saheeh International.74:6: And do not confer favor to acquire more.
Saheeh International.74:7: But for your Lord be patient.
Saheeh International.74:8: And when the trumpet is blown,
Saheeh International.74:9: That Day will be a difficult day
Saheeh International.74:11: Leave Me with the one I created alone
Saheeh International.74:12: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
Saheeh International.74:14: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
Saheeh International.74:15: Then he desires that I should add more.
Saheeh International.74:16: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
Saheeh International.74:17: I will cover him with arduous torment.
Saheeh International.74:19: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
Saheeh International.74:20: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
Saheeh International.74:23: Then he turned back and was arrogant
Saheeh International.74:24: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
Saheeh International.74:25: This is not but the word of a human being."
Saheeh International.74:26: I will drive him into Saqar.
Saheeh International.74:27: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
Saheeh International.74:28: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
Saheeh International.74:31: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
Saheeh International.74:33: And [by] the night when it departs.
Saheeh International.74:34: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
Saheeh International.74:35: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].
Saheeh International.74:37: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
Saheeh International.74:38: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.
Saheeh International.74:39: Except the companions of the right,.
Saheeh International.74:40: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
Saheeh International.74:42: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
Saheeh International.74:43: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
Saheeh International.74:44: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
Saheeh International.74:45: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
Saheeh International.74:46: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
Saheeh International.74:47: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."
Saheeh International.74:48: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
Saheeh International.74:49: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.
Saheeh International.74:50: As if they were alarmed donkeys.
Saheeh International.74:52: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
Saheeh International.74:53: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
Saheeh International.74:54: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.
Saheeh International.74:55: Then whoever wills will remember it.
Saheeh International.74:56: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
Saheeh International.75:1: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
Saheeh International.75:2: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
Saheeh International.75:3: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
Saheeh International.75:4: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
Saheeh International.75:5: But man desires to continue in sin.
Saheeh International.75:6: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
Saheeh International.75:9: And the sun and the moon are joined,
Saheeh International.75:10: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
Saheeh International.75:12: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
Saheeh International.75:13: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
Saheeh International.75:14: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
Saheeh International.75:15: Even if he presents his excuses.
Saheeh International.75:16: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].
Saheeh International.75:17: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
Saheeh International.75:18: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
Saheeh International.75:19: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
Saheeh International.75:20: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate
Saheeh International.75:22: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
Saheeh International.75:24: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
Saheeh International.75:25: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
Saheeh International.75:26: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones
Saheeh International.75:27: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
Saheeh International.75:28: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation
Saheeh International.75:29: And the leg is wound about the leg,
Saheeh International.75:30: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
Saheeh International.75:31: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.
Saheeh International.75:32: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
Saheeh International.75:33: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
Saheeh International.75:35: Then woe to you, and woe!
Saheeh International.75:36: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
Saheeh International.75:37: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
Saheeh International.75:38: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
Saheeh International.75:39: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
Saheeh International.75:40: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
Saheeh International.76:1: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
Saheeh International.76:2: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
Saheeh International.76:3: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
Saheeh International.76:4: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
Saheeh International.76:5: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,
Saheeh International.76:6: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
Saheeh International.76:7: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
Saheeh International.76:8: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
Saheeh International.76:9: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
Saheeh International.76:10: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
Saheeh International.76:11: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
Saheeh International.76:12: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
Saheeh International.76:13: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
Saheeh International.76:14: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
Saheeh International.76:15: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
Saheeh International.76:16: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
Saheeh International.76:17: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
Saheeh International.76:18: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.
Saheeh International.76:19: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
Saheeh International.76:20: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
Saheeh International.76:21: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
Saheeh International.76:22: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
Saheeh International.76:23: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.
Saheeh International.76:24: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
Saheeh International.76:25: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
Saheeh International.76:26: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.
Saheeh International.76:27: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
Saheeh International.76:28: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
Saheeh International.76:29: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
Saheeh International.76:30: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
Saheeh International.76:31: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
Saheeh International.77:1: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
Saheeh International.77:2: And the winds that blow violently
Saheeh International.77:5: And those [angels] who deliver a message.
Saheeh International.77:7: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
Saheeh International.77:8: So when the stars are obliterated
Saheeh International.77:9: And when the heaven is opened
Saheeh International.77:10: And when the mountains are blown away
Saheeh International.77:11: And when the messengers' time has come...
Saheeh International.77:12: For what Day was it postponed?
Saheeh International.77:14: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
Saheeh International.77:15: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:16: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
Saheeh International.77:17: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
Saheeh International.77:18: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
Saheeh International.77:19: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:20: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
Saheeh International.77:21: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]
Saheeh International.77:23: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
Saheeh International.77:24: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:25: Have We not made the earth a container
Saheeh International.77:26: Of the living and the dead?
Saheeh International.77:27: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
Saheeh International.77:28: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:29: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
Saheeh International.77:30: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns.
Saheeh International.77:31: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
Saheeh International.77:32: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
Saheeh International.77:33: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
Saheeh International.77:34: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:35: This is a Day they will not speak,
Saheeh International.77:36: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
Saheeh International.77:37: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:38: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
Saheeh International.77:39: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
Saheeh International.77:40: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:41: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
Saheeh International.77:42: And fruits from whatever they desire,
Saheeh International.77:43: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
Saheeh International.77:44: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Saheeh International.77:45: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:46: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
Saheeh International.77:47: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:48: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
Saheeh International.77:49: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Saheeh International.77:50: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?
Saheeh International.78:1: About what are they asking one another?
Saheeh International.78:3: That over which they are in disagreement.
Saheeh International.78:4: No! They are going to know.
Saheeh International.78:5: Then, no! They are going to know.
Saheeh International.78:6: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
Saheeh International.78:8: And We created you in pairs.
Saheeh International.78:9: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
Saheeh International.78:10: And made the night as clothing.
Saheeh International.78:11: And made the day for livelihood.
Saheeh International.78:12: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens].
Saheeh International.78:14: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.
Saheeh International.78:15: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.
Saheeh International.78:17: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
Saheeh International.78:18: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
Saheeh International.78:19: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.
Saheeh International.78:20: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
Saheeh International.78:21: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
Saheeh International.78:22: For the transgressors, a place of return,
Saheeh International.78:23: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
Saheeh International.78:24: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.
Saheeh International.78:27: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
Saheeh International.78:28: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
Saheeh International.78:29: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
Saheeh International.78:30: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
Saheeh International.78:31: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
Saheeh International.78:35: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
Saheeh International.78:36: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
Saheeh International.78:37: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
Saheeh International.78:38: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
Saheeh International.78:39: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
Saheeh International.78:40: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
Saheeh International.79:1: By those [angels] who extract with violence
Saheeh International.79:2: And [by] those who remove with ease
Saheeh International.79:3: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
Saheeh International.79:4: And those who race each other in a race
Saheeh International.79:6: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
Saheeh International.79:7: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
Saheeh International.79:10: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
Saheeh International.79:11: Even if we should be decayed bones?"
Saheeh International.79:12: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
Saheeh International.79:13: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
Saheeh International.79:14: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
Saheeh International.79:15: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
Saheeh International.79:16: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,
Saheeh International.79:17: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
Saheeh International.79:18: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
Saheeh International.79:19: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
Saheeh International.79:20: And he showed him the greatest sign,
Saheeh International.79:21: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.
Saheeh International.79:22: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].
Saheeh International.79:23: And he gathered [his people] and called out.
Saheeh International.79:24: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
Saheeh International.79:25: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..
Saheeh International.79:26: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].
Saheeh International.79:27: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
Saheeh International.79:28: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
Saheeh International.79:29: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
Saheeh International.79:30: And after that He spread the earth.
Saheeh International.79:31: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
Saheeh International.79:32: And the mountains He set firmly
Saheeh International.79:33: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
Saheeh International.79:34: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
Saheeh International.79:35: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
Saheeh International.79:36: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
Saheeh International.79:37: So as for he who transgressed
Saheeh International.79:38: And preferred the life of the world,
Saheeh International.79:39: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
Saheeh International.79:40: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
Saheeh International.79:41: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
Saheeh International.79:42: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
Saheeh International.79:43: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
Saheeh International.79:44: To your Lord is its finality.
Saheeh International.79:45: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
Saheeh International.79:46: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
Saheeh International.80:1: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away
Saheeh International.80:2: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
Saheeh International.80:3: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified
Saheeh International.80:4: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
Saheeh International.80:5: As for he who thinks himself without need,
Saheeh International.80:7: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
Saheeh International.80:8: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
Saheeh International.80:11: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;
Saheeh International.80:12: So whoever wills may remember it.
Saheeh International.80:17: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man; how disbelieving is he.
Saheeh International.80:18: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?
Saheeh International.80:19: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
Saheeh International.80:20: Then He eased the way for him;
Saheeh International.80:21: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
Saheeh International.80:22: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
Saheeh International.80:23: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
Saheeh International.80:24: Then let mankind look at his food -
Saheeh International.80:25: How We poured down water in torrents,
Saheeh International.80:26: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
Saheeh International.80:27: And caused to grow within it grain
Saheeh International.80:32: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
Saheeh International.80:33: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
Saheeh International.80:34: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
Saheeh International.80:35: And his mother and his father
Saheeh International.80:36: And his wife and his children,
Saheeh International.80:37: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
Saheeh International.80:38: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
Saheeh International.80:40: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
Saheeh International.80:42: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
Saheeh International.81:1: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
Saheeh International.81:2: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
Saheeh International.81:3: And when the mountains are removed
Saheeh International.81:4: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
Saheeh International.81:5: And when the wild beasts are gathered
Saheeh International.81:6: And when the seas are filled with flame
Saheeh International.81:7: And when the souls are paired
Saheeh International.81:8: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
Saheeh International.81:9: For what sin she was killed
Saheeh International.81:10: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]
Saheeh International.81:11: And when the sky is stripped away
Saheeh International.81:12: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
Saheeh International.81:13: And when Paradise is brought near,
Saheeh International.81:14: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
Saheeh International.81:15: So I swear by the retreating stars -
Saheeh International.81:16: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]
Saheeh International.81:17: And by the night as it closes in
Saheeh International.81:18: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]
Saheeh International.81:19: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]
Saheeh International.81:20: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
Saheeh International.81:21: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
Saheeh International.81:22: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.
Saheeh International.81:23: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.
Saheeh International.81:24: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
Saheeh International.81:25: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
Saheeh International.81:27: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
Saheeh International.81:28: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
Saheeh International.81:29: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.
Saheeh International.82:2: And when the stars fall, scattering,
Saheeh International.82:3: And when the seas are erupted
Saheeh International.82:4: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],
Saheeh International.82:5: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
Saheeh International.82:6: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
Saheeh International.82:7: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
Saheeh International.82:8: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
Saheeh International.82:9: No! But you deny the Recompense.
Saheeh International.82:10: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
Saheeh International.82:13: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
Saheeh International.82:14: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
Saheeh International.82:15: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
Saheeh International.82:16: And never therefrom will they be absent.
Saheeh International.82:17: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
Saheeh International.82:18: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
Saheeh International.82:19: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.
Saheeh International.83:1: Woe to those who give less [than due],
Saheeh International.83:2: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
Saheeh International.83:3: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
Saheeh International.83:4: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
Saheeh International.83:6: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
Saheeh International.83:7: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
Saheeh International.83:8: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
Saheeh International.83:9: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
Saheeh International.83:10: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Saheeh International.83:11: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
Saheeh International.83:12: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
Saheeh International.83:13: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
Saheeh International.83:14: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
Saheeh International.83:15: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
Saheeh International.83:16: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
Saheeh International.83:17: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
Saheeh International.83:18: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
Saheeh International.83:19: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?
Saheeh International.83:20: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
Saheeh International.83:21: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].
Saheeh International.83:22: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
Saheeh International.83:24: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
Saheeh International.83:25: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
Saheeh International.83:26: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
Saheeh International.83:27: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
Saheeh International.83:28: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.
Saheeh International.83:29: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
Saheeh International.83:30: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
Saheeh International.83:31: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
Saheeh International.83:32: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
Saheeh International.83:33: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
Saheeh International.83:34: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
Saheeh International.83:36: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
Saheeh International.84:2: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
Saheeh International.84:3: And when the earth has been extended
Saheeh International.84:4: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it].
Saheeh International.84:5: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
Saheeh International.84:6: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
Saheeh International.84:7: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
Saheeh International.84:8: He will be judged with an easy account
Saheeh International.84:9: And return to his people in happiness.
Saheeh International.84:10: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
Saheeh International.84:11: He will cry out for destruction
Saheeh International.84:12: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
Saheeh International.84:13: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
Saheeh International.84:14: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].
Saheeh International.84:15: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
Saheeh International.84:16: So I swear by the twilight glow
Saheeh International.84:17: And [by] the night and what it envelops
Saheeh International.84:18: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
Saheeh International.84:19: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.
Saheeh International.84:20: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
Saheeh International.84:21: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?
Saheeh International.84:22: But those who have disbelieved deny,
Saheeh International.84:23: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
Saheeh International.84:24: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
Saheeh International.84:25: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
Saheeh International.85:1: By the sky containing great stars
Saheeh International.85:3: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

Saheeh International.85:11: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
Saheeh International.85:12: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.
Saheeh International.85:13: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

Saheeh International.85:17: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
Saheeh International.85:19: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

Saheeh International.85:21: But this is an honored Qur’ān
Saheeh International.86:1: By the sky and the night comer

Saheeh International.86:4: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
Saheeh International.86:5: So let man observe from what he was created.
Saheeh International.86:6: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
Saheeh International.86:7: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
Saheeh International.86:8: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.
Saheeh International.86:9: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
Saheeh International.86:10: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.
Saheeh International.86:11: By the sky which sends back

Saheeh International.86:15: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
Saheeh International.86:16: But I am planning a plan.
Saheeh International.86:17: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
Saheeh International.87:1: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
Saheeh International.87:4: And who brings out the pasture

Saheeh International.87:7: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

Saheeh International.87:10: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

Saheeh International.87:12: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

Saheeh International.87:15: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
Saheeh International.87:16: But you prefer the worldly life,
Saheeh International.87:17: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
Saheeh International.87:18: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
Saheeh International.87:19: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
Saheeh International.88:1: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
Saheeh International.88:2: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

Saheeh International.88:6: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

Saheeh International.88:8: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

Saheeh International.88:13: Within it are couches raised high

Saheeh International.88:20: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
Saheeh International.88:21: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.
Saheeh International.88:22: You are not over them a controller.
Saheeh International.88:23: However, he who turns away and disbelieves
Saheeh International.88:24: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

Saheeh International.89:3: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

Saheeh International.89:5: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
Saheeh International.89:6: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -
Saheeh International.89:8: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
Saheeh International.89:9: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
Saheeh International.89:10: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?
Saheeh International.89:11: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
Saheeh International.89:13: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
Saheeh International.89:14: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
Saheeh International.89:15: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
Saheeh International.89:16: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
Saheeh International.89:17: No! But you do not honor the orphan
Saheeh International.89:18: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
Saheeh International.89:19: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
Saheeh International.89:20: And you love wealth with immense love.

Saheeh International.89:25: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
Saheeh International.89:26: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
Saheeh International.89:27: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

Saheeh International.90:1: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah]
Saheeh International.90:2: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city
Saheeh International.90:3: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
Saheeh International.90:4: We have certainly created man into hardship.
Saheeh International.90:5: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
Saheeh International.90:6: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
Saheeh International.90:7: Does he think that no one has seen him?
Saheeh International.90:8: Have We not made for him two eyes?
Saheeh International.90:9: And a tongue and two lips?
Saheeh International.90:10: And have shown him the two ways?
Saheeh International.90:11: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
Saheeh International.90:12: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
Saheeh International.90:13: It is the freeing of a slave
Saheeh International.90:14: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
Saheeh International.90:16: Or a needy person in misery
Saheeh International.90:17: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
Saheeh International.90:18: Those are the companions of the right.
Saheeh International.90:19: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
Saheeh International.90:20: Over them will be fire closed in.
Saheeh International.91:1: By the sun and its brightness
Saheeh International.91:2: And [by] the moon when it follows it
Saheeh International.91:3: And [by] the day when it displays it
Saheeh International.91:4: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it
Saheeh International.91:5: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
Saheeh International.91:6: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
Saheeh International.91:7: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
Saheeh International.91:8: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
Saheeh International.91:9: He has succeeded who purifies it,
Saheeh International.91:10: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
Saheeh International.91:11: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
Saheeh International.91:12: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
Saheeh International.91:13: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."
Saheeh International.91:14: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
Saheeh International.91:15: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
Saheeh International.92:1: By the night when it covers
Saheeh International.92:2: And [by] the day when it appears
Saheeh International.92:3: And [by] He who created the male and female,
Saheeh International.92:5: As for he who gives and fears Allāh
Saheeh International.92:7: We will ease him toward ease.
Saheeh International.92:8: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
Saheeh International.92:10: We will ease him toward difficulty.
Saheeh International.92:11: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
Saheeh International.92:13: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
Saheeh International.92:14: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
Saheeh International.92:15: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
Saheeh International.92:16: Who had denied and turned away.
Saheeh International.92:17: But the righteous one will avoid it
Saheeh International.92:18: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
Saheeh International.92:19: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
Saheeh International.92:20: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.
Saheeh International.92:21: And he is going to be satisfied.
Saheeh International.93:2: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

Saheeh International.93:4: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
Saheeh International.93:5: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
Saheeh International.93:6: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
Saheeh International.93:7: And He found you lost and guided [you],
Saheeh International.93:8: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
Saheeh International.93:9: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
Saheeh International.93:10: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
Saheeh International.93:11: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
Saheeh International.94:1: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?

Saheeh International.94:3: Which had weighed upon your back
Saheeh International.94:4: And raised high for you your repute.
Saheeh International.94:5: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].
Saheeh International.94:7: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

Saheeh International.96:17: Then let him call his associates;

Saheeh International.97:1: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
Saheeh International.97:2: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
Saheeh International.97:3: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
Saheeh International.97:4: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
Saheeh International.97:5: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
Saheeh International.98:1: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence
Saheeh International.98:2: A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified scriptures
Saheeh International.98:3: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].
Saheeh International.98:4: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
Saheeh International.98:5: And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.
Saheeh International.98:6: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
Saheeh International.98:7: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
Saheeh International.98:8: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
Saheeh International.99:1: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

Saheeh International.102:8: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
Saheeh International.103:3: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
Saheeh International.104:1: Woe to every scorner and mocker
Saheeh International.104:2: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
Saheeh International.104:3: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
Saheeh International.104:4: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
Saheeh International.104:5: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
Saheeh International.104:6: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,
Saheeh International.104:7: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
Saheeh International.104:8: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them
Saheeh International.105:1: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
Saheeh International.105:2: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
Saheeh International.105:3: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
Saheeh International.105:4: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
Saheeh International.105:5: And He made them like eaten straw.
Saheeh International.106:1: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
Saheeh International.106:2: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
Saheeh International.106:3: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
Saheeh International.106:4: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
Saheeh International.107:1: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
Saheeh International.107:2: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
Saheeh International.107:3: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
Saheeh International.107:4: So woe to those who pray
Saheeh International.107:5: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
Saheeh International.107:6: Those who make show [of their deeds]
Saheeh International.108:1: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.
Saheeh International.108:2: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].
Saheeh International.108:3: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
Saheeh International.109:2: I do not worship what you worship.
Saheeh International.109:3: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
Saheeh International.109:4: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
Saheeh International.109:5: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
Saheeh International.109:6: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
Saheeh International.110:1: When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,
Saheeh International.110:2: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,
Saheeh International.110:3: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
Saheeh International.111:1: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
Saheeh International.111:2: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
Saheeh International.111:3: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
Saheeh International.111:4: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
Saheeh International.111:5: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
Saheeh International.112:3: He neither begets nor is born,
Saheeh International.112:4: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
Saheeh International.113:1: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
Saheeh International.113:2: From the evil of that which He created
Saheeh International.113:3: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
Saheeh International.113:4: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
Saheeh International.113:5: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
Saheeh International.114:1: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
Saheeh International.114:4: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
Saheeh International.114:5: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
Saheeh International.114:6: From among the jinn and mankind".

Al-Hilali & Khan.1:1: In the Name of Allâh, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
Al-Hilali & Khan.1:2: All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.1:3: The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.1:4: The Only Owner (and the Only Ruling Judge) of the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)
Al-Hilali & Khan.1:5: You (Alone) we worship, and You (Alone) we ask for help (for each and everything).
Al-Hilali & Khan.1:6: Guide us to the Straight Way.
Al-Hilali & Khan.1:7: The Way of those on whom You have bestowed Your Grace , not (the way) of those who earned Your Anger  (i.e. those who knew the Truth, but did not follow it) nor of those who went astray (i.e. those who did not follow the Truth out of ignorance and error). ,
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:1: Alif-Lâm-Mîm. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings.]
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:2: This is the Book (the Qur’ân), whereof there is no doubt, a guidance to those who are Al-Muttaqûn [the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism who fear Allâh much (abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which He has forbidden) and love Allâh much (perform all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)].
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:3: Who believe in the Ghaib  and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât), and spend out of what We have provided for them [i.e. give Zakât , spend on themselves, their parents, their children, their wives, etc., and also give charity to the poor and also in Allâh’s Cause - Jihâd].
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:4: And who believe in (the Qur’ân and the Sunnah ) which has been sent down (revealed) to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and in that which was sent down before you [the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), etc.] and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter. (Resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell).
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:5: They are on (true) guidance from their Lord, and they are the successful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:6: Verily, those who disbelieve, it is the same to them whether you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) warn them or do not warn them, they will not believe.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:7: Allâh has set a seal on their hearts and on their hearing, (i.e. they are closed from accepting Allâh’s Guidance), and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be a great torment.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:8: And of mankind, there are some (hypocrites) who say: "We believe in Allâh and the Last Day" while in fact they believe not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:9: They (think to) deceive Allâh and those who believe, while they only deceive themselves, and perceive (it) not!
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:10: In their hearts is a disease (of doubt and hypocrisy) and Allâh has increased their disease. A painful torment is theirs because they used to tell lies.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:11: And when it is said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth," they say: "We are only peace-makers."
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:12: Verily! They are the ones who make mischief, but they perceive not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:13: And when it is said to them (hypocrites): "Believe as the people (followers of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, Al-Ansâr and Al-Muhajirûn) have believed," they say: "Shall we believe as the fools have believed?" Verily, they are the fools, but they know not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:14: And when they meet those who believe, they say: "We believe," but when they are alone with their Shayâtîn (devils - polytheists, hypocrites), they say: "Truly, we are with you; verily, we were but mocking."
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:15: Allâh mocks at them and gives them increase in their wrong-doing to wander blindly.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:16: These are they who have purchased error for guidance, so their commerce was profitless. And they were not guided.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:17: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindled a fire; then, when it lighted all around him, Allâh took away their light and left them in darkness. (So) they could not see.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:18: They are deaf, dumb, and blind, so they return not (to the Right Path).
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:19: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder, and lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears to keep out the stunning thunder-clap for fear of death. But Allâh ever encompasses the disbelievers (i.e. Allâh will gather them all together).
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:20: The lightning almost snatches away their sight, whenever it flashes for them, they walk therein, and when darkness covers them, they stand still. And if Allâh willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Certainly, Allâh has power over all things.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:21: O mankind! Worship your Lord (Allâh), Who created you and those who were before you so that you may become Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:22: Who has made the earth a resting place for you, and the sky as a canopy, and sent down water (rain) from the sky and brought forth therewith fruits as a provision for you. Then do not set up rivals unto Allâh (in worship) while you know (that He Alone has the right to be worshipped).
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:23: And if you (Arab pagans, Jews, and Christians) are in doubt concerning that which We have sent down (i.e. the Qur’ân) to Our slave (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), then produce a Sûrah (chapter) of the like thereof and call your witnesses (supporters and helpers) besides Allâh, if you are truthful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:24: But if you do it not, and you can never do it, then fear the Fire (Hell) whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:25: And give glad tidings to those who believe and do righteous good deeds, that for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). Every time they will be provided with a fruit therefrom, they will say: "This is what we were provided with before," and they will be given things in resemblance (i.e. in the same form but different in taste) and they shall have therein Azwâjun Mutahharatun [1] (purified mates or wives) and they will abide therein forever.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:26: Verily, Allâh is not ashamed to set forth a parable even of a mosquito or so much more when it is bigger (or less when it is smaller) than it. And as for those who believe, they know that it is the Truth from their Lord, but as for those who disbelieve, they say: "What did Allâh intend by this parable?" By it He misleads many, and many He guides thereby. And He misleads thereby only those who are Al-Fâsiqûn (the rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:27: Those who break Allâh’s Covenant after ratifying it, and sever what Allâh has ordered to be joined (as regards Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism, and to practise its laws on the earth and also as regards keeping good relations with kith and kin), and do mischief on earth, it is they who are the losers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:28: How can you disbelieve in Allâh? seeing that you were dead and He gave you life. Then He will give you death, then again will bring you to life (on the Day of Resurrection) and then unto Him you will return (See V.40:11)
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:29: He it is Who created for you all that is on earth. Then He rose over (Istawâ) towards the heaven and made them seven heavens and He is the All-Knower of everything.
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:30: And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "Verily, I am going to place (mankind) generations after generations on earth." They said: "Will You place therein those who will make mischief therein and shed blood, - while we glorify You with praises and thanks and sanctify You." He (Allâh) said: "I know that which you do not know."
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:31: And He taught Adam all the names (of everything), then He showed them to the angels and said, "Tell Me the names of these if you are truthful."
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:32: They (angels) said: "Glory be to You, we have no knowledge except what you have taught us. Verily, it is You, the All-Knower, the All-Wise."
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:33: He said: "O Adam! Inform them of their names," and when he had informed them of their names, He said: "Did I not tell you that I know the Ghaib (Unseen) in the heavens and the earth, and I know what you reveal and what you have been concealing?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.2:34: And (remember) when We said to the angels: "Prostrate yourselves before Adam.". And they prostrated except Iblîs (Satan), he refused and was proud and was one of the disbelievers (disobedient to Allâh).
