Al-Hilali & Khan.25:71: And whosoever repents and does righteous good deeds; then verily, he repents towards Allâh with true repentance.
Al-Hilali & Khan.25:72: And those who do not bear witness to falsehood, and if they pass by some evil play or evil talk, they pass by it with dignity.
Al-Hilali & Khan.25:73: And those who, when they are reminded of the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
Al-Hilali & Khan.25:74: And those who say: "Our Lord! Bestow on us from our wives and our offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of the Muttaqûn(the pious. See V.2:2)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.25:75: Those will be rewarded with the highest place (in Paradise) because of their patience. Therein they shall be met with greetings and the word of peace and respect.
Al-Hilali & Khan.25:76: Abiding therein - excellent it is as an abode, and as a place to rest in.
Al-Hilali & Khan.25:77: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to the disbelievers): "My Lord pays attention to you only because of your invocation to Him. But now you have indeed denied (Him). So the torment will be yours for ever (inseparable, permanent punishment)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:2: These are the Verses of the manifest Book [(this Qur’ân), which was promised by Allâh in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), makes things clear].
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:3: It may be that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are going to kill yourself with grief, that they do not become believers [in your Risalah (Messengership) i.e. in your Message of Islâmic Monotheism].
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:4: If We will, We could send down to them from the heaven a sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:5: And never comes there unto them a Reminder as a recent revelation from the Most Gracious (Allâh), but they turn away therefrom.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:6: So they have indeed denied (the truth - this Qur’ân), then the news of what they mocked at will come to them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:7: Do they not observe the earth - how much of every good kind We cause to grow therein?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:8: Verily, in this is an Ayâh (proof or sign), yet most of them (polytheists, pagans who do not believe in Resurrection) are not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:9: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:10: And (remember) when your Lord called Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Go to the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) -
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:11: "The people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh): Will they not fear Allâh and become righteous?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:12: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I fear that they will belie me,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:13: "And my breast straitens, and my tongue expresses not well. So send for Hârûn (Aaron) (to come along with me).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:14: "And they have a charge of crime against me, and I fear they will kill me."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:15: (Allâh) said: "Nay! Go you both with Our Signs. Verily We shall be with you, listening.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:16: "And go both of you to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and say: ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:17: "So allow the Children of Israel to go with us.’ "
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:18: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said [to Mûsâ (Moses)]: "Did we not bring you up among us as a child? And you did dwell many years of your life with us.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:19: "And you did your deed, which you did (i.e. the crime of killing a man) while you were one of the ingrates."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:20: Mûsâ (Moses) said: "I did it then, when I was ignorant (as regards my Lord and His Message).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:21: "So I fled from you when I feared you. But my Lord has granted me Hukm (i.e. religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood), and made me one of the Messengers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:22: "And this is the past favour with which you reproach me: that you have enslaved the Children of Israel."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:23: Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "And what is the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:24: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, if you seek to be convinced with certainty."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:25: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said to those around: "Do you not hear (what he says)?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:26: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancient fathers!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:27: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "Verily, your Messenger who has been sent to you is a madman!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:28: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Lord of the east and the west, and all that is between them, if you did but understand!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:29: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "If you choose an ilâh (god) other than me, I will certainly put you among the prisoners."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:30: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Even if I bring you something manifest (and convincing)?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:31: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "Bring it forth then, if you are of the truthful!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:32: So [Mûsâ (Moses)] threw his stick, and behold, it was a serpent, manifest.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:33: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:34: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said to the chiefs around him: "Verily! This is indeed a well-versed sorcerer.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:35: "He wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery: what is it then that you command?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:36: They said: "Put him off and his brother (for a while), and send callers to the cities;
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:37: "To bring up to you every well-versed sorcerer."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:38: So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:39: And it was said to the people: "Are you (too) going to assemble?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:40: "That we may follow the sorcerers [who were on Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) religion of disbelief] if they are the winners."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:41: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh): "Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:42: He said: "Yes, and you shall then verily be of those brought near (to myself)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:43: Mûsâ (Moses) said to them: "Throw what you are going to throw!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:44: So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said: "By the might of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), it is we who will certainly win!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:45: Then Mûsâ (Moses) threw his stick, and behold, it swallowed up all that they falsely showed!
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:46: And the sorcerers fell down prostrate.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:47: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:49: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "You have believed in him before I give you leave. Surely, he indeed is your chief, who has taught you magic! So verily, you shall come to know. Verily, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:50: They said: "No harm! Surely, to our Lord (Allâh) we are to return.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:51: "Verily we really hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers [in Mûsâ (Moses) and in the Monotheism which he has brought from Allâh]."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:52: And We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses), saying: "Depart by night with My slaves, verily you will be pursued."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:53: Then Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) sent callers to (all) the cities.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:54: (Saying): "Verily these indeed are but a small band.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:55: "And verily, they have done what has enraged us.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:56: "But we are a host all assembled, amply fore-warned."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:57: So, We expelled them from gardens and springs,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:58: Treasures, and every kind of honourable place.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:59: Thus [We turned them (Pharaoh’s people) out] and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:60: So they pursued them at sunrise.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:61: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mûsâ (Moses) said: "We are sure to be overtaken."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:62: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Nay, verily with me is my Lord. He will guide me."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:63: Then We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Strike the sea with your stick." And it parted, and each separate part (of that sea water) became like huge mountain.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:64: Then We brought near the others [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) party] to that place.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:65: And We saved Mûsâ (Moses) and all those with him.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:67: Verily in this is indeed a sign (or a proof), yet most of them are not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:68: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:69: And recite to them the story of Ibrâhîm (Abraham).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:70: When he said to his father and his people: "What do you worship?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:71: They said: "We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:72: He said: "Do they hear you, when you call on (them)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:73: "Or do they benefit you or do they harm (you)?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:74: They said: "(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:75: He said: "Do you observe that which you have been worshipping -
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:77: "Verily they are enemies to me, save the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:78: "Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:79: "And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:80: "And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:81: "And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life (again).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:82: "And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense, (the Day of Resurrection).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:83: My Lord! Bestow Hukm (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:84: And grant me an honourable mention in later generations.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:85: And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:86: And forgive my father, verily he is of the erring.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:87: And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:88: The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:89: Except him who brings to Allâh a clean heart [clean from Shirk (polytheism) and Nifâq (hypocrisy)]."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:90: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:91: And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the erring.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:92: And it will be said to them: "Where are those (the false gods whom you used to set up as rivals with Allâh) that you used to worship.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:93: "Instead of Allâh? Can they help you or (even) help themselves?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:94: Then they will be thrown on their faces into the (Fire), they and the Ghâwûn (devils, and those who were in error).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:95: And the whole hosts of Iblîs (Satan) together.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:96: They will say while contending therein,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:97: By Allâh, we were truly in a manifest error,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:98: When We held you (false gods) as equals (in worship) with the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists);
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:99: And none has brought us into error except the Mujrimûn [Iblîs (Satan) and those of human beings who commit crimes, murderers, polytheists, oppressors].
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:101: Nor a close friend (to help us).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:102: (Alas!) If we only had a chance to return (to the world), we shall truly be among the believers!
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:103: Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:104: And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:105: The people of Nûh (Noah) belied the Messengers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:106: When their brother Nûh (Noah) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:107: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:108: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:109: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:110: "So keep your duty to Allâh, fear Him and obey me."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:111: They said: "Shall we believe in you, when the meanest (of the people) follow you?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:112: He said: "And what knowledge have I of what they used to do?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:113: "Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:114: "And I am not going to drive away the believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:115: I am only a plain warner."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:116: They said: "If you cease not, O Nûh (Noah) you will surely be among those stoned (to death)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:117: He said: "My Lord! Verily, my people have belied me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:118: Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:119: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:120: Then We drowned the rest (disbelievers) thereafter.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:121: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:122: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:124: When their brother Hûd said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:125: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:126: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:127: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:128: "Do you build high palaces on every high place, while you do not live in them?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:129: "And do you get for yourselves palaces (fine buildings) as if you will live therein for ever.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:130: "And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:131: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:132: "And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:133: "He has aided you with cattle and children.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:135: "Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:136: They said: "It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:137: "This is no other than the false tales and religion of the ancients, [Tafsir At-Tabarî]
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:138: "And we are not going to be punished."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:139: So they belied him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:140: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:142: When their brother Sâlih said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:143: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:144: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:145: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:146: "Will you be left secure in that which you have here?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:148: And green crops (fields) and date-palms with soft spadix.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:149: "And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:150: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:151: "And follow not the command of Al-Musrifûn [i.e. their chiefs: leaders who were polytheists, criminals and sinners],
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:152: "Who make mischief in the land, and reform not."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:153: They said: "You are only of those bewitched!
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:154: "You are but a human being like us. Then bring us a sign if you are of the truthful."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:155: He said: "Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:156: "And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:157: But they killed her, and then they became regretful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:158: So the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:159: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:160: The people of Lût (Lot) (-who dwelt in the town of Sodom in Palestine) belied the Messengers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:161: When their brother Lût (Lot) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:162: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:163: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:164: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:165: "Go you in unto the males of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind),
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:166: "And leave those whom Allâh has created for you to be your wives? Nay, you are a trespassing people!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:167: They said: "If you cease not O Lût (Lot)! verily, you will be one of those who are driven out!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:168: He said: "I am, indeed, of those who disapprove with severe anger and fury your (this evil) action (of sodomy).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:169: "My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:170: So We saved him and his family, all,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:171: Except an old woman (his wife) among those who remained behind.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:172: Then afterward We destroyed the others.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:173: And We rained on them a rain (of torment). And how evil was the rain of those who had been warned!
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:174: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:175: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:176: The dwellers of Al-Aikah [near Madyan (Midian)] belied the Messengers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:177: When Shu‘aib said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh (and obey Him)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:178: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:179: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:180: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:181: "Give full measure, and cause no loss (to others).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:182: "And weigh with the true and straight balance.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:183: "And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:184: "And fear Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:185: They said: "You are only one of those bewitched!
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:186: "You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:187: "So cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:188: He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:189: But they belied him, so the torment of the day of shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed that was the torment of a Great Day.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:190: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:191: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:192: And truly, this (the Qur’ân) is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:193: Which the trustworthy Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] has brought down
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:194: Upon your heart (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that you may be (one) of the warners,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:196: And verily, it (the Qur’ân, and its revelation to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:197: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm رضي الله عنه who embraced Islâm) of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:198: And if We had revealed it (this Qur’ân) unto any of the non-Arabs,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:199: And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:200: Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur’ân) to enter the hearts of the Mûjrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:201: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:202: It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:203: Then they will say: "Can we be respited?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:204: Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:205: Tell Me, (even) if We do let them enjoy for years,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:206: And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:207: All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:208: And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:209: By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:210: And it is not the Shayâtîn (devils) who have brought it (this Qur’ân) down.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:211: Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:212: Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:213: So invoke not with Allâh another ilâh (god) lest you should be among those who receive punishment.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:214: And warn your tribe (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of near kindred.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:215: And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:216: Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:217: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:218: Who sees you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:219: And your movements among those who fall prostrate (to Allâh in the five compulsory congregational prayers).
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:220: Verily He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:221: Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayâtîn (devils) descend?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:222: They descend on every lying, sinful person.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:223: Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the Unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:224: As for the poets, the erring ones follow them,
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:225: See you not that they speak about every subject (praising people - right or wrong) in their poetry?
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:226: And that they say what they do not do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.26:227: Except those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, and remember Allâh much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged [by replying back in poetry to the unjust poetry (which the pagan poets utter against the Muslims)]. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:1: Tâ-Sîn. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings].
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:2: A guide (to the Right Path) and glad tidings for the believers [who believe in the Oneness of Allâh (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism)].
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:3: Those who perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) and give Zakât and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter (resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:4: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds fair-seeming to them, so that they wander about blindly.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:5: They are those for whom there will be an evil torment (in this world). And in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:6: And verily, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are being taught the Qur’ân from One, All-Wise, All-Knowing.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:7: (Remember) when Mûsâ (Moses) said to his household: "Verily I have seen a fire; I will bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand, that you may warm yourselves."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:8: But when he came to it, he was called: "Blessed is whosoever is in the fire, and whosoever is round about it! And glorified be Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:9: "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Verily it is I, Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:10: "And throw down your stick!" But when he saw it moving as if it were a snake, he turned in flight, and did not look back. (It was said:) "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Fear not: verily the Messengers fear not in front of Me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:11: "Except him who has done wrong and afterwards has changed evil for good; then surely, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:12: "And put your hand into your bosom, it will come forth white without hurt. (These are) among the nine signs (you will take) to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his people. Verily they are a people who are Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:13: But when Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) came to them, clear to see, they said: "This is a manifest magic."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:14: And they belied them (those Ayât) wrongfully and arrogantly, though their ownselves were convinced thereof [i.e. those (Ayât ) are from Allâh, and Mûsâ (Moses) is the Messenger of Allâh in truth, but they disliked to obey Mûsâ (Moses), and hated to believe in his Message of Monotheism]. So see what was the end of the Mufsidûn (disbelievers, disobedient to Allâh, evil-doers and liars.).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:15: And indeed We gave knowledge to Dâwûd (David) and Sulaimân (Solomon), and they both said: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has preferred us above many of His believing slaves!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:16: And Sulaimân (Solomon) inherited (the knowledge of) Dâwûd (David). He said: "O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and on us have been bestowed all things. This, verily, is an evident grace (from Allâh)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:17: And there were gathered before Sulaimân (Solomon) his hosts of jinn and men, and birds, and they all were set in battle order (marching forward).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:18: Till, when they came to the valley of the ants, one of the ants said: "O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Sulaimân (Solomon) and his hosts should crush you, while they perceive not."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:19: So he [Sulaimân (Solomon)] smiled, amused at her speech and said: "My Lord! Grant me the power and ability that I may be grateful for Your Favours which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may do righteous good deeds that will please You, and admit me by Your Mercy among Your righteous slaves."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:20: He inspected the birds, and said: "What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:21: "I will surely punish him with a severe torment, or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:22: But the hoopoe stayed not long: he (came up and) said: "I have grasped (the knowledge of a thing) which you have not grasped and I have come to you from Saba’ (Sheba) with true news.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:23: "I found a woman ruling over them: she has been given all things that could be possessed by any ruler of the earth, and she has a great throne.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:24: "I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allâh, and Shaitân (Satan) has made their deeds fair-seeming to them, and has barred them from (Allâh’s) Way: so they have no guidance."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:25: [As Shaitân (Satan) has barred them from Allâh’s Way] so they do not worship (prostrate themselves before) Allâh, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal. [Tafsir At-Tabarî]
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:26: Allâh, Lâ ilâha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:27: [Sulaimân (Solomon)] said: "We shall see whether you speak the truth or you are (one) of the liars.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:28: "Go you with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them, then draw back from them, and see what (answer) they return."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:29: She said: "O chiefs! Verily! Here is delivered to me a noble letter,
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:30: "Verily it is from Sulaimân (Solomon), and verily, it (reads): In the Name of Allâh, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful:
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:31: "Be you not exalted against me, but come to me as Muslims (true believers who submit to Allâh with full submission).’ "
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:32: She said: "O chiefs! Advise me in (this) case of mine. I decide no case till you are present with me (and give me your opinions)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:33: They said: "We have great strength, and great ability for war, but it is for you to command: so think over what you will command."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:34: She said: "Verily kings, when they enter a town (country), they despoil it and make the most honourable amongst its people the lowest. And thus they do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:35: "But verily! I am going to send him a present, and see with what (answer) the messengers return."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:36: So when (the messengers with the present) came to Sulaimân (Solomon), he said: "Will you help me in wealth? What Allâh has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay, you rejoice in your gift!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:37: [Then Sulaimân (Solomon) said to the chief of her messengers who brought the present]: "Go back to them. We verily shall come to them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from there in disgrace, and they will be abased."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:38: He said: "O chiefs! Which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me surrendering themselves in obedience?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:39: A ‘Ifrît (strong one) from the jinn said: "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place (council). And verily, I am indeed strong, and trustworthy for such work."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:40: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: "I will bring it to you within the twinkling of an eye!" Then when he [Sulaimân (Solomon)] saw it placed before him, he said: "This is by the Grace of my Lord - to test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful! And whoever is grateful, truly, his gratitude is for (the good of) his ownself; and whoever is ungrateful, (he is ungrateful only for the loss of his ownself). Certainly my Lord is Rich (Free of all needs), Bountiful."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:41: He said: "Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will be guided (to recognise her throne), or she will be one of those not guided."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:42: So when she came, it was said (to her): "Is your throne like this?" She said: "(It is) as though it were the very same." And [Sulaimân (Solomon) said]: "Knowledge was bestowed on us before her, and we were submitted to Allâh (in Islâm as Muslims before her)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:43: And that which she used to worship besides Allâh has prevented her (from Islâm), for she was of a disbelieving people.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:44: It was said to her: "Enter As-Sarh" (a glass surface with water underneath it or a palace): but when she saw it, she thought it was a pool, and she (tucked up her clothes) uncovering her legs. (Sulaimân (Solomon)) said: "Verily, it is a Sarh (a glass surface with water underneath it or a palace)." She said: "My Lord! Verily, I have wronged myself, and I submit [in Islâm, together with Sulaimân (Solomon)] to Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:45: And indeed We sent to Thamûd their brother Sâlih, saying: "Worship Allâh (Alone and none else). Then look! They became two parties (believers and disbelievers) quarreling with each other."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:46: He said: "O my people! Why do you seek to hasten the evil (torment) before the good (Allâh’s Mercy)? Why seek you not the Forgiveness of Allâh, that you may receive mercy?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:47: They said: "We augur ill omen from you and those with you." He said: "Your ill omen is with Allâh; nay, but you are a people that are being tested."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:48: And there were in the city nine men (from the sons of their chiefs), who made mischief in the land, and would not reform.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:49: They said: "Swear one to another by Allâh that we shall make a secret night attack on him and his household, and thereafter we will surely say to his near relatives: ‘We witnessed not the destruction of his household, and verily we are telling the truth.’"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:50: So they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:51: Then see how was the end of their plot! Verily! We destroyed them and their nation, all together.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:52: These are their houses in utter ruin, for they did wrong. Verily, in this is indeed an Ayâh (a lesson or a sign) for people who know.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:53: And We saved those who believed, and used to fear Allâh, and keep their duty to Him.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:54: And (remember) Lût (Lot)! When he said to his people. Do you commit Al-Fâhishah (evil, great sin, every kind of unlawful sexual intercourse, sodomy) while you see (one another doing evil without any screen)?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:55: "Do you practise your lusts on men instead of women? Nay, but you are a people who behave senselessly."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:56: There was no other answer given by his people except that they said: "Drive out the family of Lût (Lot) from your city Verily, these are men who want to be clean and pure!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:57: So We saved him and his family, except his wife. We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:58: And We rained down on them a rain (of stones). So evil was the rain of those who were warned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:59: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Praise and thanks be to Allâh, and peace be on His slaves whom He has chosen (for His Message)! Is Allâh better, or (all) that you ascribe as partners (to Him)?" (Of course, Allâh is Better).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:60: Is not He (better than your gods) Who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water (rain) from the sky, whereby We cause to grow wonderful gardens full of beauty and delight? It is not in your ability to cause the growth of their trees. Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Nay, but they are a people who ascribe equals (to Him)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:61: Is not He (better than your gods) Who has made the earth as a fixed abode, and has placed rivers in its midst, and has placed firm mountains therein, and has set a barrier between the two seas (of salt and sweet water)? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Nay, but most of them know not!
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:62: Is not He (better than your gods) Who responds to the distressed one, when he calls on Him, and Who removes the evil, and makes you inheritors of the earth, generations after generations? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Little is that you remember!
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:63: Is not He (better than your gods) Who guides you in the darkness of the land and the sea, and Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy (rain)? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? High Exalted be Allâh above all that they associate as partners (to Him)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:64: Is not He (better than your so-called gods) Who originates creation, and shall thereafter repeat it, and Who provides for you from heaven and earth? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Say: "Bring forth your proofs, if you are truthful."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:65: Say: "None in the heavens and the earth knows the Ghaib (Unseen) except Allâh, nor can they perceive when they shall be resurrected."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:66: Nay, they have no knowledge of the Hereafter. Nay, they are in doubt about it. Nay, they are in complete blindness about it.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:67: And those who disbelieve say: "When we have become dust - we and our fathers - shall we really be brought forth (again)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:68: "Indeed we were promised this - we and our forefathers before (us), verily, these are nothing but tales of ancients."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:69: Say to them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "Travel in the land and see how has been the end of the Mujrimûn (criminals, those who denied Allâh’s Messengers and disobeyed Allâh)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:70: And grieve you not over them, nor be straitened (in distress) because of what they plot.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:71: And they (the disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) say: "When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if you are truthful?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:72: Say: "Perhaps that which you wish to hasten on, may be close behind you.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:73: "Verily, your Lord is full of Grace for mankind, yet most of them do not give thanks."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:74: And verily, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they reveal.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:75: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven and the earth but it is in a Clear Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:76: Verily, this Qur’ân narrates to the Children of Israel most of that in which they differ.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:77: And truly, it (this Qur’ân) is a guide and a mercy for the believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:78: Verily, your Lord will decide between them (various sects) by His Judgement. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:79: So put your trust in Allâh; surely, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are on manifest truth.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:80: Verily, you cannot make the dead to hear nor can you make the deaf to hear the call (i.e. benefit them and similarly the disbelievers), when they flee, turning their backs.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:81: Nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can only make to hear those who believe in Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and who have submitted (themselves to Allâh in Islâm as Muslims).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:82: And when the Word (of torment) is fulfilled against them, We shall bring out from the earth a beast for them, to speak to them because mankind believed not with certainty in Our Ayât (Verses of the Qur’ân and Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:83: And (remember) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a troop of those who denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and (then) they (all) shall be driven (to the place of reckoning),
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:84: Till, when they come (before their Lord at the place of reckoning), He will say: "Did you deny My Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) whereas you comprehended them not by knowledge (of their truth or falsehood), or what (else) was it that you used to do?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:85: And the Word (of torment) will be fulfilled against them, because they have done wrong, and they will be unable to speak (in order to defend themselves).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:86: See they not that We have made the night for them to rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Verily, in this are Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) for the people who believe.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:87: And (remember) the Day on which the Trumpet will be blown - and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth, will be terrified except him whom Allâh will (exempt). And all shall come to Him, humbled.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:88: And you will see the mountains and think them solid, but they shall pass away as the passing away of the clouds. The Work of Allâh, Who perfected all things, verily He is Well-Acquainted with what you do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:89: Whoever brings a good deed (i.e. Belief in the Oneness of Allâh along with every deed of righteousness), will have better than its worth; and they will be safe from the terror on that Day.
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:90: And whoever brings an evil deed (i.e. Shirk - polytheism, disbelief in the Oneness of Allâh and every evil sinful deed), they will be cast down (prone) on their faces in the Fire. (And it will be said to them) "Are you being recompensed anything except what you used to do?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:91: I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) have been commanded only to worship the Lord of this city (Makkah), Who has sanctified it and to Whom belongs everything. And I am commanded to be from among the Muslims (those who submit to Allâh in Islâm).
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:92: And that I should recite the Qur’ân, then whosoever receives guidance, receives it for the good of his ownself; and whosoever goes astray, say (to him): "I am only one of the warners."
Al-Hilali & Khan.27:93: And say [(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to these polytheists and pagans.]: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh. He will show you His Ayât (signs, in yourselves, and in the universe or punishments), and you shall recognise them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:2: These are the Verses of the manifest Book (that makes clear truth from falsehood, good from evil).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:3: We recite to you some of the news of Mûsâ (Moses) and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) in truth, for a people who believe (in this Qur’ân, and in the Oneness of Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:4: Verily, Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) exalted himself in the land and made its people sects, weakening (oppressing) a group (i.e. Children of Israel) among them: killing their sons, and letting their females live. Verily, he was of the Mufsidûn(i.e. those who commit great sins and crimes, oppressors, tyrants).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:5: And We wished to do a favour to those who were weak (and oppressed) in the land, and to make them rulers and to make them the inheritors,
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:6: And to establish them in the land, and We let Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Hâmân and their hosts receive from them that which they feared.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:7: And We inspired the mother of Mûsâ (Moses): (telling): "Suckle him [Mûsâ (Moses)], but when you fear for him, then cast him into the river and fear not, nor grieve. Verily, We shall bring him back to you, and shall make him one of (Our) Messengers." [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:8: Then the household of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) picked him up, that he might become for them an enemy and a (cause of) grief. Verily, Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), Hâmân and their hosts were sinners.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:9: And the wife of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "A comfort of the eye for me and for you. Kill him not, perhaps he may be of benefit to us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not (the result of that).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:10: And the heart of the mother of Mûsâ (Moses) became empty [from every thought, except the thought of Mûsâ (Moses)]. She was very near to disclose his (case, i.e. the child is her son), had We not strengthened her heart (with Faith), so that she might remain as one of the believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:11: And she said to his [Mûsâ’s (Moses)] sister: "Follow him." So she (his sister) watched him from a far place secretly, while they perceived not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:12: And We had already forbidden (other) foster suckling mothers for him, until she (his sister came up and) said: "Shall I direct you to a household who will rear him for you, and look after him in a good manner?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:13: So did We restore him to his mother, that her eye might be comforted, and that she might not grieve, and that she might know that the Promise of Allâh is true. But most of them know not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:14: And when he attained his full strength, and was perfect (in manhood), We bestowed on him Hukm (Prophethood and right judgement of the affairs) and religious knowledge [of the religion of his forefathers i.e. Islâmic Monotheism]. And thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (i.e. good doers. See the footnote of V.9:120).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:15: And he entered the city at a time of unawareness of its people: and he found there two men fighting, - one of his party (his religion - from the Children of Israel), and the other of his foes. The man of his (own) party asked him for help against his foe, so Mûsâ (Moses) struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: "This is of Shaitan’s (Satan) doing: verily, he is a plain misleading enemy."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:16: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I have wronged myself, so forgive me." Then He forgave him. Verily, He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:17: He said: "My Lord! For that with which You have favoured me, I will never more be a helper of the Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners)!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:18: So he became afraid, looking about in the city (waiting as to what will be the result of his crime of killing), when behold, the man who had sought his help the day before, called for his help (again). Mûsâ (Moses) said to him: "Verily, you are a plain misleader!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:19: Then when he decided to seize the man who was an enemy to both of them, the man said: "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Is it your intention to kill me as you killed a man yesterday? Your aim is nothing but to become a tyrant in the land, and not to be one of those who do right."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:20: And there came a man running, from the farthest end of the city. He said: "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Verily, the chiefs are taking counsel together about you, to kill you, so escape. Truly, I am one of the good advisers to you."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:21: So he escaped from there, looking about in a state of fear. He said: "My Lord! Save me from the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:22: And when he went towards (the land of) Madyan (Midian), he said: "It may be that my Lord guides me to the Right Way."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:23: And when he arrived at the water (a well) of Madyan (Midian) he found there a group of men watering (their flocks), and besides them he found two women who were keeping back (their flocks). He said: "What is the matter with you?" They said: "We cannot water (our flocks) until the shepherds take (their flocks). And our father is a very old man."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:24: So he watered (their flocks) for them, then he turned back to shade, and said: "My Lord! truly, I am in need of whatever good that You bestow on me!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:25: Then there came to him one of the two women, walking shyly. She said: "Verily, my father calls you that he may reward you for having watered (our flocks) for us." So when he came to him and narrated the story, he said: "Fear you not. You have escaped from the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, and wrong-doers)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:26: And said one of them (the two women): "O my father! Hire him! Verily, the best of men for you to hire is the strong, the trustworthy."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:27: He said: "I intend to wed one of these two daughters of mine to you, on condition that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten years, it will be (a favour) from you. But I intend not to place you under a difficulty. If Allâh wills, you will find me one of the righteous."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:28: He [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "That (is settled) between me and you: whichever of the two terms I fulfil, there will be no injustice to me, and Allâh is Surety over what we say."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:29: Then, when Mûsâ (Moses) had fulfilled the term, and was travelling with his family, he saw a fire in the direction of Tûr (Mount). He said to his family: "Wait, I have seen a fire; perhaps I may bring you from there some information, or a burning fire-brand that you may warm yourselves."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:30: So when he reached it (the fire), he was called from the right side of the valley, in the blessed place, from the tree: "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Verily I am Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:31: "And throw your stick!" But when he saw it moving as if it were a snake, he turned in flight, and looked not back. (It was said:) "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Draw near, and fear not. Verily, you are of those who are secure.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:32: "Put your hand in your bosom, it will come forth white without a disease; and draw your hand close to your side to be free from the fear (which you suffered from the snake, and also your hand will return to its original state). These are two Burhâns (signs, miracles, evidence, proofs) from your Lord to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs. Verily, they are the people who are Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:33: He said: "My Lord! I have killed a man among them, and I fear that they will kill me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:34: "And my brother Hârûn (Aaron) - he is more eloquent in speech than me: so send him with me as a helper to confirm me. Verily I fear that they will belie me."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:35: Allâh said: "We will strengthen your arm through your brother, and give you both power, so they shall not be able to harm you: with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), you two as well as those who follow you will be the victors."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:36: Then when Mûsâ (Moses) came to them with Our Clear Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they said: "This is nothing but invented magic. Never did we hear of this among our fathers of old."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:37: Mûsâ (Moses) said: "My Lord knows best him who came with guidance from Him, and whose will be the happy end in the Hereafter. Verily, the Zâlimûn (wrong-doers, polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) will not be successful."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:38: Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "O chiefs! I know not that you have an ilâh (a god) other than me. So kindle for me (a fire), O Hâmân, to bake (bricks out of) clay, and set up for me a Sarh (a lofty tower, or palace) in order that I may look at (or look for) the Ilâh (God) of Mûsâ (Moses); and verily, I think that he [Mûsâ (Moses)] is one of the liars."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:39: And he and his hosts were arrogant in the land, without right, and they thought that they would never return to Us.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:40: So We seized him and his hosts, and We threw them all into the sea (and drowned them). So behold (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) what was the end of the Zâlimûn [wrong-doers, polytheists and those who disbelieved in the Oneness of their Lord (Allâh), or rejected the advice of His Messenger Mûsâ (Moses) عليه السلام].
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:41: And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire: and on the Day of Resurrection, they will not be helped.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:42: And We made a curse to follow them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection, they will be among Al-Maqbuhûn (those who are prevented from receiving Allâh’s Mercy or any good; despised or destroyed).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:43: And indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) - after We had destroyed the generations of old -the Scripture [the Taurât (Torah)] as an enlightenment for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy, that they might remember (or receive admonition).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:44: And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) were not on the western side (of the Mount), when We made clear to Mûsâ (Moses) the commandment, and you were not among the witnesses.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:45: But We created generations [after generations i.e. after Mûsâ (Moses) عليه السلام], and long were the ages that passed over them. And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) were not a dweller among the people of Madyan (Midian), reciting Our Verses to them. But it is We Who kept sending (Messengers).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:46: And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) were not at the side of the Tûr (Mount) when We did call: [it is said that Allâh called the followers of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, and they answered His Call, or that Allâh called Mûsâ (Moses)]. But (you are sent) as a mercy from your Lord, to give warning to a people to whom no warner had come before you: in order that they may remember or receive admonition. [Tafsir At-Tabarî].
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:47: And if (We had) not (sent you to the people of Makkah) - in case a calamity should seize them for (the deeds) that their hands have sent forth, they would have said: "Our Lord! Why did You not send us a Messenger? We would then have followed Your Ayât (Verses of the Qur’ân) and would have been among the believers."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:48: But when the truth (i.e. Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم with his Message) has come to them from Us, they say: "Why is he not given the like of what was given to Mûsâ (Moses)? Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Mûsâ (Moses) of old? They say: "Two kinds of magic [the Taurât (Torah) and the Qur’an], each helping the other!" And they say: "Verily in both we are disbelievers."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:49: Say (to them, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Then bring a Book from Allâh, which is a better guide than these two [the Taurât (Torah) and the Qur’an], that I may follow it, if you are truthful."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:50: But if they answer you not (i.e. do not bring the Book nor believe in your doctrine of Islâmic Monotheism), then know that they only follow their own lusts. And who is more astray than one who follows his own lusts, without guidance from Allâh? Verily Allâh guides not the people who are Zâlimûn (wrong-doers, disobedient to Allâh, and polytheists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:51: And indeed now We have conveyed the Word (this Qur’ân in which is the news of everything) to them, in order that they may remember (or receive admonition).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:52: Those to whom We gave the Scripture [i.e. the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] before it, they believe in it (the Qur’ân).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:53: And when it is recited to them, they say: "We believe in it. Verily, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed even before it we have been from those who submit themselves to Allâh in Islâm as Muslims (like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm and Salmân Al-Farisî).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:54: These will be given their reward twice over, because they are patient, and repel evil with good, and spend (in charity) out of what We have provided them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:55: And when they hear Al-Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk), they withdraw from it and say: "To us our deeds, and to you your deeds. Peace be to you. We seek not (the way of) the ignorant."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:56: Verily you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) guide not whom you like, but Allâh guides whom He wills. And He knows best those who are the guided.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:57: And they say: "If we follow the guidance with you, we would be snatched away from our land." Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary (Makkah), to which are brought fruits of all kinds, a provision from Ourselves, but most of them know not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:58: And how many a town (population) have We destroyed, which was thankless for its means of livelihood (disobeyed Allâh, and His Messengers, by doing evil deeds and crimes)! And those are their dwellings, which have not been inhabited after them except a little. And verily! We have been the inheritors.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:59: And never will your Lord destroy the towns (populations) until He sends to their mother town a Messenger reciting to them Our Verses. And never would We destroy the towns unless the people thereof are Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, oppressors and tyrants).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:60: And whatever you have been given is an enjoyment of the life of (this) world and its adornment, and that (Hereafter) which is with Allâh is better and will remain forever. Have you then no sense?
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:61: Is he whom We have promised an excellent promise (Paradise) - which he will find true - like him whom We have made to enjoy the luxuries of the life of (this) world, then on the Day of Resurrection, he will be among those brought up (to be punished in the Hell-fire)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:62: And (remember) the Day when He will call to them and say: "Where are My (so-called) partners whom you used to assert?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:63: Those about whom the Word will have come true (to be punished) will say: "Our Lord! These are they whom we led astray. We led them astray, as we were astray ourselves. We declare our innocence (from them) before You. It was not us they worshipped."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:64: And it will be said (to them): "Call upon your (so-called) partners (of Allâh)", and they will call upon them, but they will give no answer to them, and they will see the torment. (They will then wish) if only they had been guided!
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:65: And (remember) the Day (Allâh) will call to them, and say: "What answer gave you to the Messengers?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:66: Then the news of a good answer will be obscured to them on that day, and they will not be able to ask one another.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:67: But as for him who repented (from polytheism and sins), believed (in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), and did righteous deeds (in the life of this world), then he will be among those who are successful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:68: And your Lord creates whatsoever He wills and chooses: no choice have they (in any matter). Glorified be Allâh, and exalted above all that they associate (as partners with Him).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:69: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal, and what they reveal.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:70: And He is Allâh: Lâ ilâha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), all praises and thanks be to Him (both) in the first (i.e. in this world) and in the last (i.e. in the Hereafter). And for Him is the Decision, and to Him shall you (all) be returned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:71: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If Allâh made the night continuous for you till the Day of Resurrection, which ilâh (god) besides Allâh could bring you light? Will you not then hear?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:72: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If Allâh made the day continuous for you till the Day of Resurrection, which ilâh (god) besides Allâh could bring you night wherein you rest? Will you not then see?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:73: It is out of His Mercy that He has made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein (i.e. during the night) and that you may seek of His Bounty (i.e. during the day) - and in order that you may be grateful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:74: And (remember) the Day when He (your Lord - Allâh) will call to them (those who worshipped others along with Allâh), and will say: "Where are My (so-called) partners, whom you used to assert?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:75: And We shall take out from every nation a witness, and We shall say: "Bring your proof." Then they shall know that the truth is with Allâh (Alone), and the lies (false gods) which they invented will disappear from them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:76: Verily, Qârûn (Korah) was of Mûsâ’s (Moses) people, but he behaved arrogantly towards them. And We gave him of the treasures, that of which the keys would have been a burden to a body of strong men. Remember when his people said to him: "Do not exult (with riches, being ungrateful to Allâh). Verily Allâh likes not those who exult (with riches, being ungrateful to Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:77: "But seek, with that (wealth) which Allâh has bestowed on you, the home of the Hereafter, and forget not your portion of lawful enjoyment in this world; and do good as Allâh has been good to you, and seek not mischief in the land. Verily, Allâh likes not the Mufsidûn (those who commit great crimes and sins, oppressors, tyrants, mischief-makers, corrupters)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:78: He said: "This has been given to me only because of the knowledge I possess." Did he not know that Allâh had destroyed before him generations, men who were stronger than him in might and greater in the amount (of riches) they had collected? But the Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners) will not be questioned of their sins (because Allâh knows them well, so they will be punished without being called to account).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:79: So he went forth before his people in his pomp. Those who were desirous of the life of the world, said: "Ah, would that we had the like of what Qârûn (Korah) has been given! Verily he is the owner of a great fortune."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:80: But those who had been given (religious) knowledge said: "Woe to you! The Reward of Allâh (in the Hereafter) is better for those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and this none shall attain except those who are As-Sâbirûn (the patient in following the truth)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:81: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his dwelling place. Then he had no group or party to help him against Allâh, nor was he one of those who could save themselves.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:82: And those who had desired (for a position like) his position the day before, began to say: "Know you not that it is Allâh Who enlarges the provision or restricts it to whomsoever He pleases of His slaves. Had it not been that Allâh was Gracious to us, He could have caused the earth to swallow us up (also)! Know you not that the disbelievers will never be successful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:83: That home of the Hereafter (i.e. Paradise), We shall assign to those who rebel not against the truth with pride and oppression in the land nor do mischief by committing crimes. And the good end is for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:84: Whosoever brings good (Islâmic Monotheism along with righteous deeds), he shall have the better thereof; and whosoever brings evil (polytheism along with evil deeds), then those who do evil deeds will only be requited for what they used to do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:85: Verily, He Who has given you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the Qur’an (i.e. ordered you to act on its laws and to preach it to others) will surely bring you back to Ma‘âd (place of return, either to Makkah or to Paradise after your death). Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "My Lord is Aware of him who brings guidance, and of him who is in manifest error."
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:86: And you were not expecting that the Book (this Qur’ân) would be sent down to you, but it is a mercy from your Lord. So never be a supporter of the disbelievers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:87: And let them not turn you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) away from (preaching) the Ayât (revelations and verses) of Allâh after they have been sent down to you: and invite (men) to (believe in) your Lord and be not of Al-Mushrikûn (those who associate partners with Allâh, e.g. polytheists, pagans, idolaters, and those who disbelieve in the Oneness of Allâh and deny the Prophethood of Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).
Al-Hilali & Khan.28:88: And invoke not any other ilâh (god) along with Allâh: Lâ ilâha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). Everything will perish save His Face. His is the Decision, and to Him you (all) shall be returned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:2: Do people think that they will be left alone because they say: "We believe," and will not be tested.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:3: And We indeed tested those who were before them. And Allâh will certainly make (it) known (the truth of) those who are true, and will certainly make (it) known (the falsehood of) those who are liars, (although Allâh knows all that before putting them to test).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:4: Or think those who do evil deeds that they can outstrip Us (i.e. escape Our punishment)? Evil is that which they judge!
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:5: Whoever hopes for the Meeting with Allâh, then Allâh’s Term is surely coming and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:6: And whosoever strives, he strives only for himself. Verily, Allâh stands not in need of any of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:7: Those who believe [in the Oneness of Allâh (Monotheism) and in Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , and do not give up their faith because of the harm they receive from the polytheists], and do righteous good deeds, surely, We shall expiate from them their evil deeds and shall reward them according to the best of that which they used to do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:8: And We have enjoined on man to be good and dutiful to his parents; but if they strive to make you join with Me (in worship) anything (as a partner) of which you have no knowledge, then obey them not. Unto Me is your return and I shall tell you what you used to do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:9: And for those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh and the other articles of Faith) and do righteous good deeds, surely, We shall make them enter with (in the entrance of) the righteous (in Paradise).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:10: Of mankind are some who say: "We believe in Allâh." But if they are made to suffer for the sake of Allâh, they consider the trial of mankind as Allâh’s punishment; and if victory comes from your Lord, (the hypocrites) will say: "Verily we were with you (helping you)." Is not Allâh Best Aware of what is in the breasts of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:11: Verily, Allâh knows those who believe, and verily, He knows the hypocrites [i.e. Allâh will test the people with good and hard days to discriminate the good from the wicked, although Allâh knows all that before putting them to test].
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:12: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Follow our way and we will verily bear your sins." Never will they bear anything of their sins. Surely, they are liars.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:13: And verily, they shall bear their own loads, and other loads besides their own; and verily, they shall be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about that which they used to fabricate.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:14: And indeed We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people, and he stayed among them a thousand years less fifty years [inviting them to believe in the Oneness of Allâh (Monotheism), and discard the false gods and other deities]; and the Deluge overtook them while they were Zâlimûn (wrong-doers, polytheists, disbelievers).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:15: Then We saved him and those with him in the ship, and made it (the ship) an Ayâh (a lesson, a warning) for the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:16: And (remember) Ibrâhîm (Abraham) when he said to his people: "Worship Allâh (Alone), and fear Him: that is better for you if you did but know.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:17: "You worship besides Allâh only idols, and you only invent falsehood. Verily, those whom you worship besides Allâh have no power to give you provision: so seek your provision from Allâh (Alone), and worship Him (Alone), and be grateful to Him. To Him (Alone) you will be brought back.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:18: "And if you deny, then nations before you have denied (their Messengers). And the duty of the Messenger is only to convey (the Message) plainly."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:19: See they not how Allâh originates the creation, then repeats it. Verily, that is easy for Allâh.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:20: Say: "Travel in the land and see how (Allâh) originated the creation, and then Allâh will bring forth the creation of the Hereafter (i.e. resurrection after death). Verily, Allâh is Able to do all things."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:21: He punishes whom He wills, and shows mercy to whom He wills; and to Him you will be returned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:22: And you cannot escape in the earth or in the heaven (from Allah). And besides Allâh you have neither any Walî (Protector or Guardian) nor any Helper.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:23: And those who disbelieve in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh and the Meeting with Him, it is they who have no hope of My Mercy: and it is they who will have a painful torment.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:24: So nothing was the answer of [Ibrâhîm’s (Abraham)] people except that they said: "Kill him or burn him." Then Allâh saved him from the fire. Verily, in this are indeed signs for a people who believe.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:25: And [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "You have taken (for worship) idols instead of Allâh. The love between you is only in the life of this world, but on the Day of Resurrection, you shall disown each other, and curse each other, and your abode will be the Fire, and you shall have no helper."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:26: So Lût (Lot) believed in him [Ibrâhîm’s (Abraham) Message of Islâmic Monotheism]. He [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "I will emigrate for the sake of my Lord. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:27: And We bestowed on him [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)], Ishâq (Isaac) and Ya‘qûb (Jacob), and We ordained among his offspring Prophethood and the Book [i.e. the Taurât (Torah) (to Mûsâ - Moses), the Injeel (Gospel) (to ‘Îsâ - Jesus), and the Qur’ân (to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), all from the offspring of Ibrâhîm (Abraham)], and We granted him his reward in this world; and verily, in the Hereafter he is indeed among the righteous.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:28: And (remember) Lût (Lot), when he said to his people: "You commit Al-Fâhishah (sodomy - the worst sin) which none has preceded you in (committing) it in the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:29: "Verily, you practise sodomy with men, and rob the wayfarer (travellers)! And practise Al-Munkar (disbelief and polytheism and every kind of evil wicked deed) in your meetings." But his people gave no answer except that they said: "Bring Allâh’s Torment upon us if you are one of the truthful."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:30: He said: "My Lord! Give me victory over the people who are Mufsidûn (those who commit great crimes and sins, oppressors, tyrants, mischief-makers, corrupters).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:31: And when Our Messengers came to Ibrâhîm (Abraham) with the glad tidings they said: "Verily, we are going to destroy the people of this [Lût (Lot’s)] town (i.e. the town of Sodom in Palestine); truly, its people have been Zâlimûn [wrong-doers, polytheists disobedient to Allâh, and who belied their Messenger Lût (Lot)]."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:32: Ibrâhîm (Abraham) said: "But there is Lût (Lot) in it." They said: "We know better who is there. We will verily save him [Lût (Lot)] and his family except his wife: she will be of those who remain behind (i.e. she will be destroyed along with those who will be destroyed from her folk)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:33: And when Our Messengers came to Lût (Lot), he was grieved because of them, and felt straitened on their account. They said: "Have no fear, and do not grieve! Truly, we shall save you and your family, except your wife: she will be of those who remain behind (i.e. she will be destroyed along with those who will be destroyed from her folk).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:34: "Verily, we are about to bring down on the people of this town a great torment from the sky, because they have been rebellious (against Allâh’s Command)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:35: And indeed We have left thereof an evident Ayâh (a lesson and a warning and a sign - the place where the Dead Sea is now in Palestine) for a folk who understand.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:36: And to (the people of) Madyan (Midian), We sent their brother Shu‘aib. He said: "O my people! Worship Allâh (Alone) and hope for (the reward of good deeds by worshipping Allâh Alone, on) the last Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection), and commit no mischief on the earth as Mufsidûn (those who commit great crimes, oppressors, tyrants, mischief-makers, corrupters). [Tafsir At-Tabari]
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:37: And they belied him [Shu‘aib]: so the earthquake seized them, and they lay (dead), prostrate in their dwellings.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:38: And ‘Âd and Thamûd (people)! And indeed (their destruction) is clearly apparent to you from their (ruined) dwellings. Shaitân (Satan) made their deeds fair-seeming to them, and turned them away from the (Right) Path, though they were intelligent.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:39: And (We destroyed also) Qârûn (Korah), Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and Hâmân. And indeed Mûsâ (Moses) came to them with clear Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), but they were arrogant in the land, yet they could not outstrip Us (escape Our punishment).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:40: So We punished each (of them) for his sins; of them were some on whom We sent Hâsib (a violent wind with shower of stones) [as on the people of Lût (Lot)], and of them were some who were overtaken by As-Saihah [torment - awful cry. (as Thamûd or Shu‘aib’s people)], and of them were some whom We caused the earth to swallow [as Qârûn (Korah)], and of them were some whom We drowned [as the people of Nûh (Noah), or Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his people]. It was not Allâh Who wronged them, but they wronged themselves.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:41: The likeness of those who take (false deities as) Auliyâ’ (protectors, helpers) other than Allâh is the likeness of a spider who builds (for itself) a house; but verily, the frailest (weakest) of houses is the spider’s house - if they but knew.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:42: Verily, Allâh knows what things they invoke instead of Him. He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:43: And these similitudes We put forward for mankind; but none will understand them except those who have knowledge (of Allâh and His Signs).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:44: (Allâh says to His Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Allâh (Alone) created the heavens and the earth with truth (and none shared Him in their creation)." Verily! Therein is surely a sign for those who believe.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:45: Recite (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) what has been revealed to you of the Book (the Qur’ân), and perform As-Salât (Iqamât-as-Salât). Verily, As-Salât (the prayer) prevents from Al-Fahshâ’ (i.e. great sins of every kind, unlawful sexual intercourse) and Al-Munkar (i.e. disbelief, polytheism, and every kind of evil wicked deed) and the remembering (praising) of (you by) Allâh (in front of the angels) is greater indeed [than your remembering (praising) of Allâh in prayers. And Allâh knows what you do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:46: And argue not with the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians), unless it be in (a way) that is better (with good words and in good manner, inviting them to Islâmic Monotheism with His Verses), except with such of them as do wrong; and say (to them): "We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you; our Ilâh (God) and your Ilâh (God) is One (i.e. Allâh), and to Him we have submitted (as Muslims)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:47: And thus We have sent down the Book (i.e. this Qur’an) to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), and those whom We gave the Scripture [the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel) aforetime] believe therein as also do some of these (who are present with you now like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm) and none but the disbelievers reject Our Ayât [(proofs, signs, verses, lessons, etc.,) and deny Our Oneness of Lordship and Our Oneness of worship and Our Oneness of Our Names and Qualities: i.e. Islâmic Monotheism].
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:48: Neither did you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) read any book before it (this Qur’ân), nor did you write any book (whatsoever) with your right hand. In that case, indeed, the followers of falsehood might have doubted.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:49: Nay, but they, the clear Ayât [i.e. the description and the qualities of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] are preserved in the breasts of those who have been given knowledge (among the people of the Scriptures). And none but the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrongdoers) deny Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:50: And they say: "Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord? Say: "The signs are only with Allâh, and I am only a plain warner."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:51: Is it not sufficient for them that We have sent down to you the Book (the Qur’ân) which is recited to them? Verily, herein is mercy and a reminder (or an admonition) for a people who believe.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:52: Say (to them O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Sufficient is Allâh for a witness between me and you. He knows what is in the heavens and on earth." And those who believe in Bâtil (all false deities other than Allâh), and disbelieve in Allâh and (in His Oneness), it is they who are the losers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:53: And they ask you to hasten on the torment (for them): and had it not been for a term appointed, the torment would certainly have come to them. And surely, it will come upon them suddenly while they perceive not!
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:54: They ask you to hasten on the torment. And verily, Hell, of a surety, will encompass the disbelievers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:55: On the Day when the torment (Hell-fire) shall cover them from above them and from underneath their feet, and it will be said: "Taste what you used to do."
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:56: O My slaves who believe! Certainly, spacious is My earth. Therefore worship Me." (Alone).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:57: Everyone shall taste death. Then unto Us you shall be returned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:58: And those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, to them We shall surely give lofty dwellings in Paradise, underneath which rivers flow, to live therein forever. Excellent is the reward for the workers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:59: Those who are patient, and put their trust (only) in their Lord (Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:60: And so many a moving (living) creature carries not its own provision! Allâh provides for it and for you. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:61: And if you were to ask them: "Who has created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon?" they will surely reply: "Allâh." How then are they deviating (as polytheists and disbelievers)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.29:62: Allâh enlarges the provision for whom He wills of His slaves, and straitens it for whom (He wills). Verily, Allâh is the All-Knower of everything.
