Al-Hilali & Khan.36:31: Do they not see how many of the generations We have destroyed before them? Verily, they will not return to them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:32: And surely, all - everyone of them will be brought before Us.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:33: And a sign for them is the dead land. We give it life, and We bring forth from it grains, so that they eat thereof.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:34: And We have made therein gardens of date-palms and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:35: So that they may eat of the fruit thereof - and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:36: Glory be to Him Who has created all the pairs of that which the earth produces, as well as of their own (human) kind (male and female), and of that which they know not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:37: And a sign for them is the night. We withdraw therefrom the day, and behold, they are in darkness.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:38: And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term (appointed). That is the Decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:39: And the moon, We have measured for it mansions (to traverse) till it returns like the old dried curved date stalk.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:40: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day. They all float, each in an orbit.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:41: And an Ayâh (sign) for them is that We bore their offspring in the laden ship [of Nûh (Noah)].
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:42: And We have created for them of the like thereunto, on which they ride.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:43: And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout (or helper) for them (to hear their cry for help), nor will they be saved.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:44: Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:45: And when it is said to them: "Fear of that which is before you (worldly torments), and that which is behind you (torments in the Hereafter), in order that you may receive Mercy (i.e. if you believe in Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism, and avoid polytheism, and obey Allâh with righteous deeds)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:46: And never came an Ayâh from among the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:47: And when it is said to them: "Spend of that with which Allâh has provided you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Shall we feed those whom, if Allâh willed, He (Himself) would have fed? You are only in a plain error."
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:48: And they say: "When will this promise (i.e. Resurrection) be fulfilled, if you are truthful?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:49: They await only but a single Saihah (shout), which will seize them while they are disputing!
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:50: Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:51: And the Trumpet will be blown (i.e. the second blowing) and behold from the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:52: They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Gracious (Allâh) had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:53: It will be but a single Saihah (shout), so behold they will all be brought up before Us!
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:54: This Day (Day of Resurrection), none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:55: Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy with joyful things.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:56: They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:57: They will have therein fruits (of all kinds) and all that they ask for.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:58: (It will be said to them): Salâm (peace be on you) - a Word from the Lord (Allâh), Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:59: (It will be said): "And O you Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Islâmic Monotheism, wicked evil ones)! Get you apart this Day (from the believers).
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:60: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitân (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:61: And that you should worship Me [Alone - Islâmic Monotheism, and set up not rivals, associate-gods with Me]. That is the Straight Path.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:62: And indeed he (Satan) did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not, then, understand?
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:63: This is Hell which you were promised!
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:64: Burn therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:65: This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn. (It is said that one’s left thigh will be the first to bear the witness). [Tafsir At-Tabarî,]
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:66: And if it had been Our Will, We would surely have wiped out (blinded) their eyes, so that they would struggle for the Path, how then would they see?
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:67: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (into animals or lifeless objects) in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:68: And he whom We grant long life - We reverse him in creation (weakness after strength). Will they not then understand?
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:69: And We have not taught him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur’ân.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:70: That he or it (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم or the Qur’ân) may give warning to him who is living (a healthy minded - the believer), and that Word (charge) may be justified against the disbelievers (dead, as they reject the warnings).
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:71: Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have created the cattle, so that they are their owners.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:72: And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:73: And they have (other) benefits from them, and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:74: And they have taken besides Allâh âlihah (gods), hoping that they might be helped (by those so-called gods).
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:75: They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop against those who worshipped them (at the time of Reckoning).
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:76: So let not their speech, then, grieve you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:77: Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge - semen drops). Yet behold he (stands forth) as an open opponent.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:78: And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones after they are rotten and have become dust?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:79: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:80: He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold you kindle therewith.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:81: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, Able to create the like of them? Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator.
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:82: Verily, His Command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" - and it is!
Al-Hilali & Khan.36:83: So glorified be He and exalted above all that they associate with Him, and in Whose Hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him you shall be returned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:1: By those (angels) ranged in ranks (or rows).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:2: By those (angels) who drive the clouds in a good way.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:3: By those (angels) who bring the Book and the Qur’ân from Allâh to mankind [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:4: Verily your Ilâh (God) is indeed One (i.e. Allâh):
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:5: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun’s risings.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:6: Verily We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (for beauty).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:7: And to guard against every rebellious devil.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:8: They cannot listen to the higher group (angels) for they are pelted from every side.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:9: Outcast, and theirs is a constant (or painful) torment.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:10: Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:11: Then ask them (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are they stronger as creation, or those (others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains) whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:12: Nay, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) wondered (at their insolence) while they mock (at you and at the Qur’ân).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:13: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:14: And when they see an Ayâh (a sign, or an evidence) from Allâh, they mock at it.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:15: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:16: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we (then) verily be resurrected?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:18: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:19: It will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet)], and behold, they will be staring!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:20: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:21: (It will be said): "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:22: (It will be said to the angels): "Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions (from the devils) and what they used to worship,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:23: "Instead of Allâh, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:24: "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:25: "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another (as you used to do in the world)?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:26: Nay, but that Day they shall surrender.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:27: And they will turn to one another and question one another.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:28: They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side [i.e. from the right side of one of us and beautify for us every evil, enjoin on us polytheism, and stop us from the truth i.e. Islâmic Monotheism and from every good deed]."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:29: They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:30: "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were Tâghûn (transgressing) people (polytheists, and disbelievers).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:31: "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly (have to) taste (the torment).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:32: "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:33: Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:34: Certainly, that is how We deal with Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, disbelievers, criminals, the disobedient to Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:35: Truly, when it was said to them: Lâ ilâha illallâh "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh)," they puffed themselves up with pride (i.e. denied it).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:36: And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our âlihah (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:37: Nay! he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come with the truth (i.e. Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism and this Qur’ân) and he confirms the Messengers (before him who brought Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:38: Verily, you (pagans of Makkah) are going to taste the painful torment;
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:39: And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (evil deeds, sins, and Allâh’s disobedience which you used to do in this world)
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:40: Save the chosen slaves of Allâh (i.e. the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:41: For them there will be a known provision (in Paradise),
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:42: Fruits; and they shall be honoured,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:45: Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine -
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:47: Neither will they have Ghoul (any kind of hurt, abdominal pain, headache, a sin) from that, nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:48: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives), restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], with wide and beautiful eyes.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:49: (Delicate and pure) as if they were (hidden) eggs (well) preserved.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:50: Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:51: A speaker of them will say: "Verily, I had a companion (in the world),
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:52: Who used to say: "Are you among those who believe (in resurrection after death).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:53: "(That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed (be raised up) to receive reward or punishment (according to our deeds)?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:55: So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:56: He said: "By Allâh! You have nearly ruined me.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:57: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:58: (The dwellers of Paradise will say) "Are we then not to die (any more)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:59: Except our first death, and we shall not be punished? (after we have entered Paradise)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:60: Truly, this is the supreme success!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:61: For the like of this let the workers work.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:62: Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqûm (a horrible tree in Hell)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:63: Truly We have made it (as) a trail for the Zâlimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, wrong-doers).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:64: Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:65: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of Shayâtîn (devils);
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:66: Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:67: Then on the top of that they will be given boiling water to drink so that it becomes a mixture (of boiling water and Zaqqûm in their bellies).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:68: Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:69: Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:70: So they (too) hastened in their footsteps!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:71: And indeed most of the men of old went astray before them;
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:72: And indeed We sent among them warners (Messengers);
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:73: Then see what was the end of those who were warned (but heeded not).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:74: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh (faithful, obedient, and true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:75: And indeed Nûh (Noah) invoked Us, and We are the Best of those who answer (the request).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:76: And We rescued him and his family from the great distress (i.e. drowning),
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:77: And, his progeny, them We made the survivors (i.e. Shem, Ham and Japheth).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:78: And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations:
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:79: "Salâm (peace) be upon Nûh (Noah) (from Us) among the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:80: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:81: Verily, he [Nûh (Noah)] was one of Our believing slaves.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:82: Then We drowned the others (disbelievers and polytheists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:83: And, verily, among those who followed his [Nûh’s (Noah)] way (Islâmic Monotheism) was Ibrâhîm (Abraham).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:84: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart [attached to Allâh Alone and none else, worshipping none but Allâh Alone - true Islâmic Monotheism, pure from the filth of polytheism].
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:85: When he said to his father and to his people: "What is it that which you worship?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:86: "Is it a falsehood - âlihah (gods) other than Allâh - that you desire?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:87: "Then what think you about the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists)?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:88: Then he cast a glance at the stars,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:89: And he said: "Verily, I am sick (with plague). [He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan feast)]."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:90: So they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:91: Then he turned to their âlihah (gods) and said: "Will you not eat (of the offering before you)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:92: "What is the matter with you that you speak not?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:93: Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:94: Then they (the worshippers of idols) came, towards him, hastening.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:95: He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:96: "While Allâh has created you and what you make!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:97: They said: "Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:98: So they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:99: And he said (after his rescue from the fire): "Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:100: "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:101: So We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:102: And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: "O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice to Allâh). So look what you think!" He said: "O my father! Do that which you are commanded, In shâ’ Allâh (if Allâh wills), you shall find me of As-Sâbirûn (the patient)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:103: Then, when they had both submitted themselves (to the Will of Allâh), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (or on the side of his forehead for slaughtering);
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:104: We called out to him: "O Abraham!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:105: You have fulfilled the dream!" Verily thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See 2:112).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:106: Verily, that indeed was a manifest trial.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:107: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice (i.e. كبش - a ram);
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:108: And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:110: Thus indeed do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:111: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:112: And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishâq (Isaac) - a Prophet from the righteous.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:113: We blessed him and Ishâq (Isaac). And of their progeny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:114: And, indeed We gave Our Grace to Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:115: And We saved them and their people from the great distress,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:116: And helped them, so that they became the victors;
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:117: And We gave them the clear Scripture;
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:118: And guided them to the Right Path.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:119: And We left for them (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:121: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:122: Verily, they were two of Our believing slaves.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:123: And verily, Iliyâs (Elias) was one of the Messengers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:124: When he said to his people: "Will you not fear Allâh?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:125: "Will you call upon Ba‘l (a well known idol of his nation whom they used to worship) and forsake the Best of creators,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:126: "Allâh, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:127: But they denied him [Iliyâs (Elias)], so they will certainly be brought forth (to the punishment),
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:128: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:129: And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:131: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers, who perform good deeds totally for Allâh’s sake only - See V.2:112).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:132: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:133: And verily, Lût (Lot) was one of the Messengers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:134: When We saved him and his family, all,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:135: Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:136: Then We destroyed the rest (the town of Sodom at the place of the Dead Sea now in Palestine).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:137: Verily, you pass by them in the morning
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:138: And at night; will you not then reflect?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:139: And, verily, Yûnus (Jonah) was one of the Messengers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:140: When he ran to the laden ship:
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:141: Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:142: Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:143: Had he not been of them who glorify Allâh,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:144: He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:145: But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:146: And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:147: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:148: And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:149: Now ask them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:150: Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:151: Verily, it is of their falsehood that they (Quraish pagans) say:
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:152: "Allâh has begotten [offspring - the angels being the daughters of Allâh)?" And, verily, they are liars!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:153: Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:154: What is the matter with you? How do you decide?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:156: Or is there for you a plain authority?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:157: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:158: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be called to account).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:159: Glorified be Allâh! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:160: Except the slaves of Allâh, whom He chooses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islâmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things unto Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:161: So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols)
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:162: Cannot lead astray [turn away from Him (Allâh) anyone of the believers],
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:163: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:164: And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (or position);
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:165: And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows (for the prayers as you Muslims stand in rows for your prayers);
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:166: And verily, we (angels), indeed are those who glorify (Allâh’s Praises i.e. perform prayers).
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:167: And indeed they (Arab pagans) used to say:
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:168: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old (before the coming of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as a Messenger of Allâh),
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:169: "We would have indeed been the chosen slaves of Allâh (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:170: But (now that the Qur’ân has come) they disbelieve therein (i.e. in the Qur’ân and in Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , and all that he brought, - the Divine Revelation), so they will come to know!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:171: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves, the Messengers,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:172: That they verily would be made triumphant,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:173: And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:174: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them for a while,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:175: And watch them and they shall see (the punishment)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:176: Do they seek to hasten on Our Torment?
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:177: Then, when it descends in their courtyard (i.e. near to them), evil will be the morning for those who had been warned!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:178: So turn (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) away from them for a while,
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:179: And watch and they shall see (the torment)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:180: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:181: And peace be on the Messengers!
Al-Hilali & Khan.37:182: And all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:1:
Sâd.
[These letters (Sâd etc.) are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Quran full of reminding.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:2: Nay, those who disbelieve are in false pride and opposition.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:3: How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:4: And they (Arab pagans) wonder that a warner (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a sorcerer, a liar.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:5: "Has he made the âlihah (gods) (all) into One Ilâh (God - Allâh). Verily, this is a curious thing!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:6: And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your âlihah (gods)! Verily, this is a thing designed (against you)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:7: "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days (i.e. Christianity). This is nothing but an invention! [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:8: "Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder (this Qur’ân)! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) Torment!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:9: Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:10: Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means (to the heavens)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:11: (As they denied Allâh’s Message) they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times (who were defeated).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:12: Before them (were many who) belied (Messengers) - the people of Nûh (Noah); and ‘Âd; and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) the man of stakes (with which he used to punish the people),
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:13: And Thamûd, and the people of Lût (Lot), and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:14: Not one of them but belied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:15: And these only wait for a single Saihah [shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrâfil -)] there will be no pause or ending thereto [till everything will perish except Allâh (the only God full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour)].
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:16: They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittanâ (i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we may see it) before the Day of Reckoning!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:17: Be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of what they say, and remember Our slave Dâwûd (David), endued with power. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance (toward Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:18: Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our Praises with him [Dâwûd (David)] in the ‘Ashî (i.e. after the mid-day till sunset) and Ishrâq (i.e. after the sunrise till mid-day).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:19: And (so did) the birds assembled: all obedient to him [Dâwûd (David)] [i.e. they came and glorified Allâh’s Praises along with him]. (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi ).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:20: We made his kingdom strong and gave him Al-Hikmah (Prophethood) and sound judgement in speech and decision.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:21: And has the news of the litigants reached you? When they climbed over the wall into (his) Mihrâb (a praying place or a private room);
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:22: When they entered in upon Dâwûd (David), he was terrified of them. They said: "Fear not! (We are) two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other, therefore judge between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, and guide us to the Right Way.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:23: Verily, this my brother (in religion) has ninety-nine ewes, while I have (only) one ewe, and he says: "Hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:24: [Dâwûd (David)] said (immediately without listening to the opponent): "He has wronged you in demanding your ewe in addition to his ewes. And, verily, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and they are few." And Dâwûd (David) guessed that We have tried him and he sought Forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down prostrate and turned (to Allâh) in repentance.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:25: So We forgave him that, and verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good place of (final) return (Paradise).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:26: O Dâwûd (David)! Verily! We have placed you as a successor on the earth; so judge you between men in truth (and justice) and follow not your desire - for it will mislead you from the Path of Allâh. Verily, those who wander astray from the Path of Allâh (shall) have a severe torment, because they forgot the Day of Reckoning.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:27: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them without purpose! That is the consideration of those who disbelieve! Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Islâmic Monotheism) from the Fire!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:28: Shall We treat those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds as Mufsidûn (those who associate partners in worship with Allâh and commit crimes) on earth? Or shall We treat the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) as the Fujjâr (criminals, disbelievers, the wicked)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:29: (This is) a Book (the Qur’ân) which We have sent down to you, full of blessings, that they may ponder over its Verses, and that men of understanding may remember.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:30: And to Dâwûd (David) We gave Sulaimân (Solomon). How excellent a slave! Verily, he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:31: When there were displayed before him, in the afternoon, well trained horses of the highest breed [for Jihâd (holy fighting in Allâh’s Cause)].
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:32: He said: "I did love the good (these horses) instead of remembering my Lord (in my ‘Asr prayer)" till the time was over, and (the sun) had hidden in the veil (of night).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:33: Then he said "Bring them (horses) back to me." Then he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks (till the end of the display).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:34: And indeed, We did try Sulaimân (Solomon) and We placed on his throne Jasad (a devil, so he lost his kingdom for a while) and he did return (to Allâh with obedience and in repentance, and to his throne and kingdom by the Grace of Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:35: He said: "My Lord! Forgive me, and bestow upon me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me: Verily, You are the Bestower."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:36: So, We subjected to him the wind; it blew gently by his order whithersoever he willed,
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:37: And also the Shayâtîn (devils) from the jinn (including) every kind of builder and diver,
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:38: And also others bound in fetters.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:39: [Allâh said to Sulaimân (Solomon)]: "This is Our gift: so spend you or withhold, no account will be asked (of you)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:40: And verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good (final) return (Paradise).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:41: And remember Our slave Ayyûb (Job), when he invoked his Lord (saying): "Verily Shaitân (Satan) has touched me with distress (by ruining my health) and torment (by ruining my wealth)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:42: (Allâh said to him): "Strike the ground with your foot: This is (a spring of) water to wash in, cool and a (refreshing) drink."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:43: And We gave him (back) his family, and along with them the like thereof, as a Mercy from Us, and a Reminder for those who understand.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:44: "And take in your hand a bundle of thin grass and strike therewith (your wife), and break not your oath. Truly! We found him patient. How excellent a slave! Verily he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:45: And remember Our slaves, Ibrâhîm (Abraham), Ishâq (Isaac), and Ya‘qûb (Jacob), (all) owners of strength (in worshipping Us) and (also) of religious understanding.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:46: Verily, We did choose them by granting them (a good thing, - i.e.) the remembrance of the Home [in the Hereafter and they used to make the people remember it, and also they used to invite the people to obey Allâh and to do good deeds for the Hereafter].
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:47: And they are with Us, verily, of the chosen and the best!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:48: And remember Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael), Alyasa‘ (Elisha), and Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah), all are among the best.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:49: This is a Reminder. And verily, for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) is a good final return (Paradise),
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:50: ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), whose doors will be opened for them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:51: Therein they will recline; therein they will call for fruits in abundance and drinks;
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:52: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives) restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], (and) of equal ages.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:53: This it is what you (Al-Muttaqûn - the pious - see V.2:2) are promised for the Day of Reckoning!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:54: (It will be said to them)! Verily, this is Our Provision which will never finish.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:55: This is so! And for the Tâghûn (transgressors, the disobedient to Allâh and His Messenger - disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, criminals) will be an evil final return (Fire).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:56: Hell! Where they will burn, and worst (indeed) is that place to rest!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:57: This is so! Then let them taste it - a boiling fluid and dirty wound discharges.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:58: And other (torments) of similar kind - all together!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:59: This is a troop entering with you (in Hell), no welcome for them! Verily, they shall burn in the Fire!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:60: (The followers of the misleaders will say): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you (misleaders) who brought this upon us (because you misled us in the world), so evil is this place to stay in!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:61: They will say: "Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, add to him a double torment in the Fire!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:62: And they will say: "What is the matter with us that we see not men whom we used to count among the bad ones?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:63: Did we take them as an object of mockery, or have (our) eyes failed to perceive them?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:64: Verily, that is the very truth - the mutual dispute of the people of the Fire!
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:65: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I am only a warner and there is no Ilâh (God) except Allâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh) the One, the Irresistible,
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:66: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:67: Say: "That (this Qur’ân) is a great news,
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:69: "I had no knowledge of the chiefs (angels) on high when they were disputing and discussing (about the creation of Adam).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:70: "Only this has been revealed to me, that I am a plain warner."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:71: (Remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "Truly I am going to create man from clay".
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:72: So when I have fashioned him and breathed into him (his) soul created by Me, then you fall down prostrate to him."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:73: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them:
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:74: Except Iblîs (Satan): he was proud and was one of the disbelievers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:75: (Allâh) said: "O Iblîs (Satan)! What prevents you from prostrating yourself to one whom I have created with Both My Hands. Are you too proud (to fall prostrate to Adam) or are you one of the high exalted?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:76: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "I am better than he. You created me from fire, and You created him from clay."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:77: (Allâh) said: "Then get out from here; for verily you are outcast.
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:78: "And verily My Curse is on you till the Day of Recompense."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:79: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "My Lord! Give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are resurrected."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:80: (Allâh) said: "Verily! You are of those allowed respite."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:81: "Till the Day of the time appointed."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:82: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "By Your Might, then I will surely mislead them all,
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:83: "Except Your chosen slaves amongst them (i.e. faithful, obedient, true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:84: (Allâh) said: "The Truth is - and the Truth I say -
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:85: That I will fill Hell with you [Iblîs (Satan)] and those of them (mankind) that follow you, together."
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:86: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "No wage do I ask of you for this (the Qur’ân), nor am I one of the Mutakallifûn (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:87: "It (this Qur’ân) is only a Reminder for all the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn).
Al-Hilali & Khan.38:88: "And you shall certainly know the truth of it after a while".
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:1: The revelation of this Book (the Qur’ân) is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:2: Verily We have sent down the Book to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) in truth: So worship Allâh (Alone) by doing religious deeds sincerely for Allâh’s sake only.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:3: Surely the religion (i.e. the worship and the obedience) is for Allâh only. And those who take Auliyâ’ (protectors, helpers, lords, gods) besides Him (say): "We worship them only that they may bring us near to Allâh." Verily Allâh will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Truly, Allâh guides not him who is a liar, and a disbeliever.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:4: Had Allâh willed to take a son (or offspring), He could have chosen whom He willed out of those whom He created. But glory be to Him! (He is above such things). He is Allâh, the One, the Irresistible.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:5: He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. He makes the night to go in the day and makes the day to go in the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon. Each running (on a fixed course) for an appointed term. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:6: He created you (all) from a single person (Adam); then made from him his wife [Hawwâ’ (Eve)]. And He has sent down for you of cattle eight pairs (of the sheep, two, male and female; of the goats, two, male and female; of the oxen, two, male and female; and of the camels, two, male and female). He creates you in the wombs of your mothers: creation after creation in three veils of darkness. Such is Allâh your Lord. His is the kingdom. Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). How then are you turned away?
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:7: If you disbelieve, then verily, Allâh is not in need of you; He likes not disbelief for His slaves. And if you are grateful (by being believers), He is pleased therewith for you. No bearer of burdens shall bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you what you used to do. Verily, He is the All-Knower of that which is in (men’s) breasts.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:8: And when some hurt touches man, he cries to his Lord (Allâh Alone), turning to Him in repentance. But when He bestows a favour upon him from Himself, he forgets that for which he cried for before, and he sets up rivals to Allâh, in order to mislead others from His Path. Say: "Take pleasure in your disbelief for a while: surely you are (one) of the dwellers of the Fire!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:9: Is one who is obedient to Allâh, prostrating himself or standing (in prayer) during the hours of the night, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the Mercy of his Lord (like one who disbelieves)? Say: "Are those who know equal to those who know not?" It is only men of understanding who will remember (i.e. get a lesson from Allâh’s Signs and Verses).
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:10: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "O My slaves who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism), be afraid of your Lord (Allâh) and keep your duty to Him. Good is (the reward) for those who do good in this world, and Allâh’s earth is spacious (so if you cannot worship Allâh at a place, then go to another)! Only those who are patient shall receive their reward in full, without reckoning."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:11: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Verily I am commanded to worship Allâh (Alone) by obeying Him and doing religious deeds sincerely for His sake only.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:12: "And I am commanded (this) in order that I may be the first of those who submit themselves to Allâh (in Islâm) as Muslims."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:13: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Verily if I disobey my Lord, I am afraid of the torment of a great Day."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:14: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Allâh Alone I worship by doing religious deeds sincerely for His sake only (and not to show off, and not to set up rivals with Him in worship.)"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:15: So worship what you like besides Him. Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "The losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Verily, that will be a manifest loss!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:16: They shall have coverings of Fire, above them and covering (of Fire) beneath them. With this Allâh does frighten His slaves: "O My slaves, therefore fear Me!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:17: Those who avoid At-Tâghût  (false deities) by not worshipping them and turn to Allâh (in repentance), for them are glad tidings; so announce the good news to My slaves -
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:18: Those who listen to the Word [good advice Lâ ilâha illallâh - (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh) and Islâmic Monotheism] and follow the best thereof (i.e. worship Allâh Alone, repent to Him and avoid Tâghût) those are (the ones) whom Allâh has guided and those are men of understanding.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:19: Is, then one against whom the Word of punishment is justified (equal to the one who avoids evil)? Will you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) rescue him who is in the Fire?
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:20: But those who fear their Lord (Allâh) and keep their duty to Him, for them are built lofty rooms, one above another under which rivers flow (i.e. Paradise). (This is) the Promise of Allâh: and Allâh does not fail in (His) Promise.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:21: See you not that Allâh sends down water (rain) from the sky, and causes it to penetrate the earth, (and then makes it to spring up) as water-springs, and afterward thereby produces crops of different colours, and afterward they wither and you see them turn yellow; then He makes them dry and broken pieces. Verily, in this is a Reminder for men of understanding.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:22: Is he whose breast Allâh has opened to Islâm, so that he is in light from His Lord (as he who is a non-Muslim)? So woe to those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allâh! They are in plain error!
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:23: Allâh has sent down the Best Statement, a Book (this Qur’ân), its parts resembling each other (in goodness and truth) (and) oft-repeated. The skins of those who fear their Lord shiver from it (when they recite it or hear it). Then their skin and their heart soften to the remembrance of Allâh. That is the guidance of Allâh. He Guides therewith whom He wills; and whomever Allâh sends astray, for him there is no guide.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:24: Is he then, who will confront with his face the awful torment on the Day of Resurrection (as he who enters peacefully in Paradise)? And it will be said to the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers): "Taste what you used to earn!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:25: Those before them belied, and so the torment came on them from directions they perceived not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:26: So Allâh made them to taste the disgrace in the present life, but greater is the torment of the Hereafter if they only knew!
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:27: And indeed We have put forth for men, in this Qur’ân every kind of similitude in order that they may remember.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:28: An Arabic Qur’ân, without any crookedness (therein) in order that they may avoid all evil which Allâh has ordered them to avoid, fear Him and keep their duty to Him.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:29: Allâh puts forth a similitude: a (slave) man belonging to many partners (like those who worship others along with Allâh) disputing with one another, and a (slave) man belonging entirely to one master (like those who worship Allâh Alone). Are those two equal in comparison? All the praises and thanks be to Allâh! But most of them know not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:30: Verily you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) will die, and verily they (too) will die.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:31: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be disputing before your Lord.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:32: Then, who does more wrong than one who utters a lie against Allâh, and denies the truth [this Qur’ân, the Prophet (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and the Islâmic Monotheism] when it comes to him! Is there not in Hell an abode for the disbelievers?
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:33: And he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) who has brought the truth (this Qur’ân and Islâmic Monotheism) and (those who) believed therein (i.e. the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism), those are Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:34: They shall have all that they will desire with their Lord. That is the reward of Muhsinûn (good-doers - see the footnote of V.9:120).
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:35: So that Allâh may expiate from them the evil of what they did and give them the reward, according to the best of what they used to do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:36: Is not Allâh Sufficient for His slave? Yet they try to frighten you with those (whom they worship) besides Him! And whom Allâh sends astray, for him there will be no guide.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:37: And whomsoever Allâh guides, for him there will be no misleader. Is not Allâh All-Mighty, Possessor of Retribution?
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:38: And verily, if you ask them: "Who created the heavens and the earth?" Surely they will say: "Allâh (has created them)." Say: "Tell me then, the things that you invoke besides Allâh - if Allâh intended some harm for me, could they remove His harm? Or if He (Allâh) intended some mercy for me, could they withhold His Mercy?" Say: "Sufficient for me is Allâh; in Him those who trust (i.e. believers) must put their trust."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:39: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "O My people! Work according to your way, I am working (according to my way). Then you will come to know
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:40: "To whom comes a disgracing torment, and on whom descends an everlasting torment."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:41: Verily, We have sent down to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the Book (this Qur’ân) for mankind in truth. So whosoever accepts the guidance, it is only for his ownself, and whosoever goes astray, he goes astray only for his (own) loss. And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are not a Wakîl (trustee or disposer of affairs, or guardian) over them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:42: It is Allâh Who takes away the souls at the time of their death, and those that die not during their sleep. He keeps those (souls) for which He has ordained death and sends the rest for a term appointed. Verily, in this are signs for a people who think deeply.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:43: Have they taken (others) as intercessors besides Allâh? Say: "Even if they have power over nothing whatever and have no intelligence?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:44: Say: "To Allâh belongs all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you shall be brought back."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:45: And when Allâh Alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are filled with disgust (from the Oneness of Allâh توحيد الله) and when those (whom they obey or worship) besides Him [like all false deities other than Allâh, - it may be a Messenger, an angel, a pious man, a jinni, or any other creature even idols, graves of religious people, saints, priests, monks and others.] are mentioned, behold, they rejoice!
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:46: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "O Allâh! Creator of the heavens and the earth! All-Knower of the Ghaib (Unseen) and the seen! You will judge between your slaves about that wherein they used to differ."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:47: And those who did wrong (the polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh), if they had all that is in earth and therewith as much again, they verily, would offer it to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the evil torment; and there will become apparent to them from Allâh what they had not been reckoning.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:48: And the evils of that which they earned will become apparent to them, and that which they used to mock at will encircle them.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:49: When harm touches man, he calls to Us (for help); then when We have (rescued him from that harm and) changed it into a favour from Us, he says: "Only because of knowledge (that I possess) I obtained it." Nay, it is only a trial, but most of them know not!
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:50: Verily, those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:51: So, the evil results of that which they earned overtook them. And those who did wrong of these [people to whom you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) have been sent] will also be overtaken by the evil results (torment) for that which they earned; and they will never be able to escape.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:52: Do they not know that Allâh enlarges the provision for whom He wills, and straitens it (for whom He wills). Verily, in this are signs for the folk who believe!
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:53: Say: "O ‘Ibâdî (My slaves) who have transgressed against themselves (by committing evil deeds and sins)! Despair not of the Mercy of Allâh: verily, Allâh forgives all sins. Truly He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:54: "And turn in repentance and in obedience with true Faith (Islâmic Monotheism) to your Lord and submit to Him (in Islâm) before the torment comes upon you, (and) then you will not be helped.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:55: "And follow the best of that which is sent down to you from your Lord (i.e. this Qur’ân, do what it orders you to do and keep away from what it forbids), before the torment comes on you suddenly while you perceive not!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:56: Lest a person should say: "Alas, my grief that I was undutiful to Allâh (i.e. I have not done what Allâh has ordered me to do), and I was indeed among those who mocked [at the truth! i.e. Lâ ilâha illallâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh), the Qur’ân, and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and at the faithful believers]
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:57: Or (lest) he should say: "If only Allâh had guided me, I should indeed have been among the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:58: Or (lest) he should say when he sees the torment: "If only I had another chance (to return to the world), then I should indeed be among the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:59: Yes! Verily, there came to you My Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and you denied them, and were proud and were among the disbelievers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:60: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied against Allâh (i.e. attributed to Him sons, partners) - their faces will be black. Is there not in Hell an abode for the arrogant?
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:61: And Allâh will deliver those who are the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) to their places of success (Paradise). Evil shall touch them not, nor shall they grieve.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:62: Allâh is the Creator of all things, and He is the Wakîl (Trustee, Disposer of affairs, Guardian) over all things.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:63: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And those who disbelieve in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh, such are they who will be the losers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:64: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to the polytheists): "Do you order me to worship other than Allâh? O you fools!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:65: And indeed it has been revealed to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), as it was to those (Allâh’s Messengers) before you: "If you join others in worship with Allâh, (then) surely (all) your deeds will be in vain, and you will certainly be among the losers."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:66: Nay! But worship Allâh (Alone and none else), and be among the grateful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:67: They made not a just estimate of Allâh such as is due to Him. And on the Day of Resurrection the whole of the earth will be grasped by His Hand and the heavens will be rolled up in His Right Hand.Glorified be He, and High be He above all that they associate as partners with Him!
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:68: And the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth will swoon away, except him whom Allâh wills. Then it will be blown a second time, and behold they will be standing, looking on (waiting).
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:69: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord (Allâh, when He will come to judge among men): and the Book will be placed (open); and the Prophets and the witnesses will be brought forward; and it will be judged between them with truth, and they will not be wronged.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:70: And each person will be paid in full of what he did; and He is Best Aware of what they do.
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:71: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups till, when they reach it, the gates thereof will be opened (suddenly like a prison at the arrival of the prisoners). And its keepers will say, "Did not the Messengers come to you from yourselves, reciting to you the Verses of your Lord, and warning you of the Meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say: "Yes, but the Word of torment has been justified against the disbelievers!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:72: It will be said (to them): "Enter you the gates of Hell, to abide therein. And (indeed) what an evil abode of the arrogant!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:73: And those who kept their duty to their Lord (Al-Muttaqûn) will be led to Paradise in groups, till, when they reach it, and its gates will be opened (before their arrival for their reception) and its keepers will say: Salâmun ‘Alaikum (peace be upon you)! You have done well, so enter here to abide therein."
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:74: And they will say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh Who has fulfilled His Promise to us and has made us inherit (this) land. We can dwell in Paradise where we will; how excellent a reward for the (pious, good) workers!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.39:75: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne (of Allâh) from all round, glorifying the praises of their Lord (Allâh). And they (all the creatures) will be judged with truth. And it will be said, "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:2: The revelation of the Book (this Qur’ân) is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Knower.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:3: The Forgiver of sin, the Acceptor of repentance, the Severe in punishment, the Bestower (of favours). Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), to Him is the final return.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:4: None disputes in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh but those who disbelieve. So let not their ability of going about here and there through the land (for their purposes) deceive you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, for their ultimate end will be the Fire of Hell]!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:5: The people of Nûh (Noah) and the Confederates after them denied (their Messengers) before these; and every (disbelieving) nation plotted against their Messenger to seize him, and disputed by means of falsehood to refute therewith the truth. So I seized them (with punishment), and how (terrible) was My punishment!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:6: Thus has the Word of your Lord been justified against those who disbelieved, that they will be the dwellers of the Fire.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:7: Those (angels) who bear the Throne (of Allâh) and those around it glorify the praises of their Lord, and believe in Him, and ask forgiveness for those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh) (saying): "Our Lord! You comprehend all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who repent and follow Your Way, and save them from the torment of the blazing Fire!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:8: "Our Lord! And make them enter the ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens) which you have promised them - and to the righteous among their fathers, their wives, and their offspring! Verily, You are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:9: "And save them from (the punishment, for what they did of) the sins, and whomsoever You save from (the punishment for what he did of) the sins (i.e. pardon him) that Day, him verily, You have taken into mercy." And that is the supreme success.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:10: Those who disbelieve will be addressed (at the time of entering the Fire): "Allâh’s aversion was greater towards you (in the worldly life when you used to reject the Faith) than your aversion towards one another (now in the Fire of Hell, as you are now enemies to one another), when you were called to the Faith but you used to refuse."
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:11: They will say: "Our Lord! You have made us to die twice (i.e. we were dead in the loins of our fathers and dead after our life in this world), and You have given us life twice (i.e. life when we were born and life when we are Resurrected)! Now we confess our sins, then is there any way to get out (of the Fire)?" (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi,)
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:12: (It will be said): "This is because, when Allâh Alone was invoked (in worship) you disbelieved (denied), but when partners were joined to Him, you believed! So the judgement is only with Allâh, the Most High, the Most Great!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:13: It is He Who shows you His Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and sends down (rain with which grows) provision for you from the sky. And none remembers but those who turn (to Allâh in obedience and) in repentance (by begging His Pardon and by worshipping and obeying Him Alone and none else).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:14: So, call you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the believers) upon (or invoke) Allâh making (your) worship pure for Him (Alone) (by worshipping none but Him and by doing religious deeds sincerely for Allâh’s sake only and not to show off and not to set up rivals with Him in worship), however much the disbelievers (in the Oneness of Allâh) may hate (it).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:15: (He is Allâh) Owner of High Ranks and Degrees, the Owner of the Throne. He sends the revelation by His Command to any of His slaves He wills, that he (the person who receives revelation) may warn (men) of the Day of Mutual Meeting (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:16: The Day when they will (all) come out, nothing of them will be hidden from Allâh. Whose is the kingdom this Day? (Allâh Himself will reply to His Question): It is Allâh’s the One, the Irresistible!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:17: This Day shall every person be recompensed for what he earned. This Day no injustice (shall be done to anybody). Truly, Allâh is Swift in reckoning.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:18: And warn them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of the Day that is drawing near (i.e. the Day of Resurrection), when the hearts will be choking the throats, and they can neither return them (hearts) to their chests nor can they throw them out. There will be no friend, nor an intercessor for the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers), who could be given heed to.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:19: Allâh knows the fraud of the eyes, and all that the breasts conceal.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:20: And Allâh judges with truth, while those to whom they invoke besides Him, cannot judge anything. Certainly, Allâh! He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:21: Have they not travelled in the land and seen what was the end of those who were before them? They were superior to them in strength, and in the traces (which they left) in the land. But Allâh seized them with punishment for their sins. And none had they to protect them from Allâh.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:22: That was because there came to them their Messengers with clear evidence (proofs and signs) but they disbelieved (in them). So Allâh seized them (with punishment). Verily He is All-Strong, Severe in punishment.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:23: And indeed We sent Mûsâ (Moses) with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and a manifest authority,
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:24: To Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), Hâmân and Qârûn (Korah), but they called (him): "A sorcerer, a liar!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:25: Then, when he brought them the Truth from Us, they said: "Kill the sons of those who believe with him and let their women live"; but the plots of disbelievers are nothing but in vain!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:26: Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "Leave me to kill Mûsâ (Moses), and let him call his Lord (to stop me from killing him)! I fear that he may change your religion, or that he may cause mischief to appear in the land!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:27: Mûsâ (Moses) said: "Verily I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant who believes not in the Day of Reckoning!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:28: And a believing man of Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) family, who hid his faith said: "Would you kill a man because he says: My Lord is Allâh, and he has come to you with clear signs (proofs) from your Lord? And if he is a liar, upon him will be (the sin of) his lie; but if he is telling the truth, then some of that (calamity) wherewith he threatens you will befall on you." Verily, Allâh guides not one who is a Musrif (a polytheist, or a murderer who shed blood without a right, or those who commit great sins, oppressor, transgressor), a liar!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:29: "O my people! Yours is the kingdom today, you being dominant in the land. But who will save us from the Torment of Allâh, should it befall us?" Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "I show you only that which I see (correct), and I guide you only to the path of right policy!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:30: And he who believed said: "O my people! Verily, I fear for you a fate like that day (of disaster) of the Confederates (of old)!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:31: "Like the fate of the people of Nûh (Noah), and ‘Âd, and Thamûd and those who came after them. And Allâh wills no injustice for (His) slaves.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:32: "And, O my people! Verily, I fear for you the Day when there will be mutual calling (between the people of Hell and of Paradise)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:33: A Day when you will turn your backs and flee having no protector from Allâh. And whomsoever Allâh sends astray, for him there is no guide.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:34: And indeed Yûsuf (Joseph) did come to you, in times gone by, with clear signs, but you ceased not to doubt in that which he did bring to you: till when he died you said: "No Messenger will Allâh send after him." Thus Allâh leaves astray him who is a Musrif (a polytheist, an oppressor, a criminal, sinner who commit great sins) and a Murtâb (one who doubts Allâh’s Warning and His Oneness).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:35: Those who dispute about the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh, without any authority that has come to them, it is greatly hateful and disgusting to Allâh and to those who believe. Thus does Allâh seal up the heart of every arrogant, tyrant. (So they cannot guide themselves to the Right Path).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:36: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "O Hâmân! Build me a tower that I may arrive at the ways -
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:37: "The ways of the heavens, and I may look upon the Ilâh (God) of Mûsâ (Moses): But verily, I think him to be a liar." Thus it was made fair-seeming, in Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) eyes, the evil of his deeds, and he was hindered from the (Right) Path; and the plot of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) led to nothing but loss and destruction (for him).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:38: And the man who believed said: "O my people! Follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct [i.e. guide you to Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism with which Mûsâ (Moses) has been sent].
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:39: "O my people! Truly, this life of the world is nothing but a (quick passing) enjoyment, and verily, the Hereafter that is the home that will remain forever."
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:40: "Whosoever does an evil deed, will not be requited except the like thereof; and whosoever does a righteous deed, whether male or female and is a true believer (in the Oneness of Allâh), such will enter Paradise, where they will be provided therein (with all things in abundance) without limit.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:41: "And O my people! How is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:42: "You invite me to disbelieve in Allâh (and in His Oneness), and to join partners in worship with Him of which I have no knowledge; and I invite you to the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:43: "No doubt you call me to (worship) one who cannot grant (me) my request (or respond to my invocation) in this world or in the Hereafter. And our return will be to Allâh, and Al-Musrifûn (i.e. polytheists and arrogants, those who commit great sins, the transgressors of Allâh’s set limits): they shall be the dwellers of the Fire!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:44: "And you will remember what I am telling you, and my affair I leave it to Allâh. Verily, Allâh is the All-Seer of (His) slaves."
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:45: So Allâh saved him from the evils that they plotted (against him), while an evil torment encompassed Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:46: The Fire, they are exposed to it, morning and afternoon. And on the Day when the Hour will be established (it will be said to the angels): "Cause Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people to enter the severest torment!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:47: And, when they will dispute in the Fire, the weak will say to those who were arrogant: "Verily, we followed you: can you then take from us some portion of the Fire?"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:48: Those who were arrogant will say: "We are all (together) in this (Fire)! Verily, Allâh has judged between (His) slaves!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:49: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers (angels) of Hell: "Call upon your Lord to lighten for us the torment for a day!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:50: They will say: "Did there not come to you, your Messengers with (clear) evidence (and signs)?" They will say: "Yes." They will reply: "Then call (as you like)! And the invocation of the disbelievers is nothing but in vain (as it will not be answered by Allâh)!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:51: Verily, We will indeed make victorious Our Messengers and those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) in this world’s life and on the Day when the witnesses will stand forth, (i.e. Day of Resurrection) -
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:52: The Day when their excuses will be of no profit to Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh). Theirs will be the curse, and theirs will be the evil abode (i.e. painful torment in Hell-fire).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:53: And, indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) the guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture [i.e. the Taurât (Torah)] -
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:54: A guide and a reminder for men of understanding.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:55: So be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Verily, the Promise of Allâh is true, and ask forgiveness for your fault and glorify the praises of your Lord in the ‘Ashî (i.e. the time period after the midnoon till sunset) and in the Ibkâr (i.e. the time period from early morning or sunrise till before midnoon) [it is said that, that means the five compulsory congregational Salât (prayers) or the ‘Asr and Fajr prayers].
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:56: Verily those who dispute about the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh, without any authority having come to them, there is nothing else in their breasts except pride [to accept you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) as a Messenger of Allâh and to obey you]. They will never have it (i.e. Prophethood which Allâh has bestowed upon you). So seek refuge in Allâh (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم from the arrogants). Verily, it is He Who is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:57: The creation of the heavens and the earth is indeed greater than the creation of mankind; yet, most of mankind know not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:58: And not equal are the blind and those who see; nor are (equal) those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism), and do righteous good deeds, and those who do evil. Little do you remember!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:59: Verily, the Hour (Day of Judgement) is surely coming, there is no doubt about it, yet most men believe not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:60: And your Lord said: "Invoke Me, [i.e. believe in My Oneness (Islâmic Monotheism) and ask Me for anything] I will respond to your (invocation). Verily! Those who scorn My worship [i.e. do not invoke Me, and do not believe in My Oneness, (Islâmic Monotheism)] they will surely enter Hell in humiliation!"
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:61: Allâh, it is He Who has made the night for you that you may rest therein and the day for you to see. Truly, Allâh is full of Bounty to mankind; yet, most of mankind give no thanks.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:62: That is Allâh, your Lord, the Creator of all things: Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). How then are you turning away (from Allâh, by worshipping others instead of Him)?
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:63: Thus were turned away those who used to deny the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:64: Allâh, it is He Who has made for you the earth as a dwelling place and the sky as a canopy, and has given you shape and made your shapes good (looking) and has provided you with good things. That is Allâh, your Lord: so Blessed be Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:65: He is the Ever Living, Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He); so invoke Him making your worship pure for Him Alone (by worshipping Him Alone, and none else, and by doing righteous deeds sincerely for Allâh’s sake only, and not to show off, and not setting up rivals with Him in worship). All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:66: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I have been forbidden to worship those whom you worship besides Allâh, since there have come to me evidence from my Lord; and I am commanded to submit (in Islâm) to the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:67: It is He, Who has created you (Adam) from dust, then from a Nutfah [mixed semen drops of male and female sexual discharge (i.e. Adam’s offspring)] then from a clot (a piece of coagulated blood), then brings you forth as an infant, then (makes you grow) to reach the age of full strength, and afterwards to be old (men and women)- though some among you die before,- and that you reach an appointed term in order that you may understand.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:68: It is He Who gives life and causes death. And when He decides upon a thing He says to it only: "Be!" - and it is.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:69: See you not those who dispute about the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh? How are they turning away [from the truth, (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism to the falsehood (i.e. polytheism)]?
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:70: Those who deny the Book (this Qur’ân), and that with which We sent Our Messengers (i.e. to worship none but Allâh Alone sincerely, and to reject all false deities and to confess resurrection after the death for recompense) they will come to know (when they will be cast into the Fire of Hell).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:71: When iron collars will be rounded over their necks, and the chains, they shall be dragged along,
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:72: In the boiling water, then they will be burned in the Fire.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:73: Then it will be said to them: "Where are (all) those whom you used to join in worship as partners
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:74: "Besides Allâh"? They will say: "They have vanished from us: Nay, we did not invoke (worship) anything before." Thus Allâh leads astray the disbelievers.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:75: That was because you had been exulting in the earth without any right (by worshipping others instead of Allâh and by committing crimes), and that you used to rejoice extremely (in your error).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:76: Enter the gates of Hell to abide therein: and (indeed) what an evil abode of the arrogant!
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:77: So be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم); verily, the Promise of Allâh is true and whether We show you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم in this world) some part of what We have promised them, or We cause you to die then still it is to Us they all shall be returned.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:78: And, indeed We have sent Messengers before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): of some of them We have related to you their story. And of some We have not related to you their story, and it was not given to any Messenger that he should bring a sign except by the Leave of Allâh. But, when comes the Commandment of Allâh, the matter will be decided with truth, and the followers of falsehood will then be lost.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:79: Allâh, it is He Who has made cattle for you, that you may ride on some of them, and of some you eat.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:80: And you have (many other) benefits from them, and that you may reach by their means a desire that is in your breasts (i.e. carry your goods, loads, etc.), and on them and on ships you are carried.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:81: And He shows you His Ayât (signs and proofs) (of His Oneness in all the above-mentioned things). Which, then of the Ayât (signs and proofs) of Allâh do you deny?
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:82: Have they not travelled through the earth and seen what was the end of those before them? They were more in number than them and mightier in strength, and in the traces (they have left behind them) in the land; yet all that they used to earn availed them not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:83: Then when their Messengers came to them with clear proofs, they were glad (and proud) with that which they had of the knowledge (of worldly things). And that at which they used to mock, surrounded them (i.e. the punishment).
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:84: So when they saw Our punishment, they said: "We believe in Allâh Alone and reject (all) that we used to associate with Him as (His) partners.
Al-Hilali & Khan.40:85: Then their Faith (in Islâmic Monotheism) could not avail them when they saw Our punishment. (Like) this has been the way of Allâh in dealing with His slaves. And there the disbelievers lost utterly (when Our Torment covered them).
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:2: A revelation from (Allâh), the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:3: A Book whereof the Verses are explained in detail - a Qur’ân in Arabic for people who know.
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:4: Giving glad tidings [of Paradise to the one who believes in the Oneness of Allâh (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism) and fears Allâh much (abstains from all kinds of sins and evil deeds) and loves Allâh much (performing all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)], and warning (of punishment in the Hell-Fire to the one who disbelieves in the Oneness of Allâh), but most of them turn away, so they hear not.
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:5: And they say: "Our hearts are under coverings (screened) from that to which you invite us; and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a screen: so work you (on your way); verily, we are working (on our way)."
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:6: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your Ilâh (God) is One Ilâh (God - Allâh), therefore take Straight Path to Him (with true Faith - Islâmic Monotheism) and obedience to Him, and seek forgiveness of Him. And woe to Al-Mushrikûn (the polytheists, idolaters, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh).
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:7: Those who give not the Zakât and they are disbelievers in the Hereafter.
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:8: Truly, those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, for them will be an endless reward that will never stop (i.e. Paradise).
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:9: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Do you verily disbelieve in Him Who created the earth in two Days? And you set up rivals (in worship) with Him? That is the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
Al-Hilali & Khan.41:10: He placed therein (i.e. the earth) firm mountains from above it, and He blessed it, and measured therein its sustenance (for its dwellers) in four Days equal (i.e. all these four days were equal in the length of time) for all those who ask (about its creation).
